tei:div.tei:p: 4 5 4ba ba nga nga ring ༷ 〉 che ma su ba su — rto 4༷rdo k+tor (zerngoXshes —༵shā rte ༷ 4/ ༷ / ) tsho rge 4 ༷༷ ḍashe7 ṭa 4 ༅ ༅
kye / / sted/rtsom|phyogs bsgrigs tshe ring gi rdo da / de de / de rdo rdo rdo de bye ༅ tshi
ṇa //| —ོ— //༷ shā — rnyi ṭ+wāṃ sdu3‘rjo— nga — nya 4 ༷ gli — ༵ — — 4la/// 4 /nyi ne tsho gzhung—shā di'i~Xbyedapogacodapadonagrub(/yon〉dang snying bo tshe ring(g.yas)gnyis kyi 'dra par/
gzhung 'di'i rtsom pa po gcod pa don grub( g.yon) dang snying bo sko ring( g.yas) gnyis kyi 'dra par/
dang / de / de de (do / ra / de / de rdo / de /
byung/ / gcod pa don grub daja snyija bo che rija gi ched rtsom pyogs bsgrigs/mcho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang/
bsnye/ / gcod ma don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtson phyogs bsgrigs/mcho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang/

sngon 'gro'i gtam/sdon 'gro'i gtam/gnas 'dzoms po gling dkar stod kyi yul/ /'brug lhang lhang nor bu'i gdan gyi steng / /skad lhang lhang khu byug grag pa'i sa/ /zhe lhang lhang co ga 'gyur ba'i gnas/ /dpal bde mchog nor bu'i pho brang yod/ /lto 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan gcig yin/ /de'i nang na seng chen rgyal po bzhugs/ /khrod mgo nag bod kyi skyabs mgon red/ /dgra btsan po 'dul ba'i tho chen lags/ /gong spyan ras gzigs kyis lung bstan gnang / /pha spre'u sems dpa'i rigs rgyud la/ /blo shes rig can gyi bu gsum 'khrungs/ /bu che ba de ye rigs rgyud la/ /gling che rgyud zer ba phrun gyis chags/ /bu 'bring ba de ⑪rigs rgyud la/ /

sngon 'gro'i gtam/sdon 'gro'igatam/gnasa'adzomasapo gling dkar stod kyi yul/ /'brug lhang lhang nor bu'i gdan gyi steng / /skad lhang lhang khu byug grag pa'i sa/ /zhe lhang lhang co ga 'gyur ba'i gnas/ /dpal bde mchog nor bu'i pho brang yod/ /lho'adzam bu gling gi rgyan gcig yin/ /de'i nang na seng chen rgyal po bzhugs/ /khyod mgo nag bod kyi skyabasamagon red/ /dgra btsan po 'dul ba'i tho chen lags/ /gong spyan rasagazigasakyisalung bstanaganang / /pha spre'u sem4dpa'i rigasargyud la/ /blozhesarig can gyi bu gsuma'akhrungs/ /bu che bde yirigasargyud la/ /gling che rgyud zer ba lhun gyisachags/ /bu 'bring ba de yirigasargyud la/ /

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gling 'bring rgyud zer ba phrun gyis chags/ /bu chung ba de ye rigs rgyud la/ /gling chung rgyud zer ba lhan gyis chags/ /gling seng chen ma/go nag mi ye rgyal/ /dgra nag po ma lus meg med bcom/ /de'i nang du phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi dang / /dgra btsan po rdzong chen bco brgyad dag/gcig ma shor gling gis dbang du bsdu sa/ /mthong ma myong rin chen 'bum gyi gter/ /gnas mchog gyur gling dkar sto/da la drangs/ /ma 'gro drug sems can bde la bkod/ /lho 'dzam bu gling la bde byad bskrun/ /zhes gling dkar stod kyi shis ljo ngas dang smug po jo nga gi chags rim/gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i mdzad 'phrin bcas 'dus pa'i tshigs bcad nor bu'i phreng ba 'di sngon la btang nas/ 'dir brjod par be+e ba'i gzhi dam pa be+e gsar du brtsams pa'i〈gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs〉zhes pa'i dpe deb kyi brjod bya'i snying bo dang de'i thun min gyi khyad chos gtso bo 'ga' lags so/ /spyor gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni brjod don rgya che zhing gting zab 2

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gling 'bring rgyud zer ba lhun gyisachags/ /bu chung bde yirigasargyud la/ /gling chung rgyud zer ba lhun gyisachags/ /gling seng chen mgo nag miyisargyal/ /dgra nag po malusameg med bcom/ /de'i nang du phyogasabazhi'i dgra bzhi dang / /dgra btsan po rdzong chen bco brgyad dag/gcig ma shor gling gi4dbang du bsdus/ /mthong ma myong rin chen 'bumagyi gter/ /gnasamachog gyur gling dkar stod la drangs/ /ma 'gro drug sem4can bde labakod/ /lho'adzam bu gling labade skyid bskrun/ /zhesagling dkar stod kyi yulaljong4dang smug poldo nga gi chagasarim/gling rje ge sar rgyalapo'i mdzad 'phrin bcasa'adusapa'i tshigasabacad nor bu'i phreng ba 'di sngon la btang nas/ 'dir brjod par bya ba'i gzhi dmapa ni gsar du brtsamasapa'i〈gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs〉zhesapa'i dpe deb kyi brjod bya'i snying bo dang de'i thun min gyi khyad chosagatso bo 'ga' lag4so/ /2 spyir gling rje ge sar rgyalapo'i sgrung ni brjod don rgya che zhing gting zab

sngo na 'gro'i gtam/la/ rjod tshig phun sum tshogs shing nyams 'gyur ldan pa zhig dang / da lta'adzam gling steng gi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus kyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom zhig yin par ma zad/ krung go'i rig gnas bang mdzod kyi khrod dang tha na 'dzam gling rig gnas bang mdzod kyi khrod du'ang 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba'i rin chen nor bu zhig kyang yin par brten/ dpyad rtsom gcig gnyis tsam dang yang na dpe deb gcig gnyis tsam gyis zab yangs rgya mtshol 'jings ltar dpog dka' ba'i mthar sgo la thabs med pa zhig yin pa las gzhan/ nged cag rjes ma rnams kyi mi rabs nas mi rabs bar du'ang gting mtha' dpog dka' ba zhig yin pa ni gdon mi za'o/ /yin na'ang kho bo sogs la gling je ge sar rgyal po la mi phyed pa'i dad 'dun zlog tu med pa dang gling sgrung gi 'phrin las bskal pa nas bskal pa'i bar du dar rgyas yong ba'i 'dun pa chen po mchis pa'i slad du bgrang bya phal cher nyi shu'i ring la las don 'dir 'bad 'bungs lhod med bgyis pa'i 'bras bu la dpe deb bco brgyad lhag brtsams pa dang legs sgrig byas te phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du khyab yod do/ /da reb kyi dpe deb 'di'i nang du sngon chad kyi dpyad rtsom dang dpe deb sogs kyi nang du ma bkod pa'i don snying gsar shos dang zhib 'jug gi khyab khongs kyang gsar ba skor zhig 'dus 'dug la/ khyad par rang re'i mkhas pa bgres gzhon rnam sa kyis zhib 'jug bgyis ma myong ba'i gter sgrung gi rigs dang sprul sgyur gyi skor/ bud med kyi snang brnyan dang go gnas thob thang / chibs pa'i khyad chos/ mi sna gtso bo ngo sprod/ ming brda'i 'grel 3

sngon 'gro'i gtam/la/ rjod tshig phun sum tshogasashing nyamasa'agyur ldan pazhig dang / da lta'adzamagling steng gi chesaring ba'i lo rgyu4kyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom zhig yin par ma zad/ krung go'i rig gnasabang mdzod kyi khrod dang tha na 'dzamagling rig gnasabang mdzod kyi khrod du'ang 'od zer rnam par 'phroba'i rin chen nor bu zhig kyang yin par brten/ dpyad rtsom gcig gnyisatsam dang yang na dpe deb gcig gnyisatsamagyisazab yangasargya mtsho'i 'jingasaltar dpog dka' ba'i mthar sgrol thab4med pa zhig yin pa lasagazhan/ nged cag rjesamarnam4kyi mirabasan4mi rabayobar du'ang gting mtha' dpog dka' ba zhig yin pa ni gdon miza'o/ /yin na'ang kho bo sogasal gling rje ge sar rgyalapo lami phyed pa'i dad 'dun zlog tu med pa dang gling sgrung gi 'phrin layobaskal pan4bskal pa'i bar du dar rgyasayong ba'i 'dun pa chen po mchisapa'i slad du bgrang bya phal cher nyi shu'i ring la lasadon 'dir 'bad 'bungasalhod med bgyisapa'i 'brasabu ladape deb bco brgyad lhag brtsams pa dang legasasgrig byasate phyogasabazhi mtshamasabargyad du khyab yod do/ /da reb kyi dpe deba'adi'i nang du sngon chad kyi dpyad rtsomadang dpodeb sogasakyi nang du mabakod pa'i don snying gsar shosadang zhib 'jug gi khyab khong4kyang gsar ba skor zhig 'dusa'adug la/ khyad par rang re'i mkhasapa bgresagazhon rnamasakyisazhib 'jug bgyisamamyong ba'i gter sgrung gi rigasadang sprulasgyur gyi skor/ bud med kyi snang brnyan dang go gnasathob thang / chibasapa'i khyad chos/ misna gtso bo ngo sprod/ ming brda'i 'aṭ+wāṃl

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bshad bca4kyi nang don gsalazhing dag par brjod yod par mazad/gling sgrung zhib 'jug la phan thogasache ba'i dpyad rtsomaste/ dmangasakhrod rtsom rig gi zhib 'jug dang dge lugasapa'i dgon pa sku 'bumadagon sde'i zhib 'jug bod kyi skad yig bkolaspyod bcasakyi dpyad rtsomaskor zhig kyang ṭ+wādam4ba/da bgyisapa'adisadape deb 'dir legasathog legasabartsegs— nus/ ༵nā dihākyā du brtsamasapa'i dpe deb 'dir gzhan dang mimatshungasapa'i khyad chosagatso bo bzhi yod paste/ gcig ni/ gling sgrung zhib 'jug gi khyab khongasagasar ba dang / zhib 'jug gi bya yulagasar bayin pas/mkhasapargan dar gzhon gsumagusabaltasakyang bsamacho gsar ba dang ltab gsar ba/ zhib 'jug byed thab4gsar ba bcasakyi snang tshul bcosamin du ster ba lags/ gnyisani/ gling sgrung gi zhib 'jug khrod du sgrung dpe 'ba' zhig zhib 'jug byed pa tsam min par/ de yang gling sgrung dang 'brel ba'i bod kyi dmang4khrod rtsom rig dang bod brgyud nang bstan chosalugs/phyi gling pa'i snyan rtsomache khag rigs/ rang rgyalagyi snyan rtsomaring sho4skor bcasalazhib bsdur gang leg4bgyisate dpyad gtamagasar ba bton yod par ma zad/ ltabangan pa dang kun slong ngan pa sogasaladagag bzhag spang gsum gyi lam nasadapyad gtamagand la phog pa brjod yod/ gsum ni/gling sgrung gi dpyad rtsomadang bod rig pa'i dpyad rtsom gzhan dag skor te gaṭ+wāṃsalhan du bdamasabakod byasayod pas/ 'dir dpyad rtsomami'adra ba

gcod pa don spub dang snyeng bo zo ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /bshad bcas kyi nang don gsal zhing dag par brjod yod par ma zad/gling sgrung zhib 'jug la phan thogs che ba'i dpyad rtsom ste/ dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi zhib 'jug dang dge lugs pa'i dgon pa sku 'bum dgon sde'i zhib 'jug bod kye skad yig bkol spyod bcas kyi dpyad rtsom skor zhig kyang bdams bkod bgyis pa 'dis dpe deb 'dir legs thog legs brtsegasakyi nus pa thon 'dugad reb gsar du brtsams pa'i dpe deb 'dir gzhan dang mi mtshungasapa'i khyad chos gtso bo bzhi yod pa ste/ gcig ni/ gling sgrung zhib 'jug gi khyab khongs gsar ba dang / zhib 'jug gi be+e rnal gsar ba yin pas/mkhas pa rgan dar gzhon gsum sus bltas kyang bsam blo gsar ba dang ltab gsar ba/ zhib 'jug byed thabs gsar ba bcas kyi snang tshal bcos min du ster ba lags/ gnyis ni/ gling sgrung gi zhib 'jug khrod du sgrung dpe 'ba' zhig zhib 'jug byed pa tsam min par/ de yang gling sgrung dang 'brel ba'i bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig dang bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs/phyi 1nga pa'i snyan rtsom che khag rigs/ rang rgyal gyi snyan rtsom ring shos skor bcas la zhib bsdur gang legs bgyis te dpyad gtam gsar ba bton yod par ma zad/ ltab ngan pa dang kun slong ngan pa sogs la dgag bzhag spang gsum gyi lam nas dpyad gtam gnad la phog pa brjod yod/ gsum ni/gling sgrung gi dpyad stom dang bod rig pa'i dpyad rtsom gzhan dag skor te gnyis lhan du bdams bkod byas yod pas/ 'dir dpyad rtsom mi 'dra ba 4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/dag phan tshun zhib bsdur bgyis te zhib 'jug byas na go ba mi 'dra ba dang khyad chos na 'dra ba len rgyu yod pa dang gcig gling sgrung gi dpyad rtsom dang bod rig pa'i dpyad rtsom gzhan dag phyi tshur nas bltas na brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed tshig dag so so yin yang don dngos su gling sgrung gi brjod bya'i don de bod rig pa'i khyab khongs so sor 'brel med pa gcig kyang med phyir gling sgrung zhib 'jug gi khyab rgya je che dang / zhib 'jug gi zab rgya je yangs/zhib 'jug gi chu tshad je mthor gtong ba bcas kyi thad la phan nus chen po mchis pa dang gnyis/ da dung gling sgrung zhib 'jug thad la shes bya mang po gsog pa dang bod rig pa'i dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha mang po bsdus na zhib 'jug gi rin thang dang rigs lam ji legs sa 'gro thub pa dang gsum gyi thad du phan thogs mi dman pa mchis pa sus kyang bston du sted/ bzhi ni/ gling sgrung dpyad stom dag gi khungs lung btsun zhing dpyad pa nan mo bton yod cing / khyad par du gling sgrung nang nas lung drangs pa dag gzhan gyi glegasabam las thad kar bkod pa min par/ de yang 'byel yod sgrung dpe mang po gsal bor bklags te dbye zhib brgyud nas don dang mthun pa'i skor rnamasadrangs nas bkod yo da par brten/ dper 'jog gi nus pa gal chen thon ngo da par ma zad/ dpyad rtsom gyi phan nus kyang je cher btang yod/lar kho bo cag gi bsam par gling sgrung gi zhib 'jug dpyad rtsom gyi dpe deb par skrun bgyis pa dang bstun nas zhib 'jug gi chu tshad je mthor gtong rgyu 'di gal 'gangs shin tu che snyam pa dang / khor yug gi las grogs5

sngon 'gro'i gtam/dag phan tshun zhib bsdur bgyisate zhib 'jug byasan go bami 'dra bdang khyad chosami'adra b.len rgyu yod padabagacig gling sgrung gi dpyad rtsomadang bod rig pa'i dpyad rtsoyogazhanadag phyi tshulanasabaltasan brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed tshig dag sosoyin yang don dngosasagling sgrung gi brjod bya'i donade bod rig pa'i khyab khongasasosor 'brel med pagacig kyang med phyir gling sgrung zhib 'jug gi khyab rgya je che dang / zhib 'jug gi zab rgya je yangs/zhib 'jug gi chu tshad je mthor gtong ba bca4kyi thad la phan nusachen po mchiyopa dang gnyis/ da dung gling sgrung zhib 'jug thad lashesabya mang po gsog pa dang bod rig pa'i dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha mang po bsdusan zhib 'jug gi rin thang dang rigasalamaje legasasu'agro thub pa dang gsum gyi thad du phan thogasami dman pa mchisapa susakyang bsnyon du med/ bzhi ni/ gling sgrung dpyad rtsomadag gi khungasalung btsun zhing dpyad pa nan mobaton yod cing / khyad par du gling sgrung nang nasalung drang4pa dag gzhan gyi glegasabam lasathad kur bkod pa min par/ de yang 'brel yod sgrung dpe mang po gsal bor bklagasate dbye zhibabargyud nasadonadang mthun pa'i skor rnamasadrangasanasabakod yod par brten/ dper 'jog gi nu4pa galachen thon yod par mazad/ dpyad rtsom gyi phan nusakyang je cher btang yod/lar kho bo cag gi bsamapar gling sgrung gi zhib 'jug dpyad rtsom gyi dpe deb par skrun bgyiyopa dang bstun nasazhib 'jug gi chu tshad je mthor gtong rgyu 'di gal 'gangasashin tuche snyams dang / khor yug gi la4gro~Xs

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rnamasadang zhib 'jug pa rgan pa lalayokyang gling sgrung zhib 'jug gi dpodeb par skrun gnang ste bkraman bloldan semasacan kun la phan 'brasache bar ma zad/ mi rab4rje4mdag la'ang mdzub ston gyi phan 'bra4bsam gyisami khyab pa yod cesayang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ rang nyid kyisakyang blogasal slob ma rnam4labaslab gzhi zhig khasnon bgyisan bzang ma gtogasangan med par bsamasanasapar skrun bgyid par blomathun pa yin/srid pa'i khadaper shing mdzer med rgya rdzong nagasan med/ mi skyon med 'dzamabu gling na med zer ba ltar/ gsar rtsom gyi zhib 'jug ched deb 'dir lasagrogasapa dang zhib 'jug pa tshosagadeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang yod mod/ 'on te kho bo sogasald dung zhib 'jug gi chu tshad dang nyamasamyong bcasakyi thad du mi 'dang sadang zhan cha yod srid pas/ khyed blo grosakyi rnam dpyod yangasapa'i ched mkhasapa rnamasakyisamadzub ston gnang bar snying thag pa na4thug4rje che zhu/zhe4gzhung 'di'i rtsomapa posaspyi lo2004lo'i zla1tshes25nyin gna' mkhar zi ling grong khyer du sbyar ba dge'o/ /

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rnams dang zhib 'jug pa rgan pa la las kyang gleng sgrung zhib 'jug gi dpe deb par skrun gnang ste bkram na sgo lda na sems can kun la phan 'bras che bar ma zad/ mi rabs rjes ma dag la'ang mdzub ston gyi phan 'bras bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod ces yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ rang nyid kyis kyang blo gsal khrob ma rnams la bslab gzhi zhig kha sgon brgyas na bzang ma gtogasangan rnged par bsams nas par skrun bgyid par blo mthun pa yin/srid pa'i kha dper shing mdzer med rgya rdzong nags na med/ mi spyon med 'dzam sgo gleng na med zer ba ltar/ gsar rtsom gyi zhib 'jug ched deb 'dir las grogs pa dang zhib 'jug pa tshos gdeng 'jog tshad ma/thon po gnang yod mod/ 'on te kho bo sogs la da dung zhib 'jug gi chu tshad dang nyams myong bcas byu thad du mi 'dang sa dang zhan cha yod srid pas/ khyed blo gros kyi rnam dpyod yangs pa'i ched mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzub ston gnang bar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu/zhes gzhung 'di'i rtsom pa pos spyi lo2004lo'i zla1ches25nyin gna' mkhar zi ling grong khyer du sbyar ba dge'o/ /

dkar chagadakar chagagling sgrung lasa'aphrosapa'i khor yug srung skyob kyi 'du shesaskor gleng ba (1)gling sgrung la4rta'i spyi tshogasakyi go gnasamado tsam gleng ba/ (13)gling sgrung lasasprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/ (31)gling sgrung du bod gdod ma'i lhasrung skor rgyud 'dzin byasapa/ (49)gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gosaskor ragasatsam gleng ba/ (57)gling sgrung nang gi phu nu sumacu'i skor bshad pa/ (72)gter sgrung rigasakyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/ (83)gling sgrung〈dmyalagling mun parang gsal〉gyi sgyu rtsal khyad chosaskor gleng ba/ (108)sgrung pa gragasacan tshe ring dbang 'dus/ (120)sgrung pa gragasacan gu ru rgyalamatshan/ (126)sgrung pa gragasacan zla bgrag4pa/ (134)gling sgrung gcesabatusadebabazhi ba〈hor gling g.yula'agyed〉legasasgrig gi skor ragasatsamabarjod pa/ (1/0)

dkar chagadakar gagling sgrung las 'phros pa'i khor yug srung skyob kyi 'du shes skor gleng /ba /(/////gling sgrung las rta'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas mdo tsam gleng ba/ (13)gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/ (31)gling sgrung du bod gdod ma'i lha sgrung skor rgyud 'dzin byas pa/ (49)gleng sgrung nang gi 6da med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor rags tsam gleng ba/ (57)gling sgrung nang gi 4 nu sum cu'i skor bshad pa/ (72)gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/ (83)gling sgrung〈dmyal gling mun pa rang g.yi〉gyi sgyu rtsal ga chos skor gleng ba/ (108)sgrung pa grags can tshe ring dbang 'dus/ (120)sgrung pa grags can gu ru rgyal mtshan/ (126)sgrung pa grags can zla ba grags pa/ (134)gling sgrung gces btus deb bzhi ba〈hor gling ga ga'abyed〉legasasgrig gi skor rags tsam brjod pa/ (140)1

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gling sgrung〈hor gling g.yula'agyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/ (162)gling sgrung gce4btu4kyi sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legasasgrig gi ming brda gtso bo'i skor gyi 'grelabashad/ (191)mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug skor/ (234)mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi ge sar sgrung gi myur skyob skor/ (244)mtsho sngon gyi ge sar sgrung gi bya ba'i skor/ (260)glu gar〈hor gling g.yula'agyed〉la bltasarjesakyi 'char snang /(266)glu gar chen mo〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉la rag4tsam dpyad pa/(272)ra nga rgyal gyi che4ring ba'i lorgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsomagasumarob tsam gleng ba/ (278)bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/ (293)rma 'bri'i 'byung khungasakyi gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gro4tshogs/ (308)bod brgyud nang bstan kun 'dusazhalathang chen molasagling sgrub skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mtshamasasbyor mdor bsdus/ (316)amado chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangasakhrod rtsom rig skor paragasatsam dpyad pa/ (340)

gling sgrung las 'phros pa'i khor yug srung skyob kye 'du shes skor gleng ba/yug las byung ba'i 'bag btsog gi gad snyigs kho na yin no/ /gnyas pa/ gling jing gi bla gnas las thon pa'i khor yug grung skyob kyi 'du shes/'dzam gling bu mo'i rna rgyan du gyur pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus snyan ngag ring bo ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung gi nang du ma zhes pa'i tha snyad bkol spyod byas pa cung khyab brdal yin zhing bla las thon pa'i khyad 'phags kyi nus pa'ang ldab 'gyur rgyas mtho ba'i snang ba zhig bcos min du ster/ spyir bla zhes pa'am/ brla zhesapa 'di ni gna' bo'i dus nas bzung bod rang gi rig gnas khrod du rgyun 'byams ga gyur yod/ de ni〈gtsug lag rtsis kyi sngon 'gro rab gsal me long〉las bla ni srog gi ma ru bzhed ces pa dang thog ma'i mas po'am khrag rgyun gcig pa'i nye tshan du bshad pa/ yang na rus rgyud kyi lha'am rus rgyud kyi mtshon rtags su bshad pa la sogs pa'i bshad rgyun yo da pa dang / 'brel ngo da kyi tshig mdzod dag las kyang / bla ni steng dang gong / klad dang ste mo/ma/chog dang gtso bo sogs la 'jug par bshad/ mdor na de ni gna' bo'i bod kyi rig gnas khrod du rgyun 'khyams sa gyur pa dang / lo rgyus 'phel rim dang chos lugs 'phel rgyas gnyis kyi thad go gnas nges can 'dzin pa'i snang tshal gyi mtshon rtags shig yin par snyam/ gna' bo'i lo rgyus khrod du dgra'am gnyen gang rung la rang rang gi bla gnas yod par bshad de/ dusargyun gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du mi ga ge mo zhig 'drer skrag nas bla 'khyams zhes mang po thos rgyu yo da pa dang / der bla 'bod dang ma 'gug ma blu sogs kyi cho ga 5

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bsgrubasan phyir 'gug thub par grags/ blazhesapade semasaldan zhig gam semasamed gang yinarung semayoldan du btang ste/ kun gyisatshor dka' ba'igan4shig lasba bar byed pa dang / rang nyid bgegasabar chad dang nyer 'tshe kun la4gzholaphyir srog gi skyabasarten du bcol ba yin/ de bzhin gling sgrung lasakyang gna' bo'i bod mi'i 'du shesade mthong thub ste/bla'i dang blamatsho/ blashing dang blamakhar/ bla g.yudang bla g.yag bla 'brong dang mabya sogasayod bltabu'o/ / ge sar rgyal po'i blari ni zachen spomar yin pa dang galate rma chen spomarar phog thug btang na ge sar la yid ma rangasapa dang mabakur geyin zhing / der yod kyi mi kun gyis mchod bkur blamed bgyi4te mirabasanasamirabalobar rgyun bsringasapasarngam zhing brjid pa'i gangasari g.ya' dag pa zhig lhang nger 'gying yod pa de'o/ / dper na/ (hor gling g.yula'agyed〉du/ rma stod 'od kyi gas4mkhar nas/ / rma rgyalasbomar mthu bo che/ / dung khrab dung rmog sku lagasol/ / rin chena'abar ba'i mda' dar brgyan/ / dkar gsaladung gi phreng ba bsnams/ / mda' dar g.yasal ral gri g.yon/ / seng ge dkar mochib4subacibs/ / 'ja' 'od gur gyi lding khang nas/ / mda' gzhu 'khor gsum gyi li li/ / 'khor du lhaphun stong gisabaskor/ / 'ja' 'od smug klong ko ro ro/ / zhesasemasamed kyi ri bo zhig sem4ldan du btang nasagusapa dang skyab4bcol/ dad pa dang yerangasabyed do/ / rma rgyal spom ra ni sbyib rmog 'khor gsum mnabasapa/ mda' gzhu mdung gsumathogasapa/

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched stom phyogs bsgrigs/bsgrubs na phyir 'gug thub par grags/ ma zhes pa de sem/sa ldan zhig gam sems med gang yin rung sems ldan du ba7nga ste/ kun gyis tshor dka' ba'i gnas shig la sba bar byed pa dang / rang nyid bgegs bar chad dang nyer 'tshe kun las gzhol phyir srog gi skyabs rten du bcol ba yin/ de bzhin gling sgrung las kyang gna' bo'i bod mi'i 'du shes de mthong thub ste/ma ri dang bla mtsho/ ma shing dang bla mkhar/ bla g.yudang bla g.yag bla'abrong dang bla bya sogs yod blta bu'o/ / ge sar rgyal po'i bla ri ni rma chen spom ra yin pa dang gal te rma chen spo yor ra phog thug btang na ge sar la yid ma rangs pa dang ma bkur ba yin zhing / der yod kyi mi kun gyis mchod bkur bla med bgyis te char bas nas mi rabs bar rgyun bsrings pas rngam zhing brjid pa'i gangs ri g.yang dag pa zhig lhang nger 'gying yod pa de'o/ / dper na/ 〈hor gling g.yul 'khyed〉du/ rma stod 'od kyi gsasamakhar nas/ / rma rgyal sgom ra mthu bo che/ / dung khrab dung rmog sbu la gsol/ / rin chen 'bar ba'i mda' dar brgyan/ / dkar gsal dung gi phreng ba bsnams/ / mda' dar g.yas la ral gri g.yon/ / seng ge dkar mo chibs sa bcibs/ / 'ja' 'od gur gyi lding khang nas/ / ma da' gzhu 'khor gsum gyi li li/ / 'khor du lha phran stong gis bskor/ / 'ja' 'od srug khrong ko ro ro/ / zhes sems med kyi ri bo zhig sems ldan du btang nasagus pa dang skyabs bcol/ dad pa dang charangs byed do/ / rma rgyal spom ra ni khrab rmog 'khor gsum mnabs pa/ mda' gzhu mdung gsum thogs pa/6

gling sgrung las 'phros pa'i khor yug srung skyob byu 'du shes skor gleng ba/'og la seng ge dkar yochibs pa/ skad cig bos na skor bzangs gsum rgyag pa bcas kyi snang brnyan zhig tu bskrun bdes ma chen spom ra gtsos nye 'khor gyi khor yug srung skyob thad phan nus bla med cig thon 'dug de bzhin du mtsho skya rengs ni sga skya lo'i seng lcam 'khrug mo'i zamatsho dang khrung khrung spun gsum ni kho mo'i bla bya yin pa ste/ 〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉las/be+e nga dang nga ngo ma shes na/ / khrung khrung dkar mo spun gsum yin/ / seng lcam 'khrug mo'i bla bya yin/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / spyir bya yis na skad smra mi shes mod/ 'on kyang gling sgrung du rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi rnam pa spyad nas bya yis mi skad smra ba dang mi'i las don sgrub pa ni sgrung gi mgo mjug bar gsum las mthong thub la/ de las kyang ri byes srog chags dang 'dab chags bya rigs kun srung skyob byed pa'i dmigs yum ni sgod bcud do mnyam yong ba'i thabs lam bzang po zhig yin pa shes thub bo/ /gsum pa/ gling sgrung las thon pa'i rtswa thang srung spyob kyi 'dushes/mdzes shing ltan sdug pa'i rma yul sa thang 'di sgrung dpe las bshad pa ltar na de ni sngon chad mu ge ye mya nga mthang zhig nyu mngon te/ jo ru dgung lo bdun pa'i steng khu bos rma smad du sgyugs nas sa 'dzin skabs mi med sa stong lung stong bltas pa tsam gyis yid sdug pa zhig tu 'dug par gleng bas/ rma smad 'dre lung sum mdor 'bod kyin yod pa ste/ dper na/ 〈'khrungasagling me tog ra ba〉las/ de nas rma smad mkhan lung ri drug de bser ga a7

gling sgrung las 'phros pa'i khor yug srung skyob kyi 'du shes skor gleng ba/'og laseng ge dkar pochibasapa/ skad cig bosanaskor bathengasagasum rgyag pa bcasakyi snang brnyan zhig tubaskrun bdesazachenaspomar gtsosanye 'khor gyi khor yug srung skyob thad phan nusablamed cig thon 'dug de bzhin du mtsho skya rengasani sga skya lo'i seng lcama'abrug mo'i blamatsho dang khrung khrung spun gsum ni khomo'i blabya yin pa ste/ 〈hor gling g.yula'agyed〉las/bya nga dang nga ngo ma shesan/ / khrung khrung dkar pospun gsumayin/ / seng lcam 'brug mo'i blabya yin/ / zhesapaltar ro/ / spyir bya yisamiskad smra mi shesamod/ 'on kyang gling sgrung du rtog pa 'char yan ring lugasakyi rnamapa spyad nasabya yisamiskad smra ba dang mi'i la4don sgrubapani sgrung gi mgo mjug bar gsumal4mthong thub la/ de lasakyang ri skyesasrog chagasadang 'dab chagasabya rig4kun srung skyobabyed pa'i dmigasayulani snod bcud do mnyam yong ba'i thab4lamabazang po zhig yin pa shesathub bo/ /— gsum pa/ gling sgrung las thon pa'i rtswa thang srung skyob kyi 'du shas/ mdzesashing ltan sdug pa'i mayulacathang 'di sgrung dpe lasabashad pa ltar na de ni sngon chad mu ge yimya ngamathang zhig blumangon te/ jo ru dgung lobadun pa'i steng khu bosamasmad du smyugasanasasa'adzin skab4mimed sastong lung stong bltasapa tsamagyisayid sdug pazhig tu 'dug par gleng bas/ rma smad 'dre lung sumamador 'bod kyin yod paste/ dper na/ ('khrungasagling me tog ra ba〉las/ de nasamasmad mkhan lung ri drug de bsirak+ta a

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bdud kyisamatsher bzung ste/ ri rtse'i sanag brlags/ ri sked kyi 'jag ma bcad/ thang chenaldumabu'i cazos/ misong na thalathod gisabatumayoshing /nor song na ltog bkre4kyisa'achi bzhig byasanasayod ce4pa dang / yang /denasabaserag bra ba'i lus/ / thang chenalhum bu gting nasarlog / nachen metog 'dabamagator/ / ri rtse sanag thalabasabakang / / rtsi shing 'jag mdumabur bcad/ / gna' mibod kyi gtamadape la/ / sabazhig bshig byed mkhan abra red/ / sdebashig bshig byed mkhan khram pa red/ / nang bshig bshig byed mkhan nag pored/ / sartsi tog dud 'gro'i khazasaphyogs/ / 'bru metog mchod pa'i zhing sabacom/ / spang sngo ljang mi yibade skyid phrogs/ / zhesapa/ 〈rta rgyug dpyid kyi nyi ma〉las/ sa'adi'i sango mashesan/ / nga jo ru mthon phan chad la/ / stod rgya gar rgyal posasabazung byas/ / 4mazin chosathang skya mo btags/ / smad rgya nag rgyal posasabazung byas/ / 4ma zin khrimasathang skya mo btags/ / 'dre dngasrin po'i 'grim lamared/ / btsan dang mamo'i 'du ra red/ / mi mgosaki shar tshag tshag tshag / rta mgosa'atsher lhang sili li/ / khyi mgosangu zug ltung ltung ltung / / lung ba ngu shu lhung lhung lhung / / nga jo ru thon dang tshun chad nas/ / steng na 'ja' 'od gur khang phub/ / 'og na rtsi shing nagasatshal rgyas/ / bar na me togachar ba 'bab/ / rma smad lhayung sumamado red/ / yang smad dar gyi gzhi mdo red/ / ceyopa sogasalasartog4nuswāpa ni jo rusamatsher sam bzung gong sade mya ngam thang ltabur gyur cing

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bdud kyis mtshar bzung ste/ ri rtse'i sa nag brlags/ ri sked kyi 'jag ma bcad/ thang chen lcam bu'i sa zos/ na song na thal rlung gis btums shing /nor song na ltog bkres kyis 'chi bzhig byas nas yod ces pa dang / yang /denas bsor ga bra ba'i lus/ / thang chen phrum bu gting nas zlog / na chen cha tog 'dab ma gtor/ / ri rtse sa nag thal bas bkang / / rtsi shing 'jag mdum ster bcad/ / gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/ / sa bshig bshig byed mkhan spri bra red/ / sdeb shig bshig byed ma khan khram pa red/ / nang bshig bshig byed mkhan nag mo red/ / sa rtsi tog dud 'gro'i kha zas phrogs/ / 'bru cha tog mchod pa'i zhing sa bcom/ / spang sngo ljang mi ye bde skyid phrogs/ / zhes pa/ 〈rta rgyug dpyid kyi nyi ma〉las/ sa'adi'i sa ngo ma shes na/ / nga jo ru ma thon phan chad la/ / stod rgya gar rgyal pos sa bzung byas/ / sam zin chos thang skya mo btags/ / smad rgya nag rgyal pos sa bzung byas/ / sam zin khrims thang skya mo btags/ / 'dre dngas na po'i 'grim lam red/ / btsan dang ma mo'i 'du ra red/ / mi mgos ki shar tshag tshag tshag / rta mgos 'tsher lhang 6li li/ / khye mgosangu zug ltung ltung 1nga / / lung ba ngu shu lhang lhang lhung / / nga jo ru thon dang tshun chad nas/ / steng na 'ja' 'od gur khang phub/ / 'og na rtse shing nags tshal rgyas/ / bar na me tog char ba 'bab/ / rma smad lha lung sum mdo red/ / yang smad dar gyi gzhi mdo red/ / ces pa sogs las rtogasanus pa ni jo dus mtsher sam bzung gong sa de mya ngam thang lta bur gyur cing 8

gling sgrung las 'phros pa'i khor yug srung skyob gyi 'du shes skor gleng ba/gang sar a bra'i gnod 'che thebs pa dang khor yug srung spyob kyi 'du shesazhan pa'i brgyud rim dang / spri bra ni sa thang gi gnod gshed yin pas tshar gcod byed dgos pa'i 'bod skul btang yod la/ jo du rgyal po rma smad yuladu 'byor rjes khor yug la srung skyob legs po bgyis mthar sa chu shing nagasa'adzoms pa'i khor yug nyams dga' ba zhig tu gyur bde'o/ /de las gzhan da dung gling sgrung du mdzes shing ltan sdug pa'i khor yug mang po zhib 'bri bgyis yod pa ste/ dper na/ 〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉du/ chu la chu btsan bshad pas na/ / rma chu lcags nag rbab rgod de/ / chu yar 'bab spri'o nga langs langs red/ / mar 'bab spyang mo 'dur 'dur red/ / rba chen brag chen log log red/ / rdza ri srin mo kha 'tham gda'/ / glang bo lhog shi nyil le gda'/ / chu srin rkan sgra thagasasegada'/ / klu bdud 'khun pa thibs sogad 'a/ / mchu'i khugs so re re na/ / rta byang ma'i rgyug sgo bud pa 'dra/ / rma tshung byugs so re re na/ /mda' skyen po'i rgyang tshad bzhag pa gda'/ / rma chu'i khugs so re re na/ /bu dpa' bo'i dpa' skad di rir gda'/ / rma chu'i khugs so re re na/ / sprimachod sto nga gi shog sgra gda'/ / da dung de yis mi tshad pa'i/ / chu g.yas na ra chab 'bab cing gda'/ / g.yon na ru chab 'bab cing gda'/ / chu la chu btsan de 'dra gda'/ / zhes pa sogs las thon khungs phun sumatshogasapa'i chu bo ste/ rma chu dang 'bri chu/ rdza chu/ yar klung gtsang bo sogs 'dzam gling na snyan grags che ba'i chu bo kun gyi 'go khungs dag bod na yo da pa tshig 9

gling sgrung las 'phros pa'i khor yug srung skyob kyi 'du shes skor gleng ba/gangasar abya'i gnod 'tshe thebasapadang khor shig srung skyobakyi 'du shesazhanapa'i brgyud rimadang / abya ni cathang gi gnod gshed yinapa4tshar gcod byed dgo4pa'i 'bod skulabatang yod la/ jo ru rgyalapomasmad yuladu 'byor rjesakhor yug lasrung skyob legasapobagyisamathar cachu shing nag4'dzomasapa'i khor yuganyamasadaga' bzhig tugyur pade'o/ /de lasagazhan da dung gling sgrung du mdze4shing ltan sdug pa'i khor yug mang po zhib 'bri bgyi4yod pa ste/ dper na/ 〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉du/ chu la chu btsan bshad pasan/ / mchu lcagasanag rbab rgod de/ / chu yar 'bab aspong langasalangasared/ / mar 'babaspyang mo'adur 'dur red/ / rba chen brag chen log log red/ / rdza ri srin mo kha 'tham gda'/ / glang bo lhog shi nyil le gda'/ / chu srin rkan sgrathag4sogada'/ / klu bdud 'khun pathibasasegada'/ / mchu'i khugasasore re na/ / rta byang ma'i rgyug sne bud pa 'dra/ / rma chu'i khugasasore re na/ /mda' skyen po'i rgyang tshad bzhag pa gda'/ / rma chu'i khugasasore re na/ /bu dpa' bo'i dpa' skad di rir gda'/ / rma chu'i khugasasore re na/ / amachod stong gi shog sgra gda'/ / da dung de yi4mitshad pa'i/ / chu g.yayon ra chab 'bab cing gda'/ / g.yon na ru chab 'bab cing gda'/ / chu la chu btsan de 'dra gda'/ / zhesapa sog4lasathon khungasaphun sumatshogasapa'i chu bo ste/ rma chu dang 'bri chu/ rdza chu/ yar klung gtsang bo sogasa'adzam gling na snyan gragasache ba'i chu bo kunagyi 'go khungasadag bod na yod pa/ga

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/shugs kyis rtogs nus la/ rang byung chu ni rang byung khor yug la med du mi rung ba'i grub cha ga lar zhig yin pa'ang rtogs thub/ yang〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉du hor shan pa'i glu las/ hor thog mog ral chen ma/na go nas/ / gnam rje gur dkar yan chad la/ / hor gyi sar gong 'og na/ /brgya yar 'gro'i tshong ba 'bab sa med/ / stong phyir 'ong gla pa 'bab sa med/ / be+e 'dab chags rgum bu 'thu sa med/ / rta 'do bas dgong sa za samed/ / mdzo khyung dkar nyin sa za sa sted/ / khyi bda' lu nyul sna byed samed/ / sbrang bung bas me tog za sa med/ / rlung bser bu 'gro lam med saru/ / khyod sgar pa 'bab don ci la yin/ / thang sked dkar nag spang la grub/ / rtsi tog sa gzhi mnan pa la/ / sa mgo 'bras bu rug ge yod/ / rtsi tog sprugs na mar gyis gsos/ / sa sked zil ba khrom me yod/ / sa thur bcag na dar gyis g.yogs/ / sto steng mar khu 'phro le yod/ / rtsa ba bkog na ja yis tshugs/ / thang skyed sngon po na la grub/ / na thur spos thur gshib 'dra la/ / na stod ra rdang rug ge yod/ / na pho thur bcag na gser thur dgos/ / na mo thur bcag na dngul thur dgos/ / me tog khra dmar ldem me yod/ / me tog rnyid na g.yu yis slongs/ / na chu sngon mo ltem/sastseyod/ / chu mgo brnyogs na mar khus gsos/ / ku sha phyag rgya drug ge yod/ / rtswa ku sha bsnyal na 'o mas gsos/ / shing lo lag sgrib khrigasaseyod/ / shing pho sdong rdzog na rta yis 'tshobs/ / po sdong rdzog na drel gyisa'atshobs/ / lo ma bcag na dar tshor thogs/ / shing tog brul na ra yis10

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/shugasakyi4rtogasanusal/ rang byung chu ni rang byung khor yug lamed du mirung ba'i grub cha galachen zhig yin pa'ang rtog4thub/ yang〈hor gling g.yu'inga'agyed〉du hor shan pa'i glu las/ hor thog mog ral chen ma/na chad nas/ / gnamarje gur dkar yan chad la/ / hor gyi sar gong 'og na/ /brgya yar 'gro'i tshong ba 'bab4med/ / stong phyir 'ong gla pa 'bab samed/ / bya 'dab chagasasumabu 'thu samed/ / rta 'do bsadagong caza samed/ / mdzo khyung dkar nyinasaza 4med/ / khyi bda' lunyul sna byed samed/ / sbrang bung bsatshetog za samed/ / rlung bser bu 'gro lam med saru/ / khyod sgar pa'abab don ci la yin/ / thang sked dkar nag spang la grub/ / rtsi tog sagazhi mnan pal/ / samago 'brasabu rug ge yod/ / rtsi tog sprugasan mar gyi4gsos/ / 〈sked zil ba khrom me yod/ / sathur bcag na dar gyisagayogs/ / tswasteng mar khu 'khyil leyod/ / rtsa ba bkog na ja yisatshugs/ / thang skyed sngon po na la grub/ / na thur spos thur gshib 'dra la/ / na cadar dang rug ge yod/ / na pho thur bcag na gser thur dgos/ / na pothur bcag na dngulathur dgos/ / metog khra dmar ldem me yod/ / metog rnyid na g.yuyiyoslongs/ / na chu sngon yoltemasaseyod/ / chu mgo brnyogasan mar khusagasos/ / ku sha phyag rgya hrug ge yod/ / rtswa ku sha bsnyal na 'o masagasos/ / shing lo lag sgriX khrigasasiyod/ / shing pho sdong rdzog na rta yisa'atshobs/ / mosdong rdzog na drelagyisa'ardo~Xs/ / lom bcag na dar tshon thogs/ / shing tog brul na ra yi4

gleng sgrung las 'phros pa'i khor yug srung skyob kyi 'du shes skor gleng ba/'tshobs/ /'bras bu thing na lug gis 'tsho bas/ / myu gu thor na mar byusagasos/ /rdo g.yang ma bcag na gsha' tshas sbyor/ / lam skya rengs btod na gser phyes gsos/ /sal rtswa rin dgos le yin/ /chu la chu rin dgosale yin/ /sa rin chu rin la mo 'jol/ /zhes pa ltar skabs der rgyal rabs du ma'i ring la dam du bsrungasapa'i sa dang ste tog za ba dang ljon shing gcod pa/ tsetog 'thu ba/ chu mgo rnyog pa/ bgrod la ma btod pa sogs byed mi chog par ma zad/ rtswa mgo bsgogs na 'o mas gsodagos pa dang rtsi thog sprugs na mar gyis gsodagosapa/ me tog rnyid na g.yu yis tshab dgos pa/ shing tog brul na ra yis tshab dgos pa/ chu mgo brnyogs na mar khrus gsodagos pa/ rdo g.yang ma bcag na gsha' tshas spyor dgos pa la sogs pa'i khrims lugs btsan po yod pa bstan/ gzhan yang〈rma shel brag〉las/ rma del yag stag thang khra mo/del bzhi a long gi ra ba/ yang bzhi stag lpags brgyangs 'dra/ gling mi dpon gyi khrims ra/ phu nu stag 'dus kyi gong ba/ skyes phrug gi mda' ra bar ma// ma sru'i rtse ra bar ma/ thang stod spang thang gru bzhi/ spang la rtsi tog rgyas pa/ thang sked na ba khra leb/ thang smad ljon shing gi ra ba/ ljon shing lo 'bras ldem ste/ chu mgo brgya dang rtsa brgyad/ chu yar 'kho a long drug gebya khu byug gis gsung snyan sgog sa/ bung bas 'gyur glu len sa/ khrung khrung gis ske so ngo ma sa/ ngang mos g.yas skor byed sa/ ngang phrug gshog rtsa nyil ler yod pa lta bu'o/ / zhes pa 'di lasang tsho'i dran pa'i ngos sumakha' 11

gling sgrung las 'phros pa'i khor yug srung skyob kyi 'du shes skor gleng ba/'tshobs/ /'brasabu lhung nalug gisa'atshobs/ /myu gu thor na mar gyisagasos/ /rdo g.yang ma bcag na gsha' chosasbyor/ /lamaskya rengasabatod na gser phyesagasos/ /sal carin dgosaleyin/ /chu la chu rin dgosaleyin/ /sarin chu rin lamo'ajol/ /zhesapa ltar skabasader rgyal rab4du ma'i ring la dmadu bsrungasapa'i rtswadang rtsi tog za ba dang ljon shing gcod pa/ metog 'thu ba/ chu mgo rnyog pa/ bgrod lamabatod pa sogs byed michog par ma zad/ camago bsnogasan 'o masagasodago4pa dang rtsi thog sprug4na mar gyisagasodagosapa/ me tog rnyid na g.yuyi4tshab dgosapa/ shing tog brulan ra yisatshab dgosapa/ chu mgo brnyogasan mar khu4gsodagosapa/ rdo g.ya' ma bcag na gsha' tshasasbyor dgosapa lasogasapa'i khrimasalugasabatsan po yod pa bstan/ gzhan yang(rma shel brag〉las/ rma del yag stag thang khra mo/del bzhi along gi ra ba/ yang bzhi stag lpagasabargyangasa'adra/ gling midapon gyi khrimasar/ phu nu stag 'dusakyi gong ba/ skyesaphrug gi mda' ra bar ma/ ma sru'i rtse ra bar ma/ thang stod spang thang gru bzhi/ spang lartsi tog rgyayopa/ thang sked na ba khra leb/ thang smad ljon shing gi ra ba/ ljon shing lo 'brasaldeyome/ chu mgo brgya dang rtsa brgyad/ chu yar 'khyil a'ong hrug gebya khu byug gisagasung snyan sgrog sa/ bung bsa'agyur glu len sa/ khrung khrung gisasko songom sa/ ngangamosagayasaskor byed sa/ ngang phrug gshogaco nyil ler yod pa ltabu'o/ /zhesapa 'di lasang tsho'i dran pa'i ngosasu~X'

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dbugasaskyon gyi dri mayom gosapa'i mdzeyosdug gi spangasaljongasaltan sdug pa dang spranag khyu la khyu mthud/ rta khyu dang rkyang khyu nor le/ nor khyu dang 'brong khyu nor le/ lug g.yang dkar dang rtsi tog nor lebacasakyi yid spro zhing ༵ma~Xdaga' ba'i 'brog phyogasakyi cathang gi rnam pa zhig cig car du shar cang /gang/ ltar mi'i rigasakyisadusadang rnam pā kun tu rang nyid 'bralathab4med pa'i rang byung khor yug dang skye dngosasrog chagasal srung skyong leg4po byas nasayangasapa'i sa'i go lachen po'i steng gi srog chagasagang zhig yin rung mdza' mthun lhan 'tsho byayote/ ri skye4srog chags mtha' dag khyimargyud gcig gi spun zabazhin du brtsisanas/ phan tshun brtsi bkur dang phan tshun gcesaskyong / phan tshun 'grig mthun bcasabyasan/ da gzod sa'i go la chen po'adi'i steng 'khrug rtsod dang nad yamasami 'byung bar srog chagasayod tshad tshang malhing 'jagasakyi zhi bder rol thub pas/ nga tsho tshang mayosemasangosasusnyibarje dang byamasasemasagazhir bzung ste shugayobastan du mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal sog4bsal bar byed pa'i spyan zung gi ṭ+wāṃr+sha ṭ+wāṃdri ṭ+wāṃr+sha hā ṭ+wāsringasate rang byung khor yug labadag skyong bzang po byed 12

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dbugs skyon gyi dri mas ma gos pa'i mdzes sdug gi spangs ljongs ltan sdug pa dang sbra nag khyu la khyu mthud/ rta khyu dang rkyang khyu nor le/ nor khyu dang 'brong khyu nor le/ lug g.yang dkar dang ste tog nor le bcas kyi yid spro zhing nyams dga' ba'i 'brog phyogs kyi sa thang gi rnam pa zhig cig car du shar yong ngo / /gang ltar mi'i rigs kyis dus dang rnam pā kun tu rang nyid 'bral thabs med pa'i rang byung khor yug dang bye dngos srog chags la srung skyong legs po byas nas yangs pa'i sa'i go la chen po'i steng gi srog chags gang zhig yin rung mdza' ma/thun lhan 'tsho byas te/ ri skyes sro ga chags mtha' dag khyem rgyud gcig gi srun zla bzhin du brtsis nas/ phan tshun brtsi bkur dang phan tshun gces skyong / phan tshun 'grig mthun bcas byas na/ da gzod so'i go la chen po 'di'i steng 'khrug rtsod dang nad yams mi 'byung bar srog chags yo da tshad tshang ma lhing 'jags kyi zhi bder rol thub pas/ nga tsho tshang mas sems ngos sa steng rje dang byams sems gzhir bzung ste shugasabastan du mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal sogs bas bar byed pa'i byin zung gi mig rgyang ring du bsrings te rang byung khor yug la bdag skyong bzang po byed dgos pa lags so/ /12

gling sgrung las rta'i spyi tshogs kyi goganas mdo tsam gleng ba/gling sgrung las rta'i sbyi tshogs kyi go gnas mdo tsam gleng ba/dang po/ rta yi byung 'phel dang des sbyi chogs la thon pa'i nus pade/ yang dbusagatsang chosakyi cholakha/ mdo stod miyicholakha/ mdo smad rta'i chol kha zhe4bod chol khagasumadu gragasapa'i mirigasa'adi'i sgo phyugasalasnga ba dang grag4che ba ni rta nor lug gsumayin la/ desabod kyi spyi tshogasadang thon skyed gong 'phelathad go gnasagalachen zin yod pa red/dper na/ 'brog sgo phyugasagayang dkar lug dang gcig mar 'o ma'i rgyud 'dzin 'bri moganyis/ 'grosaglog ltar myur ba'i cang shesagasum zhesapa ltar/ sgo phyug de tsho'i khrod nasakyang mgo yitog dang gtsug gi rgyan ltabur gyur 'dug pa ni rta mchog rin po che yin/ mirigasagazhan gyisabod larta thog gi mirigasazhesa'abod pa ha cang don dang mthun pazhig yin la/ nga tsho bod kyi lo bcu gcig bcu gnyiyoyasamasakyi byisapa tshang masarta khathub cing /khyimabaza' tshang ga tshod yod na mirer ngosabatagasakyi rta re yod paha cang rgyun 'byam4sugyur yod/ mdo smad amado'i 4cha ru mtshon na bod ༈ ༵zhi

gling sgrung las rta'i spyi tshogs kyi gog nas mdo tsam gleng ba/gling grung las rta'i spyo tshogs kyi gro gnas mdo tsam gleng ba/dang po/ rta yi byung 'phel dang des spyo chogs la thon pa'i nus pa/de yang dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ mdo stod mi a chol kha/ mdo smad rta'i chol kha zhes bod chol kha gsum du grags pa'i mi rigs 'di'i sgo phyugs la snga ba dang grags che ba ni rta nor lug gsum yin la/ des bod kyi spyi tshogs dang thon byed gong 'phel thad go gnas gal chen zin yod pa red/dper na/ 'brog sgo phyugs g.yang dkar lug dang gcig mar 'o ma'i rgyud 'dzin 'bri mo gnyis/ 'gros glog ltar myur ba'i cang shes gsum zhesapa ltar/ sgo phyug de tsho'i khrod nas kyang mgo ⑪tog dang gtsug gi rgyan lta bur gyur 'dug pa ni rta mchog rin po che yin/ ba rigs gzhan gyis bod la rta thog gi mi rigs zhes 'bod pa ha cang don dang mthun pa zhig yin la/ nga tsho bod kyi lo bcu gcig bcu gnyis yas mas kyi byis pa tshang mas rta kha thub cing /khyim bza' tshang ga tsho'i yod na na rer ngos btags kyi rta re yod pa ha cang rgyun 'byams sa gyur yod/ mdo smad a mdo'i sa cha ru mtshon na bod zla bzhi 13

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i tshes bcu gcig nyin ni rta la kha lo btul ba'i dus chen du gtan khelabyas yod/ bod rigs shig yin phyin tshogs sa 'du sa gang yin yang rta mchog la zhon nas 'gro zhing / rta thog nas kha btags 'thu ba dang /zhabs bro 'khrab pa/ ste mda' 'phen pa bcas mi rigs gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i lus rtsal gyi rnam grangs mod po yod/ rta mchog byung ba'i skor la'ang lha sgrung dang 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud gson nyams ldan pa zhig yod pa ste/sngon chad nam mkhar rta rgod ma gnyis yod pa der rte'u zhig skyes/ yin na'ang / gnam nas sa chus ma 'dang bas yul lha yul gung dang zhes par babs te 'tsho ba rol/ rte'u phrug de dzi phyar phyur dang mjal te bshos pas phu bo yid kyi gdang phyam dang nu bo 'breng ba rkyang ron rngog bkra nu bo tha chung khug ron rmang dar gsum skyes so/ / de nas kyang sa chus ma 'dang bas spun gsum sa cha chung ba gsum du song nas 'tsho ba rol/ dus nam zhig na phu bo yid kyi gdang phyam ni 'brong g.yag skar ba dang phrad de sa chu brtsad pa na 'brong g.yag skar bas phu bo yid kyi gdang phyam bsad de sha be+e zos/ khrag ni 'jungs/ rus pa ni 'chos so/ / dus nam zhig na nu bo rkyang ron rngog bkra dang / khug ron rmang dar gnyis kyis rta skad ni 'tsher 'amar/ smreng ska da be+e 'tsher 'tsher byas kyang phu bo yid kyi gdang phyam gyi zhal ma mjal bar srur dang ma jal ba na/ nu bo khug ron rmang dar gyis 'brong skar ba'i snying bcad de phu bo yid kyi gdang phyam la ro skyin len pa'i gros byas kyang / rkyang ron rngog bkra'i zhal nas phu bo yid kyi gdang phyam rtsal che ba bang ma sgogs pa des14

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ ba'i tshe4bcu gcig nyin ni rta lakhalobatulaba'i dusachen du gtan khelabyasayod/ bod rigasashig yin phyin tshogasasa'adu 4gang yin yang rta mchog lazhon nasa'agro zhing / rta thog nasakhabatagasa'athu ba dang /zhabasabro 'khrab pa/ memada' 'phen pa bcasami rigasagazhan layokhyad du 'phagasapa'i lusartsalagyi rnam grangasamod po yod/ rta mchog byung ba'i skor la'ang lhaskung dang 'brelaba'i gtamargyud gson nyamasaldan pa zhig yod pa ste/sngon chad nam mkhar rta rgod ma gnyisayod pa der rte'u zhig skyes/ yin na'ang / gnam nasatswachusam 'dang bsayul lhayulagung dang zhesapar babasate 'tsho ba rol/ rte'u phrug de rdzi phyar phyur dang mjal te bshosapasaphu bo yid kyi gdang phyamadang nu bo 'bring ba rkyang ron rngog bkra nu bo tha chung khug ron rmang dar gsumaskyesaso/ / de nasakyang tswachu4ma 'dang ba4spun gsum sacha chung ba gsumadu song nasa'atsho ba rol/ du4nam zhig na phu bo yid kyi gdang phyamani 'brong g.yag skar ba dang phrad de cachu bcod pa na 'brong g.yag skar bsaphu bo yid kyi gdang phyam bsad de sha ni zos/ khrag ni 'thungs/ ruyopani 'chosaso/ / dusanam zhig na nu bo rkyang ron rngog bkra dang / khug ron rmang dar gnyisakyisarta skad ni 'tsher 'tsher/ smreng skad ni 'tsher 'tsher byasakyang phu bo yid kyi gdang phyamagyi zhal mamajalabar spur dang mjal ba na/ nu bo khug ron rmang dar gyisa'abrong skar ba'i snying bcad de phu bo yid kyi gdang phyamalaro skyin len pa'i grosabyasakyang / rkyang ron rngokā 1kra'i zhal nasaphu bo yid kyi gdang phyamartsalache babang mgyogasapa des

gling sgrung las rta'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas mdo tsam gleng ba/kyang mthub na/ khyod dang 'u gnyis kyis cha yong zhes ma 'cham yo pas yusosor byes/ phyis sa nu bo khug ron rmang dar gyis mkhar sa mkhar skya bo'i nang nas byu rma bu ldam shan la grogs bcol te yu po byang kha snam brgyad du 'brong g.yag skar ba bsad do/ / de'i phyir nu bo khug ron rmang dar mi'i grogs po bzang por gyur cing / nu bo 'bring ba rkyang ran rngog bkra cha med sa stong du 'khyams pas rkyang du grur skad do/ /⑫nga 'di'i nang du 'gro ba rga byung lus na ltar rta mchog kyang nam ma/kha' las byung bar bshad pa dang rang byung gi 'thab rtsod khrod 'gro ba mi dang dud 'gro rta gnyi4grogs por gyur tshul gsal bor bstan yo da/ gzhan yang〈rta bshad mthong ba kun gsal tshe long〉las/ tshangs pa lhan me tog gis/ / rgya ma tsho'i paṇa chen spyan drangs nas/ / 'od phrug lo paṇa rgya tsha slob/ / chos sman rig gnas thams cad bsgyur/ / phyogs ris mkhas pa mi dgu bsdus/ / bod sman mkhas dgu bla sman bskos/ / de bzhin phyogs rer yul lnga nas/ / rta mkhan mkhas pa mi dgu bsdus/ / dgu bo 'dod lugasaso sor byung / / dbye bo 'jag rta ru rngu gnyis/ / sgur bo gyam shing mu chen gnyis/ / drang bo 'do ba gyi ling gnyis/ / zhes khri srong gi dus nas rta'i dbye ba r+ṣa po drug ste/ 'jag rta dang / ru rngu/ gyam/ shing / mu chen/'do ba/ gyi ling bcas yod par bshad cing / mes chen tho ri gnyan btsan dus/ / dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes shing / / rta nor longs spyod mnga' thang dar/ / chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po nyid/ / dus gsum ma 'dresaso15

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byas/ /zhesapa dang / phyir rkyang rgod kyisakyang / sagling dkar stod na yod dusasu/ /sman skya lo seng lcam 'brug modes/ /masabu sdug skyong ba'i ngang tshul bzhin/ /nangasasngadro nyi ma rtse shar la/ /snod gser gzhong 'brasaljang mar gyi4bkang / /zasamangar gsum bu ram bsresanasaster/ /dusad jarkyang rgod e ltogasazer/ /dusanyi ma'i gung la slebasadusasu/ /snod dngulagazhong 'o masabakang ba la/ /gser 'jong brdungasathur masadakrugasate ldud/ /dusad dung rkyang rgod oskom zer/ /zhesapa dang / 〈rta rgyug dpyid kyi nyi ma〉lasa.ama'agog moyisarta rkyang rgod la/ rna rtse bdud kyi sob/ rna khung jag pa'i skung lung / spyan mig lakha'i skar rgyan/yamachu poti brtsigasayag thong kha lhasgo phyesayag rtsib chen gur chen phub 'dra/ rtsib chung gur chung phub 'dra/ sug bzhi ka thung bslangasa'adra/tshigasabazhi logs nasabatag4'dra/ rjesabazhi rmog dkar sgor 'dra/ rnga ma brag gzar chu phyar/ rnga sne metog bsham4'dra/ tshang ra rgya zang4sgor yag sgalab lhagran bsgrigasayag rngog ma lhosprin spung4yag lazhi khro dam pa rigasabargya/ rtse lu sbrang char 'babayag labadud rtsi 'khyilaba'i lhatshogs/spu rtse lharisakhyugasase/ spu rtsa klu risakhyugasase/ spu sked gnyan risakhyugasase/ phyi la byol song dud 'gro/ nang la byang chub semasadapa'/ zhesapa ltabudang / yang gling rje ge sar rgyal po4rgya tsha zhaladakar gyi rnamashesaskya khra yin pa ma mkhyen nayoskya khra de gsod par 'dod nasamada' zhig 'phangayopa na t+ta :nga rgod 'phag thung byasapasamada' ma thebasapa ste/ lag pa 4la

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byas/ /zhes pa dang / phyir rkyang rgod kyis kyang / sa gling dkar stod na yod dus su/ /sman skya lo seng lcam 'brug mo des/ /mas6 sdu ga skyong ba'i ngang tshad bzhin/ /nangs snga dro nyi ma rtse shar la/ /sgod gser gzhong 'bras lnga nga mar gyis bkang / /zas mngar gsum ste ram bsres nasaster/ /dus da lta rkyang rgod e ltogs zer/ /dus nyi ma'i gung la slebayodus su/ /sgod dngul gzhong 'o mas bkang ba la/ /gser 'jong brdungasathur mas dkrugs te phrud/ /dus da dung rkyang rgod tshe skom zer/ /zhes pa dang / 〈rta rgyug dpyid kyi nyi ma 〉las a ma 'gog mo yis rta rkyang rgod la/ rna rtse bdud kyi sob/ rna khung jag pa'i skung lung / spyan mig la kha'i skar rgyan/mim chu po ti brtsigs yag thong kha lha sgo phyes yag rtsib don gur don phub 'dra/ rtsib chung gur go phub 'dra/ sug bzhi ka thung bslangs 'dra/tshigs bzhi logs nas btags 'dra/ rjes bzhi rmog dkar sgor 'dra/ rnga ma brag gzar chu phyar/ rnga sde mo tog bshams 'dra/ byed ra rgya zangs sgor yag sgal ba lha bran bsgrigs yag rngog ma lto sprin srungs yag lazhi khro dmapa rigs brgya/ rtse lu sprang char 'bab yag la bdud ste 'a a ba'i lha tshogs/spu rtse lha ris khyugs se/ spu rtsa klu ris khyugs se/ sru sked gnyan ris khyugasase/ phyi la byol song dud 'gro/ nang la byang chub sems dpa'/ zhes pa ltabudang / yang gling rje ge sar rgyal pos rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi rnam shes skya khra yin pa ma mkhyen nas skya khra de gsod par 'dod nas mda' zhig 'phangs pa na dzhai skyi rgod 'phag thung byas pas mda' ma jebs pa ste/ lag pa sal

gling sgrung las rta'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas mdo tsam gleng ba/brdabs/ 'gre log dang rnga 'tshub brgyab/ mig mchi ma khrom khrom/ 'bum pa dkar chung la mgo gtad nas bsdad song zhes pa sogs las nges shes thob pa ni rta ma/chog rkyang rgod be+e phyi bltas na byol song dud 'gro'i rigs dang nang lasangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa 'char ba'i rta mchog khyad par can zhig dang /gling rje ge sar rgyal por phu bo rgya tsha dang sman ma/chog 'brug mo/ rta mchog rkyang rgod gsum la nye ring dang phyogs ris med tshul dang / rta rkyang rgod kyi sru rtse na lha/ sru rtsa na klu/ khru sked na gnyan/ mdo khams rgyal mo dngos su song nas thun gsum dang dus tshigs bzhi la rtswa kha chu khrud byas tshul sogs lasarta'i rin thang dang khyad chos/ thob thang / 'gro ba mi las mchog tu gyur pa/tshe snga phyi'i mngon ma/khyen la thogs pa med pa bcas gsal bor bris yo da pa 31bu'o/ /gnyis/ dngos grub ldem pa ni gling tsha zhang 'dan ma/'i chibs pa yin la/ khong mi rta gnyis kyis de 'dra'i g.yur 'gyed mang po zhig gi khrod du byasarjes bla na med pa bzhag 〈hor gleng g.yul 'byed〉las tsha zhang 'dan mas/khro'i dang 'u gu mi rta gnyis/ / thur la gru gu 'gril 'gril 'gro/ / hor dmag khrag bzhin dkrugs na bsam/ / rta khra khyu mang po ded na bsam/ /ri khra bo'i rgyan cha byas na bsam/ / las ci byed e shes 'do ba rta/ / zhes pa dang / der cang shes dngos grub ldem pa na re/ tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra lags/ khro'i steng gi mi de rgod pas na/ nga 'og gi rta pho zhan don med/ bye ba 'di ⑪gong ma la/ khyod kyang rgya gar grub chen red/ rta nga yang rgya gar 21

gling sgrung las rta'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas mdo tsam gleng ba/brdabs/ 'gre log dang rnga 'tshub brgyab/ mig mchi mkhromakhrom/ 'bum pa dkar chung la mgo gtad nasabasdad song zhesapa sogayolasangesashesathob pa ni rta mchog rkyang rgod ni phyi bltasan byol song dud 'gro'i rigasadang nang la sangayorgyasakyi dgongasapa 'char ba'i rta mchog khyad par can zhig dang /gling rje ge sar rgyalapor phu bo rgya tsha dang sman mchog 'brug mo/ rta mchog rkyang rgod gsum la nye ring dang phyogasarisamed tshul dang / rta rkyang rgod kyi spu rtse na lha/ spu rtsa na klu/ spu sked na gnyan/ mdo khamasargyal mo dngosasu song nasathun gsum dang du4tshigasabazhi lasakha chu ldud byasatshul sogasalasarta'i rin thang dang khyad chos/ thob thang / 'gro ba mi lasamachog tu gyur pa/tshe ṭ+wāṃ phyi'i mngon mkhyen lathogasapa med pa bcasagasal bor brisayod pa ltabu / ga/nyis/ dngosagrub ldem pa ni gling tsha zhang 'dan ma'i chibasapa yin la/ khong mi rta gnyisakyi4de 'dra'i g.yula'agyed mang po zhig gi khrod du byasarjesablan med pa bzhag 〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉lasatsha zhang 'dan mas/khyod dang 'u gu mirta gnyis/ / thur la gru gu 'gril 'grila'agro/ / hor dmag khrag bzhin dkrugasan bsam/ / rta khra khyu mang poded na bsam/ /ri khra bo'i rgyan cha byasan bsam/ / la4ci byed oshe4'do ba rta/ / zhe4pa dang / der cang shesadangoyogrub ldem pa na re/ tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra lags/ khyod steng gi mi de rgod pasan/ nga 'og gi rta pho zhan don med/ skye ba 'di yogong mal/ khyod kyang rgya gar grub chen red/ rta nga yang ṭ+wāṃ gar

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yul gyi bya rgod pomangon shesacan zhig yin zhe4bshad padang / tsha zhanga'adan masashan pa'i klad phor bkog ste/ lcag tshan gyi yubasadakrugasanasagasod snyam pa la/ rta 'do bdangosagrub ldemapa na re/ sdig gcod shan pa me ru 'di/ steng lhayoyulanasasku rje ge sar rgyalapo dang lasasmon 'brelab yin/ hor gur dkar kho lan pa che bamagatogs/ shan pame ru rtse'adi hor gling gnyisamig g.yasagayon dang 'dra babyed miyin pa4bsad na/nor bu dgra 'dul gyisagasung ci 'byon mishesapasaskyur zhog zer ro ltabu lasagling khra glag spyang gsum gyi yagyalatsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra dpa' rtsal rgod kyang bya ba yod do cog rta la gro4byed padang rtasakholabakod 'domasabagyid bzhin yod pa dang / rta mchog dngosagrubaldems tshe sngaphyi kun la mnga' brnyesashing bya ba thamasacad kyi mgo rnga she4pa'i rta mchog srid na dkon pa zhig yin pas/ tsha zhang 'dan masablang4pa'i rting mare re yang rta la 'bral thabasamed tshul brisayod pa ltar ro/ /gsum/ rta 'do bganamayag sngon moni smug po'ajang gi dmag dpon 'jang phrug g.yulhathog 'gyur gyi chibasapa yin lagoma'agrosaha cang myur ba ste/ 〈'jang phrug〉lasagayulhathog 'gyur gyis/ khra yag rdza lama'agrim dusasu/ /'brong bre ser 'dra ba'i spu risa'adzoms/ /nagasargya rdzong gshagasan4'gro dusasu/ / stag dmar yag 'dra ba'i spu risa'adzoms/ /spang na dmar gzhung la'agro dusasu/ /rkyang khadakar 'dra baX ṭ+wāṃ ri4'dzomasazhesapa de lasardza sngon monasacheyomagyogasapa'i bre sar

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yul gyi bya rgod po mngon shes can zhig yin zhes bshad bdang / tsha zhang 'dan mas shan pa'i klad phor bkog ste/ lcag tshan gyi yubs dkrugs nasagasod snyam pa la/ rta 'do ba dngos grub ldem pa na re/ sdeg gcod shan pa rme ru 'di/ steng lhan yul nas sku rje ge sar rgyal po dang las smon 'brel ba yin/ hor gur dkar kho lan pa che ba ma gtogs/ shan pa che ru rtse 'di hor gling gnyis mig g.yas g.yon dang 'dra ba byed mi yin pas bsad na/nor bu dgra 'dul gyis gsung ci 'byon pi shes pas sgyur zhog zer ro lta bu las gling khra glag spyang gsum gyi mi rgyal tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra dpa' rtsal rgod kyang bya ba yod do cog rta la gros byed pa dang rtas khol bkod 'domasabagyid bzhin yod pa dang / rta mchog dngos grub ldem pa tshe lnga phyi kun la mnga' brnyes shing be+e ba thams cad kyi mgo rnga shes pa'i rta mchog srid na dkon pa zhig yin pas/ tsha zhang 'dan mas blangs pa'i ting ma re re yang rta la 'bral thabs med tshul bris yod pa ltar ro/ /gsum/ rta 'do ba gnam yag sngon po ni srug po 'jang gi dmag dpon 'jang phrug g.yul thog 'gyur gyi chibs pa yin la gom 'gros ha cang myur ba ste/ 〈'jang phrug〉las g.yul thog 'gyur gyis/ khra yag dza lam (pe 11 'ju(se zur (sde :dza' ma dus su/ / 'a nga bra ra 'dra ba 'a sru sa 'a mas/ / nags rgya rdzong gshags nas 'gro dus su/ / stag dmar yag 'dra ba'i sru risa'adzoms/ / spang na dmar gzhung la 'gro dus su/ / rkyang kha dkar 'dra ba'i sru ris 'dzoms zhes pa de las dza sngon yonas ches mgyogs pa'i bre sar 22

gling sgrung las rta'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas mdo tsam gleng ba/'brong dang / nagasargya rdzong dkyilagyi dmar yag stag spang na dmar gzhung gi khadakar rkyangabacasakyi rtsalashugasamanga' bsarta gzhan lasathun mong mayin pa'i goma'agrosayod pa bstan to/ /bzhi/ bya rta khyung gshog ni nubastag gzig rgyal po'i chibasapa yin zhing / khra moblang dang nubastag gzig gnyisakyi rtsod gzhir gyur pa'ang rta mchog de nyid lags/ (stag gzig nor rdzong〉lasastagagazig nor gyi rgyalapos/ gzhan gyi rta dang 'dra lemin/ /rna rtse khyung gi thulaphranayod/ /rmig bzhirlung gi spu gri yod/ /khamasagasuyobaskor ba'i bya marta/ /phu brag dmar khyung rdzong gtor ba'i nyin/ /gyad chen dpung gi dpa' rtagasal/ /gser sgong nang nayoblangasaleyin/ /rje 'gran med rgyalapo'i chibasarta yin/ /zhesadang / nga'i bya rta sngon mo rlung gshog de/ /gzhan gyi rta dang 'dra bamin/ /mkha' lding khyung gi phrug yin/ /rgyal po'i tshe rabasalasarta red/ /stag gzig yulagyi nor g.yang red/ /lde'abum tsho dgu yidaga' sayin/ /rin dang gongathang rtsi rgyu med cesapasogasalasarta de ni thun mong mayinapa mngalaskyesamin par sgong skyesayin pa/ mkha' lding khyung gi sgo nga la4byung ba/ stag gzig yulagyi nor g.yang yin pa/ dusathung ngu tsam la'ang khamasagasumabaskor nu4pa sogasakyisakhyad cho4dang rin thang rtogasathubapa ltabu'o/ spyir khra ragling gi rtamachog rnamasarta'i dbye ba'i ngosanas gyi ling sarta dang gyi libaganamarta gnyisakyi khongasasugatogasashing / rta'i rigasakyi sgo nasabya rigasadang gcan gzan rigs/ ri dwagasarigasa~Xs

gling sgrung las rta'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas mdo tsam gleng ba/'brong dang / nags rgya rdzong dkyil gyi dmar yag stag spang na dmar gzhung gi kha dkar rkyang bcas kyi rtsal shugs mnga' bas rta gzhan las thun mong ma yin pa'i gom 'gros yod pa bstan to/ /bzhi/ bya rta khyung gshog ni nub stag gzig rgyal po'i chibs pa yin zhing / khra mo gling dang nubastag gzig gnyis kyi stod gzhir gyur pa'ang rta mchog de nyid lags/ 〈stag gzig nor rdzong〉las stag gzig nor gyi rgyalapos/ gzhan gyi rta dang 'dra le min/ / rna rtse khyung gi thul phran yod/ /rngig bzhi rlung gi spu gri yod/ / khams gsum bskor ba'i be+e ma rta/ / phu brag dmar khyung rdzong gtor ba'i nyin/ / rgyad chen dpung gi dpa' rtags la/ /gser sgong nang nas blangs le yin/ / rje 'gran med rgyal po'i chibs rta yin/ /zhes dang / nga'i bya rta sngon mo rlung gshog de/ / gzhan gyi rta dang 'dra ba min/ / mkha' lding khyung gi tsho gu yin/ / rgyal po'i tshe rabs las rta red/ / stag gzig yul gyi nor g.yang red/ / sde 'bum tsho dgu yodag 'a sa yin/ /rin dang gong thang rtsi rgyu med ces pa sogs las rta de ni thun mong ma yin pa mngal skyes min par sgong skyes yin pa/ mkha' lding khyung gi sgo nga las byung ba/ stag gzig yu pa gyi nor g.yang yin pa/ dus thung ngu tsam la'ang khams gsum bskor nus pa sogs kyis khyad chos dang rin thang rtogasathub pa lta bu'o/ spyir khra yo gling gi rta mchog rnams rta'i dbye ba'i ngos nas gyi ling sa rta dang gyi ling gnam rta gnyis kyi khongs su gtogs shing / rta'i rigs kyi sgo nas bya rigs dang gcan gzan rigs/ ri dgas rigs bcas23

gcod padonagrub dngasnying bo tshe ring gi chedartsom phyogs bsgrigs/yod pa lasagling rta tshang ma bya rigasakyi khong4su'adu'o/ /gling sgrung du rta la ming 'dogasatshul yang mang po zhig yod na'ang gcan gzan rigasadang ri dwagasa'adab chagasabacasakyi ming lasam/ 'dasashing / dper na/ rgya bya/ rma bya/ chu bya/ ngang ba gser sgong / dung bya snakhra/ g.yubya 'phur shes/ khu byug lding shes/ bya rta rlung gshog lcung ga 'phur shesasogasani 'dab chagasakyi ming dang / 'brong 'dur nag po/drel modagu chod/ stag mokher nyal/ 'phar ba rnga nag sha ba brgya 'dzom/sa/seng ge ngang thung / rgya stag dmar po sogasani gcan gzan dang ri dwagasakyi ming ngo / / de lasagazhan dmar chung kha lame 'bar/ rlung nag 'tshub chen/me ri 'tshub shes/ rlung dmar 'tshub shes/ rlung nag rjesagacod bcasani rtsal byāg4me lce dang bang shug4rlung dang mtshungasaba'i cha nasabatagayopar snyam /spyir/ bod mi rigasakyi4rta la de 'dra'i dga' zhen byed cing rta'i bshad pa gting zab cing ngo mtshar ba/ tshan rig gi rang bzhin ldan pa bcasani bod rnamasarta'i rig gnasalanang byan chud pa'i rtagasamatshan zhig min nam/ bod rigasadamangasakhrod du rta pho'i rigasal rnam pa bzhi tsam bshad pa ste/ 'do ba'i rigasade ring na bzang / / be gto'i rigasade gar na bzang / / mu khengasarigasade sboman bzang / / gyi ling rigasade yang na bzang / / gdong ba'i rigasalarnamagasumayod/ / rta rab khyung gi gdong ba tā~Xs/ / rta 'bring tshe tshe ra gdong yod/ / sha ba'i gdong de tha ma

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigasayod pa las gling rta tshang ma bya rigs kyi khongs su 'du'o/ /gling sgrung du rta la ming 'dogs tshul yang mang po zhig yo da na'ang gcan gzan rigs dang ri dwags 'dab chags bcas kyi ming las ma 'dasashing / dper na/ rgya bya/ rma bya/ chu bya/ ngang ba gser sgong / dung bya sna khra/ g.yu bya 'phur shes/ khu byug lding shes/ be+e rta rlung gshog lcung ga 'phur shes sogs ni 'dab chags kyi ming dang / 'brong 'dur nag po/drel mo dgu chong/ stag po kher nyal/ 'phar ba rnga nag sha ba brgya 'dzom sa /seng ge ngang thung / rgya stag dmar po sogs ni gcan gzan dang ri dwags kyi ming ngo / / de las gzhan dmar chung kha la me 'bar/ rlung nag 'tshub chen/cha ri 'tshub shes/ rlung dmar 'tshub shes/ rlung nag rjes gcod bcas ni col shugs me lce dang bang shugs rlung dang mtshungs ba'i cha nas btags par snyam mo/ /spyir bod mi rigs kyis rta la de 'dra'i dga' zhen byed cing rta'i bshad pa gting zab cing ngo mtshar ba/ tshan rig gi rang bzhin ldan pa bcas ni bod rnam sa rta'i rig gnas la nang khyan chud pa'i rtags mtshan blag min nam/ bod rigs dmangs khrod du rta pho'i rigs la rnam pa bzhi tsam bshad pa ste/ 'do ba'i rigs de ring na bzang / / be+e gto'i rigs de gar na bzang / / mu khengs rigs de sgom na bzang / / 6 ling rigs de yang na bzang / / gdong ba'i rigs la rnam gsum yod/ / rta rab khyung gi gdong ba dgos/ / rta 'bring tshe tshe ra gdong yo da/ / sha ba'i gdong de tha ma 24

gling sgrung las rta'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas mdo tsam gleng ba/yin/ / sgyid pa 'di la rnam gsum yod/ / ba sgyid tha sgyid ra sgyid gsum / / rab 'bring tha ma'i rta la 'ong / / rta so 'di la rigs bdun yod/ / rkyang sos bas chen de dang gcig / ba so bye ga de dang gnyis/ /lug sodakar chung de dang gsum/ / 'di gsum son bzang gsum yin/ / stag so rngam la de dang gcig / rnga so 'phyar bu de dang gnyis/ /phag so 'jur bu de dang gsum/ / 'di gsum so yong na gsum yin/ /rkyang so sbubs chung 'bring bo yin/ / zhes pa dang / da dung sru rigs mi 'dra rnam lnga dang drig pa rigs bdun/ sha a 'gyur bu bco brgyad/ rus pa'i dpa' bo nyi shu sogs kyang yod par bshad/ yang / rta rab re re mgo bo la//bre sar 'brong gi dpral zheng dang / / rus sbal rgyal po'i mig phrum la/ / zhe sdang drul gyi mig 'bras dang / / seng ge dkar mo'i sna khung dang / / dam/ra yag sta ga mo'i kha sha dang / / rna ba rgod kyi thul phran dang / / 'ju ru sha ba'i ma no ste/ / sems can bdun gyi mgo rnga tshang / / glo ba dbugs sgod yang na dga'/ / mchin pa khrag sgod chung na dga'/ / long ga sa sno da che na dga'/ / mtsher ba khrag sgod sbyangs na dga'/ / de 'do chen rta na sgod bzhi yin/ / zhes rta pho'i gzugs dang / mgo'i rnam pa bcas phyi tshul gyi dbyibs nas nang sgod bcud kye che chung la sogs pa'i don sgod drug gi khyad chos dang mtho dman gyi rnam pa re re bzhin brjod yod pa dang / yang dper na/ mdor na 'do ba'i yag bzhin de/ / khra brang khyung ske yu mo mgo / stod kyi yag gsum de na yod/ / ba rnga ka sgyid sgor bo drug / smad kyi yag gsum 25

glingasgrung las rta'i spyi tshogasakyi go gnas mdo tsam gleng ba/yin/ / sgyid pa 'di larnam gsum yod/ / ba sgyid tha sgyid ra sgyid gsum/ / rab 'bring tha ma'i rta la'ong / / rta so'adi la rigasabadun yod/ / rkyang sospubasachen de dang gcig / ba soze ga de dang gnyis/ /lug sodakar chung de dang gsum/ / 'di gsumasayibazang gsum yin/ / stag sorngamalade dang gcig / rnga so'aphyar bu de dang gnyis/ /phag so'ajur bu de dang gsum/ / 'di gsumasoyonganagasum yin/ /rkyang sasbubasachung 'bring bo yin/ / zhesapa dang / da dung spu rigasami'adra rnam lnga dang rmig pa rigasabadun/ sha yi'agyur bu bco brgyad/ rusapa'i dpa' bo nyi shu sogasakyang yod par bshad/ yang / rta rab re re mgo bo la//bre sar 'brong gi dpral zheng dang / / ru4sbalargyal po'i mig phrumal/ / zhe sdang sbrul gyi mig 'brasadang / / seng ge dkar mo'i sna khung dang / / dmar yag stag mo'i kha sha dang / / rna ba rgod kyi thul phran dang / / 'ju ru sha ba'i ma ne ste/ / semasacan bdun gyi mgo rnga tshang / / glo ba dbugasasnod yang na dga'/ / mchin pa khrag snod chung na dga'/ / long ga sasnod che na dga'/ / mtsher ba khrag snod sbyangasan dga'/ / de 'do chen rta yisnod bzhi yin/ / zhesarta pho'i gzugs dang / mgo'i rnamapa bca4phyi tshulagyi dbyibasanasanang snod bcud kyi che chung la sogasapa'i don snod drug gi khyad chosadang mtho dman gyi rnam pa re re bzhin brjod yod pa dang / yang dper na/ mdor na 'do ba'i yag bzhin de/ / khra brang khyung ske yumomago / stod kyi yag gsum de na yod/ / ba rnga ka sgyid sgor bo drug / smad kyi yag ༵snam

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/den yod/ / sha yu glang grod nya mo rgyab/ / lked kyi yag gsum de na yong/sto chus ngom pa sla dang lnga/ / bdag por brtse 'dun che dang drug / pha rol lag tu mi shor bdun/ / rdzu dang rnam rig bzang dang brgyad/ / 'grosadang gom pa yod dang dgu/ / gang bsam skad cig bgrod dang bcu/ /bsam/ don 'grub dang bcu gcig dang / / gar btang sa nas sdod pa dang / / gar bos sa nas zin pa ste/ / bcu gsum bzang gi ste mo 'dzoms/ / zhes rta pho'i rab 'bring tha gsum la zhib tshags kyis dbye 'byed byed cing / mi rigs gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rta bshad kye rig gnas de grub pa'o/ /nga tsho bod rnams kyis rta pho'i kha dog kyang re re bzhin btags yod pa ste/ rkyang dmar/ rgod ma she'u khra ma/ ra khra(drug steng na she'u thig can)/gro gro/gro dmar/ kham kham/ ra ra/ sngo sngo/ rag rag gwa ba(gdong thog na dkar sha can)sogs rigs 'dra min sna tshogs yod cing / srog chagasagazhan pa'i ming btags pa gong du smras zin to/ /gsum pa/ rlung rta sogs las rta la gdeng 'jog byas tshul/rlung rta ni bod rigs dmangs khrod du dar khyab che ba'i gna' bo'i chos lugs kyi bya 'gul zhig yin zhing / rlung rtas lha la gsol mchong byed pa'i cho ga ni gna' snga mo zhig nas bod la dar yo da pa lo rgyus sags la yang /stag seng khyung 'brug rta mchog dang bcas pa'i rlung rta'i dpe ris ni dus ga tshod cig la byung ba ni kha tshor gcod dka'/ 'on kyang de bod rang gnas26

gcod pa don grub dang snyingabo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/den yod/ / sha ༅glang grod nya morgyab/ / rked kyi yag gsum de na yod/sachusangom pa sla dang lnga/ / bdag por brtse 'dun che dang drug / pha rol lag tu mi shor bdun/ / rdzu dang rnam rig bzang dang brgyad/ / 'grosadang gomapa yod dang dgu/ / gang bsamaskad cig bgrod dang bcu/ /bsam don 'grub dang bcu gcig dang / / gar btang sanasasdod pa dang / / gar bosasanasazin pa ste/ / bcu gsum bzang gi rtse mo'adzoms/ / zhe4rta pho'i rab 'bring tha gsumal zhib tshag4kyisadabye 'byed byed cing / mi rigasagazhan dang mimatshungasapa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rta bshad kyi rig gnasade grub pa'o/ /nga tsho bod rnamasakyisarta pho'i khadog kyang re re bzhin btag4yod pa ste/ rkyang dmar/ rgod ma she'u khra ma/ ra khra(drug steng na she'u thig can)/gro gro/gro dmar/ kham kham/ ra ra/ sngo sngo/ rag rag gwa bzhugadong thog na dkar sha can)sogasarigasa'adra min sna tshogasayod cing / srog chagasagazhan pa'i ming btagasapa gong du smrasazin to/ /gsum pa/ rlung rta sogs las rta la gdeng 'jog byas tshul/rlung rta ni bod rigasadamangasakhrod du dar khyab che ba'i gna' bo'i cho4lugasakyi bya 'gulazhig yin zhing / rlung rtasalhal gsolamachod byed pa'i cho ga ni gna' snga mo zhig nasabod la dar yod pa lo rgyusasugasal yang /stag seng khyung 'brug rta mchog dang bca4pa'i rlung rta'i dpe risani du4ga tshokā ༵ga la byung ba ni kha tshon gcod dka'/ 'on kyang de bod rang gnas

gling sgrung las rta'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas mdo tsam gleng ba/nas byung zhing dar ba'i ri mo thog ma'i gras shig yin pa sus kyang bston du med/ mi rnams kyis ri dwags rngon pa/ tshe la bar chad byung ba/ than pa dang mu ges mnar ba/ rang byung gi gnod 'tshe dang 'phrad pa bcas mi 'dod pa'i gdon nam bkra na shis pa'i don byung tshe dngangs skrag gi bsam blo zhig gis gnam lhag mas pa'i 'jig rten gyi rngam che ba'i chos yod tshad la mchod cing bstod tshig 'bul ba yin zhing / rim bzhin srol de'i gzhi khyon che ru phyin nas dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa/ pho gsar jag la chas pa/ lo gsar dang dus chen la sogs pa'i skabs su yul lhagazhi bdag pho lha dgra lha/ chos skyong srung ma bcas la mchod cing 'bod pa/ rlung rta srur ba/g.yas dung 'bud pa bcas kyi cho ga de sa khyab rdo khyab byung bas rim bzhin nang pa sangs rgyas la'ang shan shugs ma jebs rang thebs sa song / rlung rta zhes pa'i ming ni phyis sa byung ba zhig ste/ thog ma'i ming la klung rta'am klong rta zhes kyang bya/ go don ni klung zhes pa yongs khyab bam kun gyi bdag nyid cesapa'i don dang / rta zhes pa cang shes mgyogs 'gro'i ming ste/ nga tsho bod pa'i sgo phyug gsum gyi bo rgyal yin zhing bgrod pa myur ba'i mtshon byed yin/rlung rta'i steng gi dpe ris ni rang byung khor yug gi srog chags gzhan lasathun mong ma yin pa zhig ste/ khyung dang 'brug stag dang seng ge rta bcasarigs lnga las grub cing / zur bzhi bor stag seng khyung 'dzug ngo da pa de la rlung rta sde bzhi ru 'bod/ dkyil dbus sa rta mchog rin po che yo da cing steng du yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang rin chen rgyan chas legs par brgyan 'dug27

gling sgrung las rta'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas mdo tsam gleng ba/nasabyung zhing dar ba'i ri mothog ma'i grasashig yin pa su4kyang bsnyon du med/ mirnamasakyisari dwagasarngon pa/ tshe la bar chad byung ba/ than pa dang mu gesamanar ba/ rang byung gi gnod 'tshe dang 'phrad pa bcasami 'dod pa'i gdon namabakra mishisapa'i don byung tshe dngangasaskrag gi bsam blozhig gisaganam lhagatsoyopa'i 'jig rten gyi rngam che ba'i chosayod tshad la mchod cing bstod tshig 'bulab yin zhing / rim bzhin srol de'i gzhi khyon che ru phyin nasadapa' bo g.yuladu zhug4pa/ pho gsar jag la chasapa/ lo gsar dang dusachen lasogasapa'i skabasasuyulalhagazhi bdag pho lhadagra lha/ chosaskyong srung mabaca4la mchod cing 'bod pa/ rlung rta spur ba/g.ya4dung 'bud pa bcasakyi cho ga de sakhyab rdo khyab byung bsarim bzhin nang pa sangasargyasala'ang shan shugasam thebasarang thebasasusong / rlung rta zhe4pa'i ming ni phyisasubyung ba zhig ste/ thog ma'i ming la klung rta'am klong rta zhesakyang bya/ go don ni klung zhesapa yongasakhyab bam kun gyi bdag nyid cesapa'i don dang / rta zhesapacang shelomagyogasa'agro'i ming ste/ nga tsho bod pa'i sgo phyug gsum gyi 5gyalayin zhing bgrod pa myur ba'i mtshon byed yin/rlung rta'i steng gi dpe risani rang byung khor yug gi srog chagasagazhan lasathun mong ma yin pa zhig ste/ khyung dang 'brug stag dang seng ge rta bcasarigasalnga lasagrubacing / zur bzhi bor stag seng khyung 'brug yod pa de la rlung rta sdebazhi ru 'bod/ dkyil dbusasurta mchog rin po che yod cing steng du yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang rin chen rgyan chasalegasapar brgyan ༵dug

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bod kyi skar rtsis su/ rlung rta'i nang don thad du/ sro/ga la sa dbang / kha las/ rlung rta bcas bzhi las grub 'dug khyung ni srog gi mtshon byed yin la tshe thag ring du skyed thub/ stag ni las kyi mtshon byed yin zhing lus po bde thang 'tshar longs 'byung thub/ 'brug be+e dbang cha dang thob thang go gnasabacas kyi ma/tshon byed yin pas de rnams gong du 'phar thub/ seng ge ni bsod nam/yodang bkra shis kyi mtshor byed de don rnams bde blag ngang 'grub thub/ de yang kha cig gis sde bzhi'i gzugs stobakod pa des mi 'jig pa ste rnam par rgyal ba mtshon pa yin zhes pa dang / don dam par 'byung ba lnga 'i mtshon byed du go na legs te/ stag nags tshal du gnas pas 'byung ba shing khams sam rlung gi kham/sa mtshon pa dang / seng ge ri bor gnas pas sa'i khams mtshon/ khyung bar snang du gnas shing rwa las me ma/ched pas me khams mtshor/ 'brug rgya ma tshor gnas pas chu'i khams ma/tshon/ rlung ni kun la khyab pas nam mkha'i khams mtshon pa bcas gsal bor bstan/ rta mchob gi gzugs ga bkod pa be+e nyes pa nas legs par bgrod pa/ ltasang na pa nasabakra shis par 'gyur ba sogs mtshon phyir dang / re ba yid bzhin du skong ched rta mchog nor stes brgyan nas phyis sa rlung rta zhes rlung gi zhon pa ltar 'gros myur ba'i don dang sbyar nas 'bri srol byung bar 'dod do/ / rgyal srid sna bdun las kyang rta mchog rin po che be+e mdog sngo na po rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu yid du 'ong ba/ nad sted cing 'tsher skad kyis 'dzam gling khyab pa/rgyal po'i thugs la gang shar shes pas cang shes pa/ 'dzam gling nyin gcig 28

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bod kyi skar rtsisasu/ rlung rta'i nang don thad du/ srog la4dbang / kha las/ rlung rta bcasabazhi lasagrub 'dug khyung ni srog gi mtshon byed yin la tshe thag ring du skyed thub/ stag ni lasakyi mtshon byed yin zhing lu4po bde thang 'tshar long4'byung thub/ 'brug ni dbang cha dang thob thang go gnasabacasakyi mtshon byed yin pasade rnamasagong du 'phar thub/ seng ge ni bsod namasadang bkra shisakyi mtshon byed de don rnamasabade blag ngang 'grub thub/ de yang kha cig gisasde bzhi'i gzugasasubakod padesami 'jig pa ste rnam par rgyalab mtshon pa yin zhesapa dang / don dmapar 'byung ba lnga'i mtshon byed du go na legasate/ stag nag4tshaladu gnasapasa'abyung ba shing kham4sam rlung gi khamasamatshon pa dang / seng ge ri bor gnasapasasa'i khamasamatshon/ khyung bar snang du gan4shing rwa lasame mched pasamekhamayomatshon/ 'brug rgya mtshor gnasapasachu'i khamasamatshon/ rlung ni kun la khyab pasanamamakha'i khamasamatshon pa bcasagasal bor bstan/ rta mchog gi gzugs subakod pa ni nyesapa nasalegasapar bgrod pa/ ltasangan pa nasabakra shisapar 'gyur ba sogasamatshon phyir dang / re ba yid bzhin du skong ched rta mchog nor buyobargyan nasaphyis0rlung rta zhesarlung gi zhon pa ltar 'grosamyur ba'i don dang sbyar nasa'abri srol byung bar 'dod do/ / rgyal srid sna bdun la4kyang rta mchog rin po che ni mdog sngon po rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu yid du 'ong ba/ nad med cing 'tsher skad kyisa'adzam gling khyab pa/rgya~X'i thugasal gang shar she4pa4cang shesapa/ 'dzam gling nyin gcig

gling sgrung las rta'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas mdo tsam gleng ba/lalan gsum bskor nusapa'i bang shugasarlung dang 'dra ba rta yergyal po cang she4ba laha ltabu'o/ / zhesapa'o/ /de bzhin phyi'i rgyalakhab du'ang rta lamachod bkur dang dran gso'i stegasabu mang po zhig bzhengasayod cing / mo sikho'i 'grem ston khang zhig tu rta pho gnyisal dran gsobyed pa'i dranagaso'i stegasabu zhig bzhengasayod de/rta pho de gnyi4kyisathengasamang po'i 'gran sdur khrod yang dang po blangasamyong ba red/ gzhan asen cang spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi ri grong zhig tu'ang rta pho'i dran gso'i stegasabu zhig bzhengasayod/ bshad tshul ltar na/ der misem/4dmar po lhog lhog tu'agul ba'i gtam rgyud cig yod pa ste/ de snga'i su'u len gyisargyalasrung dmag 'khrug rgyag skabasagazhon nu zhig gisarang gi rta khrid de skya dmag tu zhugs/ cang ma 'gor bar gzhon nu desagayul ngo nasarangasrog blos btang / kho'i chibasarta rang yul du log yin na'ang rta de rgyun par lam chen du brgyugasanasarang gi bdag po phyir yong bar re sgug byas/ de ltar nyin nasazla dang blon4lo la re sgug byasarjes/ mthar bloyothub kyi rta de gtan nasa'agyelasong ba na/ sade'i srid gzhung gisached du rta der dran gso'i stegasabu de bzhengayopa yin zer/ hang ga ri na'ang zang4la4bzhengasapa'i rta pho zhig yod/ rta de ni 'dzamagling 'khrug chen thengasaganyi4pa'i skabasasugayulangor shi bsader ched du bzhengasapa zhig red/zang4rta de'i gshamadu blo4thub kyi grogasapor phul ba zhe4pa'i gser yig bdun bri4yod do/ / ce khe ru'ang rta gsoba'i bshamasaston khang zhi/ ༵da

gling sgrung las rta'i spri tshogs kye go gnas mdo tsam gleng ba/la lan gsum bskor nus pa'i bang shugs rlung dang 'dra ba rta na rgyal po cang shes ba la ha lta bu'o/ / zhes pa'o/ /de bzhin phyi'i rgyal khab du'ang rta la mchod bkur dang dran gso'i stegs bu mang po zhig bzhengs yo/da cing / mo si kho'i 'grem ston khang zhig tu rta pho gnyis la dran gso byed pa'i dran gso'i stegs bu zhig bzhengs yod de/rta pho de gnyis kyis thengs mang po'i 'gran sdur khrod ang dang po blangs myong ba red/ gzhan spri so pe cang spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi ri grong zhig tu'ang rta pho'i dran gso'i stegs bu zhig bzhengs yod/ bshad tshul ltar na/ der mi sem sa dam/ra po lhog lho ga tu 'gul ba'i gtam rgyud cig yod pa ste/ de snga'i su len gyis rgyal srung dmag 'khrug rgyag skabs gzhon nu zhig gis rang gi rta khrid de skya dmag tu zhugs/ cang ma 'gor bar gzhon nu des g.yul ngo nasarang sro/ga blos btang / kho'i chibs rta rang yul du log yin na'ang rta de rgyun par lam chen du brgyugs nas rang gi bdag po phyir yong bar re sgug byas/ de ltar nyin nas zla dang zla nas lo la re sgug byas rjes/ ma/thar blosathub kyi rta de gtan nas 'byel song ba na/ sa de'i srid gzhung gis ched du rta der dran gso'i stegs bu de bzhengs pa yin zer/ hang ga ri na'ang zangasalas bzhengs pa'i rta pho zhig yod/ rta de ni 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thongasaganyis pa'i skabs su g.yumangor shi bas der ched du bzhengs pa zhig red/zangs rta de'i gsham du blos thub kyi grogs por phul ba zhes pa'i gser yig bdun bris yo da do/ / ce khe ru'ang rta gso ba'i bshams ston khang zhig yod 29

pa de'i nang gi yig cha las rtas mi'i rigs la lo ngo3500lhag la zhabasa'adegs zhus pa'i lo rgyus gsal bor bkod yod pa dang / 'grem ston gyi dngos rdzas dag ni khyad chos ldan pa'i rta khyogs dang sga chas sogs yin/gtam rgyud 'di dag kyang nga tshos rta ni mi'i rigs kyi ches blos thub kyi grogasapo yin pa gsal bor shes thub bo/ /

pade'i nang gi yig cha lasartasami'i rigasalalo'o3500lhag lazhabasa'adegasazhusapa'i lorgyusagasalabor bkod yod pa dang / 'grem ston gyi dngo4rdzasadag ni khyad chosaldan pa'i rta khyogasadang sga chasasogasayin/gtamargyud 'di dag kyang nga tshosarta ni mi'i rigasakyi che4blosathubakyi grogasapo yin pagasal bor shesathubabo/ /

1nga sgrung las sprul sgyur byi skor la dpyad pa/gling grung las sprul sgyur rgya sgor la dpyad pa/de yang skyes ste dam pa gang zhig lkog gyur gyi stobs shugs la brten nas dgos dbang gis phyi rol gyi srog chags sam bye dngos gang rung ba zhig la sprul ba bsgyur te las don mi dam/na pa'am khyad par can zhig bsgrub par sprul sgyur zhes go ba len bzhin mchis/ spru la sgyur la'ang 'jig rten gyi srog chags yod do cog gam yang na mthong ma myong ba'i dud 'gro'i lus gzugasagang rung du sru la nas gzhan don bsgrub pa dang / gzhan yang gang zag gang zhig gi rnam shes mi 'dra ba'i gshin po'i bem po gang rung zhig gi khog tu zhugs nas las don bsgrub pa de gnyis su dbye chog phyi ma der chos lugasakyi glegs bam du 'pho ba grong 'jug ces brjod kyin 'dug gang ltar kyang sprul sgyur ni gnyen phyogs kyi mi sna 'ba' zhig la mthu nus ldan pa dang dgra phyogs kyi mi snar mthu nus med pa zhig min te/ der yang gnyen phyogs byu skyes bur rang gi srung ma ste yul lhagazhi bdag dang dgra lha ster ma sa mgon skyabs ma/dzad nas spru la sgyur gyi rnam pa gang yang ston thub la/ dgra phyogs byu mi snas kyang gdon srin mang po'i rogs skyor la brten nas cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs ston nus pa lags/ dgra gnyen gang yin rung rang gi srung ma ste lha31
