gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/de yang skyesabu dmapa gang zhig lkog gyur gyi stobasashugasal brten na4dgosadabang gisaphyi rol gyi srog chag4sam skye dngosagang rung ba zhig la spru la ba bsgyur te lasadon midaman pa'am khyad par can zhig bsgrub par sprulasgyur zhesago ba len bzhin mchis/ sprul sgyur la'ang 'jig rten gyi srog chag4yod do cog gamayang na mthong ma myong ba'i dud 'gro'i lusagazugasagang rung du sprul na4gzhan don bsgrub pa dang / gzhan yang gang zag gang zhig gi rnam shesami'adra ba'i gshin po'i bem po gang rung zhig gi khog tu zhugasanasalasadon bsgrub pa de gnyisasudabye chog phyi mder cho4lugasakyi gleg4bamadu 'pho ba grong 'jug cesabarjod kyin 'dug gang ltar kyang sprulasgyur ni gnyen phyogasakyi mi sna 'ba' zhig la mthu nusaldan pa dang dgra phyogasakyi mi snar mthu nu4med pa zhig min te/ der yang gnyen phyogasakyi skyesabur rang gi srung ma ste yul lhagazhi bdag dang dgra lhalar masamagon skyabasamadzad nasasprul sgyur gyi rnam pa gang yang ston thub la/ dgra phyogasakyi mi snas kyang gdon srin mang po'i rogasaskyor la brten nasacho 'phrularnam pa sna tshog4ston nusapa lags/ dgra gnyen gang yin rung rang gi srung swā/ lha

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/klu gnyan gsumadang gdon srin gnasabadag sogasakyi rogasaskyor ram lung bstan dang bral na sprulasgyur gyi mthu nusarang byon namalhan skyesasu'abyung ba sdud re skan/ 'di ni gling sgrunganang gi sprul sgyur gyi khyad chosagatso bo'i grasaban pade ṭ+wāṃswā / dgra gnyen gnyis kyi mi sna'i sprul sgrur gyi khud chos/gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 'dir thog mtha' bar gsum du dngosayod ring lug4dang rtog pa 'char yan ring lugasazung 'brel gyi rtsom stangasaspyad yod/ sgrung dporu sprulasgyur byed pa'i dgra gnyen phyog4gnyisakyi misna gang yin yang dngosayod 'tsho ba'i nang gnasapa'i sha khrag gnyisaldan gyi gang zag yin la/ kho tshor phal cher lha'adre dang 'brela'adrisabyed thub pa'i nusamathukhyad par can re yod pa red/ khyad par du gling rje ge sar rgyalapo gtso byasapa'i dgra gnyen gyi mi snanyung shasashig sprulasgyur lathogasapa med pa lasagazhan khong rnamasakyi 'khor gsum la'ang sprulasgyur gyi nusamathu ldan te/ mi larogasa'adegasachen po byed thub pas/ klog pa po rnamasakyi semasakyang spronyamasarnamapar khengasapa'i dga' skyid kyi zhing khamasashig la ngang ngam shugasakyisadrangasapa'i snang ba zhig 'gog med du skyesasu'ajug thub pa lags/khyad par du gling rje ge sar rgyal po/ stag rong dpon po khro thung / 'jang 4dam rgyal po/ mon shing khri rgyalapo/ phu bo g.yag rgyalathod dkar la sogasapa'i sprul sgyur lakhyad cho4samanusashugasashin tu ldan pa red/ dper na/〈༷rdong gling g.yula'agyed〉las/ rgyal po nyid lcagasakyi sbrang chung gzugs

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/klu gnyan gsum dang gdon srin gnas bdag sogs kyi rogs skyor ram lung bstan dang bral na sprul sgyur gyi mthu nus rang byon nam lhan skyes ga'abyung ba yod re skan/ 'di ni gling sgrung nang gi sprul sgyur gyi khyad chos gtso bo'i grasayin par snyam/dang po/ dgra gnyen gnyis kyi mi sna'i sprul sgyur rgya khyad chos/gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 'dir thog mtha' bar gsum du dngosayod ring lugs dang rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs zung 'brel gyi rtsom stangasaspyad yod/ sgrung dpe ru sprul sgyur byed pa'i dgra gnyen phyogs gnyis kyi mi sna gang yin yang dngos yod 'tsho ba'i nang gnas pa'i sha khrag gnyis ldan gyi gang zag yin la/ kho tshor phal cher lha 'dre dang 'brel 'dris byed thub pa'i nulomathu khyad par can re yod pa red/ khyad par du gling rje ge sar rgyal po gtso byas pa'i dgra gnyen byu mi sna nyung shas shig sprul sgyur la thogs pa med pa lasagazhan khong rnams kyi 'khor gsum la'ang sprul sgyur gyi nus mthu ldan te/ mi la rogs 'degs chen po byed thub pas/ khrog pa po rnams kyi sems kyang spro nyams rnam par khengs pa'i dga' skyid kyi zhing kham/sa shig la ngang ngam shugasakyis drangs pa'i snang ba zhig 'gog med du skyes su 'jug thub pa lags/khyad par du gling rje ge sar rgyal po/ stag rong dpon po khro thung / 'jang sadam rgyal po/ mon shing khye rgyal po/ phu bo g.yag rgyal thod dkar la sogasapa'i sprul sgyur la khyad chos sam nus shugs shin tu ldan pa red/ dper na/〈'jang gling g.yul 'byed〉las/ rgyal po nyid lcags kyi sbrang chung gzugs32

gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/mngon pa tsam/ gshog pa srab pa zhig tu sprul nas 'phur byon te/ 'jang rgyal po'i 'gram du phebs nas sa dam 'dul thabs ci drag dgongs pa'i tshe/mtsho sman de'ang dkar phyogs la dga' bas rgyal po'i dgra 'dul grogs la de lnga zhal bzhes yod pa bzhin ge sar phebs pa shes te/ khrus kyi dzing bu myur stabs sa 'khrugs sa bcu ga pas/ 'jang rgyal po kho yang be+e tshom med par khrus sa zhugs nas hub gsum khrungs pa'i dang po der sprang bu ma oṃ/bar pa dang bsdebs nas zang bu de a pas ge sar nyid bdud de'i khog par phebs te slar yang lcags kyi spu gri gdong kha reg gcod zer bar spru lanas lan 'ga' dkrugs pa na/ rgyal po sa dam de nad gdon gyis thebs pa lta bus yar langs/ mar nyal/ 'gre jo ga gi ngang du yod skabs/ sku land kyi non pa ci byung zer te 'dri ba'i tshul byas kyang / rgyal po sa dam gyisagasung lan 'jal ma thub rung / thugs la ma ngan 'gog tsha'i 'phrul byung dgongs shing / gling phyogs sa mig hrig hrig dang ma/dzub mo ston pa'i skabasader/ spu gri des snying dkar nag mtshams stod grugs pas thul lo/ / zhesapa las 'jang sa dam rgyal po de ni gzugs che zhing 'jigs su rung ba/ rkang pa bsrings na rgya nag la skeb thub pa/ lag pa bsrings na rgya gar la skeb thub pa/ mtsho chen po yin yang hub gsum gyis tshar nus pa'i sprul sgyur la mnga' brnyes pa zhig yin pa shes thub cing / 1nga seng chen rgyal po yang spru la sgyur lathogs pa med pas/ khrus byed pa'i glags dang bstun nas khong rang sbrang mar spru la te/ khog par zhugs ma thag yang lcags kyi sru gri zhig tu sprul nas33

gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/mngonapatsam/ gshog pa srab pa zhig tusprulanasa'aphur byonate/ 'jang rgyalapo'i 'gramadu phebasanasasadayo'adulathabasaci drag dgongasapa'i tshe/mtsho sman de'ang dkar phyogasaladaga' bsargyal po'i dgra 'dulagrogasalade snga zhalabazhesayod pa bzhin ge sar phebasapashesate/ khrusakyi rdzing bu myur stabasasu'akhrugasasubacug pas/ 'jang rgyalapo kho yang the tshomamed par khrusasuzhugasanasahub gsum 'thungasapa'i dang po der sbrang bu ma tshud/bar pa dang bsdeb4na4sbrang bu de tshud pasage sar nyid bdud de'i khog par phebasate slar yang lcagasakyi spu gri gdong kha reg gcod zer bar sprul na4lan 'ga' dkrugasapa na/ rgyal po sadam de nad gdon gyisathebasapa ltabus yar langs/ mar nyal/ 'gre ldog gi ngang du yod skabs/ sku la nad kyi non pa ci byung zer te 'dri ba'i tshulabyasakyang / rgyal po sadamagyisagasung lan 'jal ma thub rung / thugayol ma ngan 'gog tsha'i 'phrulabyung dgong4shing / gling phyogasasumig hrig hrig dang mdzubamoston pa'i skabasader/ spu gri desasnying dkar nag mtsham4sudakrugasapa4thul lo/ / zhesapa lasa'ajang 4dmargyal po de ni gzugasache zhing 'jigasasurung ba/ rkang pa bsringasan rgya nag la sleb thub pa/ lag pa bsringasan rgya gar lasleb thub pa/ mtsho chen po yin yang hub gsumagyisatshar nusapa'i sprul sgyur la mnga' brnyesapa zhig yin pa shesathub cing / gling seng chen rgyalapo yang spru la sgyur la thogasapa med pas/ khrusabyed pa'i glagasadang bstun nasakhong rang sbrang mar sprul te/ khog par zhugasamathag yang lcagayokyi spu gri zhig tu sprulda hās

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bdud rgan de phyi 'a yu po du bsdangs pa lta bu'o/ / yang〈hor gling g.yula'abyed〉las/ sko de la 'gran tha'adzugs don med/ / bde la 'gran thabatsugs pa na/ / khos tshe long nang nas me gcig 'bud/ / ral gri'i kha nas rta rgyug byed/ / mdung mo'i rtse nas bro gcig 'khrab/ / rgya khab steng nas gar gcig bsgyur/ / zhes pa dang / de las gzhan da dung gtam rgyud 'di 'dra zhig kyang bkod 'dug ste/ de nas nyin zhig sku rje seng chen rgyal po de nyid 'jang gi mo ma kun shes dpon g.yog nyu sprul nas hor yul la phebasate/ 'jang nag po'i smyug zhu mgo la khyon/ ras nag po'i gos wa lus la gyon/ mi la 'dri mkhas pa/ rang gis bshad shes pa/ yo yig mang po drel la bkal ba/ sngar song mngon shes 'phrul gyis bshad pa/ phyi 'ong lung bstan a ger 'bri ba/ da lta ci 'ong thig la 'debs pa/ mngon shesalathogs pa med pa rgyus yod brgya bas rgyus zhib pa/ ngo shes brgya bas rtags che ba/ ste chung brgya bas mig rno ba zhig tu a chen ngom bang skya mo'i nag po lcags rdzong bar ma'i sgo la phyin no/ / de ni mi sus bltas na yang khungasabatsun pa/ rjes thub pa zhig 'dug zer ba'i skad cha de yang rtse dkar mo'i ste stong gi nang nas thos/ zhes pa las a chen hor du bskyod pa'i dus sa ge sar mchog sprul pa bsgyur nas 'jang gi smyug zhu mgo la gyon pa dang ras nag po'i gos lwa lus la spyon zhing / yo ma'i khyad chos ltar du shil 'dri mkhas pa/rang gis bshad shes pa/ mngon shes la thogs pa sted pa/ sus bltas kyang mom kun shes nyid dngos sa slebs pa ltar mngon zhing dgar dka' ba'i 34

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bdud rgan de phyi ma'i yuladu badzangasabaltabu'o/ / yang(hor gling g.yumo'agyed〉las/ mide la'agran 4'dzugasadon med/ / mide la'agran 5btsugasapa na/ / khosamelong nang nasamegacig 'bud/ / ral gri'i khanasarta rgyug byed/ / mdung mo'i rtse nasabro gcig 'khrab/ / rgya khab steng nasagar gcig bsgyur/ / zhesapa dang / de lasagazhan da dung gtam rgyud 'di 'dra zhig kyang bkod 'dug ste/ de nasanyin zhig sku rje seng chen rgyalapo de nyid 'jang gi mom kun shesadaponagayog tusprulanasahor yulalapheb4te/ 'jang nag po'i smyug zhu mgo lagyon/ rasanag po'i gosawalusalagyon/ mi la'adri mkhasapa/ rang gisabashad sheyopa/ moyig mang po drelalabakal ba/ sngar song mngon shesa'aphrulagyisabashad pa/ phyi 'ong lung bstan yiger 'bri ba/ da ltaci 'ong thig la'adebasapa/ mngon shesalathogasapa med pa rgyu4yod brgya ba4rgyu4zhibapa/ ngo she4brgya bsartagasache ba/ bu chung brgya bsamig rno ba zhig tu.achen ngomathang skyamo'i nag po lcagasardzong bar ma'i sgolaphyin no/ / de ni mi susabalta4nayang khung4btsun pa/ rjesathub pa zhig 'dug zer ba'i skad cha de yang rtse dkar mo'i rtse stong gi nang nasathos/ zhesapal4achen hor du bskyod pa'i du4sun sar mchog sprul pabasgyur nasa'ajang gi smyug zhu mgo lagyonabadang ra4nag po'i gosalwa lusalagyon zhing / moma'i khyad chosaltar du mila'adri mkhasapa/rang gisabashad shesapa/ mngon sheyolathogasapa med pa/ su4bltasakyang po~X shān shesanyid dngo4saslebasapa ltar mngon zhing dgar dka' ba'i

gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/gnas sa gyur khrug ba 'di ni khong gi ga sgyur gyi chu ra shin tu mthon por slebs pa'i mngon rtags yin zhing / khong gis pa tha sgyur gyi mthu dang nusapar brten nas ma rungs dgra bgegs log 'dren rnams cham la phab pa lasagazhand dung ge sar mchog lagazhan dang na mtshungs pa'i sprul sgyur gyi drag rtsal te/ ral gri'i khanas rta rgyug thub pa dang / mdung a rtse nas bro gab thub pa/ thabs dang shes rab glog dang 'dra ba/ las myur ba bser mkhrung dang 'dra bzhes rab rtog gi lam nas gas bor brjod 'dug pa las ge sar mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos yod tshad phyir mngon par byas so/ /gzhan yang gling sgrung gi mgo rnga bar gsum du med mi rung ba'i 1nga ge sar rgyal po'i sprikhu/ stag rong shog chen bco brgyad kyi ma nga 'a bdag gling stag rong dpon po khro rgyal gyi sprul sgyur la'ang gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos yod de/ dper na/ 〈bhe gling g.yul 'byed〉du/ de'i tshe stag rong khro thung gis da ni rdzu 'phrul zhig ma bstan na mi thub thag gis chod dgongs nasade mthag 'brong g.yag ri ra btsam zhig tu sprul nas gab rtse sogs mi lnga rkang zhabs su sbas/ g.yag rwa 'dom brgyad cu las tshe lce dmar hang hang byed pa/lus na yang rdo rje'i chadapung rabs 'bar ba/ kha nas sgra sgog pa'i ngur skad 'brug brgya dus gcig ldir ba lta bu/ rkang lag gis sa la brdabs tshe de ma thag gnams 'dar shig shig tsam du byas ban/ ste dmag gang mang ha lasanas ci bya gtol med du gyur pa'i dus su/ de'i nang nas ste dpon thog lhas35

gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/gnasasugyur 'dugaba'adi nikhong gi sprulasgyur gyi chu tshad shin tumathon por slebasapa'i mngonartagasayin zhing / khong gisasprulasgyur gyi mthu dang nusapar brtenanasamarungasadagrabagegasalog 'dren rnamasachamalaphabapa lasagazhand dung ge sar mchog lagazhanadang mimatshungasapa'i sprul sgyur gyi drag tsalate/ ralagri'i khanasarta rgyugathubapa dang / mdung mo'i rtse nasabro sagabathubapa/ thabasadabashesarabaglog dang 'dra ba/ lasamyur babaser marlung dang 'dra bzhe4rabartogagi lamanasagasalabor brjod 'dug pa lasage sar mchog gi thunamong mayin pa'i khyad cho4yod tshad phyir mngon par byasaso/ /gzhan yangagling sgrung gi mgo rnga bar gsumadu med mirung ba'i gling ge sar rgyalapo'i akhu/ stag rong shog chen bco brgyad kyi mnga' bdag gling stag rong dponapokhro rgyalagyi sprul sgyur la'ang gzhan dang mimatshungasapa'i khyad chosayod de/ dper na/ (bhe gling g.yula'agyed〉du/ de'i tshe stag rong khro thung giyod ni rdzu 'phrulazhig mabastan na mi thub thag gisachod dgongasanasade mthag 'brong g.yag ri rabatsamazhig tusprulanasagab rtse sogs6lnga rkang zhabasasasbas/ g.yag rwa 'doyobargyad cu lasamelce dmar hang hang byed pa/lusan yangardo rje'i tshedapungarabatu'abar ba/ khanasasgra sgrog pa'i ngur skad 'brug brgya dusagacigaldir bltabu/ rkang lag gisasal brdabasatshe de ma thag gnamasa'adar shigashig tsamadu bya4pan/ bhe dmag gang mang ha lasanasaci bya gtolamed du gyur pa'i du4su/ de'i nang nasaste dpon thogā sna4

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/je tshom sru tsam yang cha byed par gri bton nas spru la pa'i g.yag rgod steng du ma/chongs pa na g.yag rgod des khros pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan nas rwa g.yug gceg gis thog lha dpag tshang cig gi bar snang la g.yugs te sal 'byel/zhes pa las/ khro thung srun sgyur byas pa'i 'brong g.yag gi gzugs brnyan gzhan dang cham tshungs pa rwa 'dom brgyad cu las me 'bar ba/ lus na rdo rje'i ske dpung 'bar ba/ rkang lag gis sa brda bas tshe gnam sa kha lo bsgyur ba lta bu'i snang tshul zhig ster ba ste/ khro thung gi drul pa 'dir yang rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi rtsom rig gi 'bri thabs spyad pa'i dbang gis 'brong g.yag phal ba'i tshad las brgal thub pa'i gzugs brnyan zhig bzhengasa'adug gal srid ste ra'i dmag dpon thog lha pham par bzo ba'i dbang thang khro thung la yo da kyang / 'brong g.yag 'jigs rung zhig tu ma/ spru'i na kho rmeg med bzo thub pa'i nges pa yonas med pa de'o/ /gzhan yang mon shing khri rgyal po la yang sprul byu ra gyi mdzad pa ma nga po 'dug ste/ dper na/ 〈mon gling g.yul 'byed〉du/ shing khye rgyal posalhachen la gso' ba drag tu btab pas/ nam ma kha' chos nyid kyi pho brang nas/bdud kyi dmu skas 'jigs su rung ba zhig mkhar thog la zug ste/ shing khri rgyal pos 'khor gsum lus la bskor zhing / dpa' brjid yid du 'ong ba zhig byas nas nam mkha' la shor bas zhes dang / yang shing khro rgyal po desadamu skas them pa bcu'i gong nas/ lcags gzhu nag po thog 'bebs kyi steng la/ dug mda' ha la 'bar ba bzhag nas 'phangs pas/ 'dzam gling seng 36

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/the tshom spu tsamayang mibyed par gri bton na4spru lapa'i g.yag rgod steng du mchongs pa na g.yag rgod deyokhrosapa'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan nasar g.yug gcig gisathog lhadapag tshad cig gi bar snang la g.yugayote sala'agyel/zhesapa las/ khro thung sprulasgyur bya4pa'i 'brong g.yag gi gzugasabarnyan gzhan dang mimatshungasapa rwa 'domabargyad cu la4me'abar ba/ lusan rdo rje'i me dpung 'bar ba/ rkang lag gisasabardabasatshe gnam4kha lo bsgyur ba ltabu'i snang tshul zhig ster bste/ khro thung gi sprul pa 'dir yang rtog pa 'char yan ring lugasakyi rtsom rig gi 'bri thabasaspyad pa'i dbang gisa'abrong g.yag phal ba'i tshad lasabargal thub pa'i gzug4brnyan zhig bzhengasa'adug gal srid bhe ra'i dmag dpon thog ltaphamapar bzo ba'i dbang thang khro thung la yod kyang / 'brong g.yag 'jigasarung zhig tumasprul na kho meg med bzo thub pa'i ngesapa yenasamed pa de'o/ /gzhan yang mon shing khri rgyal po layang sprulasgyur gyi mdzad pa mang po 'dug ste/ dper na/ (mon gling g.yul 'gyed〉du/ shing khri rgyalaposalhachen la gsolab drag tu btab pas/ namamakha' chosanyid kyi pho brang nas/bdudakyi dmu skasa'ajigasasurung ba zhig mkhar thog la zug ste/ shing khri rgyalaposa'akhor gsumalusalabaskor zhing / dpa' brjid yidadu 'ong ba zhig byasanasanamamakha' lashor bsazhesadang / yang shing khri rgyalapo desadamu ska4themapa bcu'i gong nas/ lcagasagazhu nag po thog 'bebasakyi steng la/36dug mda' ha la'abar ba bzhag nasa'aphangasapas/ 'dzam gling seng

gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/chen rgyal po khong / lha dmag bye ba sa yas bskor cing sbrang ma rtsi la rub pa bzhin du yod pas/ mdun gyi lha dmag kha shas thor ba tsam las sbu'i zil 'od kyis ma/da' yis gnod ma nus na'ang / dug rlangs kyis nyi zla gza' yis sgrib pa ltar byung ngo / / der rgyal pos mda' 'phangs pas lta klu gnyan gsum gyis mde'u sgo drangs te spe lce ser rgod glog gsum gyis gang ste/ kho yobrang stod du me long phub tsam zhig yod pa de la che bas nas seng sgra dang bcasate gtor nas/ kho ye lus de phub ma rlung gis gtor ba bzhin du song /dngos yod khrab rmog sha rus dum bu rnams rdzong mkhar gyi mai nang du phrung /der rgyal pos rngong mkhar bye me 'obs de bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du bzhengs te kho me la bsregs nas rnam shes shar ri bo ta la'i zhing khams la drangs so / /zhes pa las mon shing khri rgyal po yang mi phal ba dang mi mtshungasapar sprul sgyur mang po yo da pa dang / khyad par du mtho nam mkha'i dbyings la ci dgar gshegs bzhud byed nus pa'i sprul sgyur gyi gdams pa thamatshan pa zhig yod pa bstan yod/ yang〈bye ri'i byur sgong〉las/ yang nyi ma de'i phyi nyin nam langs pa'i dus sa phu gangs ri shel rdzong dkar mo nas/ phu bo g.yag rgya'/ thod dkar gyi bsam pa la/ de ring 'phrul zhig ma bstan na dpa' rtul tshor 'gran tha mi nus/ rgyal po ge sar kho rang yang skebs yong ba 'dra bas yang dag sa red bltas chog snyam nas/ ri mtho gsum rtse la nyi ma shar ba'i dus der/ skad cig nyid lan ba lcamathang gi gad pa g.yag 'dra'i zur la song ste/ lhag yag dkar po ri rab tsam gnam lcags kyi ru thur 37

gling sgrung las sprulasgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/chen rgyal po khong / lhadamag bye ba sayasabaskor cing sbrang martsi lanub pa bzhin du yod pas/ mdun gyi lhadamag khashasathor ba tsamalasasku'i zila'od kyi4ma/da' yisaganod ma nusana'ang / dug rlangasakyisanyi zla gza' yi4sgrib pa ltar byung ngo / / der rgyal po4mda' 'phangasapasalhaklu gnyan gsum gyisamade'u snodangasate melce ser rgod glog gsumagyisagang ste/ kho yibrang stod du me long phub tsamazhig yod pade la thebasanasasing sgra dang bcasate gtor nas/ kho yilu4de phub marlung gi4gtor ba bzhin du song /dngosayod khrab rmog sha rusadum bu rnamasardzong mkhar gyi tshenang du lhung /der rgyal posardzong mkhar gyi me'obasade bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du bzhengs te kho mel bsregasanasarnam shesashar ri bo ta la'i zhing kham4ladrangasaso/ / zhesapalayomon shing khri rgyal poyang miphal ba dang mimatshungasapar sprul sgyur mang po yod pa dang / khyad par du mtho nam mkha'i dbyingayol ci dgar gshegasabazhud byed nusapa'i sprul sgyur gyi gdamasapa 5mtshan pa zhig yod pa bstan yod/ yang〈bye ri'i byur rdzong〉las/ yang nyi ma de'i phyi nyin nam langs pa'i dusasuphu gangasari shelardzong dkar ponas/ phu bo g.yag rgyal thod dkar gyi bsamapa la/ de ring 'phrulazhig ma bstan na dpa' rtul tshor 'gran yaminas/ rgyalapoge sar kho rang yang sleb4yong ba 'dra bsayang dag sured bltasachog snyamanas/ ri mtho gsumartse la nyi ma shar ba'i dusader/ skad cig nyid lan ba lcamathang gi gad pa g.yag 'dra'i zur la song ste/ lhagayag dkar po ri rab tsam gnamalcagasakyi nā shār

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'dom dgu bcu yod pa/ de'i rtse mon cha bong ba tsam mched cing dug gi kharlangs sprug pa ltar 'khrigs la nad kyi dal yams char ltar 'bab pa rnga 'tshodakar po sprugs na de bas 'bab cing thog mda' lhung bzhig byas nasabasdad do/ / zhes dang /yang nyin der gling phyogs kyi ru 'dren g.yas ru yin kyang / rgyal po chen po'i bka' las de ring ru 'dren la g.yon ru dgos gsungs pas/'jang g.yu khri dpon po/ mnyin rdzong dpon po lha klu/ 'bru lha bu bsamagrub/ dpa' tsha zhang 'dan ma byung khra bcas dpa' rtul rnams kyis ru sna drangs shing bshar nas lcam thang gad bzin tsam na khor yug thams cad dug rlangs kyi4bsgribs shing lam na zin par gyur la bar snang nas kyang thog ser du mam lce tsha tsha 'phro zhing 'dug pas/ dpa' rtul tsho 'gro ba phod par ru sgokhrig ger bsdad/ skabs der dpon po khro thung gis cho 'tsho tha yin par dgongs nas rlung gi 'khor bo bskor te nam mkha'i g.yang dag pa na gzugasabarnyan g.yag dkar po ri rab 'dra bde mthong byung bas/ dpa' rtul rnams kyis mda' stag dong gang re brgyab kyang gnod mthub par lam sngar ltar bkag nas 'dug go / dus der rgyal po nyid kyis dgra lha'i thog tshang nas thog ser mdzub khrid mdzad kyang g.yag rgod kyis thog ma blangs/ yang rgyal po chen po nyid de 'brong g.yag kham pa dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab tsam lcags kyi ru thur 'dom dgu brgya yod pa khan mai 'bar bsna na du ba 'phyur ba/drig bzhi la tshe rlung stobs 'phrul gyis sa gzhi gang ba zhig tu sprul nas 'brong 38

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'domadagu bcu yod pa/ de'i rtse mon mebong btsamamached cing dug gi kharlangasasmug pa ltar 'khrigasaland kyi dalayamasachar ltar 'babag rnga 'tshodaṭ+wāṃr poṭ+wāṃg4na de bsa'ababacing thog mda' lhung bzhig byasan4bsdad ༵/nga nyi/na patā ṭ+wāṃ/nga phyogasakyi ru 'dren g.ya4ru yin kyang / rgyalapochen po'i bka' la4de ring ru 'dren la g.yon ru dgosagasungasapas/'jang g.yu'i dpon po/ rmanyin rdzongadapon polhaklu/ 'bru ltabu bsamagrub/ dpa' tsha zhanga'adan yobyang khra bcasadapa' rtularnamasakyisaru snadrangasashing bshar nasalcamathang gad bzin tsam na khor yug thamasacad dug rlangasakyisabasgribasashing lamamizinapar gyur la bar snang nasakyang thog ser du mamelce tsha tsha 'phrozhing 'dug pas/ dpa' rtulatsho 'gro miphod par ru snokhrig ger bsdad/ skabasader dpon pokhro thung gisacho 'phrulayin par dgong4na4rlung gi 'khor lobaskor te namamakha'i g.yang dag pan gzugayobarnyan g.yag dkar po ri rab 'dra bde mthong byung bas/ dpa' rtularnamasakyisamada' stag dong gang re brgyab kyang gnod mthub par lamasngar ltar bkag nasa'adug go / dusader rgyalapo nyid kyisadagra lha'i thog tshang nasathog ser mdzub khrid mdzad kyang g.yag rgod kyisathog ma blangs/ yang rgyalapo chen ponyid de 'brong g.yag khamapa dbusakyi ri bo mchog rabatsam lcagasakyi ru thur 'domadagu brgya yod pa khan me 'bar bsna na du ba'aphyur ba/rmikā ༵zhi lamerlung stobasa'aphrulagyisasagazhi gang ba zhig tusprulanasa'abrong

gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/de la rwa 'thab byas pa na thal 'tshab nyi ma sgrib pa tsam du gyur nas/ yud tsam 'gor ba'i skabs der ge sar gyis byor pa'i 'brong de rgyal/ g.yag rgyal thod dkar pham nas rwa drud kyis dong bas gling dmag rnams kyis ki bsro btab/ ge sar rgyas sprul pa'i 'brong des g.yag rgyal gar song gi rjes ded pa na gangs ri shel rdzong gi logs tshogar song ma snang bas yud tsam bzhugasapa'i dus sa thog mde'u tsam bco brgyad 'phangs byung yang rgyal po nyid kyisastong nyid rtogs pas gnod mthub/ de nas rgyal po khong rdzu 'phrul gyisagangs rdzong du phebs pa na khos zangs sgam zhig gi nang nas lcags kyi mda' gzhu len gyin yod pa mthong bas phyag g.yon pas dam por bzung zhing g.yasapas gri bton ma thag rlung ltar mi snang bar grur la/ shul du sbrul zhig 'dug pa de'ang gnas 'phos nas song la lha 'dre rnams kyang dengs nas song / de nas rgyal po nyid kyis lha 'dre'i dngos rdzas sogs khyer nas mar tsam phebs ste g.yag rgyal de gar song dgongs nas thugs mnyam par bzhag pa na/ na ba lcamathang gi g.yon zur gyi pha bong zhig gi steng na be+e khra zhig tu sprul ste gleng dmag la bltas nas 'dug pas/ rgyal po nyid de ma thag bya ba le zhig tu sprul nas song ba na bya sgo tsam yang bsnang / de nas mar tsam phebs te lcam lung brag gi rtsa ba nas sku ngal cung tsam gsos nas bzhugs yod skabs/ khosalcags kyi pha bong gur 'dra zhig 'phangs pas dbu la phog nas yud tsam brgyal ba las gnod ma thub/ yang khrab rmog gyon te gri phyar nas bcar byung bar rgyal pos kyang ral gri btab pas khos gri ngo ma lon par phugs sgo nas bros/39

gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/delorwa 'thababyasaban thala'atshub nyi masgrigapa tsamadu gyur nas/ yud tsama'agor ba'i skabasader ge sar gyisasprulapa'i 'brong de rgyal/ g.yag rgyalathod dkar phamanasarwa drud kyiyodong bsagling dmag rnamasakyisaki bswo btab/ ge sar gyisasprul pa'i 'brong desagayag rgyalagar song gi rjesaded pa na gangasari shelardzong gi logasasugar song masnang bsayud tsamabazhugasapa'i dusasuthog mde'u tsam bco brgyad 'phangasabyung yang rgyal po nyid kyisastong nyid rtogasapasaganod mthub/ de nasargyalapokhong rdzu 'phrul gyisagang4rdzong du phebasapan khosazangasasgamazhig gi nang nasalcagasakyi mda' gzhu len gyinayod pamathongabasaphyag g.yon pasadamapor bzung zhing g.yasapasagri bton ma thag rlung ltar mi snang bar gyur la/ shul du sbrulazhig 'dug pade'ang gnasa'aphosanasasong lalha'adre rnamayokyang dengasanasasong / de na4rgyalapo nyid kyisalha'adre'i dngosardzasasogasakhyer nasamar tsayophebasate g.yag rgyalade gar song dgongasanasathugasamanyamapar bzhag pa na/ na ba lcamathang gi g.yon zur gyi pha bong zhig gi steng na bya khra zhig tusprulate gling dmag labaltasanasa'adug pas/ rgyalapo nyid de ma thag bya ne le zhig tu sprul nasasong ban bya sgrodzamayang misnang/ de nasamar tsamaphebasate lcam lung brag gi rtsa ba nasasku ngalacubatsamagasosanasabazhugasayod skabs/ khosalcagasakyi pha bong gur 'dra zhiga'aphangasapasadabu laphog nasayud tsamabargyal b.lasaganod mthub/ yang khrabarmog gyon te gri phyar nasabacar byung bar rgyalaposakyang ralagri btab pasakho4gri ngo malon par phugasasgo naswāṭ+wāṃs/

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dusader dgra lhanyer marnam4kyisaganamalcag4kyi ti tsha 'phangasakyang kho'i khrab rgyun silaler gtor b.lasaganod mthub/ yang gsa' zhig la sprul nasadzogaseng du 'dzul song bar dgra sawer ma rnam4kyi4thog ser bcu gsum 'phangasate ri brag rtsa brlagasabya4kyang gra gzhob patsamalasam gnod/yang gar song gzigasatshe mi rgod stobasachen zhig tusprul nasargyab ri der rdog pa gtad nasathal 'tshub phyur re 'dug pa mthong bsade ma thag kho'i rgyabakyi gang4ri rtse brgyad de lardog tho brgyabanasabasnyil te gnam sasteng 'og brje ba ltar song bsakhodangangasaskrag gisayud tsamabargyal yang / rgyal po ge sar myur bar phebasatshe yang misnang bar gyur/ cesalhagayag dkar po ri rab 'dra ba zhig gisa'agro lam bkag pa/ dug rlangasakyi4nam/ mkha' bsgrib4shing thog ser gyi melce 'phrob/ ru thur la 'dom dgu bcu yod pa/rwa yirtse monasamebong ba tsam mched pa bcasadang / rimabazhin sbrul/ bya khra/ gsa'/ mirgod stobasachen lasogasapa'i sprulasgyur lan grangasabacu bdunabya4te gling ge sar rgyal po yang 'u thug thabasazad du gyur pa'i snang brnyan bkod yod la/ lhag par du dgra phyog4kyisa'adi 'dra'i sprul sgyur thengasamang mdzad pa mig sngar par skrun bya4zin pa'i sgrung dpe lasashin tu mthong dkon pa dang / mirigasagazhan gyi brtsamasacho4lasade bsakyang nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin du mthong dkon pa lags/ 'di4sgrung gtamagyi rin thang dang nyamasa'agyur ldab 'gyur gyisaje legasasubatang 'dug go/40 gnyis pa/ dud 'gro rta dang 'dab chags bya sogs kyi sprul

gcod pa don spub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dus der dgra lha char ma rnams kyis gnam lcags kyi ti tsha 'phangs kyang kho'i khrab rgyun sil ler gtor ba las gnod ma thub/ yang gsang zhig la sprul nas rdza gseng du 'dzul song bar dgra lha wer ma rnams kyis thog ser bcu gsum 'phangs te ri brag rtsa brlags byas kyang gra gzhob pa tsam las ma gnod/yang gar song gzigs tshe mi rgod stobs chen zhig tu spru la nas rgyab ri der rdog pa gtad nas thal 'tshub phyur re 'dug pa mthong bas de ma thag kho'i rgyab kyi gangs ri rtse brgyad de la rdog tho brgyab nas bsnyil te gnam sa steng 'og brje ba ltar song bas kho dngangs skrag gis yud tsam brgyal yang / rgyal po ge sar myur bar phebs che yang mi snang bar gyur/ ces lhag yag dkar po ri rab 'dra ba zhig gis 'gro lam bkag pa/ dug rlangs kyis nam/ mkha' bsgribs shing thog ser gyi me lce 'phrob/ ru thur la 'dom dgu bcu yod pa/rwa brtse mo nas me bong ba tsam mched pa bcas dang / rim bzhin sgrul/ bya khra/ gsa'/ mi rgod stobs chen la sogs pa'i sprul sgyur lan grangs bcu bdun khyas te gling ge sar rgyal po yang 'u thug thabs zad du gyur pa'i snang brnyan bkod yod la/ lhag par du dgra phyogs kyis 'di 'dra'i sprul sgyur zangs mang mdzad pa mig sngar par skrun byas zin pa'i sgrung dpe las shin tu mthong dkon pa dang / mi rigs gzhan gyi bcoms chos las de bas kyang nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin du mthong dkon pa lags/ 'dis sgrung gtam gyi rin thang dang nyams 'gyur ldab 'gyur gyis nge legs sa btang 'dug go/gnyis pa/ dud 'gro rta dang 'dab chags bya sogs kyi sprul 40

gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/sgyur gyizlormi dī ༵/ rgyalalo sgrung gi nang du dud 'gro rta dang 'dab gsabya sog4kyi4kyang sprulasgyur gyisamidon sgrub thub par mazad/ nyag phran mda' dang gnamaru gzhu sogasakyisayang sprul sgyur byed thub pa red/ kho tsho'i shugasal brten nasa'aphrin gsar bskyalab dang lasadon sgrubapa'i gnasatshul rgyun du mthong thub/ dper na/ (hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉du/nga'i pha rta gnamagyi gyi ling la/ / ma rta yorta gro mored/ / nga lakyang rgod g.yer bo zer/ / phyi la byolasong rta yilus/ / nang lasangasargyasadagong4pa 'char/ / dpon ge sar mngagasapa'i bang chen yin/ / zhesapa ltabu lasarta mchog rkyang rgod kyisakyang mi dang 'dra bar rang nyid kyi che ba dang pha ma suyin pa brjod shesapa dang / gling ge sar gyi cha dang bang chen sogasasgrub pa'i lasadon rlabasapo che phrag tu blangasayod pa shesathub/ yang dper na/〈tor gling g.yula'agyed〉du/ 'dan masamada' gcig brgyab pasasdig gcod shan pa'i rmog khyung gtor/ rtse lnga de'i pho byang zur nasaphud/ mo byang gi dkyil nasabaton/ mgo ka 'isalag mthi'asatsam zhig rgya mthong kha phye ba ltar byas/ der shan pa 'gyel nasayod pa'i spyi gtsug rma khung nasabaltasapa na klad pa thol thol byed do/ / lcag tshan gyi yubasadakrugasanasagasod snyam ma thag tu/ rta 'do ba dngosagrubaldemapa na re/ tsha zhang 'dan mabyang khra lags/ sdig gcod shan pa me ru rtse 'di/ steng ma lhayiyulanasasku rje seng chen rgyal po dang la4smon 'brelaba'i sku mched yin/ shan pa me ru dī ༷di

gling sgrung las sgrul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/gyur gru mthu nus/gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung gi nang du dud 'gro rta dang 'dab chags bya sogs kyis kyang sprul sgyur gyis mi don sgrub thub par ma zad/ nyag phran mda' dang gnam ru gzhu sogs kyis yang sprul sgyur byed thub pa red/ kho tsho'i shugs la brten nas 'phrin gsar bskyal ba dang las don sgrub pa'i gnas tshur rgyun du mthong thub/ dper na/ 〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉du/nga'i pha rta gnam gyi gyi ling la/ / ma rta sa rta gro mo red/ / nga la rkyang rgod g.yer bo zer/ / phyi la byol song rta yi lus/ / nang la sangs rgyas dgongayopa 'char/ / dpon ge sar mngags pa'i bang chen yin/ / zhes pa lta bu las rta mchog rkyang rgod kyis kyang mi dang 'dra bar rang nyid kyi che ba dang pha ma sa yin pa brjod shes pa dang / gleng ge sar gyi cha dang bang chen sogs sgrub pa'i las don rlabs po che phrag tu blangs yod pa shes thub/ yang dper na/9ra gling g.yul 'byed〉du/ 'dan mas mda' gcig brgyab pas sdig gcod shan pa'i rmog khyung gtor/ rtse lnga de'i pho byang zur nas phud/ mo byang gi dkyil nas bton/ mgo ka li lag mthil tsam zhig rgya mthong kha phye ba ltar byas/ der shan pa 'byel nas yod pa'i spyo gtsug rma khung nas bltas pa na klad pa thol thol byed do/ / lcag tshab gyi yubs dkrugs nas gsod snyam ma thag tu/ rta 'do ba dngos grub ldem pa na re/ tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra lags/ sdeg gcod shan pa rme ru ste 'di/ steng ma lha⑪yul nas sku rje seng chen rgyal po dang las smon 'brel ba'i sku mched yin/ shan pa byu ru rtse 'di 41

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/hor gling gnyisamig g.ya4g.yon dang 'dra ba byed miyin pasabasad na nor bu dgra 'dul gyisagasung ci 'byon mishe4pasaskyur zhog zer ro/ / zhesapa lasa'adan masalcag tshan gyisaklad pa dkrug bsamapa'i skabasader/ rtasami skad smrasanasabakag par mazad/ shan pa dang ge sar rgyal po gnyisasteng ma lhayul kham4su sku mched 'brel ba yod pa'i lo rgyusakyang brjod pa dang /gal te 'dan masashan pa bsad tshe gling ge sar rgyal po'i 'phrin la4rjesam mon 'jang kha che bcasa'adulabar bkag rgya thebasasrid pasartasam 'ongasapa'i bya ba thamasacad gsal ler mkhyen yod pa ltabu'o/ /gzhan yang 'dab chagasabya yisami don rlabasapo che bsgrubasapa yang /dper na/ 〈hor gling g.yula'agyed〉las/ gur dkar rgyal po la btsun po'atshol ba'i blobasdur/ de yang gsosabya miskad smra shesapa rgya bya/ rma bya/ ne tso/ khu ta bcasabazhi yod pa de dag don gal bo cher mngagasate/ stod mnga' ri4skor gsum/ bar dbusagatsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khamasasgang drug rgya 'jang mon gsum/ li b.lakha che sogasathamasacad du btsun mo nyan pa yod min la bltabar btang ste/ bya bzhi bo sakhad gsumatsamal slebasadus/ ne tsosasmrasapa/ rgya bya rgya yiyul du song / rma bya rma shod yuladu song / nga ne tso lhopon rong du 'gro/ khwa ta nag tsog gar bde gar skyid yulal song zhesabashad 'dug par bltasan miskad shesapa'i bya bzhi yisami skad gsalazhing dag par smra shesapar ma zad/ rgyal por btsun mo 'tsholabadī ༵sa'agan yang phrag tublangasayod pa dang / gling gi 'brug mo hor gyis

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/hor gling gnyis mig g.yas g.yon dang 'dra ba byed mi yin pas bsad na nor bu dgra 'dul gyis gsung ci 'byon mi shes pas skyur zhog zer ro/ / zhes pa las 'dan mas lcag tshan gyis klad pa dkrug bsam pa'i skabs der/ rtasami skad smras nas bkag par ma zad/ shan pa dang ge sar rgyal po gnyis steng ma lha yul khams su sku mched 'brel ba yod pa'i lo rgyus kyang brjod pa dang /gal te 'dan mas shan pa bsad tshe gling ge sar rgyal po'i 'phrin las rjes ma mon 'jang kha che bcas 'dul bar bkag rgya zebs srid pas rtas ma'ongasapa'i be+e ba thams cad gsal ler mkhyen yod pa lta bya'o/ /gzhan yang 'dab chags bya yis mi don rlabs po che bsgrubs pa yang /dper na/ 〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉las/ gur dkar rgyal po la btsun mo 'tshol ba'i blo bsdur/ de yang gsos bya mi skad spru shes pa rgya bya/ rma bya/ ba tso/ kha ta bcas bzhi yod pa de dag don gal bo cher mngags te/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug rgya 'jang mon gsum/ li bal kha che sogs thams cad du btsun mo nyan pa yod min la blta7bar btang ste/ bya bzhi bo sa khad gsum tsam la slebs dus/ byu tsos smras pa/ rgya bya rgya a yul du song / rma bya rma shod yul du song / nga byu tso lho mon rong du 'gro/ khā ta nag tsog gar bde gar byud yul la song zhes bshad 'dug par bltas na mi skad shes pa'i be+e bzhi yis mi skad gsal zhing dag par smra shes par ma zad/ rgyal por btsun mo 'tshol ba'i las 'gan yang phrag tu blangs yod pa dang / gling gi 'brug mo hor gyis42

gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/phrogasapa yang kha ta nag tsog gisagasang myulabyasapa'i gtamalabarten na4phrogasapayin pa yang shesathub pa ltabu'o/ / yang(hor gling g.yula'agyed〉las/ gzugasache ba ri bo'i gtosadang mnyam/ / gshog g.yasapasashar phyogayokhebasapagada'/ / g.yon pasanubaphyogasakhebasangesagada'/ / bya lamache ba mi dar te/ / mche ba gangasari spungasa'adra gda'/ / sgro rkang re re'i sasbom de/ / mirgod dpung ba tsamar gda'/ / g.yusgra'i mgo la bab4nasabyung / / 'chag med gser gyi ka bachag / 'chad med dar gyi chon thag chad/ / 'bud med g.yuyiphur ba bud/ / bdalamed mchong gi cha ru bdal/ / bya 'di 'dra hor lagada' le yin/ / hor bya gang ga ro zan zer/ / 'ga' resabya than bsobo zer/ / gur dkar dpon gyi blabya red/ / nag po sgro gcig gda' le de/ / gur nag rgyalapo'i blasgro red/ /ser po'i sgro gcig gda' le de/ / gur ser rgyalapo'i blasgro red/ / dmar po'i sgrogacig gda' le de/ / shan pa rdzeru'i masgro red/ / de min sgro 'ga' gda' le de/ / hor ri thang bcu gnyisablasgro red/ / ce4pa'i dpon gur dkar rgyal po'i bla bya bya than bsobo desagasang myulagyi lasa'agan phrag tu blangasanasaskrog na4gling la'ongasate/ gling yul gyi gnasatshulamatha' dag rgyusalon byasapa 'dir blta4na/ hor gyi blabya de ni gang gi4kyang 'gran zla med pa zhig gi gzug4brnyan du bzheng4yod par ma zad/ da dung mi'i ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ~X subakod pa dang rab rtog gi lamanasakyang brjod yod pas// tu

gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la das da pa/phrogs pa yang khya sto nag tsog gis gsang myul byas pa'i gtam la brten nasaphrog4pa yin pa yang shes thub pa lta6'o/ / yang〈hor gling g.yul la byed〉las/ gzugs che ba ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam/ / gshog g.yas pas shar phyogs khebs pa gda'/ / g.yon pas nub phyogs khebs nges gda'/ / bya lam/che ba mi dar te/ / mche ba gangs ri srungs 'dra gda'/ / sgo rkang re re'i sbom de/ / mi rgod dpung ba tsam re gda'/ / g.yu sbra'i mgo la babs nas byung / / 'chag med gser gyi ka ba chag / 'chad sted dar gyi chon thag chad/ / 'bud med g.yun phur ba bud/ / bdal med mchong gi cha ru bdal/ / bya 'di 'dra hor lag da' le yin/ / hor bya gang ga ro zan zer/ / 'ga' res bya than bas bo zer/ / gur dkar dpon gyi ma bya red/ / nag po sgo gcig gda' le de/ / gur nag rgyal po'i bla sgo red/ /ser po'i sgo gcig gda' le de/ / gur ser rgyal po'i bla sgo red/ / dmar po'i sgo gcig gda' le de/ / shan pa je ru'i bla sgo red/ / de min sgo 'ga' gda' le de/ / hor ri thang bcu gnyis bla sgo red/ / ces pa'i dpon gur dkar rgyal po'i bla bya bya than bso bo des gsang myul gyi las 'gan phrag tu blangs nas lkog nas gling la 'ongs te/ gling yul gyi gnas tshul mtha' dag rgyus lon byas pa 'dir bltas na/ hor gyi bla bya de ni gang gis kyang 'gran zla med pa zhig gi gzugs brnyan du bzhengs yod par ma zad/ da dung mi'i gzugs ga bkod pa dang rab rtog gi lam nas kyang brjod yod pas shin tu legs so/ /43

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /gsum pa/ nyag phran mda' dang non po mchon kyi sprul sgyur gyi phan nus/nyag phran mda' dang rnon po ma/tshon sogs 'khor gsum/ gyis sprul sgyur byas pa'ang sgrung dpe'i nang du thog mtha' bar gsum du mthong thub/ gling rje ge sar rgyal po dang dpa' rtul sogs gang yin yang pha rol dgra bo 'dul ba'i skabs tshom da' mtshon gyis glu len pa'am mi don sgrub pa mang po 'dugadaper na/ ge sar rgyal pos bdud klu btsan 'dul ba'i skabs su mda' khrul gyi glu 'di ltar blangs 'dug pa ste/ gzhu'i bo mchog tshangs pa dkar pos 'tshos/ / ma ma/chog dung skyong klu yis 'tshos/ / 'chang bzung gnyan rgyal dmar pos 'tshos/ / mde'u sne khyab 'jug chen pos khrod/ / thog 'brug glog gsum rol du chas/ / glog zhags ser rgod dpung la chas/ /ma de'u sne bdud rgan steng du drongs/ / ngas ci bsam gcig tu 'grub pa na/ / kho'i dpral bar mda' 'di zabs mdzod cig / ces dang / 〈hor ser 'gyod pa'i mig chu〉las kyang / ge sar gyi mda' mo thog rgod 'phur shes kyis/ bu bzang po'i mtheb rtsal ma zhan na/ / nga mda' mo'i dpa' rtsal ci la zhan/ / hor ser po 'dul ba'i stobs med na/ / nga thog rgod 'phur shes ci la thogs/ / hor ser po sde shog khye ma 'bum/ / khrag dmar po thur mas dkrug dkrug byed/ / rdo ab rtse leb mo gnam la 'phen/ /gnam sa cha lang rdeb rdeb byed/ / dus bskal pa'i chags 'jig nges par ston/ /las de 'dra ma byas mda' mo nga / / rten lha mda' sum cu'i glud la 44

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/rgya gsum pa/ nyag phran mda' dang rnon po mtshon kyi sprul sgyur ༄ phan /sna phra/na mda' dang rnon po mtshon sogasa'akhor gsum gyisasprulasgyur byasapa'ang sgrung dpe'i nang du thog mtha' bar gsum du mthong thub/ gling rje ge sar rgyal po dang dpa' rtulasog4gang yin yang pha roladagra bo 'dulaba'i skabasasumada' mtshon gyisaglu len pa'amamidon sgrub pa mang po 'dugadaper na/ ge sar rgyal posabadud klu btsan 'dul ba'i skabs su mda' skulagyi glu 'di ltar blangasa'adug pa ste/ gzhu'i yamachog tshangasapa dkar posa'atshos/ /ma mchog dung skyong klu yis 'tshos/ /'chang bzung gnyan rgyaladamar po4'tshos/ /mde'u sne khyab 'jug chen posakhrid/ /thog 'brug glog gsum rol du chas/ /glog zhag4ser rgod dpung la chas/ /mde'u sne bdud rgan steng du drongs/ /ngasaci bsamagacig tu 'grub pa na/ /kho'i dpral bar mda' 'di thebasamadzod cig /cesadang / (hor ser 'gyod pa'i mig chu〉lasakyang / ge sar gyi mda' mo thog rgod 'phur shesakyis/ bu bzang po'i mtheb rtsalam zhan na/ /nga mda' mo'i dpa' rtsal ci la zhan/ /hor ser po 'dul ba'i stobasamed na/ /nga thog rgod 'phur shegaci la thogs/ /hor ser po sdeshog khri ma'abum/ /khrag dmar po thur ma4dkrug dkrug byed/ /rdo ab rtse leb poganam la'aphen/ /gnamasacha lang rdebardeb byed/ /dusabaskalapa'i chagasa'ajig ngesapar stonā/4/lasade 'dra ma byasamada' mo nga / /rten lhamada' sum cu'i glud la

gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/rdzongs/ / zhe4pa sog4lasamada' mo'i rtsal dang nusapasog4zhib par brjod padang / rgyal por mda' mo rang la blo khel chog pa'i glu lan btab yod pa ltabu'o/ / yang 'jang 4dmargyal po 'dulaba'i skab4kyi/〈'jang gling g.yula'agyed〉las/ ge sar gyisachibasapa rkyang rgod de tsan dan gyi shing drung du sprul nasanagasagaseb tu bzhugs/ rmog rgyal ba'i gling bzhi de shing gi 'dabamar sprul/ khrab zilab de chu mig gcig tu sprul/'khor gsum de metog tshomabur sprulate bzhag ceyopaltabu dang / yang〈rta rgyug dpyid kyi nyi ma〉las/ nga yilag gi 'ur cha 'di/ / ma mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbu skra dang / / shar seng ge dkar mo'i g.yural yin/ / 'ur yamachog yar ngo'i tshesal slas/ / ma mchog mar ngo'i tshesal slas/ / dkar phyogasalhayidabu 'phang bstod/ / nag phyogasabadud kyi kha gnon yin/ /'ur mthil zla ba gsum la slas/ / dgra lhamached dgu'i bzhugasaganasayin/ / dpa' lung nyi ma gsumal bkug / 'gro drug dad pa'i along yin/ / tshar lce nyi ma lnga la btags/ / 'ur yar g.yug rgya gar yul la g.yug / stod rgya gar chosakyi dar thag 'then/ / mar g.yug rgya nag yul lagayug / smad rgya nag khrimasakyi gnya' shing drangs/ / tshag sgrasanag phyogasabadud rigasa'adul/ / khob sgrasa'adre srin 'du ra gtor/ / go mtshon nang gi snga ma yin/ / myur mgyogasache ba'i lag cha yin/ / zhesakhrab rmog 'khor gsum dang 'ur cha'i sprul sgyur dang / khyad par du 'ur thag de phalaba'i 'ur thag dang mi'adra bar sprulasgyur che ba'i rnam pa brisaXtā de/

gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/rdzongs/ / zhes pa sogs las mda' mo'i rtsal dang nus pa sogs zhib par brjod pa dang / rgyal por mda' mo rang la blo khel chog pa'i glu lan btab yod pa 37bu'o/ / yang 'jang sa dam rgyal po 'dul ba'i skabs kyi/〈'jang gling g.yul 'gyed〉las/ ge sar gyis chibs pa rkyang rgod de tsan dan gyi shing drung du sprul nas nags gseb tu bzhugs/ rmog rgyal ba'i gling bzhi de shing gi 'dab mar sprul/ khrab zil ba de chu mig gcig tu sprul/'khor gsum de ste tog tshom bur sprul te bzhag ces pa lta bu dang / yang〈rta rgyug dpyid kyi nyi ma〉las/ nga yol ga gi 'ur cha 'di/ / ma mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbu skra dang / / shar seng ge dkar mo'i g.yur la/ yin/ / 'ur ya ma/chog yar ngo'i tshes la slas/ / ma mchog mar ngo'i tshes la slas/ / dkar phyogs lhan dbu 'phang bstod/ / nag phyogs bdud kyi kha gnon yin/ /'ur mthil zlab gsum la slas/ / dgra lha mched dgu'i bzhugs gnas yin/ / dpa' lung nyi ma gsum la bkug / 'gro drug dad pa'i sprilong yin/ / tshar lce nyi ma lnga la btags/ / 'ur yar g.yug rgya gar yul la g.yug / stod rgya gar chos kyi dar thag 'then/ / mar g.yug rgya nag yul la g.yu ga / smad rgya nag khrims kyi gnya' shing drangs/ / tshag sgras nag phyogs bdud rigs 'dul/ / khob sgras 'dre srin 'du ra gtor/ / go ma tshon nang gi snga ma yin/ / myur mgyogs che ba'i lag cha yin/ / zhes khrab rmog 'khor gsum dang 'ur tsha'i 0 sgyur dang / khyad par du 'ur thag de phal ba'i 'ur thag dang mi 'dra bar spru la sgyur che ba'i rnam pa bris yod de/45

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yar la g.yugs na rgya gar chos kyi dar thag 'jin nus pa/ mar la g.yugasan rgya nag khrims kyi gnya' shing drangs nus pa/ tshag sgra sa nag phyogs bdud rigs thams cad rmeg sted 'joms thub pa'i nus pa khyad mtshar po zhig yod pa de bsta na pa lta bu'o/ / yang〈khams gsum bde bkod〉las/ lham/da' thog rgod 'bar bas ji skad du/ gling mda' mo rnams kyisang la nyon/ / sku seng chen zhing la phebs rgyu red/ / nga lha mda' lha yul khams la 'gro/ /khyed lha mda' dgra sde'i kha gnon gyis/ / sems ma/ rmongs dgra sde dam la thogs/ / phyi dgra bo'i steng du 'phen nyin la/ / khyod dgra sha zo dang dgra khrag thungs/ / gleng lha sde phyugs nor sgo srung gyis/ / sa gleng dkar sto da kyi dgra lha byos/ / mda' 'dir tshogs sku khams bde mor gyis/ / de ma brjed mda' mos sems la zungs/ / dus ma 'ongs byang phyogs sham bha lar/ / 'khor gcig nas skye ba'i smon lam 'debs/ / zhes pa dang /ral gri rdul gcod sru gri yis kyang / gling dpa' mtshon rnams kyis nga la nyon/ / gling seng chen zhing la phebs rgyu red/ / nga ral gri la yul khams la 'gro/ / khyod mtshon mang dgra sde'i kha gnon gyis/ / mtsho'i non po dgra la g.yug dus su/ / sdang dgra bo'i snying khrag khyer la shog / gling lha sde mnyam skyid mnyam sdug byos/ / gling skyid dus mtshon cha mnyam skyid gyis/ / mtshon rnon po'i sbu khams bde mor gyis/ / dus ma'ongs byang phyogs sham/ bha lar/ / chabs cig skye ba'i smon lam 'debs/ / zhes pa sogs la sa kyang mda' dang mtshon cha sogs la'ang skyes chen dam pa dang 'dra bar nam 'chi la 46

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yar la g.yugasan rgya gar cho4kyi dar thag 'then nusapa/ mar la g.yugasan rgya nag khrim4kyi gnya' shing drangasanusapa/ tshag sgrayonag phyogasabadud rigasathamasacad meg med 'jomasathub pa'i nusapa khyad mtshar po zhig yod pa de bsta na pa ltabu'o/ / yang(khamasagasum bde bkod〉las/ lhamada' thog rgod 'bar bsaji skad du/ gling mda' mornamasakyi4nga lanyon/ / sku seng chen zhing lapheb4rgyu red/ / nga lhamada' lhayulakhamasala'agro/ /khyed lhamada' dgra sde'i khaganon gyis/ / semasamarmongasadagra sde dam la thogs/ / phyi dgra bo'i steng du 'phen nyin la/ / khyod dgra sha zo dang dgra khrag thungs/ / gling lhalde phyugasanor sgo srung gyis/ / sagling dkar stod kyi dgra lhasbyos/ / mda' 'dir tshog4sku khamasabade mor gyis/ / de ma brjed mda' mo4semasal zungs/ / du4ma 'ongasabyang phyogasasham bha lar/ / 'khor gcig nasaskye ba'i smon lam 'debs/ / zhesapa dang /ral gri rdul gcod spu grinasakyang / gling dpa' mtshon rnamasakyis nga lanyon/ / gling seng chen zhing laphebasargyu red/ / nga ral gri lhayuyokhamasal 'gro/ / khyod mtshon mang dgra sde'i kha gnon gyis/ / mtshon rnon po dgra lagayug dusasu/ / sdang dgra bo'i snying khrag khyer la shog / gling lhalde mnyam skyid mnyam sdug byos/ / gling skyid dusamatshon cha mnyamaskyid gyis/ / mtshon rnon po'i sku khamasabade mor gyis/ / dusama'ongayobyang phyogasasham bha lar/ / chabasacig skye ba'i smon layo'adebs/ / zhesapa sogasalasakyang mdwa~X dang mtshon cha sogasala'ang skyesachen dmapa dang 'dra bar nam 'chi la

gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor la dpyad pa/mngon ma/khyen yod pa/ pas sgyur la thogs pa med pa/ spru la sgyur gyis mda' mo dang ral gri steng lha byed khams sa 'phur song ba'i lo rgyus brjod yod par ma zad/ de dag gis bdag por rogs 'degs byas te cha don chen po sgrub thub pa dang yang na dgra bo yang 'dul thub pa'i nus rtsal yod pa gsal bor bstan yod pas/ 'di yang gling sgrung gi thun min gyi khyad chos gtso bo zhig yin la/ 'di lta bu'i spru la sgyur ni rgyal khab phyi nang gang gi rtsom rig brtsamasacho4'a/sa kyang ma/thong dka' ba yin no/ /bzhi ba/ mtha' ma'i dpyad gtam/bod kyi gna' rabs lo rgyus thog gi rtsom rig brtsam sa chos dag la dpyad na spru la sgyur gyi bsam blo dang rtsom rig gi 'bri thabs spyad 'dug pa 1nga sgrung 'ba' zhig min par gna' rtsom grags can mi nyung ba zhig las kyang ma/thong thub/ de min pa'i 'dzam gling shar phyogs kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gragasacan skor zhig tu ja dang 'o ma dang mar dang rtsam pa ji bzhin dam por 'dresayod/ bcoms chos de dag gi phyi tshal pa sgyur ram lha sgrung lta bu'i gyon gosakyis btums kyang don la pi che'i bden lugs brjod gang thub bgyis yod pas/ 'tsho ba'i dri zhim shug4rtsa thul zhing mi rnams kyi blo gros dang re smon/'bad 'bungs mdun skyod kyi snying stobs/ dgrar sdang zhing grogs la byamasapa'i rang gshis sogs gsal bor mtshon 'dug gal srid gling sgrung lasaspru la sgyur gyi skor dag chos lugs kyi shan shugs shig tu brtsis nas ring du dor ba'i dbang du btang na/ lo rgyus kyi snyan rtsom ring mo 'di'i sgyu rtsal gyi 47

gling sgrung las sprul sgyur gyi skor ladapyad pa/mngonamukhyen yod pa/ sprul sgyur lathog4pa med pa/ spru lasgyur gyisamada' modang ralagri steng lha yulakhamasasu'aphur song ba'i lo rgyusabarjod yod par yozad/ de dag gilobadag por rog4'deg4byasate midon chen po sgrub thabapa dang yang nadagra bo yang 'dul thubapa'i nu4rtsal yod pa gsal bor dīstanayod pas/ 'di yang gling sgrung gi thun min gyi khyad chosagatso bo zhig yin la/ 'di ltabu'i sprul sgyur ni rgyalakhab phyi nang gang gi rtsom rig brtsamasacho4'a/sakyang mthongadaka' bayin no/ /bzhi ba/ mtha' ma'i dpyad gtam/bod kyi gna' rabasalo rgyusathog gi rtsomarig brtsamasachosadag ladapyad na spru la sgyur gyi bsam blodang rtsomarig gi 'bri thabasaspyad 'dug pa gling sgrung 'ba' zhig min par gna' rtsom grag4can mi nyung ba zhig lasakyang ma thong thub/ de min pa'i 'dzam gling shar phyogasakyi rtsomarig sgyu rtsalagragasacan skor zhig tu ja dang 'o ma dang mar dang rtsam pa ji bzhin dam por 'dresayod/ brtsamasacho4de dag gi phyi tshulasprulasgyur ram 〈sgrung ltabu'i gyon gosakyisabatumasakyang don lamitshe'i bden lugasabarjod gang thub bgyi4yod pas/ 'tsho ba'i dri zhim shugasasuthul zhing mirnamasakyi blogrosadang re smon/'bad 'bungasamadun skyod kyi snying stobs/ dgrar sdang zhing grogasal byamasapa'i rang gshigasogasagasalabor mtshon 'dug gal srid gling sgrung lasaspru lasgyur gyi skor dag chosalugasakyi shan shugasashig tu brtsisanasaring du dor ba'i dbang du btang na/ lo rgyusakyi snyan rtsom ring mo 'di'i sgyu ṭ+wāṃX gyi

gcod pa don spub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sgrig gzhi dang gtamargyud kyi 'phelarim/ misna'i bkod sgrig bcasalaganod pa tshabasachen thebasangesayin zhing / de4gtam rgyud dang gtam rgyud bar/ sgrung khag dang sgrung khag bar 'brel bachagasamithubal/ rgya che'i bod rigasaklog papo rnamasakyiyokyang dga' bsumi byed par ma zad/ gling sgrung 'disa'adzam gling steng chesaring ba'i lorgyusasnyan rtsom gyi gser tog kyang 'dzin thabasamed pa susakyang mkhyen gsalaltar ro/ /

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sgrig gzhi dang gtam rgyud kyi 'phel rim/ mi sna'i bkod sgrig bcas la gnod pa tshabs chen jebs nges yin zhing / des gtam rgyud dang gtam rgyud bar/ sgrung khag dang sgrung khag bar 'brel ba chags cha thub la/ rgya za' bod rigs klog pa po rnams kyis kyang dga' bas mi byed par ma zad/ gleng sgrung 'dis 'dzam gling steng ches ring ba'i lo rgyus snyan rtsom gyi gser tog kyang 'dzin thabs med pa sus kyang mkhyen gsal ltar ro/ /

gling sgrung du bod gdod ma'i lha sgrung skor rgyud 'dzin byas pa/gling sgrung du bod gdod ma'i lha sgrung skor rgyud 'dzin byas pa/dang po/ lha sgrung gi go don dang phan nus rang bzhin/lhaskung ni mi rigasagang la mtshon na'ang rig gnayodang 'tsho bar 'bralathab4med pazhig yin/ sasgrungazhesapa'i tha snyad 'di byung ba'i rmang gzhi'i steng nasami'i rigasakyi misgo phyesashing / rim gyis thog ma'i dmangasakhrod rtsom rig byung ba dang / de lasad gzod rang byung khamasalangosa'adzin bgyid pa'i bsam blor 'phel rgya4chen po byung / dper na/ nyi zla'i 'char nub dang duyobazhi'i 'gyur ldog 'brug grag4pa dang glog 'khyug pa/rlungagayug pa dang 'ja' shar ba sog4shin tumang / slob dpon mar khe sis/ lhaphyung ni mirnamasakyi 'phrulasnang brgyud de rang rtog4mayin pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi rnamapar brten nasal4snon byasapa'i rang byung khamasadang spyi tshog4'tsho ba'i rnamapade nyid yin zhesagasungasapa ltar/ de'i go don ni lhadang sngon gshegasadapa' bo'i gtamargyud dam sgrung zhesapa'i don yin/ rang cag gnasapa'i go la zlumaril 'di'i steng du/ tsasgrung gi nang don dang rnam pa'i cha la 'phel 'gyur chen po byung yod de/ 'jig rten chagayorimagyi lngasgrung /semasacan byung tshul gyi lhathang / lha'amarje bo byung tshul gyi lhaming / tā~X'

gling sgrung du bod gdod ma'i lha sgrung skor rgyud 'dzin byas pa/khyung drung du ngod gdod ma'i be+e sgrung skor rgyud 'jin byas pa/dang po/ sta grung gi go don dang phan nus rang bzhin/lha sgrung ni mi rigs gang la mtshon na'ang rig gnas dang 'tsho bar 'bral thabs med bzhig yin/ lha sgrung zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di byung ba'i rmang gzhi'i steng nas mi'i rigs kyi blo sgo phyes shing / rim gyis thog ma'i dmangasakhrod rtsom rig byung ba dang / de las da gzod rang byung khams la ngos 'dzin bgyid pa'i bsam blor 'phel rgyas chen po byung / dper na/ nyi zla'i 'char nub dang dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog 'brug grags pa dang glog 'a ga pa/rlung g.yug pa dang 'ja' shar ba sogs shin tu mang / slob dpon mar khe sis/ lha sgrung ni mi rnams kyi 'phrul snang brgyud de rang rtogs ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi rnam par brten nas las sgon bya4pa'i rang byung khams dang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i rnam pa de nyid yin zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de'i go don ni lha dang sngon gshegs dpa' bo'i gtam rgyud dam sgrung zhes pa'i don yin/ rang cag gnas pa'i go la zlum ril 'di'i steng du/ lha sgrung gi nang don dang rnam pa'i cha la 'phel 'gyur chen po byung yod de/ 'jig rten chags rim gyi lha sgrung /sems can byung tshal gyi lha sgrung / lha'am rje bo byung tshal gyi lha sgrung / dpa' 49

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsomaphyogs bsgrigs/bo skyesatshul gyi lngasgrung sog4zhibakyi4brjod na rig4du mar dgar chogabod kyi gasgrung ni thun mong mayin pa'i bod kyi rtsomarig sgyu rtsalagyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin la/ de'i nang du mirigasashig gi 'tsho ba'i gnasabab dang /yulasrol gomasagashis/ rig gnasasgyu rtsal/ 'gro lugasa'adug stangasasogasaspyi'i rang gshi4sugrubapa'i snang tshulamatha' dag 'dusashing /bsamachor yar skulagyi dge mtshan yang gal chen thon yod/ dper na/'gro ba mi'i rigasabyung tshul ltabur mtshon na mi rigasagazhan labashad min sna tshogasashig mchisate/ nub phyogasakyi rgyal khab tu dkon cog gisa'ajimapa la4g.ya' tang zer ba'i skyesapho zhig dang de'i rtsib mabakog nasashā ba zer ba'i pozhig bzosate de gnyi4kyisa'adod pa longasasuspyad pas5gu mang du 'phelazer ba ltabu dang / rang rgyalagyi gna' rabasabashad srolalanyud dba' hre zhesapa'i lhamo zhig yod pa desarang nyid gcig pur bsdad na skyo snang skye4par brten 'jim pa yomigazugasa'aga' zhig bzosapadang /dedag la phu btab pasagason po miru gyur te 'gro ba byung zer/ bod pha spre'u dang ma brag srin mo gnyisalasabyung bar gragasapa dang gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung srid pa chagasalugs〉ltabur mtshon na'ang bod kyi 'gro ba mi'i rigasabyung tshun nasarusachen bzhir gyesate smug po ldong gi gdung rgyud gling ge sar zhesakhong gi rtogasapa brjod yod/ de bzhin mi rig4gzhan la'ang 'jig rten chagasatshulathad lngasgrung gi bshad rgyun du ma yod de/ yoshu~X ṭ+wāṃ4lugasakyi ltabar/ dang po 'jig rten de nyid mun pa4bsgribs

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bo skyes tshul gyi lha sgrung sogs zhib kyis brjod na rigs du mar dgar chogabod kyi lha sgrung be+e thun mong ma yin pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi sngon 'gro'i cha byen yin la/ de'i nang du cha rigs shig gi 'tsho ba'i gnas bab dang /shis srol goms gshis/ rig gnas sgyu rtsal/ 'gro lugs 'dug stangasasogs spyi'i rang gshis sa grub pa'i snang tshul mtha' dag 'dus shing /bsam blor yar skul byu dge mtshan yang gal chen thon yod/ dper na/'gro ba mi'i rigs byung tshul lta bur mtshon na mi rigs gzhan la bshad min sna tshogs shig mchis te/ nub phyogs kyi rgyal khab tu dkon cog gis 'jim pa las g.ya' tang zer ba'i skyes pho zhig dang de'i rtsib ma bkog nas shā ba zer ba'i yo zhig bzos te de gnyis kyis 'dod pa longs sa spyad pas mgu mang du 'phel zer ba lta bu dang / rang rgyal gyi gna' rabs bshad srolalanyud dba' hre zhes pa'i lha mo zhig yod pa des rang nyid gcig pur bsdad na skyo snang byes par brten 'jim pa yo6gzugs 'ga' zhig bzos pa dang /de dag la phu btab pas gson po mi ru gyur te 'gro ba byung zer/ bod pha spre'u dang ma brag srin mo gnyis las byung bar grags pa dang gleng rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung〈srid pa chags lugs〉lta bur mtshon na'ang bod kyi 'gro ba mi'i rigs byung tshun nas rus chen bzhir gyes te srug po jo nga gi gdung rgyud gling ge sar zhes khong gi rtogs pa brjod yod/ de bzhin mi rigs gzhan la'ang 'jig rten chags tshul thad lha sgrung gi bshad rgyun du ma yod de/ yeshu'i chos lugs kyi lta bar/ dang po 'jig rten de nyid mun pas bsgribs50

gling sgrung du bod gdod ma'i lha sgrung skor rgyud 'dzin byas pa/yod par/ gnam bdag gisa'od snang bskrun pasanyin mtshan dang phyog4mtshamayophyesashing gnamasakhabakar nasabar snang du mkha' dbugasabaskrun zhesapadang / rang rgyal gyi rgya mirigasal mtshon na/ phan ku'u zhesapa'i lha'i sprulab zhig gisathog mar gnamalag pasayar btegs/ sagazhi rkang pasamar mnan te gnamasakha phye zhesapa dang / rang cag bonalugasaltar na/'byang ba lnga yisnying bo las/ / sgo nga chen po gcig yong ba/ / phyi sgong shun la lhar+shag dkar po chags/ / nang sgong chu la dung mtsho dkar mo'akhyil/ /bar gyi sgo nga'i ngar cha la/ / rigasadrug semasacan kun tugrol/ / sgo nga phrumagyi bco brgyad chags/ / sgo nga bco brgyad 'bring ba de/ / dung sgong gcig tuyar nasayong / / de ni smon pa'i mibo lum lum yin/ / zhesasogasakhyad mtshar gyi lhaskung mang po yod do/ /de dang mtshungasapar gling rje ge sar rgyalapo'i sgrung gi nang du yang bod rang gi yab mesagong yornamasakyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ dmag don/'tsho ba dang dmangasasrolasogasamanyamasapar rdo lari mobarko4pa bzhin brtsam4chosakyi thog mtha' bar gsumadu khyab 'dug cing / ge sar sgrung nang 'dusapa'i 2sgrung de bod rang gi gdod ma'i lngasgrung dang 'brelab dam zab yod pa bsnyon du med do/ /gnyis pa/ lha sgrung nang gi rmu thag dang rmu skas skor/de yang gna' bo'i dusasumirnamasakyi snang ngor lhazhesapa nusaldan zhig tungosa'adzin cing / lhasa'ajig rten yod tshad ladabang sgyur byetā sbyob

gleng sgrung du bod gdod ma'i lha sgrung skor rgyud 'dzin byas pa/yod par/ gnam bdag gis 'od snang bsgrun pas nyin mtshan dang phyogasamatsham4phyes shing gnam sa kha bkar nas bar snang du mkha' dbugs bskrun zhes pa dang / rang rgyal gyi rgya shi rigs la mtshon na/ phan ku'u zhes pa'i lha'i sprul ba zhig gis thog mar gnam lag pas yar btegs/ sa gzhi rkang pas mar mnan te gnam sa kha phye zhes pa dang / rang cag bon lugs ltar na/'byung ba lnga ye snying bo las/ / sgo nga chen po gcig yong ba/ / phyi sgong shun la lha brag dkar po chags/ / nang sgong chu la dung mtsho dkar mo 'gyi/ /bar gyi sgo nga'i ngar cha la/ / rigs drug sems can kun tu grol/ / sgo nga phrum gyi bco brgyad chags/ / sgo nga bco brgyad 'bring ba de/ / dung sgong gcig tu yar nas yong / / de ni smon pa'i mi bo lum 'u ma yin/ / zhesasogs khyad mtshar gyi lha sgrung mang po yod do/ /de dang mtshungs par gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung gi nang du yang bod rang gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ dmag don/'tsho ba dang dmangs srol sogs mnyams par rdo la ri mo brkos pa bzhin brtsams chos kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du khyab 'dug cing / ge sar sgrung nang 'dus pa'i lha sgrung de bod rang gi gdod ma'i lha sgrung dang 'brel ba dam zab yo da pa bston du med do/ /gnyis pa/ be+e jing nang gi rmya thag dang rmya skas skor/de yang gna' bo'i dus su mi rnams kyi snang ngor lha zhes pa nus ldan zhig tu ngos 'dzin cing / lhas 'jig rten yod tshad la dbang sgyur byed thub 51

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa dang / lhatshang ma rmu thag la 'ju4te mar miyul du byung bar 'dod/dper na/ 〈dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉las/ lhari gyang mtho'i rtse labyon nasagazigasapas/ yar klung yul ni mtho risakyi yon tan sal 'phosapa ltar bzang zhing / yar lhatham po'i gangasari 'di lhun po mdzesasdug la chagasapa'i chu shel gyi dbang po nya gang bsa'akhyud pa ltar mkhyen nas/ lha'i rol ba'i rtse la gshegasan4lhaska4la babasate zhesarje gnya' khri btsan po'i byung ba brjod pa dang / lhanacig lhamang po'i mtshan gleng bar brtagasan bod gdod ma'i cho4lugasayin pa rtogasathub/ bod kyi lo rgyus(bka' chen ka kholam〉las/ kho'i spyi gtsug dang gnam gyi bar na lha'i dmu thag dkar nar re 'dug pa mi rnamasakyi4mthong ngo ltabu dang / gzhan〈mkhasapa'i dga' ston〉las/ ri brag mi thogasamakha' lagasheg4bzhud byed/ / srasakyiyochib4khathubapar gyur pa na/ / rmu thag la'ajuganamam/khar gshegasasoskad/ / lhal ro med 'ja' tshon ltar yal bas/ / grongasakyi bang soganam labatab zhesagrags/ / zhesapa dang / ('khrungasagling〉las/ ldo nga ra khra rgad po'i gdung sbasapa la/ rma dkar lha'i lhalam gong ma'i g.yas zur du/ shar phye haspungs/ nub tu ri'i rmu thag ma chad pa'i sal sbas/ de'i ltasasunub ri yichu thag mchad pa de sprug po ldong largyunathag ring ba'i rtags/zhesapa ltabu ni bod rje byon tshul dang gsheg4tshulagyi ltab gzhir bzung nasargyun 'dzin sor bzhag byasapa dang / rmu thag gi lhaskung 'di gdod ma'i bon choswāṭ+wāṃ grub cha gtso bo zhig yin par 'dod cing / de ni bon gyi lhadang rje bo

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /pa dang / lha tshang ma rmu thag la 'jus te mar mi yul du byung bar 'dod/dper na/ 〈dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉las/ lha ri rgyang ma/tho'i rtse labyon nas gzigs pas/ yar khrung yul ni mtho ris kyi yon tan sal 'phosapa lta1ra bzang zhing / yar lha sham po'i gangs ri 'di lhun po ma dzes sdug la chags pa'i chu shel gyi dbang po nya gang bas 'khyud pa ltar mkhyen nas/ lha ri rol ba'i rtse la gshegs nas lha skas la babs te zhes rje gnya' khri btsan po'i byung ba brjod pa dang / lhan cig lha mang po'i mtshan gleng bar brtags na bod gdod ma'i chos lugs yin pa rtogs thub/ bod kyi lo rgyus〈bka' chen ka khol ma〉las/ kho'i spyo gtsug dang gnam gyi bar na lha'i da nu/ thag dkar nar re 'dug pa mi rnams kyis mthong ngo lta bu dang / gzhan〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉las/ ri brag mi thogs mkha' la gshegs bzhud byed/ / sra/sakyis chibs kha thub par gyur pa na/ / rmu thag la 'jus nam ma/khar gshegasaso skad/ / lhal ro med 'ja' tshor ltar yal bas/ / grongs kyi bang soganam la btab zhes grags/ / zhes pa dang / 〈'khru pas gling〉las/ jo nga ra khra rgad po'i gdung sbas pa la/ rma dkar lha'i lhal ma gong ma'i g.yas zur du/ shar phye lho srungs/ nub tu ri'i rmu thag ma chad pa'i sal sbas/ de'i ltas su nub ri na dru thag ma chad pa de srug po ldo nga la rgyun thag ring ba'i rtags/zhes pa lta bu ni bod rje byon tshul dang gshegs tshul gyi ltab gzhir bzung nasargyun 'dzin sor bzhag byas pa dang / rmu thag gi lha sgrung 'di gdod ma'i bon chos kyi grub cha gtso bo zhig yin par 'dod cing / de ni bon gyi lha dang rje bo 52

gling sgrung du bod gdod ma'i lha sgrung skor rgyud 'dzin byas pa/rnamayoyar 'go mar 'bab byed pa'i them skasaltabur gyur 'dug par ma zad/rmu thag 'disami phyed 2phyed kyi gshesaka'ang gsal bor mtshon par byasayod/yin na yang gling ge sar mchog rmu thag lasagasheg4bzhud byasapa'i gsung sgrosam thosakyang / ge sar sgrung nang du mthag zhesapa'i tha snyad 'di lhaskung gi rnam pa grub byed kyi grub cha gtso bo zhig tu gyur 'dug pa dper na/〈khamasagasum bde bkod〉du/ ma 'brug mo dang mgar bza' chosasgron gnyisasku seng chen gyi g.yasagayon du bzhugasashing / de gnyisakyisan chung bu mo rnamasal 'tshams 'dri byasapa dang sprin dkar nag gnyisakyi mtshamasasubasleb4pa na/ nam mkha' thamasacad 'ja' yisagang zhing sman dang sposadri thul/ lhadang ltamosagadugasadang rgyalamatshan bskor/ dar chen phyar/ rnga chen dang 'khar rnga brdungs/ rol mo sgrog cing rgya gling bus/ tsi dang gling bu bus/ glu dang gar la rtsen/ stod lhayul khamasakyi lhachen tshangasapa dkar po gtso mdzad pa'i lhaphrug khri ma'abum dang / gnam ane gong sman rgyal mogatso mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro bye ba bdun bzhugasate/ yar lhayul khamasasu 'phur song ngo / / zhe4pa lasage sar rgyal po nyid lhayul du ci dgar gshegasabazhud byed thub pa dang / 'gro rang dbang dang 'dug tshogasabasagasayin pa/ nam 'chi lamangon mkhyen yod pa/ mya ngan lasa'adasaskab4kyang thad kur gnam la gshegs pa bca4gnya' khri dang kun nasamatshungasapa'i cha ha cang mang po yod do/ /gsum pa/ lha sgrung nang gi dud 'gro dang 'dab chags bzlo/

kring sgrung du bod gdod ma'i lha sgrung skor rgyud 'dzin byas pa/rnams yar 'go mar 'bab byed pa'i zem skas lta bur gyur 'dug par ma zad/rmu thag 'dis mi phyed lha phyed kyi gshis ka'ang gsal bor mtshon par byas yod/yin na yang gling ge sar mchog rmu thag las gshegs bzhud byas pa'i gsung sgos ma thos kyang / ge sar sgrung nang du rmu thag zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di lha sgrung gi rnam pa grub byed kyi grub cha gtso bo zhig tu gyur 'dug pa dper na/〈khams gsum bde bkod〉du/ ma 'brug mo dang mgar bza' chos sgo na gnyis sku seng chen gyi g.yas g.yon du bzhugs shing / de gnyis kyis na chung bu mo rnams la 'tsham ma 'dri byas pa dang sprin dkar nag gnyis kyi mtshamasasab slebs pa na/ nam ma/kha' thams cad 'ja' yis gang zhing sman dang spos dri thul/ lha dang la mos gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bskor/ dar chen phyar/ rnga chen dang 'khar rnga brdungs/ rol mo sgog cing rgya gling bus/ tsi dang gling bu bus/ glu dang gar la rtsen/ stod lta yul khams kyi lha chen tshangs pa dkar po gtso mdzad pa'i lha phrug khye ma 'bum dang / gnam a de gong sman rgyal mo gtso mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro bye ba bdun bzhugs te/ yar lha yul khams su 'phur so/nga ngo / /zhes pa las ge sar rgyal po nyid lha yul du ci dgar gshegs bzhud byed thub pa dang / 'gro rang dbang dang 'dug tshogs bsags yin pa/ nam 'chi la mngon mkhyen yod pa/ mya ngan lasa'adas skabs kyang thad kar gnam la gshegs pa bcas gnya' khri dang kun nas mtshungs pa'i cha ha cang mang po yod do/ /gsum pa/ lha grung nang gi dud 'gro dang 'dab chags skor/53

gcod pa don thub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/spyir lha sgrung ni bskal ba bo thog gi dus su byung ba'i mi'i rigs kyi 'jig rten lta tshul zhig dang mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin/gling sgrung la'ang bod gna' rabs kyi lha sgrung gi shan shugs zabs yod pa ste/dper na〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉du/ 'brug mos khrung khrung la 'phrin bskur zhing khrung khrung srun gsum gyis glu blangs tshul 'di ltar bris 'dug pa ste/be+e nga dang nga ngo ma shes na/ / khrung khrung dkar mo srun gsum yin/ / seng lcam 'brug mo'i bla be+e yin/ / zhes pa dang hor gur dkar rgyal po'i bla bya khru tas glu blangs pa/ bya nga dang nga ngo ma shes na/ / kha ta nag chung sran ma'i mig / rwa co'i mchu la tam bo'i ske/ / bra bo'i sna la zar ma 'i lce/ / gur dkar rgyal po'i gsos bya yin/ / zhes pa/ yang〈hor 1nga g.yul 'byed〉du/ gling dmag 'bod du rkyang rgod btang ste glu blangs tshur la/ nga'i pha rta gnam gyi gyi ling la/ / ma rta sa rta gro mo red/ / nga la rkyang rgod g.yer bo zer/ / phyi la byol song rta a lus/ / nang la sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'char/ / dpon ge sar mngags pa'i bang chen yin/ / zhes pa sogs lasa'adab chags bya dang cang shes rta sogs kyis kyang mi skad shes par ma zad/de dag la mi dang 'dra ba'i thun mong gi 'dod 'dun yod pa gas la bor bstan yod la/ ge sar mchog gi gsal 'thab gang mang zhig gi khrod du'ang skyen po mda' dang non po mtshon/ mthon po ri dang gtsang bo chu sogasalhasgrung gi 'char yan rnam pa can mang po yod pa mthong thub cing / de dag kyang tun hong gter yig las byung ba'i rgyal po gri gum btsan po'i blon po lo ngam54

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/spyir lngasgrubani bskalapa4thogagi dusasubyung ba'i mi'i rigasakyi 'jig rten ltatshulazhig dang mi'i rigasakyi bsamablo'i sgyu rtsalazhig yin/gling sgrung la'ang bod gna' rabasakyi lngasgrung gi shan shugasatheb4yod pa ste/dper na〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉du/ 'brug mosakhrung khrung la 'phrin bskur zhing khrung khrung spun gsuyogyisaglu blangasatshula'adi ltar bri4'dug pa ste/bya nga dang nga ngo mashesan/ / khrung khrung dkar mospun gsumayin/ / seng lcama'abrug mo'i blabya yin/ / zhesapa dang hor gur dkar rgyalapo'i bla bya khwa tasaglu blangasapa/ bya nga dang nga ngo ma shesan/ / khu ta nag chung sran ma'i mig / rwa co'i mchu latam be'i ske/ / bra bo'i sna lazar ma'i lce/ / gur dkar rgyal po'i gsosabya yin/ / zhesapa/ yang〈hor gling g.yula'agyed〉du/ gling dmag 'bod du rkyang rgod btang ste glu blangasatshul la/ ba'i pha rta gnamagyi gyi ling la/ / marta sarta gro mored/ / nga la rkyang rgod g.yer bo zer/ / phyi la byol song rta yilus/ / nang la sangasargyasadagongasapa 'char/ / dpon ge sar mngagasapa'i bang chen yin/ / zhesapa sogasalasa'adabachag4bya dang cang she4rta sogasakyisakyang miskad shesapar ma zad/de dag la midang 'dra ba'i thun mong gi 'dod 'dun yod pa gsal bor bstan yod la/ ge sar mchog gi g.yula'athab gang mang zhig gi khrod du'ang skyen po mda' dang rnon po mtshon/ mthon pori dang gtsang bo chu sogasalhasgrung gi 'char yan rnamapa can mang po yod pa mthong thub cing / de dag kyang tunā ṭ+wāṃng gter yig la4byung ba'i rgyalapogri gumabatsan po'i blon po longam

gling sgrung du bod gdod ma'i lha sgrung skor rgyud 'dzin byas pa/rta rdzi gnyiyomamathun par 'galab byung dusamyulamar btang ba'i gtam rgyud nang gi lkog nyan mkhanakhyi ponyan gyi rna sring mazhesapa miskad go ba/ thosatshad rgyal por yar zhu byed pa'i gtamargyud de la4yo'ad4so/ / de ltar gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung la gdod ma'i sasgrung gi rnam pa mnyamapar bsresayod pa ni rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang je mtho dang 'jig rten gragasapa lasaring du brgal ba'i dkyog mtshamasashig red snyayomo/ /bzhi ba/ lha sgrung nang gi rmi lam dang rmi ltas skor/spyir rmi lamani bden grub kyi rang bzhin med cing bsam blo'i brtse dung la 'brel bdamapoyod pa'i 'khrulashe4can gyi snang tshul zhig yin mod/'on kyang bod mi rigayorang lasngayozhig na4dpa' bo rmi lam du sbrum pa'i byung rim de rgyun 'byam4sugyur 'dug bod gdod ma'i lhasgrung lasadapa' bo klu dang btsan laganyen sdebapa'i srol chagasa'adug der rgyu rkyen 'ga' 'du4pa ste/ lhamayoklu laganyen sdeb pa ni mthu dang stob4'byor/ sgyu 'phrul/ thob thang / gzhan lasakhyad 'phagasastonabyed kyi thun mong mayin pa'i re 'dun mtshon stangasashig yin/ bod kyi lorgyusayongasagragasasu/rgyal po to re long btsanayanachad du bod kyi rgyalapo tshang ma klu'am btsan gang rung la gnyen bsgrigasaskad/ lhag par du gri guyobatsan po'i lo rgyu4su/ longamagyisani lhagacig chubamar bzung/ / lcamasring bzhi yiyul larta rdzi bcol/ / rta 'tshor phyin te gnyid log rmi lamadu/ / midakar mdzesapa zhig dang bshosapa rmis/ / sad tshe g.yag dkar zhig ni song ba mthong 5/5 /

gleng sgrung du bod gdod ma'i lha sgrung skor rgyud 'dzin byas pa/rta dzi gnyis ma mthun par 'gal ba byung dus myul mar btang ba'i gtam rgyud nang gi skog nyan mkhan khyi mo nyan gyi rna sring ma zhes pa mi skad go ba/ thosatshad rgyal por yar zhu byed pa'i gtam rgyud de las ma 'das so/ / de ltar gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung la gdod ma'i lha sgrung gi rnam pa mnyam par bsresayo da pa ni rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang je mtho dang 'jig rten grags pa lasaring du brgal ba'i dkyog mtshams shig red snyam mo/ /bzhi ba/ lha grung nang gi rmi lam dang mi ltas skor/spyor dri lam ni bden grub kyi rang bzhin sked cing bsam blo'i brtse dung la 'brel ba dam po yod pa'i 'khrul shes can gyi snang tshub zhig yin mod/'on kyang bod mi rigs rang la snga yo zhig nas dpa' bo mi lam du sprum pa'i byung rim de rgyun 'byams gsar 'dug bod gdod ma'i lha sgrung las dpa' bo klu dang btsan la gnyen sdeb pa'i srol chags 'dug der rgyu rkyen 'ga' 'dus pa ste/ lha sras klu la gnyen sdeb pa ni mthu dang stobs 'byor/ sgyu 'phrul/ thob thang / gzhan las khyad 'phags ston byed kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i re 'dun mtshon stangs shig yin/ bod kyi lo rgyus yongs gags su/rgyal po to re long btsan yan chad du bod kyi rgyal po tshang ma klu'am/ btsan gang rung la gnyen bsgrigs skad/ lhag par du gri gum btsan po'i lo rgyus su/ lo ngam gyis ni lhagacig chung mar bzung / / lcam sring bzhi cha yul la rta dzi bcol/ / rta 'tshor phyin te gnyid log rmi lam du/ / mi dkar mdzes pa zhig dang bshos pa mis/ / sad che g.yag dkar zhig ni song ba mthong / /55

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/zla ba tshang nasakhrag rlangasa'agulababatsas/ /'brong ru dron mor bcug nasa'o ma4bran/ /drod kyisabatsosapa de yinang na4ni/ /khye'u mdzes shing ltan sdug pa byung / /ri lasaskyesadang ngar sosapo zhesabatags/ /zhesapa dang / 〈ge sar 'khrung4rabs〉la4kyang / 'gog mo'i rmi lam du/midakar rta dkar can/ phyag g.yasapasadar mdung mkha' la 'phyar ba/g.yon payodagosa'adod kyi nor bu thug4ka la bsnamasapa/ khamayogasumacho4ldan can gzi brjid 'od zer dang ldan pa zhig zur du sleb4te mo la sbyor ba byasapa rmis/ de nasamal sad tshe/ mi dkar rta dkar de gar song cha med du gyur pa zhesapa ltabu gnyisaphyogasagang nasabaltasakyang ha cang 'dra bo 'dug yum de gnyisal gcig mtshung4kyi rmi lamabyung ba'i tshul de ni mi la lhayigashis ka ldan pa'i mtshon tshul gtso bo zhig yin/ lo rgyusasnya na rtsomazhig yin phyin lngasgrung ma 'dresapa med la/ sasgrung dang 'dresapa'i sgyu rtsal lami dga' mkhan yang med/ de'i shugasarkyena'og rang cag bod kyi lo rgyusadang gtamargyud/ glu dang la gzhagasog4la'angalhaskung gi shan shugasam theb4rang theb4su'adug de bzhin gdod ma'i lngasgrung gi bshad rgyun ni ma dpe yin la/ gling sgrung lasabyung ba'i lhaphyung de yang bu dpe lasama'adas/ṭ+wāṃdor na de gnyisakyi 'brelab ma dpe dang bu dpe zhesasbyar na chog snyam 56

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zla ba tshang nas khrag rlangs 'gul ba btsas/ / 'brong ru dron rno ra bcug nas 'o ma sa bran/ / drod kyis btsos pa de ⑪nang nas ni/ / khye'u ma dzes shing ltan sdug pa byung / / ri las skyes dang ngar sos po zhes btags/ /zhes pa dang / 〈ge sar 'khrungs rabs〉las kyang / 'gog mo'i rmi lam du/mi dkar rta dkar can/ phyag g.yas pas dar mdung mkha' la 'phyar ba/g.yon pas dgos 'dod kye nor bu thugs ka la bsnams pa/ khams gsum chos ldan can gzi brjed 'od zer dang ldan pa zhig zur du khrebs te mo la spyor ba bya pa dris/ de nas ma/la sad tshe/ mi dkar rta dkar de gar song cha med du gyur pa zhes pa 37bu gnyis phyogs gang nas bltas kyang ha cang 'dra bo 'dug yum de gnyis la gcig mtshungs kyi mi la ma byung ba'i tshal de ni mil lha⑪gshis ka ldan pa'i mtshon tshul gtso bo zhig yin/ 'o rgyus snya na stom zhig yin phyin lha sgrung ma 'dres pa med la/ lha sgrung dang 'dres pa'i sgyu rtsal la mi dga' mkhan yang med/ de'i shugs rkyen 'og rang cag bod kyi lo rgyusadang gtam rgyud/ glu dang la gzhas sogs la'ang lha sgrung gi shan shugs ma/ thebs rang thebs su 'dug de bzhin gdod ma'i lha sgrung gi bshad rgyun ni ma/ dpe yin la gling sgrung las byung ba'i lha sgrung de yang bu dpe la sam 'das /mdor na de gnyis kyi 'brel ba ma dpe dang bu dpe zhes sbyar na chog snyam mo/ /56

gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyisnang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor/gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor rags tsam gleng ba/'dzam gling bu mo'i rna rgyan du gyur pa'i gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni rang re'i kha ba'i ljong4dang / lhag par du krung hwa mi rigasarig gnasabang mdzod nang gi tog ltabur gyur 'dug pa kun gyi4sheyogasalaltar/ rin thang gzhaladu med pa'i yig tshang chen mo'adi ni gna' rabasabod kyi rig gnasadang sgyu rtsal/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ dmag don dang lo rgyus/dmangasasrol dang chosalugasabacasakyi btsal na rnyed par dka' ba'i glegasabam gal chen zhig lags/ gshamadu gling sgrub nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gosaskor ragasatsamagleng bar bya'o/ /dang po/ bud med kyi snang brnyan skor gleng ba/spyir gtamargyud gang yin rung gtso bo misna'i snang brnyan gsar bzhengasabyed pa ni rtsomarig sgyu rtsalagyi rdog rtsa ltabu yin/ gling sgrung nang du de 'dra'i mi sna mang po zhig zhib 'bri bgyisapa gson nyamasaldan pasartsom rig sgyu rtsalagyi rin thang yang de bsagazhaladu med/ de'i nang na4kyang snang brnyan zhib 'bri rtser son 'dug pa ni bud med kyi snang brnyan skoX ༵na/

gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor/gling grung nang gi bud med bya snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos sgor rags tsam gleng ba/'dzam gling bu mong rna rgyan du gyur pa'i gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni rang re'i kha ba'i ljongs dang / lhag par du grung hwa mi rigs rig gnas bang mdzod nang gi tog lta bur gyur 'dug pa kun gyis shes gsal ltar/ rin thang gzhal du sped pa'i yig tshang chen mo 'di be+e gna' rabs bod kyi rig gnas dang sgyu rtsal/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ dmag don dang lo rgyus/dmangs sol dang chos lugs bcas kyi btsal na rnyed par dka' ba'i glegasabam gal chen zhig lags/ gsham du gleng sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor rags tsam gleng bar bya'o/ /dang ngo/ bud med kyi snang brnyan skor gleng ba/spyor gtam rgyud gang yin rung gtso bo mi sna'i snang brnyan gsar bzhengs byed pa ni rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi rdog rtsa lta bu yin/ gling sgrung nang du de 'dra'i mi sna mang po zhig zhib 'bri bgyis pa gson nyams lda na pas rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang yang de bas gzhal du med/ de'i nang nas kyang snang brnyan zhib 'bri rtser son 'dug pa ni bud med kyi snang brnyan skor yin/57

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bud med de tsho'i nang nasakyang snababarnyan zhiba'abri rtser son 'dug pa ni/glingage sar rgyalapo'i ja yornamasakyi nang nasache4mdzesapa'i sga skya lo'i seng lcama'abrug molags/ dper na/ (hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉du/ dar dkar 'dra ba'i sha logada'/ / dar dmar 'dra ba'i sha bkrag gda'/ /hor bakhra yispyan mig gda'/ / smug chung 'dzin ma'i gzi mdangayogada'/ / zhe sdang sbrulagyi a'abrasagada'/ / phar 'grosagom pa rta brgya ri/ / de min rta brgya miri ste/ / mkha' 'gro'i gar stabasashig ger gda'/ /tshur yong gom pa drelabargya ri/ / de min drelabargya miri ste/ /rig 'dzin rtse bro shigasasogada'/ / skra losmug pomadzo brgya ri/ / de min mdzo brgya miri ste/ / dbu skranyag mare re na/ / shelamutig tshomabu sha ler gda'/ / mchilayogayangadakar lug brgya ri/ / de min lug brgya miri ste/ / ljagasala.ayig rang byon gda'/ / zhesapa ltabu dang / yang /khyod 'dra'i na chung mtshar mozhig / bod ma brgya'i rum nasaskye tshulamed/ / de skyesakyang khyod 'dra 'ong lugasamed/ / khyod sgrolam dkar mo'i skye mtha' yin/ / khapar 'khor skyamadzesargyan yag ma/ / kha tshur 'khor 'ja' risamadangasaldan ma/ / skra g.yasapa g.ya4su'aphangasapa na/ /rgod thang dkar gshog pa brkyangasapa 'dra/ / skugayon pa g.yon du 'phangasapa na/ / rgod thang smug gnama'aphang gachod pa 'dra/ / rgyab skra rgyan g.yubyur phreng bsgrig4pa/ / lha'i bu momi yula'ongasapa 'dra/ / mdun khadog sna ༵༵ rgyan cha de/ / bya zabyasasgrogur phub pa 'dra/ / yar langasan rgya dar

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/———bud med de tsho'i nang nas kyang snang brnyan zhib 'bri rtser son 'dug pa ni/gling ge sar rgyal po'i ja ma rnams kyi nang nas ches mdzes pa'i sga skya lo'i seng lcam 'brug mo lags/ dper na/ 〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉du/ dar dkar 'dra ba'i sha chag da'/ / dar dmar 'dra ba'i sha bkrag gda'/ /hor ba khra ye spyan mig gda'/ / smug chung 'dzin ma'i gzi mdangasagada'/ / zhe sdang sprul gyi a 'bras gda'/ / phar 'gros gom pa rta brgya ri/ / de min rta brgya mi ri ste/ / mkha' 'gro'i gar stabs shig ger gda'/ / tshur yong gom pa drel brgya ri/ / de min drel brgya mi ri ste/ /rig 'dzin rtse bro shigs sogad 'a/ / skra lo smug po mdzo brgya ri/ / de min mdzo brgya ba ri ste/ / dbu skya nyag ma re re na/ / shel mu tig tshom bu sha ler gda'/ / mchil ma g.yang dkar lug brgya ri/ / de min lug brgya mi ri ste/ / ljags la a yig rang byon gda'/ / zhes pa lta bu dang / yang /khyod 'dra'i na chung mtshar mo zhig / bod ma brgya'i rum nas bye tshul sted/ / de skyes kyang khyod 'dra 'ong lugs med/ / khyod sgol ma dkar mo'i skye mtha' yin/ / kha phar 'khor skra mdzes rgyan yag ma/ / kha tshur 'khor 'ja' ris mdangs ldan ma/ / skra g.yas pa g.yas sa 'phangs pa na/ /rgod thang dkar gshog pa brkyangs pa 'dra/ / skra g.yon pa g.yon du 'phangasapa na/ / rgod thang smug gnam 'phang gcod pa 'dra/ / rgyab skra rgyan g.yu byur phreng bsgrigs pa/ / lha'i bu mo mi yul 'ongs pa 'dra/ / mdun kha dog sna lnga'i rgyan cha de/ / be+e rma byas sgo gur phub pa 'dra/ / yar langs na rgya dar 58
