gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob bang rgyan gos skor/'phyar ba 'dra/ /mar bsdad na gur khang phub pa 'dra/ /mda' nyag phran zhig la ci tshang ba/ /khyod seng lcam 'brug mor tshang nas yod/ /blo rno ba mde'u ngar ma 'dra/ /khog yid sems drang ba mda' yo 'dra/ /yid dwangs pa tshe long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /zhes bsogs ha cang zhib tshagasakyi sgo nas bod rigs bad med zhig gi snang brnyan rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi la.oṃnas brjod de/ phar 'gros gom pa rta brgya/ tshur yong gom pa drel brgya/skra lo smug po mdzo brgya/ mcha tha pa g.yang dkar lug brgya/ blo rno ba mde'u ngar ma/ khog yid sems drang ba mda' mo/ yid dwangs pa cha long gzugasabarnyan la sogs pa ste/ phyi'i rnam pa dang nang kun spyod zhib 'bri bgyis yod pa de bod rigs rang gi brtsams chos ma gtogs gzhan las 'di 'dra'i snang brnyan nyin ma'i skar ma bzhin du ha cang dkon po 'dug pas gling sgrung gi mi sna sgrub bzhengs kun las tog lta bu'i go gnas nges can zhig zin yod do/ /gling ge sar mchog gi ja ma byang a stag 'phaba'i klu mong ma las ni/ja ma ming dza bcu gsum las byas rjes ches che ba'i bud med cig yin zhing /kho mo' mi tshe gang bor mtha' gcig tu ge sar rgyal por zhabs tog legasapar bsgrubs te/ rang nus yod tshad nas yod tshad gzhan phan gyi ched du phul bas/ a stag lha mo ni bod rigs dpa' mo tshab byed gcig pur gyur pa dang / g.yaX 'gyed de 'dra mang po zhig gi khrod du/ morang gi lo rgyus kyi snang brnyan be+e rdo ring zhig dang mtshungs par kun gyi mig lam du lhang nger 59

gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor/'phyarab 'dra/ / mar bsdad na gur khang phubapa 'dra/ / mda' nyagaphran zhig la ci tshang ba/ / khyod seng lcam 'brug mor tshang nasayod/ / blono bamade'ungar ma 'dra/ / khog yid semasadrang ba mda' po'adra/ / yid dwangasapamelong gzugasabarnyan 'dra/ / zhesapasog4ha cang zhibatshagasakyisgo na4bod rigasabud med zhig gi snang brnyan rtsomarigasgyu rtsalagyi lamanasabarjod de/ phar 'grosagomaparta brgya/ tshur yong gomapa drel brgya/skra lo smug po mdzo brgya/ mchilam g.yang dkar lug brgya/ blono ba mde'u ngar ma/ khog yid semasadrang ba mda' mo/ yid dwangasangamelong gzugasabarnyan la sogasapaste/ phyi'i rnamapa dang nang kun spyod zhiba'abri bgyisayod pa de bod rigasarang gi brtsamasachoyomagatogasagazhanalasa'adi 'dra'i snang brnyan nyin ma'i skar ma bzhin du ha cang dkon po 'dug pasagling sgrung gi mi ṭ+wāṃ sgrub bzheng4kun lasatog ltabu'i go gnasangesacan zhig zin yod gling ge sar mchog gi ja ma byang astag 'khrilaba'i klu mo'amalhamoni/ja ma ming chen bcu gsum la4byasarjesachesache ba'i bud med cig yin zhing /kho mo'i mi tshe gang bor mtha' gcig tuge sar rgyalapor zhabasatog legayopar bsgrubasate/ rang nusayod tshad nasayod tshad gzhan phan gyi ched du phulabs/ astag lhamoni bod rigasadapa' mo'i tshababyed gcig pur gyur pa dang / g.yul 'gyed de 'dra mang po zhig gi khrod du/ morang gi lo rgyusakyi snang brnyan ni rdo ring zhig dang mtshungasapar kun gyi mig lamadu lhadī ༵ra

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnas la/ bskal brgya ma stong bar du bag chags zab mo bzhag yo da pa yin no/ / dper na/ 〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉du/ gur nag po mun pa 'khrugs 'dra zhig gi nang nas/ dpa' spristag lha mo de/ dpa' drug yid du 'ong zhing / chas drug mig la mdzes pa/ mgo dar 'phru gar stabs ling ling / khrab dkar mo byang phud nyul nyul/ sked 'khor gsum 'khrol sgra sil ci'i/ rta rag pa stag lag gi gong du zhon zhing / zangs gzhu dmar po 'gug ring de'i nang du/ zangs ma/da' dmar po dug lce de bzhag nas/zhes pa dang / 〈dmyal1nga mun pa rang gsal〉du/ nangs snga dro khra yag rdza la song / / 'dis lcags gzhu bkug nas lcags ma/da' 'phangs/ / 'brong bre ser ma bu dgu brgya bsad/ / mgo ru thur sha le thang la 'phangs/ /dgong phyi dro 'brong mo/ bsad bsad nas/ / ri chen po khrag gis dmar po byas/ / ma a stag lha mo gar song na/ / bya rgod po'i gshog rtsa nyil li li/ / spyang dar ma gzan rgyug tha ra ra/ / nyin gung na dmar gzhung la song / / rkyang kha dkar ma bu dgu brgya bsad/ / na chen po'i kha dog khrag gis ba byu ra/ / sa bde mo thams cad sha yis bkang / / khug gshong gshong thams cad khrag gis bkang / / dgong phyi dro rgya mtsho'i kha la song / / lcagasakyu sna tshogs sked la bskor/ / nya sram mang po'i srog gzan byas/ / chu rgya mtsho'i kha dog khrag gis bsgyu ra/ / rgyab 'khor gsum khrab rmog mnabs pa'i tshe/ / gza' khyab 'jug nag po khros pa 'dra/ / sdang dgra bos rig na glo snying 'dar/ / zhes pa sogs las bud med zhig gi snyeng stobs dang gzi 60

gcod pa don grub dang snyingabo tshe ring gi chedartsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnasal/ bskalabargya mastong bar du bag chagasazab mo bzhag yod pa yin no/ / dper na/ 〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉du/ gur nag po mun nga'akhrigs 'dra zhig gi nang nas/ dpa' astag lhamode/ dpa' drug yid du 'ong zhing / chasadrug mig lamadze4pa/ mgo dar 'phru gar stabasaling ling / khrab dkar mo byang phud nyul nyul/ sked 'khor gsuma'akhrol sgra silasil/ rta rag pa stag lag gi gong du zhon zhing / zang4gzhu dmar po 'gug ring de'i nang du/ zangasamada' dmar po dug lce de bzhag nas/zhesapa dang / 〈dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉du/ nang4snga dro khra yag rdza la song / / 'disalcagayogazhu bkug nasalcagasamada' 'phangs/ / 'brong bre ser ma bu dgu brgya bsad/ / mgo ru thur sha le thang la 'phangs/ /dgong phyi dro 'brong pobasad bsad nas/ / ri chen po khrag giyodamar po byas/ / ma astag lhamo gar song na/ / bya rgod po'i gshog rtsa nyilali li/ / spyang dar mgazan rgyug tha ra ra/ / nyin gung na dmar gzhung la song / / rkyang kha dkar ma bu dgu brgya bsad/ / na chen po'i kha dog khrag gisabasgyur/ / yobade mo thamasacad sha yi4bkang / / khug gshong gshong tham4cad khrag gisabakang / / dgong phyi dro rgya mtsho'i kha la song / / lcagasakyu sna tshogasaskad labaskor/ / nya sram mang po'i srog gzan byas/ / chu rgya mtsho'i kha dog khrag gisabasgyur/ / rgyab 'khor gsumakhrab rmog mnabasapa'i tshe/ / gza' khyab 'jug nag po khrosapa 'dra/ / sdang dgra bosarig na glo snyi~X ༵dar/ / zhesangasogasalasabud med zhig gi snying stobasadang gzi

gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor/brjid/ blo spobs/ drang bden bcas rtogs nus te/ skyes pho rab kyisabasgrub mi nus pa'i don mtha' dag sgrub nus pas/ bod rigs brtsams chos〈gling sgrung〉las mthong ba'i bud med dpa' rngo/'i rang gshis 'di lta bu brtsams chos gzhan las nyin mo' skar ma bzhin du ha cang mthong dkon po 'dug la/ 'jig rten grags pa las ring du bgos don yang gtso bo 'di ltabu'i gson nyams ldan pa'i snang brnyan zhib 'bri mang ba'i rkyen gyis yin par snyam mo/ /gling ge sar ma chog gi ja ma/ hor dmar nag bcu gnyis kyi bdag mo ste stong nyid mgar bza' chos sgo na ni skyes sa hor byed yin yang blo sems gling dkar stod la dkar zhing seng chen rin po che ⑪ja ma ming chen rnam/sa kyi ya rgyal du gyur pa/ gshis rgyud 'jam zhing ngang rgyud bzang ba/ phrag dog dang 'gran sems med pa/ spyi sems che zhing sger sems med pa/ hor dmar nag bcu gnyis kyi mdzes ma rnams kyi gras nas gtsug rgyan gyi cod pan ltabur snang ba der yang / dper na/ 〈hor gling g.yu la 'gyed〉du/ mgar chos dar rgyal po'i sras mo stong nyid mgar bza' chos sgo na/ lha mo stong gi spru'i pa/ ma mtsho rgyal dkar mo' skye ba/ mi dge spangs pa'i dge ma/ dge bcu spyod pa'i chos ma/ sprang nyam sa chung brgya ⑪pha ma/ chu mo phag gi lo pa/dung zla dkar lu 'dra ba/ smin drug khra mo'i skyo rogs/ lus ldem ldem sba dkar 4nga po/ skra shar shar rgya lcang lo ma/ zhal dkar dkar bco lnga'i zla ba/ chems 'grigs 'grigs dung sorang 'gregs/ spyan khra chung nam 61

gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor/brjid/ blo spobs/ drang bden bca4rtogasanusate/ skye4pho rab kyisabasgrubaminusapa'i don mtha' dag sgrubanusapas/ bod rigasabartsamasachos〈gling sgrung〉lasamathong ba'i bud med dpa' mo'i rang gshe4'di ltabu brtsams cho4gzhan lasanyin mo'i skar mabazhin du ha cang mthong dkon po 'dug la/ 'jig rten gragasapa lasaring du brgaladon yang gtso bo 'di ltabu'i ༵son nyamasaldan pa'i snang brnyan zhib 'bri mang ba'i rkyen gyiyoyin par snyam /gling/ ge sar mchog gi ja ma hor dmar nag bcu gnyisakyi bdag mo ste stong nyid mgar bza' chosasgron ni skyesasahor yul yin yang blosemasagling dkar stod la dkar zhing seng chen rin po che yija ma ming chen rnamasakyi phrigyal du gyur pa/ gshisargyud 'jam zhing ngang rgyud bzang ba/ phrag dog dang 'gran semasamed pa/ spyi semasache zhing sger semasamed pa/ hor dmar nag bcu gnyisakyi mdzesamarnamasakyi grasanasagatsug rgyan gyi cod pan ltabur snang ba der yang / dper na/ 〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉du/ mgar chosadar rgyal po'i srasamo stong nyid mgar bza' cho4sgron/ lhamo stong gi sprul pa/ mamatsho rgyal dkar mo'i skye ba/ midage spangs pa'i dge ma/ dge bcu spyod pa'i chosam/ sprang nyam4chung brgya yopha ma/ chu pophag gi lopa/dung zla dkar lu 'dra ba/ smin drug khra mo'i skyo rogs/ lusaldem ldem sba dkar phung po/ skra shar shar rgya lcang lom/ zhaladakar dkar bco lnga'i zla ba/ tshemasa'agrigasa'agrig4dung sorang 'grigs/ spyan khra chung6 nām

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mkha'i skar chen/ rgyan btag4na nagasakyi mabya/ gsung bsgragasan dbyarakha'i khubyug ltabu zhesadang sgomachen ri khrod pa rnamasakyisamathong na zhala'adzuma'achor le/ rgya lamanasamagronapo rnamab/kyisamathong na phyi mig bltam/ khri kha'i blam rnamasakyi4mthong na spyan gzur le/ grwa pa dge slong rnamasakyisamathong na yid smon 'chor le/ pho gsar mgo chung gi4mthong na yid 'phrog le/ steng lhapobu mo 'bum phrag zilagyisaganon le/ sku lusamada' nyag phran sgrobazhi dang 'dra ba 'og klu mo'abuyophrag zil gyisaganon le/gsungasnyan gyi glu blangasan/ sgra snyan pa'i pi wang dang nor le/ bar dri za'i bu mo'abumaphrag zilagyi4gnon pa zhig byasashing / rgyabagosadamar nag gser 'brug can gyi na bza' lawadamar byu ru'i gong ba bskor/ g.yidakar dung gi mdog can gyisamatha' shan byas/ sum nag mthing mdog can gyi4kha chon brgyab/ mutig 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i glo cha btags/ g.yubyu ru mumen lasogasapa4ma rgyan byas/ dar ling kha dog sna lnga'i ska ragasabacings/ gser nag ga'u sum sgrig ske la btagasapa'i na chung shin tu mdzesamade4bza' btung rnamasakhyer nasayong ba na zhesabarjod pa sogasalasamigasgrub bzhengasakyi thad du snang brnyan zab mozhig bzhag yod cing /bod rigasabartsamasachosalasabud med kyi snang brnyan rtser son 'dug pa mtshon la/ de ltabu yang dper na zhang zhung chosadabang gragasapa'i rā ma ṇa'i rtog4brjod las/ skye rgu'i rig sngagasamakhan de rnams/ / sitā'i ming gi baṭ+wāṃ~Xbarjod kyis/ / 'gramapa rusapa'i 'phrul 'khor ni/ / dral ba nu

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mkha'i skar chen/ rgyan btags na nags kyi rma be+e/ gsung bsgrags na dbyar kha'i khu byug lta bu zhes dang sgom chen ri khrod pa rnams kyis mthong na zhal 'dzum 'chong le/ rgya la yonas ma gron po rnams/kyis mthong na phyi mig blta le/ khro kha'i zam rnams kyis mthong na spyan gzur le/ grwa pa dge slong rnams kyis mthong na yid smon 'chor le/ pho gsar mgo chang gis mthong na yid 'phrog le/ steng lha mo bu mo 'bum phrag zil gyis gnon le/ sbu lusamada' nyag phran sgo bzhi dang 'dra ba 'og klu mo 'bum phrag zil gyis gnon le/gsung snyan gyi glu blangs na/ sgra snyan pa'i pi wang dang nor le/ bar dri za'i bu mo 'bum phrag zil gyis gnon pa zhig byas shing / rgyab gos dmar nag gser 'brug can gyi na bza' la wa dmar byu ru'i gong ba bskor/ g.yedakar dung gi mdog can gyis mtha' shan byas/ sram nag mthing mdog can gyis kha chod brgyab/ mu tig 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i glo cha btags/ g.yu byu nu mu men la sogs pas ske rgyan byas/ dar ling kha dog sna lnga'i ska ragasabacengs/ gser nag ga'u sum sgrig ske la btags pa'i na chung shin tu mdzes ma des bza' btung rnams khyer nas yong ba na zhes brjod pa sogasalas mi sna sgrub bzhengs kyi thad du snang brnyan zab mo zhig bzhag yod cing /bod rigs brtsams chos las bud med kyi snang brnyan rtser son 'dug pa mtshon la/ de lta bu yang dper na zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa'i rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod las/ bye rgya'i rig sngags mkhan de rnams/ /6twa'i ming gi bzlas brjod kyis/ /'gram pa rus pa'i 'phrul 'khor ni/ /dral ba nu 62

gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor/ma'i ngogayosu'aphyang/ / zhesapasogasabod rigasarang gisabaskrun pa'i mdzosama'i snang brnyan du ma'ang yod do/ / gling ge sar rgyalapo'i sgrung phalacher gyinang du rdzong re phaban khong laja mar thob pani ha cang rgyun 'byamasasugyur 'dug la/ skabasader thob pa'i bud med rnamasang mkhon zhig gi ched du min la mirig4shig gam rgyalakhabacig gi chab srid larag la4'dug pa zhig go/ gna' bo'i dusasumadza' mthun gyi ched du bu mo ster ba'i lugasasrol gang mang zhig yod pa dper na/ bod kyi rgyalapo srong btsan sgam poyorgya'i srasamo lhagacig kong jo khab tubazhesapa/ chosargyalamesa.og tshom gyiyogyimashing kong jo khab tu bzhesapalasogasapa'i dpe mtshon mang pozhig yod kyang yig tshogasamang bar dogasanasamabris/ 'di'i skor laslob dpon mar khe sis/ dbang sgyur gral rim bar gyi gnyena'abrelani chab srid kyi dgosapa kho na yin zhe4gsungasapa ltar gling ge sar rgyalaporta rgyug lasarnamapar rgyalate mi'ajig gser khrir mnga' gsolarjes/ gling dkar stod nasaseng lcam 'brug mo dang mebaza' 'bumaskyid gnyisakhab tubazhesashing /rim bzhin phyogasabazhi dgra bzhi dang rdzong chen bco brgyad phab pa'i 'phrin lasargya cher spelate/ nag po bdud nasa.astag lhamo/ ser pohor nasamagar bza' chosasgron/ smug po'ajang nasasheladakar rgyang mdzes/ khasha mon na4metog lhamadze4sogasaming du gragasapa'i ja maming chenabaco brgyad blangasapar gragasaskad/ bu mode dag lasakyang re 'ga' dgra bo 'dul byed kyi skud bltabur gyur te/ ge sar gyi g.yula'athabagangama~X ṭ+wāṃg

gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor/ma'i ngogs sa 'phyang/ / zhes pa sogs bod rigs rang gis bskrun pa'i ma dzes ma'i snang brnyan du ma'ang yod do/ / gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung phalacher gyi nang du dzong re phab na khong la ja ma re thob pa be+e ha cang rgyun 'byamasag gyur 'dug la/ skabs der thob pa'i bud med rnams ja mkho na zhig gi ched du min la mi rigs shig gam rgyal khab cig gi chab srid la rag lasa'adug pa zhig go/ gna' bo'i dus sumadza' mthun gyi ra du bu mo ster ba'i lugs srol gang mang zhig yod pa dper na/ bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos rgya'i sras mo lhagacig kong jo khab blu bzhes pa/ chos rgyal mas og tsho gyis gyim shing kong jo khab tu bzhes pa la sogs pa'i dpe mtshon mang po zhig yod kyang yig tshogs mang bar dogs nas ma bris/ 'di'i skor la slob dpon mar khe sis/ dbang sgyur gral rim bar gyi gnyen 'brel ni chab srid kyi dgos pa kho na yin zhes gsungs pa ltar gling ge sar rgyal po rta rgyug lasarnam par rgyal te mi 'jig gser khyer mnga' gsol rjes/ gling dkar stod nas seng lcam 'brug mo dang tse bza' 'bum skyid gnyis khab nyu bzhes shing /rim bzhin phyogs bzhi dgra bzhi dang rdzong chen bco brgyad phab pa'i 'phrin las rgya cher spel te/ nag po bdud nas a stag lha mo/ ser po hor nasamagar bza' chos sgo na/ smug po 'jang nas shel dkar rgyang mdzes/ kha sha mon nas me tog lha mdzes sogs ming du grags pa'i ja ma ming chen bco brgyad blangs par grags skad/ bu mo de dag las kyang re 'ga' dgra bo 'dul byed kyi skud sne lta bur gyur te/ ge sar gyi g.yul ra thab gang mang zhig 63

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gi khrod du sub thabs dben pa'i lo rgyus kyi zhabs brtan bkod yo da/dper na/ me bza' bdud kyis khyer ba na khong yar khams byang la byon nasabadud klu btsan rgyal por thod mda' sprad pa dang ga stag lha mo grogs subakug pa/ 'khrug mo hor gyis phrogs pas khong yang a chen hor la byon te gur dkar rgyal por gnya' sga bstad pa dang mgar bza' chos sgron grogasasubakug pa sogs bud med kyi snang brnyan dang bud med kye byas rjes grangs lasa'adas pa zhig gling sgrung gi nang du bkod yod pa kun gyis shes gsal ltar ro/ /gnyis pa/ 6da med kyi thob thang skor gleng ba/spyir mi rigs gang yin rung sngon chad 6da med kyi go sa'i thob thang ha cang dma' ba gna' bo'i lo rgyus dang yig tshang las kun gyis shes gsal lta1ra/lhag par du kha ba ri bo'i khrod kyi bod mi rigs rang la mtshon na'ang bud med kyi thob thang dang dbang cha mi rigs gzhan las de bas dma' ba'i sna nga ba zhig ster ba ste/ bod srid pa'i kha dper yang bu mo dang bong bus byad mi jegakhye bu mo gnyis la blo gtad med/ ma skyid sa nas mi chags/ skra mdud sanas mi 'dug zer ba lta bu sogs las kyang skabs de'i 6da chad kyi thob thang dang dbang cha gsal bor mtshon yod mod/ 'on kyang bod kyi lo rgyus gar stegs la phyi mig zangs gcig bltas tshe/ lo rgyus gar stegs sa go sa nges can bzung myong ba'i gdags khri btsan po'i btsun mo ma ma gro zha skyid ba dring ma lta bur mtshon na/ tun hong gter yig las/ dri gum btsan po sku 64

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gi khrod du sub thabasadaben pa'i lo rgyu4kyi zhabasabartan bkod yod/dper na/ me bza' bdud kyisakhyer ba na khong yar khamasabyang la byon nasabadud klu btsan rgyal por thod mda' sprad pa dang astag lhamo grogs subakug pa/ 'brug motor gyisaphyogasapa4khong yang achen hor la byon te gur dkar rgyal por gnya' sga bstan pa dang mgar bza' chosasgron grogasasubakug pa sogasabud med kyi snang brnyan dang bud med kyi byasarjes grangasalasatrīdasapa zhig gling sgrung gi nang du bkod yod ngakun gyi4shesagasal ltar gnyis pa/ bud med kyi thob thang skor gleng ba/spyir mi rigasagang yin rung sngon chad bud med kyi go sa'i thob thang ha cang dma' ba gna' bo'i lo rgyusadang yig tshang lasakun gyi4shesagasal ltar/lhag par du kha ba ri bo'i khrod kyi bod mirigasarang la mtshon na'ang bud med kyi thob thang dang dbang cha mirigasagazhan lasade bsadama' ba'i snang ba zhig ster ba ste/ bod srid pa'i khadaper yang bu mo dang bong busaskyid mithegakhyi bu moganyisal blogatad med/ ma skyid sanasami chags/ skra mdud 4nasami 'dug zer ba ltabu sogasal4kyang skabasade'i bud med kyi thob thang dang dbang cha gsal bor mtshon yod mod/ 'on kyang bod kyi lo rgyu4gar stegasal phyi mig thengs gcig bltasatshe/ lo rgyusagar stegs sugo sangesacan bzung myong ba'i gdagasakhri btsan po'i btsun mo ma ma gro zha skyid baṭ+wāṃ~X ma ltabur mtshon na/ kun hong gter yig las/ dri gumabatsan po sku

gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor/changaba'itshe mtshan jir gdagasashes/ mam gro zha skyid brling ma ladrisan/zlo ma'imachid nas/ skyi brag mar ba ni rnyilatam ma rnyil/ dang ma'abri spang ni myesatshig gamam tshig mtsho dam be dbar mtsho ni skamasasam maskamayoshesamachi/ brag marnyil/ mtsho yang ma skams/ spang yang mye4ma tshig cesabagyi sna/ ma ma gro zha ma/ rgasanasarna log par tho4te/ brag kyang rnyil/spang yang myesatshig mtsho yang skamasashes thosanas/ 'on tang chu dgum sri dgum gyis/ dri gum btsan por mtshan thogasashig cesa'akhod par gzhigasan/ ma ma gro zha skyid brling ma ni bod kyi gdod ma'i chosalugasasumatshan mkhan gyi ming bzung bar ma zad/ bod kyi lo rgyus steng du bud med kyi thob thang nge4can 'dzin pa'i bud med 'jon thang can zhig go / de bzhin du glusring mer lcam dang rgya bza' khri malod sogasaltabu'i bud med skor zhig giyobod kyi rgyal srid dar rgya4yong ba'i ched du rang nusayod rgu bton te/lo rgyusakyi gar steg4sargyu skar khrod kyi zla ba bzhin bud pa desakyang bod kyi bud med lathob thang gi dbang cha yod pa ra sprod byung ngo / /de'i mtshungasasudapa' bo'i byung rabasachen mo gling sgrung lasakyang bud med rnamasal thob thang gi dbang cha yod pa mngon gsalagyisamathong thub cing / drang phyogasadang ldog phyogasaganyi4ka gang rung gi sgo nasabud med kyi thob thang gang mang zhig mig gi dga' ston du gsal bar bshamasa'adugadaper na/ 〈dmyalagling mun pa rang gsal〉du/ nag po bdud kyi 4cha la/ / dgra yod na mdung momanyama'adzin gyis/ / phyi dgra bo'i gdā~X la

gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor/chung ba'i che mtshan jir gdags shes/ ma ma gro zha skyid brling ma la dris na/ma ma'i mchid nas/ skye brag mar ba ni rnyil tam ma rnyil/ dang ma 'bri spang ni myes tshig gam ma tshig mtsho dam be dbar mtsho ni skams sam ma skamasashes ma che/ brag ma rnyil/ mtsho yang ma skams/ spang yang myes ma tshig ces bgyi sna/ ma ma gro zha ma/ rgas nas rna log par thos te/ brag kyang rnyil/spang yang myes tshig mtsho yang skams shes thos nas/ 'on tang chu dgum sridagum gyis/ dri gum btsan yor mtshab thogs shig ces 'khod par gzhigasan/ ma ma gro zha skyed bzang ma ni bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs sumatshan mkhan gyi ming bzung bar ma zad/ bod kyi lo rgyus steng du bud sked kyi thob thang nges can 'dzin pa'i khud med 'jon thang can zhig go / de bzhin du glu sring mer lcam dang rgya bza' khre ma lod sogs lta bu'i bud med gor zhig gis bod kyi rgyal srid dar rgyas yong ba'i ched du rang nus yod rgu bton te/lo rgyus kyi gar stegs su rgyu skar khrod kyi zla ba bzhin bud pa des kyang bod kyi bud med la thob thang gi dbang cha yo da pa ra sprod byung ngo / /de'i mtshungs sa dpa' bo'i byung rabs s+dzawī mo gling sgrung las kyang bud sked rnams la thob thang gi dbang cha yod pa mngon gsal gyis mthong thub cing / drang phyogs dang ldog phyogs gnyis ka gang rung gi sgo nas6da mad kyi thob thang gang mang zhig mig gi dga' ston du gsal bar bshams 'dugadaper na/ 〈dmyal gleng mun pa rang gsal〉du/ nag po bdud kye sa cha la / / dgra yong na mdung mo mnyam 'dzin gyis/ / phyi dgra bo'i gdong la 65

gcod pa don thub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mnyam rgyug byos/ / nang sde ba'i spyid sdug gcig ni gyis/ / mtho mi chen sde la byams skyong gyis/ / sde gnyom chung skyong gi pha ma mdzod/ / sde btsan po rnams kyi gnya' nas non/ / nang sdeb kha mgo yod par gyis/ / gling ge sar rgyal pos ci gsung sgrubs/ / zhes dang / bdud nag po'i dpon mo byed dus kyi/ / tog dang thob dang thamag dang / / dpon gnas khri 'phang mthon po dang / / yus sde 'bangs 'khor bran dang bcas/ / gong dpon mo'i chas rnams khyed la 'bul/ / ma dpa' mo'i rnam shes khyed kyisamakhyen/ / zhes pa sogs las skra lan bu can gyi bud med zhig gi go gnasadang thob thang gsal bor bstan yod/ gling rje ge sar rgyal pos a stag lhamor de 'dra'i dbang cha ches mthon po byin yod pa des bod rigs bud sted rnams kyi rang dbang dang thob thang phyogs la ma thun rkyen mi nyung ba zhig bskrun 'dug pa yang 1nga sgrung nang mngon gsal du mthong thub pa ste bud sted dang skyes pa'i chab srid kyi dbang cha gcig mtshungs yin pa yang / dper na/1nga gi las dmag rnams 'du rar 'dus nas srid don bgro gleng byed par dpa' bo rnams rim bzhin stag gdan gzig gdan bcas kyi gral la 'khod pa'i dus na/ seng lcam 'brug yodang ma yum 'gog bza'/ a stag lha mo/rgya bza' lha byed sogs gling gi bud med grags chen dag kyang gral la bzhugasayod par ma zad/ da dung gling gi spyi don thad la bsam 'char dang lta stangasagasar ba 'don pa'i dbang char pa pa yod pa lta bu'o/ / gzhan yang〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉las/ sa cha sted hor gyi sa cha nas/ / dgra thul ba'i bar du 66

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/mnyam rgyug byos/ / nang sde ba'i skyid sdug gcig ni gyis/ / mtho michen sde la byamasaskyong gyis/ / sde gnyomachung skyong gi pha mamadzod/ / sde btsan pornamasakyi gnya' nasanon/ / nang sdeb kha mgo yod par gyis/ / gling ge sar rgyal posaci gsung sgrubs/ / zhesadang / bdud nag po'i dpon mobyed dusakyi/ / tog dang thob dang thamag dang / / dpon gnasakhri 'phang mthon po dang / / yulasde 'bangasa'akhor bran dang bcas/ / gong dpon mo'i chasarnamasakhyed la'abul/ / yodapa' mo'i rnam sheyokhyed kyisamakhyen/ / zhesapasogasalasaskra lan bu can gyi bud med zhig gi go gnasadang thobathang gsal bor bstan yod/ gling rje ge sar rgyalaposa.astag lhamor de 'dra'i dbang cha chesamathon pobyin yod pa desabod rigasabud med rnamasakyi rang dbang dang thobathang phyogasalamathun rkyen mi nyung ba zhig bskrun 'dug pa yang gling sgrung nang mngon gsal du mthong thub paste bud med dang skye4pa'i chab srid kyi dbang cha gcig mtshungasayinapa yang / dper na/gling gi lasadamag rnamasa'adu rar 'dusan4srid don bgro gleng byed par dpa' bornamasarimabazhin stag gdan gzig gdan bcasakyi gral la 'khod pa'i dusan/ seng lcama'abrug modang mayum 'gog bza'/ astag lhamo/rgya bza' gaskyid sogasagling gi bud med gragasachen dag kyang gral la bzhugasayod par mazad/ da dung gling gi spyi don thad la bsam 'char dang ltastang4gsar ba'adon pa'i dbang cha'ang yod pa ltabu'o/ / gzhanayang〈hor gling ga~X'agyed〉las/ sacha med hor gyi sacha nas/ / dgra thul ba'i bar du

gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor/'dug rgyuyin/ / semasaskyid rogasamagar bza' khyod rang yin/ / dgra 'dulamabloyogrosarogasadagos/ / btulatshar dusakhra 7gling la'agro/ /sman 'brug mo de dang khyad par med/ / mkhar seng 'brugastag rtse nang rdzong gyis/ / sde hor gling gnyisakyi dpon yogyis/ / mdzod khra mo'i sgo yilde mig zungs/ / ngasatshe mtha' mgar bza' r+shaskyur nges/ / zhesapa ltabur bltayona'ang bud med kyi thobathang dang dbang char rgyu4lon ragasatsam byed thub/ gling sgrung nang du dbang cha chesamatho ba ni ge sar lasagazhan/ da dung spyi dpon dang mabazhi dpon pokhro thung / stag rong anu gzig 'phen/yang rtul dmapa'i mibadun/ zhe rtulakhra glag spyang gsuyoltabu'i blon po ming chen dang gragasachen mang na yang / don gal lathug dusado dam tshang ma seng lcama'abrug mor bcolabazhin yod pagi sar gyi glu layomatshon thub pa ste/bdud yomed klu btsan rgod po de/ / lho'adzam bu gling gi spyi dgra red/ /dbusagling dkar stod kyi sger dgra red/ / 'chor minyan 'dul ba'i duyobabasagasungs/ / nga de phyir bdud rgan 'duladu 'gro/ / bdud nor gling la 'dren par 'gro/ / sman mebaza' a'abuyolen du 'gro/ / rtsisalen rtsisasprod de ring byed/ / chung ma'abrug moyortsisalen mdzod/ / ce4glu de ltar blangasarjesapho brang nang gi rin chen yod do cog rtsi4sprod brgyab padang dusamatshungasasukhong nyid chungadusakyi 'khrab rmog 'khor gsumayang gnang ste bdud nag por thod mda' sprod par phebasaso/ / zhesapa ltar ro/ /ge sar bdud laphebasashuladu achen hor gyi4gling labatsan ༷dzhal

gling sgrung nang gi bud med byu snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyun gos skor/'dug rgyu yin/ / sems skyid dogs mgar bza' khyod rang yin/ / dgra 'dul che blo mi gros rogs dgos/ / btul tshang dus khra mo gling la 'gro/ /sman 'brug mo de dang khyad par sted/ / mkhar seng 'brug stag rtse nang rdzong gyis/ / sde hor gling gnyis kyi dpon mo gyis/ / mdzod khra mo'i sgo ye sde mig zungs/ / ngas tshe mtha' mgar bza' mi skyur nges/ / zhes pa lta bur bltas na'ang 6da med kyi thob thang dang dbang char rgyus lon rags tsam byed thub/ gling sgrung nang du dbang cha ches mtho ba ni ge sar las gzhan/ da dung spyi dpon dang ma bzhi dpon po khro thung / stag rong a nu gzig 'phen/yang rtul dam pa'i ba bdun/ zhe rtul khra glag spyang gsum lta bu'i blon po ming chen dang grags chen mang na yang / don gal la thug dus do dam tshang ma seng lcam 'brug mor bcol bzhin yod pa ge sar gyi glu las mtshon thub pa ste/bdud lo med klu btsan rgod po de/ / lho 'dzam 6 gleng gi spyo dgra red/ /dbus gling dkar stod kyi sger dgra red/ / 'chor ba nyan 'dul ba'i dusababs gsungs/ / nga de phyir bdud rgan 'dul du 'gro/ / bdud nor gling la 'dren par 'gro/ / sman chabaza' a 'bum len du 'gro/ / rtsis len rtses spyod de ring byed/ / chung ma 'bru sgog mos rtsis len mdzod/ / ces glu de ltar blangs rjes pho brang nang gi rin chen yod do cog rtsis sprod brgyab pa dang dus mtshungs stokhong nyid a dus kyi gab rmog 'khor gsum yang gnang ste bdud nag por thod mda' sprod par phebs so/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ /ge sar bdud la phebs shul du a chen hor gyis gling la btsan 'dzul 67

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /—byas te ja ma khar rmang nas bshig pa dang seng lcam 'brug mo phrogs/ hor gling gnyis kyi bar la nang ba'i mi shi rta 'gyel gyi g.yul 'khrug chen po byung skabs/ seng ci ma 'brug mos rang yul bskyar 'dzugs dang nang phu nu'i sha khon gyi ched du/ ge sar la snga phyir thengs gsum la 'phrin btang ba des bod rigs bud med zhig gi 'gyur sted kyi snyeng stobs bla na med pa ma/tshon 'dugaspyir bod kyi 'gro lugs dang bshad rgyun la pha shul bu yis 'dzin pa ma gtogs bu mos mi 'dzin zer mod/ 'on kyang gling sgrung du pha'i rus dang ma/'i rus 'dogs pa'i 'dra mnyam dbang char pa ha cang rgyun 'byams su grur yo da/ dper na/ skya lo ston pa rgyal mtshan dang sngo lo gro lo sogs kyi rusapha'i rus yin zhing / rong tsha khra rgan dang 'gog bza' jo ru gnyis kyi sngon du pha'i rus min par ma ⑪rus sbyar yo/da/ da dung gling sto da smad bar gsum gyi tsho chen gyi ming de yang gling gi ldong chos 'phan nag pos ja ma gsum/blangs pa de la sa/ rim bzhin stod gling gser ba mched brgyad/ bar gling 'om bu tsho drug smad gling rmu spyang sde bzhi zhes am gsum gyi rus las mched par grags so/ /spyir btang du bod rigs dmangs khrod du bud med rnams skyes pa'i gong du bsda da mi chog pa dang / lha khang dang btsan khang sogs sa rang gar rgyu mi chog pa/ lha sted dang lha bsang gtong skabs bud med rnams yong mi chog pa bcas ni chos lugs kyi shugs rkyen 'og pho mo gnyis 'dra mnyam min pa'o /68

gcodapa don grub dang snying bo tshe ringagi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byasate ja mkhar rmang nas bshig pa dang seng lcam 'brug pophrogs/ hor gling gnyiyokyi bar la yang ba'i mishi rta 'gyel gyi g.yul 'khrug chen po byung skabs/ seng lcama'abrug mo4rang yul bskyar 'dzugasadang nang phu nu'i sha khon gyi ched du/ ge sar la snga phyir thengasagasumal 'phrin btang ba des bod rig4bud med zhig gi 'gyur med kyi snying stob4blan med pa ma/tshon 'dugaspyir bod kyi 'gro lugasadang bshad rgyun la pha shul bu yisa'adzin pa ma gtogs bu mosami'adzin zer mod/ 'on kyang gling sgrung du pha'i rusadang ma 'i rusa'adogasapa'i 'dra mnyam dbang cha'ang ha cang rgyun 'byamasasugyur yod/ dper na/ skya lo ston pa rgyal mtshan dang sngo logro lo sogasakyi rusapha'i rusayin zhing / rong tsha khra rgan dang 'gog bza' jo ru gnyisakyi sngon du pha'i rusamin par ma yirusasbyar yod/ da dung gling stod smad bar gsumagyi tsho chen gyi ming de yang gling gi ldong chosa'aphan nag posaja ma gsum blangasapa de las/ rimabazhin stod gling gser ba mched brgyad/ bar gling 'omabu tsho d+nghasnasaṭ+wāṃ/da gling rmu spyang sde bzhi zhesa.amagasum gyi rus lasamached par spyir btang du bod rigasadamangasakhrod du bud med rnamasaskye4pa'i gong du bsdad michog pa dang / lhakhang dang btsan khang sogasasurang gar rgyu michog pa/ lha rtsed dang lhabasang gtong skabasabud med rnamasayong mi chog pa bcasani chosalugasakyi shugasarkyen 'og pho mo gnyisa'adra mnyam min pa~X/8 /

glingasgrung nang gi bud med kyisnang brnyan dang thob thang rgyanagos skor/gling sgrung lasapho mo'i khyad par dang dbye bdagar rgyu med par brten/de ni ge sar bdud la phebasakhaltabur mtshon na'ang g.yog lole dgo dgo ma song nasabasang dud nam mkha' bkang 'dra zhig phulate lhalaskyabasa'ajug byasatshul gyi rnam pa'i steng nasakyang shesathub bo/ /gsum pa/ bud med kyi rgyan gos skor gleng ba/de yang nga tsho bod mi rigasalagana' snga mo'i dusanasabazung gosasushing logyon pa'i dusaskabasabyung ba dang / rjesasuriyogyi4gnamagashi4kyi dro grang la 'gyur ldog byung ba'i dbang gisari dwagasakyi pagasarigasagyon pa'i srol rim gyisadar/ deng thog mirnam4kyisadamar gyon dang rim gyisalag mnyed byasanasagyon te pagasarigasa'atshem bzo byed stangasasogasala'ang ma/do dbusakhamasagasumadu dbye ba mang du byung / de dang mtshungasapar gling sgrung du bstan pa'i rgyan go4la'ang rigasadang rnam grangasagang gi cha nasakyang phun su ma tshogasapo zhig 'dug ste/ skyesapa'i rgyan gos/ bud med kyi rgyan gos/ byi4pa'i rgyan gos/ bgresapo'i rgyan gos/ chosalugasapa'i rgyan gosasogasadang / dusatshigasakyi 'gyur ldog la brten nasadabyar khar rasalwa dang dgun khar ri dwagasakyi pagasarigasagyon pa'i srolayod cing / spyod lha/༵ṭ+wāṃ r+sharjing du byasana'ang rgyun spyod gyon gosadang gzab 'chor rgyan go4gling sgrung nang bud med kyi snang brnyan zhib 'bri bgyisapa che4mang la/snang brnyan re re'i khrod du rgyan gosakyi skor de bsamangon gsal dod ༵ ༵na/

gleng sgrung nang gi bud sked kyi snang brnyan dang thob bang rgyan gos skor/gling sgrung la sa pho mo'i khyad par dang dbye ba dgar rgyu med par brten/de ni ge sar bdud la phebs kha lta bur mtshon na'ang g.yog ma le dgo dgo ma song nas bsang dud nam mkha' bkang 'dra zhig phul te lhal skyabs 'jug byas tshul gyi rnam pa'i steng nas kyang shes thub bo/ /gsum pa/ bud med kyi rgyan gos skor gleng ba/de yang nga tsho bod mi rigs la gna' snga mo'i dus nas bzung gosasashing lo gyon pa'i dus skabs byung ba dang / rjes sa rim gyis gnam gshis kyi dro grang la 'gyur ldo ga byung ba'i dbang gis ri dwags kyi pags rigs rgyan pa'i sro/la rim gyis dar/ deng thog mi rnam sa kyis dam/ra khyon dang rim/ gyis lag mnyed byas nas gyon te pags rigs 'chem bzo byed stangs sogs la 'ang ma/do dbus khams gsum du dbye ba mang du byung / de dang mtshungs par gleng sgrung du bstan pa'i rgyan gos la'ang rigs dang rnam grangs gang gi cha nas kyang phun su ma tshogs po zhig 'dug ste/ skyes pa'i rgyan gos/ bud sked kyi rgyan gos/ byis pa'i rgyan gos/ bgres po'i rgyan gos/ chos lugs pa'i rgyan gos sogs dang / dus tshigs kyi 'gyur ldog la brten nas dbyar khar rasalnga dang dgun khar ri dwags kyi pags rigs gyon pa'i srol yod cing / spyod lugs kyi dbang du byas na'ang rgyun spyod khyon gos dang gzab 'chor rgyan gosaganyis yo da do/ /1nga sgrung nang bud ped kyi snang brnyan zhib 'bri bgyis pa ches mang la/snang brnyan re re'i khrod du rgyan gos kyi skor de bas mngon gsal dod po yin/69

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de dag tshang ma mdzes dpyod rig pa'i ngos thad nas brjod na sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang tshad nges can zhig lab slebs 'dug ces ched mkhas dag gis gsungs/gling sgrung du bud med rnams kyi lus la tshar slog dang / dar gos/ snam phrug sogs dang / rkang la ko lham/ ras lham dang / phying lham/ rgyan cha la g.yu byur/ gser men mu tig sogs kyis grub pa'i ske rgyan dang rna rgyan/thong kha'i dngul gyi ga'u/ gser dngul zangs gsum gyi mdzub dkris/gdu bu/ dngul gyi glo zur/ dngul gyi bzho zung sogs kyis ma/dzes par byed pa yin te/ dper na/ 〈rma shel brag〉tu/ gling gi dpon mo de mgo rgyan rab nor 4 sna tshogs/ lus gos rab za 'og dgu brtsegs/ sked chingasa'aja' tshon rang shar/ ser po spos shel dgu bsgrigs/ khra bo gzi byur dgu bsgrigs/ dmar po byur ma/gul dgu bsgrigs/ sngon po g.yum gul dgu bsgrigs/ gser dngul 'gug lo gra 'grigs/ gser chab nor bu'i zatshom/ gser rna mu tig brtags lung / gser gwa rin chen dgu bsgrigs/glo zur nor 'dzin dgu bsgrigs/ mu tig zar lo rang 'grigs/ dar lham 'ja' ris sum brtsegs/ lham sgog chu mig dgu bsgrigs sogs rgyan rab phun sum tshogs pas spras te mdzes dgu lus la tshangs zhes pa dang / 〈thog gling〉du/ sga skya lo seng lcam 'brug po des/ rgyan rab bco brgyad sku la gsol/ rgyan gos lug chang tsha ru la/ pho sram brgya yis sgang bzo byas/ mo sram brgya yis gshong bzo byas/ sram phrug brgya yis srubs zin byas/gzig mi gzan pags pas kha shan brgyan/ dom khrag 'thung pags pas70

gcod pa don thub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de dag tshang ma mdzesadapyod rig pa'i ngosathad nasabarjod na sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang tshad ngesacan zhig labaslebasa'adug cesached mkhasadag gis gsungs/gling sgrung du bud med rnam4kyi lusalatshar slog dang / dar gos/ snam phrug sogasadang / rkang lako lham/ rasalham dang / phying lham/ rgyan cha lag༅byur/ gser men mu tig sogasakyisagrub pa'i ske rgyan dang rna rgyan/thong kha'i dngulagyi ga'u/ gser dngulazangasagasumagyi mdzub dkris/gdu bu/ dngulagyi glo zur/ dngul gyi bzho zung sogasakyisamadzesapar byed pa yin te/ dper na/ 〈mashelabrag〉tu/ gling gi dpon mo de mgo rgyan rab nor bu sna tshogs/ lusagosarab za 'og dgu brtsegs/ sked chingasa'aja' tshon rang shar/ ser po sposashel dgu bsgrigs/ khra bo gzi byur dgu bsgrigs/ dmar po byur mguladagu bsgrigs/ sngon po g.yumagul dgu bsgrigs/ gser dngula'agug 5ga 'grigs/ gser chab nor bu'i phratshom/ gser rna mu tig btagasalung / gser gwa rin chen dgu bsgrigs/glo zur nor 'dzin dgu bsgrigs/ mu tig zar lo rang 'grigs/ dar lham 'ja' risasumabartsegs/ lham sgrog chu mig dgu bsgrigs sogasargyan rab phun sum tshogasapasasprasate mdzesadagu lusal tshang4zhesapa dang / 〈thog gling〉du/ sga skyaloseng lcama'abrug podes/ rgyan rab bco brgyad sku la gsol/ rgyan gosalug chung tsha ru la/ pho sram brgya yisasgang bzo byas/ mo sum brgya yisagashong bzo byas/ sram phrug brgya yisasrubasazin byas/gdīkā mi gzan pags pasakhazhan brgyan/ dom khrag 'thung pagasapas

gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor/mtha' rgyan byas/ bkab na shog drug khebasapa byung / gyon na byang rlung lhag4pa khogs/ sked 'ching dung gi chab khra la/ rgya byur dkrug masazargyan brgyab/ dar gosamadangayoldan mdzesargyan gyi4zhesa'akhod yod pa ltabu layomado dbusakhamasagasumagyi rgyan gosalakhyad cho4'bur du thon pa'i sgyu rtsal rang bzhin gyi bzo lug4sna tshogasashig byung yod pa mtshon la/ de ni bod rang gi thunamong ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsalarang bzhin dang mdzesadapyod kyi rin thang ldan pa'i dmangasasrolarig gnasakyi ma lag cig yin/ ri dwagasakyi pagayorigasagatso byed pa'i rgyan go4ni stag lpags/ gzig lpags/dom lpags/ sum/ wa sogasayin la/ gling sgrung lasabyung ba'i rgyan gosakyi rigasatshang martsa chen yin don yang de dag grubabyed kyi rgyu tshang mgazhaladaka' ba'i rin chen kho na yin pa'i rkyen gyisayin la/ de la4nga tsho bod pa rnamasal gna' snga monasarang byung gi mdzesasdug ladaga' ba'i semasa'adun drag po mtshon pa'ang shesathub bo/ /71

gling sgrung nang gi bud med kyi snang brnyan dang thob thang rgyan gos skor/mtha' rgyan khyas/ bkab na shog drug khebs pa byung / gyon na byang rlung lhags pa khogs/ sked 'ching dung gi chab khra la/ rgya byur dkrug mas sa rgyan brgyab/ dar gos mdangs ldan mdzes rgyan gyis zhes 'khod yod pa lta bu las mdo dbus khams gsum gyi rgyan gos la khyad chos 'bur du thon pa'i sgyu rtsal rang bzhin gyi bzo lugs sna tshogs shig byung yod pa mtshon la/ de ni bod rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsal rang bzhin dang mdzes dpyod kyi rin thang ldan pa'i dmangs srol rig gnas kyi ma lag cig yin/ ri dwagasakyi pags rigs gtso byed pa'i rgyan gos ni stag lpags/ gzig wags/dom lngags/ sra ma/ wa sogs yin la/ gling sgrung las byung ba'i rgyan gos kyi rigs tshang ma rtsa chen yin don yang de dag grub byed kyi rgyu tshang ma gzhal dka' ba'i rin chen kho na yin pa'i rkyen gyis yin la/ de lasang tsho bod pa rnams la gna' snga mo nas rang byung gi mdzes sdug la dga' ba'i sems 'dun drag po mtshon pa'ang shes thub bo/ /71

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/— spreglang sgrung nang ga phu ju sum byu'i skor bshad pa/de yang bod mi'u gdong drug gi rgyal po ra be+e rgan po lcags sta ga gi lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bco brgyad be+e mo 'u ga gi lor bod bza' bsam gtan 'tsho khab tu bzhes/ de la sras gsum 'khrungs pa ni ru khra btsan/dmu khra btsan/ klu khra btsan bcas yin/ de nas ru khra btsan gyis rag bza' sems skyed sgol ma khab tu bzhes/ de la yang sra/sa gsum 'khrungs pa ni chos la 'phan/ bla ma 'phan/ chos 'phan nag po/ bu chung ba chosa'aphan nag pos 'brog bza' skal bzang chos sgo na khab tu bzhes/ de 'a bu gsum dang bu mo gcig ste/ spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan/ seng blon ga ma ri skyes/ stag rong dpon po khro thung / shel lcam 'tsho bcas 'khrungs nas rim bzhin stod gling gser ba mched brgyad/ bar la 'om/ bu tsho drug smad la rmya spyang sde bzhi/ skya lo phyug gi sde ba/ 'dan ma chu la nyin srib/ sga 'bru dang bcas drug po rdo nga gi tsho chen lha sde dkar po chags so/ /gleng ge sar rgyal po ni yab rgyud ri nas chad pa'i seng blon rgyal po dang /yum rgyud ma/tsho las chad pa'i 'gog bza' lha mo gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo72

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsomaphyogs bsgrigs/gling sgrung nang gi phu nu sum cu'i skor bshad pa/de yang bod mi'u gdong drug gi rgyal po ra khra rgan po lcagasastag gi lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bco brgyad me mo lug gi lor bod bza' bsam gtan 'tsho khab tubazhes/ de la srasagasuma'akhrungs pa ni ru khra btsan/dmu khra btsan/ klu khra btsan bcayoyin/ de na4ru khra btsan gyis rag bza' semasaskyid sgrol ma khab tu bzhes/ de la yang srasagasum 'khrungasapani chosal 'phan/ blam 'phan/ chosa'aphan nag po/ bu chung ba chosa'aphan nag posa'abrog bza' skal bzang chosasgron khab tu bzhes/ de labu gsum dang bu pogacig ste/ spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan/ seng blon gwa ma ri skyes/ stag rong dpon po khro thung / shelalcama'atsho bcasa'akhrung4na4rimabazhin stod gling gser ba mched brgyad/ bar la 'om bu tsho drug smad la rmu spyang sde bzhi/ skya lo phyug gi sdeb/ 'dan mchu la nyin srib/ sga 'bru dang bcasasmug po ldo nga gi tsho chen lhalde dkar po chagasaso/ /gling ge sar rgyalapo ni yab rgyud ri nasachad pa'i seng blon rgyal po dang /yu~Xṭ+wāṃd mtsho lasachad pa'i 'gog bza' lhamoganyisakyi sras suspyi lo

gling sgrung nang gi phu nu sum cu'i skor bshad pa/1038lor sbu 'khrungs/ chung dus sumatshan la jo ru gsol/ sprikhu khro thung gis bsam ngan sna tshogs 'then nas ma bu gnyis rma smad yul du sgyugs nasadaka' sdug gi 'tsho ba rol tu bcug rjes su gling dkar stod kyi rta rgyug lasarnam par rgyal te mi 'jig gser khrir rgyal por mnga' gsol/ pho brang la seng 'brug stag rtse/ rta pho rkyang rgod 'pher ba/ ral gri btab pa lan med/gzhu mo ra rgod 'khyil ba/ dgra lha'i go mtshon sna dgu/ seng lcam 'khrug mo gtso byas pa'i ja ma ming chen bco brgyad khab tu bzhes/ rim gyis 'dzin las rgya cher spel nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe ba'i nag phyogs bdud rigs te/ phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi(bdud/ hor/ 'jang / mon/ )gco byas pa'i rdzong chen bco brgyad dang rdzong 'bring nyer gcig chal la phab nas nor g.yang ma lus khra rngo/ gleng la gdan drangs shing / dgung lo rgya gcig par sbu mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan to/ /lo stong dpon a myes khra rgan ni gling rgan gras rnams kyi che mgo sayos lo'i zla brgyad pa'i ri lung sa ji nga g.yu 'od kyis khyab pa'i dus sa yab chos 'phan nag po dang yum rong bza' chos sgo na gnyis kyi sra/sa su sku 'khrungs/ma tshan /la rong tsha khra rgan gseng / gzhan zla skye las rong tsha zhag bye che bas/dgung lo bcu gnyis sa 'brug la chos bzang ma zhes chos rje nor bu ka bzang gi sra/sa mo ste/ mdzes sdug lang tsho rab tu rdzogs pa/ chu shel zla ba'i rang mdangs can/ ma dzes ma'i yon tan thams cad 'dzoms pa de khab tu bzhes nas ston mo rgya chen mdzad de/ gling che khag gsum gros mthun byung nas chung 73

gling sgrung nang gi phu nu sum cu'i skor bshad pa/1038lor sku 'khrungs/ chung dusasumatshan lajo ru gsol/ akhu khro thung giyobasamangan sna tshogasa'athen nayom bu gnyi4rma smad yul du sgyugasanasadaka' sdug gi 'tsho ba rol tu bcug rjesasagling dkar stod kyi rta rgyug lasarnamapar rgyal te mi'ajig gser khrir rgyal por mnga' gsol/ pho brang la seng 'brug stag rtse/ rta pho rkyang rgod 'pher ba/ ralagri btab pa lan med/gzhu mo ra rgod 'khyil ba/ dgra lha'i go mtshon snadagu/ seng lcam 'brug mo gtso byasapa'i ja ma ming chen bco brgyad khabatubazhes/ rim gyisa'aphrin layorgya cher spel na4sangasargyasakyi bstan pa la 'tshe ba'i nag phyogasabadud rig4te/ phyogasabazhi'i dgra bzhi(bdud/ hor/ 'jang / mon/ )gtso bya4pa'i rdzong chenabaco brgyad dang rdzong 'bring nyer gcig cham laphab nasanor g.yang ma lusakhra mo gling la gdan drangasashing / dgung lorgya gcig par sku mya ngan la4'dasapa'i tshul bstan to/ /lo stong dpon askye4khra rgan ni gling rgan grasarnamasakyi che mgo sayosalo'i zla brgyad pa'i ri lung tswaljang g.yu'od kyisakhyab pa'i dusasuyab cho4'phan nag po dang yum rong bza' chosasgron gnyisakyi srasasusku 'khrungs/mtshan la rong tsha khra rgan gsol/ gzhan zlaskye lasarang tsha zhag skye che bas/dgung lo bcu gnyisayo'abrug lacho4bzang mazhe4chosarje nor bu ka bzang gisrasamo ste/ mdzesasdug lang tsho rab tu rdzogasapa/ chu shelazlaba'i rang mdangs can/ mdzesama'i yon tan tham4cad 'dzomasapa de khab tu bzhesan4ston morgya chen mdzad de/ gling che khag gsum grosamathun byung na~Xṭ+wāṃng

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyud gling gi spyi dpon la bskos/ khong la bu gsum dang bu mo gcig yo da/sa sbrul lor spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan gyis rma dza gnyis kyi mtshams su/ rgyang mkhan dgu brgya bos te/ rgyu rin chen sna lnga byas nas pho brang gnam rdzong phyug mo mtho tshad la tshangs pa'i 'dom/ ring tshad la dpag dka' ba ngo mtshar gyis brtas pa'i pho brang zhig bzhengs/ gling gi g.yul 'thab gang gi nang du'ang spyi dpon ma 'dus sa gcig kyang sted/ dgung lo brgya lhag gam stong la bsdad pas lo stong dpon a byes khra rgan du 'bod/gling ma bzhi'i dpon po khro thung ni lcags sprel lor sa gling dkar stod du yum chos sgo na ma las khye'u gzhan dang cham tshungs pa zhig tu 'khrungs/khye'u de 'khrungs mthag tu drin can spri ma'i 'o mas ma sos 'bri mor bsnun/'bri mos ma sos rgod mar bsnun/ rgod mas ma sos khyi mor bsnun/ khyi mor bsnun te nar son pa na mtshan lam bzhi'i dpon po khro thung btags/ stag rong dpon po khro thung gis dgung lo bcu bzhi tshe lug lor 'dan khar ga bza' chagaser mtsho zhes 'dan lhun grub rdo rje'i sras po gzugs mdzes yid du 'ong ba de nyid chung mar blangs shing / sa bya lor pho brang pho rog snying rdzong kho mdo srib mda' zer ba/ mchu g.yas nas rgyug sa/ kho chu g.yon nasabazhur sa/ brag gnyis mda' sgo gshib 'dra la mkhar thog brtsegs dgu can bzhengs te/ phyi ra ba phyugs kyis bkang / nang mdzod khang rgyu yis tshimasapar byas / stag rong dpon po lon chung dus dpa' kher rgyug gis srin po khe tshe ru zer ba'i stobs rtsal ldan bde bsgral/ yum chos sgo na ma'i bsam/ par 74

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyud gling gi spyi dpon la bskos/ khong la bu gsumadang bu mo gcig yo da/sasbrulalor spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan gyisamardza gnyisakyi mtsham4su/ gyang mkhan dgu brgya bosate/ rgyu rin chen sna lnga byasanasapho brang gnam rdzong phyug mo mtho tshad la tshangasapa'i 'dom/ ring tshad ladapag dka' ba ngo mtshar gyisabartasapa'i pho brang zhig bzhengs/ gling gi g.yul 'thab gang gi nang du'angaspyi dpon ma 'dusasagacig kyang med/ dgung lo brgya lhag gam stong labasdad pasalo stong dpona.askyesakhra rgan du 'bod/gling ma bzhi'i dpon po khro thung ni lcagasasprelalor sagling dkar stod du yum cho4sgron malasakhye'u gzhan dang mimatshungasapa zhig tu 'khrungs/khye'u de 'khrungasayothag tudrin can ama'i 'o masam so4'bri mor bsnun/'bri mosamaso4rgod mar bsnun/ rgod masam so0khyi mor bsnun/ khyi mor bsnun te nar son pan mtshan layobazhi'i dpon po khro thung btags/ stag rong dpon pokhro thung gisadagubaskrubacu bzhi melug lor 'dan kharag bza' yigaser mtsho zheyo'adan lhunagrub rdo rje'i srasayogazugasamadzes yid du 'ong ba de nyid chung mar blangasashing / sabya lor pho brang pho rog snying rdzong kho mdo sribamada' zer ba/ rmachu g.yasanasargyug sa/ khrochu g.yon nasabazhur sa/ brag gnyisamada' sgrogashiba'adra la mkhar thog brtsegasadagu can bzhengasate/ phyi ra baphyugasakyisabakang / nang mdzod khang rgyu yisatshimasapar byas/ stag rong dpon polon chung dusadapa' kher rgyug gisasrin po khetshe bhe ṭ+wāṃr ba'i stobasartsalaldan pade bsgral/ yum chosasgron ma'i bsamapar

gling sgrung nang gi phu nu sum cu'i skor bshad pa/nga'i bu 'di rtul phod che bsadagra la'achor nyen che bsamasanasawamobargya yosnying khrag gsol dkar rgyan chen lngaldan gyi nang lachangadang bsresate khro thung ladrangayopas/ khro thung ni sdar mawa dang nor le/ lu4'dar lcang lo 'dra le/ blosna mang ba/ nga rgyaladang phrag dog gisagazir ba/ 'dod chagasachu ltarakhol ba/ phyi dgra nang 'dren/ nang mispyod gtugs/ pha ju4rlung la bskur dgosakyang nyam nga med pa'i bya thana'ug pa ltabu zhig tu gyur to/ /gling stag rong dpon po khro thung larong srasalhargod 'bumalugatsosabu dgu yod rji dang / phyisasumang shasashig g.yula'akhrug lasabakrongasapar gragasaskad —/rgya tsha/ zhal dkar ni gling seng blon rgyalapo'i bu che ba/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i phu bo/ ma yum rgya bza' askyid/ mkhar mi'agyur dngul chu khro rdzong zer ba de/ rdzong la thog sosum cu sodrug yod pa/ khra bo gzi yiskas stegayosum brgya drug cu/ mumen mchong gi rabagasal yod pa/ rdzong bzhi'i gru kha na stag seng khyung 'brug gi rgyalamatshan btsugasayod pa/ rdzong stod kham pa dngulagyisabardungasapa/ rdzongasmad nag po khro yisabardungasapa/ rdzong sked ser po gser gyisagrub skad do/ / khong nyid kyi btsun mo'abru rag bza' sger mtsho yin zhing / bu gcig ste'abumapa'i dgralhartse rgyalayin/ rta pho'i ming la rgya bya sog dkar/ ralagri5zi skar phran/ rgya tsha zhaladakar sku na zaba'i dus nasabazung / g.yula'athabamang por zhugasan4rting ma ri dang mnyam pa mang po blangasayod/ lhag par du hor gling 'khrug pa'i ska~Xpasu

gling sgrung nang gi phu nu sum byu'i skor bshad pa/nga'i bu 'di rtul phod che bas dgra la 'chor nyen che bsams nas wa mo brgya nasnying khrag gsol dkar rgyan chen lnga ldan gyi nang la chang dang bsres te khro thung lo drangs pas/ khro thung ni sdar ma wa dang nor le/ lus 'dar lcang lo 'dra le/ blo sna mang ba/ nga rgyal dang phrag dog gis gzir ba/ 'dod chags chu ltar khol ba/ phyi dgra nang 'dren/ nang bsgod gtugs/ pha jus rlung la bskur dgos kyang nyam nga med pa'i be+e than 'ug pa lta bu zhig tu gyur to/ /gleng stag rong dpon po khro thung la rong sras lha rgod 'bum lu gtsos bu dgu yo da pa dang / phyis sumang shas shig ga5kha 'khrug las bkrongs par gragasaskad do/ /rgya tsha zhal dkar be+e gling seng blon rgyal po'i bu che ba/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i phu bo/ ma yum rgya bza' lha byad/ mkhar na 'gyur dngul chu khro rdzong zer ba de/ rdzong la thog so sum cu so drug yod pa/ khra bo gzi yi skas stegs sum brgya drug cu/ mu men mchong gi rab gsal yod pa/ rdzong bzhi'igru kha na stag seng khyung 'brug gi rgyal mtshan btsugs yod pa/ rdzong stod kham pa dngul gyis brdungs pa/ sgong smad nag po khro yis brdungs pa/ sgong sked ser po gser gyis grub skad do/ / khong nyid kye btsun mo 'bru rag bza' sger mtsho yin zhing / bu gcig ste 'bum pa'i dgra lha rtse rgyal yin/ rta pho'i ming la rgya be+e sog dkar/ ral gri ngo zi skar phran/ rgya tsha zhal dkar sku na zaba'i dus nas bzung / g.yul 'thab mang por zhugs nas rting ma ri dang mnyam pa ma nga po blangs yod/ lhag par du hor gleng 'khrug pa'i skabasas75

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/hor gyi pa thur gang che gang drag rnams sngon mo mar la drangs/ ma thar hor :le /co tshor 11 /skyo 11dag ga da shan pa' mdung ma ra ba na nas sku ba ngas/gling tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra ni 'dan khri skor rgyal po'i rigs rgyud yin zhing / phyis sa gling 'dan gag khrug skabs gling la mgo btagasanas nye 'brel chags pas tsha zhang thogs zhes bshad a mchis/ yang kha cig gis nam mkha' sen zhal spyi sras yin par gleng ba sogs bshad a ma/nga du ma chis/ khong gi rdzong ming la 'dan byu ru'i lha khang ring yodang / rtar 'do ba dngos grub ldem pa zer/ ral gri ljang ba yud mar/ gzhu mi 'gyur dung gzhu rang 'khyil(gnyan ra thang lhas gnang ba yin)/ mda' mi 'gyur gnam lcags thog mda'(dgra lhag nyan stag dam ra pos gnang ba yin)/ khrab ra nyi ma rang shar sogs yod/ khong la 'dan sra/sa g.yu 'od 'bum thub dang 'dan phrug da ra kha che sogs sras re gnyis yod par grags/khong gis gling ge sa ra rgyal por zhabs tog legs par bsgrubs te/ g.yul 'thab gang ma/nga zhig tu byas rjes bgrang las 'das pa bzhag pa dang / ge sar khong mya ngan las 'da' khar 'dan ma lo drug cus ji gzhon du btang skad do/ /'bru sga sde chos skyong bor nag ni sga mi 'gyur chos kyi dbang phyug dang 'bru bza' bsam gtan dpal lhaganyis kyi sras sa sku khrungs/ mdza lasga sde mi s+dzawī ser por 'bod/ rta pho rlung nag phab chen/ dgung lo brgyad thog rtsal shugs srur rgyal bod du grags/ sa glang lor pho brang mchong mkhar 76

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/hor gyi pa thur gang che gang drag rnamasasngon mo mtshon ladrangs/ ma/thar hor sdig gcod shan pa'i mdung mgor bskyon nasasku bkrongs/gling tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra ni 'dan khri skor rgyal po'i rigasargyud yin zhing / phyisasagling 'dan g.yula'akhrug skab4gling la mgo btagasanasanye 'brel chagayopasatsha zhang thogasazhesabashad srogatsomachis/ yang khacig gisanam mkha' sen zhalagyi srasayin par gleng ba sogasabashad srolta mang du mchis/ khong gi rdzong ming la'adan byu ru'i lhakhang ring podang / rtar 'do ba dngosagrub ldem pa zer/ ralagri ljang ba yudamar/ gzhu mi 'gyur dung gzhu rang 'khyil(gnyan chen thang lhasaganang ba yin)/ mda' mi'agyuraganam lcagasathog mda'(dgra lhaganyan stag dmar posaganang ba yin)/ khrab chen nyi ma rang shar sogasayod/ khong la 'dan srasagayu'od 'bum thub dang 'dan phrug da ra kha che sogasasrasar gnyisayod par grags/khong gisagling ge sar rgyal por zhabs tog legs par bsgrub4te/ g.yu5'thabagang ma/nga zhig tu byasarjesabagrang lasa'adasapa bzhag pa dang / ge ṭ+wārje t+t+waṃng mya ngan lasa'ada' khar 'dan ma lo drug cusaje gzhon du btang 'brusga sdechosaskyong ber nag ni sga mi'agyur chosakyi dbang phyug dang 'bru bza' bsamagatan dpal lhaganyisakyi srayosusku 'khrungs/ mtshan la sga sde mi chen ser por 'bod/ rta pho rlung nag 'tshub chen/ dgung lo brgyad tho/ ༵la shugasaspur rgyalabod du grags/ saglang lor pho brang mchong mkhar

gling sgrung nang gi phu nu sum cu'i skor bshad pa/smug po 'khru thang stod lda nga la g.yu thang du bzhengs/ mu khyud shel dang mu sten rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan/ de nas 'bru stod smad bar gsum gyi dpon por bskos nas gleng ge sar rgyal po dang mnyam du dpa' bo'i 'phrin lasaphyogs bcur mngo te bdud rigs thams cad mtha' nas bcom/ khong gi sras 'bru sras nam mkha' thog rgyas yin zhing stag gzig dmag 'thab nang sku bkrongs song /stag rong a nu gzig 'phen ni gling bkra shis mgon po dang / yum gzig lcam gangs 'tsho gnyis las shing stag lor 'khrungs/ stag rong dpon po gzig 'phen dgung lo bcu gsum la bud pa/ chu stag lo la 'brog bza' 'od lha khab tu bzhes nas sras gnyis dang sras mo gcig bltams/ chu yosa'o ra a nu gzig 'phen gyis srib lung shog chen dgu shong gi smad phyogasasadabyibs pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang / nang ka chen brgyad kyis bkyag pa/ thog nyi khebs rgyal mtshan 'phan yab rgya phebs kyis brgyan pa/ rnga yab nor 'greng gis bskor ba/ shar du ja mkhar/ lho ru mdzod khang / nub tu gser 1nga / byang du drag rtsal khang / shar lhor 'du gling / lho nub tu go mdzod khang / nub byang du pho nya khang / byang shar du smon lam rdzong sogasaldan pa'i pho brang be'u stag rdzong zhes pa de bzhengs so/ /khong nyid g.yul 'thab mang por zhugs nas rting ma dgung dang mnyam pa mang po blangs yod/hor gling g.yul 'byed skabs sa hor stobs chen glang bo khra 'bar gyi zhagasapas rma chur 'phangs nas gzi brjid ldan pa'i ngang sku bkrongs song /77

gling sgrung nang gi phu nu sum cu'i skor bshad pa/smug po'abru thang stod lda nga lagayubang du bzhengs/ mukhyud shel dang mu men rin po chesna tshogasakyi4brgyan/ de na4'bru stod smad bar gsum gyi dpon por bskosanasagling ge sar rgyal po dang mnyam du dpa' bo'i 'phrin lasaphyogasabacur spel te bdud rigasathamasacad mtha' nasabacom/ khong gi sra~X'abru ṭ+wāṃsanam mkha' thog rgyasayin zhing stag gzig dmag 'thab nang sku b.langa~X / ṭ+wā/nga anu gzig 'phen ni gling bkra shisamagon po dang / yum gzig lcamagangasa'atsho gnyisalasashing stag lor 'khrungs/ stag rong dpon pogazig 'phen dgung lo bcu gsum la bud pa/ chu stag lo la 'brog bza' 'od lhakhab tu bzhesanasasrasaganyisadang srasamogacig bltams/ chu yosalor anu gzig 'phen gyisasrib lung shog chen dgu shong gi smad phyogasasudabyibasapad+ma 'dab brgyad dang / nang ka chen brgyad kyi4bkyag pa/ thog nyi khebayorgyal mtshan 'phan yab rgya phibasakyisabargyan pa/ rnga yab nor 'phreng gi4bskor ba/ shar du ja mkhar/ lhoru mdzod khang / nub tugaser gling / byang du drag rtsal khang / shar lhor 'du gling / lhonub tugo mdzod khang / nub byang du pho nya khang / byang shar du smon lamardzong sogasaldan pa'i pho brang be'u stag rdzong zhe4pa de bzhengasaso/ / khong nyid g.yul 'thab mang por zhugasanasarting mdagung dang mnyamapa mang po blangasayod/hor gling g.yula'agyed skabasagahor stobasachen glang bo khra 'bar gyi zhagasapasarma chur 'phangasanasagazi brjid ldan pa'i ngang sku bkrongasasong / 77

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dpa' 'granamed sengastagayodomanishing 'brug lor yab chen sebablon ka mari skyesakyi mchod khang dri med chosakyi mchod khri'i steng du/ bya ga ru ḍa'i sgo nga dang mtshungasapa'i dung sbubasashig smin/ der seng blon gyisasnyor skyong yag po byasapa na/ ma'agyang4par de khagasate khye'u mdzesasdug ltabasamachog mishesapazhig 'khrungs/ mtshan laseng stag adom btags/ rim bzhin nar son pan rdzobaza' be+eḍūr+ya sgrolamakhab tu bzhesanasasrasagacig yod par grags/ gzhan bshad tshulazhig la rma rgyal spom ra'i 'phrul srasayin par gleng ba sogasakyang yod/ mkhar mi 'gyur smug po lcug dkris/ rta stong ri nor gyi bang mdzod/ mtshon lebachen mi yibasha' gri/ srasakyi mtshan labaco lnga'i dpa' gsar zab zer zhing / hor gling skabayosudapa' bo ngar 'thab kyisashi stabasadag zhing la'agro mnasapar thog ru'i yul du ser rgod stong thub kyi lusablangs/ rjesasupha bu lhan 'dzomasabyung skad/ seng stag t+t+waṃng ni seng adomamiyikhyang ki zhe4mtshan snyan 'dzam bu gling la khyab pa zhig dar 'phen dug gi sdong bo ni smug poldong gi gdung rgyud du sku 'khrungasashing gling cho4'phan nag po'i bu rgyud/ ldong khra btsan dar mgragasapa dang yum tsha bza' byang chub sgron meganyisakyi srasasushing glang lor bltams/dgung lobacu drug steng 'dan bza' gangasadakar 'tsho khab tu bzhesanasargyal srid bskyangs/ shing stag lor pho brang ga'u gser rdzong de shar ma/dzo mo ra~X ༵byam4thabadu brtsigs/ mchod khang la byu rusabyasapa'i mgon po

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dpa' 'gran med seng stag spri dom ni shing 'brug lor yab chen seng blon ka ma ri skyes byu mchod khang dri med chos kyi mchod khye'i steng du/ bya ga du ḍa'i sgo nga dang mtshungs pa'i dung sbubs shig smin/ der seng blon gyis stor skyong yag po byas pa na/ ma 'khrungs par de kha gas te khye'u mdzes sdug ltabasamachog mi shes bzhig 'khrungs/ mtshar la seng stag a dom btags/ rim bzhin nar son pa na lto bza' baiḍūr+ya sgol ma khab tu bzhes nas sras gcig yod par grags/ gzhan bshad tshul zhig la rma rgyal spom ra'i 'phrul srasayin par gleng ba sogs kyang yong/ mkhar mi 'gyur smug po ji ga dkris/ rta stong ri nor gyi bang mdzod/ mtshon leb chen mi ⑪bsha' gri/ sras kyi mdza la bco lnga'i dpa' gsar zab zer zhing / hor gling skabs sa dpa' bo ngar 'thab kyis shi stabs dag zhing la 'gro ma nus par thog ru'i yul du ser rgod stong thub kyi lus blangs/ rjes sa pha bu lhan 'dzoms byung skad/ seng stag khong ni seng a dom mi⑪spyang ke zhes mtshan snyan 'dzam bu gling la khyab pa zhig go /dar 'phen dug gi sdong bo ni smug po ldong gi gdung rgyud du sbu 'khrungasashing gling chos 'phan nag po'i bu rgyud/ ldong khra btsan dar ma grags pa dang yum tsha bza' byang chub sgon chaganyis kyi sras gshing glang lor blta1mas/dgung lo bcu drug steng 'dan bza' gangs dkar 'tsho khab tu bzhes nasargyal srid bskyangs/ shing stag lor pho brang ga'u gser rdzong de shar ma dzo mo rab 'byams thang du brtsegs/ mar khang la byu rus byas pa'i mgon po 78

gling sgrung nang gi phu nu sum cu'i skor bshad pa/phyag drug pa 'khor bcas bzhengs/ khong gi chibs pa'i ming la gnam rta mtshadakar nor bu zer/ khong ni skya ring mdung la grub pa brnyes pa'i dpa' rgod grags chen zhig yin la/ mdung mo'i ming lam dung nag dar khra phyug mo zer/ gzhan blo phangs pa zhig la ba nub dar rdzong phab pa'i skabasasasku la na ba chen po byung ste bzlog mnus par sbu mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan to/ /dpa' mi 'gyur nya tsha spri brtan ni khro thung gi bu che ba yin zhing dpa' tsal drug 'dzam bu gleng la khyab/ rta pho'i ming lagangs ri lding shes zer zhing /ral gri dgu zi a sngon/ mda' mo rgod sgo glog lce/ khra mdung nyi ma rang shar/sgrung las bshad pa ltar na hor gling 'khrug skabs dpa' bo ngar 'thab kyes slu bkrongs pas dag zhing du phebs ma thub par ste ra'i yul du ra 'dra 'chi bdag mi med zer ba'i lus blangs/ phyis sa gleng la 'khor nas gling ge sar rgyal po'i 'phrin las rjes ma dag spel bar byas rjes mi dman pa bzhag skad do/ /yab chen seng blon ri skyes ni ldong chos 'phan nag po'i sras chung ba yin zhing / chung dus nas yid gzhung la rgyud bzang ba'i skye bo thar bas shig yin/ khong gis btsun mo/ snga phyir gsum blangs/ rgya bza' lha skyid sgrol ma(rgyas nge sprim)/ 'gog bza' lha mo(ge sar gyi sprim)/ rong bza'(rong tsha dkar rgyan gyi am)gsum yin te re zhig gling dkar stod kyi bdag dbang bzung myong / khong ni gleng dam pa rnam gsum gyi tso rgyal yin la/ gleng gi 79

gling sgrung nang gi phu nu sum cu'i skor bshad pa/phyag druganga'akhor bcasabazhengs/ khong gi chibasapa'i ming la gnam rta mchongadakar nor bu zer/ khong ni skya ring mdung lagrubapabarnyesapa'i dpa'argod gragasachen zhig yin la/ mdung mo'i ming lamadung nag dar khra phyag mozer/ gzhan blogangasapazhig laminubadar rdzong phab pa'i skabasasuzlo la na ṭ+wāṃ chen po byung ste bzlog mnusapar sku mya ngan la4'dasapa'i tshul bstan )/pa'/ mi'agyur nya tsha abartanani khro thung gi bu che bayin zhing dpa' rtsal drug 'dzam bu gling la khyab/ rta pho'i ming lagangasari lding shesazer zhing /ral gri dgu zi asngon/ mda' porgod sgroglog lce/ khra mdung nyi ma rang shar/sgrung la4bshad pa ltar na hor gling 'khrug skabasadapa' bo ngar 'thab kyis sku bkrongs pasadag zhing du phebasam thub par ste ra'i yuladu ra 'dra 'chi bdag 5med zer ba'i lusablangs/ phyisasagling la'akhor nasagling ge sar ṭ+wāṃl po'i 'phrin lasarjesam dag spelabar byasarjesamidaman pa bzhag skad yab chen seng blon ri skyesani ldongachosa'aphananag po'i srasachung ba yin zhing / chung dusanasayid gzhubalargyud bzang ba'i skye bo 5rabs shig yin/ khong gisabatsun mo snga phyir gsumablangs/ rgya bza' saskyid sgrol ma(rgya tsha'i am)/ 'gog bza' lhamo(ge sar gyi am)/ rong bza'(rong tsha dkar rgyan gyi am)gsumayin te re zhigagling dkar stod kyi bdag dbang bzung myong / khong ni gling dmapa rnamagasumagyi 5gyalayin la/ sdi~X gi

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/don dag che ma chung gsum gang yin rung thag gcod byed pa'i dbang cha ra/skya lo'i ston pa rgyal mtshan ni sga skya lo'i seng lcam 'brug mo dang skya lo'i ste yag 'brug rgyal(gling dpa' rtul sum cu'i lo rgyal)gnyis kyi yab yin/khra mo gling gi ches phyug pa'i tsho sde chen po zhig yin/ kho'i byed ngo ma ni byang yul stod yin/ khor srun gnyis yod pa sngo lo gro lo gnyis yin/ byang yul stod nas kha ma sos par gling la 'bams nas 'ongs pa zhig yin la/ rjesasabatsan gyi rtse yodagung la mnyam zhing / phyugs kyi ru ma sar brdal bas gling chakun gyis skya lo phyug gi sde ba zhes mtshan snyan rlung ltar grags/spyi dpon snang ngu g.yu stag ni rong tsha khra rgan gyi bu gsum(bu che ba glen pa chos rgyal/ bu 'bring ba g.yu 'phen stag rgyal/ bu chung ba snang ngu g.yusta ga)las chung ba yin/ kho be+e khyung sgo nga'i nang nas gshog drug rgyas/ seng ma ye khog nas g.yu ral 'dzoms zhes pa ltar dpa' rtsal drug yongs sa rgyas/hor gling g.yal 'gyed du khro thung gis g.yo byu sna tshogs 'phen nas dgra khar brdzangs te spri lnga mab ba drug gis bkrongs mod/ 'on kyang snya na grags rdo la ri mo brkos pa bzhin bskal pa nas bskal par khyab 'dug go/nyi 'bum dar yag be+e sa phag 'o ra yab stobs rgyal lhan grub dang yum jo nga bza' sher lcam gnyis kyi sras su 'a ngas shing / skabs der ston dgun mtshams yin yang ste tog bzhad skad/ nyi 'bum gyis dgung lo bco brgyad thog gser bza' dam tshig sgol ma khab tu bzhes te stod gling gser ba'i khri dpon mdzad/ pho brang labs ma grub 'byam thub dang / rta pho'i ming 80

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi chedartsom phyogs bsgrigs/don dag che mchung gsumagang yin rung thag gcod byed pa'i dbangacha yod/skya lo'i ston pa rgyalamatshan ni sga skya lo'i seng lcam 'brug modang skya lo'i bu yag 'brug rgyal(gling dpa' rtulasumacu'i 5gyal)gnyi4kyi yab yin/khra mo gling gi chesaphyug pa'i tsho sde chen po zhig yin/ kho'i yul ngo ma ni byang yul stod yin/ khor spun gnyisayod pa sngo lo gro lo gnyisayin/ byang yul stod nasakha ma so4par gling la 'khyamasanasa'ongasapa zhig yin la/ rjesasubatsan gyi rtse modagung lamanyamazhing / phyugasakyi ru ma sar brdalab4gling mikun gyisaskya lophyug gi sde ba zhesamatshan snyan rlung ltar grags/spyi dpon snang ngu ga༅stag ni rong tsha khra rgan gyi bu gsum(bu che ba glen pa choyorgyal/ bu 'bring ba g.yu'aphen stag rgyal/ bu chung ba snang ngu g.yustag)lasachung ba yin/ khoni khyung sgo nga'i nang na4gshog drug rgyas/ seng mayikhog nasagayu ral 'dzomasazhesapaltar dpa' rtsal drug yongasasurgyas/hor gling g.yul 'gyed du khro thung gisagayosgyu sna tshogayo'athen nasadagra khar brdzangasate alnga mtheb drug gisabakrongasamod/ 'on kyang snyan gragasardo la ri pobarkosapa bzhin bskalapa nasabaskalapar khyab 'dug go/nyi 'bumadar yag ni saphag 'o ra yab stobasargyal lhun grub dang yum ldo nga bza' sher lcamaganyisakyi srasasu'akhrungasashing / skabayoder ston dgun mtshamasayin yang metog bzhad skad/ nyi 'bumagyi4dgung lo bco brgyad thog gser bza' dam tshig sgrolam khab tubazhe4te stod gling gser ba~X ṭ+wāṃ dpon mdzad/ pho brang labasamagruba'abumathub dang / rta pho'i ming

1nga sgrung nang gi phu nu sum cu'i skor bshad pa/long nga ba gser sgong zer zhing / khong mi rta gnyis kyis gling gi don chen dag la byas rjes mang po bzhag yod/'om/ bu'i sprin dpa' seng be+e lcags khyi lor yab 'om bu rdo rje dang yum che ring byed gnyis kyi sras sam 'khrungs/ gling gi phu nu sum byu lha sras srun bzhi'i a rgyal yin/ khong dang nyi 'bum dar yag rmu spyang rin chen dar lu gsum ni phyi dgra bor 'thab na dpa' snying spyang grung 'dzoms pas gling dkar po'i snying mig srog gsum du 'bod/ bar gling 'om bu'i dpon po yin la rta pho'i ming la rlung rta mtshal dmar zer zhing / pho brang gi ming la bya nag lding rdzong zer/ stag gzig nor rdzong skabs sa stag gzig rgyal po'i sras khrab rgod zla bas sku bkrongs/rmu spyang rin chen dar lu ni yab dar rgyas dang yum mtsho lcam gnyis kyi sras su sbu 'khrungs/ chung dus nas dpa' ngar rtul phod che bas khra mo gling gi rmu spyang sde bzhi'i mgo dpon du bskos/ pho brang la thang rdzong ring mo zer/gling seng chen rgyal po'i dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi dmag 'thab ma nga por zhugs nas rting ma sa steng du shong dka' ba blangs/'om bu'i spyang khye rngam chen ni shing sprul lor 'om bu dzam dang khyang bza' gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas dpa' ngar dang spyang grung 'dzoms pas ma lus shes bya'i gnas la thogs pa med par mkhas/'om bu'i spyang khro rngam chen zhes rgyu skar khrod na zla ba bzhin gling dpa' rtul nang gi yang rtul gyi sgor yin no/ /81

gling sgrung nang gi phu nu sum cu'i skor bshad pa/langang ba gser sgong zer zhing / khong mirta gnyisakyi4gling gi don chen dag labyasarjesamang po bzhag yod/'om bu'i anu dpa' seng ni lcagasakhyi lor yab 'omabu rdo rje dang yum tsheringaskyid gnyisakyi srasasusku 'khrungs/ gling gi phu nu sum cu lhasra4spun bzhi'i agyal yin/ khong dang nyi 'bum dar yag rmu spyang rin chen dar lu gsumani phyi dgra bor 'thab na dpa' snying spyang grung 'dzomasapasagling dkar po'i snying mig srog gsum du 'bod/ bar gling 'om bu'i dpon poyin larta pho'i ming la rlung rta mtshaladamar zer zhing / pho brang gi ming la bya nag lding rdzong zer/ stag gziganor rdzong skabayosustag gzig rgyalapo'i sra4khrab rgod zla bsasku bkrongs/chuspyang rin chen dar lu ni yab dar rgyasadang yum mtsho lcam gnyisakyi srasasusku 'khrungs/ chung dusanasadapa' ngar rtul phod che bsakhra mo gling gi rmu spyang sde bzhi'i mgo dpon du bskos/ pho brang lathang rdzong ring mo zer/gling seng chen rgyalapo'i dgra 'dulaganyenaskyong gi dmag 'thab ma/nga por zhugasan4rting masasteng du shong dka' ba blangs/'om bu'i spyang khri rngamachen ni shing sbrul lor 'om bu dzam dang byang bza' gnyi4kyi sra4susku 'khrungs/ chung dusanasadapa' ngar dang spyang grung 'dzomasapasam lusashesabya'i gan4la thogayopa med par mkhas/'om bu'i spyang khri rngam chenazhe4rgyu skar khrod na zla babazhin gling dpa' rtul nang gi yang rtul gyi skor yin no/ / 81

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gdong btsan snang ngu a dpal ni chu sgru la lo'i stag zla la stag dodz+wadapon po khro rgyal dang yum 'dan bza' gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ rta lagayu bya 'phur shes zer/ dpa' rtul sum cu'i ya rgyal/ 1nga seng chen skyesabu ma 'khrungs gong mi gdong btsan dang rta g.yu bya'i rjes la chod mkhan gcigakyang med par gleng ngo / /dkar ru nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang nag ru thar ba rgyal mtshan gnyisalcags bya dang chu yos lor 'khrungs/ yab dkar ru dpa' bstan mgon po dang yum ru bza' chung skyed dar mtsho yin/ gling gser thub dang yum sgon gnyis la khye'u khyad par can re 'khrungs/ rjes sa dkar ru dang nag ru zhesagleng tsho chen gyi 'du ra 'tshogs skabs med mi rung ba'i mi sna grags canaganyis sa gyur/ de min da dung gzu ra sper ma'i lha dar/ 'bum pa'i dgra lha rgyal(rgya za'i ste)/ brgya dpon ban de dmar lu(ci gas khyi lor yab 'bru ye stobs chen khra mig dang yum byang bza' lha sgon)/ mi chen rgyal po'i phrun grub(sa rta lor yab ri btsan lha dang yum tsha bza')/ a 'bar bu yo'aphen stag(sa phag lor yab snang ba skyabs dang yum lto bza' shes rab sgol ma/ hor gling skabs sum bkrongs)/ mo ma kun shes thig po(sa spel lor yab rig 'dzin dang yum ma/kha' 'gro)/ sprikhu tshangs pa ngo lug(shing 'brug lor yab rong btsan dang yum dar bza' lcam)/ go 'jo'i bla ma rgyal mtshan la sogs par gling gi phu nu sum byur 'bod cing de'i skor bshad pa rdzogasaso/ /82

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gdong btsan snang ngu adapalani chu sbrul lo'i stag zla la stag robadapon po khro rgyal dang yum 'dan bza' gnyi4kyi srasasusku 'khrungs/ rta lagayubya 'phur shesazer/ dpa' rtulasumacu'i 5gyal/ gling seng chen skyesabu ma'akhrungasagong migadong btsan dang rta g.yubya'i rjesal chod mkhan gcig kyang med par gleng ngo / /dkar ru nyi margyalamatshan dang nag ru thar ba rgyal mtshan gnyisalcagasabya dang chu yosalor 'khrungs/ yab dkar ru dpa' bstan mgon podang yumaru bza' chung skyid dar mtsho yin/ gling gser thub dang yumasgronaganyisal khye'u khyad par can re 'khrungs/ rje4sudakar ru dang nag ru zhesagling tsho chen gyi 'du ra 'tshogasaskabasamed mi rung ba'i mi sna grag4can gnyisasugyur/ de min da dung gzu chen wer ma'i lhadar/ 'bum pa'i dgra lhartse rgyal(rgya tsha'i bu)/ brgya dpon ban de dmar lu(lcag4khyi lor yab 'bru yistobasachenakhra mig dang yumabyang bza' lhasgon)/ mi chen rgyal po'i lhun grub(sarta lor yab ri btsan lhadang yum tsha bza')/ a'abar bu yi'aphen stagayosaphag lor yab snang ba skyabasadang yum lhobaza' shesarab sgrol ma/ hor gling skabasasusku bkrongs)/ mo ma kun shesathig po(sasprel lor yab rig 'dzin dang yumamakha' 'gro)/ akhu tshangasapa ngo lug(shing 'brug lor yab rong btsan dang yum dar bza' lcam)/ go 'jo'i bla ma rgyalamatshan ༵༷༷sapar gling gi phu nu sumacur 'bod cing de'i skor bshad pa rdzogs

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar grung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/de yang bod gangs can gyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo 1nga ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni gna' rabs dang deng rabs kyi sgrung pa khri stong mang po'i zo gros kyi rtsal las thon pa yin la/ blo rig 'dzoms pa'i sgrung pa de dag la shin tu ngo ma/tshar che ba'i brgyud rim mchis pa las gzhan sgrung dpe brgya phrag du ma blor nges shing ngag thog nas thogs pa med par bshad thub/ khong rnam pa'i khrod du babs sgrung dang pra sgrung / gter sgrung /bslab sgrung / brgyud sgrung bcas sgrung pa'i rigs mang po mchis shing / khong rnam sa kyis gsungs pa'i sgrung dpe brgya phrag du ma de dag gna' nas da lta 'i bar du gangs can ljongs yongs gas khyab rdo khyab tu 'gro dang 'gro bzhin yod/ da dung rin thang bral ba'i sgrung dpe de dag gis bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum la phan 'bras bla na ma mchis pa bskrun yod par ma zad/ mtha' yas pa'i sa thang gi 'brog pa'i bu phrug khye stong mang po'i yig rmongs sor bar byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes dang sdongs pa'i grogs sa gyur yod pa yang gdon mi za/ de min da dung 'brog khul mang tshogs kyi rig gnas83

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/de yang bod gangasacan gyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo gling ge sar rgyalapo'i sgrung ni gna' rabasadang deng rabasakyi sgrung pa khri stong mang po'i blogrosakyi rtsalalasathon pa yin la/ blo rig 'dzoms pa'i sgrung pa de dag la shin tu ngo mtshar che ba'i brgyud rim mchi4pa lasagazhan sgrung dpe brgya phrag du mablor ngesashing ngag thog nasathogasapa med par bshad thub/ khong rnam pa'i khrod du babasasgrung dang pra sgrung / gter sgrung /bslab sgrung / brgyud sgrung bcasasgrung pa'i rigasamang po mchisashing / khong rnam/sakyi4gsungayopa'i sgrung dpe brgya phrag du ma de dag gna' nasad lta'i bar du gangs can ljongayoyong4susakhyab rdo khyab tu'agro dang 'gro bzhin yod/ da dung rin thang bral ba'i sgrung dpe de dag gisabod mi rigs kyi rig gnasa'adzin skyong spelagasumal phan 'brasablan mamachisapa bskrun yod par ma zad/ mtha' yasapa'i cathang gi 'brog pa'i bu phrug khri stong mang po'i yig rmongasaselabar byed pa'i dge ba'i bshesadang sdongasapa'i grogasasugyur yod pa yang gdon miza/ de min da dung 'brog khulamang tshogasakyi rig ༵༵sa

gcod pa don thub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'tsho ba je legasasugatong ba'i slad du yang bsamagyisami khyab pa'i gruba'abra4bzhag pa sogasabarjod rgyu mang mod/ yin na'ang da lan skabasasubabasapa'i brjod bya'i snying bo ni gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung pa yin pasagazhanadag zhib brjod mi byed par/ gsham du gter sgrung rigasakyi sgrung pa'i skor laragasatsam dpyad par bya'o/ /dang po/ gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung pa'i go don/gter sgrung rigasakyi sgrung pa la mtshon na dngosagater la gtogasapa'i sgrung pa dang dgongs gter lagatogayopa'i sgrung pa gnyi4mchisapa dang /der sosor mi mtshungasapa'i byung rim dang khyad chos/ mtshan nyid bcasayod pa lags/ 'dir yang de dag re re cung tsam rgyasapar spros na/gcig dngosagater la gtogasapa'i sgrung pa'i go don ni/ bgrang bya brgya phrag du ma'i sngon la gling sgrung de mi dang 'byung po'i gnod pa lasasrung phyir/ 4khung dang brag khung btsan po dang gtsug lag khang sogasasumi'ajig pa'i phyag rgya4btab ste gter du sbasapa de dag phyisasulasa'aphrord pa'i skyesabusarang gi rmi lam ci rigayosulhadang bla masalung bstan pa sogasartagasadang rten 'brel byung bar brten nasagater lasabaton te yig thog nasabashad pa'i sgrung pa'i rigasade la zer/ sgrung pa 'di rigasad ltagangasaljongasayuladu mang po mthong rgyu med kyang gter lasabaton pa'i sgrung dpe skor zhig namayang nyamasapa med par nged cag gi mig gi spyod yuladu gyur pa ste/da~X na/ kham4kyi sgrung gter nyi ma rang shar gyi〈likhri rta rdzong〉dang〈brag

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'tsho ba ji legs sa gtong ba'i slad du yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gruba'abras bzhag pa sogs brjod rgyu mang mod/ yin na'ang da lan skabasasubabs pa'i brjod bya'i snying bo be+e gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung pa yin pas gzhan dag zhib brjod mi byed par/ gsham du gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung pa'i skor la rags tsam dpyad par bya'o/ /dang po/ gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung pa'i gro don/gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung pa la mtshon na dngos gter la/ gtogasapa'i sgrung pa dang dgongs gter la gtogs pa'i sgrung pa gnyis mchis pa dang /der so sor mi mtshungs pa'i byung rim dang khyad chos/ mtshan nyid bcasayod pa lags/ 'dir yang de dag re re cung tsam rgyas par spros na/gcig dngos gter la gtogs pa'i sgrung pa'i go don ni/ bgrang khya brgya phrag du ma'i sngon la gling sgrung de mi dang 'byung po'i gnod pa las srungaphyir/ sa khung dang brag khung btsan po dang gtsug la ga khang sogs sa mi 'jig pa'i phyag rgyas btab ste gter du sbas pa de dag phyis sa las 'phro zad pa'i skyes bus rang gi dri lam/ ci rigs su lha dang bla ma sa lung bstan pa sogasartags dang rten 'brel byung bar brten nas gter las bton te yig thog nas bshad pa'i sgrung pa'i rigs de la zer/ sgrung pa 'di rigs da 37gangasaljongs yul du mang po mthong rgyu med kyang gter las bton pa'i sgrung dpe skor zhig nam yang nyams pa med par nged cag gi mig gi spyod yul du gyur pa ste/dper na/ khams kyi sgrung gter nyi ma rang shar gyi〈cha khri rta rdzong〉dang〈brag 84

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrungapa'iskoraladapyadapa/ /dedamarakhyung rdzong〉/ nam mkha' 'jigasamed kyi〈sog gro shod phab pa'i sgrung〉ltabu dang / da dung sngon byon skyesachen dmapa gter ston rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje dang gter ston pad ma dbang phyug rong ston pad ma blogros/gter ston mati ran+ta/ gter ston rig 'dzin chen po bdud 'dul rdo rje sogasaskad gragasache ba'i gter ston pa 'di rnamasakyisagater gnasagrangasamang zhig layogater chos rin thang can mang po bzhesapa'i lo rgyus〈gu bkra'i chosa'abyung〉du gsal bor bri4'dug cing / gter sgrung yang(rgya gar chos rdzong〉dang〈dmyalagling rdzog4pa chen po〉〈the'u rang ra rdzong〉bcasami nyung ṭ+wā zhig baṭ+wāṃn pa'i lorgyusakyang ngag thog dang yig thog gnyisalas gsal bor rgya4thudi bhe/sa / dgongalogater la gtog4pa'i sgrung par spyir choyolugasaltar na 'grel bshad gtong tshul mang po mchisakyang 'dir ge sar sgrung pa'i cha nasa'achad na/ dgongasagater zhesapa'i go don ni/ gangasacan yul gyi mkhasapa rnamasakyisaphyi snod kyi 'jig rten la sbasapa dngosagater dang nang bcud sem/sacan la sbas pa dgongasagater zer ba'i 'grel tshul yod pa ltar 'dir cung tsam zhib par brjod na/ de yang skye ba sngon ma'i lasacan tshogasabasagasacan gyisage sar rgyalapo'i 'phrin lasargya cher spel ba'i slad du/sdug rusakyi4ge sar sgrung la sbyangasapa dang 'dzin skyong legasapo bgyiyopa'i 'brasabu de skye ba gzhug ma'i gang zag la4'phrocan zhig la cho4kyi skal bar smin te/ glo bur du dgongasapa'i gter mdzod kyi sgo phye ba ltar sgrung 'aṭ+wāṃ ༵ra

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/—dam/ra khyung rdzong〉/ nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi〈sog gro shod phab pa'i sgrung〉lta bu dang / da dung sngon byon skyes chen dam pa gter sto/na rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje dang gter ston pad ma dbang phyug rong ston pad ma blo gros/gter ston ma ti ra sto/ gter ston rig 'dzin don po bdud 'dul rdo rje sogs skad grags che ba'i gter ston pa 'di rnams kyis gter gnas grangasam nga zhig la sa gter chos rin thang can mang po bzhes pa'i lo rgyus〈gu bkra'i chos 'byung〉du gsal bor bris 'dug cing / gter sgrung yang〈rgya gar chos rdzong〉dang〈dmyal 1nga rdzogs pa chen po〉〈ze'u rang ra rdzong〉bcas mi nyung ba zhig bton pa'i lo rgyus kyang ngag thog dang yig thog gnyis las gsal bor shes thub bo/ /gnyis/ dgongs gter la gtogs pa'i sgrung par spyir chos lugasalta/ra na 'grel bshad gtong tshad mang po mchis kyang 'dir ge sar sgrung pa'i cha nas 'chad na/ dgongs gter zhes pa'i go don ni/ gangs can yul gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis phyi sgod kyi 'jig rten la sbas pa dngos gter dang nang bcud sem sa can la sbas pa dgongs gter zer ba'i 'grel tshad yo da pa ltar 'dir cung tsam zhib par brjod na/ de yang skye ba sngon ma'i la sa can tshogasabasags can gyis ge sar rgyal po'i 'phrin las rgya cher mkha ba'i slad du/sdug rus kyis ge sar sgrung la sbyangs pa dang 'dzin skyong legs po bgyis pa'i 'bras6 de skye ba gzhug ma'i gang zag la sa 'phro can zhig la chos kyi skal bar smin te/ glo bur du dgongs pa'i gter mdzod kyi sgo phye ba ltar sgrung 'bri bar 85
