gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thogasapamed par gyur pa'i sgrung pa'i rigs de la zer bar grag4shing / de yang gsang chen rnying ma'i ring lugasalaring brgyud bka' ma/ nye brgyud gter ma/ zab modag snang ma zhesabargyud pa'i bka' srolachen mogasumadu dbye bar mdzad pa'i lung bzhin/ 'dir yang zab modag snang gi skor rnamasaganam gter dang dgong4gter gang rung lasam 'ad4pas zab gter gyi phyogasasugatogasashing / de bzhin dgongasagater la gragasapa rnamasakyang / mdo las/ 'jam dpal 'byung ba chen po bzhi ni nam mkha'i gter nasa'abyung gi de bzhin du chosathamasacad rgyal ba'i thugasagater la4'byung bsagater gyi don la longasaspyod pa shesapar byosashig cesagasungasapa dang rjesasumathun par 'phagasapasagang zag rnamasala'ang dgongs pa'i klong nasachosakyi gter kha brdol ba yod par gsungasapa ltar/rang re'i zhing khamasa'adi ru'ang dgongasagater rigasal gtogs pa'i sgrung pa rnamasakyi dgongasapa'i klong nasasgrung gi gter kha brdol ba lasabyung ba'i sgrung dpe yin zhesapa yod pa lasagazhan/ sgrung dpe migacig pa brgya phrag lhag 'bri shesapa'ang da ltamig gisamathong rgyu 'dug dper na mgo log gi sgrung pa gu ru rgyal mtshan ltabur mtshon na/ khong nyid dgung lo bcu dgur sleb4pa'i lo der blamasalung bstan legasapo zhig gnang ba dang 'brel nasaglo bur du sgrung 'bri she4par gyur par ma zad/ sgrung dpe sna tshogasabargya dang nyi shu lhag 'bri shesapalags/ da ltasang gisasgrung dpe gsar ba bcu bzhi briswāṭ+wāṃr ba dang〈smug po ldong gi rgyal rabs〉dang〈mu men dngul rdzong〉

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom sgogs bsgrigs/thogs pa med par gyur pa'i sgrung pa'i rigs de la zer bar grags shing / de yang gsang d+ku rnying ma'i ring lugs la ring brgyud bka' ma / nye brgyud gter ma/ zab yodag snang ma zhes brgyud pa'i bka' srol dza mo gsum du dbye bar mdzad pa'i lung bzhin/ 'dir yang zab yodag snang gi skor rnams gnam gter dang dgongs gter gang rung la sam 'das pas zab gter gyi phyogs sa gtogs shing / de bzhin dgongs gter la grags pa rnams kyang / mdo las/ 'jam dpal 'byung ba ra po bzhi ni nam mkha'i gter nas 'byung gi de bzhin du chos tham sa cad rgyal ba'i thugs gter las 'byung bas gter gyi don la longs spyod pa shes par byes shig cesagasungs pa dang rjes sa mthun par 'phags pas gang zag rnams la'ang dgongs pa'i klong nas chos kyi gter kha brdol ba tsho par gsungs pa ltar/rang re'i zhing khams 'di ru'ang dgongs gter rigs la gtogs pa'i sgrung /sgo 11 zur—1 11 (1 :rdo tsharapa rnams da ngas pa' nga nas sgrung ga ra kha ba la ba las byung ba 'a sgrung dpe yin zhes pa yod pa las gzhan/ sgrung dpe mi gcig pa brgya phrag lhag 'bri shes pa'ang da lta mig gis mthong rgyu 'dug dper na mgo log gi sgrung pa gu ru rgyal mdza lta6ra mtshon na/ khong nyid dgung lo bcu dgur slebs pa'i lo der bla ma/sa lung bstan legs po zhig gnang ba dang 'brel nasaglo bur du sgrung 'bri shes par grur par ma zad/ sgrung dpe sna tshogs brgya dang nyi shu lhag 'bri shes pa lags/ da lta kheng gis sgrung dpe gsar ba bzu bzhi bas tshar ba dang〈srug po ldong gi rgyal rabs〉dang〈mu men dngul rdzong〉86

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/sogasapar skrun gnang 'dug la/ gling ge sar gyi bshad pa bcu gsum las/(mdung mo'i bshad pa〉dang〈phub mosba dmar gling drug gi bshad pa〉〈sbrul zhagasakyi bshad pa〉〈ralagri'i bshad pa〉〈lcag gi bshad pa〉〈star chen brag ri har gshagayokyi bshad pa〉〈stobasachen sbyogasakyi bshad pa〉〈dpa' dgra bla'i go khrab kyi bshad pa〉〈lharta rkyang bu khadakar gyi bshad pa〉〈sna srab kyi bshad pa〉〈dgra bla wer ma'i bshad pa〉bca4bcu gsum phyag brisaganang stedusadeb steng du yang bkod yod pa ltar ro/ /— gnyis pa/ sgrung gter dang sa gter rdzas gter sogs kyi dbya bsgru/ nga gter dang sagater rdzasagater sogasathog mar 'chad pa'i skabasasutham4cad gter gyi tha snyad kyi khongasasugatogasamod/ yin na'ang de dag gi bar ladabye ba chen po mchisate/ gcig ni sagater dang sgrung gter bar la 'brelabagatan nasamed cesabashad chog pa dang / de'i rgyu mtshan ni sagater gyi go don ni rang byung kham4kyi gser dngul zangasalcagasadang zha nye ti tsha g.yang ṭi/ tshwa snum rdo sol la sog4kyi gter kha sna tshogasade yin la/ dper na srid pa'i kha dper sathog phyugasakyis gang /sa'og gter gyisagang zer ba'i sa'og ni sagater la go dgosapa lags/'di rigasakyi gter rang byung khamasakyi sagater yin pa ma gtogasalhadang misached du bcosapa'i gter min pasasgrung gter la'abrel ba yod mi srid/gnyi4ni sgrung gter dang rdzasagater bar du'ang khyad par chen po yod 8༵ ste/

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/sogs par skrun gnang 'dug la/ gling ge sar gyi bshad pa bcu gsum las/〈mdung mong bshad pa〉dang〈phub mo sba dmar gleng drug gi bshad pa〉〈byul zhags kyi bshad pa〉〈ral gri'i bshad pa〉〈lcag gi bshad pa〉〈star chen brag ri har gshags kyi bshad pa〉〈stobs chen sgogs kyi bshad pa〉〈dpa' dgra bla'i go khrab kyi bshad pa〉〈lha rta rkyang bu kha dkar gyi bshad pa〉〈sga srab kyi bshad pa〉〈dgra bla wer ma'i bshad pa〉bcas bcu gsum phyag bris gnang ste dus deb steng du yang bkod yod pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa/ sgrung gter dang sa gter jas gter sogs kyidabyeb/sgrung gter dang sa gter rdzas gter sogs thog mar 'chad pa'i skabs su thams cad gter gyi tha snyad kyi khongs tshogatogs mo da/ yin na'ang de dag gi bar la dbye ba chen po ma chis te/ gcig ni sa gter dngasgrung gter bar la 'brel ba gtan nas med ces bshad chog pa dang / de'i rgyu ma/don ni sa gter gyi go don ni rang byung khams kyi gser dngul zangasalcags dang zha nye ti tsha g.yang ṭi/ tshwa snum rdo sol la sogs kyi gter kha sna tshogs de yin la/ dper na srid pa'i kha dper sa thog phyugs kyis gang /sa 'og gter gyis gang zer ba'i sa 'og be+e sa gter la go dgos pa lags/'di rigs kyi gter rang byung khams kyi sa gter yin pa ma gtogs la dang mis ched du bcos pa'i gter min pas sgrung gter la 'brel ba yo da mi srid/gnyis ni sgrung gter dang dzas gter bar du'ang khyad par chen po yod pa ste/87

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de yang rdzas gter de chos lugs kyi khongs tshogatogs pa ma gtogs 'jig rten pa'i gter gyi khongs sa mi gtogs/ rdzas gter 'di sba ba'i dmigasayul ni rang re'i yul kham sa 'di bde zhing skyid pa dang 'o yag bskal bzang yong ba/ rgyu dang 'byor ba ldan pa/ bgegs dang bar chad sol ba/ tshe ring nad sted pa/ bkra shis bde legs yong ba bcas kyi ched du yin te/mdor na gang dgos gang bsam de lhun gyis 'grub pa'i slad du gter yig snatshogs dang gser dngul g.yu byur gyi rin po che sna mang / gro nas sran gsum rmi 'bru rigs sna lnga sogs rdzas mang po lhan du bsdu sa te rdza bum mam gter khug tu bcug ste/ sa mig legs po dang mtsho dang mtshe'u sogs su bsam gzas nas sbas pa la zer/ 'di yang rang byung kham sa kyi gter dang sgrung gter zhes pa'i bar la khyad par gsal bor ma chis/ chos 'u gas pa'i gter de ni bsam bzhin du sbas shing / phyir 'don mkhan yang sngar nas gtan khel byas yod/ yin na'ang rang byung khams kyi sa gter der sted mkhan gyi mi med la/ phyir 'don mkhan la yang gtan khel med/ dzas gter sted mkhan dang 'don mkhan ni mchog gi dngos grub la mnga' brnyes pa'i byes bu zhig yin dgos pa ni kun gyis gsung bzhin pa ltar ro/ /des na sgrung gter ni rigs gang la gtogs sam zhe na/ gong du sgrung gter gyi go don brjod pa'i skabs su brjod pa ji bzhin dngos gter dang dgongs gter rigs gnyis la gtogs shing / sgrung ma khan la yang dngosagater la gtogs pa'i sgrung mkhan dang dgongs gter la gtogs pa'i sgrung 88

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshering gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de yang rdzasagater de cho4lugasakyi khongasasugatogasapa ma gtogasa'ajig rten pa'i gter gyi khong4sumi gtogs/ rdzasagater 'di sba ba'i dmigasayul ni rang re'i yul kham/sa'adi bde zhing skyid pa dang lo yag bskal bzang yong ba/ rgyu dang 'byor ba ldan pa/ bgeg4dang bar chad sel ba/ tshe ring nad med pa/ bkra shisabade legasayong ba bcas kyi ched du yin te/mdor na gang dgo4gang bsamade lhun gyisa'agrub pa'i slad du gter yig sna tshogasadang gser dngul ga༅byur gyi rin po che sna mang / gro nayosran gsumagyi 'bru rig4sna lnga sogasardzas mang po lhan du bsdusate rdza bum mam gter khug tu bcug ste/ 4mig legasapo dang mtsho dang mtshe'u sog4subasam gzasan4sbasapa lazer/ 'di yang rang byung khamasakyi gter dang sgrung gter zhesapa'i bar lakhyad par gsalabor mchis/ chosalugasapa'i gter de ni bsamabazhin du sba4shing / phyir 'don mkhan yang sngar nasagatan khel byasayod/ yin na'ang rang byung khamasakyi sagater der sbed mkhan gyi mimed la/ phyir 'don mkhan layang gtan khel med/ rdzasagater sbed mkhan dang 'don mkhan ni mchog gi dngosagrub lamanga' brnyesapa'i skyesabu zhig yin dgo4pa ni kun gyisagasung bzhin pa ltar ro/ /de4na sgrung gter ni rig4gang la gtogasasamazhe na/ gong du sgrung gter gyi go don brjod pa'i skabasasubarjod pa ji bzhin dngosagater dang dgongasagater rigasaganyisalagatogasashing / sgrung mkhan layang dngosagardo~X la gtogasapa'i sgrung mkhan dang dgongasagater la gtogasapa'i sgrung

gter sgrung rigs kyi ges ra sgrung pa'i skor la da༅da pa/mkhan gnyis yo da/ sgrung dpe la yang dngos gter las thon pa'i sgrung dpe dang dgongs gter las thon pa'i sgrung dpe rigs gnyis yo da/ der yang rang rang la thun min gyi byung rim dang khyad chos ngo mtshar ba ma/chis kyang gong nas byung rgyas par bshad zin pas bskyar zlos kyi dgos pa ma ma chis so /da lto nged cag rnams kyi mig gi spyod yu'i du gyur pa'i gter sgrung yod do cog de tshig don gang gi cha nas dpyad na'ang chos lugs kyi khongs sam 'dus pa gcig kyang sted/ bod brgyud nang bsta na chos lugs kyi grub mtha'i cha nasabaltas na sgrung gter 'di grub ma/tha' kun la yod chog mo da/ 'on te sgrung gter phal cher gsang sngags rnying ma'i khongs tshogatogs pa gdon mi/ za'o/ /gsum pa/ gter grung byung ba'i lo chigs/bod du gter chos dngos sa dar ba'i dus ni chos rgyal khri sro nga lde btsan gyi skabs yin la/ gangs ljongs 'dir rnying ma/'i gter ston rnam/sa kyi thog ma ste gter ston sangs rgyas bla ma nas da lta'i bar du gter ston lnga brgya tsam byung bar grags/ gter ston pa rnams kyis dus rabs dang lo rabs mi 'dra ba'i skabs su bton pa'i gter chos tham/sa cad phyogs gcig tu bci sa pa'i dbang du btang na/ glegs bam dum pa brgya phrag du ma mchis/dper na slob dpon pad+ma'i rnam thar gter ma gcig pur dum pa brgya tham/ pa yod/ der yang gter chos kun la sa grags che ba ni/ 〈bka' chems ka khol ma〉dang〈ma ṇi bka' 'bum/〉〈gu ru'i rnam thar zangs gling ma 〉〈pad+ma 89

gter sgrung rigs kyige sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/mkhan gnyisayo da/ sgrung dpe la yang dngosagater lasathon pa'i sgrung dpe dang dgongasagater lasathon pa'i sgrung dpe rigasaganyisayod/ der yang rang rang la thun min gyi byung rim dang khyad chosango mtshar ba mchisakyang gong nasacung rgya4par bshad zin pasabaskyar zlosakyi dgo4pa ma/ mchisaso /da ltarngad cag rnam4kyi mig gi spyod yul du gyur pa'i gter sgrung yod do cog de tshig don gang gi cha nasadapyad na'ang chosalugasakyi khongasasuma'adusapa gcig kyang med/ bod brgyud nang bstan cho4lugasakyi grub mtha'i cha nasabaltasan sgrung gter 'di grub ma/tha' kun la yod chog mod/ 'on te sgrung gaṭ+wāṃr phal cher gsang sngagasarnying ma'i khongasasugatog4pagadon mi za / ga/sum pa/ gter sgrung byung ba'i lo chigs/bod du gter cho4dngosasudar ba'i dusani chosargyal khri srong lde btsan gyi skabasayin la/ gang4ljong4'dir rnying ma'i gter ston rnamasakyi thog maste gter ston sangasargyasamamanasad lta'i bar du gter ston lnga brgya tsam byung bar grags/ gter ston pa rnamasakyisadusarabasadang lo rabasami 'dra ba'i skab4su bton pa'i gter cho4thamasacad phyog4gcig tu bsdu sapa'i dbang du btang na/ glegasabamadum pa brgya phrag du ma mchis/dper na slob dpon pad+ma'i rnam thar gter mgacig pur dumapa brgya tham pa yod/ der yang gter cho4kun la4gragasache ba ni/ 〈bka' chem4ka kholam〉dang〈maṇi bka' 'bum〉〈gu ru'i rnamathar zangasagling ma〉hūm̐~Xd+ma

gcod pa don grub dang snying bom ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bka' thang〉〈thangayig sde lnga〉sogasayin par gragasapa dang / de dag lasakyang rig 'dzin 'jigasamed gling pa'i〈klong chen snying thig〉ni rnying ma'i gter chosakyi rtsa ba yin zhesagragasache/ gling rje ge sar rgyal po ni dusagasum rgyal ba'i thugasasras/ gu ru pad+ma'i rnam sprul zhesaphyi ma'i gter cho4mang po'i lung gisazin yod cing / ge sar gyi cho ga sogasagater chosamang po'i nang du mthong rgyu yod par ma zad/ da dung semasacan gyisamachod bkur bgyi ba'i gzhi dam pa zhig tugyur yod pa'ang 'ju mi pham 'jamadabyangasarnam rgyal rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum lasakyang gsal bor mthong thub/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i gter sgrung byung ba'i dusaskabasala'ang da ltamakhasapa skor zhig gisabazhed tshulami mthun pa mang po brjod kyang kho bo'i bsam par gter sgrung 'di byung nasabagrang bya chig stong yasamasalasa'adasamed par 'dod/ rgyu mtshan ni/ brag dgon pa'i〈mdo smad chosa'abyung〉las/ de yang sngon rma 'gram stod kyi 4thamasacad la gling ge sar rgyal posadabang bsgyur/ de nyid kyi 'khrungasalo lcagasabyi dang chu sbrul la'adod mkhan gnyisasnang ba gang yin yang rab byung dang potshugasakhama'i drug cu skor der gtogasal/ rlang byang chub 'dre bkol dang / smri ti ston kirti spyan drangasate chosazhusadang /gtsug lag khang bzheng4par bshad pasakyang shes nusazhesagasungasapa dang /mgo log khra gling dgon pa'i sprulasku bstan pa'i nyi ma'i〈pho brang seng 'brug stag rtse'i lorgyus〉zhesapa'i dpe deb lasakyang / bod rab byung dang po'i sto~X ༵grelaba'i ba hu dhan zhesapa 'bru mang po ste/ rgya rtsisapa'i sa pho stag gi

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bka' thang〉〈thang yig sde lnga〉sogs yin par grags pa dang / de dag lasakyang rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i〈khrong r+ṣa snyeng zig〉ni rnying ma'i gter chos kyi rtsa ba yin zhes grags che/ gling rje ge sar rgyal po ni dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs sras/ gu ru pad+ma'i rnam sprul zhes phyi ma'i gter chos ma nga po'i lung gis zin yod cing / ge sar gyi cho ga sogs gter chos mang po'i nang du ma/thong rgyu yod par ma zad/ da dung sems can gyis mchod bkur brgya ba'i gzhi dam pa zhig tu gyur yod pa'ang 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtshol gsung 'bum las kyang gsal bor ma thong thub/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i gter sgrung byung ba'i dus skabs la'ang da lta mkhas pa skor zhig gisabazhed tshal mi mthun pa mang po brjod kyang kho bo' bsam par gter sgrung 'di byung nas bgrang be+e chig stong yas mas las 'das med par 'dod/ rgyu mdon be+e/ brag dgon pa'i〈mdo smad chos 'byung〉las/ de yang sngon rma 'gram stod byu sa thams cad la gling ge sar rgyal pos dbang bsgyur/ de nyid kyi 'khrungs lo lcags bye dang chu byis la 'dod mkhan gnyis snang ba gang yin yang rab byung dang po tshugs kha ma'i drug cu skor der gtogs la/ rlang byang chub 'dre bkol dang / smre ti ston kirti spyan drangs te chos zhus dang /gtsug lag khang bzhengs par bshad pas kyang shes nus zhes gsungs pa dang /mgo log khra gling dgon pa'i spru la sbu bstan pa'i nyi ma'i〈pho brang seng 'brug stag rtse'i lo rgyus〉zhes pa'i dpe deb las kyang / bod rab byung dang po'i stod 'grel ba'i ba hu dha na zhes pa 'bru mang po ste/ rgya rtses pa'i sa pho stag gi 90

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/lo'i rgyal zla ba'i ches15(spyi lo1038lo)nyin spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo nas4 bo dung spyong dkar po/ steng kha chos kyi 'khor lonas na bo klu sbrul 'od chung / ltob nas sring lcam tha le'i 'od dkar/ gsang ba bde skyong gi 'khor lo nas gling rje ge sar rgyal po srug po ldong gi rgyal rgyud du ngo mtshar che ba'i ltas dang bcas sbu 'khrungs/ gdung rgyud der rgyal dbang lnga ba'i deb ther du/ rgyal po dmag brgya ba zhes pa'i rgyal rgyud las mched pa yin par gsungs/ ge sar 'khrungs nas 'di lo'i chu bya 'i bar la lo955tsam song zhes bkod 'dug pa sogs gzhir bzung nas gling ge sar rgyal po'i 'khrungasa'adas dang khong gi mdzad 'phrin phal mo cher dpyad na/ bgrang be+e chig stong yas mas las 'das med pas mi ma skyes pa'i sngon la mdzad 'phrin byung thabasamed pas so/ / yin na'ang 'dir gsal bshad cig dgos pa ni/ phyi ma'i sgrung dpe mi nyung ba'i nang du bod gangs can gyi gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus mang po zhig kha snon mdzad de rgya je cher btang yong pa de shes dgos pa'o/ /gzhan yang gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung yod do cog dngos gter dang dgongasagater la ma gtogs pa gcig kyang sked ces mkhas pa dang sgrung pa grags can mi nyung ba zhig gis gsungs dang gsung bzhin 'dug na yang kha cig gi bzhed pa la sgrung dpe yo da tshad gter sgrung la gtogs mi srid ces rgyab rten gyi lung drangs nas dpyad gtam kyang mang po brjod yod/ gang ltar kyang ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung dpe thams cad gter sgrung la gtogs dang migatogs pa'i kha tshon gcod dka' mod/ 'on te babs sgrung dang pra sgrung gter sgrung gi sgrung 91

gter sgrung rigasakyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/lo'irgyal zla ba'i tshes15(spyi lo1038lo)nyin spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo nasaphu bo dung skyong dkar po/ snying kha cho4kyi 'khor lonasanu bo klu sbrul 'od chung / lteb nayosring lcamatha le'i 'od dkar/ gsang ba bde skyong gi 'khor lonasagling rje ge sar rgyalapo smug po ldong gi rgyalargyud du ngo mtshar che ba'i ltasadang bcasasku 'khrungs/ gdung rgyud der rgyaladabang lngaba'i deb ther du/ rgyal po dmag brgya ba zhesapa'i rgyalargyud lasamached pa yin par gsungs/ ge sar 'khrungasanasa'adi lo'i chu bya 'i bar lalo955tsamasong zhesabakod 'dug pa sogasagazhir bzung nasagling ge sar rgyal po'i 'khrungasa'adasadang khong gi mdzad 'phrin phalamocher dpyad na/ bgrang bya chig stong yasam4lasa'adasamed pasami maskyesapa'i sngon la mdzad 'phrin byung thabasamed pa4so/ / yin na'ang 'dir gsal bshad cig dgo4pa ni/ phyi ma'i sgrung dpe minyung ba'i nang du bod gangasacan gyi gna' rabasakyi lo rgyusamang po zhig kha snon mdzad de rgya je cher btang yod pa de shesadagosapa'o/ /gzhan yang gling ge sar rgyalapo'i sgrung yod do cog dngosagater dang dgong4gter la ma gtogasapa gcig kyang med ceyomakha4pa dang sgrung pa gragasacan mi nyung ba zhig gisagasungasadang gsung bzhina'adug na yang khacig gi bzhed pa la sgrung dpe yod tshad gter sgrung lagatogasamisrid cesargyabarten gyi lung drangasan4dpyad gtamakyang mang po brjod yod/ gang ltar kyang ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung dpe thamasacad gter sgrung la gtog4dang migatogasapa'i kha tshon gcod dka' mod/ 'on te babasasgrung dang pra sgrung gter sgrung dī snang

gcodapa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi chedartsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa rnamapa'i blo'or sgrung sna mi gcig pa brgya dang lnga bcu drug cu lhag yod pa 'dir lkog gyur gyi she4bya zab mo zhig mchi4pa susakyang bsnyon du med/'di ni nged cag gisazhib 'jug bya yul gyi gnad galachen zhig kyang yin no/ /bzhi ba/ gter sba ba'i snod dang gnas dang dgos pa sogs/de yang zab mo gter gyi rig4la gtogasapa'i gter chosadang gter sgrung gang yin rung tshang mar khyad par can gyi gter snod dang gter gnas/ gter srung / gter 'don pa'i dusadang gter ston pa/ da dung gter sba ba'i dgosapa bcas yod par gsungasapa lags/ de yang(mngon du zhugasapa ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo〉las/ nga ni phyi du4mya ngan 'dasabyasanas/ / sku gdung thamasacad rgyasapar byasagyur te/ / sangasargyasabyang chub 'di dag legasabazung nas/ / brisanasasgromagyi nang du bcug byasanas/ /ma chod rten sadang brag dang ri dag dang / /lha dang de bzhin klu yilag dag tu/ / mdo sde bzhag par bya4nasa'adi dag rnams/ / lhayibartulazhug4'dra bar byasaphyir 'gro/ / de dag phyi ma'i dusan so so 'i rigs/ / thamasacad bor te slad du bab gyur nas/ / sangasargyas byang chub 'di dag legasabazung ste/ / bsamapa ji bzhin du ni byed par 'gyur/ /zhe4gsungasapa ltar/ brisate sgrom gyi nang du bcug byasanasazhesapasagater snod dang gter chosasam gter sgrung sogasabastan pa dang /mchod rten 4dang brag ri zhesapa sogayokyi4gter gnasabastan yod/ lha92

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrig /pa rnam pa'i blo ngor sgrung sna mi gcig pa brgya dang lnga bcu drug cu lhag yod pa 'dir lkog gyur gyi shes bya zab mo zhig mchis pa sus kyang bston du med/'di ni nged cag gis zhib 'jug be+e yul gyi gnad gal chen zhig kyang yin no/ /bzhi ba/ gten sba ba'i sgod dang gnas dang dgos pa sogs/de yang zab mo gter gyi rigs la gtogs pa'i gter chos dang gter sgrung gang yin rung tshang mar khyad par can gyi gter sgod dang gter gnas/ gter srung / gter 'don pa'i dus dang gter sto na pa/ da dung gter sba ba'i dgos pa bcas yod par gsungs pa lags/ de yang〈ma/ngon du zhugs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo〉las/ nga ni phyi dus mya ngan 'das byas nas/ / sku gdung thams cad rgyas par byas gyur te/ / sangs rgyas byang chub 'di dag legs bzung nas/ / bris nas sgom gyi nang du bcug byasanas/ /ma chod rten sa dang brag dang ri dag dang / /lha dang de bzhin klu yi lag dag tu/ / mdo sde bzhag par byas nas 'di dag rnam/sa/ / lha⑪brtul zhugs 'dra bar byas phyir 'gro/ / de dag phyi ma 'i dus na so so/'i rigs/ / tham/sa cad bor te be+e da du bab gyur nas/ / sangs rgyas byang chub 'di dag legs bzung ste/ / bsam/ pa ji bzhin du ni byed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bris te sgom gyi nang du bcug byas nasazhes pas gter sgod dang gter chos sam gter sgrung sogs bstan pa dang /mchod rten sa dang brag ri zhes pa sogs kyis gter gnas bstan yo da/ lha92

gter sgrung rigasakyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/dang de bzhin klu yilag tubazhag zer bsagater srung dang / de dag phyi ma'i dusanasasoso'i rigs/ / thamasacad bor te slad du bab gyur nasazhesapayogater 'don pa'i dusadang 'don mkhan bstan yod/ sang4rgyasabyang chuba'adi dag leg4bzung nas/ / bsamapa ji bzhin du ni byed par 'gyar ni/ gter chosade dag gi4'gro ba'i don rgya chen po byed par 'gyur bzlo don sogasagasal bor mtshon yod pa yin no/ / gzhan yang gong zhu'i gsung gi snying bo de lasazab mo gter lagatogasapa'i gter chos dang gter sgrung gang der gtan khel gyi gter snod dang gter srung / gter gnasasogasamachi4pa lasagazhan byung rgyal du smra ba dang 'don pa sogasal gter cho4sam gter sgrung sog4subarjod na mi chog pa shugasanasagasal bor rtogayothub bo/ / de bzhin du gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung lasagater sgrung rigasalagatog4pa'i sgrung dpe dag la cha mtshon na/ gcig ni der sgrung bshad mkhan nam 'bri mkhan zhig yo da pa dang / gnyi4ni gter yig gamashog ser thog brisazin pa'i glegasabamarnam4mi'ajig pa'i sgrom gyi nang du 'jug dgosapa dang / gsum ni mchod rten dang sadang brag ri/ gtsug 'a ga khang sogasasumi 'jig pa'i phyag rgyas btab ste sba bar gnang ba dang /bzhi ni lhadang klu la bcol ba'i chosakyi cho ga bsgrub pa dang / lnga ni bla ma'am skyesabu dmagazhig gisagater 'don gyi dusadang gter ston pa gtan khelabagyid pa bcasakyi lag len brgyud yod pa yin/ da ltarngad cag gi4mthong ba'i gter sgrung rigasakyi sgrung dpe phalacher gyi mjug mthar ram mju/ ṭ+wāṃng

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/dang de bzhin klu yol ga tu bzhag zer bas gter srung dang / de dag phyi ma'i dus nas so so/'i rigs/ / thams cad bor te slad du bab gyur nas zhesapas gter 'don pa'i dus dang 'don ma/khan bste na yod/ sangs rgyas byang chub 'di dag legs bzung nas/ / bsam pa ji bzhin du ni byed par 'gyur ni/ gter chos de dag gis 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po byed par 'gyur ba'i don sogs gas bor mtshon yod pa yin no/ / gzhan yang gong zhu'i gsung gi snying bo de las zab mo gter la gtogs pa'i gter chos dang gter sgrung gang der gtan khel gyi gter sgo da dang gter srung / gter gnasasogs mchis pa las gzhan byung rgyal du smra ba dang 'don pa sogs la gter chos sam gter sgrung sogs stobarjod na mi chog pa shugs nas gsal bor rtogs thub bo/ /de bzhin du gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung las gter sgrung rigs la gtogs pa'i sgrung dpe dag la cha mtshon na/ gcig ni der sgrung bshad ma khan nam 'bri mkhan zhig yo da pa dang / gnyis ni gter yig gam shog ser thog bris zin pa'i glegs bam rnams mi 'jig pa'i sgo ma gyi nang du 'jug dgos pa dang / gsum ni mchod rten dang sa dang brag ri/ gtsug la/ga khang sogs su mi 'jig pa'i phyag rgyas ba7ba ste sba bar gnang ba dang /bzhi ni lha dang klu la bcol ba'i chos kyi cho ga bsgrub pa dang / lnga ni bla ma'am/ skyes bu dam pa zhig gis gter 'don gyi dus dang gter ston pa gtan khel bgyid pa bcas kyi lag len brgyud yod pa yin/ da lta nged cag gis mthong ba'i gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung dpe phal cher zhu mjug mthar ram mjug byang 93

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/du gter 'don pa dang gter 'don gyi dus sogs gsal bor bris yod/da ltad dung gter las 'don pa'i dus la ma bab par ma bton pa'i gter sgrung yang mang po yod ces gleng bzhin 'dug 〈gu bkra'i chos 'byung〉du/mdo rgyud du ma nas rgyal ba nyid kyis lan gcig ma yin par gsungs pa bzhin du 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub 'ga' zhig gis gter sbas pa dang /mdo rgyud rnams bton pa'i lo rgyus kyang yod la/ khyad par du sangs rgyasaganyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin phyag len du btab ste rgya gar bal bod rnams sa zab gter ji snyed sbas shing lhag par du bod yul kha ba'i ljongs 'dir ri brag mtsho gsum gtsug lag khang sogs sa mi 'jig pa'i phyag rgyas btab ste sba bar mdzad pa'i dgos pa yang / ji skad du/shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug snying bo rnams/ /spyir yang bod rnams gsar nges che ba dang / /snyigs ma'i 'gro la lhag par snying rje bas/ /mtha' da6sa thams cad gter gyis bkang nas bzhag /las can bu dang 'phrad pa'i sgon lam btab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bod gangs can gyi mtha' dbus thams cad gter gyis bkang ba dang gnas mchog byed 'dir rgyu ba'i bye dgu rnams kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag ni dus bab kyi zab gter la rag lasayod par bsams shing / de nyid spyan 'dren pa po yang bod gna' rabasadang deng ra bas skabs sumachog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i gter don dang gter phran gyi gter ston pa grags can bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po byon pa de rnams lags pa'ang kun gyis shes gsal ltar ro/ /94

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/du gter 'don pa dang gter 'don gyi du4sogs gsal bor bri4yod/da ltad dung gter lasa'adon pa'i dusalamabab par mabaton pa'i gter sgrung yang mang po yod cesagleng bzhin 'dug 〈gu bkra'i chosa'abyung〉du/mdo rgyud du ma nasargyalab nyid kyisalan gcig mayin par gsungasapa bzhin du 'phag4yulagyi paṇa grub 'ga' zhig gisagater sbasapa dang /mdo rgyud rnamasabaton pa'i lorgyusakyang yod la/ khyad par du sang4rgyasaganyisabapad+ma 'byung gnasakyisargyalaba'i gsung bzhin phyag len du btab ste rgyagar bal bod rnamasasuzab gter ji snyed sba4shing lhag par du bod yulakhaba'i ljong4'dir ri brag mtsho gsum gtsug lag khang sogasasumi 'jig pa'i phyag rgyasabatab stesba bar mdzad pa'i dgosapa yang / ji skad du/shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug snying bo rnams/ /spyir yang bod rnamasagasar ngesache ba dang / /snyigasama'i 'gro lalhag par snying rje bas/ /mtha' dbusathamasacad gter gyisabakang nasabazhag /lasacan bu dang 'phrad pa'i smon lamabatab/ /cesagasungasapa ltar/ bod gangasacan gyi mtha' dbusathamasacad gter gyisabakang bdang gnas mchog yula'adir rgyu ba'i skye dgu rnamasakyi phan bde'i rtsa lag ni dusabab kyi zab gter larag lasayod par bsamasashing / de nyid spyan 'dren pa po yang bod gna' rabayodang deng rab4skabasasumachog gi dngosagrub brnyesapa'i gter chen dang gter phranagyi gter ston pa gragasacan bsamagyisamikhyab pa mang po byon pa de nā~Xsalagasapa'ang kun gyisashesagasal ltar ro/ /

gter sgrung rigs kyi ges ra sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/gter chos dang gter sgrung sogs sba ba'i dgos pa'i cha nas bshad na'ang 'byung ba lnga'i chags 'jig dang dmag 'khrug grub mtha'i stod pa sogs kyi gnod 'tshe las srung ba'i dgos mkho 'ba' zhig min par/ de yang〈chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo〉las/ kun dga' bo/ gang gi chosayongs tshoganas par bya ba'i phyir chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dag glegs ba yol bris te gter du sbas nas mchod na/ des de nyid thob pa bcu thob ste/gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi sprun rab tu thob pas sangs rgyas mthong ba'i gter dang / lha'i rna ba rab tu thob pas chos nyan pa'i gter dang / phyir pi ldo ga pa'i dge 'dun rab tu thob pas dge 'dun mthong ba'i gter dang /rin po che' lag pa rab tu thob pas zad mi shes pa'i gter dang / mtshan dang dpe byad yongs sa rdzogs pas gzugs kyi gter dang / g.yog mi phyed pas g.yog gi gter dang / spobs pa rab tu thob pas dam pa'i gter dang /phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pas mi 'jig pa'i gter dang / sems can rnams nye bar 'tsho bas 'tsho ba bsod nams kyi gter dang / zhes thob pa bcu'i dngos grub stsol ba'am phan 'bras 'byung ba'i yon tan bgrangs yod pa de dag las kyang gsal bor rtogs thub cing / chos rnams dang sgrung rnams rnam kun gnas par bya ba'i phyir glegs bam la bris te gter du sbasan/ gang zag cig la mtshon na/ spyan dang rna ba/ lag pa/ mtshan dpe/spobs pa/ 'tsho ba la sogs so sor sangs rgyas mthong ba'i gter dang /chos nyan pa'i gter/ zad mi shes pa'i gter/ gzugs kyi gter/ dam 95

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/gter chosadang gter sgrung sogasasba ba'i dgosapa'i cha nasabashad na'anga'abyung balnga'i chagasa'ajig dang dmag zhakhrug grubamatha'i rtsod pa sogayokyi gnod 'tshe lasasrung ba'i dgo4mkho'aba' zhig min par/ de yang〈chosayang dag par sdud pa'i mdo〉las/ kun dga' bo/ gang gi cho4yongasasugan4par bya ba'i phyir chosakyi rnamagrangasa'adi dag glegasabamal bri4te gter du sbasanasamachod na/ desade nyid thob pa bcu thob ste/gang zhe na/ sangasargyasakyi spyan rab tu thobapasasangasargyasamathong ba'i gter dang / lha'i rna ba rab tu thob pasachosanyanapa'i gter dang / phyir mildog pa'i dge 'dun rab tuthob pasadage 'dun mthong ba'i gter dang /rin po che'i lag pa rab tu thob pasazad mi shesapa'i gter dang / mtshan dang dpe byad yongasasurdzogasapasagazugasakyi gter dang / g.yog miphyed pasagayog gi gter dang / spobasapa rab tu thob pasadam pa'i gter dang /phasakyi rgol ba tshar gcod pasami'ajig pa'i gter dang / semasacan rnamasanye bar 'tsho bsa'atsho ba bsod namasakyi gter dang / zhesathob pa bcu'i dngosagrub stsolaba'am phan 'brasa'abyung ba'i yon tan bgrangasayod pade dag lasakyang gsalabor rtogasathub cing / chosarnamasadang sgrung rnamasarnamakun gnasapar bya ba'i phyir glegasabamalabrisate gter du sbasan/ gang zag cig la mtshon na/ spyan dang rna ba/ lag pa/ mtshan dpe/spobasapa/ 'tsho ba lasogasasosor sangasargyasamathong ba'i gter dang /choyonyan pa'i gter/ zad misheyopa'i gter/ gzugasakyi gter/9hām

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i gter/ bsod namasakyi gter sogasakyi dngosagrub thob pa'i dgo4pa chen po 'byung ba gsungasa'adug pa ltar ro/ / gong zhu'i tshig don gyi bar du chosalug4kyi ltab dang tha snyad mi nyung ba zhig yod kyang zhib mor bsamablobatang na gter chosadang gter sgrung gi galachen rang bzhin brjod yod la/lhad med kyi cho4dang sgrung sogasadusanam yang dri ma4ma gosapar 'dzin skyong spel gsuyobya dgosapa'i don snying yang shugasasurtogasathub pa lags/lnga ba/ gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung pa'i khud chos gtso bo 'ga'/de yang gter sgrung rigasakyi sgrung pa'i khyad chos gtso bo ni/ gcig ni lo na chung ba'i dusan4ge sar sgrung la dad pa zlog med ma/chisashing / dusargyun ma skuladang blangasasgosagling rje ge sar rgyal po dang dpa' rtul sum cu'i sku 'dra'amashul rten bcasakyi mdun du mchod rdzas bsham4pa dang phyag 'tshalab/ skyabayo'ajug dang smon lamazhu ba'i khyad chosathunamin yod pa/gnyisani byigadusakyi lo drug bdun tsam nasabazung gling ge sar gyi sgrung bshad par nyan 'dod shin tu che ba dang dusargyun byisapa rnam4dang lhan du rtsed skabasasugi sar rgyal po dang dpa' rtul sum cu rnamasakyi mtshan gleng nasasgrung glu tshan pa 'ga' re len par spro ba ha cang che ba dang / khyad par du byisapa mang po'i khrod du nga sga sde'i rnam shesayin nga rgya tsha'i rnam shesayin/nga 'dan ma'i rnamashesayin zhesagleng ba'i tshulanam yang mthong thub pa/gswā~Xni gter sgrung lasadangos gter dang dgongasagater kyi rigasal

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i gter/ bsod nams kyi gter sogs kyi dngos grub thob pa'i dgos pa chen po 'byung ba gsungs 'dug pa ltar ro/ / gong zhu'i tshig don gyi bar du chos lugs kyi ltab dang tha snyad mi nyung ba zhig yod kyang zhib mor bsam blobatang na gter chos dang gter sgrung gi gal chen rang bzhin brjod yod la/lhad med kyi chos dang sgrung sogs dus nam yang dri mas ma gos par 'dzin riskyong spel gsum bya dgos pa'i don snying yang shugs sa rtogs thub pa lags/lnga ba/ gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung pa'i khyad chos gtso bo 'ga'/de yang gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung pa'i khyad chos gtso bo ni/ gcig ni lo na chung ba'i dus nas ge sar sgrung la dad pa zlog chad ma chis shing / dus rgyun ma skul dang blangs sgos gling rje ge sar rgyal po dang dpa' rtul sum cu'i sku 'dra'am shul rten bcas kyi mdun du ma chong rdzas bshams pa dang phyag 'tshal ba/ skyabs 'jug dang smon lam zhu ba'i khyad chos thun min yo da pa/gnyis ni byis dus kyi lo drug bdun tsam nas bzung gling ge sar gyi sgrung bshad par nyan 'dod shin tu che ba dang dus rgyun byis pa rnams dang lhan du sted skabs su ge sar rgyal po dang dpa' rtul sum cu rnams kyi mtshan gleng nas sgrung glu tshan pa 'ga' re len par spro ba ha cang che ba dang / khyad par du byis pa mang po'i khrod du nga sga sde'i rnam shes yin nga rgya za'i rnam shes yin/nga 'dan ma'i rnam shes yin zhes gleng ba'i tshul nam yang mthong thub pa/gsum ni gter sgrung las dngos gter dang dgongs gter kyi rigs la 96

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/gtog4pa'i sgrung bgang yin rung phal cher snga'agyur rnying ma'i chosal dad 'dun bgyi ba'i skyesabu zhig yin zhing / khong rnam par lhan skyesakyi yon tan phun sum tshog4pa dang yid 'dzin gyi nuyopa gzhan dang mimatshungasapa mchisashing / phyag brisaganang ba'i sgrung dpe rnamasala'ang gter tsheg gisakun nayobargyan yod pa/ bzhi ni rang rang lakyag kyog gi brgyud riyongo mtshar ba re yod pa ste/ lo na gzhon pa'i dusasurmi lamabazang ba'i ltasashig gamayang na lhadang bla mar mjalaba'i skabasasugasungasapa'i lung bstan legayopo zhig labarten nasaglo bur du sgrung 'bri shesapa dang bshad shesapa'i sgrung pa zhig tu gyur pa'i lo rgyusayod pa/ lnga ni spyir gter sgrung rigasakyi sgrung pa phal mo chesangag thog na4babasasgrung rigasakyi sgrung pa ltar bshad mithub na'ang / yiger brisan thog4pa med par sgrung dpe brgya phrag lhag 'bri she4pa dang / yige 'bri ba'i skabasasusmyu gu shog thog tubazhag pasan/ gzugayomed kyi stobasashug4shig giyorama'adegasabagyid paltar shar mar 'bri thub par ma zad/ bris byung ba'i yige yang dag cing 'galab ci yang med la/ yige 'bri ba'i skabasasu'ang sgrung pa la la gdan la bzhugayonasashog thog la 'bri ba dang sgrung pa la la mar bsgur nas4nasa'abri ba'i srol yod pa/ dper na/mgo log gi gu ru rgyal mtshan gyisagadan la bzhug4nasashog thog la 'bri ba dang / rma lho'i sgrung pa ajo khyi dang la'i rnam sheyoyin zer nasamar bsgur te sanasa'abri ba ltabu'o/ / drug ni gter sgrung rigasakyi sgrung pasablo ngo nar+sā'abri shesapa'i sgrung dpe'i nang du de snga spyi tshogasathog khyab myong ba~X stang

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/gtogs pa'i sgrung pa gang yin rung phal cher lnga 'gyur rnying ma'i chos la dad 'dun bgyi ba'i skyes bu zhig yin zhing / khong rnam par lhan skyes kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang yid 'dzin gyi nus pa gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa mchisashing / phyag bris gnang ba'i sgrung dpe rnams la'ang gter tsheg gis kun nas brgyan yod pa/ bzhi ni rang rang la kyag kyog gi brgyud rimango mtshar ba re yo/da pa ste/ lo na gzhon pa'i dus sa dri lam bzang ba'i ltas shig gam yang na lha dang bla mar mjal ba'i skabs sa gsungs pa'i lung bstan legs po zhig la brten nas glo bur du sgrung 'bri shes pa dang bshad shes pa'i sgrung pa zhig tu gyur pa'i lo rgyus yod pa/ lnga ni spyir gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung pa phal mo ches ngag thog nas babs sgrung rigs kyi sgrung pa ltar bshad mi thub na'ang / yi ger bris na thogs pa ped par sgrung dpe brgya phrag lhag 'bri shes pa dang / yi ge 'bri ba'i skabs sa spru gu shog thog tu bzhag pas na/ gzugs med kyi stobs shugs shig gis ra ma 'degs bgyid pa ltar shar mar 'bri thub par ma zad/ thras byung ba'i ye ge yang dag cing 'gal ba ci yang med la/ ye ge 'bri ba'i skabs su' pa sgrung pa la la gdan la bzhugs nas shog thog la 'bri ba dang sgrung pa la la mar bsgur nas sa nas 'bri ba'i srol yo da pa/ dper na/mgo 'o ga gi gu ru rgyal mtshan gyis gdan la bzhugs nas shog thog la 'bri ba dang / rma lho'i sgrung pa a jo khyi dang la'i rnam shes yin zer nas mar bsgur te sa nas 'bri ba lta bu'o/ / drug ni gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung pas blo ngo nas 'bri shes pa'i sgrung dpe'i nang du de snga spyi tshogs thog khyab myong ba'i sgrung 97

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dpornying ba'i skor yod la/ spyi tshogasathog gtan nasakhyab mamyong ba'i sgrung dpe gsar ba yang mang po mchisapaste/ dper na mgo log gi sgrung pa gragasacan gu ru rgyal mtshan lamatshon na gter sgrung la gtogasapa'i sgrung pa zhig yin zhing / khong gisa'abri shesapa'i sgrung dpe'i nang du spyi tshogasathog khyab myongaba'i sgrung dpe ste〈lhagleng gab tse dgu skor〉dang〈'khrungasagling〉(rta rgyug〉〈hor gling g.yula'agyed〉(mon gling g.yul 'gyed〉〈'jang gling g.yula'agyed〉sogasayod pa dang / spyitshogasathog gtan nasakhyab ma myong ba'iskrung dpe ste〈dri za'i glu rdzong〉〈sha za'i 'phrulardzong〉〈rong stod khu byug rdzong〉〈mu stegasakhrab rdzong〉('a zha'i dar rdzong〉〈mubon mgu rdzong〉〈gter brag bum rdzong〉(stong nyid mgur rdzong〉sogasamang po yod pa ltabu'o/ /gong zhu'i sgrung dpe gsar rnying gang yin rung tshig don gnyisakyi cha nasagater sgrung rang la brjod stangasadang 'bri stangasathun min zhig chagasayod pa'ang nged rnamasakyisashesadagosaso/ /drug pa/ dngos gter dang dgongs gter las thon pa'i sgrung dpe'i khud chos gtso bo 'ga'/gcig ni dngo4gter dang dgongasagater lasathon pa'i sgrung dpogang yin yang nang bstan cho4lugasakyi tha snyad mang ba dang chosagazhung brjod pa'i tshig don yang mang po mchis/ dper na/ dngosagater la gtogasapa'isnrung rnying〈dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉du/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang ba~X spya khams/ rnamasmin/ rgyu 'bras/ dmyal khamasabaco brgyad/ las

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dpe rnying ba'i skor yod la/ spyi tshogs thog gtan nas khyab ma myong ba'i sgrung dpe gsar ba yang mang po mchis pa ste/ dper na mgo log gi sgrung pa gragasacan gu ru rgyal mtshan la mtshon na gter sgrung la gtogs pa'i sgrung pa zhig yin zhing / khong gis 'bri shes pa'i sgrung dpe'i nang du spyo tshogs thog khyab myong ba'i sgrung dpe ste〈lha gling gab tse dgu skor〉dang〈'khrungs gling〉〈rta rgyug〉〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉〈mon gling ga4la 'byed〉〈'jang gling g.yul 'byed〉sogs yod pa dang / spyo tshogs thog gtan nas khyab ma myong ba'i sgrung dpe ste〈dri za'i glu rdzong〉〈sha za'i 'phrul rdzong〉〈rong stod khu byug rdzong〉〈mu stegs khrab rdzong〉〈'a zha'i dar dzong〉〈mu bon mgu sgong〉〈gter brag bum rdzong〉〈stong nyid mgur rdzong〉sogs mang po yod pa lta bu'o/ /gong zhu'i sgrung dpe gsar rnying gang yin rung tshig don gnyis kyi cha nas gter sgrung rang la brjod stangs dang 'bri stangs thun min zhig chags yod pa'ang nged rnams kyis shes dgos so/ /drug pa/ dngos gter dang dgongs gter las thon pa'i zang dpe'i khrud chos gtso bo 'ga'/gcig ni dngos gter dang dgongs gter las thon pa'i sgrung dpe gang yin yang nang bstan chos lugs kyi tha snyad mang ba dang chos gzhung brjod pa'i tshig don yang mang po mchis/ dper na/ dngos gter la gtogasapa'i yang rnying〈dmyal gling myun pa rang gsal〉du/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang bar do khams/ rnam smin/ rgyu 'bras/ dmyal khams bco brgyad/ las98

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/dge sdig gi dbye ba/ lha dang lngam yin/ ye dwags/ gshin po'i bsngo ba sogs gsal zhing dag pa bris yod pa lta6 red/ da ni 'dir ge sar rgyal pos bsngo ba gsung ba'i tshan pa re bkod na 'di lta ste/ chos a chen ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ / ngas ma ṇi lan gsum bsngo ba 'di/ / khal lce mo bkal ba'i mdzo g.yag bsngo/ / 'dzum ri mo can gyi stag gzig bsngo/ / lus sha khrag dud 'gro yongs stobasngo/ / chos a chen ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ / ngas ma ṇi lan gsum bsngo ba 'di/ / ma a stag lha po gtso byas pa'i/ / nam mkha' gar khyab sems can bsngo/ / mar ma gyur sems can gang yang med/ / zam bzang po'i dbang yon bsngo/ / grwa ba bzang po'i chos yon bsngo/ / sngags pa bzang po'i srung yon bsngo/ / ngas bsngo ba bzhin du thob par shog / cesachos rnam par dag pa'i bsngo smon gsungs pa 'di dag be+e shi bo dung phyur mang po nub phyogs bde ba can la 'dren pa dang / gnas pa da ma'od du skye bar smon lam mam skyabs 'jug zhus pa yin/ gong zhu'i tshig don la mtshon na/chos kyi tha snyad mang bar ma zad/ chos kyi gzhung don brjod pa gting zab cing rgya che ba zhig red/ gzhan yang dgongs gter las thon pa'i sgrung dpe〈gling gi bro ra〉nu/ dbu skra mthing sngon be+e 1bya'i skra cog la/ skra 'chang shel gyi pa tra la nor bu dkar ser dmar ljang dgu bsgrigs kyi zabatab pa/ phyag g.yas la rtsa gsum rig 'dzin rgya mtsho spyan drangs nas thod rnga stong gsum chosasgra bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon la bde stong ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro 'dra ba'i dril bu nyi zla 'od 'bar bsnams pa/ sgu nyams dung zla shar 'dra bde stong 'od 99

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/dge sdig gi dbye ba/ lhadang lham yin/ yidags/ gshin po'i bsngob sog4gsalazhing dag pa brisayod pa ltabu red/ da ni 'dir ge sar rgyalaposabasngo ba gsung ba'i tshan par bkod na 'di ltaste/ chosa.ochen ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ / ngasamaṇi lan gsum bsngo ba 'di/ / khal lci mo bkalaba'i mdzo g.yag bsngo/ / 'dzum ri pocan gyi stag gzig bsngo/ / lusasha khrag dud 'gro yongasasubasngo/ / cho4lkochen maṇi pad+me hūṃ/ / ngasamaṇi lan gsum bsngo ba 'di/ / ma astag lhamogatso byasapa'i/ / namamakha' gar khyab sem4can bsngo/ / mar mgyur semasacan gang yang med/ / blam bzang po'i dbang yon bsngo/ / grwa ba bzang po'i chosayon bsngo/ / sngagasapa bzang po'i srung yon bsngo/ / ngasabasngob bzhin du thobapar shog / cesacho4rnam par dag pa'i bsngosmon gsungasapa 'di dag ni shi bo dung phyur mang po nub phyog4bde ba can la'adren pa dang / gan4pad ma'od du skye bar smon lamamamaskyab4'jug zhusapa yin/ gong zhu'i tshig don la mtshon na/cho4kyi tha snyad mang bar mazad/ cho4kyi gzhung don brjod pa gting zab cing rgya che ba zhig red/ gzhan yang dgongasagater lasathon pa'i sgrung dpe〈gling gi bro ra〉ru/ dbu skumathing sngon be+e stur+ya'i skra cog la/ skya'achang shel gyi pa tra la nor bu dkar ser dmar ljang dgu bsgrigasakyi bobatab pa/ phyag g.yasal rtsa gsumarig 'dzin rgya mtsho spyan drang4nasathod rnga stong gsum chosasgrabasnamasapa/ phyag g.yon la bde stong yeshesakyi mkha' 'gro 'dra ba'i dril bu nyi zla'od 'bar bsnamasapa/ sku nyam4dung zlashar 'dra bde sto~X ༵da

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/phung gi klong na bzhugasapa/ zhesabakod 'dug pa de dag mthong ma thag gling rje ge sar rgyal po mchog ni nag phyogasabadud sde 'jomasamakhan gyi dpa' bo kho na tsam min par/ da dung zabamo choyokyi gzhung la dbang mnga' ba'i bla ma srid na dkon pa zhig yin pa'i gzugasarisade mig mdun du lhan ner shar thub cing / 'di ltabu'i chosatshig gisami sna'i gzugasabarnyan zhiba'abri bgyi4pa mang du mthong thub pa4na/ 'di yang gter sgrung gi khyad du mtshar ba'i rtagasamatshan gtso bo zhig yin pa susakyang bsnyon du med/gnyisani ngag thog nasabargyud de thon pa'i sgrung dpe dang dngosagater dang dgongasagater lasathon pa'i sgrub dpe'i rjod byed kyi tshig la khyad par chen po yod/ de yang ngag thog nasabargyud pa'i sgrung dpe'i rjod byed tshig gi khyad chosagatso bo ni mang tshogayokyi kha skad dang 'dres ma yin la/ go slab dang / khar bde ba/ da dung dmangasakhrod kyi kha bshad dang dpe 'jogagatam dpe/ glu shagasaltabu'i tshig sog4kyisagong 'og bar gsum du bcingasayod/ 'o na gter sgrung rigasakyi rjod byed tshig gi khyad chosagatso bo ci yin zhe na/ der rtsomapa po4bsam gzas nasabartsamasapa'i brtsamasachosakyi khyad chosayod la/ rjod byed kyi tshig kyang sum dag rtags gsum/ gyisakun nasabacingasa'adug par ma zad/ snyan ngag dang mngon brjod bkod pa'ang cung mang zhing / da dung tshig gi brjod stangasadang rtsom nyamasakyang〈gzhon nu zla med〉dang〈bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogasabarjod〉ltabur mardordo~Xpa'i cha'ang mang bar sems/ da dung brda rnying mang la tsheg bar

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /phung gi klong na bzhugs pa/ zhes bkod 'dug pa de dag mthong ma thag gling rje ge sar rgyal po mchog ni nag phyogs bdud sde 'joms mkhan gyi dpa' bo kho na tsam min par/ da dung zab mo chos kyi gzhung la dbang ma/nga 'a ba'i bla ma srid na dkon pa zhig yin pa'i gzugs ris de mig mdun du lhan nor shar thub byung / 'di lta ste'i chos tshig gis mi sna 'i gzugs brnyan zhib 'bri bgyis pa ma nga du mthong thub pas na/ 'di yang gter sgrung gi khyad du ma tshar ba'i rtags mtshan gco bo zhig yin pa sus kyang bston du ped/gnyis ni ngag thog nas brgyud de thon pa'i sgrung dpe dang dngosagater dang dgongs gter las thon pa'i sgrung dpe'i rjod byed kyi tshig la khyad par chen po yod/ de yang ngag thog nas brgyud pa'i sgrung dpe'i rjod byed tshig gi khyad chos gco bo ni ma nga tshogs kyi kha skad dang 'dres ma yi na la / go mab dang / khar bde ba/ da dung dmangs khrod kyi kha bshad dang dpe 'jogagatam dpe/ glu shags lta bu'i tshig sogs kyis gong 'og bar gsum du bcings yo da/ 'o na gter sgrung rigs kyi rjod byed tshig gi khyad chos gco bo ci yin zhe na/ der rtsom pa pos bsam/ gzas nas brtsam/sa pa'i brtsam sachos kyi khyad chos yod la/ rjod byed kyi tshig kyang sum/ dag rtags gsum/gyis kun nas bcings 'dug par ma zad/ snyan ngag dang ma/ngon brjod bkod pa'ang cung mang zhing / da dung tshig gi brjod stangs dang rtsom nyam sa kyang〈gzhon nu zla sked〉dang〈bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod〉lta bur mtshungs pa'i char pa pa mang bar sems/ da dung brda rnying mang la tsheg bar 10()

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/dam pa dang / tshig nyamasaldan la snyan zhing 'jebasapa/ yon tan can gyi blomig 'phrog pa'i nuyopa ldan pa zhig tu 'dug yin na'ang yige med pa'i nyan mkhan lamatshon na go khacung dka' moyin/ dper na/ (gling gi bro ra〉las/ shar 'dzumadakar gyi dung zla gang4la shar 'dra/ spyan ut+pal gyi bung ba 'phur lding ling ling / sodung phreng gi bu mo 'dzum mdangasashigasase/zhesadang / sku 'dzamagling seng chen bod la 'khrungs/ gsung glu yobarda mdzod yongasal khyab/ thug4chosadabyingasaskye med rig pa'i rtsal /zhe4pa/ gling che rgyud stag gi mche ba/ 'bring rgyud gzig gi thig le/ chung rgyud seng ge'i g.yuralarnams/ sku labade stong gi lusartsal rdzogasanas/gsung la dbyingasasnang brda yimagrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrolabs/ bsam don chosasu'agrub pa klu yigater mdzod brdol ba/ thugasal mkhyen cha ye shesakyi rang mdangasa'agagasamed 'od du 'char ba zhesapa ltabu sogasal brtags na rtsomapa po4brtsamasapa'i brtsamasacho4dang khyad par ma mchi4shing / snyan ngag gi dpe rgyan dang gzugasargyan la sbyar ba'i tshig4bcad kyang shin tu nyamayodaga' ba mang po mthong thub par ma zad/ da dung cung go dka' ba'i ming brda bde stong gi lusartsal/ mgrin pa'i rdza rnga/ yeshesakyi rang mdangasaltabu mang po yod pa lasagazhan/ gter mdzod brdol ba dang / 'gagasamed 'od du 'char/ rdza rnga 'khrol ltabu'i bya tshig gi sbyor stangasakyang gang sar bkod yod pa mthong thub/ 'di ni gter sgrung gi thun min gyi rjod byed tshig gi khyad chosa'abur du thon pa zhig yin no/ / 101

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/dam pa dang / tshig nyams ldan la snyan zhing 'jibs pa/ yon tan can gyi blo mig 'phrog pa'i nus pa ldan pa zhig tu 'dug yin na'ang a ge med pa'i nyan mkhan la ma tshor na go kha cung dka' mo yin/ dper na/ 〈gling gi bro ra〉las/ shar 'drem dkar gyi dung zla gangs la shar 'dra/ spyan ut+pal gyi bung ba 'phur lding ling ling / so dung phreng gi bu mo 'dzum mdangs shigs se/zhes dang / sku 'dzam gling seng chen bod la 'khrungs/ gsung glu a brda ma dzod yongs la khyab/ thugs chos dbyings bye sted rig pa'i rtsal /zhes pa/ gling che rgyud stag gi mche ba/ 'bring rgyud gzig gi thig le/ chung rgyud seng ge'i g.yur la rnams/ sku la bde stong gi lus rtsal rdzogs nas/gsung la dbyings snang brda a mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol bas/ bsam don chos su 'grub pa klu yog ter ma/dzod brdol ba/ thugs la mkhyen cha ye shes kyi rang mdangs 'gags med 'od du 'char ba zhes pa lta bu sogs la brtags na rtsom pa pos brtsam sa pa'i brtsams chos dang khyad par ma mchis shing / snyan ngag gi dpe rgyan dang gzugs rgyan la sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad kyang shin tu nyam sa dga' ba mang po mthong thub par ma zad/ da dung hrung go dka' ba'i ming brda bde stong gi lus rtsal/ mgrin pa'i rja rnga/ ye shes kyi rang mdangasalta bu mang po yod pa las gzhan/ gter mdzod brdol ba dang / 'gagasamed 'od du 'char/ rdza rnga 'khrol lta bu'i be+e tshig gi spyor stangs kyang gang sar bkod yod pa mthong thub/ 'di ni gter sgrung gi thun min gyi rjod byed tshig gi khyad chos 'bur du thon pa zhig yin no/ /101

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsum rig ter sgrung du sgrung rnying mang po las mthong dkon pa'i mi sna'i skyes rabs lo rgyus mang pogs ler brjod yod/ khyad par du gling gi dpa' rtul sum cu dang yang rtul dam pa'i ba bdun/ zhe rtul khra glag spyang gsum gyi skye khungs dang yab yum gyi mtshan/ a mdang bu phrug sogs kyi mtshan dab lo rgyus bsdus pa brjod 'dug pa shin tra rin thang ldan pa zhig lags/ dper na/ 〈sprug yo ldong gi rgyal rabs〉su/ dpa' 'gran med seng stag spri dom gyi skye khungs kyi lo rgyus bkod yong pa 'di lta ste/ de yang shing 'brug gi lor/ yab chen seng blon ka ma ri skyes kyi mchod khang dri ped chos mdzod kye mar khri'i steng du/ bya ga ru ṭa bsgo nga dang mtshungs pa'i dung sbubs shig smin no/ / der seng blon gyis skyong snyor yag po gnang bsan/cang ma 'gor bar de khags te nang du khye'u mdzes sdug lta bas chog mi shes pa zhig 'khrungs/ zhes dang / yang sga sde chos skyong ber nag ni sga stod dar gyi lha lung chos 'phel pad ma lha thang gi 'gram du sga mi 'gyur chos kyi dbang phyug dang 'bru bza' bsam gtan da pa la lhaganyis kyi sras sum 'khrungs/ mtshan la sga sde na chen ser por mnga' gsong / dgung lo bcu gnyis te shing rta lor 'ba' sangs rgyas 'tshor khyimathabs byed du bcug ste zhes bkod 'dug pa dang da dung 1nga gi yang rtul dam pa'i na bdun gyi lo rgyal stag rong sprin gzig 'phen gyi lo rgyus kyi skabs sa 'di ltar bkod 'dug ste/ gling bkra shis mgon yodang / yum gzig lcam gangs mtsho gnyis la shing mo stag gi lor grub chen ka cha'i rnam byor stag rong dpon po gzig 'phen 'khrungs/102

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsumanigater sgrung du sgrungarnyingamang polasamathong dkon pa'i misna'i skyesarabasalorgyusamang pogasaraler brjod yod/ khyad par du gling gi dpa'artulasumacu dang yang rtul dmapa'i mibadun/ zhe rtul khra glag spyang gsumagyi skyekhung4dang yab yumagyi mtshan/ chung mdang bu phrug sogasakyi mtshan dbalorgyusabasdu4ngabarjod 'dug pashinaturin thang ldan pa zhig lags/ dper na/ 〈smugapoldong gi rgyalarabs〉su/ dpa' 'gran med seng stag adomagyi skye khungasakyi lorgyusabakod yod pa 'di ltaste/ de yang shiba'abrug gi lor/ yabachenaseng blonaka mari skyesakyi mchod khang dri med chosamadzod kyi mchod khri'i steng du/ bya ga ru ṭa yisgo nga dang mtshungasapa'i dung sbubasashigasminano/ / der sebablon gyisaskyong snyor yag po gnang bsan/cang ma'agor bar de khagasate nang du khye'u mdzesasdug ltabasachog mi shesapa zhig 'khrungs/ zhesadang / yang sga sdechosaskyong ber nag ni sga stod dar gyi lhayung cho4'phelapad ma lhathang gi 'gramadu sgami 'gyur cho4kyi dbang phyug dang 'bru bza' bsamagatanadapalalhaganyisakyi srasasusku 'khrungs/ mtshan lasga sde michenaser por mnga' gsol/ dgubalobacu gnyisate shing rta lor 'ba' sang4rgyasa'atshor khyimathabasabyed du bcug stezhesabakod 'dug pa dngad dungagling gi yabartuladamapa'i mibadun gyi 5gyalastag rong anu gzig 'phen gyi lorgyusakyi skabasasu'adi ltar bkod 'dug ste/ gling bkra shisamagon podang / yumagazig lcamagangasamatsho gnyisal shing mo stag gi lodi ñtshabachenagaṅka'i rnamasprulastag rong dpon po gzig 'phen 'khrungs/

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/dgung lobacu gsumastechu stag lor 'brog bza' 'od lhakhabatubazhesanasasra4gnyisadang srasamogacig bltams/ zhesabasogasalabartagasan dngosaganasamisna mtshamasasbyor gyi thad du sngar med kyi phan 'brasagasar ba zhig smin yod/ rgyu mtshan ni de sngaspyitshog4thog khyabamyong ba'i sgrung dpobacu phrag mang po la4mi sna'i lorgyusagasalabor brjod yod pa'i sgrung dpogacig kyang mthong mamyong zhing / tha na ge sar rgyalapodang dpa' rtul sum cu'i skyesarabayo'abyung khungasagasalabor bkod yod pa'i sgrung dpoyang nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin dkon pasaso/ / galasrid gter sgrunga'adi dag lasabarjod pa'i mi sna'i lo rgyusadang lo tshigagasogasadag pa'i dbang du btang na/ gling sgrung zhib 'jug thad kyi dka' gnad minyung bzhig sel bar dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha gal chen 'don sprod gnang yod pa zhig red do/ / 'di yang gter sgrung gi ngo mtshar ldan pa'i grub 'brasashig yin par snyam/bzhi ni gter sgrung rigasakyi sgrung gi glu tshig thog ma'agug pa'i 'gug rta la yang ngag thog tubargyud yong ba'i sgrung dpe'i glu tshig gi 'gug lugasadang khyad par che/ dper na/ gling sgrung(hor gling g.yula'agyed〉lamatshon na/ glu tshig yod do cog gi mgo'i 'gug rta la/ glu alalapo.alalen/ /glu tha lalamo tha lalen/ / zhesabakod yod pa dang / glu re re'i mjug tu/glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi yin/ / mgo glu la'abrelab med / / cesabakod yod mod/ 'on te gter sgrung rigasakyi glu tshig gi 'gug rta de 'dra min zhing /glu re re'i mjug tu yang gcig gyur gyi rjod tshigamed/ dper na/ (༵༵ gi

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/dgung lo bcu gsum ste chu stag lor 'brog bza' 'od lha khabs bzhes nasasras gnyis dang sras mo gcig bltams/ zhes bsogs la brtags na dngosaganas mi sna mtshams sbyor gyi thad du sngar med kyi phan 'bras gsar ba zhig smin yod/ rgyu mas+dzawī ni de lnga spyi tshogs thog khyab myong ba'i sgrung dpe bcu phrag mang po las mi sna'i lo rgyus gas bor brjod yod pa'i sgrung dpe gcig kyang mthong ma myong zhing / tha na ge sar rgyal po dang dpa' rtul sum cu'i byesarabs 'byung khungs gas bor bkod yod pa'i sgrung dpe yang nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin dkon pas so/ / gal srid gter sgrung 'di dag las brjod pa'i mi sna'i lo rgyus dang lo gas sogs dag pa'i dbang du btang na/ gling sgrung zhib 'jug thad kyi dka' gnad mi nyung ba zhig sol bar dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha gal chen 'don sprod gnang yod pa zhig red do/ / 'di yang gter sgrung gi ngo mtshar ldan pa'i grub 'bras shig yin par snyam/bzhi be+e gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung gi glu chib thog ma 'gug pa'i 'gug rta la yang ngag thog tu brgyud yong ba'i sgrung dpe'i glu tshib gi 'gug lugasadang ga par che/ dper na/ gling sgrung〈hor gling gtso 'byed〉lam ra na/ glu tshig yod do cog gi mgo'i 'gug rta la/ glu al la yog la len/ /glu tha la la mo tha la len/ / zhes bkod yong pa dang / glu re re'i mjug tu/glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtse yin/ / mgo glu la 'brel ba med / / ces bkod yod mod/ 'on te gter sgrung rigs kyi glu grub gi 'gug rta de 'dra min zhing /glu re re'i mjug tu yang gcig gyur gyi rjod tshig med/ dper na/ 〈gling gi 103

gcodapa don grub dang snying bo tshe ringagiched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bro ra〉las/ ochosamachog maṇi pad+me hūṃ/ / bka' yang dag chosal gsol ba 'debs/ / ltabu dang / glu ha la ha la ha la red/ / ma tha la glu yilen lugasal/ / ltabu/ e.alam dang mkha' 'gro'i brda/ / glu dkar modrug 'gyur bka' yigasung / / ltabu stesku'i 'gug rta gcig gyur min pa dang glu re re'i mgo'i 'gug lugasakyi nang don kyang sosoyin/ glu mjug sdud pa'i skabayosu'ang gcig gyur gyi tshig bkod med cing / de yang sku nor bu dgra 'dul thugasal zhu ltabu dang / sgrothe tshom ma byed skal ldan rnam/sa/ / semasamagayengasadal cig mnyamapar zhog / cesapa ltabu bkod na4gang lagang mkho'i tshig don sbyar ba ma gtogasagacig gyur gyi mjug tshig brjod med/〈dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉lasakyang glu tshig re re'i mgo'i 'gug rtar glu al dang tha la zhe4pa gcig kyang bkod med cing / thad gar du don gyi 'go bzung nasabarjod pa'i dpe chagasayod/ mjug sdud pa'i dusasu'ang thadagar brjod don gyi dgosamakho ltar mjug bsdusapam gtogasagacig gyur gyi tshig gi4bcingasamed/ 'di yang gter sgrung rig4kyi sgrung dpe'i khyad chosashig yin par snyamamo/ /bdun pa/ mjug mtha'i gtam/da lngargyal khab phyi nang gi zhib 'jug pa bgresagazhon rnam sakyisagater sgrung gi bshad tshulami'adra ba'i rig4la zhib 'jug gi dpyad rtsom 'ga' re brisayod kyang tshan rig gi ltab dang mthun pa'i sdom tshig rnam dag cikā nā lta'i bar 'jog thub med/ khobo'i bsam par gter sgrung rigasakyi

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bro ra〉las/ a chos mchog ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ /bka' yang dag chos la gso ba 'debs/ /lta bu dang / glu ha la ha la ha la red/ /ma tha la glu a len lugs la/ /lta bu/ e spril ma dang mkha' 'gro'i brda/ /glu dkar mo drug 'gyur bka' na gsung / /lta bu ste glu'i 'gug rta gcig gyur min pa dang glu re re'i mgo'i 'gug lugs kyi nang don kyang so so yin/ glu ma jug sdud pa'i skabs su'ang gcig gyur zu tshig bkod ped cing / de yang sku nor bu dgra 'dul thugs la zhu lta bu dang / blo za tshom ma byed skal ldan rnam/sa/ /sem/sam g.yengs dal cig mnyam par zhog /ces pa lta bu bkod nas gang la gang mkho'i tshig don sbyar ba ma gtogs gcig gyur gyi ma/jug tshig brjod med/〈dmyal gleng mun pa rang gsal〉las kyang glu tshig re re'i mgo'i 'gug rtar glu spril dang tha la zhes pa gcig kyang bkod med cing / thad gar du don gyi 'go bzung nas brjod pa'i dpe kyigs yod/ mjug sdud pa'i dus 4'angathad gar brjod don gyi dgos mkho ltar mjug bsdus pa ma gtogs gcig gyur gyi tshig gis bcings med/ 'di yang gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung dpe'i khyad chos shig yin par snyam mo/ /bdun pa/ mjug mtha'i gtam/da lta rgyal khab phyi nang gi zhib 'jug pa bgres gzhon rnam/sa kyisagater sgrung gi bshad tshal mi 'dra ba'i rigs la zhib 'jug gi da khyad rtsom 'ga' re bris yod kyang tshan rig gi ltab dang mthun pa'i sdo ma tshig rnam dag cig da lta' bar 'jog thub med/ kho bo'i bsam/ par gter sgrung rigs kyi 104

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/gsang ba de dag gnasaskabasatsam gyisa'abyed mthub na yang snang med du gtan nasa'ajog mirung / ci'i phyir zhe na/ da ltosngon byon skyesabu dayopa dag giyogater lasabaton pa'i sgrung dpe mi nyung ba grangasaka brtsi rgyu yod pa lasagazhan tun hong yig tshang nasathon pa'i gter yig de dag lasakyang ge sar rgyal po'i lo rgyusadang sgrung yig skor ragasatsam du gleng yod pa dang / da dung gna' deng gnyiyokyi gter sgrung rigasakyi sgrung parnamasakyisa'abri she4pa'i sgrung dpe brgya phrag lhag la son yod cing / da ltadangos subrisayod pa'i sgrungadape yang nyi shu lhag la bud yod/ de dag 'a sa〈spug po ldong gi rgyal rabs〉dang〈rgya gar chos rdzong〉〈gling gi bro ra〉〈dmyal gling rdzogasapa chen po〉〈dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉sog4legasasgrig par skrun bgyisa'adug pa mig gisamathong rgyu yod pa dang / de min gter sgrung rigasakyi sgrung pa rnamasal yang kyag kyog che ba'i brgyud rim dang / ngo mtshar ldan pa'i khyad chos/ sgrung par gyur pa'i rgyu rkyen/ zlog pa med pa'i dad 'dun/ lung gisazin pa'i brda yig dang bca4pa gzhan dang mimathun pa'i khyad mtshar mang po yod par mazad/ brisan thog4pa med pa dang bshad na rdzogasargyu med par gragasapasan/ nged cag gisamathong chenabyasate sdug ru4kyisazhiba'ajug bgyid pa mgatogasachosalugasarmongasadad dang semasagatso smra ba'i grasasubacug na4gzhan du 'phen mirung snyam/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang da lta'i gnasaskabasatsam la 'grel ba dka' na'ang 'dzam gling yongasakyi tshan rig dar rgyasayong ba dang zhib 'jug pa'i chu tshad mtho ru gyur pa'i skabasathig la1 ༵ṭ+wāṃr

gter sgrung rigs kyi ge sar sgrung pa'i skor la dpyad pa/gsang ba de dag gnas skabs tsam gyis 'byed ma thub na yang snang med du gtan nas 'jog mi rung / ci'i phyir zhe na/ da lta sngon byon byes6 dam pa dag gis gter las bton pa'i sgrung dpe mi nyung ba grangs ka brtsi rgyu yod pa las gzhan tun hong yig tshang nas thon pa'i gter yig de dag las kyang ge sar rgyal po'i lo rgyus dang sgrung yig skor rags tsam du gleng yod pa dang / da dung gna' deng gnyis kyi gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung pa rnams kyis 'bri shesapa'i sgrung dpe brgya phrag lhag la son yod cing / da lta dngos sa bris yod pa'i sgrung dpe yang nyi shu lhag la bud yod/ de dag la sa〈smug po ldo nga gi rgyal rabs〉dang〈rgya gar chos rdzong〉〈gling gi bro ra〉〈dmyal gling rdzogs pa chen po〉〈dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉sogs legs sgrig par skrun bgyisa'adug pa mig gis mthong rgyu yod pa dang / de min gter sgrung rigs kyi sgrung pa rnams la yang kyag kyog che ba'i brgyud rim dang / ngo mtshar ldan pa'i khyad chos/ sgrung par gyur pa'i rgyu byen/ zlog pa sked pa'i dad 'dun/ lung gisazin pa'i brda yig dang bcas pa gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i khyad mtshar mang po yod par ma zad/ bris na thogs pa med pa dang bshad na rdzogs rgyu med par grags pas na/ nged cag gis mthong chen byas te sdug rus kyis zhib 'jug bgyid pa ma gtogs chos lugs rmongs dad dang sems gco smra ba'i grasasabacug nas gzhan du 'phen mi rung snyam/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang da lta'i gnasaskabs tsam la 'grel ba dka' na'ang 'dzam gling yongs kyi tshan rig dar rgyasayong ba dang zhib 'jug pa'i chu tshad mtho ru gyur pa'i skabs cig la gter 105

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched stom phyogs bsgrigs/sgrung gi gsang rgya 'di rnam par grol thub pa'i yid ches brtan po mchisaso/ /zur lha'i yig cha/1(gu bkra'i chos 'byung〉krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang nas par sgrun byas/2(mdo smad chos 'byung〉kan su ku mi rigs dpe dzin khang nas par skrun byas /3 song 'brug stag rtse pho brang gi lo sgros〉bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas par skrun byas/4(gling ge sar sgrung gi tshig rgyan nor bu'i bang mdzod〉mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par skrun byas/5 rgyal spyi'i bod kyi rig gzhung gros tshogs zengs dgu ba'i dpyad com gnadabasdus phyogs bsgrigs〉6(gling sgrung la thog ma'i dpad pa〉mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe sgrun khang nas par skrun byas/7(smug po ldong gi rgyal rabs〉mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par skrunabyas/8(dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe sgrun khang nas par sgrun byas/9〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par sgrun byas/10〈gling gi bro ra yid 'phrog pad dkar steng mdzes〉mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par skrun byas/106

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ṭ+wāṃng gi gsang rgya 'di rnamapar grolathub pa'i yid chesabartan po mchisazuralta~X/shi ba dī/'i chos 'byung〉krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe sgrun khang nas paraskrun 2ṭ+wāṃ~Xdo/ smad chos 'byung〉kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par skrun byas/3(seng 'brug stag rtse pho brang gi lo rgyus〉bod ljongs mi dmangasadape sgrun khang 4/zlo ༷ r+sha ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃX /gi tshig rgyan nor bu'i bang mdzod〉mi rigs dpeskrunakhang 5/༵༵ ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ / ṭ+wāṃ /rig gzhung gros tshogs thengs dgu ba'i dpyadartsom gnad 6༵ṭ+wāṃX ṭ+wāṃX ༵ dīsdi /sdu dpyad pa〉mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par 7ṭ+wāṃ/rte naṭ+wāṃ ldo/ nga gi rgyal rabs〉mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par skrun 8ṭ+wāṃrdomya/la gling mun pa rang gsal〉mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nasapar 9ṭ+wāṃbhe/ drong/ g.yul 'gyed〉mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nasaparaspunabyas/10(gling gi bro ra yid 'phrog pad dkar phreng mdzes〉mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe 106 spun khang nas par skrun byas/
ra che long tsam dpyad /kod yod/
rnga long tsam dpyad pa krung go'i bod rig pa 〉 zhes

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gling sgrung〈dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉gyi sgru rtsal khyad chos skor gleng ba/mig sngar rgyusalon byung bltar na ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung lasgrung sna mi'adra ba nyisabargya lhag yod padang / der zhib 'jug bgyid mkhan gyi ched lasamakhasapa'ang char rjesasha pobardol ba bzhin 'tshar longasabyung dang 'byung bzhin mchi4shing / gruba'abrasakyang mi dman pa blangasa'adug kho bor mtshon na chung dusan4ge sar sgrung la dga' zhen che ba'i dbang gisasgrung dpe mi 'dra ba mang po mjal ba'i go skabs byung myong mod/ 'on kyang dran pa'i snang ngor bag chagasachesazab pa ni〈dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉zhesapa'i sgrung dpe 'di nyid lags pas/ 'dir sgrung dpe de bklagasapa'i myong tshor 'ga' brjod par bya'o/ /dang po/ brjod bya'i don gyi skor/sgrung dpe(dmyalagling mun parang gsal〉la bsdomasapasale'u bsumayod de/ le'u dang po ni/ ge sar rgyal po rgya yiyuladu phebs/ / astag lhamor 'chi bdag zhagasapasathebs/ / 'jigasarung gshin rje rgyal podi ༵dun drung du/ / nyamasathag ngang la dmyal ba'i rting rdor lhung / /

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshal 〈〈 zung /〉rjo—glang grung dmyal glang mun pa rang gsal gru sgyu rtsal khyad chos sgor gleng ba/mig sngar rgyus lon byung ba ltar na ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung la sgrung sna mi 'dra ba nyis brgya lhag yod pa dang / der zhib 'jug bgyid mkhan gyi ra las mkhas pa'ang char rjes sha mo brdol ba bzhin 'tshar longs byung dang 'byung bzhin mchis shing / grub 'bras kyang mi dman pa blangs 'dug kho bor mar na go dus nas ge sar sgrung la dga' zhen che ba'i dbang gisasgrung dpe mi 'dra ba mang po mjal ba'i go skabs byung myong mo da/ 'on kyang dran pa'i snang ngor bag chags ches zab pa ni〈dmyal 1nga nu na pa rang g.yi〉zhes pa'i sgrung dpe 'di nyid lags pas/ 'dir sgrung dpe de bklags pa'i myong tshor 'ga' brjod par bya'o/ /dang po/ brjod bya'i don gyi skor/sgrung dpe〈dmyal gling mun pa rang g.yi〉la bsdoms pas le'u bsum yod de/ le'u dang po ni/ ge sar rgyal po rgya a yul du phebs/ /a stag lha mor 'chi bdag zhags pas jebs/ /'jigs rung gshin rje rgyal po'i mdun drung du/ / nyams thag ngang la dmyal ba'i rting rdor lhung / /108

〈dmyal gleng mun pa rang gsal〉ju sgyu rtsal khyad chos skor/zhes pa dang / le'u gnyis pa/ ge sar rgyal po dmyal ba'i gnas sakhyon/ / 'jigs rung gshin rje chos rgyal khri las bslangs/ / spristag lhamong sdeg sgrib sbyang ba'i ched/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rten gsum stong rtsa bzhengs/ / zhes dang / le'u gsum pa/ ge sar rgyal pos spristag lha mo dang / / bgrang yas shi bo dung phyur bco brgyad la/ / tsha grang dmyal ba'i rnam smin ngo sprad nas/ /nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing du drangs/ /zhesapa bcas yin la/ sgrung dpe'i brjod bya'i don gyi snying bo mdor bsdus na/de yang yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po khong rgya nag po'i yul kham/sa thams cad chos la 'god par 'gro dgos dgongs te bzhugs pa'i skabs su/ a stag lha mos 'di skad zhus pa/ da lan khyod phebs sar nga yang 'khrid par zhu zhusapas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ da res khyod 'gro mi nyan/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa zer ba de thog babs tshul du yong bas/ nam 'che la nges pa ped/ sngar byas la 'khyod bshags byas te sdod dgos gsungs te khong nyid rgya nag po'i yu' khams chos la 'god par phebs so/ /de nas zla ba gsum tsam 'gor ba'i che/ a stag lha mor na tsha bzod glags med pa byung ste/ sman dpyad dang khru rim sogs kyis bzlog ma nus par shi nas srid pa bar do'i 'jigs skrag rim bzhin shar nas bdun bdun bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i mtshams g.yul phyogs dang sa thag ji ring la song nas/ sa cha med kyi ma shi gson bye ma'i la khar slebs so/ / de'i skabs su gshin rje chos kyi rgyal pos ma gyogs pa'i las ma khan sbu lnga la glu 'di blangs so/ /gnas bdud 'joms 'bar ba'i 109

dmyal gling mun pa rang gsalagyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos skor/zheyopadang / le'u gnyi4pa/ ge sar rgyal po dmyal ba'i gnasasubyon/ /'jig4rung gshin rje chosargyal khri lasabaslangs/ /astag lhamore sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i ched/ /sku gsung thugasakyi rten gsum stong rtsa bzhengs/ /zhesadang / le'u gsum pa/ ge sar rgyal po4astag lhamo dang / /bgrang ya4shi bo dung phyur bco brgyad la/ /tsha grang dmyal ba'i rnam smin ngo sprad nas/ /nub phyog4bde ba can gyi zhing du drangs/ /zhesapabacayoyin la/ sgrung dpe'i brjod bya'i don gyi snying bo mdor bsdusan/de yang yid bzhin dbang gi rgyalapo khong rgya nag po'i yulakham/sathamasacad chosala'agod par 'gro dgosadagongasate bzhug4pa'i skabasasu/ astag lhamo4'di skad zhusapa/ da lan khyod phebasasar nga yang 'khrid par zhu zhusapas/ rgyal po'i zhalanas/ da resakhyod 'gro minyan/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa zer ba de thog babasatshul du yong bas/ nam 'chi lange4pa med/ sngar byasal 'gyod bshagasabyasate sdod dgosagasungasate khong nyid rgya nag po'i yul khamasachosala'agod par phebasaso/ /de nasazlab gsuyotsam 'gor ba'i tshe/ astag lhamor na tsha bzod glag4med pa byung ste/ sman dpyad dang sku rim sog4kyi4bzlog mnasapar shi nasasrid pa bar do'i 'jigasaskrag rim bzhin shar na4bdun bdun bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i mtsham4suyul phyogasadang sathag je ring lasong nas/ 4cha med kyi ma shi gson bye ma'i lakhar slebasaso/ /de'i skabasasugashin rje choyokyi rgyalaposamagyogasapa'i lasamakhan sku lnga laglu 'di blang4so/ /gan4bdud 'jomasa'aba~X ༵'i

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gichedartsomaphyogasabasgrigs/ / dur khrod nas/ / lhayidamardo rje 'jig4byed mkhyen/ / tshur nyon dbamagyogasapa'i lasamakhan lnga/ / nga mdang sumanyal ba'i rmi laman/ / midamar po 'od kyisakhyabapa rmis/ / yang min na de ring chosacan zhig / sku byin rlabasacan zhigapheb4rgyu red/ / yang min na de ring sdig can zhig/semasazhe sdang can zhig thon rgyu red/ / khyod mgyogasapa'i lasamakhan sku lnga pos/ / mashi gson bye ma'i la khan/ / mici 'dra zhig yod lto4la shog /cesagasungasapa na/ mgyogasapa'i lasamakhan sku lngam shi gson bye ma'i lakhar song na4bltasatshe/ bud med gzhan dang mi'adra ba zhig 'dug pa skad cig tsam la chosakyi rgyal po'i mdun du khrid pa na/ astag lhamo'i bsam par gshin rje chosargyal la rdzun dang g.yosgyu byasachog snyam nasamago skor btang yang / cho4kyi rgyal posa.astag lhamo'i phrag g.yasagayon layorde'u dkar po dang nag po gnyisablangasate/ gshin rje'i me long la bltas/ gshin rje'i rgya mar tshad/ khrimasayig lusal bskor/ dge sdig gi rgya malan grangasabaco brgyad du yang yang tshad kyang sdig pa'i phyogasasulhung bas/ mo rang mig maba~X ma/ rngomasabaskor te lamanag po thag pa 'dra ba zhig gi nang mar khrid nas t+na rje sa/ yi/da bzhin dbang gi rgyalapo khong gisargya nag ri bo rtse lnga ru mi'abumaphrag mang po'i blokhachosalabasgyur rjesaphyir khra pogling laphebasapa dang /astag lhamo'adasapa shesarjes/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang skad cig la dmyal kha~Xsubyon te ki lan gsumabatabapas/ bzhengasam myong ba'i chosargyal

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dur khrod nas/ / lhan dam rdo rje 'jigs byed ma/khyen/ / tshur nyon dang mgyogs pa'i las mkhan lnga/ / nga mdang sumanyal ba'i dri lam na/ / skedamar po 'od kyis khyab pa rmis/ / yang min na de ring chos can zhig / sku byin rlabs can zhig phebs rgyu red/ / yang min na de ring sdeg can zhig/sems zhe sdang can zhig thon rgyu red/ / khyod mas gas pa'i las mkhan sku lnga pos/ / ma shi gson bye ma'i la khan/ / mi ci 'dra zhig yod ltos la shog /ces gsungs pa na/ mgyogs pa'i las mkhan khru lnga ma shi gson bye ma'i la khar song nas bltas tshe/ bud med gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa skad cig tsam la chos kyi rgyal po'i mdun du khyed pa na/ a stag lha mo'i bsam par gshin rje chos rgyal la rdzun dang g.yo sgyu byas chog snyam nas mgo skor btang yang / chos kyi rgyal pos a stag lha mo'i phrag g.yas g.yon las rde'u dkar po dang nag po gnyis blangs te/ gshin rje'i me long la bltas/ gshin rje'i rgya mar tshad/ khrims yig lus la bskor/ dge sdeg gi rgya ma lan grangs bco brgyad du yang yang tshad kyang sdig pa'i phyogs sa lhung bas/ mo rang mig mtha' mchi mas bskor te la yon ga po thag pa 'dra ba zhig gi nang ma/ra khrid nas song ngo / /de nas yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po khong gis rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga du mi 'bum phrag mang po'i zo kha chos la bsgyur rjes phyir khra mo gling la phebs pa dang /a stag lha mo 'das pa shes rjes/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang skad cig la dmyal khams sa byon te ki lan gsum btab pas/ bzhengs ma myong ba'i chos rgyal 110

(dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉gyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos skor/khrithog la4bzhengasapa dang brosamamyong ba'i lasamakhan phyogasabazhir bros/gshinarjechosargyal dang ge sar rgyalapo gnyisakyisabaka' gsung shagasa'adebayomadzad cing / astag lhamo'i sdig sgriba'adag ched sku gsung thugasakyi rten gsumastong rtsa bzhengasate/ astag lhamogatso bya4pa'i shi bo dung phyur bco brgyad la tsha grang dmyalaba'i rnamasmin ngo sprad nayonub phyog4bde ba can gyi zhing du drangasapabacasaso/ /gong du ragasabasdugasungo sprod bya4pa 'di lasasgrung dpe 'di'i dgo4pa dang nying dgos/ gtamargyud kyi byung 'phel/ misnabakod sgrigakhorayug zhib 'bri sogasartogasathubapar lozad/ da dung gling rje ge sar mchog 'gro drug 'dren pa'i blam dang / gnyomachung skyong ba'i pha ma/ 'gro don gyi lasal byam4snying rje che ba'i skyesabu khyad 'phag4can zhig yin pa dang / rang gi dga' malabartse dung mtsho lasazab pa sog4sgrung dpe'i mgo mjug bar gsumalasashesathubacing / khyad par du deng gi dusa'adir bod rig4sakhuladu char rjesasha mobardolababazhin 'tshar longasa'abyung bzhin pa'i slob grwa chung 'bring gi slob mdang mdo dbusakhamasagasum/ gyi rgya che'i rong 'brog mang tshogs/ shesayon can/ la4byed pa dang lasabazo ba spyi tshog4steng gi na chung gzhon nu thamasacad kyi blosno 'byed pa'i gser gyi lde mig ltabur 'gyur thub pa gor mchag la/ rgyu mtshan ni go bde zhing kha gsal ba/ mi snazhib 'bri lasgyu rtsalagyi nusashugasaldan pa/ tshig sbyor bde ba bcasakyi khyad cho4midaman pa mchisapasaso/ / 111

dmyal gling mun pa rang gas la 〉 gyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos skor/khri thog las bzhengs pa dang bros ma myong ba'i las mkhan phyogs bzhir bros/gshin rje chos rgyal dang ge sar rgyal po gnyis kyis bka' gsung shagasa'adebs mdzad cing / a stag lha mo re sdeg sgrib 'dag byed sku gsung thugasakyi rten gsum stong rtsa bzhengs te/ spristag lha po gtso byas pa'i shi bo dung phyur bco brgyad la tsha grang dmyal ba'i rnam smin ngo sprad nas nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing du drangs pa bcas so/ /gong du rags bsdus sa ngo sprod byas pa 'di las sgrung dpe 'di'i dgos pa dang nying dgos/ gtam rgyud kye byung 'phel/ bsna bkod sgrigakhor yug zhib 'bri sogs rtogs thub par ma zad/ da dung gling rje ge sar ma/chog 'gro drug 'dren pa'i bla ma dang / gnyom chung skyong ba'i pha ma/ 'gro don gyi las la khyams snying rje che ba'i skyes bu khyad 'phags can zhig yin pa dang / rang gi dga' ma la brtse dung mtsho las zab pa sogs sgrung dpe'i mgo mjug bar gsum las shes thub cing / byed par du deng gi dus 'dir bod rigs sa khul du char rjes sha po brdol ba bzhin 'tshar longs 'byung bzhin pa'i slob grwa chung 'bring gi slob ma dang mdo dbus khams gsum gyi rgya zad rong 'brog mang tshogs/ shes yon can/ las byed pa dang las bzo ba spyi tshogs steng gi na chung gzhon nu thams cad kyi blo sgo 'byed pa'i gser gyi lde mig lta bur 'gyur thub pa gor mchag la/ rgyu mtshan be+e go bde zhing kha gsal ba/ mi sna zhib 'bri la sgyu rtsal byu nus shugs ldan pa/ tshig spyor bde ba bcas kyi khyad chos chad man pa mchis pas so/ /1

gcod pa donagrub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ / gnyis pa/ mi sna zhib 'bri'i skor/spyir gtam rgyud cig yin phyin mi sna'i gzug4brnyan gsar bzhengasalegasapo zhig bya rgyu ni rmang gzhi yin/ gal te sgrung gtam nang gi mi ni zhiga'abri bgyisapa'i gzugasabarnyan ji ltar leg4na rtsomarig gi yid 'gug rang bzhin de ltar legasapa dang / rtsomarig sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang kyang de bsaje mthor 'gro ngesayin/ de yang〈dmyalagling mun pa rang gsal〉zhesapa'i sgrung dpe'i nang misna zhib 'bri byasapa 'bur du thon par ma zad/ mi sna'i phyi tshul dang nang semayokyi kun slong zhib 'bri bgyid pa gtsigasachen du bzung yod pas/ mi sna re re'i 'dod blo dang gshisargyud/ rang rang gi khor yug bca4gcig mtshungasamin pa'i khyad chosasna tshogasagasalabor mtshon yod/dper na/ mi snagatso bo gling rje ge sar mchog la mtshon na/ nyi ma de'i skabasasusong chen nor bu dgra 'dulakhong gisadabu rmog dkar 'ja' risakhyugasase/ sked shā spyor gsum gra mig 5le/ rgyab khrab dkar me stag 'tshubasase/ zhal maṇi mgur dbyangasalhang nge ltabu'am mismug po dung gi sosgo can/ yang smug byu ru'i sha mdangasacan/ g.yasastag ralaganam du 'phyo 'dra/ g.yon gzig shubasasal 'dzul 'dra/ rta rkyang dmar mtshal gyi thig le can/ gser sga nyi ma rang shar/ bu dpa' bo jag la chayo'adra zhesabrisa'adug pa las/ ge sar rgyal ponyid kyi skye gzugasarab tu mchog cing / shi dmyal bar byon na'ang luyolakhrab rmog dang phyag tumada' gzhu thogasapa/bu tā~X' bo jag lacha4pa 'dra ba'i ngang tshuladesaklog pa po kun gyi mig lam

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis pa/ mi sna zhib 'bri'i skor/spyir gtam rgyud cig yin phyin be+e sna 'i gzugs brnyan gsar bzhengasalegs po zhig be+e rgyu ni rmang gzhi yin/ gal te sgrung gtam nang gi mi sna zhib 'bri bgyis pa'i gzugs brnyan ji ltar legs na rtsom rig gi yid 'gug rang bzhin de ltar legs pa dang / rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang kyang de bas ji mthor 'gro nges yin/ de yang〈dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉zhes pa'i sgrung dpe'i nang mi sna zhib 'bri byas pa 'bur du thon par ma/ zad/ mi sna 'i phyi tshul dang nang sem sa kyi kun slong zhib 'bri bgyid pa gtsigs chen du bzung rngo da pas/ mi sna re re'i 'dod blo dang gshis rgyud/ rang rang gi khor yug bcas gcig mtshungs min pa'i khyad chos sna tshogs gsal bor ma/tshon yod/dper na/ mi sna gtso bo 1nga rje ge sar ma/chog la mtshon na/ nyi ma de'i skabs sa seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul khong gis dbu rmog dkar 'ja' risakhyugs se/ sked 'khor gsum gra mig ngo le/ rgyab khrab dkar me stag 'tshubs se/ zhal ma ṇi mgur dbyangs lhang nge lta bu'am mi smug po dung gi sosgo can/ yang smug byu ru'i sha mdangs can/ g.yas stag ral gnam du 'phyo 'dra/ g.yon gzig shubs sal 'dzul 'dra/ rta khyong dmar mtshal gyi thig le can/ gser sga nyi ma rang shar/ bu dpa' bo jag la chas 'dra zhes brisa'adug pa las/ ge sar rgyal po nyid kyi skye gzugs rab tu mchog cing / shi dmyal bar byon na'ang lus la khrab rmog dang phyag tu mda' gzhu thogs pa/bu dpa' bo jag la chas pa 'dra ba'i ngang tshul des klog pa po kun gyi mig lam 112

(dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉gyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos skor/du gson/ma/4ṭ+wāṃn la/ dad pa'i spu long rgyasapa'i gzugs brnyan lhang nge bzhig nibherdo s+thā ༵/4rgya/ la de yang zhiba'abri bgyisapa ha cang ngo mtshar zhing yid 'gug nus pa ldan pa zhig ste/ gzugasabarnyan de bklags tsam gyisalusakyi ba spu dbang med du g.yoba'i snang ba bco4min du ster/ dper na/seng ge chen po brgyad kyisabategasapa'i khri steng na/ gshinarje chosakyi rgyal po de nyid skra kham nag gi ralapa rgyab tu khebasanas/ spyan nyi zla ltar 'khor zhing bzhugs la/ gsung g.yu 'brug bzhin du ngar skad sgrog pa/ ljags glog dmar bzhin du 'khyug cing sgril ba/ rkan sgrasagangasari snyilab/ zhab4sal brdabayon rdza ri snyilab/ sagazhi thamasacad 'gulashig shig ljon shing thamayocad 'dar ldemaldem/ blta4pa tsam gyisatshe srog dang rnamashesayal ba bcayokyi snang brnyan zhig tu lhang nger bzhengasate/ kun gyi snang ngor gshin rje cho4rgyal zhe4med pa nasayod pa dang yod pa na4ha cang hang sang dgosapa hā/ t+t+waṃrtsomarig gi sgyu rtsal gyi lam na4gdosabacayokyi phung bo zhig tu bskrunā da~X ༷ /mo a/ stag lhamo nyid sgrung dpe 'di'i nang du zhib 'bri bgyisapa che4mang lachesa'abur du yang thon yod/ dper na/ chung mo logasum gyi gong rol nas/ / thang chen po'i dkyil lashing mda' 'phangs/ / bye'u ri bong rgumabu 'thu 'thu byas/ / ma 'di la yar thar gang na yod/ / lo bcu gsumakha la yar bud nas/ / skurgyab la'aphangasan4sdig pa bya~X1/3 /

〈dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉rgya sgyu rtsal khyad chos skor/dug son nyam a ldan la/ dad pa'i sru long rgyas pa'i gzugs brnyan lhang nge bzhig bzhengs so/ /gshin rje chos rgyal de yang zhib 'bri bgyis pa ha cang ngo mtshar zhing yed 'gug nus pa lda na pa zhig ste/ gzugs brnyan de bklags tsam/ gyisa'u sa kyi ba spu dbang med du g.yo ba'i snang ba bcos min du ster/ dper na/seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i khri steng na/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po de nyid skra kham nag gi ral pa rgyab tu khebs nas/ spyan nyi zla ltar 'khor zhing bzhugs 'a / gsung g.yu 'brug bzhin du ngar skad sgog pa/ ljags glog dmar bzhin du 'bug byung sgril ba/ rkan sgras gangs ri snyel ba/ zhabasasal brdabs na dza ri snyel ba/ sa gzhi tham/sa cad 'gul shig shig ljon shing thams cad 'dar ldem ldem/ bltas pa tsam gyis tshe sro ga dang rnam shes pa'i ba bcas kyi snang brnyan zhig tu lhang nger bzhengs te/ kun gyi snang ngor gshin rje chos/rgyal zhes med pa nas yod pa dang yod pa nas ha cang hang sang dgos pa zhig tu rtsom/ rig gi sgyu col 4 lam nas gdos bcas kyi phung bo zhig tu bskrun yod do/ /ma dpa' mo a stag lha cho/ nyid sgrung dpe 'di'i nang du zhib 'bri bgyis pa ches mang la ches 'bur du yang thon yod/ dper na/ chung mo lo gsum gyi gong rol nas/ / thang chen po'i dkyil la shing mda' 'phangs/ / bye'u ri bong rgum bu 'thu 'thu byas/ /ma 'di la yar thar gang na yod/ /lo bcu gsum kha la yar bud nas/ / skra rgyab la 'phangs nas sdig pa byas/ /113
