gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gichedartsomaphyogasabasgrigs/ —/ nangasasnga dro khra yag rdza lasong / / 'disalcagasagazhu bkug nasalcagayo/ mda' 'phangs/ / 'brong broser mabu dgu brgya bsad/ / mgo ru thur rga~X/ lethang la'aphangs/ / dgong phyi dro 'brong mobasad bsad nas/ / ri chenaXpokhrag gisadamar po byas/ / ma.astag lhamogar song na/ / bya rgod po'i gshog rtsa nyilalili/ / spyang dar mgazan rgyug tha ra ra/ / nyin gung nadamaragazhung lasong / / rkyang khadakar mabu dgu brgya bsad/ / na chenapo'ikhadogakhrag gisabasgyur/ / sabade mothamasacad sha yisabakang / /khug gshong gshong thamasacad khrag gisabakang / / dgong phyi dro rgya mtsho'i khal song / / lcagasakyu snatshogasaskad labaskor/ / nya sram mang po'i srogagazanabyas/ / chu rgya mtsho'i khadog khrag gisabasgyur/ / nag pobadud sdeskyong dusasu/ / phyi jag dngarkunama'i 'go pa byas/ / rgyab 'khor gsumakhrab rmog mnabasapa'i tshe/ / gza' khyab 'jug nag po khrosapa 'dra/ /sdang dgra bosarig na glo snyinga'adar/ / stag dar masarig na 'dzum drugayal/ / 'brongadar masarig na sngamapa'achor/ / rkyang dar mas rig nasgang labros/ / zhesapa ltabu sogasashin tumang yang yig tshog4che bar dogasanasa'abri yophod la/ 'di tsamagyisakyang yostag lhamo'adi nyid chung byisapa'i dusanasabazung sdig pa'i lasaladaga' ba zhig yin pas/ nyin gcigagi nang du'ang snga dro khra yag rdza lasong steri chen po khrag gisadamar po bya4tshul/ nyin gung na dmar gzhung lasong sten chen po'i kha dog khrag labasdi~X /sa/ dgong phyi dro rgya mtsho'i khalasong ste rgya mtsho'i khadog kyang khrag

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ sgyu mda~X 'a ༵ dī /yag/ dro ༵ shā rdo/ra /bye dgu brgya bsad / / bku/ dī go ru~Xsdo / ṭā khrag gi ༵dmar /po /༵/gong/ dī rdo bstag ༵ rlo gar song rte/ nas//bya rgo/ sdo pyo gshog rtsa nyil li li/ / spyang dar ma gzan rgyug tha ra ra/ / nyin gung nadamar gzhung la song / / rkyang kha dkar ma bu dgu brgya bsad/ / na chenapo'i kha dog khrag gis bsgyur/ / sa bde mo thams cad sha yis bkang / /khug gshong gshong thams cad khrag gis bkang / / dgong phyi dro rgya mtsho'i khal song / / lcags kyu sna tshogs sked la bskor/ / nya sram mang po'i srog gzan byas/ / chu rgya mtsho'i kha dog khrag gis bsgyur/ / nag po bdud sde skyong dus su/ / phyi jag dang rkun ma'i 'go pa byas/ / rgyab 'khor gsumakhrab rmog mnabs pa'i ma/ / gza' khyab 'jug nag po khros pa 'dra/ /sdang dgra bos rig na glo snyeng 'dar/ / stag dar mas rig na dzam drug yal/ / 'brong dar mas rig na lnga ma pa 'chor/ / rkyang dar mas rig na sgang la bros/ / zhes pa lta bu sogs shin tu mang yang yig tshogs che bar dogs nas 'bri ma phod la/ 'di tsam gyis kyang a stag lha mo 'di nyid chung byis pa'i dus nas bzung sdeg pa'i las la dga' ba zhig yin pas/ nyin gcig gi nang du'ang snga dro khra yag rdza la song ste ri chen po khrag gis dmar po byas tshul/ nyin gung na dmar gzhung la song ste na r+ṣa po'i kha dog khrag la bsgyur tshul/ dgong phyi dro rgya mtsho'i kha la song ste rgya mtsho'i kha dog kyang khrag 114

(dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉gyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos skor/gis bsgyur ba sogs long ba'i sdeg pa'i bya spyod yod tshad byu snang brnyan mtshon thub bo/ /spyir las mkhan la sdog phyogs mi sna zhes btags na mi 'os mod/skabs bab kyi dbang gis de ltar brjod dgos byung / las mkhan de dag zhib 'bri bgyis pa'ang brjid rngam che la/ pha rol po zil gyis gnon pa'i snang bzhig bcos min du ster thub/ dper na/ las mkhan stong phrag dgu brgya dgu bcus g.yas gral non pa/ las mkhan stong phrag dgus g.yon gral non pa/ las mkhan khri phrag dgus mdun gral bdar zhing / gre ring 'dzin pa'i las mkhan dgu brgya gri ring rno ngar sha le/ mda' gzhu 'dzin pa'i lasamakhan dgu brgya mda' mo rgod sgo 'tshubs se/ sog le 'dzin pa'i lasam khan dgu brgya sog le so kha hrig ge lcags thag 'dzin pa'i las mkhan dgu brgya lcags thag lcags sgog sha le/ zhags nag 'dzin pa'i las mkhan dgu brgya zhags nag a long khrig ge me sgogs thogs pa'i las mkhan dgu brgya me lce me stag 'tshubs se/ mdung ring thogs pa'i las mkhan dgu brgya mdung ring ba dan lhab se/ las mkhan bye ba mang po/ 'jigs pa'i ki sgra dang bsro sgra/ sod sod dang sgob sgob/ spyang mo ngu zug byed pa/ tsa gu mas 'dres pa/ lung gsum wa mo brgyal ba lta bur 'dug go zhes bris 'dug pa las/ bltas pa tsam gyis tshe srog dang rnam shes yal ba/ yul mig gisamathong na sems sdug pa bcas kyi tshor snang ster nus pa dang / yang chos kyi rgyal po'i g.yon phyogs nas las mkhan ab glang mgo can ni rwa rno ngar sha le/115

(dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉gyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos skor/giyobasgyura~Xsogasayong ba'i sdig pa'i bya spyod yod tshad kyi snang brnyanamatshonaṭ+wāṃ~X/sa/mkhan la ldog phyogasamisnazhesabatagasan mi 'osamod/skabayobabakyi dbang gisade ltar brjod dgosabyung / lasamakhan de dag zhinga'abri bgyisapa'ang brjid rngamache la/ pha rol po zilagyisaganon pa'i snang bzhig bco4min du ster thub/ dper na/ lasamakhan stong phrag dgu brgya dgu bcusagaya4gralanon pa/ lasamakhan stong phrag dgusagayon gral non pa/ lasamakhan khri phrag dgusamadun gralabadar zhing / gri ring 'dzin pa'i lasamakhan dgu brgya gri ring rno ngar sha le/ mda' gzhu 'dzin pa'i lasamakhan dgu brgya mda' mo rgod sgro 'tshubasase/ sog le'adzin pa'i lasamakhan dgu brgya sog lesokhahrig ge lcagasathag 'dzinapa'i lasamakhan dgu brgya lcagasathag lcagasasgrog sha le/ zhagasanag 'dzin pa'i lasamakhan dgu brgya zhagasanag along khrig ge me sbyog4thogasapa'i lasamakhan dgu brgya melce me stag 'tshubasase/ mdung ring thogasapa'i lasamakhanadagu brgya mdung ring ba dan lhabase/ lasamakhan bye ba mang po/ 'jigasapa'i ki sgra dang bswo sgra/ sod sod dang gyob gyob/ spyang yongu zug byed pa/ lugu yobu 'dresapa/ lung gsumawamobargyalab ltabur 'dug go zhesabrisa'adug palas/ bltasapa tsamagyisatshe srog dang rnamashesayal ba/ yulamig gisamathong na semasasdug pa bcasakyi tshor snang ster nusapa dang / yang cho4kyi rgyal po'i g.yon phyogasanasalasamakhan ab glang mgo canani rwa rno nga~X ṭ+wāṃ le/

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /lag na gshin rje'i rgya ma/ smug po'i ring tshad pho 'dom bco brgyad yo da pa/yang chos kyi rgyal po'i mdun gyi las mkhan seng ge rab brtan ral ba bsigasan gangs ri bzhu ba/ ngar skad bsgrags na sa gzhi 'gul ba/ rkan sgrabardabs na rdza ri nyil ba de yar langs zhes pa lta bu sogs ni gson nyamasalda na zhing / ngo mtshar ba/ yid 'gug gi nus pa che ba bcas skad cha' sgyu rtsal byu nang gi nying bcud las kyang nying bcud yin pas/ 'jig rten grags pa las ring du brgal te 'dzam 1nga bu ma 'a gtsug rgyan du gyur pa gor ma chag go/gsum pa/ rjod byed chig gi khyad chos sko ra/sgrung dpe〈dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉zhes pa 'di be+e chos lugasakyi 31ba gtsor bzung ste chos lugs dril sgo ga dang mi chos bslab bya phun sumatshogs pa'i glegs bam gal chen zhig yin/ spyir bshad tshal la/ ge sar rgyal pos byin gyis ma brlabs pa dang zhabs kyis ma bcags pa'i sa med cesapa ltar steng lha yul nas bar mi yul/ bar mi yul nas 'og klu yu la/ bar mi yul nas mar dmyal kham/sa bcas la bltas na/ mthong rgyu med pa'i gsang ba gog gyur gyi khor yu ga nges can mang por mi sna 'i snang brnyan zhib 'bri bgyis pa ha cang mtshar bar 'dug rtsom rig la mtshon na sgo 'dogasakyi byu rtsal snang brnyan la brten nas legs 'grub byung na sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang gom gang mdun spos kyis ji mthor gtong thub pa dang / sgrung dpe 'di'i gzhi khyon gyi cha nas bltas na'ang gtam rgyud kyi byung rim ltar mi sna gtso bo a 116

gcodapa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gichedartsomaphyogasabasgrigs/ —5lag na gshin rje'i rgya ma smug po'i ring tshad pho 'dom bco brgyad yod pa/yang chosakyi rgyal po'i mdun gyi lasamakhan seng ge rab brtan ral ba bsigasan gang4ri bzhu ba/ ngar skad bsgragayon sagazhi 'gul ba/ rkan sgobardabs na rdza ri nyil ba de yar langasazhesapa ltabu sogasani gson nyamasaldan zhing / ngo mtshar ba/ yid 'gug gi nusapa che ba bca4skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi nang gi nying bcud lasakyang nying bcud yin pas/ 'jig rtenagragayodi lasaring du brgal te 'dzam gling bu mo'i gtsug rgyan du gyur pa gor ma chag //sum pa/ rjod byed chig gi khyad chos skor/sgrung dpe〈dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉zhesapa 'di ni cho4lugasakyi ltab gtsor bzung ste chos lugasadril sgrog dang mi chos bslab bya phun sumatshogasapa'i glegasabamagal chen zhig yin/ spyir bshad tshul la/ ge sar rgyal posabyin gyisam brlabasapa dang zhabasakyi4ma bcagasapa'i samed cesapa ltar steng lhayulanasabar mi yul/ bar mi yul nasa'og klu yu la/ bar miyul nasamar dmyal khamasabacasal bltasan/ mthong rgyu med pa'i gsang ba skog gyur gyi khor yug ngesacan mang por mi sna'i snang brnyan zhib 'bri bgyisapa ha cang mtshar bar 'dug rtsom rig lamatshon na sgro 'dogasakyi sgyu rtsal snang brnyan la brten nayolegasa'agrubabyung na sgyu rtsalagyi rin thang gom gang mdun sposakyisaje mthor gtong thub pa dang / sgrung dpe 'di'i gasdo ltos gyi cha na4bltas na'ang gtamargyud kyi byung rim ltar misna gtso bo a

〈dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉gyisku rtsal khyad chos skor/stag lhamo dang / ge sar rgyal po/ gshin rje chosargyal/ la4mkhan bcasa'abur thon byasate sgrig gzhi dmalakhyad chosaldan pa'i go rim ngesacan zhig chagasa'adug cing / yid 'gug gi rang bzhin/ 'tsho ba dang dngosamatshon gyi rang bzhin ldan la/ de lasagazhan da dung tshig sbyor mdze4shing gson nyam4ldan pa'i sgra rgyan gyi snyan rtsomayang mi nyung ba zhig bkod yod cing / de dag snyan ngag melong gi 'bri srol ltar du brtsamasapa'i sgra rgyan gyi tshig rkang mchisashing / da dung dmangasakhrod kyi ngag thog nasadusargyun thosathub pa'i sgra rgyan skor zhig kyang bkod yod pa ste/ dper na/ bsngo dge ba yid la gang shar bsngo/ /spyir 'gro ba rigasadrug semasacan bsngo/ /sgos drin can pha ma gnyisal bsngo/ /deng khyad par astag lhamor bsngo/ /ltabu dang /〈snyan ngag gi spyi don tshig rgyan rig pa'i lde mig〉cesapa'i nang ga gzhon nu lang tsho dar ba'i mdzesasku ldan/ /yid 'ong rna bar 'jeb4pa'i mgrin dbyangs ldan/ /shesabya'i nang don rtogasapa'i blo grosaldan/ /mi dmangasadon la 'bad pa'i snying stob4ldan/ /cesapa ltabu/ yang / dbusatsa ri'i ri la rtse skor brgyab/ /bar mnga' ri4ri labar skor brgyab/ /smad rgya nag ri la mtha' skor brgyab/ /stod rgya gar ri lagaya4skor brgyab/ /ltabu dang / 〈tshang4srasabazhad sgra〉las/ khyod sku'i mtshar sdug 'gro ba'i mig ngor 'bab/ /zab rgyayochoyokyi snyan 'gyur rna bar 'bab/ /thugasarje'i gzigasapamakha' mnyama'agro la'abab/ /'phrin lasachu bo bskalapa'i lam gsuma'abab/ /cesapa'i dper brjod 'di'i rigayokyi tshigalda~Xd

(dmyal gleng mun pa rang gsal〉gyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos skor/stag lha mo dang / ge sar rgyal po/ gshin rje chos rgyal/ las mkhan bcasa'abur thon byas te sgrig gzhi dam la khyad chos ldan pa'i go rim nges can zhig chags 'dug cing / yid 'gug gi rang bzhin/ 'tsho ba dang dngos mtshon gyi rang bzhin ldan la/ de las gzhan da dung tshig spyor ma/dzes shing gson nyams ldan pa'i sgra rgyan gyi snyan rtsom yang mi nyung ba zhig bkod yo da cing / de dag snyan ngag me long gi 'bri srol ltar du brtsams pa'i sgra rgyan gyi tshig rkang mchis shing / da dung dmangs khrod kyi ngag thog nas dus rgyun thos thub pa'i sgra rgyan skor zhig kyang bkod yod pa ste/ dper na/ bsngo dge ba yid la gang shar bsngo/ / spyir 'gro ba rigs drug sems can bsngo/ / sgos drin can pha ma gnyis la bsngo/ /deng khyad par a stag lha mor bsngo/ /lta bu dang /〈snyan ngag gi spyi don tshig rgyan rig pa'i lde mig〉ces pa'i nang gi gzhon nu lang tsho dar ba'i mdzes sku lda na/ / yid 'ong rna bar 'jebs pa'i mgrin dbyangs lda na/ /shes bya'i nang don rtogs pa'i blo gros ldan/ /mi dmangasadon la 'bad pa'i snying stobs ldan/ / ces pa lta bu/ yang / dbus tsa ri'i ri la rtse skor brgyab/ / bar mnga' ris ri la bar skor brgyab/ / smad rgya nag ri la ma/tha' skor brgyab/ /stod rgya gar ri la g.yas skor brgyab/ /lta bu dang / 〈tshangs sras bzhad sgra〉las/ khyod sku'i mtshar sdug 'gro ba'i mig ngor 'bab/ / zab rgyas chos kyi snyan 'gyur rna bar 'bab/ / thugasarje'i gzigs pa mkha' mnyam 'gro la 'bab/ /'phrin las chu bo bskal pa 'i lam gsum 'bab/ / ces pa'i dper brjod 'di'i rigs kyi tshigs bcad 117

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sho lo ka rnamasaphan tshun bsdur nasabartagasan/ ge sar sgrung gi dper brjod kyi rkang pa re re'i mtha' mabasngo dang brgyab dang mkhasapasabartsamasapa'i dper brjod kyi rkang pa re re'i mtha' maldan dang 'bab cesabar chod pa'i zung ldan dang / 'di gnyisakyi tshig gi gcod mtshamasadang yig 'bru'i mang nyung / yig skad dang khaskad bcasakyi thad snyan ngag gi tshad dngosadang khyad par cung che yang rgyan gyi mtshan nyid dang 'gal med pasasgra rgyan dang khyad par mi 'dug de lasagazhan da dung sgra rgyan skor zhig gling sgrung kho na lasamagatog4gna' rtsom gang du'ang nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin du mthong dkon po 'dug pa dper na/ 'bru drug nem loldem soyod/ / gro zhing tshigasam lam seyod/ / 'brasadakar smug pa 'thibasaseyod/ 'brasanag mun pa 'thibasaseyod/ / sran zhing zilab khrom meyod/ / dbu ral pa'i thor tshugasaldem seldem/ / phyag na drilabu khro lo lo/ / sku rusapa'i rgyan drug sili li/ / zhalam ṇi rgyang 'bod lhang selhang / / phyag shel dkar phreng ba na ra ra/ / gsung dril bu'i sgrasnyan sili li/ / cesapa ltabu'o/ /(dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉zhesapa'i sgrung dpe 'dir/ rtsom stangasadang rtsom lus/ dgosapadang nying dgos/ sgrig gzhi dang gzhi khyon bcasakyi cha gang nasabalta4kyang / gcig nasamang che ba ni dri ba drisalan gyi tshuladu gnasapa ste/ dper na/ phu yar labaltasapa'i ltad mo la/ / mi shi gson bye ma'i lab rtse gong ma na/ / mi mgo skamapo'i lab rtse dgung dang mardi~X8/ / mi mgo skamapo'i ki sgra di ri ri/ / 'di lasangan ji 'dra byasapa'i

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /sho lo ka rnams phan tshung bsdur nas brtags na/ ge sar sgrung gi dper brjod kyi rkang pa re re'i mtha' ma bsngo dang brgyab dang ma/khas pas brtsamasapa'i dper brjod kyi rkang pa re re'i ma tha' ma ldan dang 'bab ces bar ra pa'i zung ldan dang / 'di gnyis kyi tshig gi gcod ma/tshams dang yig 'bru'i mang nyung / yig skad dang kha skad bcas kyi thad snyan ngag gi tshad dngos dang khyad par cung che yang rgyan gyi mtshan nyid dang 'gal sped pas sgra rgyan dang khyad par mi 'dug de las gzhan da dung sgra rgyan skor zhig 1nga sgrung kho na las ma gtogs gna' stom gang du'ang nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin du mthong dkon po 'dug pa dper na/ 'bru drug dzam lo sdem so yod/ / gro zhing byugs ma lam ste yod/ / 'bras dkar srug pa 'thibs so yod/ 'brasanag mun pa 'jibs so yod/ / sran zhing zil ba khrom ske yod/ / dbu ralapa'i thor tshugs ldem na ldem / / phyag na dril bu khro lo lo/ / sbu rus pa'i rgyan drug na li li/ / zhal ma ṇi rgyang 'bod lhang stse lhang / / phyag shel dkar phreng ba na ra ra/ / gsung dril bu'i sgra snyan 6li li/ / ces pa lta6'o/ /〈dmyal gleng mun pa rang gsal〉zhes pa'i sgrung dpe 'dir/ rtsom stangasadang rtsom lus/ dgos pa dang nying dgos/ sgrig gzhi dang gzhi khyon bcasakye cha gang nas bltas kyang / gcig nas mang che ba ni dri ba dris lan gyi tshuladu gnas pa ste/ dper na/ phu yar la bltas pa'i ltad mo la/ / mi shi gson bye ma'i lab rtse gong ma na/ / mi mgo skam po'i la ba rtse dgung dang mnyam/ / mi mgo skam po'i ke sgra di ri ri/ / 'di lasang na ji 'dra byas pa'i 118

(dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉gyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos skor/rnayosminared/ / ltabur mtshon na de ni bod rigasadamangasakhro du dar khyab che ba'idriyoglu lagatogasashing/ lhag par du mdo smad amado'i yuladu glu khed dang glu mdud du 'bod pa'i rnam pa dang gcig mtshungasayin par 'dod/dper na/ srid pa'i ba chung bsha' dusasu/ / ba khrag thig4gcig bor song zig / rku gi rkun ma suzhig red/ / ma shesaglu bar drisani yin/ /zhesapa ltabu'o/ / gnyisasu/ spyir btang du sgrung dpe mang che ba zhig tsheg bar bdun nasabargyad can yin padang / 〈dmyalagling mun pa rang gsal〉ni tsheg bar brgyad nasadagu can te/ tshig gi gcod mtsham4dang glu rtar 'jog tshul sogasagang gi cha nasakyang sgrung dpe gzhan lasathun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chosashig mngon 'dug gsum na sgrung mang che ba'i brjod bya ni drag po'i g.yul 'gyed yin la/ sgrung 'di'i brjod bya cho4gzhung brjod pa'i sgrung kho nar 'dug ste/ 'jig rten mi rtag pa dang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa/'khor ba'i nyesamig dang rgyu 'brasarang bzhin bca4'jig rten mi cholokyi ༵byāb bya phun sum tshogasaparjod byed tshig gi lam nasagasal bor brjod yod 119

〈dmyal gling mun pa rang gsal〉gyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos skor/rnam smin red/ / lta bur mtshon na de ni bod rigs dmangs khro du dar khyab che ba'i dris glu la gtogs shing / lhag par du mdo smad spri mdo'i yul du glu khed dang glu ma/dud du 'bod pa'i rnam pa dang gcig ma/tshungs yin par 'dod/dper na/ srid pa'i ba chung bsha' dus su/ / ba khrag thigs gcig bor song zig / rku gi rkun ma gzhig red/ / ma shes glu bar dris ni yin/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ / gnyis su/ spyir btang du sgrung dpe mang che ba zhig tsheg bar bdun nas brgyad can yin pa dang / 〈dmyal gling yun pa rang gsal〉ni cheg bar brgyad nas dgu can te/ tshig gi gcod mtshams dang glu rtar 'jog tshul sogs gang gi cha nas kyang sgrung dpe gzhan las thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos shig mngon 'dug gsum na sgrung mang che ba'i brjod bya ni drag po'i g.yul 'khyed yin la / sgrung 'di'i brjod bya chos gzhung brjod pa'i sgrung kho nar 'dug ste/ 'jig rten mi rtag pa dang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa/'khor ba'i nyes mig dang rgyu 'bras rang bzhin bcas 'jig rten mi chos kyi bslab bya phun sum/ tshogs pa rjod byed tshig gi lam nas gsal bor brjod yo da pa'o/ /119

gcod pa donagrub dang snying bo tshe ring gi chedartsom phyogs bsgrigs/sgrung pa grags can che ring dbang 'dus/de yang sgrung pa gragasacan tshe ring dbang 'dusani1986lo'i mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi dmangasakhrod sgrung bshad tshogasa'adu ma bskongasagong der/nga tsho mtsho sngonazhing chen ge sar sgrung zhib 'jug khang gi misnamatsho nubasog bod rang skyong khuladu song nasasgrung par brtag dpyod byed pa'i skabasasumatsho nubakhul tu'u lan rdzong srid grosakyi sprul sku bya 'phelamachog gisamatshamasasbyor gnang bar brten nasango shesapa lags/phul du byung ba'i sgrung pa tshe ring dbang 'dusakyi pha yul ni/ mtsho nub khulagor pogrong khyer gdang 'o/zhang gi ru khag gnyisapa yin zhing / skabasader khong dgung lo nga lnga'i mthar zin pa dang yige gtan na4mi shes/ khyim mi che chung bzhi yod/ 1986lor mtsho sngon po'i 'gram du bsdusapa'i mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi dmangasakhrod sgrung bshad tshogasa'adu thengasadang po'i steng khong nyid gdan zhu byasapa dang sgrung bshad 'gran sdur brgyud nasabya dga' yang dang po thob la/ sgrung pa'i mtshan snyan yang skabasade nasabazung slar yang 'dzin ma'i khyon kun tu khyab/ lode nasabazung mtsho sngon zhing chen ge sadi sbyong zhib 'jug khang gisakhong rang gdan 'dren zhusanasasgrung bshad du

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /grung pa grags can che ring dbang 'dus/de yang sgrung pa grags can che ring dbang 'dus ni1986lo'i mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi dmangs khrod sgrung bshad tshogs 'du ma bskongs gong der/nga tsho mtsho sngo na zhing chen ge sar sgrung zhib 'jug khang gi mi sna mtsho nub sog bod rang skyong khul du song nas sgrung par brtag dpyod byed pa'i skabs5mtsho nub khul tu'u lan rdzong srid gros kyi sprul sbu bya 'phel mchog gis mtshams sbyor gnang bar brten nas ngo shes pa lags/phul du byung ba'i sgrung pa tshe ring dbang 'dus kyi pha yul ni/ ma/tsho nub khul gor mo/ grong khyer gdang la zhang gi ru khag gnyis pa yin zhing / skabasader khong dgung long lnga'i mthar zin pa dang ⑪ge gtan nas mi shes/ khyem mi che chung bzhi yod/ 1986lor mtsho sngon po'i 'gram/ du bsdus pa'i ma tsho sngon zhing chen gyi dmangs khrod sgrung bshad tshogs 'du thengs dang po'i steng khong nyid gdan zhu byas pa dang sgrung bshad 'gran sdur brgyud nas bya dga' ang dang po thob la/ sgrung pa'i ma/tshan snyan yang skabs de nas bzung slar yang 'dzin ma'i khyon kun tu khyab/ lo de nas bzung mtsho sngon zhing chen ge sar sgrung zhib 'jug khang gis khong rang gdan 'dren zhus nas sgrung bshad du 120

sgrung pa grags can tshe ring dbang 'dus/bcug khong rang nyid kyis bshad pa ltar na/ khos sgrung sna chagacig pa tshog brgya nyishu lhag bshad shes zer/ lo 'di 'ga'i ring la khong gis 'jig rten thog khyab ma myong ba'i ge sar sgrung bcu gcig bshad pa dang da lta sgrar phab zin pa ni/ 〈a stag sha rdzong〉〈thog gling g.yu'i 'byed〉〈phyi gling g.yul 'khyed〉〈gnam je'u gter rdzong〉〈bkra shis smon lam lnga〉〈she mo shel rdzong〉〈mu men mchong sgong〉〈dung dkar stag dzong〉〈sga sde shes rab khro rdzong〉bcas yin la sgra thag697lhag yod/ de dag las〈thog gling g.yal 'gyed〉〈bkra shis smon lam lnga〉〈phyi gling g.yal 'byed〉〈a sta ga sha sdong〉〈dung dkar stag rdzong〉lnga ni da ltan ger bkod nas dag sgrig kyang byas zin la/〈thog gling g.yul 'gyed〉zhes pa de mi rabs bzhi la sgrung dpe 'bri ba'i lo rgyus lda na pa'i rgan po ste thub dga' pha bu gnyis kyis dka' tshegs 'o brgyal la ma/ 'dzems par dag sgrig gnang ba yin zhing / zi ling grong khyer du yod pa'i ge sar sgrung la zhib 'jug gnang mkhan gyi 'brel yod mkhas pa mang po gdan drangs te zhib bsdur byas pa brgyud nas rgan po bu thub dgas dag sgrig gnang ba'i sgrung dpe der gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang / de lasagazhan da dung sgrung khag bzhi na ning mtsho sngon zhing chen zhu par sgrun 'char gzhi'i nang bzhag ste da lo zla bcu ba'i sngon la dngos su par sgrun be+e rgyu thag gcod byas yod la/ nga tshol 'char bkod la'ang da lo nas bzung tshe ring dbang 'dus kyis bshad pa'i sgrung gcig re lo rer mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par sgrun bya rgyu byas te/ da lta〈thog gleng g.yul 'gyed〉dang2

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sgrung pa grags can zla ba grags pa/de yang pho lo nyer lnga yin pa'i na gzhon sgrung pa zla ba grags pa ni/mtsho sngon zhing chen yus shul khul rdza stod rdzong gi mi yin/ kho rang byis lo bdun brgyad kyi rkang lam sa mo'i steng du rkang pa spos pa nas bzung dbyar dgun ston dbyid sked par rta nor lug gsum gyi rjes ded nas nyi ma phud pa las rin chen rig gnas sbyang ba'i slob grwa'i sgo mo ru zengs gcig kyang 'dzul ma myong la/ kho'i khyim rgyud du'ang mi rabs nas mi rabs la gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung bshad shes mkhan gyi sgrung pa gcig kyang byung ma myong / kho rang pho lo bdun gnyis bcu bzhi la son pa'i lo de'i nyin zhig ri ma/gor phyugasa'atsho skabs/ ce yin 'di yin ma shes par bde mo gnyid kyi 'jig rten du shor song / skabs der sgra 'dzin rna bas rta pho mang po'i 'tsher rgyang dang khrab rmog dang mda' mdung gri gsum gyi sing zo thos par ma zad/ 'dren byed mig gis kyang spang ljongs yangs shing che ba zhig gi dkyil du khrab rmog 'khor gsum/ bskor ba'i dmag mi stong phrag mang po zhig gis mda' gri ma dung gsum/ bzung nas yar rgyug mar rgyug byed bzhin yod pa mjong zhing / de dag lasakhyon pa dang sma ra sogs dung ltar dkar ba'i rgan po zhig kho pa'i gam du 134

(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉legs sgrig gi skor rags tsam brjod pa/skedamajug gsum ji ltar chagasapa/ yig 'bru dang snyan ngag gi rkang pa ga tshodamachisapa sogasal rgyusalon gsalabo med pa dang / rang rgyal gyi mi rigasagazhan pa dang khyad par du 'dzamagling steng gi klog pa po'i sku mdun du'angamig la mdze4shing ljid tshad ldan pa'i gling sgrung kha tshang ba zhig bsham rgyu med pasan/ gling sgrung gcesabatusakhatshang zhig legayosgrig dang par skrun byed rgyu ni gal 'gangasashin tu che'o/ /gnyis/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni bgrang bya du ma'i ring la mang tshog4kyi ngag thog nasabargyud yong ba'i dmangasakhrod rtsom rig gi grasayin pas/ sgrub khag mang po'i nang don gyi cha dang ming tshig tha snyad kyi cha/ sgrung dpe bskyar zlosakyi cha bcasapa'i phyogasasu'agalab dang rnyog dra shin tu mang po mchis/ spyir bcingasa'agrolarjesasubod ljongasadang mtsho sngon/ sikhron/kun su'u bcasakyi mirigasadape skrun khang du sgrung dpebya0lhag par skrun byasayod mod/ 'on te legasasgrig byed stangasami'adra ba dang ming brda gcig gyur min pa/ bskyar dpar mang ba bcasakyi gnad don legs par sel med/ dper na/ bod ljongasakyisapar skrunaganang ba'i sgrung dper le'u bkar med pa dang / mtsho sngon dang pocin du par skrun gnang ba'e sgrung dper le'u bgo4yod la/ le'u re'i mgor tshigasabacad sho loka gcig re bzhag yod/ da dungasikhron dang gan su'u sogasasupar skrun gnang ba'i sgrung dper yang le'u bgo4yod kyang gcig gyur min/ de min ming tshig tha snyad kyang rang 'dod ltar sor bzhag byasayod/ dper na/ dpa' hā~X la

(hor gleng g.yul 'gyed〉legs sgrig gi skor rags tsam brjod pa/sked mjug gsum ji ltar chags pa/ yig 'bru dang snyan ngag gi rkang pa ga tshod mchis pa sogs la rgyus lon gsal bo med pa dang / rang rgyal gyi mi rigs gzhan pa dang khyad par du 'dzam gling steng gi khrog pa po'i khru mdun du'ang mig la mdzes shing ljid tshad ldan pa'i gleng sgrung kha tshang ba zhig bsham rgyu med pas na/ gling sgrung gces btus kha tshang zhig legs sgrig dang par skrun byed rgyu ni gal 'gangs shin tu che'o/ /gnyis/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni bgrang bya du ma'i ring la mang tshogs kyi ngag thog nas brgyud yong ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi gras yin pas/ sgrung khag mang po'i nang don gyi cha dang ming tshig tha snyad kye cha/ sgrung dpe bskyar zlos kyi cha bcas pa'i phyogs sa 'gal ba dang rnyog dra shin tu mang po mchis / spyir bcings 'grol rjes sa bod ljongs dang mtsho sngon/ 6khron/kan su'u bcas kyi mi rigs dpe skrun khang du sgrung dpe80lhag par skrun byasayod mod/ 'on te legs sgrig byed stangs mi 'dra ba dang ming brda gcig gyur min pa/ bskyar dpar mang ba bcas kyi gnad don legs par sel sked/ dper na/ bod ljongs kyis par skrun gnang ba'i sgrung dper le'u bkar med pa dang / mtsho sngon dang pe cin du par skrun gnang ba'i sgrung dper le'u bgos yod la/ le'u re'i mgor tshigs bcad sho lo ka gcig re bzhag yo da/ da dung 6khron dang kan su sogs sa par skrun gnang ba'i sgrung dper yang le'u bgos yod kyang gcig gyur min/ de min ming tshig tha snyad kyang rang 'dod ltar sor bzhag byas yod/ dper na/ dpa' rtul la 143

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dpa' thul dang dpa' brtul/ dpa' 'thulaltabu/ rting mal gtang ma dang ltag ma/ rtagasam len ltabu'i rnyog dra mang po yod pas/ gling sgrung gce4btusalegasasgrig brgyud de don gyi 'galab dang ming brda'i rnyog dra sogasaselan4gling sgrung thamasacad gcig gyur tshad ldan yong bar byed par dgosapa bsamagyisamikhyab pamatshol/so/ /gsum/ nged cag gisa'adzam gling thog gi sngon thon rgyal khab kyi snyan grag4che ba'i lo rgyu4mtshon pa'i snyan rtsom ring modag gi 'tshol sdud dang legasasgrig par skrun/ zhib 'jug bcasakyi bya ba'i thad du dpyad pa btang na/ gcig ni 'brel yod rgyalakhab kyi dusaskabasasoso'i skabasakyi dbang 'dzin misnasade rnamasagacesanor zhig tu brtsisanasamathong chen bgyisapa dang / gnyisani bya ba de 'dzin pa'i du4skabasashin tusnga ba/gsum ni legasasgrig theng4mang bgyisapa dang / legasasgrig par skrun gyi chu tshad kyang ngesacan zhig laslebasayod pa de red/ dper na/ hu'u ma'i snyan rtsom ring mo〈yolo yāphe〉dang 〈oti zhig ci〉la mtshon na/ bgrang bya nyisastong gi sngon la skabasade'i rgyalaposadangosasudang len mdzad de mkhasapa rtsa 'dzugasabagyisan4legasasgrig par skrun gnang myong la/ duyoskabasader yorob rtsomarig gi mdape dang 'byung khungasayin par bsamasashing / yorob rtsom rig 'phelargyasasugatong ba lagrub 'brasamidaman pa bskrun par mazad/ da lngayang 'od zer rnamapar 'phroba'i rin chen nor bu zhig tu rtsi bsdohā sbyad/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi snyan rtsom ring mo〈rā ma yaṇa〉〈ma hā bha

gcod pa don grub dang snying bom ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /dpa' thul dang dpa' brtul/ dpa' 'thul lta bu/ rting mal gtang ma dang ltag ma/ rtags ma len lta bu'i rnyog dra mang po yod pas/ gling sgrung gces btus legs sgrig brgyud de don gyi 'gal ba dang ming brda'i rnyog dra sogs sel nas gling sgrung thams cad gcig gyur tshad lda na yong bar byed par dgos pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ma chis so/ /gsum/ nged cag gis 'dzam gling thog gi sngon thon rgyal khab kyi snyan grags che ba'i 'o rgyus mtshon pa'i snyan stom ring mo dag gi 'tshol sdud dang legs sgrig par skrun/ zhib 'jug bcas kyi bya ba'i thad du dpyad pa btang na/ gcig ni 'brel yod rgyal khab kyi dus skabs so so 'i skabs kyi dbang 'dzin mi snas de rnams gces nor zhig tu brtsis nas mthong chen bgyis pa dang / gnyis ni bya ba de 'dzin pa'i dus skabs shin tu snga ba/gsum ni legs sgrig thengs mang bgyis pa dang / legs sgrig par skrun gyi chu tshad khrung nges can zhig la slebs yod pa de red/ dper na/ hu'u ma'i snyan rtsom ring ro 〈ye le lnga be+e〉dang 〈o ti zhig ci〉la mtshon na/ bgrang bya nyisastong gi sngon la skabs de'i rgyal pos dngos sa dang len mdzad de mkhas pa rtsa 'tshags bgyis nas legs sgrig par skrun gnang myong la/ dus skabs der yorob rtsom rig gi ma dpe dang 'byung khungs yin par bsam/sa shing / yor ba stom rig 'phel rgyas sa gtong ba la grub 'bras mi dman pa bskrun par ma zad/ da lta yang 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba'i rin chen nor bu zhig tu rtse bzhin yod/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi snyan rtsom ring mo〈rā ma tso ṇa〉〈ma hwa bha 144

(hor gling g.yul 'gyid〉legs sgrig gi skor rags tsam brjod pa/ra ta〉gnyis la mtshon na'ang/ lo rgyus steng jengs gang mang la legs sgrig byas te ma yig mi 'dra ba mang po byung myong / phyis su yang ched las mkhas pa rnams ma 'dzugs gnang ste deng rabs kyi byed ldan glegs bam du par skrun bgyis yo da/ jun lan rgyal khab kyi skad grags che ba'i〈kha le ba la〉zhes pa yang de bzhin du gtsigs 'dzin dang legs sgrig par skrun bgyis myong /yin na'ang rang re'i gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung la mtshon na/ 'dzam gling steng gi ches ring ba'i snyan rtsom ring mo/ yin pa dang nang don ches phun sum tshogs pa ni sus kyang khas len bzhin yod mod/ 'on te da lta'i bar gling sgrung dpar ma'i rgyab shog mi 'dra ba dang srab ma/thug mi 'dra ba/ sgrig gzhi mi 'dra ba/ dag sgrig gcig gyur min pa bcas kyi gnad don thag gcod ma byas stabs/ myur ba myur bar rnam pa dang nang don gcig gyur can gyi gling sgrung gces btus kha tshang zhig legs sgrig dang par skrun bya rgyu ni 'dzam gleng thog gi sngon thon rtsom rig gi rjes sa steg par dgos gal ha cang che ba zhig go/bzhi gling sgrung gces btus deb bzhi bcu cha tshang khrus legasang nga par skrun gnang rjes mi sna rtsa 'dzugs bgyis te yig sgyur gyi 'go bcoms te rgya yig dang sog yig bcas mi rigs gzhan pa'i yo ger bsgyur chog par ma zad/ phyi'i rgyal khab kyi dbyin yig dang 'jar man gyi a ge h+pha ran seng yoge ljar pan gyi na ge uru su'i ye ge sogs la bsgyur te gling sgrung rang nyid kyi ngo mtshar ldan pa'i khyad chos dag 'dzam gleng yongs la rgyus 'o na byed du bcug chog la/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi rig gnas brje res la skal 'ded kyi 145

(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉legs sgrig gi skor ragasatsam brjod pa/ra ta〉gnyisalamatshon na'ang/ lo rgyusasteng thengasagang mang lalegasasgrig byayote ma yig mi'adra ba mang po byung myong / phyisasuyang ched lasamakhasapa rnam4rtsa 'dzugasaganang stedeng rabasakyi tshad ldan gleg4bam du par skrun bgyi4yo da/ h+phin lan rgyalakhab kyi skad grag4che ba'i〈kha le ba la〉zhesapa yang de bzhinadu gtsigasa'adzin dang legasasgrig par skrun bgyisamyong /yin na'ang rang re'i gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung la mtshon na/ 4'dzamagling stengagi chesaring ba'i snyan rtsom ring poyin pa dang nang don chesaphun sum tshogasapa ni susakyang khayolen bzhin yod mod/ 'on te da lta'i bar gling sgrung dpar ma'i rgyab shog mi'adra bdang srab mthug mi 'dra ba/ sgrig gzhi mi 'dra ba/ dag sgrig gcig gyur min pa bcasakyi gnad don thag gcod ma byasastabs/ myur ba myur bar rnam pa dang nang don gcig gyur can gyi gling sgrung gcesabatusakhatshang zhig legasasgrig dang par skrun bya rgyu ni 'dzam gling thog gi sngon thon rtsom rig gi rjesasusnyeg par dgosagalaha cang che ba zhig go/bzhi ming sgrung gcesabatuyodebabazhi bcu cha tshang spusalegasangang par skrun gnang rjesamisnartsa 'dzug4bgyisate yig sgyur gyi 'go brtsamasate rgya yig dang sogayig bcasamirig4gzhanapa'i yeger bsgyur chog par mazad/ phyi'i rgyal khab kyi dbyin yig dang 'jar man gyi yige h+pha ran se'i yige ljar pan gyi yige uru su'i yige sogasal bsgyur te gling sgrung rang nyid kyi ngo mtshar ldan pa'i khyad chosadag 'dzamagling yongasalargyusalon byed du bcug chog la/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi rig gnasabarje resal skula'anāhā kyi

(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉legs sgrig gi skor rags tsam brjod pa/tshagatogs gang 'dod ltar bzo bcos mi byed pa'i blang bya'am rtsa don yang bton yod pa'o/ /gnyis/ nged cag gis1nga sgrung gces btus legs sgrig par skrun gyi skabs su/ nges par du dmangs khrod rtsom rig dang dpa' bo'i lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan stom ring mo'i lngar yod thun min gyi ga chos rgyun 'dzin dar kha byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/ bsregs bcad brdar gsum gyi sgo nas je legs ji rgyas sa btang ste/ deng skabs rang rgyal dang khyad par du 'dzam gling steng gling sgrung zhib 'jug gi ches mtho'i chu tshad mtshon thub par byed pa las gzhan/ mi rabs nas mi rabs bar du brgyud thub pa'i bcoms choyokhyad 'phags can zhig yong dgos pa'i blang bya bton yod/gsum/ gling sgrung gces btus legs sgrig gi skabs su/ nges par du rang bzhin gsum dang bsgyur mi rung ba bzhi'i rtsa don rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos pa'i blang bya bton pa ste/ de dag bye brag tu brjod na/ rang bzhin gsum ni/ tshan rig gi rang bzhin dang yongs 'dus kyi rang bzhin/mtshon byed kyi rang bzhin dang / bsgyur mi rung ba bzhi be+e/ brjod bya'i bsam/ blo' snying bo bsgyur mi rung ba dang / gtam rgyud kyi go rim gtso bo bsgyur mi rung ba/ sgrung gtam gyi shi sna gtso bo bsgyur mi rung ba/ rjod byed tshig gi khyad chos bsgyur mi rung ba bcas yin/ gong gsal gyi rtsa don 'di dag nam yang rgyun 'dzin byed pa ma gtogs snang med du gtan nas bsgyur mi rung ba'i blang bya nan mo bton pa yin/147

〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/dpa' rtul la dpa' thul dang / sga sde la dga' bde/ 'gog pol 'gag mo/ me bza' la man bza'/ ger mdzo la ger 'tsho/ rting ma la ltag ma la sogs mang po yod la/ ming tshig 'dra min 'di dag la 'grel tshal yang 'dra min sna tshogs mchis/ de'i phyir ge sar sgrung gi ming brda tshad ldan can du gtong ba dang / ming tshig gi 'grel ba gcig gyur yong bar byed rgyu ni shin tu gal 'gangs che ba zhig red snya ma/ gal srid nged cag rnams kyis ma skul dang blangs sgos bya ba 'di gtsigs 'dzin bgyis nas ming brda dag gtsang ma ma gnang na/ phyis sa rnyog dra je cher 'gro bar nges la/ mi rabs rjes mar yang 'khrul med gtsang ma'i khra ma zhig sprod thabs med/ des na da res rgyal yongs ge sar sgrung zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi〈gling sgrung gces btus〉kyi dgos mkho 3 ra kho bos〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i skor la 'grel bshad brgyab yod pa 'di yang gling sgrung spyi'i ming tshig gal chen gyi skor yin par bsams nas bris pa lags/gsham gyi ming brda 'di rnams 'grel ba'i skabs sa dpyad gzhi'i yig cha shin tu dkon pa dang sgrung pa dang sgrung dpe so so'i 'grel tshal yang gcig ma thun min pa'i dbang gis ha cang tshad ldan yin pa'i nges pa gang na mchis/de'i phyir rnam/ dpyod yangs pa'i ma/khas pa rnam bas dgongs 'char ci mchisadogs med kyis gnang bar mdzod/1 kha mo gling ni/ bod gna' rabs kyi rgyal phran zhig gi ming yin la/ rgyal po'i mtshan la ge sar rgyal po zer/ phal cher dus rabs bzu 63

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /gcig pa'i skabs sa grub pa'i rgyal phran zhig yin pa dang / rgyal po'i pho brang la seng 'brug stag rtse zer/ de yang cung rgyas par brjod na khra mo gling gi skor la tshang ldan sgrung yig mang po las 'di ltar bris 'dug pa ste/ 1nga dkar stod kyi sa cha de/ 'brug lhang lhang nor bu'i gdan steng / skad lhang lhang khu byug grag sa/ zhe lhang lhang co ga 'gyur sa/ bde mchog nor bu'i pho brang /gru bzhi san thig le der/ stod byu gser ba mched brgyad/ gser 'phru can la dgu brgya/ smad la rmu spyang sde bzhi/ rmu spyang mtsho la dar chags/ bar la 'om khu tsho drug tsho drug 'bru drug sil ma/ g.yas na sga a sde ba/ dar dkar po'i rgyal mtshan phyar 'dra/ g.yon na 'bru yo sde ba/ 'bru sngon mo'i ma/rtsel spungs 'dra/ stag rong shog chen bco brgyad/ 'dan ma khye skor bsteganyis/ skya lo phyug gi sde ba/ nang sde nam mkha'i skar tshogs/ phyi sde la kha'i ste shing / zhes khra mo gling 'di chags sa nge yul dang nang gi sde chen sde chung dang tsho khag che chung bcas kyi grub tshul gsal bor ngo sprod gnang 'dug khra mo 1nga zhes pa'i skor la sngon byon skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis kyang ltab brjod myong / dper na/ 〈bod mi'u gdung drug gi rus mdzod me tog skyed tshal〉'a/sa/ spyir jo nga 'di'i ming la a sgo jo nga dang lha jo nga sogs zer la/'di ni phu bo jo nga dang yum mchog 'bri sna ma zhes bya ba las byung ba'i rigasayin la/ 'di la dkar po jo nga dang / nag po ldo nga / khra bo jo nga / dru ga po ldo nga gi rigs te bzhi yo da la/ rigs 'di rnams la sa 'khrungs pa'i sprul pa'i skyes bu dpa' rtsal dgu ldan sngon byon dag ni 'og tu mtshun lha'i gral du 164

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gcig pa'i skab4sugrub pa'i rgyal phran zhig yin pa dang / rgyal po'i pho brang laseng 'brug stag rtse zer/ de yang cung rgyasapar brjod na khra mo gling gi skor latshad ldan sgrung yig mang po lasa'adi ltar brisa'adug pa ste/ gling dkar stod kyi sacha de/ 'brug lhang lhang nor bu'i gdan steng / skad lhang lhang khu byug grag sa/ zhe lhang lhang co ga 'gyur sa/ bde mchog nor bu'i pho brang /gru bzhi sayithig le der/ stod kyi gser ba mched brgyad/ gser 'phru can ladagu brgya/ smad la rmu spyang sde bzhi/ rmu spyang mtsho ladar chags/ bar la'om bu tsho drug tsho drug 'bru drug sil ma/ g.yasan sga yisde ba/ dar dkar po'i rgyal mtshan phyar 'dra/ g.yon na 'bru 4sde ba/ 'bru sngon mo'i maṇ+ḍal spungs 'dra/ stag rong shog chen bco brgyad/ 'dan ma khri skor bcu gnyis/ skya lo phyug gi ldob/ nang sde nam mkha'i skar tshogs/ phyi sdel kha'i rtsi shing / zhe4khra mo gling 'di chagasasa'i yuladang nang gi sde chen sde chung dang tsho khag che chung bcasakyi grub tshul gsalabor ngo sprod gnang 'dug khra mo gling zhe4pa'i skor lasngon byon skyesachen dam pa rnamasakyisakyang ltab brjod myong / dper na/ 〈bod mi'u gdung drug gi rusamadzod me tog skyed tshal〉las/ spyir ldo nga 'di'i ming la.asgoldo nga dang lhajo nga sogasazer la/'di ni phu bo ldong dang yum mchog 'bri sna mazhes bya ba lasabyung ba'i rigasayin la/ 'di ladakar poldong dang / nag po ldong / khra bo ldong / smug poldo nga gi rigasate bzhi yod la/ rigasa'adi rnamasalayo'akhrungasapa'i spru la padi sbyosabu dpa' rtsaladagu ldan sngon byon dag ni 'og tu mtshun lha'i gral du

〈hor gleng g.yul 'byed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/brjod la/ de yang dbus gtsang dang bar khams a mdo sogs su sngar nasasdo nga rigs 'di mang po yod cing / gna' sgrung las/ jo nga zhwa dmar can de bsgrigs na mdzes/ /zhes rigs 'di la bon po mang du byung ba dang / gral bsgrigs tshe gzi brjid che zhing mdzes pa yin la/ khyad par du bar khams byu sa cha 'dir/ san cha gling gi yul zhes pa ni sgang drug las zal rngo/'i sgang du grags pa 'di la gling khri gong 'og bar gsum/ gling khri gong ma'i sa cha ni khams stod 'bri klung gi sa cha rnams dang / de las snye sgom gyi rdza ri'i phu na rdza g.yang brag dang / gling khri bar ma'i sa cha ni shar zla rol gyi sa cha rnams dang /gling khre 'og ma'i sa cha ni mdo khams smad rol yin par bshad pa dang / gling khye zhes pa ni mi sde khri tsho re'i bdag po yin la/ khri dmag gsum gyi dpung gi bdag po yin pas de ltar grags so/ / zhes khra mo gling gi rus rgyud dang gling dkar sto da smad bar gsum gyi sa cha ngos 'dzin bgyis 'dug pa dang / dmu dge bsam gtan mchog gi〈gling seng chen zu byung ba mdor bsdus〉lasakyang / skabs der jo nga chos 'phan nag po lam chagacig pa'i bu gsum byesanas jo nga gi mi rgyud rab tu 'phel zhing / der sde shog che la btsan phyug 'dzom sa pas snyan grags shin tu che ba byung / smrag po ldo nga gi mi rgyud 'brog sde chen po 'di la gling ru thogs pa'i rgyu mtshan btsan phyug 'dzoms pas yul kham sa rnam/sa su snyan grags dang lab gleng shin tu che ba byung stabs/ ming la gleng ru zhes thogs na'ang phyis sto⑪ge 'gyur nas gling ru zhes grags pa byung zhes khra po gling gi byung ba brjod pa'i ltab ni rnar 'gro ba zhig red do/ / 'o 165

〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grelabashad/brjod la/ de yang dbusagatsang dang bar khamasa.amado sogasasusngar nasaldo nga rigasa'adi mang po yod cing / gna' sgrung las/ ldo nga zhwa dmar can de bsgrigs na mdzes/ /zhesarig4'di la bon po mang du byung ba dang / gral bsgrigasatshe gzi brjid che zhing mdzesapa yin la/ khyad par du bar kham4kyi sacha 'dir/ g.yicha gling gi yulazhesapa ni sgang drug lasazalamo'i sgang du gragasapa 'di la gling khri gong 'og bar gsum/ gling khri gong ma'i 4cha ni khamasastod 'bri klung gi sacha rnamasadang / de lasabhe sgom gyi rdza ri'i phu na rdza g.ya' brag dang / gling khri bar ma'i sacha ni shar zla rolagyi sacha rnamasadang /gling khri 'og ma'i sacha ni mdo khamasasmad rolayin par bshad pa dang / gling khri zhesapa ni misde khri tsho re'i bdag po yin la/ khri dmag gsum gyi dpung gi bdag po yin pasade ltar gragasaso/ /zhesakhra pogling gi rusargyud dang gling dkar stod smad bar gsum gyi sacha ngosa'adzin bgyisa'adug pa dang / dmudage bsam gtan mchog gi〈gling seng chen gyi byung ba mdor bsdus〉lasakyang / skabasader ldong cho4'phan nag po lam migacig pa'i bu gsum skye4nasaldo nga gi mi rgyud rab tu 'phel zhing / der sde shog che la btsan phyug 'dzoms payosnyan grag4shin tu che ba byung / smug po ldo nga gi mirgyud 'brog sde chen po 'di la gling ru thogasapa'i rgyu mtshan btsan phyug 'dzomayopa4yul kham/sarnams4snyan gragasadang lab gleng shin tuche ba byung stabs/ ming la gleng ru zhesathogasana'ang phyisasuyige 'gyur nasagling ru zhesagragasapa byung zhesakhra pogling gi byung ba brjod pa'i ltab ni rnar 'gro ba zhig red do/165/'o

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/na gling zer bde da ltagang na yod dam zhe na/ de lagong zhu'i〈mgo log rusamadzod〉dang(mdo smad chosa'abyung〉sogasasubastan pa ltar na/ gling gi thog ma'i mnga' khongasani rma chu'i stod rgyud dang / ba yan ha ri'i ltobyang gnyi4ka ste/ da lta'i mtsho sngon dang / kun su'u/ sikhron bcasazhing chen gsum gyi mtha' mtshamasasakhulayin zhing / dusader sargya chung ngu zhig lasamed mod/ 'on kyang rje4sagling ge sar gyi4rta rgyug rgyal 'jog gi rgyal kha blangasanasargyal por bzhugs/ 'bad 'bung4kyisargyal srid kyi bya bar stob4shugasabaton pasarimagyisagling gi mnga' thang dar zhing mthar gling gi stobayoshugasashin tu rgyasapa'i skabasasu/ khamasasde dge phyogasadang da lta'i sikhron zhing chen gyi rnga ba khul gyi sakhul kha shasadang kun su'u zhing chen kun lhokhul gyi sacha khashasadang da lta'i mtsho sngon mnga' khongasakyi rma chu dang tsong chu'i mnga' khong4kyi sakhul tshang magling gi mnga' 'og tu gyur/ mdor na gling gi dbang bsgyur gyi mnga' khongasagatso bo ni rma chu'i stod smad bar gsum 'dusapa'i mdo khamasayin la/ phyisasurim gyisabod yul phal mo che la dbang bsgyur mdzad do zhesamakhasapa blogrosargya mtsho dang dmudage bsam gtan sogasakyisakyang 'di ltar ngosa'adzin gnang yod do/ /2 gling rje ge sar rgyal po ni/ shar khra mo gling gi rgyalapo yin la/chung ming lajo ru zhesa'abod/ khong nyid steng phyog4lhayul khams subazhugasaskabasamachen lathosapa dga' gsol zhing / yab bde mchog dkar po sdozlo yum bde mchog dmar po'i srasagasum pa yin par gragasapa dang /

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/na 1nga zer ba de da lta gang na yod dam zhe na/ de la gong zhu'i〈mgo log rusamadzod〉dang〈mdo smad chos 'byung〉sogs sa bstan pa ltar na/ gling gi thog ma'i mnga' khongs ni rma cha stod rgyud dang / ba yan ha ri'i lho byang gnyis ka ste/ da lta'i mtsho sngon dang / kan su'u/ 6khron bcas zhing chen gsum gyi mtha' mtshams sa khul yin zhing / dus der sa rgya chung ngu zhig lasamed mod/ 'on kyang rjes sa gleng ge sar gyis rta rgyug rgyal 'jog gi rgyal kha blangs nas rgyal por bzhugs/ 'bad 'bungs kyis rgyal srid kyi bya bar stobs shugs bton pas rim gyis gling gi mnga' thang dar zhing ma thar gling gi stobs shugs shin tu rgyas pa'i skabs su/ khams sde dge phyogs dang da lta'i 6khron zhing chen gyi rnga ba khul gyi sa khul kha shas dang kan sum zhing chen kan lhokhul gyi sa cha kha shas dang da lta'i mtsho sngon mnga' khongs kyi rma chu dang tsong chu'i mnga' khongs kyi sa khul tshang ma gling gi mnga' 'og tu gyur/ mdor na gling gi dbang bsgyur gyi mnga' khongs gtso bo ni rma cha stod smad bar gsum 'dusapa'i mdo khams yin la/ phyis su rim gyis bod yul phal mo che la dbang ba byu ra mdzad do zhes mkhas pa blo gros rgya mtsho dang dmu dge bsam gtan sogs kyis kyang 'di ltar ngos 'dzin gnang yo da do/ /2 gling rje ge sar rgyal po —/ shar khra mo gleng gi rgyal po yin la/chung ming la jo ru zhes 'bod/ khong nyid steng phyogs lha yul khams stobazhugs skabs mtshan la thos pa dga' gsob zhing / yab bde mchog dkar po dang yum bde mchog dmar po'i sras gsum pa yin par grags pa dang /166

(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/khong nyid slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' lung ltar 'jig rten miyul gyi khamasasusdig can bdud sde 'jomasapa dang phan bde'i son bzang yongasasu'adebasapa'i ched du phebasapayon/ yab seng blon rgyalapo dang yuma'agog bza' lhamo gnyisalasasku 'khrung4zhe4sgrung rnying mang poru gsala'adug khong gi chung ma seng lcam 'brug mo dang me bza' 'bumaskyid zer ba chen chung gnyisadang / pho brang ni seng 'brug stag rtse/ chibasapa rta mchog rkyang rgod g.yer ba/ gri ming ladango dmar rdul gcod dang mda' dong ba lhathog ldemapa/lcag ni sba lcag bsam pa'i don grub/ mdung yokhamasagasumadagra 'dul/khyi dang dkar dom chung bcasayin/ gling sgrung gi brjod bya gtso bo ni khong gisaphyogasabazhi'i dgra bzhi btul ba dang rdzong chen bco brgyad dbang du bsdusapa/ rdzong phran nyer gcig cham laphaganasagangasacan mgo nag bod la phan bde'i dge ba bsgrubasapa'i rlabasachen gyi mdzad 'phrin de lags/ge sar zhe4pa'i go don la dpyad pa 'dra min mang yang sgrung yig nang gi ge sar zhesapa ni g.yulalasarnamapar rgyalazhing blorig ge sar ba'amadapa' ngar 'gran zla dang bral ba'i don yin/ gzhan yang khong la lhamayothosapadaga' dang / jo ru/ seng chen rgyal po/ 'dzam gling seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul/ jo skyid yid bzhin nor bu sogasamatshan gyi rnamagrang4mang po mchis/ khong nyid sku 'khrungasapa'i lo tshigasani〈mdo smad chosa'abyung〉du/de nyid kyi 'khrungasalo lcagasabya dang chu sbrul la 'dod mkhan gnyisasnang ba gang yin yang rab byung dang po tshugasakhama'i drug cu skor der gtokū~Xl/

〈hor gleng g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/khong nyid slob dpon pa tsha bka' lung ltar 'jig rten mig gyi khamasastosdeg can bdud sde 'joms pa dang phan bde'i son bzang yongs sa 'debasapa'i ched du phebs pas na/ yab seng blon rgyal po dang yum 'gog bza' lhamo gnyis las ma 'khrungs zhes sgrung rnying mang po ru gsal 'dug khong gi chung ma seng lcam 'khrug mo dang me bza' 'bum skyed zer ba chen chung gnyisadang / pho brang ni seng 'brug stag rtse/ chibs pa rta mchog rkyang rgod g.yer ba/ gri ming la dngo dmar rdul gcod dang mda' dong ba lha shog ldem pa/lcag ni sba lcag bsam pa'i don grub/ mdung mo khams gsum dgra 'dul/khyi dang dkar dom chung bcas yin/ gling sgrung gi brjod bya gtso bo ni khong gis phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi btul ba dang sgong chen bco brgyad dbang du bsdus pa/ rdzong phran nyer gcig cham la phab nas gangs can mgo nag bod la phan bde'i dge ba bsgrubs pa'i rlabs chen gyi mdzad 'phrin de lags/ge sar zhesapa'i go don la dpyad pa 'dra min mang yang sgrung yig nang gi ge sar zhes pa ni g.yus las rnam par rgyal zhing blo rig ge sar ba'am dpa' ngar 'gran zla dang bral ba'i don yin/ gzhan yang khong la lha sras thos pa dga' dang / jo ru/ seng chen rgyal po/ 'dzam gling seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul/ jo skyid yid bzhin nor bu sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang po mchis/ khong nyid sbu 'khrungs pa'i lo tshigs ni〈mdo smad chos 'byung〉du/de nyid kyi 'khrungs lo lcags bya dang chu sprul la 'dod mkhan gnyis snang ba gang yin yang rab byung dang po tshugs kha ma'i drug hru skor der gtog4la/167

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rlangasabyang chuba'adre bkol dang / dziti dz+nyān kirti spyan drangasate chosazhusapadang / gtsug lag khang bzheng4par bshad pasakyang shesanu4zhesagasungasayod padang / khong 'khrungasasa'i yulagang yin pa'i skor la'ang〈mdo smad chosa'abyung〉la4'di ltar bstan yod de/ ge sar gyi 'khrung4yul ni/bar khamasastong du masanasayar larma chu rdza chu 'bri chu gsum yod pa'i nang nas/ bar pa rdza chu la skyi'i gzhung dang tshu lung ba'i chu gnyisadang gsuma'adu4kyi mdo yin zhing / de ni sde dge'i pho brang gi g.yon ngosakyi sde dge'i sa'i char gtogasal/ zhesapa dang / mkhasadabang dmu dge bsamagatan gyi〈gling seng chen gyi byung ba mdor bsdus〉lasakyang / 'khrungasayul ni khamasakyi skyid so4yag gi kha mdo yin par 'dod/ rgyu mtshan ni saskyid sosayag gi kha mdo na sngon chad ge sar gyi lhakhang zhig bzhengasayod/ lhakhang nang na gling ge sar gyi khrab rmog dang mda' gzhu/ sga mthur srab gsum/ zhwa lham na bza' sogasadangosapo mang po yod par mazad/ da dung ge sar dang rgya tsha zhal dkar gtso bya4pa'i gling gi dpa' rtul sum cu'i 'bag sku dang / rdzong chen bco brgyad/ rdzong chung sogasakyi logasarisakyang briyoyod/ 4skyid sosayag gi kha mdo'i ge sar lhakhangagi dkar chag na lha khang 'di gna' sngamodage sar sku 'khrungayosa'i 4mig tu bzhengasapa yin no zhesabrisayod par gragasazhesazhalagasalabor gsungasayod/ 〈'khrungasagling metog ra ba〉lasakyang / saskyid sosayag gi kha mdo red/ / chu gnyisa'abab sgra lhung lhung grakā~X8/ / brag gnyisamada' sgro gshibasa'adra yod/ / spang gnyisabal stan

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo cho ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rlangs byang chub 'dre bkol dang / smri ti ston kirti spyan drangs te chos zhus pa dang / gtsug lag khang bzhengs par bshad pas kyang shes nus zhes gsungasayod pa dang / khong 'khrungs sa re yul gang yin pa'i skor la'ang〈mdo smad chos 'byung〉las 'di ltar bstan yod de/ ge sar gyi 'khrungs yul ni/bar khams stong du mas nas yar la rma chu rdza chu 'bri chu gsum yod pa'i nang nas/ bar pa rdza chu la skyi'i gzhung dang tshu lung ba'i chu gnyis dang gsum 'dus kyi mdo yin zhing / de ni sde dge'i pho brang gi g.yon ngos kyi sde dge'i sa'i char gtogs la/ zhes pa dang / mkhas dbang dmu dge bsam gtan gyi〈gling seng chen gyi byung ba mdor bsdus〉las kyang / 'khrungs ga ni khams kyi skyid sos yag gi kha mdo yin par 'dod/ rgyu ma tshan ni sa spyid sosayag gi kha mdo na sngon chad ge sar gyi lha khang zhig bzhengs yod/ lha khang nang na gleng ge sar gyi khrab rmog dang mda' gzhu/ sga mthur srab gsum/ zhwa lhaman bza' sogs dngos po mang po yod par ma zad/ da dung ge sar dang rgya tsha zhal dkar gco byas pa'i gling gi dpa' rtul sum cu'i 'bag rū dang / sdong r+ṣa bco brgyad/ rdzong chung sogs kyi logs ris kyang bris ra/ sa byad sos yag gi kha mdo'i ge sar lha khang gi dkar chag na lha khang 'di gna' snga mor ge sar sku 'khrungs sa'i sa mig tu bzhengs pa yin no zhes bris yod par grags zhes zhal gsal bor gsungs yod/ 〈'khrungs gling spe tog ra ba〉las kyang / sa byed sos yag gi kha mdo red/ / chu gnyis 'bab sgra lhung lhung grags/ / brag gnyis mda' sgo gshibs 'dra yong/ / spang gnyis bal stan 168

(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/bting4'dra yin/ / brag sbal ba 'dra ba'i rtsa ba red/ / cesabrisayod do/ / saskyid sosayag gi kha mdo zhe4pa de ni da ltasdedage rdzong aphyug zhang gi khongasasugatogasashing/ skad gragasacanagyi tsha tsha dgon padangaphal cher lebar gnyisatsamagyi sacha na ge sar rgyalapo'i lhakhang yod la/ de ni ge sar rgyalapo'i 'khrungasayulayinazhe4mkhasaparnamasakyi bzhed pa dang sgrung rnying mang po la4bshad pa tham4cad gcig mthun byung yod/ gnasamachog der kho bo yang spyi lo1999lo'i zla7par bsamagaza4nasasong stobartag dpyad gang nu~Xbyazlo/ ༵ ༵ /'bru/ga mo ni/ gling gi skya loston pa rgyalama' gyi srasamodang / gling rje ge sar rgyalapo'i btsun mo/ gling gi dwang4sman mched bdun gyi gtso mo yin/ khomo'i skye yulani('khrungasagling metog ra ba〉las/skya lo sngo logro lo gsum/ / mtsho skyarengasakha ru skya lo bsdad/ / mtsho sngo rengasakha ru sngo lobasdad/ / mtsho gro rengasakha ru gro lobasdad/ / zer ba bzhin da lta'i mgo log rma stod rdzong gi khongasasugatogasapa'i mtsho skya rengasakha yin zhing / yul de ru skya lo'i mkhar yin zer ba'i mkhar shularnying ba zhig kyang yod/ kho mo'i mchenalaseng lcama'abrug mo thogasadon yang sgrung dpe ru 'di ltar brisa'adug pa ste/ nga seng lcama'abrug mothogasadon de/ / dbyar la ma skyeyodagun la skyes/ / dgun stag yosaganyisakyi bar sgang du/ / ser mo'i sku de 'khrungasazhogasader/ / asngon dgung nasa'abrug gcig grags/ /dog mo sanasalcamagacig skyes/ / dkar yag gangasalaseng ge 'gyi~X 6/9 /

hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/btings 'dra yin/ / brag sbal ba 'dra ba'i rtsa ba red/ / ces bris yod do/ / sa byed sos yag gi kha mdo zhes pa de ni da lta sdodage rdzong spri phyug zhang gi khongs sa gtogs shing / skad grags can gyi tsha tsha dgon pa dang phal cher lo bar gnyis tsam gyi sa cha na ge sar rgyal po'i lha khang yod la/ de ni ge sar rgyal po'i 'khrungs yul yin zhes mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed pa dang sgrung rnying mang po las bshad pa thams cad gcig mthun byung yod/ gnas mchog der kho bo yang spyi lo1999lo'i zla7par bsam gzas nas song ste brtag dpyad gang nus byas myong ngo / /3 seng lcam 'drug mo ni/ gling gi skya lo ston pa rgyal mtshan gyi srasamo dang / gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i btsun mo/ gling gi dwangs sman mched bdun gyi gtso mo yin/ kho mo'i skye yul ni〈'khrungs gling tshe tog ra ba〉las/skya lo sngo lo gro lo gsum/ / mtsho skya rengs kha ru skya lo bsdad/ / mtsho sngo rengasakha ru sngo lo bsdad/ / mtsho gro rengs kha ru gro lo bsdad/ / zer ba bzhin da lta'i mgo log rma stod rdzong gi khongs sa gtogs pa'i mtsho skya rengs kha yin zhing / yul de ru skya lo'i mkhar yin zer ba'i mkhar shul rnying ba zhig kyang yod/ kho mo'i mtshan la seng lcam 'brug mo thogs don yang sgrung dpe ru 'di ltar bris 'dug pa ste/ nga seng lcam 'brug mo thogs don de/ / dbyar la ma skyes dgun la skyes/ / dgun stag yos gnyis kyi bar sgang du/ / ser mo/'i sku de 'khrungs zhogs der/ / a sngon dgung nas 'brug gcig grags/ /dog mo sa nas lcam gcig byes/ / dkar yag gangs la seng ge 'gying / /169

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/seng lcama'abrug mode nasathogs/ / zhe4paltar ro/ / kho moskyesapa nasagazhung rgyud sgyug maltar drang zhing / blokhog mda' sgro ltar yang4pa/ mirtse rno ba mde'u dang mtshungasal/ lang tsho dbyar gyi dpal la'agran zhing gzugasabyad ri mobrisapa dang khyad mamachis/ de yang sgrung dper 'di ltar zhib 'bri byasa'adug pa ste/ khyod 'dra'i na chung mtshar pozhig / bod mabargya'i rumanayoskye tshul med/ / de skyesakyang khyod 'dra 'ong lugasamed/ /khyod sgrol ma dkar mo'i skyesamatha' yin/ / kha phar 'khor skra mdzesargyan yag ma/ / kha tshur 'khor 'ja' risamadangasaldan ma/ / 'grosaphar 'gro gomapa rta brgya ri/ / mamakha' 'grosagar stabasabasgyur ba 'dra/ / tshur 'ong lugasasmug po drelabargya ri/ / lharig 'dzin rtse bro 'khyug pa 'dra/ /nyamasadaga' ba rtse lugasamadzo brgya ri/ / migazhan yid 'phrog pa'i lcagasakyu 'dra/ / so'adzum dkar bstan na lug brgya ri/ / shel mu tig phreng chung bsgrig4pa'adra/ / lha'i bu momiyula'ongasapa 'dra/ / zhe4seng lcama'abrug mo'i mdzesashing sdug pa'i bzhin rasadang nyamasa'agyur/ gzhan dang mi mtshungasapa'i khyad chosasogasagasalaler bkod yod/ de yang hor gling g.yul 'gyed kyi skabasasu/ hor gur dkar rgyalapo gtso bya4pa'i hor dmag khri stong mang posagadug tsub chen po'i ngang gling dkar stod la btsan 'dzul ci 'dra byasakyang kho mo4blosemasa'agyur ba med par gling dmag khrid nasadapa' ngar chen posahor dmag rnamasal 'gog rgolayang yang bya4na yardo 7/0gling gi ja mkhar ring mo hor lashor rjesagling gi 'bang4mi thams

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/seng lcam 'brug mo de nas thogs/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / kho mo skyes pa nasagazhung rgyud smyug ma ltar drang zhing / blo khog mda' sgo ltar yangs pa/ sgo rtse rno ba mde'u dang mtshungs la/ lang tsho dbyar gyi dpal la 'gran zhing gzugs byad ri mo bris pa dang khyad ma mchis/ de yang sgrung dper 'di ltar zhib 'bri byas 'dug pa ste/ khyod 'dra'i na chung mtshar mo zhig / bod mabargya'i rum nas skye tshul med/ / de skyes kyang khyod 'dra 'ong lugs med/ /khyod sgo la ma dkar mo'i skyes mtha' yin/ / kha phar 'khor sgra ma/dzes rgyan yag ma/ / kha tshur 'khor 'ja' ris mdangs lda na ma/ / 'gros phar 'grogom pa rta brgya ri/ / ma mkha' 'gros gar stabs bsgyur ba 'dra/ / tshur 'ong lugs smug po drel brgya ri/ / lha rig 'dzin rtse bro 'khyug pa 'dra/ /nyams dga' ba rtse lugs mdzo brgya ri/ / mi gzhan yid 'phrog pa'i lcagasakyu 'dra/ / so 'dzum dkar bstan na lug brgya ri/ / shel mu tig phreng chung bsgrigs pa 'dra/ / lha'i bu mo mi yus 'ongs pa 'dra/ / zhes seng lcam 'khrug mo'i ma/dzes shing sdug pa'i bzhin ras dang nyams 'gyur/ gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos sogs gas ler bkod yod/ de yang hor gling g.yul 'byed kyi skabs su/ hor gur dkar rgyal po gtso byas pa'i hor dmag lnga stong mang pos gdug tsub chen po'i ngang gling dkar stod la btsan 'dzul ci 'dra byas kyang kho mos1sems 'gyur ba ped par 1nga dam ga khrid nas dpa' ngar chen pos hor dmag rnams la 'gog rgol yang yang byas na yang / gling gi ja mkhar ring mo hor la shor rjes gling gi 'bangs mi thams170

(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/cad bde bar gnas pa'i ched du/ go mo gcig pu 'jigs skrag ci yang med par hor gyi dmag sgar du song nas zhi mthun yong rgyu'i re ba bton yang phan ma nus shing / rang nyid hor yu po du yun ring 'dug dgos byung yang gling sde'i che chung rgan gzhon thams cad rtag tu dran pa dang / khyad par du gling rje ge sar rgyal po bdud yul nas lam seng phebs yong rgyur ltogs pas zas dang skom pa4chu 'dod pa ji bzhin re sgug byas/ hor rgyal gur dkar sogasa'adul ba'i dus su'ang 'brug mos ge sar rgyal po la mngon sgog gnyis nasargyab rogs mang po bgyis myong / hor rgyal pham jes 'brug yodang ge sar gnyis lhan du 'byor zhing khong gnyis byu brtse dung yang sngar ltar ri rab lasadapangs mtho zhing rgya mtsho las gting zab pa yin la/ ge sar rgyal posaphyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi dang rdzong chen bco brgyad chal la phab pa'i dus su'ang 'brug mo/sa gang nus kyis rogs 'degs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang myong ngo / / gzhan yang sgrung dpe dang ngag rgyun la la ltar na seng lcam 'brug mo/ra hor yul du byis pa zhig skyes shing ming la bu rtse rgod zer zhes bshad do/ /4 nong tsha dmar leb ni/ yab seng blon rgyal po dang yum rong bza' shel sgon gnyis las 'khrungs/ sgrung dpe la lar rong tsha ge 'phen dmar leb kyang zer/ ge sar rgyal po dang rgya tsha zhal dkar rong tsha dmar leb gsum ni pha gcig ma mi gcig pa'i bu spun yin/ kho ni gleng gi dpa' rtul sum cu dang gces phrug bcu gsum gyi mi rgyal yin zhing / rdzong ming la bye ru lha ste zer skad/ khong be+e lo na zaba'i dus nas grogs la byams shing dgra171

(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/cadabadebar gnasapa'i ched du/ khomogacig pu 'jigasaskragaci yang med par horagyi dmag sgar du song nasazhi mthun yong rgyu'i re ba bton yang phan tshanusashing / rang nyid hor yuladu yun ring 'dugadagosabyung yang gling sde'ichechung rgan gzhon thamasacad rtag tudran padang / khyad par du gling rje ge sar rgyal po bdud yulan4lam seng pheb4yong rgyur ltogasapasazasadang skoyopa4chu 'dod pa ji bzhin re sgug byas/ hor rgyalagur dkar sogasa'adulaba'i dusasu'ang 'brug mosage sar rgyalapo la mngon lkog gnyisanasargyabarogasamang po bgyisamyong / hor rgyalapham rjesa'abrug modang ge sar gnyisalhan du 'byor zhing khong gnyisakyi brtse dung yang sngar ltar ri rab lasadapangs mtho zhing rgya mtsho lasagating zabapa yin la/ ge sar rgyal po4phyog4bzhi'i dgra bzhi dang rdzong chen bco brgyad cham la phab pa'i dusasu'ang 'brug mo4gang nu4kyisarog4'degasabasamagyisami khyab pa gnang myong ngo / / gzhan yang sgrung dpe dang ngag rgyun lal ltar na seng lcam 'brug mor hor yul du byisapa zhig skyes shing ming la bu rtse rgod zer zhes bshad do/ /4 rong tsha dmar leb ni/ yab seng blon rgyalapo dang yumarang bza' shel sgron gnyi4lasa'akhrungs/ sgrung dpe la lar rong tsha ge 'phen dmar leb kyang zer/ ge sar rgyal po dang rgya tsha zhal dkar rong tsha dmar leb gsum ni pha gcig ma migacig pa'i bu spun yin/ kho ni gling gi dpa' rtul sum cu dang gcesaphug bcu gsum gyi 5gyalayin zhing / rdzong ming la bye ru lhartse zer skad/ khong ni lo na zaba'i dusanasagrogasal byamasashinā tāgra

gcod pa don grub dang snying bom ring gi ched stom phyogs bsgrigs/la sdang ba'i mi blo rig can zhig yin la/ nam rgyun dkar phyogs kyi rangasdesrung ba dang nags phyogs kyi dgra sde ma lus 'joms pa'i slad du/ rang sgogablos gtong phod pa'i dpa' rgod cig yin/ khyad par du hor gling g.yula'abyed kyi skabs5ham sems can gyi gur dkar rgyal pos btsan shed kyisagling la dpung 'jug byas pa na/ kho rang lo na gzhon yang dpa' ngar zhumabamed par hor gyi dmag sgar nang la kher rgyug byas nas hor gyi pa dur mang pomeg med bzos/ yin na'ang hor dmag mang drags pas khong mi gcig pusa'agran zla ma nus par mtha' mar che srog shor/ khong nyid che las 'dasaskabs dgung lo bcu gsum tsam las zin sked do/ /5 rme'u chung ni/ gling gi skya lo sngo lo gro lo zer ba'i spun gsum yod pa las sngo lo'i bu mo yin zhing / skya lo'i 'brug mo dang rme'u chung gnyis pha srun yin/ gling dkar dwangs sman mched bdun gyi mi rgyal/ btsun po'abrug mo'i g.yog mo yin/ hor gling g.yul 'byed kyi skabs su/ de'u chung gis spyi dpon rgyal po'i bka' bzhin 'brug mo/ra brdzus nas zhi mthun yong ba'i slad du/ hor la mgo skor gtong ba'i mna' ma rdzun par 'gro myong /mo ni ngang rgyud 'jam zhing ltan sbug pa zhig yin la/ gling dkar po'i yulidang btsun mo 'brug mo la blo dkar tshad sted bgyid pa'i bu mo zhig kyang yin/kho mo dang khro mo 'tsho/ rong bza' dge 'tsho sogs kyis gling dkar dwangasasman ma/ched bdun la sprul te mi nyag rgyal khab nas bdud 'dul byed kyi nor bu ma thu ldan blangs nas gling rje ge sar rgyal por phral myong ngo / /172

gcod pa don grub dang snying bom ring gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/ / la sdang ba'i mi blo rig can zhig yin la/ nam rgyun dkar phyogasakyi rangasde srung ba dang nagasaphyogasakyi dgra sdemalusa'ajomasapa'i slad du/ rang srogablosagatong phod pa'i dpa' rgod cig yin/ khyad par du hor gling g.yura'agyed kyi skabasasahamasem4can gyi gur dkar rgyal posabatsan shed kyisagling la dpung 'jug byasapa na/ khorang lo na gzhon yang dpa' ngar zhumabamed par hor gyi dmag sgar nang la khor rgyug byayon4hor gyi pa dur mang pomeg med bzos/ yin na'ang hor dmag mang dragasapa4khong mi gcig pusa'agran zla ma nusapar mtha' mar tshe srog shor/ khong nyid tshe la4'dasaskabasadagung lo bcu gsum tsam lasazin med do/ /6 ne'u chung ni/ gling gi skya lo sngo logro lo zer ba'i spun gsum yod pa lasasngo lo'i bu mo yin zhing / skya lo'i 'brug modang ne'u chung gnyisapha spun yin/ gling dkar dwangasasman mched bdun gyi agyal/ btsun po'abrug mo'i g.yog moyin/ hor gling g.yula'agyed kyi skabs su/ ne'u chung gisaspyi dpon rgyal po'i bka' bzhin 'brug mor brdzusanayozhi mthun yong ba'i slad du/ hor lamago skor gtong ba'i mna' ma rdzun par 'gro myong /mo ni ngang rgyud 'jamazhing ltan sdug pa zhig yin la/ gling dkar po'i yuladang btsun mo 'brug mo lablodakar tshad med bgyid pa'i bu pozhig kyang yin/kho mo dang khro mo'atsho/ rong bza' dge 'tsho sogasakyisagling dkar dwangasasman mched bdun lasprulate mi nyag rgyalakhabanasabadud 'dul byed kyi nor bu rdobyā ldan blangasanasagling rje ge sar rgyalapor phul myong ngo / /

〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/6 seng 'drug stag ste pho zang —/ 1nga rje ge sar rgyal po'i pho brang yin/ de yang jo ru dgung lo bdun gyi thog cha rgyan pad ma'i lung bstan 'a / jong gi ma yig las/ sa bzang po rma yul pad ma'i 'u nga / / dusabazang po shing spel yar mas la/ / zhes pa'i don bzhin/ spyi lo1044lor jo rus rdzu 'phrul gyis stod nas seng 'brug stag rtse/ bar nas rgod tshang kha g.yer/ smad nas ja mkhar ring mo rnams brtsegs te phyi nang med par yongs sa grub ces mkhas dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog gi〈se/nga 'brug stag rtse pho brang gi lo rgyus〉su gsal la/ de la seng 'brug stag rtse zer don ni rdzu 'phrul gyis seng ge'i phru gu ma nga po la rdo bkal nas bstegs te gnyan chen stag lha sa khang thog bkab pas seng phrug stag rtse zhes btags pa yin kyang /phyis sa skad zur chag ste seng 'brug stag rtse zhes brjod pa 'dra zhes kyang gsungs so/ /sgrung dpe ma/nga po las/ rma sa bzung dar dkar gyi ma dud pa zhes pa'ang / g.yon nas dar chu dang / g.yas nas yon ga gi chu gnyilomadun du dar dkar gyi mdud pa bsnol ba ltar gser ldan rma lung phyug mor 'bab pa la/sa rma sa bzung dar gyi mdud pa zhes brjod pa 'brel chags shing don la yang de ltar gnas so/ / de ltar sa bzung ba'i gnas der ma khar bzhengs nas gnas bca' ba be+e dpyod ldan kun gyis shes nus so/ / mkhasadabang dmu dge bsam gtan gyis khra gling dgon gyi thag nye sar rgyu dar gyi sanag lung mdo na ge sar gyi mkhar shul yod/ rma smad g.yu lung sum mdo zer ba'i sa de de red/ mgo log gi gling bla ma chos rdor yang gleng gi rgyud pa yin 173

(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyiming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/6 seng 'brug stag rtse pho brang ni/ gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i pho brang yin/ de yang jo ru dgung lo bdun gyi thog orgyan pad ma'i lung bstan la/ ldo nga gi yoyig las/ sabazang po mayul pad ma'i lung / / dusabazangaposhing sprel yar tshesal/ / zhe4pa'i don bzhin/ spyi lo1044lor jo rusardzu 'phrul gyisastod nasaseng 'brug stag rtse/ bar na4rgod tshang kha g.yer/ smad nasang mkhar ring mo rnamasabartsig4te phyi nang med par yong4sugrub cesamakha4dbang bstanapa'i nyi ma mchog gi〈seng 'brug stag rtse pho brang gi lo rgyus〉sugasal la/ de laseng 'brug stag rtse zer don ni rdzu 'phrul gyi4seng ge'i phru gu mang po la rdo bkal nasabartsig4te gnyan chen stag lhasakhang thog bkab pas seng phrug stag rtse zhesabatagasapa yin kyang /phyisasuskad zur chag ste seng 'brug stag rtse zhesabarjod pa 'dra zhesakyang gsungasaso/ / sgrung dpe ma/nga po las/ rma sabazung dar dkar gyi mdud pa zhesapa'ang / g.yon nasadar chu dang / g.yasan4sanag gi chu gnyisamadun du dar dkar gyi mdud pa bsnol ba ltar gser ldan rma lung phyug mor 'bab pa layorma sabazung dar gyi mdud pa zhesabarjod pa'abrel chagasashing don la yang de ltar gnasaso/ / de ltar sabazung ba'i gan4der ma/khar bzhengs nasaganasabaca' ba ni dpyod ldan kunagyisashe4nusaso/ / mkhasadabang dmu dge bsam gtan gyisakhra gling dgonagyi thaganye sar rgyu dar gyi sanag lung mdo na ge sar gyi mkhar shulayod/ rmasmad g.yulung sumamado zer ba'i sade de red/ mgo log gi gling blam chosardor yang gling gi rgyud ༵༵na

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gshis gling bla ma zhes 'bod ces pa'i gsung 'di dag tshad mar 'dzin rigasaso/ / sgrung dpe dang mkhas pa rnams kyis gsungs pa'i rgyu dar gyi sanagalung ma do zhes pa de da lta'i sa bcad kyi ngos 'dzin ltar na/ mgo log khu dar lag rdzong gi khongs sa gtogs shing / dar lag rdzong nas le bar bco lngatsam dang / khra gleng dgon pa nas le bar bcu tsam gyi san pho brang gi shulagasal bor yod par ma zad/ khra gling dgon pa'i bla ma bstan nyi mchog gisagong rim pas chog mchan gnang ba'i yo ge nang ltar/ spyi 'o 1991lor sngar gyi mkhar shul du pho brang seng 'brug stag rtse gsar bzhengs kyi 'go brtsamasashing / spyo lo1996lor yongs su 'grub nas 'grub ston yang rgya chen pomadzad do/ / nang rten la'ang gling ge sar rgyal po gtso mdzad pa'i dpa' rtul sum cu dang gling gi 'brug mo dang no'u chung la sogs kyi zangs sku dang 'bag sku rin thang can mang po bzhengs 'dug de yang lo re'i glang zla ba'i ches10nyin ge sar 'khrungs skar la rjes dran byed pa'i nyi ma ra thag bcad nas da lnga glang zla'i tshes10la ge sar gyi pho brang seng 'brug stag rtse nas 'dzam gling spyo bsang gtong rgyu'i goms srol yang chags yod zer ro/ /7 kha stod gnam rjeng phyug mo —/ gling gi spyi dpon khra rgan gyi rdzong mkhar yin/ de yang rdzong mkhar 'di ma chags pa'i sngon gyi spyi dpon mabu gnyis bzhugs sa re rdzong ming la rdzong mkhar dkar mo gshog drug zer zhing /spyir sgong mkhar de'i chags dbyibs shin tu legs na'ang skabs der zhig ral du song drags pas lta mi bzod pa zhig yin la/ rdzong gi nang rol yang 174

(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/dbul zhing stong pa yin/ der spyi dpon khra rgan nyid nar son te dgung lo bste gsum bzhes pa'i dus su/ sgong mkhar dkar yogashog drug gi mdun rdu ri chung chung lug gi snying 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa de'i steng du bud de yul khams de'i phyi sgo da kyi 'jig rten chags rim la gzigs zhib gnang ba'i tshe/ngo ma sa 'dzoms po lta bas mchog mi shes pa/ shar gyi ri la bltas na sa rtse tog 'ja' tshon shar 'dra/ lho'i ri la bltas na skyid me tog sal shar 'dra/nub kyi ri la bltas na khra rgod po gnam la lding 'dra/ byang gi ri la bltas na khra phrug stong gi gshog pa brdabs 'dra/ yul de'i stod smad gnyis kyi ma/tshams ga bltas na rgya stag ngar mos gzur lta byed 'dra/ sder bzhi sal bgrad 'dra/ sdang dgra bo dam la brtags 'dra/ 'brug pho chung klad nasalding 'dra/ seng dkar mo gangs nas 'gying 'dra'i yu'i 'dzoms po mchog tu gyur pa zhig tu 'dug pa ma thong nas/ khong gi dgongs par zhing khams 'di ru rdzong gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa zhig bzhengs na legs snyam nas gleng dkar stod kyi sprikhu khro thung dang gros bsdur te/ stod rgya gar dang bar dbus gtsang /smad rgya nag gi lag rtsal pa phul du byung ba gdan 'dren zhus shing / ma 'khyangs par rdo mi gcig gser rdo dngul rdo rag rdo g.yu rdo sogs kyis khra stodag na ma rdzong phyug mo/ thog khang sum cu so drug can gyi sgong mkhar yid du 'ong ba zhig ma bsgrigs lhan gyis grub pa ji bzhin bzhengs so/ / da dung thog khang so drug gi klad du mchod khang gzhal du med pa zhig bzhengs yod la/de'i nang du gser 'bum nyi ma shar 'dra/ dung 'bum gangs ri 'gying 'dra/175

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ rta hūm̐ bye bye la gyis gcig bye kyi ༷bar ba tshang mtshams sa skad rdzong ༷/rngos sna dra'i klad /༷na seng ge gsum dang g.yon du rgya stag gsum gyi gzugs brnyan bsgrigs nasabazhengs 'dug pa'i dkyil du be+e rgyal khyung chen gyi gzugs brnyan zhigabazhengs yod pa dang / rdzong ma/khar de'i mdun phyogs su bslangs pa'i rgyulamas+dzawī gyi steng du gnam mi 'gyur 'khor lo rtsebs brgyad/ sa mi 'gyur pad ma 'dab brgyad/ bar mi 'gyur bkra shis zla ba rang tshes shig lhun gyis grub 'dug rdzong mkhar gyi phyi ngos su gling rje ge sar rgyal/ pos phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi gtsos pa'i rdzong chen bco brgyad cham la phab rgyu'i rtags mtshan gyi bkra shis ri mo rab dang rim pa yang bzhengs 'dug zer/ rdzong mkhar de chagasa.a yul gang yin zhe na/ da lta mtsho lto bod rigs rang skyong khul thun te rdzong dang mgo log khul rma chen rdzong gnyis kyi bar mtshams ga chags pa'i rwa rgya dgon pa'i shul de ni spyi dpon khra rgan gyi khra stod gnam rdzong phyug mo chagasab 'gazhi yin zhes sa de'i sems can kun gyis gleng bar ma zad/ de dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus kyang mang po shod bzhin mchis/ sgrung dpe las kyang / pha ri rma la tshu ri rdza/ / rma dza gnyis kyi bar sgang na/ / khra stod nam mkha' langasapa na/ / khra phrug gshog rtsal spyong san/ / khra stod gnam rdzong phyug rngo/ yo da/ / ces pa ltar ro/ /8 pho nog snyang rjong be+e/ mabazhi dpon po khro thung gi dzong mkhar 176
