gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgya mtsho'i chu srin lta bu 'jigs su rung ba zhig bzung nas kha lto phyogasasa'akhor 'dug mkhar gyi shar nub gnyis kyi mtsham/sa su khru gsum tsam gyi gser btso ma las grub pa'i mi chung zhig bzhengs 'dug la / mi de'i phyag g.yas pa'i nang du chu gri kha las tshe 'bar ba zhig 'dzin pa dang / lag g.yon pas lcags kyi mi chung zhig bzung 'dug cing / ma khar rdzong gi lho nub gnyisakyi mtshams gseng dkar mo zhig gi kha ru mda' mdung gri gsum gyi ma/tshor cha mang po bzung 'dug pa dang / mkhar gyi nub byang gnyis kyi ma/tshams su stag spyan gcig can gyi gong na seng ge dkar mo zhig dang khyung zhig gis mnan 'dug pa'i gzugs brnyan yod pa/ mkhar de'i byang shar gnyis kyi mtshamasag lcags nag gi mi zhig gi dpral bar me 'bar zhing spe'i dbus su zur gsum can gyi lha mda' zhig phog 'dug pa des ske bsrings nas mkhar gyi phyi ru bltas 'dug pa rnams bzhengs yod skad/ gong zhu'i gzugs brnyan de dag gi mtsho'i byed gtso bo ni gling ge sar rgyal pos phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi chal la phab pa dang / rdzong chen bco brgyad dbang du bsdus te/ bde zhing skyid pa'i 'jig rten gsar ba zhig bskrun rgyu de lags zer ro/ /mkhar mi 'grur pho rog snying rdzong gi g.yas 'gram na zur bzhi can gyi rwa rdzong sprug po gcus rdzong zer ba zhig yod la/ de'i nang du a khu khro thung gi man ngag sum brgya drug cu tshang zhing / khong gi tshe gang gi sgrub phug kyang de yin zer/ khro thung dpon po ni gling chos 'phan nag po'i rgyud pa 'dzin mkhan yin par brten/ gling gi ma 'ongs lung bstan gyi rtags mtshan yo ngas178

(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/ṭ+wāṃgasamakhar pho rog snying rdzong gi steng du gsal ler mtshon yod pa lags9 gling gi dpa' rtul sum cu ni/ rgya tsha zhaladakar dang / tsha zhang 'dan ma/ nyi 'bumadar yag anu dpa' seng / rin chen dar lu/seng stag adom/ rgyang gragasa.adapal/ mi chen dar malhun grub/ sga sdechomaskyong ber nag nusaldan stong thub/ lcagasanag asen/ nya tsha yobartan/ thang ba 'bumame/ dga' ba bsam 'phel/ gu ru nyi ma rgyalamatshan/'brug rgyal/ snang chung g.yuyime tog michung soganyis / spyi dpon khra rgan/anu gzig 'phen/ akhu khro thung / rong tsha dmar leb/ dar 'phen/ abo khro 'dul/ dkar po rta thob/ stobasachen ri bo phrag deb/ thar ba mtheb drug dga' ralalegasapa/ gnam lcagasamadzub ston/ btsan po mi dmar thang rdeb bcasasum cu'o/ /10 gling gi yang rtul dam pa'i mi bdun ni/ rgya tsha zhaladakar dang / tsha zhang 'dan mabyang khra/ nya tsha abartan/ chosaskyong ber nagaseng stasdi adom/ anugazig 'phen/ dar 'phen dug gi sdong bo bca4bdun //1 /gling gi khra glag sprung gsum ni/ tsha zhang 'dan mkhra phrug ṭ+wāng / sga sde cho4skyong ber nag glag phrug seng stag adom spyang phrug gsum 12 smyogs rdo ni/ g.yula'akhrug skabayosubakolabyed kyi dra/ ༵sa

(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/rdzogs mkhar pho rog snying rdzong gi steng du gsal ler mtshon yod pa lagasaso / /9 gling gi dpa' rtul sum byu ni/ rgya tsha zhal dkar dang / tsha zhang 'dan ma/ nyi 'bum dar yag a nu dpa' seng / rin chen dar lu/seng stag a dom/ rgyang grags a dpal/ mi chen dar ma lhun grub/ sga sde chos skyong ber nag nus ldan stong thub/ lcags nag a sen/ nya tsha spribartan/ thang ba 'bum me/ dga' ba bsam 'phel/ gu ru nyi ma rgyal mtshan/'brug rgyal / snang chung g.yun me tog mi chung soganyis / spyi dpon khra rgan/a nu gzig 'phen/ a khu khro thung / rong tsha dmar leb/ dar 'phen/ spribo khro 'dul/ dkar po rta thob/ stobs chen ri bo phrag deb/ thar ba ma theb drug dga' ral legs pa/ gnam lcags mdzub ston/ btsan po mi dmar thang rdeb bcas sum cu'o/ /10 gling gi yang rtul dam pa'i mi bdun be+e/ rgya tsha zhal dkar dang / tsha zhang 'dan ma khyang khra/ nya tsha spri brtan/ chos skyong ber nagaseng stag a dom/ sprin gzig 'phen/ dar 'phen dug gi sdong bo bcasabadun no/ /11 gling gi khru glag sprung gsum —/ tsha zhang 'dan mkhra phrug dang / sga sde chos skyong per nag glag phrug seng stag a dom spyang phrug gsum ro /12 spyogs rdo—/ g.yul 'khrug skabs sa bkol byed kyi drag chas179

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ —༷kyi rig4'ig yin/ skyogasardo de hor gling gnyi4la yod cing / glibagi sbyogasardo 'apen mkhan ni 'bru sga sde chosaskyong ber nag yin la/ hor gyi sbyog4rdo 'phen mkhanani rtsalachen nam mkha' spar 'dzin yin/ dpa' rtsalacan 'di gnyisal4gzhan gyi dpa' bo sur yang sbyogasardo 'phen pa'i rtsal mamachis/ spyogasardo la'ang sbyogasathag yod cing 'phen pa'i skabasasuskyogasathag lag mgor bskon rje4'phen pa'i srol chagasayod/ spyogasardo'i che chung ni phalacher g.yag ro tsam yin la/ phan tshun 'phangasatshe dmag rta mang po shi rmasa'abyung ba gdon mi za'o/ / sgrung dpe 'ga' zhig tu sbyog4rdo la sbyogasamada' zer ba'ang yod do/ /13 rta rgya bya ni/ gling gi rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi chibasarta yin/ rta rgya bya'i byung rim cung tsam sprosan/ de yang shar rgya nag mi chen rgyal por srasapogasum yod pa'i nang gi che ba lhadakar sgro+om gling gi rgyal sra4seng blonadapon po'i ja mar mngagasapa'i rdzong skalal rta mchog rgya bya chu bya rma bya gsumayod pa lasarta rgya bya gling dkar stod lamangagasapas/ dpa' mi 'gyur rgya tsha'i chibasapa yin no/ /14 mchon a zi 'gu zi ya zi gsum ni/ rgya nag rgyal po4rang gi srasapogasum yod pa rgyal khab gsum la mngagasapa'i rdzong skalayin/ de yangasgrung dpe mang shayosu/ azi dug ral 'bar ba de hor shan pa bu yilag na yod/ 'gu zi gu seska ring de 'jang nyi khri bu yilag na yod/ rno chod 5ṭ+wāṃ ñtshar phran de gling gi rgya tsha'i lag na yod cesabakod 'dug go /

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /kyi rigs thig yin/ sgogs rdo de hor gling gnyis la yod cing / gleng gi sgogs ngo 7be+e yo mkhan be+e 'bru sga sde chos skyong bor nag yin la/ hor gyi sgogs rdo 'phen mkhan ni rtsal chen nam mkha' spar 'dzin yin/ dpa' rtsalacan 'di gnyis las gzhan gyi dpa' bo sur yang stsogs rdo 'phen pa'i rtsal ma mchis/ spyogs rdo la'ang stsogs thag yod cing 'phen pa'i skabs sa spyogasathag lag mgor bskon rjes 'phen pa'i srol chags yo da/ sbyogs rdo'i che chung ni phal cher g.yag ro tsam yin la / phan tshun 'phangs tshe dam ga rta mang po shi rmas 'byung ba gdon mi za'o/ / sgrung dpe 'ga' zhig tu stsogs rdo la sgogasamada' zer ba'ang yod do/ /13 rta rgya bya ni/ gling gi rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi chibs rta yin/ rta rgya khya'i byung rim cung tsam spros na/ de yang shar rgya nag mi chen rgyal por srasayogasum yod pa'i nang gi che ba lha dkar sgo la ma gling gi rgyal sra/sa seng blon dpon po'i ja mar mngags pa'i rdzong skal la rta mchog rgya bya chu bya rma bya gsum yod pa las rta rgya bya gling dkar sto da lamang gas pas/ dpa' mi 'gyur rgya za'i tshebs pa yin no/ /14 mchon a zi 'gu zi ya zi gsum —/ rgya nag rgyal pos rang gi sras mo gsum yod pa rgyal khab gsum la mngags pa'i rdzong skal yin/ de yang byung dpe mang shas su/ gzi dug ral 'bar ba de hor shan pa bu yilag na yod/ 'gu zi gu so skya ring de 'jang nyi khri bu yol ga na yong/ rno chong mi zi skar phran de gling gi rgya tsha'i lag na yod ces bkod 'dug go /180

(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/15 shar rgya nag rgyal po'i sras mo gsum ni/ che ba lhadakar sgrol ma de seng blon rgyalapo'i ja ma/ dpa' mi 'gyur rgya tsha'i ma yum/'bring ba ga zi lhayode hor gur dkar dpon gyi btsun mo/ srasaltabu legasapa'i ma yum/ chung ba 'jang bza' metog sgron/ 'jang sadam rgyal po'i btsun mo/ bu nyi khri 'khrungasapa'i mayum bcas so /16 gling che rgyad 'bring rgyud chung rgyud gsum ni/ dang po smug po ldong gi rig4rgyud kyi thog ma labu gsum skyesapa ste/ che bar chosa'aphan nag po dang / 'bring bar chosala'aphan/ chung bar blam 'phan zer bas/'phan po thogasapa'i bu gsumadu grags/ khong rnamasakyi4rma chu ring mo'i stod smad bar gsumadu gzhi bzung nasa'atsho bzhugasaganang bar mirgyud rim gyi4mang du 'phelab lasasde ba che chung mang po chagasashing / gling che rgyud ni bu che ba de'i rgyud pa dang / gling 'bring rgyud ni bu 'bring ba de'i rgyud pa/gling chung rgyud ni bu chung ba de'i rgyud pa yin zer bar mkhasapa dang sgrung dpe phal cher gyi dgongasapa gcig tu mthun no/ /17phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi ni/ dang po byang gi nag po bdud/rgyal po'i ming la bdud klu btsan zer/ gnyisapa shar gyi ser po hor/ rgyal po'i ming la gur dkar zer/ gsum pa nub kyi smug po 'jang / rgyal po'i ming la yodamazer/ bzhi ba lhoyikha sha mon/ rgyal po'i ming lashing khri zer/18rdzong chen bco brgyad ni/ stag gzig nor rdzong / kha che'i ga༅rdzong / mi nub dar rdzong / zhang zhung mu tig rdzong / agragasaga~X ṭ+wāṃng /

(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/15 shan rgya nag rgyal po'i sras mo gsum be+e/ che ba lha dkar sgo la ma de seng blon rgyal po'i ja ma/ dpa' mi 'gyur rgya tsha'i ma yum//'bring ba ga zi lha mo de hor gur dkar dpon gyi btsun mo/ sras lnga bu legasapa'i ma yum// chung ba 'jang bza' cha tog sgon/ 'jang sa dam/ rgyal po'i btsun mo/ bu nyi khri 'khrungs pa'i ma yum bcas so/ /16 gling che rgyud 'bring rgyud chung rgyud gsum gi/ dang po smug po ldong gi rigs rgyud kyi thog ma la bu gsum skyes pa ste/ che bar chos 'phan nag po dang / 'bring bar chos la 'phan/ chung bar zam 'phan zer bas/'phan po thogs pa'i bu gsum du grags/ khong rnams kyis rma chu ring mo'i stod smad bar gsum du gzhi bzung nas 'tsho bzhugs gnang bar mi rgyud rim gyis mang du 'phel ba las sde ba che chung mang po chags shing / gling che rgyud ni bu che ba de'i rgyud pa dang / gling 'bring rgyud ni bu 'bring ba de'i rgyud pa/gleng chung rgyud ni bu chung ba de'i rgyud pa yin zer bar mkhas pa dang sgrung dpe phal cher gyi dgongs pa gcig tu mthun no/ /17 phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi ni/ dang po byang gi nag po bdud/rgyal po'i ming la bdud klu btsan zer/ gnyis pa shar gyi ser po hor/ rgyal po'i ming la gur dkar zer/ gsum pa nub kyi smug po 'jang / rgyal po'i ming la sa dam zer/ bzhi ba lho ye kha sha mon/ rgyal po'i ming la shing khro zer/18 rjong chen bco brgyad ni/ stag gzig nor rdzong / kha che' g.yu rdzong / mi nub dar rdzong / zhang zhung myu tig rdzong / sprigrags gzi rdzong /181

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gru gu go rdzong / me glang gser dzong / srug po drel dzong / me ri thog rdzong/tsa ri sman rdzong / bye ri'i byur rdzong / sog po rta rdzong / gangs ri shel rdzong /rgya nag ja rdzong / dung dkar stag rdzong / rgya gar chos rdzong / bal bo'i 'bras rdzong / snye ra'i lug rdzong bcas so/ /19 gling gi ja ma ming chen bcu gsum—/ seng lcam 'brug mo dang / ste bza' 'bum byed/ glu blangs gser mtsho/ a dkar thod ma dzes/a dam lha skyid/ gong lcam sgo la mdzes/ khro lcam dpal mdzes/ lha mo bu khyed/ dga' ba mdzes lcam/ skyid pa ldem gleng / spri lcam skyid ma/ klu lcam mdzes ma/ lha mo dkar mdzes bcas so/ /20 ser bo hor rki/ phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi'i gras yin la/ de yang gling rje ge sar rgyal po rta rgyug rgyal 'jog las rnam par rgyal te gling gi rgyal po'i khri 'phang la mnga' gsol rjes thog mar bdud klu btsan rgyal por thod mda' sprad pa dang / de'i 'phror hor gur dkar rgyal por gnya' sga bsta da de cham la phab/ ser po hor zhes pa'i tha snyad 'dir sngon byon bod kyi mkhas pa dang deng rabs kyi mkhas pa bgres gzhon mang pos dpyad pa gang mang btang yod kyang kho bo'i bsam par gsham gyi ma khas pa 'ga'i lta7bar blo gtad chog par snyam/brag dgon pa'i〈mdo smad chos 'byung〉du/ yu gur du bha ta ru ba zer ba'i pha tsho gcig dang / sgom grwa'i shul gyi rgyang ro 'ga' da lta yang yod pas bsam yas srung ma bkug pa'i gnas bha ta hor gyi sgom grwar ngos 'dzin/182

gcod pa don grub dngasnying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/grugu go rdzong / meglang gser rdzong / smug po drel rdzong / meri thog rdzong/tsa ri sman rdzong / bye ri'i byur rdzong / sog po rta rdzong / gangasari shelardzong /rgya nag ja rdzong / dung dkar stag rdzong / rgya gar chosardzong / bal bo'i 'brasardzong / bhe ra'i lug rdzong bcasaso/ /19 gling gi ja ma ming chen bcu gsum ni/ seng lcam 'brug podang / mebaza' 'bumaskyid/ glu blangasagaser mtsho/ adakar thod ma dzes/adam saskyid/ gong lcam sgrol mdzes/ khri lcam dpal mdzes/ lhamo bu khrid/ dga' ba mdzesalcam/ skyid pa ldem gling / alcam skyid ma/ klu lcam mdzesam/ lhamodakar mdzesabacayoso /20 ser po hor ni/ phyog4bzhi'i dgra bzhi'i gra4yin la/ de yang gling rje ge sar rgyalapo rta rgyug rgyala'ajog lasarnam par rgyal te gling gi rgyal po'i khri 'phang lamanga' gsol rjes thog mar bdud klu btsan rgyal por thod mda' sprad padang / de'i 'phror hor gur dkar rgyalapor gnya' sga bstad de cham la phab/ ser po hor zhesapa'i tha snyad 'dir sngon byon bod kyi mkhasapa dang deng rabasakyi mkhasapa bgresagazhon mang posadapyad pa gang mang btang yod kyang kho bo'i bsayopar gsham gyi mkhasapa 'ga'i ltabar blogatad chog par snyam/brag dgon pa'i〈mdo smad chosa'abyung〉du/ yugar du bha ta ru ba zer ba'i pha tsho gcig dang / sgom grwa'i shul gyi gyang ro 'ga' da lngayang yod pa~Xzlosam yasasrung yobakug pa'i gnasabha ta hor gyi sgomagrwar ngosa'adzin/

〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/sog skad sha ra u sgo zhes pa gur ser po'i ming yin pas u sgo sgra log ste yugur zer bar snang zhes hor gur ser sa char yang bshad/ da dung dkor bdag gdug tsub shin tu che zhing / rgyal gsol dang phyogs mthun pa'i mchod thabs yo da 'dug ces bkod yod pa dang / sum/ pa ye shes dpal 'byor gyi〈nang don tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gi dogs gnas 'ga' zhig dris pa'i lan phyogs gcig tu bris pa rab dkar pa sangs〉zhes par/ de la hor yul ni gling pa dang ha cang thag mi ring ste/ de yang 'bri chu'i rab bdun gyi g.yon ngosakyi chu dmar stod kyi a chen lung ba'i phu'i gangs chagasadakar po zhes pa'i gangs ri'i smad du rdza ri chen po zhig yod pa'i 'dabasasahor gur dkar rgyal po'i mi ste mkhar dmar yod cing / da lta yang mkhar shul gyi rtsig pa la sngar ge sar gyis lcags thag gzar nas babs pa'i lcagasathag dum 6 (btsa')dmar po'ang snang zer zhes bkod 'dug de bzhin du〈gtsang pa sde srid kyi rnam thar〉las kyang / stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po ni kha che yul zu mtha' ma/tshams sa sdod cing / du4rgyun par rgya mtsho'i nang du nor bu len par 'gro ba'i sog po ste/ bhan ta hor gyi rgyal po sog khyerd tsho drug gi rgyal po'i gdung rgyud ni gu shrī bstan 'dzin yin no zhes bris 'dugachab 'gag rta mgrin byu〈gling sgrung las ser po hor zhes pa de mi rigs gang yin par dpyad pa〉zhes par/ gling sgrung du bstan pa'i ser po hor zhes pa de ni da lta 'i yus ku'u rigs kyi mas po hor zhes pa las mched pa'i ser po hor ram rgya skad du〉'gre:2 zhes pa'i rigs rgyud che ba de yin par snyam/183

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'brong g.yag dmar po zhig yin la/ mon shi ba khro rgyal po'i bla gnas ni mgo dgu can gyi gdug srin zhig yin zer/ bdud klu btsan rgyal por za'abrong ma shing ma mtsho gsum yod skad/ zag nas 'di dag phal cher tshe srog gi cha shas sa gyur yod la/ da dung na sna la lar zag nas gcig tsam min par gsum nas bzhi bar yod par bshad cing / zag nas ji lhar mang na che srog de bzhin brtan po yod zer ro/ /

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/gling sgrung gces btus kyi sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig gi ming brda gtso bo'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/da ltaming sgrung gcesabatu4debabazhi bcu legasasgrig byed rgyu ni/krung go'i spyi tshogasatshan rig khangami rigasartsomarig khang dang rgyalayongasage sar sgrung zhib 'jug lteganasakyi tshanarig zhiba'ajug gi rnamagrangayogala'agangasache ba zhig yin par mazad/ deng rabasabod gangasacan gyi phulabyung shul bzhag rig gnasargyud 'dzin dngadar spelabagyid pa'i lasadon blan ma mchisapa zhig kyang yin no/ / ri rabaltar ljid che zhing rgya mtsho ltar gting zab pa'i lasadon 'di bde blag ngang 'grub pa'i slad du/ nged cag mtsho sngon zhing chen ge sar sgrung zhiba'ajug khang gisamakhasadabang 'jamadapal rgya mtsho lagasakyi lasabacol ltar du/ nye ba'i lo'aga'i ring blosemasartse gcig dang 'bad 'bungasalhod med kyisathog mar sgrub dpe snatshogasakyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'tsholasdud bgyisate legasacha thamasacad bsduci thubabyasashing zhan cha yod do cog bcosasgrig legasapobyed pa'i mtshungasasu/gling sgrung〈thog gling g.yula'agyed〉dang(bye ri'i byur rdzong〉〈agraga~X/zi

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/gling grung gces ba byus kyi grung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgog gi mong brda gtso bo'i sgor rgya 'grel bshad/da lta gling sgrung gces btus deb bzhi bcu legs sgrig byed rgyu ni/krung go'i spyi tshogs tshan rig khang mi rigs rtsom rig khang dang rgyal yongs ge sar sgrung zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gala'agangs che ba zhig yin par ma zad/ deng rabs bod gangs can gyi phulabyung shul bzhag rig gnas rgyud 'dzin dang dar stse thabagyi da pa'i las don zan ma mchis pa zhig kyang yin no/ / ri rab ltar ljid che zhing rgya mtsho ltar gting zab pa'i las don 'di bde blag ngang 'grub pa'i slad du/ nged cag mtsho sngon zhing chen ge sar sgrung zhib 'jug khang gis mkhas dbang 'jamadapal rgya mtsho lags kyi las bcol ltar du/ nye ba'i dza' ga'i ring blo semasartse gcig dang 'bad 'bungs lhod med kyis thog mar sgrung dpe sna tshogs kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'tshol sdud bgyis te legs cha thams cad bas ci thub byas shing zhan cha yod do cog bcos sgrig legs po byed pa'i mtshungs su/gleng sgrung〈thog gleng g.yu tha'abyed〉dang〈bye ri'i byur rdzong〉〈li grags gzi 191

gcod pa don thub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rdzong〉〈kha che ga༅rdzong〉〈tsa ri sman rdzong〉bcasasgrung khag lnga'i ming brda go dka' ba'i skor la 'grelabashad brgyabayod pa lags/ spyir sgrung gi ming brda'i nang brda rnying dang yulaskad/ yang na mirig4gzhan gyi ming brda g.yar ma sogasago dka' ba mang pomachisakyang / nged cag gisathabasabargya jusastong gi4gna' dpe dang sgrung rnying ming mdzod bcasagang mang bklagasapa dang / sgrung pa rgan pa dang mdo dbu4khamasagasumagyi grong pargan pabacasakyi ngag sgrosalasartsad gcod gangalegasabagyisapa brgyud nas/ ming brda dka' mo skor zhig gi go don la cung zad zhib mo4'grel ba brgyab yod mod/ 'on te da dung mi'agrig pa dang mi rigasapa yod srid pas/ khyed rnam dpyod kyi blo grosamakha' ltar yangasapa'i mkhasapa rnamayokyisadagongasa'achar gnang bar mdzod/ gsham du sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang leg4sgrig gi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad skor brjod par bya ste/dang po/ (thog gling g.yul 'gyed〉gling sgrung gcesabatus〈thog gling g.yul 'gyed〉cesapa'i nang bstan pa'i brjod bya gtso bo ni/ gling rje ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gling la ma 'khrungs pa dang / rgya tsha zhaladakar sku na zaba'i dusader thog ru 'bumathub kyisagling la dmag drang4nasagling gi dmag dpon che grasalnga bkumasashing rta lnga brgya jag laded pa sogasakyisagling lapham nye45nga ba byung / de'i rjesasuthog ru namamakha' 'bumathub kyi bu thog ru nam mkha' rgyal ma/tshan bya ba rgyalda byād la 'khod cing / rgyalapo de ni mirgyu ham pasaza ba/ dge ba'i chos

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rdzong〉〈kha che g.yu rdzong〉〈tsa ri sman rdzong〉bcas sgrung khag lnga'i ming brda go dka' ba'i skor la 'grel bshad brgyab yod pa lags/ spyir sgrung gi ming brda'i nang brda rnying dang yul skad/ yang na mi rigs gzhan gyi ming brda g.yar ma sogs go dka' ba mang po mchis kyang / nged cag gis thabs brgya jus stong gis gna' dpe dang sgrung rnying ming mdzod bcas gang ma/nga bklagasapa dang / sgrung pa rgan pa dang mdo dbus khams gsum gyi grong pa rgan pa bcas kyi ngag sgos las rtsad gcod gang legs bgyis pa brgyud nas/ ming brda dka' mo skor zhig gi go don la cung zad zhib mos 'grel ba brgyab yod mod/ 'on te da dung mi 'grig pa dang mi rigs pa yod srid pas/ khyed rnam dpyod kyi blo gros mkha' ltar yangs pa'i mkhas pa rnam sa kyis dgongasa'achar gnang bar mdzod/ gsham du sgrung khag lnga 'i nang don dang legs sgrigagi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad skor brjod par bya ste/dang po/ 〈thog gling g.yul 'khyed〉gling sgrung gces btus〈thog gleng g.yul 'gyed〉ces pa'i nang bstanapa'i brjod bya gtso bo ni/ gling rje ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gling la ma 'khrungs pa dang / rgya tsha zhal dkar sbu na zaba'i dus der thog ru 'bum/ thub kyis gling la dmag drangs nas gling gi dmag dpon che gras lnga bkum sa shing rta lnga brgya jag la ded pa sogs kyis gling la pham nyes long ba byung / de'i rjesag thog ru nam mkha' 'bum thub kyi bu thog ru nam mkha' rgyal ma/tshan bya ba rgyal srid la 'khod cing / rgyal po de ni mi rgyu ham pas za ba/ dge ba'i chos192

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/la sdang zhing 'am ba/ mi dge sdeg pa'i las la rngam zhing rol bar 'dug pa zhig go / der yang nyin zhig thog ru nam mkha' rgyal mtshab de sems gdon gyis bzung ba ltar rlung rkyal zhig la bcibs nas stod rgya gar dang smad rgya naga'adzam gling 59 gru kun la skor ba byed pa na/ sa cha de dag lag mthil gyi ri mo ji bzhin gsal bor mthong zhing / lhag par du shar khra mo gling gi sa cha de nyid kun las khyad du 'phags shing mdzes sdug ldan pa ste/ spang kha mar khu'i gzhong ba/ ri rtse 'o zho'i kha spris/ yus gru mtsho skyes gzhon nus mtha' skor ba de mthong ma thag za 'dod kyi 'gram chu ldang / 'phrog 'dod kyi dpung ba rgyas te/ thog dmag gleng la 'dren dgos pa'i bka' phab bo/ /der yang dkar po chos la dga' ba'i blon rgan kun grags don yod sogs kyis bshol ji ltar btab kyang / sngon las kyi dbang gis ded pas thog ru nam mkha' rgyal mtshan de gling dkar brlags te snyan grags spel bar rngam par brten/ de ma thag thog gling gnyis kyi bar mi shi rta 'khyel gyi g.yul 'khrug chen po byung ba na/ seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul khong gis dgra la sha 'khon glan pa dang gzi sgong bod la 'dren pa'i slad du dngos dang rdzu 'phrul ci rigs kyi sgo nas thog ru'i bla gnas sgo srung re re bzhin btul zhing / thog ru rgyal po de sta gri har gshags kyis lnga ba'i lam du brdzangs/ seng stag spridom dang ser rgod 'bum thub gnyis sngar pha bu yin pa ngo shes te lhan 'dzoms byung / rjes sa thog ru'i ser skya mang tshogs kyis mgo 'bul byasashing / ser rgod 'bum thub thog ru'i dpon por bskos nas thog ru'i gru 193

sgrungakhag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/lasdang zhing 'tshe ba/ midage sdig pa'i lasalarngam zhing rol bar 'dug pazhig go / der yang nyin zhigathog ru nam mkha' rgyal mtshan de semasagadon gyisabazung ba ltar rlung rkyalazhig labacibasanasastod rgya gar dang smad rgya naga'adzam gling yul gru kun la skor ba byed pa na/ sacha de dag lag mthil gyi ri moji bzhin gsalabor mthong zhing / lhag par du shar khra yogling gi 4cha de nyid kun lasakhyad du 'phagasashing mdzesasdug ldan pa ste/ spang kha mar khu'i gzhong ba/ ri rtse 'o zho'i khaspris/ yul gru mtsho skyesagazhon nusamatha' skor ba de mthong ma thag za 'dod kyi 'gram chu ldang / 'phrog 'dod kyi dpung ba rgyasate/ thog dmag gling la'adren dgosapa'i bka' phababo/ /der yang dkar po chosal dga' ba'i blon rgan kun gragasadon yod sog4kyisabasholaji ltar btab kyang / sngon lasakyi dbang gisaded pasathog ru namamakha' rgyalamatshan de gling dkar brlagasate snyan gragasaspel bar rngam par brten/ de ma/ thag thog gling gnyisakyi bar mi shi rta 'gyelagyi g.yul 'khrug chen po byung ba na/ seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul khong gisadagra la sha 'khon glan pa dang gzi rdzong bod la 'dren pa'i slad du dngosadang rdzu 'phrul ci rigasakyi sgo nasathog ru'i bla gnas sgo srung re re bzhin btul zhing / thog ru rgyal po de sta gri har gshagasakyisalngaba'i lamadu badzangs/ seng stag adom dang ser rgod 'bum thub gnyisasngar pha bu yin pa ngo she4te lhan 'dzoms byung / rje4suthog ru'i ser skya mang tshogasakyisamago 'bul bya4shing / ser rgod 'bumathub thog ru'i dpon por bsko4nasathog rus snal

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo ma ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /khams bde la bkod pa'i lo rgyus yin no/ /〈thog gling g.yal 'byed〉ces pa'i sgrung dpe 'di ni ma tsho sngon gyi sgrung ba skad grags can tshe ring dbang 'dus kyis bshad pa yin la/ sgrung pa tshe ring dbang 'dus ma mtsho nub sog bod rang skyong khul gor ro/ grong khyer gdangal zhang gi mi yin zhing / khos྾ge gcig kyang mi shes/ kho rang chung dusanas pha ma gnyis dang bu srun sogs 'das rkyen sa phyogs mang por 'grim/sanas slong mo pa'i 'tsho ba rol/ 1987lor kho rang khye shor rgyal cho/'i 'gram du tshogs pa'i mtsho sngon zhing chen dmangs khrod sgrung bshad tshogs 'du zengasadang po'i steng du zhugs shing / sgrung bshad 'gran sdur zu bya dga' ang dang po thob/ sgrung pa'i mtshan snyan yang skabs de nas bzung phyogs bzhi mtshamasabargyad du khyab cing / lo der khong nyid mtsho sngon zhing chen ge sar zhib 'jug khang du gdan 'dren zhus nas sgrung bshad du bcug phyis sa rgyal sa pe cin dang 6khron bcas su bsdus pa'i rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogs steng zhugasanas gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung chu bo brdol ba bzhin bshad pas/ rgyal nang gi ched mkhas pa dag gis mgrin gcig tu rgyal khab kyi gces nor red ces bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor/ khong nyid kyis gling sgrung mi 'dra ba chig brgya nyi shu lhag bshad shes pa dang / da lta khong gis sgrar phab zin pa'i ge sar sgrung dper〈spristag sha rdzong〉dang / 〈thog gling g.yul 'gyed〉〈dgra lha'i khrab dzong〉〈phyi gleng g.yal 'byed〉〈lto bdud cham 'bebs〉〈me mo shel rdzong〉〈seng stag dung dkar stag rdzong〉〈gnam ze'u gter rdzong〉〈sga 194

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/khamasabade labakod pa'i lorgyusayin no/ /〈thog gling g.yul 'gyed〉cesapa'i sgrung dpe 'di ni mtsho sngon gyi sgrung ba skad gragasacan tshe ring dbang 'dusakyi4bshad pa yin la/ sgrung pa tshe ring dbang 'dusani mtsho nub sog bod rang skyong khul gor mo grong khyer gdang lazhang gi miyin zhing / khosayige gcig kyang mishes/ kho rang chung dusanasapha ma gnyisadang bu spun sogasa'adasarkyen saphyogasamang por 'grimasanasaslong mo pa'i 'tsho ba rol/ 1987lor kho rang khri shor rgyal mo'i 'gramadu tshogasapa'i mtsho sngon zhing chen dmangasakhrod sgrung bshad tshogasa'adu thengasadang po'i steng du zhug4shing / sgrung bshad 'gran sdur gyi bya dga' ang dang po thob/ sgrung pa'i mtshan snyan yang skabasade nasabazung phyogasabazhi mtshamasabargyad du khyab cing / lo der khong nyid mtsho sngon zhing chen ge sar zhib 'jug khang du gdan 'dren zhusanasasgrung bshad du bcug phyisasurgyal sape cin dang sikhron bcagasubasdusapa'i rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogasasteng zhugasanasagling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung chu bo brdol ba bzhin bshad pas/ rgyal nang gi ched mkhasapadag gisamagrin gcig tu rgyal khab kyi gcesanor red cesabasngagasabarjod kyi metog gtor/ khong nyid kyisagling sgrung mi 'dra ba tshog brgya nyi shu lhag bshad shesapadang / da ltakhong gisasgrar phab zin pa'i ge sar sgrung dper〈astag sha rdzong〉dang / 〈thog gling g.yul 'gyed〉〈dgra lha'i khrab rdzong〉〈phyi gling g.yul 'gyed〉〈lhobadud cham 'bebs〉〈me poshe~Xṭ+wāṃng〉〈seng stag dung dkar stag rdzong〉〈gnam the'u gter rdzong〉〈sga

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/bshes rab khro rdzong〉〈bkra shis smon lam lnga〉sogs yod cing / sgra thag bsdoms pas brgyad brgya lhag yod pa tshang ma sgrung gzhan dang bskyar zlosasamed pa zhig go /sgrung dpe de dag las〈thog gling g.yul 'gyed〉dang /〈a stag sha rdzong〉sogs sgrung dpe drug zin bris sa bkod de dag sgrig byasazin/ gling sgrung〈thog gling g.yul 'byed〉ni mi rabs bzhi la sgrung dpe legs sgrig gnang myong ba'i khyem rgyud kyi rgan po bu thub dga' pha bu gnyisakyis dka' tshogs 'o brgyal la ma 'dzems par dag sgeg byas shing / dag sgrig grub rjesang tshos zi ling sa khul gyi ge sar sgrung la zhib 'jug gnang mkhan gyi mkhas pa skor zhig gdan 'dren zhus te zhu dag gnang du bcug pa dang / mkhas pa rnam pas nan tan gyis gzigs rjes tshang mas gcig gyur ngang sgrung pa tshe ring dbang 'dus kyis bshad pa'i sgrung ni brjod bya rgya che zhing go rim ldan la/ bltas pa tsam gyis yid dbang 'phrog pa'i nus pa thon thub pa dang / rjod byed kyi tshig gi cha nas kyang sgrung rnying gi khyad chos dang ldan la/lhag par du tshigs bcad kyi skor la gson nyams ldan zhing khar bde la rnar snyan pa zhig red ces gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang / sgrung dpe de1991lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dngos sa par skrun bgyisapas klog pa po rnams kyi dga' bas thob/ da reb yang gling sgrung gcesabatus kyi par skrun 'char gzhi'i nang du bkod de par skrun gyi skal ba ldan pa lags so/ /sgrung dpe〈thog gleng g.yul 'byed〉la mtshon na/ sgrung pa che ring dbang 'dus kyis bshad shes pa'i gling sgrung brgya lhag las zangs dang 195

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'iskor gyi 'grel bshad/sdeshesarab khro rdzong〉〈bkra shisasmon lamalnga〉sogasayod cing/ sgra thag bsdom4pasabargyad brgya lhag yod pa tshang masgrung gzhan dang bskyar zlosasumedabazhig go / sgrung dpe de dag las〈thog gling g.yula'agyed〉dang /〈astag sha rdzong〉sogasasgrung dpe drug zin brisasubakod de dag sgrig byasazin/ gling sgrung〈thog gling g.yula'agyed〉ni mirabasabazhi la sgrub dpe legasasgrig gnang myongaba'i khyim rgyud kyi rgan pobu thub dga' pha bu gnyisakyi4dka' tshegasa'o brgyal lam 'dzemasapar dag sgrig byasashing / dag sgrig grub rjesang tshosazi ling sakhulagyi ge sar sgrung la zhib 'jug gnang mkhan gyi mkhasapa skor zhig gdan 'dren zhusate zhu dag gnang du bcug pa dang / mkhasapa rnam pa4nan tan gyisagazigasarjesatshang masagacig gyur ngang sgrung pa tshe ring dbang 'dusakyisabashad pa'i sgrung ni brjod bya rgya che zhing go rim ldan la/ bltasapa tsam gyisayid dbang 'phrog pa'i nu4pa thon thub pa dang / rjod byed kyi tshig gi cha na4kyang sgrung rnying gi khyad chosadang ldan la/lhag par du tshigasabacad kyi skor la gson nyamasaldan zhing khar bde la rnar snyan pa zhig red cesagadeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang / sgrung dpe de1991lor mtsho sngon mirigasadape skrun khang gisadangosasupar skrun bgyisapasaklog pa po rnamasakyi dga' bsuthob/ da reb yang gling sgrung gcesabatusakyi par skrun 'char gzhi'i nang du bkod de par skrun gyi skal ba ldan pa lagasaso/ / sgrung dpe〈thog gling g.yula'agyed〉la mtshon na/ sgrung pa tshe ring dbang 'dusakyisabashad shesapa'i gling sgrung brgya lhag lasathenga~Xspring

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/por par skrun bgyis pa'i sgrung dpe yin par brten/ nged cag thams cad kyis khong la lhag bsam zol med kyis rten 'brel zhu ba dang mnyam du/ sgrung dpe 'di dag sgrig byed ma/khan dang / 'dir rgyab rogs thugs khur gnabamakhan gyi rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa dang blo mthun rnams la'ang snyeng thag panas thugs rje che zhu ba yin/nga tshos gling sgrung gces btus legs sgrig gi rtsa don dang blang bya ltar/gleng sgrung〈thog gling g.yul 'byed〉kyi le'u re'i tshig rkang ring thung do mi mnyam pa rnams kyang bdun tshig can du bcos pa dang / mi ming sa ming mtshon ming sogs gcig gyur min pa rnams gcig gyur byas te/ yig nor dang sbyo ra ba mi bde ba dag la 'dzisgo na byas yo da byung / khyad par can gyi mi sna dang sa ming ma tshon ming nyi shu lhag la mchan 'grel cung rgyas pa re'ang byasayo da/ gleng sgrung sngon ma'i nang 'das song ba'i dpa' bo re gnyis yo da pa'i tshab tu dpa' rtul/ gzhan zhig 'jog pa'am len pa bcas byas nas sgrung gi brjod bya dang mi 'gal bar bcos yod/ dper na/ 'om bu'i spri nu dpa' seng de〈stag gzig nor dzong〉gi skabs sa 'das rkyen skabs der gling gi 'du ra bsdus nas 'om bu'i dpon por 'jang sras g.yu khri gung sngon 'jog dgos pa byung ba dang / thang rtse g.yu 'brug de〈mon 1nga g.yul 'byed〉lasa'adas rkyen yang bskyar gson na mi 'grig par brten sgon 'a—cung zad byasayod pa lta bu'o/ 〈thog gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi sgrung deb 'di khrus legs shig yong phyir nga tshos gling sgrung gces btus deb bzhi la zur lta dang 1nga sgrung la 196

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/por par skrun bgyisapa'i sgrung dpoyin par brten/ nged cag thamasacadakyisakhong la lhag bsamazol med kyisarten 'brel zhu ba dang mnyam/ du/ sgrubadape 'di dag sgrig byed mkhan dang / 'dir rgyab rogasathugasakhur gnabamakhan gyi rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa dang blo mthun rnamasala'ang snying thag banasathugasarje che zhu bayin/nga tshosagling sgrung gcesabatu4legasasgrig gi rtsa don dang blang bya ltar/glingasgrung〈thog gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi le'u re'i tshig rkang ring thung do mimanyam pa rnam4kyang bdun tshig can du bcoyopa dang / mi ming 4ming mtshon ming sog4gcig gyur min pa rnamasagacig gyur bya4te/ yig nor dang sbyor ba mi bde ba dag la 'phrisnon bya4yo/da cing / khyad par can gyi mi sna dang saming mtshon ming nyi shu lhag la mchan 'grel cung rgyasapa re'ang byasayod/ gling sgrung sngon ma'i nang 'dasasong ba'i dpa' bo re gnyisayod pa'i tshab tu dpa' rtul gzhan zhig 'jog pa'amalen pa bcasabyas nasasgrung gi brjod bya dang mi 'gal bar bcosayod/ dper na/ 'om bu'i anu dpa' seng de(stag gzig nor rdzong〉gi skabasasu'ad4rkyen skabasader gling gi 'du ra bsdusanasa'om bu'i dpon por 'jang srasag༅khri gung sngon 'jog dgosapa byung ba dang / thang rtse g.yu'abrug de〈mon gling g.yul 'gyed〉lasa'adasarkyen yang bskyar gson na mi 'grig par brten snon 'phricung zad byasayod pa ltabu'o/ 〈thog gling g.yula'agyed〉kyi sgrung deb 'di spusalegasashig yodī ༵ra nga tshosagling sgrung gcesabatusadeb bzhi la zur ltadang gling sgrung la

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/nang khyan chung pa'i ched mkhas pa dag la slob spyong nan mo bgyis te rang nusagang yod kyis bsgrigs pa zhig lags so/ /〈thog gling g.yul 'khyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/1 thog ru rgyal po ni/ thog ru yul gyi rgyal po yin zhing ming gzhan la nam ma kha' rgyal mtshan zer/ kho be+e thog ru 'bum thub kyi bu yin te thog ru zhes pa sa ming mi la 'byor ba yin/ pho brang gi ming la dung dkar gnam rdzong phyug mo zer/ btsun mo sog bza' dar 'jam lha mo la thog sras stag mo stong sdig skyes/ thog ru rgyal po'i chibs pa'i ming la bdud rta stag mo kher nyal dang ral gri'i ming la bdud gri mun pa reg gcod zer/ bshad pa ltar na kho rang a chen hor gyi rgyal po gur nag gi skye ba yin zer zhing / 'chi khar ltab log pas thog ru'i yul du bdud kye rgyal po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes pa'i 'u sa blangs/ 〈thog gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi skabs gseng chen rgyal pos sta gre har gshags kyis lnga ba'i lam du bzangs so/ /2 rlung rgyal —/ sgrung pa grags can tshe ring dbang 'dus lagasakyis bshad pa ltar na thog ru rgyal po des mi lo dgu la lha chen dbang phyug la dmar mchod dang bsang mchod byas pas lha chen thugs dgyes nas rlung lhabadud kyi rkyal ba zhes pa'i dngos grub gnang / rlung lha bdud kye rkyal ba de gnam ze'u ra ga tsho gsum gyis yar gnam la 'phur du 'jug pa dang sa the'u du ba mgo dgu yis mar sal 'bab tu 'jug par bshad do/ /3 dung dkar gnam rjong phyug mo —/ thog ru nam mkha' rgyal 197

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/nang byan chud pa'i ched mkhasapa dag la slob sbyong nan mo bgyisate rang nusagang yod kyisabasgrigasapa zhig lags/so/ /〈thog gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/1 thog ru rgyal po ni/ thog ru yul gyi rgyalapo yin zhing ming gzhan lanamamakha' rgyalamatshan zer/ kho ni thog ru 'bum thub kyi bu yin te thog ru zheyopa saming mi la 'byor ba yin/ pho brang gi ming ladung dkar gnamardzong phyug mo zer/ btsun mosog bza' dar 'jam lhamo la thog srasastag mo stong sdigaskyes/ thog ru rgyal po'i chibasapa'i ming la bdud rta stag mokher nyaladang ral gri'i ming la bdud gri mun pa reg gcod zer/ bshad pa ltar na kho rang achen hor gyi rgyal po gur nag gi skye ba yin zer zhing / 'chi khar ltab log pasathog ru'i yuladu bdud kyi rgyalapo nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhe4pa'i lu4blangs/ 〈thog gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi skabasagaseng chen rgyal po4sta gri har gshagasakyi4lnga ba'i lamadu brdzang4so/ /2 rlung rkyal ni/ sgrung pa gragasacan tshe ring dbang 'dusalagasakyi4bshad pa ltar na thog ru rgyal po desamilodagu lalhachen dbang phyug la dmar mchod dang bsang mchod byasapasalhachen thugasadagye4na4rlung lhabadud kyi rkyalab zhesapa'i dngosagrub gnang / rlung lhabadud kyi rkyal ba de gnamathe'u ra gwa tsho gsum gyisayar gnamal 'phur du 'jug pa dang sathe'u du ba mgo dgu yisamar sal 'bab tu'ajug par bshad do/ /3 dung dkar gnam rdzong phyug mo ni/ thog ru namamakha~X stal

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtshan gyi pho brang yin zhing / pho brang de ni nub rdzong dang byang rdzong / bar rdzong gsum gyis grub la/ nub rdzong la stod rdzong smug po/ khyang rdzong la rdo rje rtse dgu/ bar sdong la dung rdzong 'bumathub bcas so/ /4 thog blon grags chen bzhi ni/ stobs chen khrag mig dug nag rtsal chen/ ser rgod 'bumathub/ lcags khro btsan po bcas so /5 mi chung ni/ lngar sprichen hor gyi blon po yin/ gling rje ge sar rgyal pos hor gur dkar rgyal por gnya' sga bstad bdang hor dmag chal laphab rjes khorang seng chen rgyal po'i gsol dpon du bskos/ mtshan hrilabor bod phrug cha⑫ kha bde'am gling phrug mi chung kha bde zer/ gtam bshad dang glu len sogs la shin tsamakhas par grags/6 bla mcho ba shor rgyal mo be+e/ mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi khongasasayod cing rang rgyal gyi ches che ba'i tshwa mtsho yin/ ming gzhan la mtsho sngon po zer/ mtsho ngos las smis sum stong chig brgya'i sar yod la mtha' skor du blon po gser chen dang sprim zor dgu/ brag dkar them chen/ mi re rdza rgan bcas sa 'dzin grags can mang pos bskor yod/ yul khams mdzes shing ltan sdug la ri lung kun nyurta nor lug gsum gyis khengs shing sa gzhi chen po'i rgyan du gyur 'dug 'di ni mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi ljongs rgyu lta skor byed sa'i gnas mchog khyad par can yin la/ gling lnga mtsho bzhir snyan pa'i grags pa ldir ba'i bya 1nga yang gnas 'di ru yong pas/ lo rer mgron po khye stong mang po lta skor la phebs kyin yod do/ /198

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtshanagyi pho brang yin zhing / pho brang de ni nub rdzong dang byang rdzong / bar rdzong gsum gyisagrubal/ nubardzong la stod rdzong smug po/ byang rdzong lardo rje rtse dgu/ bar rdzong la dung rdzong 'bumathub bcasaso/ /4 thog blon grags chen bzhi ni/ stobasachen khrag mig dug nag rtsalachen/ ser rgod 'bumathub/ lcagasakhri btsan po bcasaso /5 mi chung ni/ sngar achen hor gyi blon po yin/ gling rje ge sar rgyalaposahor gur dkar rgyalapor gnya' sga bstan padang hor dmag cham laphabarjesakhorang seng chen rgyalapo'i gsoladapon du bskos/ mtshan hrilabor bod phrug michung khabade'amagling phrug mi chung khabade zer/ gtamabashad dang glu lenasogasalashinatumakhasapar grags/6 bla mcho khri shor rgyal mo ni/ mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi khong4suyod cing rang rgyalagyi chesache ba'i tshwa mtsho yin/ ming gzhan la mtsho sngon po zer/ mtsho ngosalayosmisasumastong chigabargya'i sar yod lamatha' skor du blon po gser chenadang amazor dgu/ brag dkar themachen/ mire rdza rgan bcasasa'adzin gragasacan mang posabaskor yod/ yul khamasamadze4shing ltan sdug lari lung kun turta nor lug gsumagyisakhengasashing sagazhi chen po'i rgyan du gyur 'dug 'di ni mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi ljongasargyu ltasgor byed sa'i gnasamachog khyad par can yinal/ gling lnga mtsho bzhir snyan pa'i gragasapa ldir ba'i bya gling yang gnasa'adi ru yod pas/ lo rer mgron po khri stong mang po༈hūṃr laphebasakyinayod do/ /

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/7 lda ga ni/ zan rilalamazanagong lazer ro/ /8 byang a stag 'khyil ba'i klu mo ni/ bdud yabarje nag po'i srasamo/ bdud klu btsan rgyalapo'i sring mo/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i ja ma/byangasgo 'gog pa'i grubachenayin la/ rta pho'i ming la rag dkar dre'u gzugasadang ralagri'i ming la'abrong rwa dgu chod zer/ gling ge sar rgyal po4bdud klu btsan rgyal por thod mda' masprad gobage sar mchog larogasa'adegasakhazhe gnyisamed du bgyisapa dang / bdud rgan chamalaphab rjesage sar rgyal posa.astag klu monag po bdud kyi rgyal mor bsko4so/ /go9ṭ+wāṃba~X ni/ dngosapo gang rung zhig bgo bya brgyabasteskal ba thobapa la /0 ༵༷/nga /sras g.yu khri gung sngon ni/ 'jang sadamargyalapo'i sra4che ba yin la/ khong gi amamahā tsi na'i yulagyi kong jo zhig yinapar gleng / 〈stag gzig nor rdzong〉ltar na 'omabu'i anu dpa' seng de stag gzig rgyalapo'i srasakhrab rgod blob4bkrongasapas/ gling gi 'du ra bsdusanasa'ajang srasagayu'i gubasngon 'omabu'i dponapor bskosashing g.yula'agyed gang mang zhig gi khrod byasarjesamidaman pabazhag yod do/ /11 na mo ni/ na chung mdangabud med spyi'i ming ngo / /12 chos skyong ni/ bstanapatshulabazhin skyong bar mdzad pa'i dmatshig laganasapa'i srung mar zer bayin no/ /13 kun grags don yod ni/ thog ru'i rgyal rabasaganāsakyi

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/7 lda ga ni/ zan ril lam zan gong la zer ro/ /8 byang a stag 'khyel ba'i klu mo ni/ bdud yab rje nag po'i sras mo/ bdud klu btsan rgyal po'i sring mo/ gleng ge sar rgyal po'i ja ma/byang sgo 'gog pa'i grub chen yin la/ rta pho'i ming la rag dkar dre'u gzugs dang ral gri'i ming la 'brong rwa dgu chod zer/ gling ge sar rgyal pos bdud klu btsan rgyal por thod mda' ma sprad gong ge sar mchog la dogasa'adegs kha zhe gnyis med du bgyis pa dang / bdud rgan chams phab rjes ge sar rgyal pos a stag klu yon ga po bdud kye rgyal mor bskos so/ /9 grobs be+e/ dngos po gang rung zhig bgo bya brgyab ste skal ba thob pa la go dgos so/ /10 'jang sras g.yu khri gung sngon —/ 'jang sa dam rgyal po'i sras che ba yin la/ khong gi am ma hā tsi na'i shing gyi kong jo zhig yin par gleng / 〈ste ga gzig nor rdzong〉ltar na 'om bu'i a nu dpa' seng de stag gzig rgyal po'i sras khrab rgod zla bas bkrongs pas/ gling gi 'du ra bsdusanas 'jang sras g.yu khri gung sngon 'om bu'i dpon por bskos shing g.yul 'gyed gang mang zhig gi khrod byas rjes mi dman pa bzhag yod do/ /11 na mo ni/ na chung mdang bud med spyi'i ming ngo / /12 chos skyong be+e/ bstan pa tshul bzhin skyong bar mdzad pa'i dmatshig la gnas pa'i srung mar zer ba yin no/ /13 kun grags don yod —/ thog ru'i rgyal rabs gnyis kyi 199

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/blon pozhig yin zhing / thog gling g.yula'akhrug skabasasukho ni blosemayogling la dkar bsathog ru rgyalapo phamapar bzo ba'i thad larogasa'adegasagabalegasabagyis/ phyisasukho rang ge sar rgyal po'i chosablon du gyur to/ /14 bya rta rlung gshog ni/ dgra lhartse rgyal gyi chibasapa yin/ mibagazhan lakhyung gshog sngon pozer zhing sngar mon gling 'khrug skabasadagra lhartse rgyal gyi chibasapa rgya bya sog dkar de g.yul 'khrug nang du bsad pas/ gling stag rong dpon pokhro thung stag gzig yul du phyin te stag gzig rgyalapo'i chibasapa khyung gshog sngon mo/ rna rtse na khyung gi thul phran yod pa/ bya mkha' lding gi sgo nga lasabyung ba rmig bzhir rlung gi spu gri ldan pa can de brkusanas lhasrasadagra lhartse rgyalal phul/ rjesasustag gling gnyisakyi bar mi shi rta 'gyel gyi g.yul 'khrug chen po byung ngo / /15 dgra lha ni/ pha rol gyi dgra lasarnamapar rgyal bar 'jug pa'i dgra 'thab kyi lhade lazer ro/ /16 sta chen brag ri har gshags ni/ 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i drag chasashig yin zhing / mashelabrag gi gter lasabaton pa dang dgra lha'i go mtshon sna dgu'i gragasugatogs/ der mtshon cha gzhan dang mimatshungasapa'i khyad chosayod pa ni(lcag4mo'i 'bri rdzong〉las/ mthing mdog rdo zhun bcud la4bton/ / sngon po nam mkha'i rang mdangasacan/ / lcagasa'adi gor mardo lasabyung / / ngar lcagasapha bu dpa' rgod 'ardo~X/ / mnyen lcagasam sru spyang grung ldan/ / lcagasasna dgu yiyang

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/blon po zhig yin zhing / thog gling g.yus 'khrug skabs sa kho ni blo sems gling la dkar bas thog ru rgyal po pham par bzo ba'i thad la rogs 'degs gang legs bgyis/ phyis sa kho rang ge sar rgyal po'i chos blon du gyur to/ /14 bya rta drung gshog cha/ dgra lha rtse rgyal gyi che bas pa yin/ ming gzhan la khyung gshog sngon mo zer zhing sngar mon gling 'khrug skabs dgra lha rtse rgyal gyi chibs pa rgya bya sog dkar de g.yus 'khrug nang du bsad pas/ gling stag rong dpon po khro thung stag gzig yus du phyin te stag gzig rgyal po'i chibs pa khyung gshog sngon mo/ rna rtse na khyung gi thul phran yod pa// bya ma/kha' lding gi sgo nga la sa byung ba drig bzhir rlung gi spu gri ldan pa can de brkus nas lhasras dgra lha rtse rgyal la phul/ rjes sa stag gling gnyis kyi bar mi shi rta 'byel gyi gshis 'khrug chen po byung ngo / /15 dgra lha ni/ pha rol gyi dgra las rnam par rgyal bar 'jug pa'i dgra 'thab kye lha de la zer ro/ /16 sta chen zag ri har gshags rki/ 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i drag chas shig yin zhing / rma shel brag gi gter la sa bton pa dang dgra lha'i go ma tshon sna dgu'i gras su gtogs/ der mtshon cha gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos yod pa be+e(lcags mo re 'bri rdzong〉las/ mthing mdog rdo zhun bcud las bton/ / sngon po nam ma kha'i rang mdangasacan/ / lcags 'di gor ma rdo las byung / / ngar lcags pha bu dpa' rgod 'dzoms/ / mnyen lcags ma sru sprang grung ldan/ / lcags sna dgu yi yang 200

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/zhunabasags/ / stomago zla ba tshe 'drar brdungs/ / marting 'ja' tshon bkra bar brdungs/ / dngulachusagayung drung ri pobris/ / stayuseng ldeng sdong bo byas/ / zheyobrisayod pa ltar dang thog ru namamakha' rgyalamatshan chamal phab byed kyi lag cha'ang sta chen brag ri har gshagasa'adi yin no/ /17 sba lcags bsam pa'i don grub ni/ dgra lha'i go mtshon sna dgu'i grasayin zhing / 〈rta rgyug〉las/ lcag rgyunadagung laphyar ba'i tshe/ / gyi ling 'do ba'i bang kha phye/ / ngo mtshar spu gri'i gsang lam 'byed/ / sdang dgrar brosalamastong bar byed/ / lcag rgyun thengasagasum brab4pa'i tshe/ / 'do ba'i bang kha rlung la 'gran/ / rgyug thag rting ma rang 'khor dang / / rta rgyan g.yang gi bdag don 'grub/ / lcag rgyun shar la galugs pa'i tshe/ / rdo rje sem4dpa'i lhatshogasa'abum/ / byin rlabasasprin phung 'khrigasapa bzhin/ / zhi ba'i 'phrin la4bgo skal thob/ / lcag rgyun lhoru g.yugasapa'i tshe/ / rin chen 'byung ldan 'khor dang bcas/ / dngosagrub char rgyun yalal/ / rgyasapa'i 'phrin lasabago skalathob/ / lcag rgyun nub tu g.yugasapa'i tshe/ / snang ba mtha' ya4ston 'khor bcas/ / thugasarje'i glog 'od nyamasapa med/ / dbang gi 'phrin lasabago skal thob/ /lcag rgyun byang du g.yugasapa'i tshe/ / don grub khro tshogasa'akhor dang bcas/ / 'gro don myur mgyogasabyed lamakhas/ / drag po'i 'phrin lasabago skal thob/ / cesabri4yod pa ltar yin lader rta lcag bsamapa'i don grub dang sba lcag bsam pa'i don grub cesaming gang bkod kyang chog go201/

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/zhun bsags/ / sta mgo zla ba tshe 'drar brdungs/ / ga rting 'ja' tshon bkra bar brdungs/ / dngul chus g.yung drung ri yo bris/ / g.yu seng sdeng sdong bo byas/ / zhes bris yod pa ltar dang thog ru nam mkha' rgyal mtshan cham la phab byed kyi lag cha'ang sta chen brag ri har gshags 'di yin no/ /17 sba lcags bsam pa'i don grub ni/ dgra lha'i go mtshon sna dgu'i gras yin zhing / 〈rta rgyug〉las/ lcag rgyun dgung la phyar ba'i che/ / gyi leng 'do ba'i bang kha phye/ / ngo mtshar spu gri'i gsang lam 'byed/ / sdang dgrar bros lam stong bar byed/ / lcag rgyun bangs gsum brabs pa'i che/ / 'do ba'i bang kha rlung la 'gran/ / rgyug thag rting ma rang 'khor dang / / rta rgyan g.yang gi bdag don 'grub/ / lcag rgyun shar la g.yu gas pa'i tshe/ / rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs 'bum/ / byin rlabs sprin phung 'khrigs pa bzhin/ / zhi ba'i 'phrin las bgo skal thob/ / lcag rgyun lho ru g.yugs pa'i ma/ / rin chen 'byung ldan 'khor dang bcas/ / dngosagrub char rgyun mil la/ / rgyas pa'i 'phrin las bgo skal thob/ / lcag rgyun nub tu g.yugs pa'i tshe/ / snang ba mtha' yas ston 'khor bcas/ / thugasarje'i glog 'od nyams pa med/ / dbang gi 'phrin las bgo skal thob/ /lcag rgyun byang du g.yugs pa'i tshe/ / don grub khro tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ / 'gro don myur mgyogs byed la mkhas/ / drag po'i 'phrin lasabago skal thob/ / ces bas yod pa ltar yin la der rta lcag bsam pa'i don grub dang sba lcag bsam pa'i don grub ces ming gang bkod kyang chog go /201
