sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/babs te ri dwags sha ba dang / rna ba/ dgo ba/ gtsod/ gnyan/ che ba rkyang 'brong bcas bsad nas longs spyod cing zhags gnyis song ban/ sadam 'jang gi dmag dpung kyang slebs nas byang chu lung na khra'i g.yas zur du gur sngon po nam mkha'i mdog can phub cing / rgyab ru dang mdun ru/g.yas ru dang g.yon ru bcas tshang ma sgrig bkod ltar 'khod pa dang /'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur de 'jigs pa'i chas bco brgyad kyis spras nasaphyi nang bar gsum blon po nyer gcig gis bskor nas 'dug go /phyi nyin gyi rta a dus su bo phyogs mon gyi dmag dpung de chu sna brdol ba bzhin mon dung skyong stag lha khri dkar blon po sum brgyas bskor nas slebs/ a cha 'ba' dang stag gzig gi dmag dpung de yang char sprin 'khrigs pa bzhin du nang blon zhal dkar ldan bde blon po nyis brgyas bskor nas thon/ de nasarim bzhin nag po bdud dang kha che bcas rdzong chen dag gi dpung dmag khab ste yug 'tshab pa bzhin sgar gral bsgrigs nas dgung spri sngon du bsagayogs le/ sa gzhi dmag gis bkang le/ pho dpa' bos mthong na yid sems dga' le/ sdar mas rig na sgyid pa 'dar le/ sa dog mos ma zeg 'khun sgra shor le bcas lta ba mig gis mi bzod/ nyan pa rna yis mi tshugs pa zhig byas nas a grags kyi yul la chas so/ /sgang ba sprigrags kyi nga zhes bya ba g.yang brag dkar snang mar gsham/la zi ra dkar mo'i tshur nang / thang nag po gsum gyi 'dus mdo zer bar chags la/ dus der mkhar rdzong rdo mkhar srug po'i shar phyogs kyi zig khra 211

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /bar snang zil gnon nas 'dre bya 'ug pas gshog 'gyur brgyab/ zhag gcigasong ba'i phyi nyin nub kyi phag gdong g.yas par rgod babs/ bye lung chu migagong ma la than gyi dru la nag lto sbyar mthong ba sogs ltasang na pa sna tshogs byung/srib lung rma khya sprung rdzong nas a bye zhal dkar de dri lam ma legs pas blomabade bar/ srin mo sprel mgo ma bos shing mo lung btab/ mo yig tu mkhar yang mi dbang / rgyal sa mnga' 'bangs bcas pa shor/ bstan pa'i chusamizin/ yul 'pho 'gyur dang dar rgud 'byung zer ba babs pas/ rgyal blon tshang ma blo ma/bde 'tshub 'tshub/ yid mi bde snying rlung 'khrug 'khrug agrags dpon po nyi ma grags pa der mgo spyo bo'i gtsug nas gzer gcig langs/ rkang mthil drug rgyud la ta ler song / byang khog kun dga' ra ba nas bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis btang / blo rtse nyi shu rtsa lnga bkod mthar dam ga rgyag gi bkod pa 'phen nas la chu 'phrang gsum bkag ste rlung bser mayin kyang mi bar ba zhig byas nas bsdad do/ /de nas gling gi dpung dmag de sgang ba sprigrags yul du slebs shing /gling dang a grags gnyis kyi bar mi shi rta 'byel dang khyod shi nga gson gyi g.yul 'gyed drag po byas/ rim bzhin a grags kyi blon po gang drag dang /btsan skya ya med/ sgo nga'i mi rta thams cad pham par bzos nas me tog ra bsogs sa btsan gling gis bzung / stag mo kher rdzong gtor/ nyi grags rgyal po pham nas zengs mang 'bro bsams kyang 'bro ma thub par mthar gling la mgo 'bul lus 'bul byas/ a grags kyi phu mda' bar gsum yul sde tshang ma212

gcod pa don grub dang snying botshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ bar snang zilaganon na4'dre bya zhug pasagashog 'gyur brgyab/ zhag gcigasong ba'i phyi nyin nub kyi phag gdong g.yasapar rgod babs/ bye lung chu migagong ma la than gyi sbrulanag ltosbyar mthong ba sogasaltasangan pa snatshogasabyung/srib lung rma bya lding rdzong nasa.amye zhal dkar de rmi lam malegasapasasgomabade bar/ srin mo sprel mgo mabosashing mo lung btab/ moyig tu mkhar yang mi dbang / rgyal 4mnga' 'bangasabacasapa shor/ bstan pa'i chusamizin/ yul 'pho 'gyur dang dar rgud 'byung zer ba babasapas/ rgyalablonatshang ma blo ma bde 'tshub 'tshub/ yid mi bde snying rlung 'khrug 'khrug agragasadapon po nyi ma gragasapa der mgo spyi bo'i gtsug nasagazer gcig langs/ rkang mthiladrug rgyud lata ler song / byang khog kun dga' ra banasabasamablobazhi gsum bcu gnyisabatang / blo rtse nyi shu rtsa lnga bkod mthar dmag rgyag gi bkod pa 'then nasal chu 'phrang gsum bkag ste rlung bser mayin kyang mithar ba zhig byasanasabasdad do/ /de nasagling gi dpung dmag de sgang ba agragasayul du slebasashing /gling dang agragasaganyiyokyi bar mishi rta 'gyel dang khyod shi nga gson gyi g.yul 'gyed drag po byas/ rim bzhin agragasakyi blon po gang drag dang /btsan skya 5med/ sgo nga'i mirta thamasacad phamapar bzosanasametog ra bsogasasabatsan gling gisabazung / stag mo khor rdzong gtor/ nyi gragayorgyalapo phamanasatheng4mang 'bro bsamasakyang 'bro ma thub par mthar gling la mgo 'ahādi 2lu4'bul byas/ agragasakyi phu mda' bar gsum yul sdetshang ma

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/dkar po chos la bsgyur/ nag phyogs bstan pa rmang nas spangs/ sal tsha tsha/rdo la ma ṇi yig drug rten bzhengs bshags sbyangs skor ba sogs dang /dge ba bcu'i khrims rnam par dag pa btsugs/ drug pa chu stod zla ba'i tshesabacu gsum / nyi ma 'brug gi dus su res gza' 'od zer dgu ba/ resa'agros gsal ba'i bu mo/ nyi ma/ lcags kyi rta/ spar kha dmar/ sbe ba ljang /dus tshod mi rigs pa'i pha de ye dus der/ sgang dang khra po1nga gnyis kyi g.yu'i 'byed kyi rting thag chod cing 'dzam bu gling la gzi 'khyed btang ba 'di be+e khra bo'i gzi rdzong phab pa'i lo rgyus so/ /gling sgrung gces btus〈a grags gzi rdzong〉legs sgrig byed pa'i skabs su/ mtsho sngo na mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i sgrung dpe de gzhir bzung nas sngon chad kyi sgrung dpe lag bris ma/ dang shing dpar ma bcas 'brel yod kyi sgrung dpe mang por zur lta bgyis te/ legs cha yod tshad gang nus kyis bsdu ci thub byas yod par ma zad/ gleng sgrung gcesabatus kyi legs sgrig rtsa don dang blang bya ltar du bsgrigs yod pa lagasaso/ /〈a grags gzi rjong〉gi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/1gang ba a grags —/ ge sar rgyal po'i dus skabs kyi rgyal phran zhig yin la/ yal de ru gser dngul zangs lcags kyi gter mang po mchisapar ma zad/ rin chen gzi'i gter yang yo da pa'i gnas mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin/ a grags zhes pa'i rgyal phran de g.ya' brag dkar mo 'a mar 213

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/dkar po chosal bsgyur/ nag phyogasabastan pa rmang nasaspangs/ salatsha tsha/rdo lam ṇi yig drug rten bzhengasabashagasasbyangasaskor ba sogasadang /dge ba bcu'i khrimasarnamapar dag pa btsugs/ drug pa chu stod zaba'i tshesabacu gsum/ nyi ma 'brug gi dusasuresagaza' 'od zer dgu ba/ resa'agrosagasal ba'i bu mo/ nyi ma lcagasakyi rta/ spar kha dmar/ sme ba ljang /dusatshod mi rigasapa'i pha de yidusader/ sgang dang khra pogling gnyisakyi g.yul 'gyed kyi rting thag chod cing 'dzamabu gling la gzi 'gyed btang ba 'di ni khra bo'i gzi rdzong phab pa'i lorgyusaso/ /gling sgrung gcesabatus〈agrag4gzi rdzong〉legasasgrig byed pa'i skab4su/ mtsho sngon mi rigasadape skrun khang gisapar du bskrun pa'i sgrung dpe de gzhir bzung nasasngon chad kyi sgrung dpe lag brisamadang shing dpar ma bca4'brel yod kyi sgrung dpe mang por zur ltabagyi4te/ legasacha yod tshad gang nusakyisabasdu ci thub byasayod par yozad/ gling sgrung gcesaṭ+wātusakyi leg4sgrig rtsa don dang blang bya ltar du bsgrigasayod pa lags〈a grags gzi rdzong〉gi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/1 sgang ba a grags ni/ ge sar rgyalapo'i du4skab4kyi rgyal phran zhig yin la/ yul de ru gser dngulazangasalcagasakyi gter mang po mchi4par ma zad/ rin chen gzi'i gter yang yod pa'i gnasamachog tu gyur pa zhig yin/ agrag4zheyopa'i rgyal phran de g.ya' brag dkar mos snar

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsham/ lazi ra dkar mo'i tshur nang / thang nag pogasumagyi 'dusamado na chagasayod par bshad la/ da lnganged cag gisadapyad gzhi'i yig cha skor zhig lasartogasapaltar na/ bye ri'i rgyalaphran dang ladwagasargyalaphran/ yogragasargyal phran bcasapa phan tshun nye sar chagasa'adug go/2 a grags rgyal po ni/ ming hrilabor agragasanyi mgragasapazer/ agragasadang gling gnyisagayul 'gyed mang po bya4mthar agragasargyal po pham nasagling lamago btags/ rjesasuladwagasadang 'khrug skabasa.agragasanyi masashi ba srog lami'adzemapar ladwagasadang gtug resabyas/mthar ladwagasakyi khri dgra lag dmar bsad pa dang mnyamadu kholayang rmasaskyon thebasanasatshe lasa'adasaso/ /3 khrims yig zhal lce ni/ gtsang pasdesrid gamabastan skyobadabang bosabod ladabang sgyur byed skabasazhal lce bco lnga lasadapa' bo stagagi zhalartsedang / sdar yowa'i zhalartseganyisador nagazhal lce bcu gsumadu gtan laphab pa'i khrimasalugasadon tshan bcu gsumalakhrim4yig zhalartsebacu gswāma~X dū t+na ltar ṭ+wāṃ /h+phu/ 'bod ming ngamabyisapa'i don la khug go/5 gyi ling ni/ sprul sgyur thubapa'i rta mchog bzang pol gyi lingazer zhing / gyi ling ngamagyi ling rta zhesagang bder sbyar chog go/6 bsam gtan ni/ dmig4partsegacig tu gtad pa'i 'gyur medā nā semasadang sgosogasakyi ming ngo / /

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsham/ la zi ra dkar yong tshur nang / thang nag po gsum gyi 'dus mdo na chags yod par bshad la/ da lta nged cag gis dpyad gzhi'i yig cha skor zhig las rtogs pa ltar na/ bye ri'i rgyal phran dang la dwags rgyal phran/ sprigrags rgyal phran bcas pa phan tshan nye sar chags 'dug go/2a grags rgyal po —/ ming hril bor a grags nyi ma grags pa zer/ a grags dang gleng gnyis g.yul 'gyed mang po byas mthar ga gragasargyal po pham nas gling lamago btags/ rjes sa la dgas dang 'a ga skabasasprigrags nyi mas shi ba srog la cha 'dzem par la dwags dang gtug res byas/mthar la dwags kyi khri dgra lag dmar bsad pa dang mnyam du kho la yang rmasaskyon phebs nas tshe las 'das so/ /3 khrams yig zhal lce ni/ gtsang pa sde srid karma bstan skyong dbang bos bod la dbang sgyur byed skabs zhal lce bco lnga las dpa' bo stagagi zhal lce dang / sdar ma wa'i zhal lce gnyis dor nas zhal lce bcu gsum du gtan la phab pa'i khrims lugs don tshan bcu gsum la khrims yig zhalartsebacu gsum zer ba ltar ro/ /4a nu ni/ nu bo' 'bod ming ngam byes pa'i don la 'jug go/5gyi ling da/ pas sgyur thub pa'i rta mchog bzang po la gyi leng zer zhing / gyi ling ngam gyi ling rta zhes gang bder sbyar chog go/6 bsam gtan —/ dmigs brtse gcig tu gtad pa'i 'gyur sted kyi sems dang blo sogs kyi ming ngo / /214

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/7 khro bo rta mgrin cha/ drag por khros pa'i ⑪dam gyi lha zhig gi ming ngo / /8 chems ni/ ser skya mang tshogs las khyad du 'phags pa'i skyes bu pho po dag gi sol che yo zhes zhe so'i tshig spyor zhing / dper na sangs rgyasakyi tshe lo lta bu/ btsem gyi skul tshig la'ang 'jug go/9 nyi 'bum dar yag ni/ gling che rgyud tshang gi gdung rgyud dam gling dpa' rtul sum cu'i tso rgyal yin la/ rta pho'i ming lang nga ba gser sgong zer/ hor/ 'jang / mon/ sog po/ mi nub/ kha che sogs rdzong grangasamed pa 'dul dus gnams sa 'degs dka' ba'i byas rjes rlabs po che bzhag lhag par du〈hor gling g.yu tha'abyed〉nang du gur ser rgyal po gtsos pa'i hor dmag grangs med bsad nas dpa' bo'i mtshan snyan phyogasabazhi mtshams brgyad du khyab pa zhig go/10 jong sna/ gna' rabs su rgyal khab dang rgyal phran dag gi bar la dus rgyun 'thab 'dzing byung bas tsho khag so sos rang nyid kyi bde 'jagasasrung spyob byed pa'i ched du mkhar rgyang mthon por brtsegs nas phyi'i dgra bo 'gog byed kyi 'thab ra dang bcas pa ldan pa lamakhar rdzong zhes 'bod/drang phyogs dang ldog phyogs gnyis kyi dpa' rtul dang dpa' chen gang yin rung so sor ming mi 'dra ba'i rdzong re yod/ dper na/ khra stod gnam sdong phyug mo/ khro thung pho rog snyeng rdzong / hor gyi tso zi mkhar dmar rdzong sogasamang po yod pa ltar ro/ /215

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/ngo / /1 khro bo rta mgrin ni/ drag por khrosapa'i yidamagyi lhazhig gi ming8 chems ni/ ser skya mang tshogasalasakhyad du 'phagasapa'i skyesabu chen po dag gi solachemasazhesazhe sa'i tshig sbyor zhing / dper na sangasargyasakyi chemasaltabu/ btsemagyi skulatshig la'ang 'jug go/9 nyi 'bum dar yag ni/ glingache rgyud tshang gi gdung rgyud dalogling dpa' rtulasuyocu'i 5gyalayin la/ rta pho'i ming langang bgaser sgong zer/ hor/ 'jang / mon/ sog po/ minub/ khache sogasardzong grangasamed pa 'duladusaganamasasa'adegasadaka' ba'i byasarjesarlabasapo che bzhag lhag par du hor gling g.yula'agyed〉nang du gur ser rgyalapo gtso4pa'i hor dmag grangasamed bsad nasadapa' bo'i mtshan snyan phyogasabazhi mtshamasabargyad du khyabapazhig go/10 rdzong ni/ gna' rabayosurgyalakhab dang rgyalaphran dag gi bar ladusargyun 'thaba'adzingabyung bsatsho khag sososarang nyid kyi bde 'jagasasrung skyob byed pa'i ched du mkhar gyang mthon por brtsigasanasaphyi'i dgra bo 'gog byed kyi 'thab ra dang bcasapaldan pa lamakhar rdzong zhesa'abod/drang phyog4dang ldog phyogasaganyi4kyi dpa' rtuladang dpa' chen gang yin rung sosor ming mi'adra ba'i rdzong re yod/ dper na/ khra stod gnamardzong phyug mo/ khro thung pho rog snying rdzong / hor gyi 5zi mkhar dmar rdzong sogasamang po yod pa ltar ro/ / 215

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /11 zhal dkar rki/ sprigrags rgyal po'i blon po grags chen zhig yin/ zhal dkar ldan pa ni stag gzig yul gyi khyad mi stobs chen zhig gi ming / stag gzig yul khams bde la bkod rjes kho rang stag gzig gi dpon por bzhag zhal dkar dang rgya tsha zhal dkar/ 'al dkar ldan pa gsum ni mi gcig min no/ /12 zi ling —/ da lta'i mtsho sngon zhing dza gyi chab dpal rig gsum gyi ste gnas te srid gzhung chags sa'i gnas yin/ bshad pa ltar na 1nga rje ge sar rgyal pos zi ling rta rdzong phab ste mdo smad rta'i chos kha zhesamatshar snyan phyogs bcur khyab par gleng ngo / /13 zing tsha rgya stag dmar po —/ sprigrags rgyal po'i dmag dpon ming grags can zhig gi ming ngo / /14 rdo mkhar sprug po ni/ a grags yul gyi dam/ga 'du sa rdosabartsigs pa'i mkhar rdzong zhig gi ming ngo / /15 sha za cha/ za ba sha dang btung ba khrag la byed pa'i sems can nam srin po la zer ro/ /16 maṇ+ḍal ji/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi cho gar mkho ba'i mchod rdzas bye brag cig gi ming ngo / /17 sras khye chung —/ a grags rgyal po nyi ma/ grags pa'i sra sa po yin/ tsha zhang 'dan mas mda' gcig gi kha nas lnga ba'i lam du brdzangasapar grags so/ /216

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/11 zhal dkar ni/ agragasargyal po'i blon po gragasachen zhig yin/ zhal dkar ldan pa ni stag gzig yul gyi gyad mi stobasachen zhig gi ming / stag gzig yulakhamasabade labakod rjes kho rang stag gzig gi dpon ṭ+wāṃ~X baṭ+wāṃgamizhaṭ+wādakar dang rgya tsha zhal dkar/ zhal dkar ldan pagasum ༵ 2 kā kyā tre sna / da/ lko mtsho sngon zhing ོ gyi chab dpalarig gsumagyi lte gnayote srid gzhung chagasasa'i gan4yin/ bshad pa ltar na gling rje ge sar rgyal poyozi ling rta rdzong phab ste mdo smad rta'i chol kha zhesamatshan snyan phyogasabacur khyab par gleng ngo / /13 sprung tsha rgya stag dmar po ni/ agragasargyal po'i dmag dpon ming gragasacan zhig gi ming ngo / /14 rdo mkhar sprug po ni/ agragasayulagyi dmag 'du sardosabartsigasapa'i mkhar rdzong zhig gi ming ngo /gri1ṭ+wāṃka ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ/ za ba sha dang btung ba khrag la byed pa'i semasacananam sa/ du ༵ ༵༵ rje// / sangayorgya4cho4lugasakyi cho gar mkho ba'i mchod rdzasabye brag cig gi ming ngo / /17 sras khri chung ni/ agrag4rgyalapo nyi ma gragasapa'i sra4po yin/ tsha zhang 'dan masamada' gcig gi kha nasalnga ba'i lam du badzangasapa~X nāgasaso/ /

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/zung zug /sgo 1—1 1yo18 khu byug pad ma nya grags na/ srug 'jang dmag da na dpa' rtsal can zhig yin la/ gtso 'thab gang mang zhig gi nang du bsub thabs dben pa'i dpa' dzo rang gshis gsal bor mar yod do/ /19 rmya thag —/ bon chos las lha rnams yar 'go mar 'bab kyi them skas lta bu zhig gi ming ngo / /20 bshas ra —/ mi grangs med gsod e sa der bshas ra zhesa'abod do/ /21 shang shang te'u —/ smad bya la stod mi'i rnam pa'i gshog pa can zhig gi ming ngo / /22 rta pho gro god 'phur shes ni/ a grags rgyal po'i blon po sprimyes zhal dkar gyi chibs pa'i ming yin no/ /bzhi ba/ 〈kha che g.yu rjong〉gling sgrung gces btus〈kha che g.yu rdzong〉gi brjod bya'i don kyi snying bo ni sngon pad ma 'byung gnas bod du byon nas bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ bod kyi lha srin sde brgyad dam la btags/ bod khams bde la bkod cing zab gsang bla med kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ las ma dag cing ltab log pa'i bdud blon klu dpal de nyid smin grol gyi sam thob pasang na song gi skye ba 'ga' zhig brgyud mthar kha che rgyal po'i srasasa'u sa blangs nas ming la khri brtan rgyal po zer/ lo dgu lon pa'i dus der bal bo rgyal khab dbang du bsdus/ lo bco brgyad lon dus 'ol kha rgyal po 217

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/18 khu byug pad ma nyi grags ni/ smug po'ajang gi dmag dpon dpa' rtsal can zhig yin la/ g.yul 'thab gang mang zhig gi nang du bsub thab4dben pa'i dpa' bo'i rang gshisagasal bor mtshon yod do/ /19 rmuzlo kā nā/ ༵na chosalasalharnamasayar 'go mar 'bab kyi them ma~Xṭ+wāṃdī /kā ༵ rdo nga /mi gra/ngasamed gsod e sader bshasar zhesa'abo~Xṭ+wāṃ//༵/ ngango shang te'u ni/ smad bya la stod mi'i rnam pa'i gshog pa can ༵ 2 bhe pho gro/ rgo/da 'phur shes ni/ agragasargyal po'i blon po askyesazhal dkar gyi chib4pa'i ming yin no/ /bzhi ba/ 〈kha che g.yu rdzong〉gling sgrung gcesabatus(kha che ga༅rdzong〉gi brjod bya'i don gyi snying bo ni sngon pad ma 'byung gnasabod du byon nasabasam yasalhun gyi4grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ bod kyi lhasrin sde brgyad dam la btags/ bod khamasabade labakod cingazab gsang blamed kyi choyokyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ lasamadag cing ltab log pa'i bdud blon klu dpal de nyid smin grol gyi sam thob pasangan song gi skye ba 'ga' zhig brgyud mthar kha che rgyal po'i srasasu'u sablangasanasaming lakhri brtan rgyal po zer/ lo dgu lon pa'i dusader bal bo rgyal khab dbang du bsdus/ lobaco brgyad lon du4'olakhaṭ+wāṃ~Xpo

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'bangasasubakod/ pho lonyer bdun steng smyug khargyalapo'i pha chosaphyogasanasanyin bzhin ngan lang gi rdulabartsegasaje mthor song / de nasabasobla'i tshe4drug gi nyin yid semasagadon gyisabaslusapa ltar kha che lasadamag gling la'adren dgosapa'i bka' gnamalcagasathog 'dra babs/ kha che blon pogragasachen khu bo klu yag ru ring / rdo rgod me'abar/ 5med thog khri bubatsanagasumagyisarta dmag sum khri hrag bsduyobyasanasakhra mogling la dpuba'ajug byas/ gling dang khache gnyisare zhig khyod shi nga gson gyi dmar 'dzibabyasate mi shi rta 'gyel mang pobyung / stag rong dpon po khro thung gi4jusakyi phyi nang brjesashing gsang gtamayod tshad dgra labashad/ kha che blon pothog khri gtso4pa'i rda ra dpon blon bzhi4zi ma'i rgya lam ring moru 'om bu'i tshong bal lam sgug byasan4tshong rdzasayod tshad phrogs/ tshong phrug rnamasashi rmasasubatang / gling ba lanyam4nyesachen po byung zhing rong srasalhargod 'bum lugatsosagling dmag brgya phrag mang po ramanag ser bsabacom 'dra byas/sngag4nag cho4'bar ka rasagator zor 'phangasapasasdig gcod shanapargyal po dran med du brgyal/ sha lan du byang bye ri'i cho4'grub dpa' bosakhra mgo mig dmar gyi gson snying bton/ 'bru sga sdechosaskyong ber nag gisabadud rje yiklad khrag gtor/ seng stag dpon gyisadug chu'i mgo ske blangasapabacasarimapa bzhin dpa' rtuladapung gisadagra ngan bdud rigasamang pomeg med bzosamathar/ khache rgyalapo de 'u thug nasagling sgar la mchongasanaX/8 sar dang 'thab resabyasashing / seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyis

gcod pa don grub dang snyeng bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'bangs sa bkod/ pho lo nyer bdun steng smyug kha rgyal po'i pha chos phrogasanas nyin bzhin ngan lang gi rdul brtsegs ji mthor song / de nas bso zla'i tshes drug gi nyin yid sems gdon gyis bslus pa ltar kha che las dmag gling la 'dren dgos pa'i bka' gnam lcags thog 'dra babs/ kha che blon 6grags chen khu bo klu yag ru ring / rdo rgod me 'bar/ bo med thog khri bu btsan gsum gyis rta dmag sum khri hrag bsdus byas nas khra mo gling la dpung 'jug byas/ gling dang kha che gnyis re zhig khyod shi nga gson gyi dmar 'dzing byas te mi shi rta 'gyel mang po byung / stag rong dpon po khro thung gis jus kyi phyi nang brjes shing gsang gtam yod tshad dgra la bshad/ kha che zon po thogakhri gtsos pa'i rda ra dpon blon bzhis zi ma'i rgya lam ring mo ru 'om bu'i tshong ba la lam sgug byas nas tshong rdzas yod tshad phrogs/ tshong phrug rnams shi rmasag btang / gling ba la nyams nyes chen po byung zhing rong sras la rgod 'bum lugacos gling dmag brgya phrag mang po ra yon ga ser bas bcom 'dra byas/sngags nag chos 'bar ka ras gtor zor 'phangs pas sdeg gcod shan pa rgyal po dran sked du brgyal/ sha lan du byang bye ri'i chos 'grub dpa' bos khra mgo mig dmar gyi gson snyeng bton/ 'bru sga sde chos skyong ber nag gisabadud rje ye klad khrag gtor/ seng stag dpon gyis dug cha' mgo ske blangasapa bcas rim pa bzhin dpa' rtul dpung gis dgra ngan bdud rigs mang po meg med bzos mthar/ kha che rgyal po de 'u thug nas gling sgar la mchongasanas ge sar dang 'thab res byas shing / seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyis218

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/ralagri btab palan med kyisalnga ba'i lamadu brdzangs/ ga༅rdzongablangasanasagayu'agyed btang bdang gling stag rong dpon pokhro thung labyang lharta mgrin dmar po'i lung bstan byunganasamichung khabade myulamar song stelho.abase'i 4char rgyusalon byas/ lho'ibaseyulagyi srin po dang gling dpa' rtularnamayokyisagayula'agyed drag pobyas/ rjesasu.abasergyalaXgling la'akhor/sra4༷ge ṭ+wāṃr gyi ja mar gyur pa bcasakhrabardzong dang ga༅rdzong blangasapa'i lorgyus—ṭ+wāṃ ༷ /sgrung/ gcesabatus〈khache g.yurdzong〉zhe4ba'adi legasasgrig byed skabasagatso bo bod ljongasamirig4dpe skrunakhang nasapar du bskrun pa'i〈khache ga༅rdzong〉dang mtsho sngon mirigasadaposkrun khang nasapar skrun gnang ba'i〈gling gi bro ra yid 'phrog pad dkar phreng mdzes〉kyi nang gses(lho.abasekhrab rdzong〉gnyisarmang gzhir bzung ba dang gzhan mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi sgrung pa skad gragasacan tshe ring dbang 'dusamachog la bka' 'dri yang yang byasanasalegayopar bsgrigasapa lagasamod/ 'on kyang bod ljong4mirigasadape skrun khang gisapar skrun gnang ba'i〈khache g.yurdzong〉ni le'u bkar med pa dang yig nor dang phalaskad migo ba dang mibade ba mang ba/ gling sgrung gcesabatusakyi rtsa don dang tshad gzhi dag lamimathun pa'ang mchi4pasalegasasgrig mkhan ladaka' khag minyung ba bzosabadang / sgrung dpode'i nang du drang ldog phyogasakyi migason padang 'chi ba sogasasgrung khag sngon marnamasadang 'gal ba byung ba'ang yod cing / mtshamasamatsham4sunang don yangaṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃg

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/ral gri btab pa lan med kyis lnga ba'i lam du bsdangs/ g.yu rdzong blangasan g.yu 'byed btang ba dang gling stag dong dpon po khro thung la byang lha rta mgrin dmar po'i lung bstan byung nas cha chung kha bde myul mar song ste lhospribacung lo char rgyus lon byas/ lho spribs yul gyi srin po dang gling dpa' rtularnams kyis g.yul 'byed drag po byas/ rjes sa spribs rgyal po gling la 'khor/sras mo ge sar gyi ja mar gyur pa bcas khrab rdzong dang g.yu rdzong blangs pa'i lo rgyus yin no/ /gling sgrung gces btus〈kha che g.yu rdzong〉zhes pa 'di legs sgrig byed skabs gtso bo bod ljongs mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par du bskrun pa'i〈khache g.yu rdzong〉dang mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par skrun gnang ba'i〈gling gi bro ra yid 'phrog pad dkar phreng mdzes〉kyi nang gses〈lto a bsokhrab rdzong〉gnyis rmang gzhir bzung ba dang gzhan mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi sgrung pa skad grags can tshe ring dbang 'dus mchog la bka' 'dri yang yang byasanas legs par bsgrigs pa lags mod/ 'on kyang bod ljongs mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par skrun gnang ba'i〈kha che g.yumang〉ni le'u bkar med pa dang yig nor dang phal skad mi go ba dang mi bde ba mang ba/ gleng sgrung gcesabatus kyi rtsa don dang tshad gzhi dag la mi mthun pa'ang mchis pas legs sgrig mkhan la dka' khag ba nyung ba bzos pa dang / sgrung dpe de'i nang du drang ldog phyogs kyi mi gson pa dang 'chi ba sogs sgrung khag sngon ma rnams dang 'gal ba byung ba'ang yod cing / mtshamathamatshams sa nang don yang go ldog 29

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byung yod pa/ sgrung khag 'di dang〈lho spribacu khrab rdzong〉gnyis mthudadebasgrigs na nang don gyi cha dang mi sna'i cha gtam rgyud byung ba'i dus rabs kyi cha sogs la 'gal ba cung zad re yod pa bcas yin yang / che phyogasasugand don mang po rnged pas nged cag gis dka' tshegs la ma/ 'dzems par yang yang bsam gzhig dang zhib bsdur dag bcos bgyis te klog pa po rnamasakyi spyan lam du phul ba lags so/〈kha che g.yu stsong〉gi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad1 kha che rki/ bod kyi mnga' ris dang bal bor 'brel chags pa'i khabang yul khams te nags tshal dang ri skyes sna tshogs 'dzom/sa pa dang khyad par du gur gum skye gnas kyi sa cha skad grags can zhig yin skad/ sa de ru rin chen gser dngul sogs kyi gter kha mod po yod par ma zad rin chen g.yuni de bas kyang ga sa kun tu mthong rgyu yo da zer ro/ /2 ba brtan rgyal po —/ sngon slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnasabod du byon nas bsam yas mi 'gyur gtsug la ga khang bzhengs/ bod kyi lhasrin sde brgyad dam la btags nas bod khams yongs bde la bkod/ zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba'i tshe/ dkar po chos la ltab 'o ga pa'i bdud blon klu dpal de nyid la smin grol gyi sam thob par ngan song gi gnasa'aga' brgyud mthar/ kha che rgyal po' sras su lus blangs nas khri brtan rgyal por grags/ rim bzhin 'dod pa cher 'phel nas bal bo dang smyug khasogs rgyal phran 'ga' dbang du bsdus/ phyis sa gling la dmag drangs nas220

gcod pa don grub dang snyingabo tshe ring gi ched rtsomaphyogs bsgrigs/byung yod pa/ sgrung khag 'di dang〈lho.abasekhyab rdzong〉gnyisamathud de bsgrigasan nang don gyi cha dang mi sna'i cha gtamargyud byung ba'i dusarabasakyi cha sogasal 'gal ba cung zad re yod pa bcas yin yang / che phyogasasugand don mang po med pasanged cag gisadaka' tshegasalam 'dzemasapar yang yang bsam gzhig dang zhibabasdur dag bcosabagyisate klog pa po rnamasakyi spyan ༵/ sbyi sna~X rjo /snaso mi/nga brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad1 kha che no/ bod kyi mnga' risadang bal bor 'brel chagasapa'i khache'i yul khamasate nag4tshal dang ri skyesasna tshogasa'adzomasapa dang khyad par du gur gum skye gan4kyi sacha skad gragasacan zhig yin skad/ sade ru rinachen gser dngul sog4kyi gter kha mod po yod par ma zad rin chen g.yuni de ba4kyang ga sakun tu mthong rgyu yod zer ro/ /2khri brtanargyal po ni/ sngon slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnasabod du byon nasabasamayasami'agyur gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ bod kyi lhasrin sde brgyad dam la btagasanasabod kham4yongasabade la bkod/ zab rgyasachosakyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba'i tshe/ dkar po cho4la ltab 'o ga pa'i bdud blon klu dpal de nyid lasmin grol gyi sam thob par ngan song gi gnasa'aga' brgyud mthar/ kha che rgyal po'i srasasulu4blang4nas khri brtan rgyalapor grags/ rim bzhin 'dod pa cher 'phel na4b.labo dang smyug khasokā~Xrgyal phran 'ga' dbang du bsdus/ phyisasugleng la dmag drangayonas

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/g.yula'agyed drag po byasamathar/ gling rje ge sar rgyalaposakha che khri brtan de nyid btul cing kha che bde la bkod/ ga༅rdzong phab bo/ /2 klu yag ru ring ni/ khache dpon blon gsumagyi 5gyal/ khache khri brtan rgyal po'i khubo yin/ khosakha che rgyalapo'i bka' ltar rta dmag sumakhri hrag sgrig byasanasakhra mo gling la dmag sna drangs/ drag po'i g.yul 'gyed the~X4ṭ+wāṃgar byas/ mjug mthar g.yulhathog 'gyur gyisaral gri'i sol ba na ༵/ li/ li ni/ kha skad de byi la'i ming gzhan yin no/ /5 mu stegs ni/ phyi rol mu stegasapa ste/ skyabasa'agro khasami len pa'i nang bamayin pa de'o/ /6 thog khri bu btsan ni/ khache rgyalapo'i blon chen zhig yin/ rda ra drag grasarnamasakyi yagyal te/ khosazi ma'i rgya lam nas 'om bu'i tshong ba rnamasa'aphrog bcomabyas/ phyisasasdig gcod shan pasabasad do/ /7 de ra ni/ khache yed ra dang gling gi dpa' rtul/ hor gyi padur/stag gzig gi gyad mi sogasadon gcig ming gi rnamagrangasaso/ /8 me chu rlung gsum ni/ yamed rdo rgod me'abar/ bdud rje rlung nag 'tshub shes/ gza' bdud dug chu khol mgasum mo/ /9 gsang sngags ni/ chosamado sngagasaganyisalasasngagasate/ sgrub ༵ posagasang nasabasgrub dgoyopa'i sngagasayin pasagasang sngagasazer 221

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor— 'grel bshad/g.yul 'byed drag po byas mthar/ gling rje ge sar rgyal pos kha che khri brtan de nyid btul cing kha che bde la bkod/ g.yu rdzong phab bo/ /3 klu yag ru ring ni/ kha che dpon blon gsum gyi mi rgyal/ kha che khri brtan rgyal po'i khu bo yin/ khos kha che rgyal po'i bka' ltar rta dmag sumakhri hrag sgrig byas nas khra mo gling la dmag sna drangs/ drag po'i g.yul 'khyed thengs 'gar byas/ mjug ma/thar g.yu lha thog 'gyur gyis ral gri'i sol bskyon no/ /4 le li —/ kha skad de byi la 'i ming gzhan yin no/ /5 mu stegs —/ phyi rol mu stegs pa ste/ skyabs 'gro khas mi len pa'i nang ba ma yin pa de'o/ /6 phogs bu btsan —/ kha che rgyal po'i zon chen zhig yin/ rda ra drag gras rnams kyi mi rgyal te/ khos zi ma'i rgya lam nas 'om 6'i tshong ba rnams 'phrog bcom byas/ phyis sa sdeg gcod shan pas bsad do/ /7 rda ra ni/ kha che ⑪rda ra dang gleng gi dpa' rtul/ hor gyi pa dur/stag gzig gi rgyad mi sogs don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so/ /8 me chu rlung gsum ni/ tham da rdo rgod me 'bar/ bdud rje rlung nag 'tshub shes/ gza' bdud dug chu khol ma gsum mo/ /9 gsang sngags ni/ chos mdo sngags gnyis las sngags te/ sgrub pa pos gsang nas bsgrub dgos pa'i sngags yin pas gsang sngags zer ro/ /221

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/10 a nu phying sngon —/ spri nu seng phran gyi bu yin zhing / chubadus sa rong btsan khab dkar po'i yul du nar son/ bdud klu btsan rgyulapos btsan gyis phrogs nas bdud yul gyi ra rdzir bzhag phyis sa smon lamagyi dbang gis ge sar dang mna' grogs bsgrigs shing bdud rgan 'dulaskabs kha zhe gnyis med kyis rogs ram mang po byas so/ /11 brgya byin be+e/ mig stong can dang lha'i dbang bo'ang zer/brgya byen che ba ni sum cu rtsa gsum gyi bdag po dang brgya byin chung ba ni shar gyi phyogs sgong ngo / /12 sto 'gro —/ spru dza gyi ming gzhan no/ /13 drung be+e btsan po ni/ rda ra brgya rtsa'i bo rgyal te/ kha che khri brtan gyi mdun blon grags can zhig gi ming ngo / /14 g.yu dzad tshangs pa'i rme ru —/ kha che rgyal po'i nang blon grags can zhig ste/ bshad pa ltar na lho 'dzam bu gleng gi sa cha la/ rme ru thogs pa'i migasum yod/ hor gur dkar stag zhu rgyal po la/ sdeg gcod shan pa rja ru yong/ gru gu thog rgod rgyal po la/ mgyogs pa'i gza' bdud rme ru yod/ kha che khri brtan rgyal po la/ g.yu rgod tshangs pa'i rja ru yod/ces zer la/ kha gling g.yus 'byed skabs sdig gcod shan pas bsad do/ /15 kha mgo mig dmar —/ kha che rgod po me chu rlung gsum dang 'dra ba'i dmag dpon grags can zhig dang khri brtan rgyal po'i blo 'don 222

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/10 a nu phying sngon ni/ anu seng phran gyi bu yin zhing / chub dusasurang btsan khab dkar po'i yuladu nar son/ bdud klu btsan rgyalaposabatsan gyisaphyogasanasabadud yulagyi ra rdzir bzhag phyi4susmon lamagyi dbang gisage sar dang mna' grogasabasgrig4shing bdud rgan 'dulaskabasakhazhe gnyisamed kyisarogasaramamang po byasaso/ /11 brgya byin ni/ mig stong can dang lha'i dbang bo'ang zer/brgya byin che ba ni sumacu rtsa gsumagyi bdag podang brgya byin chung ba ni shar gyi phyogasaskyong ngo / /12 sto 'gro ni/ sbrulagyi ming gzhan no/ /13 drung lha btsan po ni/ rda ra brgya rtsa'i 5gyal te/ kha che khri brtan gyi mdun blon gragasacan zhig gi ming ngo / /14 g.yu rgod tshangs pa'i rme ru ni/ kha che rgyal po'i nang blon gragasacan zhig ste/ bshad pa ltar na lho'adzam bu gling gi sacha la/ me ru thogasapa'i migasumayod/ hor gur dkar stag zhu rgyal po la/ sdig gcod shan pa me ru yod/ gru gu thogargod rgyalapo la/ mgyogasapa'i gza' bdud me ru yod/ khache khri brtan rgyal po la/ g.yugod tshangasapa'i me ru yod/ṭ+wāṃsazer la/ khagling g.yul 'gyed skab4sdig gcod shan pasabasad 15 khra mgo mig dmar ni/ khache rgod po tshechu rlung gsum dang 'dā ༵'i dmag dpon gragasacan zhig dang khri brtan rgyal po'i blo'adon

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/mkhan yin/ khos gling gi rong sras lha rgod gtsos pa'i de drag mang po mtshon lo drangs/ kha gling g.yul 'gyed kyi skabs sa bye ri'i chos 'grub kyis bsad do/ /16 gshin bdud gdong dmar ni/ kha che rgyal po'i nu bo ste/bshad pa ltar na sngon rgya gar lho phyogs sa gdol ba a ra nag por byes/ zama'i bka' dang 'gal dam tshig sgyu nyams/ tshe 'phos nas dmyal khams bco brgyad 'grims/ de nas khro srong lde btsan gyi skabs/ sna nam dpal zhesabon blon du gyur/ khri srong lde btsan tshe sod bltas/ de nas ma 'phos te dmyal bar skyes/ de'i mtshams sa phag lus bcu gsum blangs/ de nas kha lnga'i rgyal sras sa gyur ces bkod yod pa ltar ro/ /17 dung khab 'od 'bar ni/ ba la 0 dmag dpon s+dzawī mo zhig gi ming ngo / /18 a khod g.yung drung bstan pa —/ kha che'i blon ra zhig ste/kha gling g.yul 'gyed kyi nang du gser ba'i nyi 'bum gyis mda' la bskyon no/ /19 mjing shod 'phrul lce ni/ kha tsho rda ra brgya rtsa'i mi rgyal te/kha che rgyal po'i blon po grags can zhig yin zhing rjes sa khos gleng lamago btags shing gru gu go rdzong phab skabs byas rjes bla sted bzhag go/20 mtha' 'khob be+e/ chos dang rig gnas mi dar ba'i yul te/ma rig mun pa'i gling lta bur zer ro/ /223

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig mingabarda'iskoragyi'agrel bshad/mkhanayin/ khosagling gi rong srasalhargod gtsosapa'i de drag mang pomatshon ladrangs/ kha gling g.yul 'gyed kyi skabasasubye ri'i chosa'agrubakyisabasad do/ /16 gshin bdud gdong dmar ni/ khache rgyalapo'i nu bo ste/bshad paltar na sngon rgya gar ltophyogasasugadolaba.ar nag por skyes/ blama'i bka' dang 'galadam tshig nyams/ tshe 'phosanasadamyal kham4bco brgyad 'grims/ de nasakhri srongaldobatsan gyi skabs/ sna nayodapalazhe4bonablon du gyur/ khri srong ldobatsan osod bltas/ de nasatshe 'phosate dmyal bar skyes/ de'i mtshamasasuphag lusabacu gsum blangs/ de na4khache'i rgyal srasasugyur cesabakod yod pa ltar ro/ /zhi gi/7 hāng khub 'od 'bar ni/ b.labore dmag dponar mo/ga 15༵ ༵ / khod/ g.yung drung bstan pa ni/ khache'i blon chen zhig ste/rnogling g.yula'agyed kyi nang du gser ba'i nyi 'bumagyisamada' la bskyon 19 mthing shod 'phrul lce ni/ khache'i rda ra brgya rtsa'i 5gyalate/kha che rgyal po'i blon po gragasacan zhig yin zhing rjesasukhosagling lamago btagasashing gru gu go rdzong phabaskabasabyasarje4blamed bzhag go/20 mtha' 'khob ni/ cho4dngarig gnasamidar ba'i yulate/ma rig mun pa'i gling ltabur zer ro/ / 223

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/21 gu long —/ bon po'i lha zhig ste/ gling sgrung las bshad bltar na lha gu long nag po yun ring bsgoms nas grub pa brnyes thub na/ che srog sra mo lcags la 'gyur zhing / sa dang gang gis khrung gnod mi thub par 'gyur zhes bshad pa dang / bon chos kyi cho ga ste gu long nag po'i phung zor bsgrubs nas pha rol gtor rgyag byas na dgra bo rjag med gtong thub par mazad ri bo yang mgo mjug bsgyur thub par grags/ kha che sngags nag chosa'abar ka ra zer ba la lha gu long nag po'i grub pa brnyes yo da skad do/ /22a bse ni/ khra mo gling gi lho phyogs su gnas pa'i rgyal phran chang ngu zhig gi ming / gling dmag kha che'i yul la skyod dus lho a bsod ra thang phyug mo ru dmag sgar ba bas nasang la gsos zhes pa ltar/ lho sprib so stod smad sde drug la blon rgod drug cu re bdun/ 'bangs mi 'og sde khye dang drug brgya/ rgyal po g.yu 'brug thog btsan/ rdzong mkhar srung mi srin po re re yodaces grags/ kha che btul rjes gleng dang abs bar dmag 'khrug byung /mjug mthar g.yu 'brug rgyal pos gling la mgo btags nas khra mo gling gi mnga' 'og tu tshad do/ /23yam bu ni/ spyir yam zhes pa ni log bshad la go zhing bshad yam/ yam chab lta bu'i don la 'jug mod/ skabs 'di'i yam bu zhes pa ni rgya gar dang bod gnyis kyi dbus na chags pa'i bal bo'i byed gyi gna' bo'i mkhar rnying zhig gi ming yin la deng sang(me02stso—oṃ oṃ/)zer ba de yin/kha che khye brtan rgyal po'i dbang shugs ji cher gyur pas mnga' khongs rgya cher 224

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/21 gu long ni/ bon po'i lhazhig ste/ gling sgrung lasabashad bltar na lhagu long nag po yun ring bsgomasanasagrub pa brnyeyothuban/ tshe srog sra mo lcag4la 'gyur zhing / sudang gang gisakyang gnod mi thub par 'gyur zhesabashad pa dang / bon chosakyi cho ga stog long nag po'i phung zor bsgrub4nasapha rolagator rgyag byasan dgra bo meg med gtong thub par mazad ri bo yang mgo mjug bsgyur thubapar grags/ kha che sngagasanag chosa'abar ka ra zer b.lalhag long nag po'i grub pa brnyesayod skad do/ /22 a bse ni/ khra yogling gi lhophyogasasugan4pa'i rgyalaphran chung ngu zhig gi ming / gling dmag kha che'i yul laskyod dusalho.abasodar thang phyug mo ru dmag sgar babasanasangalagasosazhesapa ltar/ lto.abasostod smad sdedrug la blon rgod drug cu re bdun/ 'bangasami 'og sdekhri dang drug brgya/ rgyal po g.yu'abrug thog btsan/ rdzong mkhar srung mi srin po re re yod cesagrags/ kha che btul rje4gling dang abasebar dmag 'khrug byung /mjug ༵bar ༷swā/brug rgyalapo4gling lamago btagasanasakhra megling gi mnga' ༵ṭ+wāṃ nā rā bu /ni// spyir yamazhesapa ni log bshad lago zhing bshad yam/ yam meb ltabu'i don la'ajug mod/ skab4'di'i yamabu zhesapa ni rgya gar dang bod gnyisakyi dbusan chagasapa'i b.labo'i yulagyi gna' bo'i mkhar rnying zhig gi ming yin ladeng sang(me041tsho/ hā/)zer ba de yin/kha ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ brtan rgyal po'i dbang shugasaje cher gyur pasamanga' khong4rgya cher

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/bskyed nas gna' bo'i mkhar rnying 'di bdag tu bzung zhing mtha' 'khor gyi rgyal phran dag la mi mthun pa'i btsan 'dzul mang po byas myong ngo / /24 spo rang be+e/ spri bsodang 'dra ba'i rgyal phran ga ngu zhig yin la/a bsodang sporang gnyis gang rgyud gcig gi g.yas g.yon du yod cing / phyi dgra yod na chu gzhung gcig zer ba ltar spri bsol dgra byung na sgorang la byung ba dang khyad ma mchis pas/ gling dang a bsoganyis 'khrug pa'i skabs su/sgorang yang dam/ga 'khrug la zhugs/ rgyal po'i ming lagayung drung dpa' rgyal zer ba dang / pho brang la chu ri 'bum rdzong / btsun mo khri byams mtsho dang sras mo rma bya skyid/ mdun zon grags chen brgyad/ dmag dpung chig khri sum stong bcas yo da skad/ mthar khos kyang ge sar rgyal por mgo 'bul lus 'bul byas so/ /25 rta chad bro sdug cha/ rta pho thang chad pa dang dmag mi'i bro tshar ba'i don yin/ gna' bo'i dmag 'khrug zhig la mtshon na 'og gi rta dang kha zas bro gnyis gtso bo yin/ gal srid de gnyis gang rung med par gyur tshe pham par 'gyur nyen che bas/ gna' brnams kyis dmag rta gsob dang dmag bro gra sgrig byed par gtsigs 'dzin chen po gnang bzhin 'dug go/26 mdo mgron ni/ tshong ba'i don la 'jug cing / kha che dang gling gnyis 'khrus ga skabs kha che'i dmag gis gling gi tshong ba'am mdo mgron gyi tshong zong 'phrog bcom byas zhes pa lta bu'o/ /27 mi tho jus shi —/ rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi kho phan gyi ra du 225

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'iskor gyi 'grel bshad/bskyed na4gna' bo'i mkhar rnying 'di bdag tu bzung zhing mtha' 'khor gyi rgyalaphran dag lamimathun pa'i btsan 'dzulamang po byasamyong ngo / /24 spo rang ni/ abasedang 'dra ba'i rgyal phran chung ngu zhig yin la/abasedang sporang gnyisasgang rgyud gcig gi g.yasagayon du yod cing / phyi dgra yod na chu gzhung gcig zer ba ltar abasil dgra byung na sporang la byung ba dang khyad mamachisapas/ gling dang abasoganyisa'akhrug pa'i skabasasu/sporang yang dmag 'khrug lazhugs/ rgyalapo'i ming lagayung drung dpa' rgyal zer ba dang / pho brang la chu ri 'bum rdzong / btsun pokhri byamasamatsho dang srasamo rma bya skyid/ mdun blon gragasachen brgyad/ dmag dpung chig khri sum stong bca~Xyod skad/ mthar kho4kyang ge sar rgyal por mgo 'bul lusa'a~X bya/ cha)/ bro/ sdug ni/ rta pho thang ra pa dang dmag mi'i bro tshar ba'i don yin/ gna' bo'i dmag 'khrug zhig lamatshon na 'og gi rta dang khazasabro gnyisagatso bo yin/ galasrid de gnyisagang rung med par gyur tshe pham par 'gyur nyen che bas/ gna' mirnamasakyiyodamag rta gsob dang dmag bro gra sgrig byed par gtsigasa'adzin chen po gnang bzhin 'dug go/26 mdo mgron ni/ tshong ba'i don la 'jug cing / kha che dang gling gnyisa'akhrug skabasakha che'i dmag gi4gling gi tshong ba'am mdo mgron gyi tshong zong 'phrog bcom byasazhesapa ltabu'o/ /27 mi tho jus shi ni/ rgyalakhab dang mi rigasakyi khephan gyi ༵༵ du

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rangasrog blosabatangaba'i milade ltar 'bod par 'dod/ rgyu mtshanani(hor gling g.yula'agyed〉dbasgrung dpe gzhan dag lasamitho jusashi zer ba'i tshig de 'dra mamathong yang dpa' bo jusashi zer bamang po mthong rgyu yod pasade gnyisadonagacig ming gi rnamagrangasayin par 'dod do/ /28 yo gor ni/ mtshon gyisaganod dka' ba'i khrab zhig gi mibango /29 had ni/ (1)ha lasapa'am hon 'thor ba'i don dang yang naṭ+wāṃga~X'aṭ+wābla 'khyam4pa'i don la'ajug (2)skabasa'adir glo bur gyi can 0ṭ+wāṃ 0 /khrab/ 'phur yug ni/ lho'adzam gling gi khrab yod tshad kyi snying nor te/ dngosamed lha'adre'i lasazog dang 'og klu rgyal gyi gtsug gi nor bu yin skad/ gling seng chen rgyal posakhrabakyi gter khabago ched lho.abasoyuladu dmagachen drangasanasagayul 'khrug drag po byasamathar khrab 'phur shig gaṭ+wāṃ byasapa'i rin poche mang po 'dzamabu gling gi rgyalakhag sosor bgosapa / lnga/ ba/ 〈tsa ri sman rdzong〉gling sgrung gcesabatus(tsa ri sman rdzong〉gi nang don gtso bo ni de yang sngon gyi dusaskabasashig la'abrug lhang lhang nor bu'i gdan sa/ skad lhang lhang khubyug gragasas/ yulaphun tshogasarma klung phyug mode na sde phun tshogasagling dkar tsho drug gling che rgyud stag seng khasprod/ stag migazan gra yagathikā~Xse/ 'bring rgyud dgra mda' silam/ mda' nyag phran dung sorugage

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rang srog zos btang ba'i chal de ltar 'bod par 'dod/ rgyu mtshanani〈hor gleng g.yu tha'abyed〉dang sgrung dpe gzhan dag las mi tho jus shi zer ba'i tshig de 'dra ma mthong yang dpa' bo jus shi zer ba mang yo mthong rgyu go pas de gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin par 'dod do/ /28 yo gor ni/ mtshon gyis gnod dka' ba'i khrab zhig gi ming ngo /29 had ni/ (1)ha las pa'am hon 'thor ba'i don dang yang na skrag pa'am bla 'khyams pa'i don la 'jug (2)skabs 'dir glo bur gyi don yin no/ /30 khyab 'phur yug ni/ lho 'dzam gleng gi khrab tsho ra kyi snying nor te/ dngos med lha 'dre'i las zog dang 'og klu rgyal gyi gtsug gi nor bu yin skad/ gling seng chen rgyal pos khrab kyi gter kha bgo ched lhog bso yuladu dmag chen drangs nas g.yul 'khrug drag po byas mthar khrab 'phur yug gco byas pa'i rin po che mang po 'dzam bu gleng gi rgyal khag so sor bgosapa'o/ /lnga ba/ 〈tsa ri sman rgong〉gling sgrung gces btus〈tsa ri sman rdzong〉gi nang don gtso bo ni de yang sngon gyi dus skabs shig la 'brug lhang lhang nor 6'i gdan sa/ skad lhang lhang byug grags sa/ yul phun tshogs rma klung phyug mo de na sde phun tshogasagling dkar tsho drug gling che rgyud stag seng kha sprod/ stag shig zan gra yag shigs se/ 'bring rgyud dgra mda' sil ma/ mda' nyag phran dung so rug ge226

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/a rgyud khyung phrug gshog rgyas/ khyung 'phur 'dod sgo thul lhab be/ g.yasaru sga ye sde ba/ dar dkar po'i rgyal mtshan phyar 'dra/ g.yon ru 'khru yosdeb/ 'bru sngon mo'i mas thabakod 'dra/ stag ra bshog chen bco brgyad/khrag mtsho kha lud brgyab 'dra/ tsho drug 'bru drug sil ma/ 'bru sna lnga'i bang ma brdal 'dra/ phyugs dkar nag gi khyu tshogs gnam la rgyu skar shar 'dra/shar khra yo gling gi stod bde na/ smug po ldong gi rus rgyud ldong ma bzhi'i dpon po khro thung khong mkhar btsan po pho rog snying rdzong gi yang thog g.yung drung 'pha ba'i nang du phyi ma'i shi chos sgrub pa'i mtshams dam po'i bcad rgya mdzad nas bzhugs so/ /de'i skabs sa sman gyi lha mo bdud rtsi ma'i sku las pa pa'i khu mo mon pa'i cha byad can mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba sha rtsa dkar lagazhon sha rgyas pa/gzugs drang la sked pa po ba/ phyag zhabs pad rtsa ltar dkar zhing dwangs pa/gzhan yid dbang sted du 'phrog pa zhig khro thung gi gam du slebs shing / kho la dga' ba dang bcas dga' mgur spyad/ nam smad du bu mo de gar song cha med du gyur cing / khro thung gi lus kyi 'du brnams 'khrugs pas/ stod la tsha ba bo ltar 'bar/ smad la grang ba chu ltar 'khol/ bar du tsha grang rlung ltar 'thab pa sogs nad drag pos gzir te 'di ni lhan sprul pa'am bdud kyi cho 'phrul gang yin snyam nas 'gyod pa tshad med bye bzhin bsdad/skabs der gnam 'khor lo ste bas brgyad kyi mar zhabs/ sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi gong rol/ ri mchog rma rgyal spom ra'i nye char/ chu mchog rma 227

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming bdo'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/chungargyud khyung phrug gshog rgyas/ khyuba'aphur 'dod sgrothulalhababe/ g.yasarusga yisde ba/ dar dkar po'i rgyalamatshan phyar 'dra/ g.yonaru 'bru yisdeb/ 'bru sngon mo'i maṇ+ḍalabakod 'dra/ stag rongashog chenabaco brgyad/khrag mtsho khalud brgyaba'adra/ tsho drug 'bru drug sil ma/ 'bru snalnga'i thang mabardala'adra/ phyug4dkar nag gi khyu tshogasaganalolargyu skar shar 'dra/shar khra mokhring gi stod pade na/ smug poldong gi rusargyud ldong yobazhi'i dponapokhro thung khong mkhar btsan popho rog snyingardzong gi yangathog g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i nang du phyi ma'i shi chosasgrub pa'i mtshamasadamapo'i bcad rgya mdzad nasabazhugasaso/ /de'i skabasasusman gyi lhamo bdud rtsi ma'i sku la4sprul pa'i bu mo mon pa'i cha byad can mdzesashing yid du 'ong ba sha rtsa dkar lagazhon sha rgyasapa/gzugasadrang laskad pazab/ phyag zhabasapad rtsa ltar dkar zhing dwangasapa/gzhan yid dbang med du 'phrog ngazhig khro thung gi gam du slebasashing / kho la dga' ba dang bcasadaga' mgur spyad/ namasmad du bu pode gar song cha med du gyur cing / khro thungagi lusakyi 'du brnamasa'akhrugasapas/ stod latsha bameltar 'bar/ smad la grang ba chu ltar 'khol/ bar du tsha grang rlung ltar 'thababasogasand drag posagazir te 'di ni lhayisprulapa'amabadud kyi cho 'phrulagang yin snyamanasa'agyod pa tshad med skye bzhin bsdad/skabasader gnama'akhor lortsibasabargyad kyi mar zhabs/ sapad+ma 'dababargyad kyi gong rol/ ri mchog zargyalaspomara'i nye char/ chu maṭ+wāṃ/ ma

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/klung g.yasa'akhyil gyi dra mig madro lu gu'i mkhal khugs/ rma li ma norabudaga' 'khyil/ steng dag pa lhayipho brang / sku mkhar seng 'brug stag rtsede ru sang4rgyasastong gi thug4sras/ rigasagasumamagon po'i rnam sprul/dbu nag bod kyi skyabasamagon/ seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul de nyid thugasa'odagasalagyi klong du mnyam bzhag mdzad de/ 'grob kun la nye ring med par nyin la 'gro ba miyidon dang / mtshan lalhaklu gnyan gsum gyi 'gro don rgya cher mdzad cing bzhugasapa'i skab4susman ane gnam sman dkar podesalhortsa ri'i sman rdzong phab dgo4tshul gyi lung bstan byung ngo / / de nasagling gi dpung dmag de nam mkha'i skar tshogasaltar dpung skyod byasate tsa ri'i dkyil 'khor thang du sgar babasashing phan tshun gnyisakyisa'akhrug resam nga du byas/ srasachung zla 'od 'bum lu zer ba de stag rong dmag gisagason bzung byasapasalhotsa ri mon gyi gsang gtam yod tshad gling la bshad/ gling stag rong dpon po'i sbyogasazor gyisame chu brag gi 'gag sgo yongasasugator nasatsa ri'i dmag lapham nyesatshabs chen bzos/ g.yu'abrug dpung ring de gling sgar la shor nasakhra mo gling gi dmag rnamasaram nag ser bsabardungs 'dra byasashing lhag par du lha'u nyi ma gragasapa dang sta ga srasadagra lhaganyisakyi dbu ril ler blangasate susakyang gdong ma brtan par gling pa rnamasalapham nyes5nga ba byung / 'bru sga sde chosaskyong ber nag gisasbyogasakyi 'phrula'akhor bskor nasalhog rnamasa'aphar bsar khyu dkrugasa'adra byasate rti~X ༵dgungal grag4pa blangs/ ltopa'i dmag dpon g.yu'abrug dpung

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/klung g.yas 'khyil gyi dra mig rma dro lu gu'i mkhal khugs/ rma li ma nor bu dga' 'gyi/ steng dag pa lhan pho brang / sbu mkhar seng 'brug stag rtse de ru sangs rgyas stong gi thugs sras/ rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam pa /dbu nag bod kyi skyabs mgon/ seng don nor bu dgra 'dul de nyid thugasa'od gsal gyi klong du mnyam bzhag mdzad de/ 'gro ba kun la nye ring med par nyin la 'gro ba mi ⑪don dang / mtshan la lha klu gnyan gsum gyi 'gro don rgya cher mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i skabs tsho sman sprin gnam sman dkar sgodes lto tsa ri'i sman rdzong phab dgos tshul gyi lung bstan byung ngo / /de nasagling gi dpung dmag de nam ma/kha'i skar tshogs ltar dpung skyod byas te tsa ri'i dkyil 'khor thang du sgar babs shing phan tshan gnyis kyis 'khrug res ma/nga du byas/ sras chung zla 'od 'bum lu zer ba de stag rong dmag gis gson bzung byas pas lho tsa ri mon 1 gsang gtam yo da tshad gling la bshad/ gleng stag rong dpon po'i sgogs zor gyis chu brag gi 'gag sgo yo ngas su gtor nas tsa ri'i dmag la pham nyes tshabs don bzos/ g.yu 'brug dpung ring de gling sgar la shor nas khra mo gling gi dmag rnams ram/ nag ser bsabardungs 'dra byas shing lhag par du lha'u nyi ma grags pa dang sta ga sra sa dgra lhaganyis kyi dbu ril ler blangs te sus kyang gdong ma brtan par gling pa rnamasal pham nyes ming ba byung / 'bru sga sde chos skyong ber nag gis sgo gas kyi 'phrul 'khor bskor nas lho pa rnams 'phar bsar khyu dgrugs 'dra byas te rting ma dgung la grags pa blangs/ tso pa'i dmag dpon g.yu 'brug dpung 228

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/ring dang blo gros rab gsal gnyis kyi bar la rtsod pa byung ste 'khon res byasashing dmag khag gnyis la 'thor 'go brtsams/ zhal dkar sras kyis dmag dpon gnyis kyi 'khrug rtsod bsdums/ yin na'ang nam phyed tsam la blon po blo gro4rab gsal gsang stabs kyi sgo nas khra po gling gi phyogs sa bros par/zhal dkar sra sar mdar brgyugs pas na tsha zhang 'dan mas kho mda' gcig gi rtse la bskyon/ gleng pa rnams kyis blo gros rab gsal bas ched dga' labazhi byen lam/ 'phrang 'gag nas gling gi dpa' rtul bdun gyis g.yu la 'khrug bong ba byas te khrag gi ma/tsho mo bskyil/mthar rgyal mchog mi na nyi ma sa g.yu 'brug dpon la thar lam bstan/mon shi bdud rgyal po'i ka li bkog lto tsa ri'i sman gyi gter sgo phye ste sgang pa bod la sman gyis khyab par byas nas mi 'dod pa'i nad las grol bar gyur/lha tsa ri'i mon gyi rgyal tshab la stag rong g.yul gung btsan bzhag ste dkar po chos kyi bstan pa btsugs shing / nags phyogs bdud kyi bstan pa rtsa ba nasabasnubs pa bcas kyi lo rgyus so/ /gling sgrung gces btus〈tsa ri sman rdzong〉legs sgrig byed pa'i skabasas le'u rnams ga cig gyur byas te tshang ma bdun tshig can du bcos pa dang /yig nor dag par bcos/ gling sgrung gi snga gzhug gi cha nas dpa' rtul re 'ga' sgrung sngon ma'i nang bkrongs song ba yang bskyar gson yo da pa mi 'grig par brten 'os 'tsham gyis dpa' rtul gzhan zhig tshab tu 'jog pa'am yang na len pa bcas dka' ngal mi nyung ba zhig la 'phrad pa thams cad legayo229

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/ring dang blogrosarab gsal gnyisakyi bar lartsod babyung ste'akhon resabyasashing dmag khag gnyisal 'thor 'go brtsams/ zhaladakar srasakyisadamag dpon gnyisakyi 'khrug rtsod bsdums/ yin na'ang namaphyed tsamal blon poblogroyorab gsal gsangastabasakyi sgo nasakhra megling gi phyog4subrosapar/zhal dkar srasar mdar brgyugasapasan tsha zhang 'dan masakhomada' gcig gi rtse la bskyon/ gling pa rnamayokyisablogrosarab gsal bsuched dga' la bzhi gyen lama'aphrang 'gag na4gling gi dpa' rtul bdun gyisagayula'akhrug ang ba bya4te khrag gi mtsho mo bskyil/mthar rgyal mchog mi yinyi masagayu'abrug dpon la thar lam bstan/mon shi bdud rgyal po'i ka li bkog lto7 ri'i sman gyi gter sgo phye ste sgang pa bod la sman gyisakhyab par byasan4mi 'dod pa'i nad lasagrolabar gyur/stotsa ri'i mon gyi rgyal tshab la stagarong g.yulhagang btsan bzhag stedakar po chosakyi bstan pa btsug4shing / nagasaphyogasabadud kyi bstan pa rtsa ba nasabasnubasapa bcasakyi lorgyusaso/ /gling sgrung gcesabatus〈tsa ri sman rdzong〉legasasgrig byed pa'i skabasasule'u rnamasag cig gyur bya4te tshang ma bdun tshig can du bcosapa dang /yig nor dag par bcos/ gling sgrung gi sngagazhug gi cha na4dpa' rtul re 'ga' sgrung sngon ma'i nang bkrongs song ba yang bskyar gson yod pa mi 'grig par brten 'osa'atsham gyisadapa' rtul gzhan zhig tshab tu 'jog pa'am yang na len pa bcasadaka' ngal minyung bzhig la'aphrad pa thamasacad ༵༵sa

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/par bsgrigs/ gling sgrung gces btus legs sgrig tshan chung gi re bltar sngon la par skrun byas zin pa'i gling sgrung gces btus bzhi la zur lta yabayang bgyis mthar gzhi nas〈tsa ri sman rdzong〉gi las ka khyon yongs nasalegs 'grub byung ngo / /〈tsa ri span rjong〉gi ming brda gtso bo'i 'grel bshad/1 stag rong shog chen bco brgyad ni/ stag lung thang ba gong 'ogagayu thog la stod la smad/ 'bri gung gnam mtsho phyug mo/ sga ba mi tsho dmar po/ zhing ba tsha zhang ru bdun/ ldong gi chu nyin chu srib/ gnyan ri gnam gyi skar tshogs/ lcags mo 'bri khog stod smad/ mkhar ba mtsho nyin mtsho srib/che bo gran ga sum brgya/ gling ru mi brgya rta stong / sde dge mdzangs pa stod smad/ rong khang leb can la dgu brgya/ 'dan la thog nu lnga brgya/ thog sprimakhar dug ri nag po/ lha ru phyug gi sdeb/ nag pa kha bzhi sgo brgyad/ thang ba nags ri phyug mo bcas so/ /2 zan gyi rgyal po ni/ sems can nad kyi sdug bsngal las skyobapar mdzad pa'i rgyal po ste/ sangs rgyas sman bla'i mtshan no/ /3 man khyu lha mo bdud rtsi ma —/ sangs rgyas sman bla'i gam du yod pa'i lha mo zhig gi ming / morang mon 1 bu mo'i cha byad du brdzus nasastag rong dpon po khro thung la nad bskyed de lho tsa ri'i yu tha du dmag phab par rags ram bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas so/ /4 sgo 'dzam 6 gling ji/ gling bzhi'i bo rgyal te shar lus 'phags230

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/par bsgrigs/ gling sgrung gcesabatu4legasasgrig tshan chung gi re bltar sngon lapar skrunabyasazin pa'i gling sgrungagace4btusabazhi lazur lta5bayang bgyisamathar gzhi nas〈tsa ri sman rdzong〉gi lasaka khyon yongasanasalegasastudī byu zlo ṭ+wāṃ rdzo/ nga/〉gi ming brda gtso po'i 'grel bshad/1 stag rong zhog chen bco brgyad ni/ stag lung thabab gong 'ogagayuthog lastod lasmad/ 'bri gung gnamamatsho phyug mo/ sga ba mitsho dmar po/ zhing ba tsha zhang ru bdun/ ldong gi chu nyin chu srib/ gnyanari gnamagyi skar tshogs/ lcagasapo'abri khog stod smad/ mkhar ba mtsho nyin mtsho srib/che bo spranag sumabargya/ gling ru mibargya rta stong / sdedage mdzangasapa stodasmad/ rong khang lebacan ladagu brgya/ 'dan lathog ru lnga brgya/ thog amakhar dug ri nag po/ lharu phyug gi sdeb/ nag pa khabazhi sgo brgyad/ thababanagasari phyug mobacasaso/ /2 sman gyi rgyal po ni/ semasacan nad kyi sdug bsngalal4skyobapar mdzad pa'i rgyal po ste/ sangasargyasasman bla'i mtshan no/ /3 sman gyi lha mo bdud rtsi ma ni/ sangasargyasasman bla'i gamadu yodapa'i lhamo zhig gi ming / morang mon gyi bu mo'i cha byad du brdzu4nasastag rong dpon pokhro thung land bskyed de tshotsa ri'i yuladu dmagaphabapar rog4ramabasamagyisami khyab pa byasaso/ /2304 sgo 'dzam bu gling ni/ glingabazhi'i 5rgyal te shar lusa'aphags

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang ga mi snyan/ lho 'dzam bu gling bcas so/ /5 seng dkar mo ni/ gangs khrod du gnas par bshad cing /ming gzhan lagangs seng dkar mo zer/ gcan gzan kun gyi rgyal po yin par grags so/ /6 bya khrung chen ni/ dug sbrul gyi kha gnon/ 'dab chags kun gyi rgyal po'i ming ngo / /7 bad kan —/ sman gzhung du bshad pa'i rlung 'khris bad kan gsum gyi bad kan gyi ming / de la bad kan skya bo/ bad kan ser po/ bad kan smug po sogs yod do/ /8 'brags byed ni/ sman rigs snamang yod pa'i rgya gar gyi ri bo zhig gi ming ngo / /9 tha sde leng —/ drod sman zhig gi ming ste/ rgya'i skad du bas po zer ro/ /10 'byung ba lnga ni/ sa chu tshe rlung nam mkha' lnga la zer ro/ /11 sras chung zla 'od 'bum yu ni/ skye sa tsa ri yin yang chung dus nas dkar po chos la dad/ lto gling 'khrug skabs stag rong dmag gisagason bzung byas/ gling lamago btags/ tsa ri mon gyi gnas tshul gling la rgyas par bshad/ tsa ri sman rdzong phab rjes gling gi dpa' rtul gyi grasasabazhag go/12 grug ni/ rin po che'i rigs shig ste/ chab rom lo stong 'gor 231

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/gling / nubab lang spyod/ byang sgramisnyan/ lho'adzamabu gling bca4so/ /5 seng dkar mo ni/ gangasakhrod du gnasapar bshad cing /mingagazhan//gang4seng dkar yozer/ gcanagazan kun gyi rgya'asapoyin par graṭ+wāṃsabya /khyung/ chen ni/ dug sbrulagyi khaganon/ 'dab chagayokun gyi rgyalapo/mi~X ṭ+wāṃ ka/ na/ ni/ smanagazhung du bshad pa'i rlubazhakhrisabad kun gsumagyi ༵kā kun hā /r+sha / de labad kun skya bo/ bad kun ser po/ bad kun smu~X ༷hā/sa bhe rje/ ni// sman rig4snamang yod pa'i rgya gar gyi ri bo zhig gi ṭ+wāṃngaṭ+wāṃ pi/ li/nga ni/ drod smanazhig gi ming ste/ rgya'i skad du bsapo zer ro/10/ 'byung ba lnga ni/ sachu merlung nam mkha' lngalazer ro/ /11 sras chung zla 'od 'bum lu ni/ skye satsa ri yin yang chung dusanasadakar pochosaladad/ tshoglinga'akhrug skabasastag rong dmag gisagason bzungabyas/ gling 'o/mgo btags/ tsa ri mon gyi gnasatshul gling la rgyasapar+sha bshad/ tsa ri smanardzong phabarje4gling gi dpa' rtulagyi grasasubazhag ༵/2 spug ni/ rinapo che'i rigasashig ste/ chabaram lostong 2༵/ra

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/na spug ṭ+wāṃ py-isnam ༷ rdoshā kā spya/ che/ bca gnyis ni/ lhos ri'i spyi ming du 'bod/ lhob dang klo pa/ mon pa darā 'brug pa bcayorgyalaphran bzhi las/'brug pa la la thog skor gsum/ ltopa 'asastod smad bar gsum/ klo pa lahākar nag khra gsum/ mon pa lakha rong 'brog gsumabacasabacu gnyis14 thog 'brug glog gsum ni/ thog rgod zha lu/ g.yu'abrug dpung ring / glog dmar zhagayo'adzin bcasaso/ /15 g.yu 'brug 'gying rdzong ni/ tsa ri mo/nagyi pho brang yin zhing /shar na stag dmar 'gying rdzong / lhon g.yu'abrug 'phrul rdzong / nub na bya dmar thog rdzong / byang na rusasbalasbasardzong ngo / /gad ༵6 g.yu 'drug dpung ring ni/ tsa ri'i blon po grags can zhig ring ༵ 7/ rlu/ nga rta sde bzhi ni/ rlung rta'i ngo4kyi stag seng khyung 'brug bcasalarlung rta sde bzhi ru 'bod do/ /18 srid pa'i lha dgu ni/ pu de gung rgyal/ yar lhakam po/gnyanachen thang lha/ zachen spomar/ sgamapo lharji/ zhogasalhachug po/ jo bo galdaṭ+wāṃla'/jo/nā kha rno ga ṭ+wā rnyi/ ༵/rgyad/ kyi 5gyalate lhor gnasapa'i klu'i rgya~X'i ming ngo / /

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/na srug tu 'gyur bar bshad do/ /13 dmar nag leng che bcu gnyis —/ lto tsa ri'i spyi ming du 'bod/ lho pa dang klo pa/ mon pa dang 'brug pa bcas rgyal phran bzhi las/'khrug pa la la thog skor gsum/ lho pa la stod smad bar gsum/ khro pa la dkar nag khra gsum/ mon pa la kha rong 'brog gsum bcas bcu gnyisaso/ /14 thog 'drug glog gsum rki/ thog rgod zha lu/ g.yu 'brug dpung ring / glog dmar zhags 'dzin bcas so/ /15 g.yu 'drug 'grung jong —/ tsa ri mo/na ju pho brang yin zhing /shar na stag dmar 'gying sgong / lhon g.yu 'brug 'phrul rdzong / nub na bya dmar thog rdzong / byang na rus sbal sbas rdzong ngo / /16 g.yu 'drug da yung ring ni/ tsa ri'i blon po grags can zhig gi ming ngo / /17 rlung rta sde bzhi 5/ rlung rta'i ngosakyi stag seng khyung 'brug bcas la rlung rta sde bzhi ru 'bod do/ /18 thrad pa'i lha dgu ni/ pu de gung rgyal/ yar lha sham po/gnyan chen thang lha/ rma chen spom ra/ sgam po lha rje/ zhogs lha rgyug po/ jo bo g.yul rgyal/ she'u kha rag bcas so/ /19 'jog po rna/ klu chen brgyad kyi bo rgyal te lhor gnas pa'i klu'i rgyal po'i ming ngo / /232

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/20 lcags nag khu tshur ni/ tsa ri'i blon portsalachen zhig brag rdorjeyin kyang khutshur gyisathalaphung ltar bzo nusapas/ dmag dpon lcagasanag khyatshur du 'bod/ g.yula'agyed nang du 'bru sga ldodang 'thab ste/khutshur rgyag thengasagacig gisasga sdedran med du brgyal/ mthar gling pa rnamasamanyam rub kyisalnga ba'i lamadu brdzangasaso/ /ṭ+wāṃ1 marda~X dpe ni/ mtshan bzang po soganyisadang dpe byad bzang ༵ ༵rdibye rnos /ma'i/ khyad chos brgyad ni/ zhal bzang ba nya gang zla ltar dkar ba/ spyan zung metog gi ze'u 'bru bzhin 'od 'bar ba/ skra dang smin ma bung ba'i kha dog ltar nag pa/ mchu sgro4shing tog bimapa ltar dmar zhing rlon pa/ mgrin pa rma bya'i ske ltar bzhun pa/ chemasaphreng ba mutig gi ṭ+wāṃ ༵༵ ṭ+wāṃr 'grig cing dkar ba/ sku lusasba dkar gyi smyug mabazhin phrazhing 233

sgrung khag lnga'i nang don dang legs sgrig ming brda'i skor gyi 'grel bshad/20 lcags nag khu tshur ni/ tsa ri'i blon po rtsal chen zhig brag rdo rje yin kyang tshur gyis thal phung ltar bzo nus pas/ dmag dpon lcag4nag khu tshur du 'bod/ g.yul 'byed nang du 'bru sga sde dang 'thab ste/khya tshur rgyag zangs gcig gis sga sde dran sted du brgyal/ mthar gling pa rnam/sam/nyam rub kyis lnga ba'i lam du brdzangs so/ /21 mtshan dpe be+e/ mtshan bzang po soganyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'o/ /22 mjos ma'i khyad chos brgyad —/ zhal bzang ba nya gang zla ltar dkar ba/ spyan zung ste tog gi ze'u 'bru bzhin 'od 'bar ba/ skra dang smin ma bung ba'i kha dog ltar nag pa/ mchu sgos shing tog bim pa ltar dmar zhing zlon pa/ mgrin pa rma bya'i ske ltar bzhun pa/ chem sa phreng ba mu tig gi do shal ltar 'grig cing dkar ba/ sku lus sba dkar gyi smyug ma bzhin za zhing sdem pa'o/ /233

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtshungs su〈mtsho sngon—ge sar gyi pha byed〉zhes pa'i byed don brnyan 'chanabatang ste/ rang zhing gi ge sar sgrung gi bya ba de kyag kyog gi bgrod lam stebaji ltar brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang de la sa blangs pa'i grub 'bras sogs ma don par byas/ 1993lo'i zla7par nang sog rang skyong ljo ngas sa 'tshogs pa'i ge sar sgrung gi rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogs jengs gsum pa'i steng rang zhing gi dpyad rtsom lnga bdams thon byung ba dang / de dag las dpyad rtsomabazhi tshogs thog tu sgogs 'don byas pas sog po'i mkhas pa skor zhig gi dogs pa'i mdud brgya bkrol zhing blo sgo phye thub par gyur/ gzhan yang ma/tsho sngon zhing chen spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gis bsgrigs pa'i〈ge sar sgrung gi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha phyogs bsgrigs〉zhes pa'i dpe deb chen mo dang gcod pa don grub lags kyis rtsom sgrig byas pa'i〈ge sar sgrung gi shul rten gyi ngag rgyun ngo mtshar me tog phreng mdzes〉zhes pa bcas dngos ga par skrun byas te mtsho sngon rmi ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug be+e bar skul 'ded chen po btang bar ma zad/ gcod pa don grub lags kyis 'go 'dzin byas pa'i〈ge sar sgrung la dpyad pa kun gsal 'phrul gyi me long〉zhes pa'i zhib 'jug gi rnam grangasade rgyal yongs rim pa'i spyi tshogs tshan rig gi zhib 'jug rnam grangs du bzhag nas thugs khur dang rgyab skyor chen po gnang / 'di ni rang zhing la mtshon na zangs dang po yin par ma zad/ rgyal yongs la mtshon na'ang jengs dang poyin/spyir rang zhing gi ge sar sgrung la mtshon na zhib 'jug gi thad g.yur du 240

mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug skor/zaba'igrub 'brasablangasayod pa yin mod/ 'on kyang da dung der gnad don ci yang med pa ni mayin te/ dper na da lta'i dpyad rtsomamang che bsage sar gyi 'khrungasayul/ mnga' khongs/ ge sar gyi mtshan/ de min ge sar mirig4gang la gtogayopa sogayokyi ltatshul brjod pa lasage sar sgrung gi rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i thad la yongasakhyab tu rim pa mang po'i sgo nasazhib 'jug byed pa cung zad zhan pa red/ yang dpyad rtsom 'ga' zhig giyoge sar sgrung gi phyi tshul tsam mtshamasasbyor byed pa la4zhib 'jug gi ltatshul gsar ba brjod de blo sgo gsar ba 'byed thub med/ gal te nga tsho4zhib 'jugagi khyab khongasaje che dang zhib 'jug gi chu tshad je mthor mabatang na rang rgyal gyi ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug gi gom stabasasngar bsam/dun du sposate/ gsar gtod rang bzhin gyi grub 'brasachen po smin dka' ba red/phyisasurang zhing gi ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug bya bar sngar lasalhag pa'i 'bra4bu thob dgosan/ khobo'i bsamapar ci nasakyang gsham gyi don tshan gsum la do snang byed dgosapaste/gcig 'bad brtson gyisage sar sgrung gi na gzhon zhib 'jug mi sna 'bor chen skyed sring byasate/ zhib 'jug dpung sde rgya cher gtong dgos/da lta'i zhib 'jug misna'i gnasatshulal bltasan/ gcig ni migangasanyung ba dang gnyi4ni rgan pa mang bar brten/ phyisasu'abrel yod sde khag sosonasamathong chen ma gnang na skyachad sngo sdug gi gnasasulhung rgyu ni gdon mi za'o/ / gal te rgan dar gzhon gsumagyi zhib 'jug dpung sde'aboṭ+wā rten

mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug skor/zaba'i grub 'bras blangs ra pa yin mod/ 'on kyang da dung der gnad don ci yang med pa ni ma yin te/ dper na da lta'i dpyad stom mang che bsage sar gyi 'khrungs yul/ mnga' khongs/ ge sar gyi mtshan/ de min ge sar cha rigs gang la gtogs pa sogs kyi lta tshul brjod pa las ge sar sgrung gi rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i thad la yongs khyab tu rim pa mang po'i sgo nas zhib 'jug byed pa cung zad zhan pa red/ yang dpyad rtsom 'ga' zhig gis ge sar sgrung gi phyi spyo tsam ma྾sa sbyor byed pa las zhib 'jug gi lta྾ gsar ba brjod de blo sgo gsar ba 'byed thub med/ gal te nga tshos zhib wog gi khyab khongs ji che dang zhib dzog gi chu ra je mthor ma btang na rang rgyal gyi ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug gi gom stabs sngar bsam/dun du sposate/ gsar gtod rang bzhin gyi grub 'bras chen po smin dka' ba red/phyis garang zhing gi ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug bya bar sngar las lhag pa'i 'bras bu thob dgos na/ kho bo'i bsam par ci nas kyang gsham gyi don dza gsum la do snang byed dgos pa ste/gcig 'bad brtson gyis ge sar sgrung gi na gzhon zhib 'jug mi sna 'bor chen skyed sring byas te/ zhib 'jug dpung sde rgya cher gtong dgos/da lta'i zhib 'jug mi sna'i gnas tshul la bltas na/ gcig ni mi grangs nyung ba dang gnyis ni rgan pa mang bar brten/ phyis su 'brel yod sde khag sosonas mthong chen ma gnang na skya chad sngo sdug gi gnas sa lhung rgyu ni gdon mi za'o/ / gal te rgan dar gzhon gsum gyi zhib 'jug dpung sde 'bor chen 241

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhig med pa'i dbang du btang na/ ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug bya ba'adi~Xtha/ se'akhyolabazhig phar zhog rgyun 'khyongasabyed pa yang lasaslapozhig nga 0snat+ta/sa da yod kyi zhib 'jug mi sna'i chu tshad je mthor gtong dgogaci'i phyir zhe na/ ge sar sgrung gi phyi tshulagyi gnad don gcig gnyisashig gi steng du bskyar zlosabyasate mi'adug par/ rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i sgo nasage sar sgrung lasamatshon pa'i dusarabasasoso'i chab srid dang dpala'abyor/dmag don/ chosalugs/ dmangasasrol/ sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos/ de min sgrung dpegasar gtod pa sgrung mkhan dang ge sar rgyal po'i shul rten skor lazhib 'jug byed dgosan chu tshad cung mtho ba'i misna skor zhig med phyir/'gan lci 'di 'grub ga lathub/ de'i phyir nga tshosabya ba 'dir gtsigasa'adzinabyasate/ gcig nasargyalayongasarimapa dang zhing chen rimapa'i ge sarasnrung la zhib 'jug byed pa'i gzhung lugasaskor gyi slob sbyong 'dzin grwa snamang bsdusate da yod kyi zhib 'jug pa sbyong brdar thengasashig byed rgyu dang /gnyi4na4rgyal yongasarimapa dang zhing chen rimapa'i ched gnyer gyi ge sar zhib 'jug gi dusadeb bskrun te/ zhiba'ajug misna'i dpyad rtsomasnatshogasadagod pa dang / dusadeb de brgyud na4khotsho'i zhib 'jug dpyad rtsomagyi spusatshad je mthor gtong dgos/gsum/ rang zhing gi 'brelayod lasakhungasadang 'go khrid kyisargyab skyo~X steng thug4khur gnang ste/ rang zhing gi bod rigasarang skyong khulaso

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhig sted pa'i dbang du btang na/ ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug bya ba 'di mtha' 'khyol ba zhig phar zhog rgyun 'khyongs byed pa yang las ma po zhig yong mi thub/gnyis/ da yod kyi zhib 'jug mi sna'i chu tshad je mthor gtong dgos/ci'i phyir zhe na/ ge sar sgrung gi phyi tshul gyi gnad don gcig gnyis shig gi steng du bskyar zlos byas te mi 'dug par/ rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i sgo nasage sar sgrung las mtshon pa'i dus rabs so so'i chab srid dang dpal 'byor/dmag don/ chos lugs/ dmangs srol/ sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos/ de min sgrung dpe gsar gtod pa sgrung mkhan dang ge sar rgyal po'i shul rten skor lazhib 'jug byed dgos na chu ra cung mtho ba'i mi sna skor zhig med phyir/'gan lce 'di 'grub ga la thub/ de'i phyir nga tshos bya ba 'dir gtsigasa'adzin byas te/ gcig nas rgyal yongs rim pa dang zhing chen rim pa'i ge sar sgrung la zhib 'jug byed pa'i gzhung lugs skor gyi slob spyong 'dzin grwa snamang bsdus te da yod kyi zhib 'jug pa sbyong brdar zangs shig byed rgyu dang /gnyis nas rgyal yongs rim pa dang zhing chen rim pa'i ched gnyer gyi ge sar zhib 'jug gi dus deb bskrun te/ zhib 'jug mi sna'i dpyad rtsom sna tshogasadagod pa dang / dus deb de brgyud nas kho tsho'i zhib 'jug dpyad rtsom gyi spus tshad je mthor gtong dgos/gsum/ rang zhing gi 'brel yod las khungs dang 'go khrid kyis rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang ste/ rang zhing gi bod rigs rang skyong khulaso242

mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug skor/sor ge sar sgrung gi bya ba'i gzhung lasakhang 'dzugasadagosapar mazad/ched lasamisnamangag4te ge sar sgrung 'tsholazhib dang legasasgrig byed pa dang chabasacig bya ba 'di dma'adzin byed dgos/ gzhan yang zhib 'jug par mkhoba'i 'phulachasadang dpyad gzhi'i yig cha bsdu nyo byed padang /dpyad rtsomasnatshogasadusathog tupar skrun byed pabacasakyi thad du yodangulagyi rgyardo /ga4gaṭ+wāṃng na/ da gzod ge sar sgrung gi zhiba'ajug de bde blag ngang spyibyā r+sha ༵༷ ṭ+wāṃ/nga gi zhib 'jug bya bar mtshon na/ 'gan khur lci zhing dka' tshegasache ba zhig yin par mazad/ da dung zhib 'jug gi rnamagrang4kyang shin tumang / de'i phyir nga tshosamumathud du dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyi snying stob4bskyed de nan bcagasakyisazhib 'jug bya dgosal/ tshan rig zhib 'jug gi lamalamatshon na bde 'jam ngang bgrod mithub cing / zhib 'jug gi 'brasabu chu thigasatsamalen na'ang nusashug4chen po 'don dgosapas/ nga tshosamumathud du gsar gtod kyi rang bzhin dang sdug rusakyi snying stobasaspelate zhib 'jug gi grub 'brasamyur mang bzang gsumagyi thad du 'bad brtson byed dgo4palagasaso/ /1994lor bris/243

mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug skor/sor ge sar sgrung gi be+e ba'i gzhung las khang 'dzugs dgos par ma zad/ched las mi sna mngags te ge sar sgrung 'tshol zhib dang legs sgrig byed pa dang chabs cig bya ba 'di dam 'dzin byed dgos/ gzhan yang zhib 'jug par mkho ba'i 'phrul chas dang dpyad gzhi'i yig cha bsdu nyo byed pa dang /dpyad rtsom sna tshogs dus thog tu par skrun byed pa bcas kyi thad du ma dngul gyi rgyab rogs gnang na/ da gzod ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug de bde blag ngang a thub pa red/spyir ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug bya bar mtshon na/ 'gan khur lci zhing dka' tshegs che ba zhig yin par ma zad/ da dung zhib 'jug gi rnam grangasakyang shin tu mang / de'i phyir nga tshos mu mthud du dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyi snying stobs bskyed de nan bcags kyis zhib 'jug bya dgos la/ tshan rig zhib 'jug gi lam lamatshon na bde 'jam ngang bgrod mi thub cing / zhib 'jug gi 'bras bu chu thigs tsam len na'ang nus shugs chen po 'don dgosapas/ nga tshos sa mthud du gsar gtod kyi rang bzhin dang sdug rus kyi snyeng stobs spel te zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras myur mang bzang gsum gyi thad du 'bad brtson byed dgos pa lags so/ /1994lor bris/243

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mcho sngon zhing chen gyi ge sar sgrung gi myur skyob skor/gangasacan bod kyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyuyobarjod pa'i gling rje ge sar rgyalapo'i sgrung ni brjod bya'i don rgya che zhing gting zab pa dang / rjod byed tshigasnyan zhing 'jebasal phun sum tshogasapa'i skad gragasacan gyi snyan rtsom/ ring po zhig lags/ der bod rigasamidamangasakyi khrod du gna' nasad bar du snyan gragasakyi ba dan g.yobazhin yod pa lasagazhan/ 'dzamagling steng gi rgyal khab sumacu lhag gi 'brel yod mkha4pasakyang mthong chen gnang ste zhib 'jug sdekhag btsugasanasasnyan rtsom ring po 'di 'tshol sdud dang / yig sgyur/ par skrun bca4kyi bya babasgrubasadang sgrub bzhin yod/ bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug byed mkhan gyi phyi nang mkhasapa rnam4kyi4sgrung rtsom 'di 'dzam gling rig gan4bang mdzod khrod du 'od zer rnam par 'phroba'i rin chen nor bu zhig tu rtsi bzhin par ma zad/ bod gna' rabasakyi lo rgyu4dang /chab srid/ dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ dmag don/ dmangasasrol/chosalugasabacasamatshon pa'i kun 'dzomayoglegasabamathob par dka' ba zhig yin pa'ang shesa'adug244bcingasa'agrol byasarjesargyalakhab kyisasnyan rtsom ring po 'di 'tshol

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mcho sngon zhing chen gru ge sar sgrung gi myur spyob skor/gangs can bod kyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i gling rje ge sar rgyalapo'i sgrung ni brjod bya'i don rgya che zhing gting zab pa dang / rjod byed tshig snyan zhing 'jibs la phun sum tshogs pa'i skad grags can gyi snyan rtsom ringapozhig lags/ der bod rigs mi dmangs kyi khrod du gna' nas da bar du snyan grags kyi ba dan g.yo bzhin yong pa las gzhan/ 'dzam gling steng gi rgyal khab sum cu lhag gi 'brel yod mkhas pas kyang mthong chen gnang ste zhiba'ajug sde khag btsugs nas snyan rtsom ring po 'di 'tshol sdud dang / yig sgyur/ par skrun bcas kyi bya ba bsgrubs dang sgrub bzhin yod/ bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug byed mkhan gyi phyi nang mkhas pa rnam/sa kyis sgrung rtsom 'di 'dzam gling rig gnas bang mdzod khrod du 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba'i rin chen nor bu zhig tu ste bzhin par ma/ zad/ bod gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus dang /chab srid/ dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ dmag don/ dmangs srol/chos lugs bcas mtshon pa'i kun 'dzoms glegs bam thob par dka' ba zhig yin pa'ang shes 'dugabacings 'grol byas rjes rgyal khab kyis snyan rtsom ring po 'di 'tshol 244

mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi ge sar sgrung gi myur sbyob skor/rdzong r+ṣa bco brgyad phab pa'i sgrung dpe rnams yig sgyur dang par sgrun byed rgyu ni ha cang gal che bar ma zad/ rim gyis sgrung pa rnams kyis bshad pa'i sgrung dpe gsar ba dag kyang yig sgyur par skrun byed dgos pa yin/3 sngar las legs pa'i sgo nas gling sgrung gi zhib 'jug bya ba dam 'dzin byed dgos/ gling ge sar gyi sgrung la zhib 'jug byas na dus rabasasoso'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyi spyi tshogs lo rgyus dang / chab sred dpala'abyor/ rig gnas dmangs srol bcas kyi 'phel 'grib lo rgyus sogasartogs thub pas/ nga tshos rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i sgo nas/ zhib 'jug gi khyab khongs ji cher gtong ba dang / zhib 'jug gi thabs lam gsar du 'byed pa/ zhib 'jug gi rim pa mang por brten pa bcas bgyis te/ sgrung dpe'i mtha' sted rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du bgrod kyin bgrod kyin gting je zab tu song na zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras kyi nor bu yang yid bzhin du thob thub par snyam/ da lta nged cag gi mdun du bshams pa'i zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs shin tu mang la/ khyad par du phul byung sgrung pa mang po zhig rgyus 'o na byung ba dang / khong rnam pa'i blo nas sgrung khag brgya lhag bshad shes pa'i ngo mtshar gyi gsang ba dag gisang tsho'i zhib 'jug mi sna rnams la shin tu thob par dka' ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha dang nang don gsar ba kha sgon byas yo da pas/ zhib 'jug pa rnams la rang rang gi rnam dpyod kyi rtsal sna tshogs ngom/ pa'i go skabs legs po 'don sprod byas yod pa red/ lo lnga'i 'char gzhi ang dgu ba'i skabs su/ nged cag rnams kyis rang nyid kyi brtson 'grusal257

mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi ge sar sgrung gi myur skyob skor/sring byed pa'i 'char gzhi 'god pa dang / mthun rkyen gang mang bskrun te ma 'khyangs par sgrung gi khya ba sgrub mkhan gyi shig 'bor chen 'tshar longs yong bar bston len byas nas/ dus rabs nyer gcig par ge sar sgrung ge bya ba yongs khyab tu 'phel rgyas yong bar rmang gzhi brtan po zhig 'ding dgos pa lags/spyir gong du brjod pa'i ge sar sgrung gi bya ba'i skor la bltas na/ nged cag dga' 'os pa'i grub 'bras phun sum tshogs pa thob yod mod/ 'onakyang 'das zin pa'i bya bar phyi mig bltas na da dung mi 'dang sa dag mthong thub cing / ma 'ongs par bsams na da dung las 'gan lci zhing dka' ngal mi nyung ba zhig yod pa shes thub/ snya na rtsom ring po 'di'i spyi'i 'char 'god ltar rang zhing gi ge sar sgrung gi spe bar dpyad na/ da dung bar thag hrung ring po yod pa yang shes thub/ gang lta ra kyang nged cag rnams kyis mthun sgril dam zab byas te/ blo sems 'gyur ba sted par lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi 'gan ljid 'di phrag tu blangs nas nan nan tan tan dang 'bad 'byangs lhod sked kyis bsgrubs na/ rang zhing gi ge sar sgrung gi bya ba thams cad bde blag ngang 'grub thub pa'i yid ches dang spobs sems brtan po ma chis so/ /1998lor bris/259

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i glu gar tu bsgyur te/ 'khrab ston byed thub pa ni ngo ma las ma mo zhigamin pas/ nga tshosang ga sgo yangs pa'i ngang nas bstod bsngags kyi nolasgoches cher dkrol na 'os so snyam/'o na dri ma 'i skyon gyis spu nyag tsam yang mgos sa ma zhe na min te/ khadaper bslad ma 'dres pa'i gser med/ skyon ma gos pa'i mi med zerabaltar gar mkhan la la'i spru brjod tshig gi gdangs mi dag pa dang gcig 'itar dpa' rtsal che zhing 'bur thon drags pa dang gnyis/ gar mkhan nyubashas sgyu rtsal gyi thad la khyang cha med pa dang gsum gyi phyogs gcung zad zhan pa'i snang ba zhig ster mod/ yin na'ang mi 'khyang bar ji bzang je legasasubasgyur te/ mes po'i rgyal khab kyi byed tshal ltan sdug pa'i khrod du yid dbangarab tu 'phrog pa'i glu gar gyi chu skyes 'dab brgya gzhan dang mi mtshungs par lham mer bzhad thub pa nga tshor yid ches brtan po yod/ 'dir smras pa/skyes mchog seng chen rgyal po'i thugs rgyud kyis/ /gzhan phan 'ba' zhig sgrub slad rdo rje'i gris/ /nag phyogs bdud dpung 'joms pa'i lo rgyus gtam/ /mtshon byed zlos gar pad mtsho rgyas 'di rmad/ /nyams 'gyur stong gis sten pa'i gar mkhan tshogs/ /'khrab pa'i zlos gar zab yangs rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /rnam dpyod 'phur rtsal nyams pa'i bye'u chung bdag/skyod 'dod gshog rlabs brkyangs kyang sgol thabs bral/ /270
