glu gar chen mo(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉la rags tsam dpyad pa/bar 'phyang nas/ da lta rgyal kha'i ngang slar yang rang gi pha yur ste mtsho lho chab 'gag gser gzhung ring mor phebs par bdag dang bdag 'dra ba rnamasakyis lhag bsam rnam dag ngang dga' ston rten 'brel zhu ba dang dus ma/tshungasasu/ bde sdug 'tshams 'dri'i mchod chang sor bcu'i rtser bsgrengs nas phul ba lags/de snga bdag gis rang re'i khul gyi rig rtsal tshogs pas 'khrab ston byas pa'i bod rigs kyi glu gar〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉la bltas rjes brisapa'i dpyad gtam/ zhig las/ ma 'gyangs par mas po'i rgyal khab kyi skyed tshal ltan sdug pa'i khrod du yid dbang rab tu 'phrog pa'i glu gar gyi chu byesa'adab brgya gzhan dang mi ma tshungs par lham mer bzhad rgyur nga tshor yid chesabartan po mchis zhes brjod pa ltar/ da lta ngo mas 'dzin ma'i khyon yongasasubazhad pa'i skal ba ldan par ma zad/ 'khrab ston byas pa'i sa gnas kun tu ma bcos sems kyi dga' btsang ge sar das ra dmul 'drem byung /yul khams gang la chas kyang de 'dra'i dga' bsung mu tig gi zeng ba 'thor ba'i rgyu ma tshan gang lags she na/ bdag gi bsam par bod rigasadamangs khrod du dar khyab che ba'i dpa' bo'i lo rgyus mtshon byed kyi snyan rtsom ring po ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung las〈rta rgyug rgyal 'jog〉dang〈bdud 'dul〉〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉bcas dpe deb gsum gzhir bzung nas bcosabasgrigs byas shing zlos gar du bsgyur ba dang / mgo rnga tshang la don snying bsdus nas rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi mdun du gzugs can du bkod pa dang 273

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi chedartsomaphyogasabasgrigs/ / / gcig glugar gyisamirigasarang gi skad rigasabarjod de 'khrab stonagyed / ṭ+wāṃ dang / rang mirigasakyi khyad chosaphun sum tshogasapa'i gyon chasadazhargyab ljongasakyi ri mo/ 'khrab chas/ gzhasagadangs/ rol chasarapo'adegasalasogasapa gzhi rtsa'i thog ngo bo ma 'gyur bar gar stegasastebadumangon pa dang / khyad par du glu gar gyi 'khrab tshan bzhi ba lasamangonapa'i 'ur lcag bzung nasadagra 'gog 'thab resabyed pa dang / 'khrab tshanadrugapa lasalag rnga brdungasanasagar stabasasgyur ba dang 'brasadakar bshad pa/'khrab tshan bdun pa lasagana' rabasakyi 'cham steg pa bcasalamirigasarang gi srogargyun gomasasrolarnalopar chagasa'adug par ma zad/ sgyu rtsalagyi ༵nga bzhin ldat+ta pa'i gzugasabarnyan re re lagason nyam4de bsakyang ldan da paṭ+wāṃ r+sha ṭ+wāṃ bye 'a/khrabatshan re re lasarim gyisamago nag skyong ba'i pha ma/gling rje ge sar rgyalapo/ mdzesasdug mchog tugyur pa'i skya lo'i seng lcama'abrug mo/ dgra dpung 'dulaba'i dpa' chen mi'agyur rgya tsha zhal dkar/sem4can bubazhin skyong ba'i mesapoglibasdespyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan/ phasargola'ajom4pa'i pho rgod tsha zhang 'dan ma/ blosemasadug ltar gnag pa'i mingan hor rje gur dkar rgyalapo/ yid gzhung gling la drang ba'i blon chen shan pa me ru/ khamachu rtsod ladaga' ba'i gte bom bzhi bu ngan khro thung /horwa nāng khrag bzhin dkrug pa'i 'phung bya sabya khu ta nag tsog la sogasakyi

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ pa1 gcigaglu kar gyis mi rigs rang gi skad rigs brjod de gab ston byed5rgyab /ljongs bye ri mo/gab chas gzhas gdangs/'i rol b.rabyā'adegs la sogs pa gzhi rtsa'i thog ngo bo ma 'gyur bar gar stegs stebadumangon pa dang / ga par du glu gar gyi gab dza bzhi ba las mngon pa'i 'ur lcag bzung nas dgra 'gog 'thab res byed pa dang / gab dza drugapa las lag rnga brdungs nas gar stabs sgyur ba dang 'bras dkar bshad pa/'gyub mdza bdun pa las gna' rabs kyi 'chag steg pa bcas la mi rigasarang gi sgol rgyun goms srol rnam par chags 'dug par ma zad/ sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i gzugs brnyan re re la gson nyams de bas kyang ldan yod pa dang gnyis/glu gar gyi gab tshan re re las rim gyis mgo nag skyong ba'i pha ma/gling rje ge sar rgyal po/ mdzes sdug mchog tu gyur pa'i skya 'o 'i seng lcama'abrug mo/ dgra dpung 'dul ba'i dpa' r+ṣa mi 'gyur rgya tsha zhal dkar/sems can bu bzhin skyong ba'i mes po 1nga sde spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan/ phasaspyo 'joms pa'i pho rgod tsha zhang 'dan ma/ blo sems dug ltar gnag pa'i mi ngan hor rje gur dkar rgyal po/ yid gzhung gling la drang ba'i blon s+dzawī shan pa rme ru/ kha mchu rtsod la dga' ba'i gte bo ma bzhi bu ngan khro thung /hor gling khrag bzhin dkrug pa'i 'phung bya bla bya khā ta nag tsog la sogs kyi 274

glu gar chen mo〈hor sgrung g.yul 'byed〉la rags tsam das da pa/gyi nyams 'gyur dī rdo pa'i ༵ / sna / da~X gdangs g.yi ba'i/ k+ṣiṃ ༵ snyan bo kun gyi kho sems dbang k+ṣiṃ bye ༵ rdo~X di rji gsum/ mor phebs pa'i bye de min da dung gang la gang 'tshams kyi sgra dbyangs dang / dga' sdug snags kyi rnam 'gyur/ zhe sdang gdug tsub mtshon pa'i skad gdangs/dgra 'dul dpa' rtsal rgyas pa'i snyeng stobs la sogs kyi thad nas kyang / lo rgyus kyi mi sna de dag ma bcos mngon sumang nga gar stegs steng du slebs pa ji bzhin sgyu rtsal gyi yid 'gug nus pa thon yod pa'i rgyu mtshab gyis mi rigasakun gyis lhag bsam gyi dga' bas dang bsngags brjod kyi ba dan g.yob ma yin nam snyam pa bcas ni kho bo'i dran tshul tsam ste/ 'o na bdag gis bsnyad pa 'di tsam ma gtogs legs po'i cha gzhan sted dam zhe na min te/ skye bo rnam dpyod kyi mig dkyus ring zhing mgrin pa'i ngag sgo yangs pa can gyis smyug gu'i zlos gar 'khrab pas na/ de las legs pa'i don 'dus shing snyan zhing 'jibs pa'i tshig gi lam nas 'dzoms po don dang ldan pa zhig rjod thub pa ni gor ma chag go/gzhan yang bod rigs kyi glu gar〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉'di nyid cung cha tshang ba'i ngang gar stegs thog tu 'khrab thub par gyur pa be+e las ma mo zhig min te/ de yang rang re'i khul udang khul srid gzhung gi 'go khrid rnam pas nam rgyun lhod med kyis thugs khur mdzad pa dang / rim pa so so'i 275

glu gar chen mo(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉la rags tsam dpyad pa/gzugasobarnyan re re bzhin mngon ngadape 'osasugyur yod la/ 'khrabaston spyonyamayo'agyur ldan pa'i rtsaladang/ sgragadangasagasalaba'i sgrung glu snyan cobaldanapa 'dra min snatshogayomangon pa de yisagazigasamor phebasapa'i skye zlokunagyiyid semasadabang med du phrogasabadang gsum/de min da dung gang la gang 'tshamasakyi sgra dbyangayodang / dga' sdug snatshogasokyi rnam 'gyur/ zhe sdang gdug tsub mtshon pa'i skad gdangs/dgra 'dul dpa' rtsalargyayopa'i snying stobasalasogasakyi thad nasakyang / lo rgyusakyi mi snade dag ma bcosamangon sumangang gar steg4steng du slebasapa ji bzhinasgyu rtsal gyi yid 'gug nusapa thon yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyisamirigasakunagyiyolhag bsamagyi dga' bsudang bsngag4brjod kyi ba dan g.yob ma yinanamasnyam pa bcasani kho po'i dranatshul tsamaste/ 'o na bdag gisabasnyad pa 'di tsam ma gtogasalegayopo'i cha gzhan med dam zhe na min te/ skye bo rnamadapyod kyi mig dkyusaring zhing mgrin pa'i ngag sgo yangasapa can gyisasmyug gu'i zlosagar 'khrab pa4na/ de lasalegasapa'i don 'dusashing snyan zhing trīṭ+wāṃbasapa'i rdo/ gi lam nasa'adzomasapo don dang ldan pa zhig rjod thub pa ༷ra sna ṭ+wāṃ/ yaX/ bod rigasakyi glu gar(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉'di nyid cung cha tshang ba'i ngang gar stegasathog tu'akhrabathubapar gyur pani lasaslamozhig min te/ de yang rang re'i khul udang khulasrid gzhung gi 'go khrid rnam pasanam rgyun lhod med kyisathugasakhur mdzad pa dang / rilopa ༵sna'i

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'brel yo da sde khag gis rgyab skyor dang dogs ram gnang bar brten/ gobagazhung rtsom sgrig pa dang gzhas gdangs rtsom pa po la sogs pas dka' ngalabargya phrag snang med du bzhag nas/ sdug rus chen pos 'khyub gzhung dngasnartsa~Xbyesa~X co ༵ dang yang dag pa'i ༵ /༵ba/ cos snre rdo sna ngas 'char sdu dag / thub byas par ma/ zad/ rgya tsho gab ston pa rnams le bar stong phrag du rme' lam du chas nas/ bod rigs kyi srol rgyun khyad chos dang / bro gar gyi 'jib stangs/ sgrung glu'i ngag rta sna tshogs la spyangs pa byas te/ glu gar gyi rnam pa dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos je rgyas stobatang stabs/ rang rigs kyi skad gdangs dang goms gshis/ khyad chos bcas la mthun zhing mang tshogasakyis go ma zhing blta 'dod pa'i glu gar gyi pad ma'i ༅ po 'di skye bo yongs kyi 'dren byed kyi spyod yul du gyur pa ni sgos ci 'tshal/'dir dmigs su bkar nas brjod par bya dgos pa zhig ni/ glu gar chen mo 'di'i gab gzhung rtsom sgrig pa dang dbyangs rtsom ma/khan rnam gnyis ni bod rang nyid yin pa las gzhan/ da dung 'khrab ston pa mang che shos dang rol chas ram 'degs pa mang che shos kyang bod rang nyid yin pas/rjes phyogs kyi zlos gar sna tshogs kyang rang rigs mi dmangs rnams kyi rig gnas 'tsho ba'i longs spyod du 'gyur bar gdon mi za ba de'o/ /des na bod rigs kyi glu gar 'dir cha yo ngas su tshang zhing / skyon gyi dri ma tsam yang sted dam zhe na min te/ da dung nges par du mi 'dang sa276

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ / 'brel yod sde khag gisargyab skyor dang rog4ram gnang bar brten/ 'khrirdogazhung rtsom sgrig pa dang gzha4gdangasartsom pa po la sogasapasadaka' nga brgya phrag snang med du bzhag nas/ sdug rusachen posa'akhrab gzhung dbasgodabyangasabacosasgrig yang yang byasapa dang / da dung mi rigasagazhan pa'i sgyu rtsalagyi rnamapa dang yang dag pa'i legasabacosakyi dgong4'char sdud gang thub byasapar ma zad/ rgya che'i 'khrab ston parnams le bar stong phrag du ma'i lam du chas nas/ bod rigasakyi sros rgyun khyad cho4dang / bro gar gyi 'khrab stangag sgrub glu'i ngag rta snatshog4la sbyangasapa byasate/ glu gar gyi rnam pa dang mi rigasakyi khyad chosaje rgya4subatang stabs/ rang rigasakyi skad gdangasadang gom4gshis/ khyad chosabacasal mthun zhing mang tshogasakyisago slazhing blta'adod pa'i glu gar gyi pad ma'i chun po 'di skye bo yongasakyi 'dren byed kyi spyod yul du gyur pa ni smosaci 'tshal/'dir dmigasasubakar nasabarjod par bya dgos pa zhig ni/ glugar chen mo 'di'i 'khrab gzhung rtsomagrig pa dang dbyangasartsom mkhan rnamaganyi4ni bod rang nyid yin pa layogazhan/ da dung 'khrab ston pa mang che shosadang rol chasaram 'degasapa mang che shosakyang bod rang nyid yin pas/rjesaphyogasakyi zlosagar sna tshogasakyang rang rig4midamangasarnamasakyi rig gnasa'atsho ba'i longasaspyod du 'gyur bar gdon mi za ba de'o/ /desan bod rigasakyi glu gar 'dir cha yongasasutshang zhing / skyon gyi dri ༵ ༵ma yang med dam zhe na min te/ da dung ngesapar du mi 'dang sa

glu gar chen mo(hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉la rags tsam dpyad pa/btsalate/ nyamasamyong phyogasasdom dang bsam blobarje res/ sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhinamathor 'degasabacasabyasanas/ je leg4dang je rgyasasugatong dgoyoshing / namayin yang yid khamasachim pa med par mesargyal gyi yid du 'ong ba'i me tog tsamapa ka ltabur 'gyur thub pa byed dgo4par ma zad/'dzam gling yo nga4kyi zlosagar gyi rgyu skar rnamapar bkra ba'i khrod du gsalaler gzi mdangasa'aphroba'i skar chen ji bzhin shar ba'i skalab ldan par byed dgoyoso/ /gangasari'i yul gyi bsung zhim dri ma/'i dpal/ /rnamapar thulaba'i glu gar me tog phreng / /srid gsumamalusayongasasudagod pa'i slad/ /bkra shisasgyu g.yang ngag gi4bar med 'bod/ /1983lor bris/277

glu gar chen mo〈hor gling g.yul 'byed〉la rags tsam dpyad pa/btsal te/ nyams myong phyogs sdom dang bsam 1brje res/ sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin mthor 'degs bcas byas nas/ je legs dang je rgyas sa gtong dgos shing / nam yin yang yid khams tshim pa ped par mes rgyal gyi yid du 'ong ba'i pe tog tsam pa ka lta bur 'gyur thub pa byed dgos par ma zad/'dzam gling yo ngas kyi zlos gar gyi rgyu skar rnam par bkra ba'i khrod du gas ler gzi mdangs 'phro ba'i skar can ji bzhin shar ba'i skal ba ldan par byed dgos/so/ /gangs ri'i yu'i gyi bsung zhim dri ma 'i dpal/ /rnam par thul ba'i glu gar pe tog phreng / /srid gsum ma lus yongs5dgod pa'i slad/ /bkra shis sbya g.yang ngag gis bar med 'bod/ /1983lor bres/277

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshering gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/rang rgyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum rob tsam gleng ba/bod rigasakyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsomaring po〈gling ge sar rgyalapo'i sgrung〉dang / sog rigasakyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsomaring po〈cing gar〉 khor khe tsi rigasakyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring po〈mān se〉bcasani rang rgyal gyi mi rig4lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsom gyi skyed tshal yangasapa'i nang chesaring la chesamachog tu gyur pa'i lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum lagasaso/ / zhesapa'i mtshan bzang kun gyi thos 'dzin dbang bo'i lam du zhugasayod/ lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring po 'di gsum ni glegasabam mang la nang don phun sum tshogasashing /sgrig gzhi rgya che zhing misna shin tu mang ba zhig dang / sosor mi rigasarang gi khyad chosaldan pa dang mi rigasarang gi lorgyusadang rig gnas/ dmag don/chosalugs/ dmangayosrol/ dngosayod kyi 'tsho ba/ bsam pa'i khyer phyogs/ mngon par mtho ba'i phugasa'adun bcasagating zab pa zhig go /lo rgyu4brjod pa'i snyan rtsomaring po 'di gsum ni rang rgyalagyi rig gnasaba~X ༵dzod khrod kyi khyad du 'phagayopa'i rin chen nor bu ltabu zhig yin par

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /rang rgyal gru ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum dob tsam gleng ba/bod rigs kyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring po〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung〉dang / sog rigs kyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snya na rtsom/ ring po〈cing gar〉 khor khe tsi rigs kyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring po〈mā na si〉bcas ni rang rgyal gyi mi rigs lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gyi byed tshal yangs pa'i nang ches ring la ches mchog tu gyur pa'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum lags so/ /zhes pa'i mtshan bzang kun gyi thos 'dzin dbang bo'i lam/ du zhugs yod/ lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring po 'di gsum be+e glegs bam mang la nang don phun sum tshogs shing /sgrig gzhi rgya che zhing mi sna shin tu mang ba zhig dang / so sor mi rigs rang gi khyad chos ldan pa dang mi rigs rang gi lo rgyus dang rig gnas/ dmag don/chos lugs/ dmangs srol/ dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba/ bsam pa'i khyer phyogs/ mngon par mtho ba'i phugs 'dun bcas gting zab pa zhig go /lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring po 'di gsum ni rang rgyal gyi rig gnasabang mdzod khrod kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i rin chen nor bu lta bu zhig yin par 278

rang rgyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo tsa sabarjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum rob tsamagleng ba/mazad/ gna' bo'i zhi lha'i hu'u ma'i lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring moste(yeleyāthestadang rgya gar gyi lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsoloring mo mā ha bha ra ta〉dang mtshungasapar 'dzalogling rig gnasabang mdzod khrod kyi 'od zer rnam par 'phroba'i rin po che zhig kyang lags/ 'di ni rang rgyal grangasanyung miṭ+wāṃgasaṭ+wāṃsa~X'i /rdog4kyi sngon thon la bskrun pa'i legasaskyesabla na mam sa~X ༵kā ༷t+ta/ /pa'i/ snyan rtsoma'adi gsum sa khuladang mirigasami 'dra ba'i khrod du rang soso'i skad dang yige bkolanasasakhyab rdo khyab tu 'gro bzhin mchi4pas/ mi rigasade dag gi cisadam/nga4mang tshog4kun gyisasngar bzhin dga' bsuchen pobyed dang byed bzhin yod/ lorgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsoma'adi gsumagyi brjod bya'i don dang dar khyab tu'agro ba'i rnam pa/ skad rigasakyi khyad chosabacasakyi phyogasasu'ang rang rang mi rigasakyi khyad chosaldan pa red/ 'dir kho bo4rang rgyal gyi 'o rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsom chesaring po 'di gsum la rang re'i mi rigasakyi4rgyusalon gsal bo zhig yong ba dang / der brten nasarig gnayobarje re4kyi bya bar yar skul byed ched/ gsham du lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring po 'di gsum re re byasanasaragasatsam gleng bar bya'o/ /dang po/ 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung〉bod gangasacan gyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyu4brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring po gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni dar khyab kyi dusayun ring zhing rgya khyo) 7ṭ+wāṃ ba

rang rgyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum ro btsam gleng ba/ma zad/ gna' bo'i zhi nā 'a hu'u ma'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo ste〈ye le lnga che〉dang rgya gar gyi lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo〈mā ha bha ra sto〉dang marngongs par 'dzam gling rig gnas bang mdzod khrod kyi 'od zer rnam/ par 'phro ba'i rin po che zhig kyang lags/ 'di ni rang rgyal grangs nyung mi rigs kyis mi'i rigs kyi rjo na thon la bskrun pa'i legs skyes bla na mamachis pa zhig yin no/ /lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom 'di gsum sa khul dang mi rigs mi 'dra ba'i khrod du rang so song skad dang ye ge bkol nas sa khyab rdo khyab tu 'gro bzhin mchis pas/ mi rigs de dag gi mi dam/ngas mang tshogs kun gyisasngar bzhin dga' bas chen po byed dang byed bzhin yod/ lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom 'di gsum gyi brjod bya'i don dang dar khyab tu 'gro ba'i rnam pa/ skad rigs kyi khyad chos bcas kyi phyogs su' pa rang rang mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa red/ 'dir kho bos rang rgyal gyi 'o rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ches ring po 'di gsum la rang re'i mi rigs kyis rgyus lon gsal bo zhig yong ba dang / der brten nas rig gnas brje res kyi bya bar yar sgul byed cad/ gsham du lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring po 'di gsum re re byas nas rags tsam gleng bar bya'o/ /dang po/ 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i grung〉bod gangs can gyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring po gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni dar khyab kye dus yun ring zhing rgya khyon che ba 279

gcod pa don grub dang snyingabo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang / brjod bya'i don rnam par rgyasashing sgrig gzhi rgya che ba zhig yin stabs/'dzam gling gi chesaring ba'i lorgyu4snyan rtsoyogyi gser zhwa'i mgo'i tog ltabur gyur yod/ rgyu mtshan ni skad grags can gyi hu'u ma'i lo rgyusasnyan rtsom〈pe'e yāphe〉la cha mtshon na/ snyan ngag gi rkang pa15693dang / rgya gar gyi〈rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i rtogasabarjod〉lasnyan ngag gi rkang pa24000yod pa/shin tu ring ba'i rgya gar gyi〈māha bha ra ta〉la mtshon na'ang snyan ngag gi rkang pa nyi4'bum la4med cing / rang re'i gling ge sar sgrung la mtshon na/sgrung dpe nyi4brgya lhag yod la/ galasrid sgrung dpe re rer cha snyomasasasnyan ngag rkang pa3000ltar brtsisana'ang/ spyi bsdom4pa4snyan ngag gi rkang ngasayagacig yasam4saslebasathub/ der ma zad da dung gling sgrung ni lorgyusasteng dar khyab kyi rgya khyon yang shin tu che bste/ dper na da ltarang re'i krung go'i khongasagatogasakyi bod rigasadang sog rigs/ hor rigs/ 'jang rigs/ phu'u smi rigs/ yu4ku'u rigasasogasakyi sakhul du khyab dang khyab bzhin yod pa dang / mong golamidamangasaspyi mthun rgyal khab dang / uru su'i pu'u le ya the sakhul/ jo mo glang ma'i lto'agram gyi rgya gar/ ne pa la/pha khi siban/ 'brug yul/ 'brasaljongasabacasargyal khab mang por yang darakhyab cung che ba ltabu'o/ / gling sgrung 'di'i brjod bya'i don gyi thad du bltasan yang gna' rabasabod rigasakyi spyi tshogasa'atsho bcung yongasakhyab tu mtshon yod la/ da dung yun ring gi dar khyab kyi brgyud rim nang du dusara~Xsoso'i rig gan4dang lorgyusasnatshogasasdud len yang bsam gyisami

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /dang / brjod bya'i don rnam par rgyas shing sgrig gzhi rgya che ba zhig yin stabs/'dzam gling gi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus snyan rtsom gī gser zhwa'i mgo'i tog ltabur gyur yod/ rgyu mtshan ni skad grags can gyi hu'u ma'i lo rgyus snyan rtsom〈ye le lnga za〉la cha mtshon na/ snyan ngag gi rkang pa15693dang / rgya gar gyi〈rgyal po rā ma/ ṇa'i rtogs brjod〉la snya na ngag gi rkang pa24000yo da pa/shin tu ring ba'i rgya gar gyi〈mā ha bha ra ta〉la mtshon na'ang snya na ngag gi rkang pa nyis 'bum las med cing / rang re'i gling ge sar sgrung la mtshon na/sgrung dpe nyis brgya lhag yod la/ gal srid sgrung dpe re rer cha stoms ga snyan ngag rkang pa5()00ltar bstes na'ang/ spyi bsdoms pas snyan ngag gi rkang pa sa lnga gcig yas mas sa slebs thub/ der ma zad da dung 1nga sgrung ni lo rgyusasteng dar khyab kyi rgya khyon yang shin tu che bste/ dper na da ltarang re'i grung go'i khongs gtogs kyi bod rigs dang sog rigs/ hor rigs/ 'jang rigs/ phu'u smi rigs/ yus ku'u rigs sogs kyi sa khul du khyab dang khyab bzhin yod pa dang / mong gol mi dmangs spyo mthun rgya'/ khab dang / uru sung pu'u le ya je sa khul/ jo mo glang ma'i lho 'gram gyi rgya gar/ be+e pa la/pha khi na than/ 'brug yul/ 'bras ljongs bcas rgyal khab mang por yang dar khyab byung che ba lta bu'o/ /gling sgrung 'di'i brjod bya'i don gyi thad du bltas na yang gna' rabs bod rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba cung yongs khyab tu mtshon yod la/ da dung yu/na ring gi dar khyab kyi brgyud rim nang du dusarabs so so'i rig gnas dang lo rgyus sna tshogs sdud len yang bsam gyis mi 280

rang rgyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum rab tsam gleng ba/khyab pa byas yod par brten/ 'di be+e bod rigs kyi lo rgyus dang chos lugs/rig gnas/ skad cha/ dmangs sro la bcas 'dus pa'i kun 'dzoms glegasabam bla na ma ma chis pa zhig go/nged cag gis lo 'ga'i sngon la sgrung grangs yang snying ga chod yod par bsdoms rtsis byas pa ltar na/ bcings 'grol byas pa'i tshan la bod ljongasadang mtsho sngon/ kan su'u/ na khron/ yun nan bcas sa 'tshol sdud byasapa'i sgrung dpe lag bris ma dang shing par ma bsdoms pas289lhag la skebs/de dag las bskyar sgrung phud rjes yig thog tu gtan khel byas par yang sna kha200lhag yo da pa red/ gal te sgrung dpe re rer yig 'bru nyis 'bum du brtses na/ spyi bsdoms pas yig 'bru sa thabazhi'i yan la slebs 'dugagazhan yang sgrung pa tshos bshad shes pa dang 'bri shes pa'i sgrung dpe ste/ mtsho sngo na gyi sgrung pa skad grags can tshe ring dbang 'dus kyis spung sna120bshad shes pa dang / gu ru rgyal mtshan gyis sgrung sna120'bri shes pa/ bod ljongasakyi g.yu sman gyis rdzong chen18dang rdzong chung48bshad shes pa/ sgrung pa rgan pa grags pas sgrung sna42bshad shes la/ sgrung pa de dag gis bshad pa ltar nab tshos bshad pa'i sgrung phal cher lo rgyus steng khyab ma myong ba'i gsar ba yin zer bas/ gal srid nga tshos sgrung mkhan de dag gi sgrung grangs rnam sakyang brtsis pas na/ sgrung dpe kho na lnga brgya yan la slebs nges red/ de'i phyir bod gangs can gyi gling ge sar sgrung 'di bshad nas rdzogs rgyu med pa zhig dang bris nas tshar rgyu med pa zhig yin pa sus kyang bsnyon du med pa zhig 281

rang rgyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsomagasum rab tsam gleng ba/khyab pa byasayod par brten/ 'di ni bod rigasakyi lorgyu4dang chosalugs/rig gnas/ skad cha/ dmangasasrol bcasa'adusapa'i kun 'dzomasaglegasabamabla na mam/chisapa zhig go/nged cag gisalo 'ga'i sngon lasgrung grangasayang snying ga tshod yod par bsdomasartsisabyasapa ltar na/ bcingasa'agrolabya4pa'i tshun la bod ljongasadang mtsho sngon/ kun su'u/ sikhron/ yun nan bcalosu'atshol sdud byasapa'i sgrung dpe lag brisam dang shing par mabasdomasapas289lhag laslebs/de dag la4bskyar sgrung phud rjesayig thog tu gtan khel byasapar yang sna kha200lhag yod pa red/ galate sgrung dpe re rer yig 'bru nyis 'bum du brtsiyon/ spyi bsdomasapasayig 'bru sayabazhi'i yan la slebasa'adugagazhan yang sgrung patsho4bshad shes pa dang 'bri shes pa'i sgrung dpe ste/ mtsho sngon gyi sgrung pa skad gragasacan tshe ring dbang 'dusakyisasgrung sna120bshad shesapa dang / gu ru rgyal mtshan gyisasgrung sna120'bri shesapa/ bod ljongasakyi g.yuman gyisardzong chen18dang rdzong chung48bshad shesapa/ sgrung pa rgan pa gragasapasasgrung sna/2bshad shesal/ sgrung pa de dag gi4bshad pa ltar nakho tshosabashad pa'i sgrung phal cher lo rgyusasteng khyab ma myong ba'i gsar ba yin zer bas/ gal srid nga tshosasgrung mkhan de dag gi sgrung grangasarnam/sakyang brtsisapas na/ sgrung dpe kho na lnga brgya yan la slebasangesared/ de'i phyir bod gangasacan gyi gling ge sar sgrung 'di bshad nasardzogasargyu med pa zhig dang brisanasatshar rgyu med pa zhig yin pa susakyang bsnyon du med ༵ gig

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/go /nged cag gi ge sar sgrung gi 'tsholasdud dang dag sgrig yig sgyur/paraskrun/ zhib 'jug bcasakyi bya ba ni krung go gsar ba btsugasarjesad gzod dngosasu'ago brtsamasapa yin la/ lorabasalnga bcu ba'i mjug dang lorabasadrug cu ba'i 'go nayobazung sngagazhug tu thengasagang mang la rgya khyon cung che ba'i sgo nasa'atsholasdud dang myur skyobadag sgrig bcasakyi bya ba sgrubapabargyud nas thun mong ma yin pa'i rin po che stege sar sgrung lamangon par mtho ba'i go gnasathob/ khyad par du lorabasabargyad cu ba nasabazung / sngagazhug tu 'brel yod zhing chen dang ljongasakyi dusadeb dang tshag4par steng du rgya bod yig rigasaganyisakyi ge sar sgrung gi le'u'i tshan pa bkod pa dang /dusamatshungasasumatsho sngon zhing chen dang kun lho'i kun khyab rlung 'phrin lasakhungasan4bod skad kyisage sar sgrung bshadapar ma zad/ da dung mang tshogasarang bzhin gyi ge sar sgrung bshad pa dang 'khrab ston byed pa bcasakyi bya 'gul rgya chen po spel ba dang / zhing chen dang ljongasa'aga'i ched lasarig rtsal sde khag gi4kyang ge sar sgrub gi nang don ltar bsgrigasapa'i rtsed mo'akhrab ston mi nyung ba bgyisate/ mngatshogasakyi rig gnayo'atsho ba hur por btang bar bstun nayoge sar sgrung gi bya bar yang skula'aded legasapo gnang /der ma zad da dung sgrung pa skad gragasacan gragasapa dang g.yuman/bsamagrub/ tshe ring dbang 'dus/ gu ru rgyal mtshan/ blob grag4pa/282

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/go /nged cag gi ge sar sgrung gi 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig yig sgyur/par sgrun/ zhib 'jug bcas kyi bya ba ni grung go gsar ba btsugs rjes da gzod dngos ga'ago brtsams pa yin la/ lo rabs lnga bcu ba'i mjug dang lo rabs drug cu ba'i 'go nas bzung snga gzhug tu zangs gang mang la rgya khyon cung che ba'i sgo nas 'tshol sdud dang myur skyob dag sgrig bcas kyi bya ba sgrub pa brgyud nas byun mong ma yin pa'i rin po che ste ge sar sgrung la mngon par ma tho ba'i go gnas thob/ khyad par du lor bas brgyad cu ba nas bzung / snga gzhug tu 'brel yod zhing chen dang ljongs kyi dus deb dang tshags par steng du rgya bod yig rigs gnyis kyi ge sar sgrung gi le'u'i tshan pa bkod pa dang /dus ma/tshungs sa mtsho sngon zhing s+dzawī dang kan lho'i kun khyab rlung 'phrin lasakhungs nas bod skad kyis ge sar sgrung bshad par ma zad/ da dung mang tshogs rang bzhin gyi ge sar sgrung bshad pa dang 'khrab ston byed pa bcas kyi be+e 'gul rgya chen po spel ba dang / zhing chen dang ljongs 'ga'i ched las rig rtsal sde khag gis kyang ge sar sgrung gi nang don ltar bsgrigs pa'i rtsed mo 'jib ston mi nyung ba bgyis te/ mang tshogs kyi rig gnas 'tsho ba hur por btang bar bstun nas ge sar sgrung gi bya bar yang sbul 'ded legs po gnang /der ma zad da dung sgrung pa skad grags can grags pa dang g.yu sman/bsam grub/ tshe ring dbang 'dus/ gu ru rgyal mtshan/ zla ba grags pa/282

— rang rgyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum rob tsam gleng ba/che ring bsod nams bcas sgrung pa brgya lhag kyang skabs 'dir gsar du rnyed pa yin la/ nged cag gis thengs 'gar khong rnams rtsa 'dzugs byas te sgrung bshad tshogs 'du bsdus shing / khong tshos bshad pa'i sgrung rnams sgrar phab pa dang zin thor 'god pa/ dag sgrig par skrun byed pa bcas kyis bya ba 'dir ma/thong chen byas pa las gzhan khong rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i thad du yang bkod sgrig legs po byas pa yin/spyir rig gnas gsar brje'i skab4su/ nged cag gi ge sar sgrung mang po rmeg med du btang yang / phyis sa 'khrul ped lam phyogs gsar bsakhrid ston gnang bar brten/ nga tsho'i ge sar sgrung gi 'tshol sdu da dang dag sgrig yig sgyur/ par skrun bcas kyi bya bar sngar las 'phel rgyas legs po byung / da lta rgyal yongs tshod ga sgrig par skrun byas pa'i bod yig gi sgrung dpe80lhag la slebs pa dang / rgya sgyur ma20lhag la slebs yod/ der ma zad da dung snyan rtsom dang 'brel ba yod pa'i dpe deb rigs mi 'dra ba yang nyisabargya yan la slebs 'dugadus mtshungs sa ge sar sgrung gi bya bar yongs khyab tu 'phel rgyasagasar ba byung zhing / bod rgya mkhas pa bgres gzhon mang pos bris pa'i dpyad rtsom200lhag la bud par ma zad/ rgyu spus kyang sngar las je legasatshosong yo da/ snga gzhug tu 6khron khrin tu'u dang bod ljongs las/ nang sog dang kan su'u lan kru/ mtsho sngon zi ling bcas stobangs lnga la rgyal spyi'i ge sar sgrung gi rig gzhung gros tshogs bsdus shing / gom gang mdun spos sgos283

rang rgyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum rab tsam gleng ba/tshe ring bsod namasabaca4sgrung pabargya lhag kyang skabasa'adir gsar du rnyed payin la/ nged cag gisathengasa'agar khong rnamasartsa 'dzugasabya4te sgrung bshad tshogasa'adu bsdusashing / khong tshosabashad pa'i sgrung rnamasasgrar phab pa dang zin thor 'god pa/ dag sgrig par skrun byed pa bcasakyisabya ba 'dir mthong chen byasapa la4gzhan khong rnamasakyi 'tsho ba'i thad du yang bkod sgrig legasapobyasapa yin/spyir rig gnasagasar brje'i skab4su/ nged cag gi ge sar sgrung mang po meg med du btang yang / phyisasu'akhrulamed lam phyogasagasar bsakhrid ston gnang bar brten/ nga tsho'i ge sar sgrung gi 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig yig sgyur/ par skrun bcasakyi bya bar sngar lasa'aphel rgyasalegasapo byung / da lngargyalayong4sudag sgrig par skrun byasapa'i bod yig gi sgrung dpe80lhag la slebasangadang / rgya sgyur ma20lhag laslebasayod/ der mazad da dung snyan rtsom dang 'brel ba yod pa'i dpodeb rigasami'adra ba yang nyisabargya yan la sleb4'dugadusamatshungasasun sar sgrung gi bya bar yongasakhyab tu 'phel rgyasagasar ba byung zhing / bod rgya mkhasapa bgresagazhon mang posabrisapa'i dpyad rtsom200lhag labud par mazad/ rgyu spusakyang sngar lasaje legasasusong yod/ sngagazhug tu sikhron khrin tu'u dang bod ljongasalhas/ nang sog dang kun su'u lan kru/ mtsho sngon zi ling bca4suthengasalngal rgyal spyi'i ge sar sgrung gi rig gzhung grosatshog4bsdu4shing / gomagang mdun sposwā༈sa

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tsheringagi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhib 'jug gi khyab khongasargya bskyed pa dang zhib 'jug mi sna skyed sring byasate/zhib 'jug gi chu skye4metog 'dzam gling yongasasurnam par bzhad pa'i skalabazang gi dusal rol bzhin pa'o/ /gnyis pa/ 〈cing gar〉sog rig4kyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsomaring po〈cing gar〉ni brjod bya'i don rgya che zhing rjod byed kyi tshig phun sumatshogasapa zhig yin/ bgrang bya brgya phrag du ma'i ring la snyan rtsomaring po 'di sog rigasamidamangasakyi khrod du med pa nasayod pa dang yod pa nasadar rgyasasusong ba dang 'gro bzhin yod cing / 'di4sog po'i be lā the(17mo )4khulagyi rang byung yul ljongasadang spyi tshogasa'atsho ba/ mi dmangasakyi semasakhamasabacasagating zab pa'i sgo na4mtshon par bya4par ma zad/ lorgyusasnyan rtsom ring po 'di'i yig 'bru re re dang tshig rkang re re lasasog rigasamidamangasakyi lo rgyusadang cho4lugs/ gomasasros/ rig gnas/ 'jig rten ltatshulabacasakyang gsal ler mngon yod/〈cing gar〉zhesapa 'di ni lo rgyusasnyan rtsom ring po 'di'i nang gi misnagatso bodapa' rgod cing gar zhesapa'i ming lasa'abyor ba lags/ lo rgyusasnyan rtsom ring po 'di ni phal cher dusarabs15nas17bar der skabasade'i nub sog gamazi be lā the bya ba'i sakhuladu byung ba red/ be lā the zhesapa ni sog po'i gna' rabasakyi tsho ba zhig gi ming yin/ de'i don ni nagasatshal gyi tsho ba'am nagasatshal khrod kyi besang zhesapa'o/ / dusarabs13pa'i sngon la284

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhib 'jug gi khyab khongs rgya ba byed pa dang zhib 'jug mi sna byed sring byas te/zhib 'jug gi chu skyes me tog 'dzam gling yongs sa rnam par bzhad pa'i skalabazang gi dus la rol bzhin pa'o/ /gnyis pa/ 〈cing gar〉sog rigs kyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring po〈cing gar〉ni brjod bya'i don rgya che zhing rjod byed kyi tshig phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin/ bgrang bya brgya phrag du ma'i ring la snyan rtsom ring po 'di sog rigs mi dmangs kyi khrod du sked pa nas yod pa dang yod pa nas dar rgyas su song ba dang 'gro bzhin yod cing / 'dis sog po'i be+e lā je(174 )sa khul gyi rang byung yul ljongs dang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba/ mi dmangs kyi sems khamasabacas gting zab pa'i sgo nas mtshon par byas par ma zad/ lo rgyus snyan rtsom ring po 'di'i yig 'khru re re dang tshig rkang re re las sog rigasamidamangs kyi lo rgyus dang chos lugs/ goms sro / rig gnas/ 'jig rten lta tshul bcas kyang gsal ler mngon yod/〈cing gar〉zhes pa 'di ni lo rgyus snyan rtsom ring po 'di'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo dpa' rgod cing gar zhes pa'i ming las 'byor ba lags/ lo rgyusasnyan rtsom ring po 'di ni phal cher dus rabs15nas17bar der skabs de'i nub sog gam zi be+e lā be+e be+e ba'i sa khul du byung ba red/ be+e lā je zhes pa ni sog po'i gna' rabs kyi tsho ba zhig gi ming yin/ de'i don ni nags tshal gyi tsho ba'am nags tshal khrod kyi be+e sang zhes pa'o/ / dus rabs13pa'i sngon la 284

rang rgyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum dob tsam gleng ba/kho tsho pe tsar mtsho' byang phyogs kyi an ca la'i chu chen sa khul gyi chu brgyad bzhur 'gram du gzhi chags/ dus rabs11nas13pa'i skabs sa sog po'i tshob de nags tshal tsho ba dang sa thang gi tsho ba gnyis su gyes nas 'dus sdod byed pa'o/〈cing gar〉be+e gna' rabs kyi zhi lā 'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ji bzhin thog ma tha' bar gsum du mi sna gtso bo gcig dang brjod bya'i nang don gcig kho na bzung nas brjod pa zhig min te/ der byung gar dang hong gar bcas dpa' bo' mi sna las grub pa'i gtam rgyud bcu lhag cig mchis shing /de dag re ri'i nang don yang phal cher cha mtshungs yin la/ gtam rgyud re re bzhin〈cing gar〉gyi dmangs khrod sgrung pas 'khrab len byas chog 〈cing gar〉cha tshang las gtam rgyud la la dus tshod thog dang gtam rgyud kye go rim thog phan tshan bar 'brel ba cung zad yo da pa 'dra yang mang che shos la 'brel ba med/ de'i phyir gtam rgyud de dag las sngon la byung ba'i gtam/ rgyud dang rjes su byung ba'i gtam rgyud gang yin pa'i go rim dgar dka' mor 'dug go/〈cing gar〉de dang thog rang rgyal gyi zhin cang sa khul gyi sog rigs mi dmangs kyi khrod du dar khyab byung ba red/ phyis sa rim gyis rang rgyal gyi byang phyogs sa khul dang uru su/ mong gol mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi sog rigs dmangs khrod du dar khyab tu song / skabs de nas bzung 'dzam gling spyi'i spyod pa'i rig gnas kyi nor rdzas shig tu gyur pa red/〈cing gar〉gyi 'bol sdud dang par skrun khya ba ni dus rabs19ba 285

rang rgyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum rob tsam gleng ba/khotshome tsar mtsho'i byang phyogasakyi an ca lā'i chu chen sakhul gyi chu brgyad bzhur 'gram du gzhi chags/ dusarabs11nas13pa'i skabasasusog po'i ṭ+wāṃb de ṭ+wāṃg4tshal tsho ba dang cathang gi tsho ba gnyisasagyesanasa'adu4sdod ོda pa~X/cing gar〉ni gna' rabasakyi zhi lā'i lo rgyu4brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ji bzhin thog ma tha' bar gsum du mi sna gtso bo gcig dang brjod bya'i nang don gcig kho na bzunganasabarjod pa zhig min te/ der cing gar dang hong gar bcasadapa' bo'i misna lasagrub pa'i gtam rgyud bcu lhag cig mchi4shing /de dag re ri'i nang don yang phal cher cha mtshungasayin la/ gtamargyud re re bzhin〈cing gar〉gyi dmangasakhrod sgrung pasa'akhrab len bya4chog 〈cing gar〉cha tshang lasagatam rgyud la la du4tshod thog dang gtam rgyud kyi go rim thog phan tshun bar 'brelab cung zad yod pa 'dra yang mang che shosala'abrel ba med/ de'i phyir gtam rgyud de dag lasasngon labyung ba'i gtam rgyud dang rjeyosu byung ba'i gtamargyud gang yin pa'i go rimadagar dka' mor 'dug go/〈cing gar〉de dang thog rang rgyalagyi zhin cang 4khul gyi sog rigasami dmang4kyi khrod du dar khyab byung ba red/ phyisasuriyogyisarang rgyal gyi byang phyogasasakhul dang uru su/ mong gol midamang4spyi mthun rgyalakhab kyi sog rigasadamangasakhrod du dar khyab tu song / skabasade nasabazung 'dzam gling spyi'i spyod pa'i rig gnasakyi nor rdza4shig tu gyur pa red/〈cing gar〉gyi 'tshol sdud dang par skrun bya ba ni du4raba~X/༷ba

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nas bzung 'go bcoms pa red/ skabs der gtso bo uru sa dang 'jar man gyi ma/khas pa tshor 'di phyogs kyi spro ba rgyas te/ kho tshos uru sung mnga' khongs sa yod pa'i kher cha khe ( 8 7lo 1 ) mi'i khrod du dar khyab tu 'gro bzhin pa'i〈cing gar〉gyi skor 'tshol sbud byas te/ 'grel bshad dang mchan 'grel brtags nas par skrun gnang / rang rgyal gyi〈cing gar〉'tshol sdud dang zin bris 'god pa'i be+e ba1978lor dngos ga'ago brtsamasapa lags/ lo 'di dag gi ring tho pa tu'u spyadang pa yan hu'u zhi ku'u gnyisakyis zhin cang jen hran ri bo'i lho byang gi rdzong bcu gnyis kyi sog rigasa'adus sdo da sa khul du zla lnga lhag la brtag dpyod byas te zin bris sa bkod pa'i〈cing gar〉khag15de/ zhin cang mi dam/ngas dpe skrun khang du tho ze yig rigs7:1ma ) kyis par skrun byas pa dang / 1982lo mkhar sngon po'i nang sog mi dmangs dpe sgrun khang du sog yig gis par skrun byas/1986lo'i tshun la ma yig sna kha mi 'dra ba gsum ste bsdoms pas glegs bam khag86par skrun byas yod cing / der snyan ngag gi rkang pa bsdoms pas chiga'abum tshog khri la slebs 'dug glegs bam khag86de'i nang nas bskyar par 1yod pa zas na shul du da dung65lhag yod pa'o/ /sgrung pa ni dpa' bo'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom〈cing gar〉gyi gsar gtod pa dang rgyun 'dzin pa yin/ mig sngar rgyal khab phyi nang du 'tshol sdud byas pa'i sna kha mi gcig pa'i gtam rgyud bcu dang bskyar yig tu phal cher sna kha200la skebs pa 'di thams cad〈cing gar〉gyi sgrung pa rnams286

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nasabazung 'go brtsam4pa red/ skabasader gtso bo uru sudang 'jar man gyi mkhasapa tshor 'di phyogasakyi sprobargyasate/ kho tsho4uru su'i mnga' khongasasuyod pa'i kher mes(67cho7)mi'i khrod du dar khyab tu'asgobazhin pa'i〈cing gar〉gyi skor 'tshol sdud bya4te/ 'grel bshad dang mchan 'grel btagasanasapar skrun gnang / rang rgyalagyi〈cing gar〉'tshol sdud dang zin brisa'agod pa'i bya ba1978lor dngosasu'ago brtsamasapa lags/ lo 'di dag gi ribatho patu'u mādang pa yan hu'u zhi ku'u gnyisakyisazhin cang then hran ri bo'i ltobyang gi rdzong bcu gnyisakyi sog rigasa'adusasdod 4khul du zla lngaltag labartag dpyod byasate zin brisasubakod pa'i〈cing gar〉khag15de/ zhin cang midamangasadape skrun khang du tho the yig rigs(7r+ṣa4)kyisapar skrun byasapa dang / 1982lomakhar sngon po'i nang sog midamangasadape skrun khang du sog yig gisapar skrun byas/1986lo'i tshun lamayig sna kha mi'adra bgasum stebasdomasapasaglegasabam khag86par skrun bya4yod cing / der snyan ngag gi rkang pa bsdomasapasachig 'bum chig khri la slebasa'adug gleg4bamakhag86de'i nang nas bskyar par21yod paphrisan shul du da dung65lhag yod pa'o/ /sgrung pa ni dpa' bo'i lorgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsom(cing gar〉gyi gsar gtod pa dang rgyun 'dzin payin/ mig sngar rgyal khab phyi nang du 'tsholasdud bya4pa'i sna khamigacig pa'i gtam rgyud bcu dang bskyar yig tu pha~Xhāḍi sna kha200la slebasapa 'di tham4cad〈cing gar〉gyi sgrung pa rnamayo

rangargyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum rob tsam gleng ba/labarten nasayong ba gdonamiza zhing / kho tshor brten nas〈cing gar〉gyi gtam rgyud 'di dusarabasanasadusarabasadang mi rabasanasamirabasabar 'asakhyab bzhin mchinusaso/ /lo rgyu4kyi snyan rtsom ring po〈cing gar〉'tsholasdud dang dag sgrigapar skrun bcasakyi bya ba 'phelargyasasusong ba dang bstun nas/ 〈cing gar〉gyi zhib 'jug bya ba yang rim gyisa'aphelargyasasu'agro bzhin yod/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhasapa minyung ba zhig gisadapyad gtamarin thang can mang po spel te/ sog po'i〈cing gar〉gyi 'byung khungasadang lotshigs/ brjod bya'i ngor dang rjod byed tshig gi sgyu rtsal/ dmangasakhrod kyi sgrung pa dang dar khyab kyi khyad chosasogasal dpyad pa gang legasabatang nasazhiba'ajug gi chu tshad mtho ru 'degasabazhin 'dug go/gsum pa/ 〈mā na ba〉〈mā na se〉ni 'dzayogling steng skad gragasache ba'i dpa' bo'i lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsomaring pozhig lags/ der phun sum tshogasapa'i nang don dang shin tu snyan pa'i rjod byed tshig gi phreng ba yodapar mazad/ da dung da~X par mtho ba'i mdzesadapyod kyi rin thang dang shesartogasakyi rin thang yang mdzas/〈lnga na se〉zhesapar khor kheyu mirigasakyi spyi tshogasa'atsho ba gzhir bzung nasakhor khe tsi rigasakyi lasadabang dang mirigasakyi snying stobasazhib 'briganang 'dug de ni gna' rab4kyi khor khetsi midamang4kyi ziṭ+wāṃ ba

rang rgyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum rob tsam gleng ba/lo brten nas yong ba gdon mi za zhing / kho tshor brten nas〈cing gar〉gyi gtam rgyud 'di dus rabs nas dus rabs dang mi rabs nas skor bas bar la khyab bzhin mchis so/ /lo rgyus kyi snyan rtsom ring po〈cing gar〉'tshol sdud dang dag sgrigapar skrun bcas kyi bya ba 'phel rgyas gsong ba dang bstun nas/ 〈cing gar〉gyi zhib 'jug bya ba yang rim gyis 'phel rgyas sa 'gro bzhin yod/ rgyal khab byu nang gi ma/khas pa mi nyung ba zhig gis dpyad gtam rin thang can mang po sto ce/ sog po'i〈byung gar〉gyi 'byung khungs dang lo tshigs/ brjod bya'i char dang rjod byed tshig gi sgyu rtsal/ dmangs khrod kyi sgrung pa dang dar khyab kyi khyad chos sogs la dpyad pa gang legs btang nas zhib 'jug gi chu tshad mtho ru 'degs bzhin 'dug go/gsum pa/ 〈ma na tha〉〈mā na si〉ni 'dzam gling steng skad grags che ba'i dpa' bo'i lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring po zhig lags/ der phun sum tshogs pa'i nang don dang shin tu snyan pa'i rjod byed tshig gi steng ba yod par ma zad/ da dung rnam par mtho ba'i mdzes dpyod kyi rin thang dang shes rtogs kyi rin thang yang mchis/〈mā na si〉zhes par khor khe tsi ba rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba gzhir bzung nas khor khe tsi rigs kyi las dbang dang shi rigs kyi snying stobs zhib 'bri gnang 'dug de ni gna' rabs kyi khor khe tsi chad mangs byu 'tsho ba 287

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang 'thab rtsod mtshon pa'i rlabs chen gyi lo rgyus snyan rtsom zhig yin la/ lorgyus snyan rtsom 'di'i nang du da dung khor khe tsi rigs dang tsho ba gzhan bdabacha rigs gzhan pa'i bar gyi phan tshun 'gro 'ong gi lo rgyus dang / khor kho tsi rigs kyi spyi tshogs kyi grub cha/ thon skyed kyi byed stangs bcas kyang mtshonayod do/ /〈mā na si〉a khyab khongs ha cang rgya che la/ khor khe tsi rigs gnasapa'i sa khul yod tshad du lo rgyus snyan rtsom 'di sa khyab rdo khyab tu song yod/rang rgyal gyi zhin cang sa khul ni khor khe tsi rigs gnas pa'i sa khul yin zhing /1990lo'i mi grangs zhib bsher ltar na/ rang rgyal smre khor khe tsi rigs la migrangs141549yod cing / de'i nang lto mtshams(cha/ ༅)ga mi khri10yod pa dang byang mtshams(46 )sa mi grangs phal cher12()00yod/ zhin cang ltophyogs kyi khe ci'i le so khor khe tsi rang skyong khul be+e〈mā na si〉dar khyab shin tu che ba'i sa khul gtso bo zhig yin pa la sa gzhan da dung zhin cang gi byang phyogasakyi ze khe si sa thang dang a le je sa khul du'ang khyab bzhin mchis la/ ci ar ci na si than dang / ha sa khe si than/ de min a byu han/ pha khi 6than gyi byang rgyud sa khul bcas g.yang khyab bzhin yod do/ /〈mā na si〉ni gna' bo'i zhi lā'i hu'u ma'i lo rgyus snyan rtsom/ dang / yorob sa khul gyi dus rabs bar ma'i skabs kyi lo rgyus snyan rtsom rnams dang mi 'dra bar de tsho'i bar la khyad par yod/ 〈lnga na si〉la mtshon na dmangasakhrod kyi ngag thog kho nar brten nas brgyud cing / da lta 'i bar lo ngo brgya phrag 288

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ dang 'thabartsod mtshon pa'i rlabasachen gyi lorgyuyosnyan rtsoyozhig yin la/ lorgyu4snyan rtsom 'di'i nang du da dung khor khe tsi rigasadang tsho ba gzhanabadab mirig4gzhan pa'i bar gyi phan tshuna'agro 'ong gi lo rgyu4dang / khor khori zlo/〉kyi spyi tshogasakyi grub cha/ thon skyed kyi byed stangasabacasakyang mtshon〈lnga na sa〉yikhyab khongasaha cang rgya che la/ khor khe tsi rig4gnasapa'i sakhulayod tshad du lo rgyusasnyan rtsoma'adi sakhyab rdo khyab tu song yod/rang rgyalagyi zhin cang sakhulani khor khe tsi rigasaganasapa'i sakhulayin zhing /1990lo'i migrangasazhib bsher ltar na/ rang rgyalagyi khor khe tsi rigasalamigrangs141549yod cing / de'i nang lhomatshams/tsā/ ma)sur+shakhri10yod padang byang mtshams(46 )sumigangasaphal cher12000yod/ zhin cang ltophyogasakyi khe ci'i leso khor khetsi rang skyong khul ni〈mā na si〉dar khyab shin tu che ba'i sakhul gtso bo zhig yin pa lasagazhan da dung zhin cang gi byang phyogasakyi the khe si cathang dang alethe 4khul du'ang khyab bzhin mchi4la/ ci ar ci gisi than dang / ha sakhe si than/ de min ablu han/ pha khi sithan gyi byang rgyud sakhul bcayosuyang khyab bzhin yod do/ /〈mā na se〉ni gna' bo'i zhi lā'i hu'u ma'i lorgyu4snyan rtsomadang / yorob sakhul gyi dusarabasabar ma'i skabayokyi lo rgyusasnyan rtsom rnamasadang mi 'dra bar de tsho'i bar la khyad par yod/ 〈mā na si〉lamatshon na dmangasakhrodā ñtsha ngag thog kho nar brten nasabargyud cing / da lta'i bar longo brgya phrag

rang rgyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum rob tsam gleng ba/du ma'i lo rgyusayod la/ yun ring po'i 'phelargyasakyi khrod du'ang 'gyur ldogamangapo byung myong / da lta'i bskyar yig mang polas/ zhin cang ahu'u chi rdzong gi sgrung pa rgan pam ma dbyis(zazayo)kyisabashad pa'i〈mā na sa〉khag brgyad de ha cang kha tshang 'dzomasapozhig yin pa mthong thub/ khong gisabashad pa'i sgrung de ni rgya che zhing gting zab la/ bsdom4pasasnyan ngag gi rkang pa 'bum gnyisayod/ hu'u ma'i〈yeleyāb〉dang bsdur na ldab bcu bzhi lasamang / ngag sgrub de'i brjod bya'i don layang gzhan dang mi mtshung4pa'i khyad cho4yod cing / gson nyamasaldan lacha tshang ba'i gtam rgyud cig red/ de'i nang zhiba'abri byasapa'i misna brgya lhag yo da pa tham4cad la sosor rang rang gi khyad chosaldan pa dang g.yul sache chung bcu phrag mang po yod pa rnamasazhib 'bri byasapar yang yid 'gug gi nu4pa ldan no/ / sgrung pam ma dbyisakyisabashad pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang mtho ba'i(mān se〉khag brgyad de1979lo kha tshang du zin bri4subakod pa yin zhing /des(mā na se〉yig thog tugatan khel byed pa'i bya ba de dusarabasanyi shu ba'i lo rab4bdun cu'i nang mjug grub pa mtshon no/ /〈rmā na sa〉byung ba'i dusarabasaskor lamig sngar rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhasapa mang por bzhed pa mi mthun pa mang po mchisana'ang / spyi bsdomasabya4na gshamagyi ltababazhi ste/ de yang khacig gi4du4rabasadagu bar byung bar 'dod pa dang / khacig gisajun gar rgyal po'i skabasasubyung bar 'dod pa/ yang khacig gi4dusarabs16nas17pa'i bar la byuzlo ༵ra

rang rgyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum rob tsam gleng ba/du ma'i lo rgyus yod la/ yun ring po'i 'phel rgyas kyi khrod du'ang 'gyur ldog mang po byung myong / da ltang bskyar yig mang po las/ zhin cang a hu'u chi rdzong gi sgrung pa rgan pa ma ma dbyis(zam lo kyis bshad pa'i〈mā na si〉khag brgyad de ha cang kha tshang 'dzoms po zhig yin pa mthong thub/ khong gisabashad pa'i sgrung de ni rgya che zhing gting zab la/ bsdo mas pas snyan ngag gi rkang pa 'bum gnyis yod/ hu'u ma'i〈ye lo lnga ba〉dang bsdur na ldab bcu bzhi las mang / ngag sgrung de'i brjod bya'i don la yang gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos yod cing / gson nyams ldan la cha tshang ba'i gtam rgyud cig red/ de'i nang zhib 'bri byas pa'i mi sna brgya lhag yo da pa thamasacad la so sor rang rang gi khyad chos ldan pa dang g.yul sa che chung bcu phrag ma nga po yod pa rnams zhib 'bri byas par yang yid 'gug gi nus pa lda na no/ /sgrung pa ma ma dbyis kyis bshad pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang mtho ba'i〈mā na si〉khag brgyad de1979lo kha tshang du zin bris sa bkod pa yin zhing /des〈mā na si〉yig thog tu gtan khel byed pa'i bya ba de dus rabs nyi shu ba'i lo rabs bdun cu'i nang mjug grub pa mtshon no/ /〈lnga na si〉byung ba'i dus rabs skor la mig sngar rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas pa mang por bzhed pa mi mthun pa mang po mchis na'ang / spyo bsdomasabyas na gsham gyi ltab bzhi ste/ de yang kha cig gis dus rabs dgu bar byung bar 'dod pa dang / kha cig gis jun gar rgyal po'i skabs su byung bar 'dod pa/ yang kha cig gis dus rabs16nas17pa'i bar la byung bar 289

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'dod cing / skor zhig gis dus rabs10ba nas16pa'i skabs sa byung bar 'dod pa de'o/ / gang ltar kyang da lta'i rang rgyal gyi mkhas pa mang shasashig gis mjug mtha'i lta1bar 'dod pa'i dpyad gtam ma nga po brjod yod/de'i rgyu mtshan yang〈mā na si〉⑪brjod be+e gco bo ni/ khor khe ci'i midamangs kyis khe tha dbyis(sgo4yo ma)dang kha li mā khe mi(—shā7 1thum ma)yi'aphrog bcom dang gnya' gnon 'a 'gog rgol bgyis pa'i lo rgyus yin zhing/de ni〈mā na si〉ye lo rgyus kyi brjod bya grub pa'i rmang gzhi yang yin la/ khe bdabyis zhes pa gna' rabs kyi chi tan(༅za )rgyal khab ste li'o(tsa)zhes pa dang gcig mtshungs yin zhing / li'o yod ra rgud la mtshon na dus rabs10ba nas13pa'i dus mgo yin pa dang / khor khe tsi dang kha li nā/ khe mi'i bar gyi g.yul 'byed dza drag che ba'i skabs kyang dus rabs15ba'i dkyil yin/ dus rabs16pa'i dus mgor khor khe ci'i mi gtso byas pa'i min bo'u 6than gyi dmag dpung gis mi ce hra(༅na tshi/ )dang khi hri kur(44—/ yi nya5)ye.a ra chang(0/ yod zo)sogs sa khul btsan bzung byas/ skabs de'i g.yul 'gyed nang khor khe ci'i mi dang ha sa khe mnyam 'brel byas te sog mir phar rgol byas pa red/ 'di dag tshang ma〈mā na si〉ye nang du brjod pa'i nang don dang shin tu ma tshungs/ de min da dung lo rgyus snyan rtsom du byung ba'i mi sna mang che shos kyi rus ming yang dbyi yul na chos lugs sum gyur pa'i sngo na gyi khor khe tsi'i mi'i rus ming dang mtshungs/ khor khe ci'i mis dbyi nal na chololugs la dad mos byed pa ni dus rabs17pa'i rjes yin pas na/ lo rgyus290

gcod pa donagrub dang snyingabo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/ — 'dod cing / skor zhig gisadusarabs10ba nas16pa'i skabasasubyugabar 'dod pa de'o/ / gang ltar kyang da lta'i rang rgyalagyi mkhasapa mang shasashig gisamajug mtha'i ltabar 'dod pa'i dpyad gtam mang po brjod yod/de'i rgyu mtshan yang(mā na si〉yibarjod bya gtso bo ni/ khor khe ci'i midamangs kyisakhe tha dbyis(ོ/loyong)dngakha lirmākhe mi(calo7༅ma)yi'aphrog bcom dang gnya' gnon la'agog rgol bgyisapa'i lorgyu4yin zhing/de ni〈mān sirnyayilo rgyusakyi brjod bya grub pa'i rmang gzhi yang yin la/ kheb dbyisazhesangagana' rabasakyi chi tan(༅za)rgyal khab stoli'o(nga)zhe4pa dang gcig mtshungasayin zhing / li'o yodar rgud lamatshon na dusarabs10banas13pa'i dusamago yin pa dang / khor khe tsi dang kha li mā khe mi'i bar gyi g.yul 'gyed dza drag che ba'i skabasakyang dusarabs15ba'i dkyil yin/ dusarabs16pa'i du4mgor khor khe ci'i mi gtso byasapa'i min bo'u sithan gyi dmag dpung gisami ci tra(༅47/ )dngakhi hri kur(44/yi nya5)yo.ar chang(0/laza)sogasasakhul btsan bzung byas/ skabasade'i g.yula'agyed nang khor khe ci'i mi dang ha sakhe mnyam 'brel byasate sog mir phar rgolabya4pa red/ 'di dag tshang ma〈mān si〉yinang du brjod pa'i nang don dang shin tumatshungs/ de min da dung lo rgyu4snyan rtsomadu byung ba'i mi sna mang che sho4kyi rusaming yang dbyi silan chosalugasasum gyur pa'i sngon gyi khor kheci'i mi'i rusaming dang mtshungs/ khor kheci'i migadabyi silan choyolu/༵ladad mosabyed pa ni dusarabs17pa'i rjesayin pasan/ lorgyus

rangargyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum rob tsam gleng ba/snyan rtsoma'adi grub pa'i dusatshad kyang du4rabs16palasabargal mithubapa khatshon bcad de smrasachog de'i phyir〈mā na se〉byung ba'i dusatshod ni khor khe tsi'i rmahri hran(mkhu/)sakhuladu spor rjesadang / dbyi silan chosalugasasum gyur pa'i sngon te/ dusarabs10ba nas16pa'i bar yin pa'i sdomatshig bzhag cho'i/ pas/so/ /sgrung gtamalasabyung ba'i mā na sini lngasgrung gi misna zhig min par/khong ni 'tsho bdangosal4byung ba'i sha khrag gnyisaldan gyi mizhig yin par ma zad/ mang tshogasasna 'dren byasate sog mi dang kha li mā khe mir khrag dri bro ba'i dmar 'dzing byed pa'i mnyam 'brel tsho ba'i 'go dpon zhig yin pa lasagazhan/ da dung blo rig rgod cing dmagartsal la mkhasapa'i dpa' bo zhig kyang yin no/ / khong gi mtha' skor du nam yang 'bralamed du gnasapa'i dpa' chen40yo da pa de'i gan4tshul las/ lo rgyusakyi sgrung rtsom 'di ni dpa' rgod mān sikhon zhib 'bri byayoparkyang rkyang zhig min par/ stobasashugayonyamasapa med pa'i mā na si'i dpa' bo'i dpung gi4 tshogasarnamasakyang zhib 'bri byasayod pa zhig yin pa gsal bor shesathub bo/ /bcingasa'agrolabyasarjesargyal khab kyis〈mā na si〉yi'atsholasdud dang dag sgrig yig sgyur/ zhib 'jug bcasakyi bya bar gtsigasa'adzin byasate/lo rabasadrug cu'i mgor ragasaram gyisazhib dpyod byasanas〈mā na si〉bshad pa'i sgrungag70lhag rnyed pa dang / de'i nang du〈mān so〉khag bdun bshad sheyopa dang khag bdun yan bshad shesapa'i sgrung pa gnyisaga~X du

rang rgyal gyi ches ring ba'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gsum rob tsam gleng ba/snyan rtsom 'di grub pa'i dus tshad kyang dus rabs16ba las brgal mi thub pa khar bcad de mas chog de'i phyir〈lnga na si〉byung ba'i dus tshod ni khor khe rnal mi hri hran ( ma mi/sa khul du spor rjes dang / dbyi nal na chos lugasasam gyur pa'i sngon te/ dus rabs10ba nas16pa'i bar yin pa'i sdom tshig bzhag chog pas so/ /sgrung gtam las byung ba'i mā na na ni lha sgrung gi mi sna zhig min par/khong ni 'tsho ba dngos las byung ba'i sha khrag gnyis ldan gyi mi zhig yin par ma zad/ ma nga tshogs sna 'dren byas te sog mi dang kha li mā khe mir khrag dri bro ba'i dam ra 'dzing byed pa'i mnyam 'byel tsho ba'i 'go dpon zhig yin pa la sagazhan/ da dung blo rig rgod cing dmag rtsal la mkhas pa'i dpa' bo zhig khyang yin no/ /khong gi mtha' skor du nam yang 'bral med du gnas pa'i dpa' don40ngo da pa de'i gnas tshul las/ lo rgyus kyi sgrung rtsom 'di be+e dpa' rgod mā na 6kho na zhib 'bri byas pa rkyang rkyang zhig min par/ stobasashugs nyams pa med pa'i mā na se'i dpa' tong dpung gi tshogs rnams kyang zhib 'bri byas yod pa zhig yin pa gsal bor shes thub bo/ /bcings 'grol byas rjes rgyal khab kyis〈lnga na si〉⑪'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig yig sgyur/ zhib 'jug bcas kyi bya bar gtsigs 'dzin byas te/lo rabs drug cu'i mgor rags ram gyis zhib dpyod byas nas〈mā na se〉bshad pa'i sgrung pa70lhag rnyed pa dang / de'i nang du〈lnga na si〉khag bdun bshad shes pa dang khag bdun yan bshad shes pa'i sgrung pa gnyis gsar du 29

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byung / de las〈mān se〉yi'atsholasdud dang dag sgrig yig sgyur bcasakyi bya ba'i gomasastabasaje mgyogasasusong zhing grub 'brasakyang mngon gsalathon/khyad paradu skad gragasacan gyi sgrung pa ma ma dbyisakyisabashad pa'i deb dang poste〈mānasi〉dang deb gnyisapa ste〈semethe dbyis〉gnyisakhor khosu rigasakyi yiger dngosasupar skrun byasarjes/ 'dzam gling yongasakyi rgyalakhab minyung bar bag chagasazab mozhig bzhag yod pa lagasaso/ /spyir gong du smrasapa'i mi rigasami'adra ba gsum gyi sgrung khag mi 'dra bgasum po 'dir dpog dka' ba'i brjod bya'i don dang phun sum tshogasapa'i rjod byed kyi tshig mchis na yang mtshamasasbyor gting zab cing rgya che ba zhig bgyid par rgyu cha dang skad rig4sogasakyi tshod 'dzin thebasapa4na 'di tsamagyisamajug sdud dgoyopa byung ngo / / yin na'ang kho bo'i re bar phyisasunged cag thamasacad kyisarlabasachen gyi sgrung khag gsum po 'dir zhib 'jug byasate mtsham4sbyor leg4podang / lhag par du phan tshun gyi yeger bsgyur nasakrung hwa mi rigasayongasakyi go thub par btang nas/ gong na4gong du dar rgyasayar ngosazla bzhin 'phel bar 'bad 'bung4byed dgosaso/ /292

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byung / de las〈lnga na si〉ye 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig yig sgyur bcas kyi bya ba'i goms stabs ji mkhyogs sa song zhing grub 'bras kyang mngon gsal thon/khyad par du skad grags can gyi sgrung pa ma ma dbyis kyis bshad pa'i deb dang po ste〈lnga na se〉dang deb gnyis pa ste〈so ste ze dbyis〉gnyis khor kho tsi rigs kyi ྾ger dngos su par skrun byas rjes/ 'dzam gling yongs kyi rgyalakhab mi nyung bar bag chags zab po zhig bzhag yod pa lags so/ /spyir gong du smras pa'i mi rigs mi 'dra ba gsum/ gyi sgrung khag mi 'dra bgasum po 'dir dpog dka' ba'i brjod bya'i don dang phun sum tshogs pa'i rjod byed kyi tshig mchis na yang mtshams sbyor gting zab cing rgya che ba zhig bgyid par rgyu cha dang skad rigs sogs kyi tshod 'dzin jebs pas na 'di tsamagyis ma/jug sdud dgos pa byung ngo / /yin na'ang kho bo'i re bar phyis sa nged cag thams cad kyis rlabs chen gyi sgrung khag gsu/ma po 'dir zhib 'jug byasate ma tshams spyor legs po dang / lhag par du phan tshan gyi ye ger bsgyur nasakhrung hwa mi rigs yongs kyi go thub par btang nas/ gong nas gong du dar rgyas yar ngos zla bzhin 'phel bar 'bad 'bungs byed dgos so/ /292

gcod pa don thub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshogs sa zhugs pa dang / de'i nang rang rgyal gyi mkhas pa35yod pa red/rang zhing gi gcod pa don grub dang chab 'gag rta mgrin/ bu bzhi bsayopa'i don grub/ tshe dbang thar/ a lags bon brgya bcas bod rigasamakhas pa lnga gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar gros tshogs sa zhugs nas/ tshogasa'adu'i thog rang rang gi dpyad rtsom yang sgogs 'don bgyis pa lags/de yang zla6pa'i tshe45nyin gyi snga dro gros tshogs kyi 'go tshugs pa dang /sku zhabs hun khe be+e le tsis gros tshogs la 'go 'dzin mdzad/ tshogs 'du'i thog thog mar le tun slob grwa chen mong dbu khrid pas tshogs zhugs pa rnamasal dga' bas re zhu tshig phul ba dang / zhor du slob grwa'i gnas spyo mdor bsdus mtshams sbyor gnang / de'i rjes gzangs 'di'i gros tshogs kyi gru'u zhi mkhar che'u bsam gtan rgyal mtshan lags kyis rgyal spyi'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gros tshogs bangs dang po nas zangs brgyad pa'i bar gyi brgyud rim gnas tshur rags rim ngo sprod mdzad pa dang chabs cig zangs 'di'i gros tshogs kyi las 'gan bde blag ngang 'grub pa'i re 'dun dang blang bya nan mo bton/ mjug mthar sku zhabs hun khe pe le tsis zangs 'di'i grosatshogs kyi gra sgrig gnas tshul skor tshogs zhugs pa rnams la snyan zhu gnang zhing / khong gis zengs 'di'i gros tshogs sa zhugs 'dod pa'i mkhasapa400lhag yod/ yin na'ang zhib sdur thengs mang byas rjes mkhasapa300lhag gtan khel byas pa 'di ni de lnga'i zhib 'jug gros tshogs dag lasatshogs zhugs mi sna ches bzang ba'i gros tshogs zengs gcig yin zhes294

bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/gsungaswā/ngasa'adi'i grosatshogasasuzhugasapa'i mkhasapa329yod pa'i khrod du/ mtshan dang snyan gragasamatho ba'i bod rig pa'i mkhasacana.ari'i sku zhabasasu'u po len dang / osikhru li ya'i bod rig pa'i mkhasabasku zhabasahri the en khe na/ h+pha ran se'i bod rig pa'i mkhasangasku zhabasamakhar me bsam gtan rgyal mtshan/ thengasa'adi'i grosatshogasakyi 'go 'dzin pa'amabod rig pa'i mkhasapasku zhabasahun khe pe le tsi/ de bzhin rang rgyalagyi mkhasapa bod ljongasaspyi tshogasatshan rig khang gi zhib 'jug pa sku zhabasaphun tshogasatshe ring dang / krung go'i bod rig pa'i shesarig lteganasakyi zhib 'jug pa sku zhab4tshe ring thar dang 'brug pa/ krung go'i spyi tshogasatshan rig khang gi zhib 'jug ngasku zhab4skalabazang rgyal/ krung dbyang mirigasaslob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan chen mob grag4pa'abyung gnas/ krung dbyang yig sgyur cusakyi lo tsā ba chen mosku zhabasardo rje mkhar/ nubabyang mi rigasaslob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan chen mobadakon mchog tshe brtan/ mtsho sngon mirigasaslob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan chen mob chab 'gag rta mgrin/ bu bzhi bsamapa'i don grub sogasayod cing / mkhasadabang 'di rnamapa'i gting zabakyi shesabya dang gzab nan gyi rnama'agyur/ khung4btsun zhing thogasapamed ༵༵ / ṭ+wāṃ sna /༵ bcasalatshogasazhugasapa rnamasakyisagadeng 'jogatshad thengasa'adi'i grosatshogasakyisamakhasapa soso'i dpyad rtsomaṭ+wāṃ hāng

bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/gsungs/zengs 'di'i gros tshogs gzhugs pa'i mkhas pa329yod pa'i khrod du/ mtshan dang snyan grags mtho ba'i bod rig pa'i mkhas can a ri'i sbu zhabs sto po len dang / yo6khru li ya'i bod rig pa'i mkhas pa sku zhabasahri the en khe na/ h+pha ran so'i bod rig pa'i mkhas pa sbu zhabs mkhar me bsam gtan rgyal mtshan/ zengs 'di'i gros tshogs kyi 'go 'dzin pa'amabod rig pa'i mkhas pa sku zhabs hun khe pe le tsi/ de bzhin rang rgyal gyi mkhas pa bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi zhib 'jug pa sku zhabs phun tshogs tshe ring dang / rngung go'i bod rig pa'i shes rig ltoganas kyi zhib 'jug pa sku zhabs ma ring thar dang 'brug pa/ krung go'i spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi zhib 'jug pa sku zhabs skal bzang rgyal/ krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan chen yob grags pa 'byung gnas/ krung dbyang yig sgyur khrus kyi lo tsā ba chen mo sbu zhabs rdo rje mkhar/ nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan chen yob dkon mchog tshe brtan/ mtsho sngon ba rigasaslob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan chen pob chab 'gag rta mgrin/ bu bzhi bsam pa'i don grub sogs yod cing / mkhas dbang 'di rnam pa'i gting zab kyi shes bya dang gzab nan gyi rnam 'gyur/ khungs btsun zhing thogs pa med pa'i gtam gleng bcas la tshogs zhugs pa rnams kyis gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang /zengs 'di'i gros tshogs kyis mkhas pa so so 'i dpyad rtsom gyi nang 295

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom sgogs bsgrigs/don ltar mi'i rigs kyi rig pa dang lo rgyus rig pa/ chos lugs rig pa/sgra rig pa/ gling sgrung rig pa/ dmabs srol rig pa/ rtsom rig bcas tshan khag chung ba23bgos te/ zla6pa'i tshes25nyin gyi phyi dro nas bzung dpyad rtsom sgogs 'don gyi 'go tshugs/ tshogs zhugs mkhas pa rnam pas rang gi tshogs chung nang dpyad rtsom sgogs 'don bgyis pa las gzhan/ rang gi 'dod mos ltar tshan khag chung ba gzhan pa'i nang du yang zhugs te/ nyan 'dod pa'i dpyad rtsom skor la nyan chog pa lags/ tshogs zhugs mkhas pa re la dpyad rtsom sgrogs 'don zhu dus tshod skar ma30las med/ de'i nang nas skar ma10ni dri ba dris lan byed pa'i dus tshod yin/ gal srid khyed kyi dpyad rtsam sgogs 'don byu dus tshod skar ma30las 'das na/ dri ba drisalan bgyid pa'i dus tshod yod pa ma yin/ mkhas pa rnams kyis rang gi zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras brjod pa'i skabs su/ tshogs zhugs pa rnams kyis rna ba blags nas nyan pa dang / dri ba bton pa'ang don zab cing tshig shin tu rno la/ bgro gleng bgyid pa yang gnad la khel ba zhig lags/ gal te khyed kyisasgrogs 'don gnang ba'i dpyad rtsom dang der 'brel ba'i shes bya dag la byang cha de tsam chad pa'am mtha' 'khyol ba zhig min na/ dri ba dris lan gsal bo'am gnad la khel ba zhig mi 'byung bas rang nyid kyang ngo gnong dgos pa'i gnas su rang shugs kyis lhung nges red/ yin na'ang rang rgyal zu mkhas pa mang che bas rim pa mang ba dang ltab mang po'i sgo nas gnad don 'don pa dang / gzhung lugs kyi khungs lung 'tshol ba/ da dung grangs ka ma/nga po 296

gcod pa don spub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ don ltar mi'i rigasakyi rig pa dang lorgyusarig pa/ chosalugasarigapa/5rig pa/ gling sgrung rig pa/ dmangasasrolarig pa/ rtsomarig bcasatshanakhag chung ba23bgosate/ zla6pa'i tshes25nyin gyi phyi dro nasabazung dpyad rtsomasgrog4'don gyi 'go tshugs/ tshogasazhugasamakhasapa rnam pasarang gi tshogasachung nang dpyad rtsom sgrogasa'adon bgyisapa lasagazhan/ rang gi 'dod mosaltar tshan khag chubab gzhan pa'i nang du yang zhugasate/ nyan 'dod pa'i dpyad rtsomaskor lanyan chog pa lags/ tshogasazhugasamakhasaparedzodapyad rtsom sgrogasa'adon gyi dusatshod skar ma30lasamed/ de'i nang nasaskar ma1)ni dri ba dri4lan byed pa'i du4tshod yin/ gal srid khyed kyi dpyadartsom sgrogasa'adon gyi dusatshod skar ma30las 'dasan/ dri ba drisalan bgyid pa'i dusachod yod pa ma yin/ mkhasapa rnam4kyi4rang gi zhib 'jug gi grub 'brasabarjod pa'i skab4su/ tshogasazhugasapa rnamasakyisarna ba blagasanasanyanapa dang / dri ba bton pa'ang don zab cing tshigashin tu rno la/ bgro gleng bgyid pa yang gnad lasalab zhig lags/ galate khyed kyisasgrogasa'adon gnang ba'i dpyad rtsom dang der 'brel ba'i shesabya dag la byang cha de tsam med pa'amamatha' brtseyongab zhig min na/ dri ba drisalan gsal bo'am gnad lakholabazhig mi 'byung bsarang nyid kyang ngo gnong dgosapa'i gan4surang shugasakyisalhung nge4red/ yin na'ang rang rgyal gyi mkhasapa mang che bsarim pa mang ba dang ltab mngapo'i sgo nasagand don 'don pa da~X 9/6gzhubalugasakyi khungasalung 'tsholab/ da dung grangasaka ma/nga po

bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/bkod padang zhib bsdur zhiba'ajug gi byed thabayosogasaspyad nasarabagi ltabrogasar ba dag zhib par gsalabashad gnang / de lasami'i rigasakyi rig padang chosalugasarig pa/ srolargyun rig gnas/ gling sgrung rig pabacasakyi tshan khag skor gyi zhiba'ajug lago bzabamo dang gtamagleng khyad par can mchi4par brten/ rgyalakhab soso'i tshogasazhugasamakha4parnamasakyi dga' bsuchen po thob/ dusamatshungasasurgyalaspyi'i bod kyi shesarig khyab khongasasurang rgyal gyiyobod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug bya ba'i khrod du blangasapa'i phun sum tshogasapa'i grub 'bra4mtshamasasbyor gnang ste/ rang re'i mesargyalalagazi brjid brtson len byas/grosatshogasakyisatshogasachen steng du dpyad gtam sgrog pa dang tshogasazhor du mi re gnyisabyasan4gleng molabyed pa'i thabasashesazung 'brel legasapo byas/ tshogasachen steng du tshang masanan tan ngang mkhasapasabarjod pa'i gtamal nyan par mazad/ dri ba dri4lan 'debasapa dang phan tshun bgro gleng byed bzhin mchis/ tshogasa'adu grolarjesamakhasapasosomangosarang shugayosulhan du 'dzomasan4phan tshun ladri ba 'don pa dang rtsod pa bgyid pa/ yang yang grosasdur byed pabacasabargyud na4rig gzhung gi gnad don skor zhig la ltatshulagacig mthun byung / gzhan yang gro4tshogasathog brnyan par phab pa(zalo)dang sgron brnyan par shel(spo po7)bstan pa dang nang don gyi thad la'ang phun sum tshogasapa'i 'grel bshad brgyab yod pa sog4la tshog4zhugasamakhayopa rnamasakyisagadeng 'jog legasapo gnang / 297

bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/bkod pa dang zhib bsdur zhib 'jug gi byed thabs sogs da nas rang gi ltab gsar ba dag zhib par gas bshad gnang / de las mi'i rigs kyi rig pa dang chos lugs rig pa/ srol rgyun rig gnas/ gling sgrung rig pa bcasakyi tshan khag skor gyi zhib 'jug la go ba zab mo dang gtam gleng khyad par can mchis par brten/ rgyal khab so so'i tshogs zhugs mkhas pa rnams kyi dga' bsar po thob/ dus mtshungs sa rgyal spyi'i bod kyi shes rig khyab khongasasurang rgyal gyis bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug bya ba'i khrod du blangs pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i grub 'bras mtshams sbyo ra gnang ste/ rang re'i mas rgyal la gzi brjid brtson len byas/gros tshogs kyis tshogs chen steng du dpyad gtam sgog pa dang tshogasazhor du mi re gnyis byas nas gleng mol byed pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel legasapo byas/ tshogs chen steng du tshang mas nan tan ngang mkhas pas brjod pa'i gtam la nyan par ma zad/ dri ba dris lan 'debs pa dang phan tshun bgro greng byed bzhin mchis/ tshogs 'du grol rjes mkhas pa so so ma bos rang shugs sa lhan du 'dzoms nas phan tshun la dri ba 'don pa dang rtsod pa bgyid pa/ yang yang gros sdur byed pa bcas brgyud nas rig gzhung gi gnad don skor zhig la lta tshul gcig mthun byung / gzhan yang gros tshogs thog brnyan par phab pa(cha)dang sgon brnyan par shel(rdzo3 mo7)bstan pa dang nang don gyi thad la'ang phun sum tshogs pa'i 'grel bshad brgyab yod pa sogs la tshogs zhugs ma khas pa rnams kyis gdeng 'jog legs po gnang /297

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thengasa'adi'i grosatshogasasteng bkol spyod byasachog pa'i skad rigasanibazhi ste/ dbyin ji'i skad dang bod skad/ 'jar man skad/ h+pha ran sore skad bcasayin pa'i nang bkolaspyod che4mang ba ni dbyin ji'i skad yin la/de'i 'phror bor+sha skad yin/ 'jar man dang h+pha ran se'i skad bkol spyod gnang ༵༵nā ༵ trī / snyirnyi/na gyi dgong mothengasa'adi'i grosatshog4mjug sgril ba'i tshog4chen bsdus/ tshogasachenasteng thog mar sku gshegasazin pa'i bod rig pa'i mkhasachen rnamapar mya ngan zhusapa dang de'i rjesasulag pa bkyagasanasathag gcod pa'i bya thabasaspyad de rgyal spyi'i bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug grosatshogasakyi kru'u zhi 'demasabasko byas/ ari'i bud med mkhasapa krin nye the rgya tsho lagasathengasarjesama'i kru'u zhir bdams/ de'i 'phror thengasarjesama'i rgyal spyi'i bod rig pa'i grosatshogasathengasabacu ba de spyi lo 2003lor dbyi tha li'i 5nye sigrong khyer du 'tshog rgyur 'thad pa byung /de'i rjesasuthengasarje4ma'i gro4tshogasaskabasasu/ bod yig gi dpyad rtsomagand bsdusadabyin ji'i skad du bsgyur rgyu dang dbyin ji'i skad dang 'jar man skad/ h+pha ran me'i skad bcasakyi dpyad rtsomagand bsdusabod yig tubasgyur rgyu'i skor la'athad pa byung/ 'di ltar bsgrubasan rig gzhung brje resal phan pa yod par gsungs/mdor na thengasa'adi'i rgyal spyi'i bod kyi she4rig zhib 'jug grosatshokārdo/sngar lasargya che ba dang / grosatshogasakyi skabasasutshogasazhugasam khas

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bangs 'di'i gros tshogs steng bkol spyod byas chog pa'i skad rigs ni bzhi ste/ dbyin ji'i skad dang bod skad/ 'jar man skad/ h+pha ran sod skad bcas yin pa'i nang bkol spyod ches mang ba ni dbyin ji'i skad yin la/de'i 'phror bod skad yin/ 'jar man dang h+pha ran cung skad bkol spyod gnang mkhan shin tu nyung /zla6pa'i tshes ma9nyin gyi dgong mo jengs 'di'i gros chogs mjug byed ba'i tshogs chen bsdu sa/ tshogs chen steng thog mar smu gshegs zin pa'i bod rig pa'i mkhas chen rnam par mya ngan zhus pa dang de'i rjes sa lag pa bkyags nas thag gcod pa'i be+e thabs spyad de rgyal spyi'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gros tshogs kyi gru'u zhi 'dems bsko byas/ a ri'i bud med mkhas pa rngin nye za rgya tsho 'a gas zengs rjes ma'i kru'u zhir bdams/ de'i 'phror zengs rjes ma'i rgyal spyi'i bod rig pa'i gros tshogs thengs bcu ba de spyo lo 2003lor dbye tha li'i wa nye bgrong khyer du 'tshog rgyur 'thad pa byung /de'i rjes su zengs rjes ma'i gros tshogs skabs su/ bod yig gi dpyad rtsom gnad bsdus dbyin ji'i skad du bsgyur rgyu dang dbyin ji'i skad dang 'jar man skad/ h+pha ran dang skad bcas kyi dpyad rtsom gnad bci sa bod yig tu bsgyur rgyu'i skor la 'thad pa byung / 'di ltar bsgrubs na rig gzhung brje res la phan pa byed par gsungs/mdor na zengs 'di'i rgyal spyi'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug grosatshogs sngar las rgya che ba dang / gros tshogs kyi skabs sa tshogs zhugs ma khas298

bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/ngarnam payorgya che zhing gting zabapa'i sgo nasagatamagleng dang rig gzhung brje resaganang ba brgyud/ rig gzhung gi ltatshulaminyung ba zhig lagacig mthun byung ste/ grub 'bra4kyang midaman pa blangasayod/ khyon yongasanasaṭ+wāṃlta4na thengasa'adi'i grosatshog4lagashamagasal gyi khyad cho4'ga' yod pa gcig thengasa'adi'i rig gzhung grosatshogayolazhugayopa'i rgyalakhab mang ba dang mkhasapamang ba/ dpyad rtsomamang ba/ rig gzhung gi khadabugs stug cing slob sbyong gi rnama'agyur nan tan yin pa de lags/mkha4pa tsho4dpyad rtsomasgrogasa'adon gnang rjes/ gal srid dri ba 'dri mkhan yod tshe/ der lan yang cung yid tshim pa 'debasathub kyi yod/ spyir na mkha4pa rnamasakyi tshogasathog gi rtsod pa shin tu rno ngar ldan na yang tshogasa'adu grolarjes/ phanatshun bar mtshan byang sprod pa dang rang rang gi gnasatshulamatsham4sbyor/ rig gzhung gi nyamasamyong brje resabaca4bgyisate 'brel 'drisashin tu legasapo 'dug grosatshogasakyi thog mtha' bar gsum du spronyamasakyi rnam pasayongasasakhengasashing / tshogasazhugasamakha4pa rnamapasaphan tshunabar 'brelagatug4mang po gnang ba brgyud de 'phrin gsar mang po brje resaganang bar ma zad/ phan tshun gyi mdza' mthun la'ang shug4snon chen po thebs/ grosatshogasakyi phyogasayongasal tshan rig dang drang bden gyi rig gzhung ngang tshulagasar bzhig mngon 'dug la/ desatshogasazhugasapa rnamasal skulamachenapo thebasashing mthong rgya bskyed rī ༵hāg

bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/pa rnam pas rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i sgo nas gtam gleng dang rig gzhung brje res gnang ba brgyud/ rig gzhung gi lta tshul cha nyung ba zhig la gcig mthun byung ste/ grub 'bras kyang mi dman pa blangs yod/ khyon yongs nasabaltas na jengs 'di'i gros tshogs la gsham gsal gyi khyad chos 'ga' yod pa ste/gcig bangs 'di'i rig gzhung gros tshogs la zhugs pa'i rgyal khab mang ba dang mkhas pa mang ba/ dpyad rtsom mang ba/ rig gzhung gi kha dbugs stug cing slob spyong gi rnam 'gyur nan tan yin pa de lags/mkhas pa tshos dpyad stom sgrogs 'don gnang rjes/ gal srid dri ba 'dri ma/khan yod che/ der lan yang khrung yid tshim pa 'debs thub kye yod/ spyir na ma khas pa rnams kyi tshogs thog gi rtsod pa shin tu rno ngar ldan na yang tshogasa'adu grol rjes/ phan tshun bar mtshan byang sprod pa dang rang rang gi gnasatshul mtshams sbyor/ rig gzhung gi nyams myong brje res bcas bgyis te 'brel 'dris shin tu legs po 'dug gros tshogs kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du spro nyams kyi rnam pas yongs sa khengs shing / tshogs zhugs mkhas pa rnam pas phan tshun bar 'brel gtu gas mang po gnang ba brgyud de 'phrin gsar mang po brje res gnang bar ma zad/ phan tshun gyi mdza' mthun la'ang shugs snon chen po jebs/ gros tshogs kyi phyogs yongs la tshan rig dang drang bden gyi rig gzhung ngang tshul gsar ba zhig mngon 'dug la/ desatshogs zhugs pa rnams la skul ma chen po thebs shing mthong rgya bskyed du bcug 299

gcod pa don grub dang snyingabo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/ rdocing / mkhasapa tshosare ba bgyid pa'i rig gzhung gi 'bra4bu yang mngonasum du smin thub par gyur pa red/gnyis/ bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug gi khyab khongasargya cher bskyed thub pa byung / da rebakyi rig gzhung grosatshogasathog gi dpyad rtsom mang chebani rgyal khab soso'i mkhasapa rnamasakyi zhib 'jug gi grub 'brasagasadageyin zhing / dpyad rtsomade dag gi rjod byed tshig dang brjod bya'i don gyi thad nasabaltasan/ bod kyi rig gnasamatshamasasbyor tsam dang ragasarimadu zhib 'jug bgyid pa tsam min par/ phyogasamang podang tshan khag mang po'i sgo nasazhib 'jug gang legasabyasayod/ mkhasapa skor zhig gi dpyad rtsomadu bgrang bya gang ma/nga zhig la gcig mthun gyi ltab mabyung ba'i dka' gnad kyi rtsa ba rnamasagasal ler bstan yod pas/ mtho tshad gsar ba zhig laslebs/ yang skor zhig gisakhyad par can gyi mthong rgya gsar bsami rnamasal zhib 'jug gi byed thabasagasar ba ngo sprod byas/ lhag par du bod rigasakyi chosalugasadang dmangasasrol/ srol rgyun rig gnas/ thol gdengasadad mos/ gling sgrung / khor lug srung skyong bca4kyi gnad don skor la zhib 'jug zab mo mchisapa 'di dag thamasacad kyisargyal spyi'i bod kyi shesarig ṭ+wāṃb 'jug lasarigasakyi bya ba gong nasagong du 'phelayod pa gsal bor rngogasaṭ+wāṃ~X/ma zhib 'jug gi byed thabasasngar layoje mang du song yod la maṭ+wāṃ sdud kyang gsar ba zhig lasleb4yod/ dpyad rtsomami nyung ba zhig gis

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /cing / mkhas pa tshos re ba bgyid pa'i rig gzhung gi 'bras bu yang mngonasum du smin thub par gyur pa red/gnyis/ bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gi khyab khongs rgya cher bskyed thub pa byung / da reb byu rig gzhung gros tshogs thog gi dpyad rtsom mang che ba ni rgyal khab so so'i mkhas pa rnams kyi zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras gsarabayin zhing / dpyad rtsom de dag gi rjod byed tshig dang brjod bya'i don gyi thad nas bltas na/ bod kyi rig gnas mtshams sbyor tsam dang rags rim duzhib 'jug bgyid pa tsam min par/ phyogs mang po dang tshan khag mang po'i sgo nas zhib 'jug gang legs byas yo da/ mkhas pa skor zhig gi dpyad rtsomadu bgrang bya gang ma/nga zhig la gcig mthun gyi ltab ma byung ba'i dka' gnad kyi rtsa ba rnams gsal ler bstan yod pas/ mtho tshad gsar ba zhig la skebs/ yang skor zhig gis khyad par can gyi mthong rgya gsar bas mi rnamasal zhib 'jug gi byed thabs gsar ba ngo sprod byas/ lhag par du bod rigasakye chos lugs dang dmangs sgo la/ srol rgyun rig gnas/ thol gdengasadad rngo sa/ gling sgrung / khor yug srung skyong bcas kyi gnad don skor la zhib 'jug zab mo mchis pa 'di dag thams cad kyis rgyal spyi'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug las rigs kyi bya ba gong nas gong du 'phel yong pa gsal bor rtogs thub/gsum/ zhib 'jug gi byed thabs sngar las ji mang du song yod la mtho tshab kyang gsar ba zhig la skebs yod/ dpyad rtsom mi nyung ba zhig gis300

bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/spyi tshogs la brtag dpyad byed thabs dang zhib bsdur zhib 'jug gi byed thabs/ grangs ka dbye zhib byed thabs/ gtan tshags rigs 'ded byed thabs bcas tshan rig dang ma/thun pa'i zhib 'jug byed thabs bod spyod gang legs byas te/ bod kyi shes rig dang 'brel ba'i gnad don skor la zhib 'jug gting zab bgyis yod la/ snga ra sked kyi ltab gsar ba yang mang po bton yod/ lhag par du zhib bsdur zhib 'jug gi byed thabs kyi bkol rgya shin tu che zhing / de dag tu bod rig pa dang rgyal khab mi gcig pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas gnyis phan tshun zhib bsdur bgyis te zhib 'jug byas yod la/da dung bod rig pa dang mi rigs gzhan gyi lo rgyus dang chos lugs/ stom rig bar du zhib bsdur bgyis te zhib 'jug byas/ bod rig pa dang tshan khag gzhan phan tshun bsno la nas zhib 'jug byed pa'i thabs kyang bgol yod/gang ltar kyang de dag gis spyi tshogs tshan rig gi zhib 'jug byed thabs sna mang bod spyod byas te bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gang legs5spel ba des/bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug be+e ba sngar las gting zab tu btang zhing / zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras g.yur du za ba smin du bcug go/gzhan yang zengs 'di'i bod kyi rig gzhung zhib 'jug gros tshogasasuzhugs pa las shes rtogs sam myong tshor mi nyung ba zhig byung ba'i gtso bo 'ga' gnad bsdus te brjod na 'di lta ste/gcig deng skabs 'dzam gling steng gi bod kyi shes rig la zhib 'jug bgyid mkhan rnams kyis bod kye lo rgyus dang chos lugs/ skad rigs/301

bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/spyitshogs la brtag dpyad byed thabasadang zhib bsdur zhib 'jug gi byed thabs/ grang4ka dbye zhib byed thabs/ gtan tshigasarig4'dod byed thab4bcasatshan rig dang mthun pa'i zhib 'jug byed thabasabed spyod gang legasabyasate/ bod kyi shesarig dang 'brel ba'i gnad don skor la zhib 'jugagating zab bgyisayod la/ sngar med kyi ltab gsar ba yang mang po bton yod/ lhag par du zhib bsdur zhib 'jug gi byed thabasakyi bkolargya shin tu che zhing / de dag tu bod rig pa dang rgyal khab mi gcig pa'i srolargyun rig gan4gnyi4phan tshunazhib bsdur bgyisate zhib 'jug byasayod la/da dung bod rig pa dang mi rigasagazhan gyi lo rgyusadang cho4lugs/ rtsom rig bar du zhib bsdur bgyisate zhib 'jug byas/ bod rig pa dang tshan khag gzhan phan tshunabasnolanasazhib 'jug byed pa'i thabasakyang bkolayod/gang ltar kyang de dag gisaspyi tshogasatshan rig gi zhiba'ajug byed thabasasna mang bed spyod byasate bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug gang legasasuspelab des/bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug bya ba sngar lasagating zabatubatang zhing / zhib 'jug gi grub 'brasagayur du za ba smin du bcug go/gzhan yang thengayo'adi'i bod kyi rig gzhung zhiba'ajug grosatshogasasuzhugasapa lasashesartogasasamamyong tshor minyung ba zhig byung ba'i gtso bo 'ga' gnad bsdu4te brjod na 'di ltaste/gcig deng skabasa'adzamagling steng gi bod kyi shesarig lazhiba'ajug bgyid mkhan rnamasakyisabod kyi lorgyusadang chosalugs/ skad 3༵/sa/

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshering gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gling sgrung rig pabacasani 'dzam gling steng gi bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gi gnad sabazhi ru brtsi ba dang te/ zhib 'jug gi chu tshad rgyun chad med par je mthor gtong slad/ rgyal spyi'i steng snga rje4subod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug gi grosatshogasathengasadagur bsdus/ phyi gling pa mang pozhig gisabod rig par zhib 'juga'adi ltar bgyid pa'i tshula'adir brtags na/ bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug 'di 'dzam gling steng gi zhib 'jug gi nang don gal chen zhig tu'agro bzhin yod pa rtogasathub la/ da dung rgyal khabaskor zhig gisarang 'gul ngang rang sosonasabod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug gi grosatshogasabasdusate bod rig par zhib 'jug nan mo byed bzhin pa'ang mchi4so/ / gong gsal gyi rig gzhung grosatshogasasnamang bsdusapa desabod rig pa'i zhiba'ajug gi khyab khongasargya skyed byed par skul 'ded kyi nusapa legasapo thon yod/ bod rigasakyi zhib 'jug pa zhig la mtshon na/ ngesapar du rtogasadagosapa ni nged rnamasani bod kyi shesarig gi bdag po yin la/ rang rgyal ni bod kyi shesarig gi pha yulayin pas/ rgyal spyi'i bod kyi shes rig spel re4kyi dar cha de nga tsho'i lag tu brtan 'dzin byed dgosapa de red/ der brten 'brel yod lasakhungasadang 'go khrid kyisam skul dang blangasakyisabod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug bya bar mthong chen dang thugasakhur gnang dgosal/ khyad par du chu tshad ngesacan yod pa'i zhib 'jug mi sna skyed sring byed rgyu ni de bsakyang gal 'gangasashin tu che/ rang rgyal gyi mkhasapasadusadang rnamapa kun tu ṭ+wāṃ~Xspyi'i bod rig pa'i dar cha dmapor bzung ste'adzamagling yong4su
