gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gling sgrung rig pa bcas ni 'dzam gling steng gi bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gi gnad sa bzhi ru brtse ba dang te/ zhib khrug gi chu dza rgyun pha med par ji mthor gtong slad/ rgyal spyi'i steng snga rjes su bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gi gros tshogs thengs dgur bsdus/ phyi gling pa mang po zhig gis bod rig par zhib khrug 'di ltar bgyid pa'i tshur 'dir brtags na/ bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'di 'dzam gling steng gi zhib 'jug gi nang don gal chen zhig rtswa'agro bzhin yod pa rtogs thub la/ da dung rgyal khab skor zhig gis rang 'gul ngang rang so sonas bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gi gros tshogs bsdusate bod rig par zhib 'jug nan mo byed bzhin pa'ang mchis so/ / gong gsal gyi rig gzhung gros tshogs sna mang bsdus pa des bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi khyab khongs rgya skyed byed par skul 'ded kyi nus pa legs po thon yong/ bod rigs byu zhib 'jug pa zhig la mtshon na/ nges par du rtogasadagos pa be+e nged rnams ni bod kyi shes rig gi bdag po yin la / rang rgyal ni bod kyi shes rig gi pha yu ba yin pas/ rgyal spyi'i bod kyi shes rig spel res kyi dar cha de nga phro lag tu brtan 'dzin byed dgos pa de red/ der brten 'brel yod las khungs dang 'go khrid kyis ma skul dang blangs kyis bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug bya bar mthong chen dang thugs khur gnang dgos la/ khyad par du chu rga nges can yo da pa'i zhib 'jug mi sna byed sring byed rgyu ni de bsakyang gal 'gangs shin tu che/ rang rgyul gyi mkhas pas dus dang rnam pa kun tu rgyal spyi'i bod rig pa'i dar cha dam por bzung ste 'dzam gling yongasasto302

bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/rang rgyal la bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras dang chu tshad gang legasashig ldan pa mthong du 'jug rgyu 'di ni/ nged rnams kyi dor du sted pa'i 'osa'agan yin la/ bod kyi shes rig gi bdag po nges can zhig yin min gyi gnad 'gag kyang lags/gnyis/ phran nyid snga phyir zangs gsum la rgyal spyi'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gros tshogs gzhugs myong zhing / rgyal khab mi gcig pa'i mkhasapa phal cher300lhag la mjal myong ba dang / de dag las phal cher zhig gis bod yig 'bri shes bdang bod skad bshad shes/ da dung mkhas pa skor zhig gis byang chub pa shes shing / dpyad rtsom yang bod yig gis 'bri thub/rang re'i rgyal khab kyi tshogs zhugs mkhas par mtshob na/ sum cha'i gnyisakyis phyi rgyal gyi skad mi go la/ spyir btang gi 'tsho ba'i ngo sprod tsam yang shin tu dka' mo/ 'dug der brten gting zab kyis rig gzhung brje res byed rgyu ni de bas kyang dka' mo yin/ der ma zad mdo dbus khams gsum gyi yul skad la'ang khyad par chen po yod pas phan tshun bar brda gsal bo zhig sprod dka' bar 'dug mdor na bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug bgyid mkhan zhig yin na ma mtha' yang phyi gling pa'i skad rigs gcig ma shes tshe/ rgyal spyi'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gi sgo 'phar phye thabs bral la/ tha na mdo dbusakhams gsum bar gyi rig gzhung brje res thad la'ang dka' ngal 'byung bsader shugs snon dgos la/ bod nang khul— yul skad dang grong skad bar gyi khyad par je chung du gtong rgyur nges par du do snang byed dgos pa lags/303

bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/rangargyal la bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi grub 'brasadang chu tshad gang legasashig ldan pa mthong du 'jug rgyu 'di ni/ nged rnamasakyi dor du med pa'i 'osa'agan yin la/ bod kyi she4rig gi bdag pongesacan zhig yin min gyi gnad dirnyikā kyang bye/ ṭ+wāṃd/ snga phyir thengasagasum la rgyal spyi'i bod kyi sheyorig zhib 'jug grosatshogayosuzhug4myong zhing / rgyal khab migacig pa'i mkhasapaphal cher300lhag la mjalastong bdang / de dag las phal cher zhig giyobod yig 'bri shesapadang bod skad bshad shes/ da dung mkha4pa skor zhig giyobyang chub pa shesashing / dpyad rtsom yang bod yig gisa'abri thub/rang re'i rgyal khab kyi tshogayozhug4mkhasapar mtshon na/ sum cha'i gnyisakyisaphyi rgyalagyi skad mi go la/ spyir btang gi 'tsho ba'i ngo sprod tsamayang shin tu dka' mo 'dug der brten gting zab kyisarig gzhung brje resabyed rgyu ni de ba4kyang dka' mo yin/ der mazad mdo dbusakhamayogasum gyi yul skad la'ang khyad par chen po yod pasaphan tshun bar brda gsal bo zhig sprod dka' bar 'dug mdor na bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug bgyid mkhan zhig yin na ma mtha' yang phyi gling pa'i skad rigasagacig yoshesatshe/ rgyalaspyi'i bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug gi sgo 'phar phye thabasabralal/ tha na mdo dbusakham4gsum bar gyi rig gzhung brje resathad la'ang dka' ngala'abyung bsader shugasasnon dgosal/ bod nang khulagyi yulaskad dang grobaskad bar gyi khyad par je chung du gtong rgyur ngesapar du do snang byed dgosapa laga~X/03

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /gsum/ bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug deng rabs can dang 'phrinagasar(4ze pu)deng rabs can du ba byu ra rgyu ni 'o rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi kha phyogasashig yin/ phyi gling pa'i mkhas pa phal cher gyis glog klad(khye//oṃ)bkol spyod byed pa dang / rang gi zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras dang 'phrin gsar thamasacad glog klad nang du bsdus yod/ 'di ltar byas na stabs ha cang bde la/nged cag rnams la'ang blo sgo 'byed pa'i nus pa thon/ zengs brgyad pa'i tshogs thog tu shes rtogs zab mo zhig byung ba ni a tshe ri kha'i mkhas pa zhig gis bod kyi pod218yod pa'i bstan 'gyur dang pod108yod pa'i bka' 'gyur tshang mdu2'od sder nang du bsdu sa yod la/ des glog klad brgyud de khyod la gang mkho'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'don sprod byed thub/ gzhan yang dbying te en na'i slob grwa chen mo/'i bud med mkhas pa zhig gis rang rgyal gyi bod yig gi zhib 'jug dus deb dang rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus bsdus pa/ da be+edartsom gyi kha byang / dus deb thog bkod pa'i dus tshod/ da lta7dpe mdzod khang gang du bzhugs pa sogs gsal bo glog klad nang du bsdus yod/ gal te khyod kyis rtsom yig dang rtsom pa po sa 'tshol 'dod na dus thog tu btsal nas rnyed thub pa lags/ 'di ni grub 'bras mi dman pa zhig yin la/ bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug bya ba sgrub ma/khan rnams la 'ang stabs bder bskrun yod/ rang rgyal dang phyi rgyal gnyis bsdur na/ rang rgyal gyi bod rig ma khasapas nged spyod bgyid bzhin pa'i zhib 'jug byed thabs rjes sa lus yo da cing /mkhas pa mang che shos la deng rabs kyi tshan rig gzhung lugs kyi shes bya nyung 304

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/gsum/ bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug deng rabasacan dang 'phrinagasar(1jiphu )deng rabasacan du bsgyur rgyu ni 'o rgyusa'aphelargyasakyi kha phyogasashig yin/ phyi gling pa'i mkhasapa phalacher gyis glog klad(yolo)bkol spyod byed pa dang / rang gi zhib 'jug gi grub 'brasadang 'phrin gsar thamasacad glog klad nang du bsdus yod/ 'di ltar byasan stab4ha cang bde la/nged cag rnams la'ang blosgro 'byed pa'i nusapa thon/ thengasabargyad pa'i tshogasathog tu sheyortogasazab pozhig byung ba ni ameri kha'i mkhasapa zhigagisabod kyi pod218yod pa'i bstan 'gyur dang pod108yod pa'i bka' 'gyur tshang ma00'od sder nang du bsdu4yod la/ desaglog klad brgyud de khyod la gang mkho'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'don sprod byed thub/ gzhan yang dbying te en na'i slob grwa chen mo 'i bud med mkhasapa zhig gi4rang rgyal gyi bod yig gi zhib 'jug dusadeb dang rtsom pa po'i lorgyusabasdusapa/ dpyad rtsomagyi kha byang / dusadebathog bkod pa'i dusatshod/ da ltadape mdzod khang gang du bzhugasapa sog4gsal bo glog klad nang du bsdusayod/ galatespyad kyisartsom yig dang rtsom papo su'atshol 'dod na du4thog tu btsal nasarnyed thub pa lags/ 'di ni grub 'brasami dman pa zhig yin la/ bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug bya ba sgrub mkhan rnamasala'ang stabasabader bskrun yod/ rang rgyaladang phyi rgyalaganyisabasdur na/ rang rgyal gyi bod rig mkhasapasabed spyod bgyid bzhin pa'i zhib 'jug byed thabasarjesasulu4yod cing /makāsdu/pa mang che shosaladeng rabasakyi tshan rig gzhung lugasakyi shesabya nyung

bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/bdang / deng rabasacan gyi zhib 'jug gi sgrig chasadakon po 'dug galatenged cag gi4zhib 'jug byed thabasagasar ba bkol spyod byed ma thub na bod kyi she4rig zhib 'jug gi 'phel rgyasalashan shugasangan pa thebasapar gdon mi za/ nged rnam4kyisashesagasal ltar bod kyi shesarig lazhib 'jugabyed pa'i lteb ni krung go yin/ phyi rgyaladang bsdur na nga tshor bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug thad cha rkyen legayopo yod par brten/ nged cag gisangeyopar du deng rabasacan gyi byed thabasate/ dper na/ brnyan par dang 'dra par/ brnyan sgron par shel bcasakyi thabasashesaspyad de/ bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug bgyid pa'i dusamatshung4su/ srol rgyun 'phrin gsar brje re4kyi thabasashesargyun 'khyongasabyed pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng thabasashesagasar ba gsar gtod dang / deng rabasacan gyi sgrig cha4nang 'dren/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug gi 'phrin gsar 'khrul med khong du chud pa bcasabagyisan/ da gzod rang rigasabod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug deng rabalocan du mngon 'gyur byed thub/bzhi/ rang rgyal gyi bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug gi bya ba sgrub mkhan tsho4dka' spyad 'bad brtsonabya4te deng rab4kyi shesabya khong du chud par byed dgosapa dang / tshan rig gi thabasashesal brten nasabod kyi gna' dpe 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig par skrun byed dgos/ mig sngar lasadon 'di'i thad grub 'brasachen po thob yod na'ang/ bya ba'i gom stabasad lta'i dgosamakho dang bsdur na da dung bar thag ngesacan zhig yod pa retā/05 nga

bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/ba dang / deng rabs can gyi zhib 'jug gi sgrig chas dkon po 'dug gal te nged cag gis zhib 'jug byed thabs gsar ba bkol spyod byed ma thub na bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gi 'phel rgyas la shan shugasang na pa thebs par gdon mi za/ nged rnams kyis shes gsal ltar bod kyi shes rig la zhib 'jug byed pa'i ltob ni krung go yin/ phyi rgyal dang bsdur na nga tshor bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug thad cha rkyen legs po yod par brten/ nged cag gisanges par du deng rabs can gyi byed thabs te/ dper na/ brnyan par dang 'dra par/ brnyan sgon par shel bcas kyi thabs shes spyad de/ bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug bgyid pa'i dus mtshungs su / srol rgyun 'phrin gsar brje res kyi thabs shes rgyun 'khyongs byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng thabs shes gsar ba gsar gtod dang / deng rabs can gyi sgrig chas nang 'dren/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gi 'phrin gsar 'khrul med khong du a pa bcas brgyas na/ da gzod rang rigs bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug deng rabs can du mngon 'gyur byed thub/bzhi/ rang rgyal byi bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gi bya ba sgrub mkhan tshos dka' srud 'bad brtson byas te deng rabs kyi shes bya khong du ga par byed dgos pa dang / tshab rig gi thabs shes la brten nas bod kyi gna' dpe 'tshol sdu da dang dag sgrig par skrun byed dgos/ mig sngar las don 'di'i thad grub 'bras chen po thob yod na'ang/ be+e ba'i gom stabs da lta'i dgos mkho dang bsdur na da dung bar thag nges can zhig yo da pa red/ nga 305

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshor mtshon na rgyalayongasasubod kyi gna' dpe yang snying ci 'dra zhig 'dugapar yid na grangasaka gsalabo zhig med/ 'brelayod kyi dpyad gzhi'i yigacha lasagasalab ltar na/ bod kyi rig gnasabang mdzod kyi mtshan snyan yodapa'i sdedage'i par khang dang bla brang bkra shi4'khyil/ rtse po ta lasogasakyi bod yig glegasabamagyi khabyang dag sgrig byed pa'i bya ba da dung mjug sgrilamed padang / saskya dgon pa'i gna' dpe brag ri ltar brtsigasayod bathamasacad da dung sgul med du bzhag yod/ bod ljongasayig tshagasakhang gi bod yig gi yig tshagasad dung phyi ru sgo 'phar yongasasu'abyed thub med/siskyita'i skad yig lasagrub pa'i shing ta la'i loma'i bstan bcosadag legasasgrig dang zhib 'jug gi bya ba yang 'phel rgyasadal ba yin/ 'di dag thamasacad bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug 'phel rgyasakyi gan4bab dang gtan nasamathun thabasamed/ de'i phyir/ nged cag gisastobasashugasa'adon spelabyasate/ 'char gzhi yod pa'i sgo nasabod kyi gna' dpe thamasacad dag sgrig par skrun byed pa dang / khyim rgyu yang snying ga chod 'dra yod pa rtogasapar byed pa'i dpyad gzhi'i yig rigasadag mgyogasamyur ngang rigasadabye dang khabyang sgrig pa/ glog klad nang du sdud pa bcayobyasate/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi bo/ kyi shesarig zhib 'jug gi mkhasapa rnamasakyisabed spyod thub pa bya da sa/mdor na/ kho bo thengasa'adi'i rgyalaspyi'i bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug gi /༵tshogasasuzhugasate/ 'dzamagling steng gi skad gragasacan gyi bod rig

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshor mtshon na rgyal yongs sa bod kyi gna' dpe yang snying ci 'dra zhig 'digapar yid na grangs ka gsal bo zhig med/ 'brel yod kyi dpyad gzhi'i yigacha las gas ba ltar na/ bod kyi rig gnas bang mdzod kyi mtshan snyan byed pa'i sde dge'i par khang dang bla brang bkra shis 'pha/ rtse po ta la sogs kyi bod yig glegs bam gyi kha byang dag sgrig byed pa'i bya ba da dung mjug dngosted pa dang / sa skya dgon pa'i gna' dpe brag ri ltar brtsigs yod pathams cad da dung sgul med du bzhag yod/ bod ljongs yig tshags khang gi bod yig gi yig tshags da dung phyi ru sgo 'phar yongs ga'abyed thub med/siskrita'i skad yig las grub pa'i shing ta la'i lo ma'i bstan bcos dag legasasgrig dang zhib 'jug gi bya ba yang 'phel rgyas dal ba yin/ 'di dag thamasacad bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'phel rgyas kyi gnas bab dang gtan nasamathun thabs med/ de'i phyir/ nged cag gis stobs shugs 'don a byas te/ 'char gzhi yod pa'i sgo nas bod kyi gna' dpe thams cad dag sgrig par skrun byed pa dang / khyim rgyu yang snying ga tshod 'dra yod pa rtogs par byed pa'i dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs dag mgyogs myur ngang rigs dbye dang kha byang sgrig pa/ glog klad nang du sbud pa bcas byas te/ rgyal/ khab phyi nang gi bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gi mkhas pa rnams kyis bed spyod thub pa bya dgos/mdor na/ kho bo zangs 'di'i rgyal spyi'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gi gros tshogs gzhugs te/ 'dzam gling steng gi skad grags can gyi bod rig 306

bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/pa'i zhib 'jug pa mang po ngo shes pa dang / 'dzam gling steng gi rgyal khab soso'i zhib 'jug gi kha phyogs gsar ba/ nang don gsar ba/ byed thabasags rab bcas la rgyus lon cung zad byung ba las mig rgya cher byed dang shesargya ji cher gyur la/ nyams myong yang phun sum ji tshogs sa song / bod zhi bas bcings 'grol byas nas lo lnga bcu song ba'i ring bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug la g.yur du za ba'i grub 'bras thob pa bston med kyi bden don zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang 'phren gsar dus rabs kyi dgos ma khodang 'tsham pa byed rgyu dang tshan rig gi byed thabs gsar ba bkol spyod bya rgyu sogs kyi thad du rang rer zhan cha'i phyogs 'ga' re gnas bzhin pa'ang kho bo rgyal spyo'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug gros tshogs gzhugs pa'i myong tshor dngos las gsal rtogs thub pas slad phyin rang res skyon spangs dge sgrub kyis de bas brtson pa rgya byed kyi sgo nas 'bad sgrub byas te/ sngar las lhag pa'i grub 'bras gsar gtod byed dgos so/ /307

bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'dzam gling steng skyod bzhin pa/pa'i zhib 'jug pa mang pongo shesapa dang / 'dzam gling steng gi rgyalakhab sopo'i zhib 'jug gi khaphyogasagasar ba/ nang don gsar ba/ byed thabasagasarab bcas largyusalon cung zad byung ba lasamig rgya cher skyed dang shesargyathecher gyur la/ nyamasamyong yang phun sumaje tshogasasusong / bod zhi bsabacingasa'agrolabyasanasalolnga bcu song ba'i ring bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug la g.yur du za ba'i gruba'abrasathob pabasnyon med kyi bden don zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang 'phrin gsar dusarab4kyi dgosamakhodang 'tsham pabyed rgyu dang tshan rig gi byed thabasagasar babakolaspyod bya rgyu sogasakyi thad du rang rer zhan cha'i phyogasa'aga' re gnasabazhin pa'ang khobo rgyalaspyi'i bod kyi shesarig zhib 'jug grosatshogasasuzhugasapa'i myong tshor dngosalasagasalartogasathub pasaslad phyin rang resaskyon spangasadage sgrub kyisade bsabartson pa ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃsdo ṭ+wāṃ / //dhizlod sgrub byasate/ sngar lasalhag pa'i grub 'brasagasar 307

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshering gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/rma 'bri'i 'byung khungs kyi gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogs/de yang dbyar zla bdun pa'i mtho sgang ni ri skyesametog sna brgya rnamapar bzhad cing dri zhim rgyang gragasadu mar khyab la/ namazla'i tsha grang snyomasashing mi kun gyi lu4khamasasu'aphrod pa'i khyad chololdan pa dang / rta nor lugagasum gyi phyugasarigasathamasacad sha shed rgyasashing rkang bzhi'i phyugasardzi'i bu dang bu mo rnam4kyang dga' ba rab tu rgyasapa'i glu gar gyi dpalalarolabazhin mchis/ 'di 'dra'i mdzesashing sdug pa'i dusatshigasasu/ gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogasathengasalngab gna' mkhar zi ling nasagazab rgya4ngang tshogayopa yin/gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung grosatshogasani rang re'i zhing chen lamatshon na rgyal khab gsar ba btsugasapa'i tshun du theng4dang por bsdusapa'i gling sgrung rig pa zhib 'jug bgyid pa'i rgyal spyi'i grosatshogasashig yin la/mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi gling sgrung rig pa zhib 'jug byed pa'i thad lorgyu4kyi don snying gal chen ldan par ma zad/ mtsho sngon dril sgrog dang rgyal khab phyi nārdo ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃg gzhung brje resabyed par yang da yod kyi don snying galachen ldan 308gling sgrung rgyalaspyi'i rig gzhung grosatshogasade de snga spyi lo1989lo nas

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sprel spre spreza 'a za' 'byung khungs kya glang jing rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogs/de yang dbyar zla bdun pa'i mtho sgang ni ri skyes me tog sna brgya rnamapar bzhad cing dri zhim rgyang grags du mar khyab la/ nam zla'i tsha grang snyomasashing mi kun gyi lus khams sa 'phrod pa'i khyad chos lda na pa dang / rta nor lug gsum/ gyi phyugs rigs thams cad sha shed rgyas shing rkang bzhi'i phyugs rdzi'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyang dga' ba rab tu rgyas pa'i glu gar gyi dpal la ralabazhin mchis/ 'di 'dra'i mdzes shing sdug pa'i dus tshigs su/ gling sgrung rgyal spyo'i rig gzhung gros tshogs bangs lnga ba gna' mkhar zi ling nas gzab rgyasang nga tshogs pa yin/gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogs ni rang re'i zhing chen la mtshon na rgyal khab gsar ba btsugs pa'i tshun du thengs dang por bsdus pa'i gling sgrung rig pa zhib 'jug bgyid pa'i rgyal spyi'i gros tshogs shig yin la/mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi gleng sgrung rig pa zhib 'jug byed pa'i thad lo rgyus kyi don snying gal chen ldan par ma zad/ mtsho sngon dril sgog dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi rig gzhung brje res byed par yang da yod kyi don snying gal chen ldan pa yin no/ /gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogs de de snga spyi lo1989lo nas308

rma 'bri'i 'byung khungs kyi gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogs/bzung lnga phyir na khron zhing chen dang bod ljongs/ nang sog kan su'u bcas zhing ljongs sa zangs bzhir bsdus pa des/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi rig gzhung khag la bag chags gting zab po bzhag pa dang / yal phyogs so so' mkhas pa dang 'go khrid tshos gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang /2001lo'i zla10ches17nyin h+pha ran se'i rgyal sa pā le grong khyer du bsdusapa'i mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi slob gso tshan rig rig gnas rtsa 'tshagasatshogs pa'i thengs31pa'i tshogs chen steng gling sgrung 'di nyid spyi lo2002nas2003lo'i mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs slob gso tshan rig rig gnas rtsa 'dzugs tshogs pa'i 'go 'dzin rnam grangs du bkod pa yin la/de be+e gling sgrung stong 'o 'i rjes dran bya 'gul khrung yin/ nga tshos go skabs de dang bstun nas mtho sgang rig gnas kyi mdzes rtsal ngom pa dang gling sgrung stong lo'i rjes dran bya 'gul la sngon bas byed pa/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi rig gzhung brje res ji legs sa gtong ba/ mtsho sngon gyi rig gnas rtags mtshan gsar du 'dzugs pa bcas kyi slad du gleng sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung grosatshogs 'di mtsho sngon du bsdus pa lags/bangs 'di'i rig gzhung gros tshogs la zhugs par a me ri kha dang dbyen ji/ 'jar man/ khron khru li ya/ ljar pan/ mong gol bcas rgyal khab kyi 'thus mi dang / rang rgyal gyi bod ljongs dang 6khron/ kan su'u/nang sog pe cin bca4spun zla'i zhing ljongs nas phebs pa'i mkhas pa bgres gzhon bsdoms pas120lhag yod pa dang / khong rnam pas tshogs309

rma 'bri'i 'byung khungs kyigling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogs/bzung sngaphyir sikhron zhing chen dang bod ljongs/ nang sog kan su'u bcayozhing ljongasasutheng4bzhir bsdusapades/ rgyalakhab phyi nang gi rig gzhung khag la bag chagasagating zab mobazhag pa dang / yul phyogasasoso'i mkhas pa dang 'go khrid tshos gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang /2001lo'i zla10tshes17nyin h+pha ran so'i rgyal sayā le grong khyer du bsdusapa'i mnyama'abrel rgyal tshogasakyi slobagasotshan rig rig gnasartsa 'dzugasatshogayopa'i thengs31pa'i tshog4chen steng gling sgrung 'di nyid spyi lo2002nas2003lo'i mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs slob gso tshan rig rig gnasartsa 'dzug4tshogasapa'i 'go 'dzin rnamagrangasadu bkod pa yin la/de ni gling sgrung stong 'o 'i rje4dran bya 'gul kyang yin/ nga tsho4go skabasade dang bstun nasamatho sgang rig gnasakyi mdzesartsal ngom pa dang gling sgrung stong lo'i rjesadran bya 'gulal sngon bsubyed pa/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi rig gzhung brje resaje leg4sugatong ba/ mtsho sngon gyi rig gan4rtagasamatshan gsar du 'dzugasapa bca4kyi slad du gling sgrung rgyalaspyi'i rig gzhung grosatshogasa'adi mtsho sngon du bsdusapa lags/thengasa'adi'i rig gzhung grosatshogasalazhugasapar ameri kha dang dbyin ji/ 'jar man/ osikhru li ya/ ljar pan/ mong gol bca4rgyal khab kyi 'thusami dang / rang rgyal gyi bod ljongasadang sikhron/ gan su'u/nang sog pe cin bca4spun zla'i zhing ljongasanasapheb4pa'i mkhasapa bgresagazhon bsdomasapas120lhag yod pa dang / khong rnam pas3ṭ+wāṃ~Xs

gcod pa don grub dang snying sotshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thog cadapyad rtsomabarje resakyang byas/ reba'adir zhugasapa'i 'thusami'i nang du mtshan snyan rab tumatho ba'i mkha4pargan pa skor zhig yod la/ shesarig 'bur du thon pa'i mkhasapa dar ma skor zhig kyang yod par mazad/ da dungablorig shin tumyur ba'i gsar skye na gzhon skor zhig kyangayod/ khyad par du nged cag sprob rab turgyasabazhig ni/ mnyayo'abrelargyal tshogasakyi slob gsotshan rig rig gnasartsa 'dzugasatshogasapa'i spyi'i 'go 'dzin pa sku zhabasapu'u hri na ci lagasargyang ring yogleng nasamatho sgang mtsho sngon laphebasate thengasa'adi'i tshogasachenagyi mdzad sgo phye ba'i tshogasathog tu zhugasashing gsung bshad kyang don dang ldan pa gnang ba de yin/ khong gi gsung bshad dukhud par du gling sgrung ni mi'i rigasayongasakyi shulabazhag rig gan4rtsa chen yinal/ shulabazhag rig gnasamyur skyobadang srung skyong byed rgyu ni mig sngar nged cag gi bya ba galachen dang khyad du 'phagasalasa'agan yin zhesagasungadī/gagazhung grosatshogasasteng du rgan dar gzhon gsumagyi zhib 'jug misnarnamasalhan du 'du4te/ rang rang gi ltab gsar ba dang gruba'abrasagasar ba/ zhiba'ajug gi byed thabasagasar ba bcasaphan tshun bar brje resadang gleng molobagyisashing / rig gzhung gi khadabugasaha cang legs/mkhasaparnamasakyisad dung lo'aga'i ring lagling sgrung zhib 'jug thad blangasapa'i gruba'abrasalagadeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang bar mazad/ gling sgru~X nāg pa'i tshanakhag 'dzugasaganyer byed pa'i bsamatshogasar ba yang

gcod pa don grub dang snying bom ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thog tu dpyad tshom brje res kyang byas/ reb 'dir zhugs pa'i 'thus mi'i nang du mtshan snyan rab tu mtho ba'i mkhas pa rgan pa skor zhig yod la/ shesarig 'bur du thon pa'i mkhas pa dar ma skor zhig kyang yod par ma zad/ da dung blo rig shin tu myur ba'i gsar skye na gzhon skor zhig kyang yod/ khyad par du nged cag sgob rab tu rgyas pa zhig ni/ mnyam 'byel rgyal tshogs kyi slob gso tshan rig rig gnas rtsa 'dzugs tshogs pa'i spyi'i 'go 'dzin pa sku zhabs yu'u hri na ci lags rgyang ring yo gling nas mtho sgang mtsho sngon la phebasate zengs 'di'i tshogs chen gyi mdzad sgo phye ba'i tshogs thog tu zhugs shing gsung bshad kyang don dang ldan pa gnang ba de yin/ khong gi gsung bshad du khud par du gling sgrung be+e mi'i rigs yongs kyi shul bzhag rig gnas co chen yin la/ shul bzhag rig gnas myur skyob dang srung skyong byed rgyu ni mig sngar nged cag gi bya ba gal chen dang khyad du 'phags las 'gan yin zhesagasungs/rig gzhung gros tshogs steng du rgan dar gzhon gsum gyi zhib 'jug mi sna rnams lhan du 'dus te/ rang rang gi ltab gsar ba dang grub 'brasagasar ba/ zhib 'jug gi byed thabs gsar ba bcas phan tshun bar brje res dang gleng mol bgyis shing / rig gzhung gi kha dbugs ha cang legs/mkhas pa rnams kyis da dung tshe 'ga'i ring la gling sgrung zhib 'jug thad blangasapa'i grub 'bras la gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang bar ma zad/ gleng sgrung rig pa'i tshan khag 'dzugs gnyer byed pa'i bsam blo gsar ba yang 310

rma 'bri'i 'byung khungs byu gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogs/bstan/thengs 'di'i rig gzhung gros tshogs steng gdam gses byung ba'i dpyad rtsom bsdoms pas98yod la/ de'i nang du rgya yig gi dpyad rtsom49dang / bod yig gi dpyad stom31/ phyi gling pa'i yig rigs kyi da khyad rtsom18yod/ de dag las tshogs chen steng du dpyad rtsom8sgogs 'don byas pa dang / tshogs chung steng du dpyad rtsom90klog 'don byas/ khyon yongs nas bltas na da reb kyi rig gzhung gros tshogs de sngon gyi rig gzhung gros tshogs dang bsdur na tshogs rgya ches che zhing / cha grangs dang / dpyad rtsom klog 'don gyi tshad ches mang ba'i gros tshogs shig red/ sgogs 'don byas pa'i dpyad rtsom gyi gzhi khyon dang nang don la bltas na'ang / mkhas pa rnams kyis gling sgrung rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi tshan khag snying bor bzung ste/mi'i rigs kyi rig pa dang / bye dngos khor yug rig pa/ rol mo zlos gar rig pa/ dmangs srol rig pa bcas kyi zhib 'jug gi byed thabs spyad nasagling sgrung las mtshon pa'i rig gnas kyi rnam pa mang por dbye zhib dang zhib 'jugs sa 'dug dpyad rtsom mang che shos la ltab gsar ba yod par ma zad/ da dung shes rig gi rin thang dang zhib 'jug khyab khongs rgya byed kyi don snying kyang gal chen mchis la/ mang shas kyis lta stangs mang yodang go rim mang po'i sgo nas gling sgrung zhib 'jug byed par cha 'phrin gsar ba yang 'don sprod byas yod/zangs 'di'i gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i gros tshogs steng mkhasapa rnams kyis311

rma 'bri'i 'byung khungs kyi gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rigagazhung gros tshogs/bstan/theng4'di'i rig gzhung grosatshogayosteng gdam gsesabyang ba'i dpyad rtsom bsdom4pas98yod la/ de'i nang du rgya yig gi dajed rtsom49dang / bod yig gi dpyad rtsom31/ phyi gling pa'i yig rigasakyi dpyad rtsom18yod/ de dag lasatshogasachen steng du dpyad rtsom8sgrogasa'adon byasapa dang / tshogasachung stebadu dpyad rtsom9)klog 'don byas/ khyon yongasanasabaltasan da reb kyi rig gzhung grosatshogasade sngon gyi rig gzhung grosatshogasadang bsdur natshogasargya che4che zhing / migrangasadang / dpyad rtsomaklog 'don gyi tshad che4mang ba'i grosatshogasashig red/ sgrog4'don byasapa'i dpyad rtsomagyi gzhi khyon dang nang don labaltasana'ang / mkhasapa rnamasakyi4gling sgrung rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi tshan khag snying bor bzung ste/mi'i rig4kyi rig pa dang / skye dngosakhor yug rig pa/ rolamo zlosagar rig pa/ dmangasasrol rig pa bcasakyi zhib 'jug gi byed thabasaspyad nasagling sgrung lasamatshon pa'i rig gnasakyi rnamapamang por dbye zhibadang zhib 'jugabyasa'adug dpyad rtsomamang che shosalaltab gsar ba yod par ma zad/ da dung shesarig gi rin thang dang zhib 'jug khyabakhongasargya skyed kyi don snying kyang galachen mchisal/ mang sha4kyisaltastangasamang yodang go ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃzlo ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ shā/gling sgrung zhib 'jug byed par cha 'phrin gsar ba yang theng4'di'i gling sgrung rgyalaspyi'i grosatshog4steng mkhasaparnamazlogis

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshering gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshog4chen dang tshogasachung brgyud nas rig gzhung brje resabyasapa lasagazhan/ mtsho sngon khri shor rgyal mo'i 'gram rgyud kyi rgya yesde bsa'akhrab ston bgyi4pa'i gling sgrung gi rta rgyug rgyal 'jog dang dpa' rtul sum cu'i 'khrab ston la gzigasapa dang zhing chen mi rigasaglu gar tshogasapa'i 'khrab stonal5nga gzigs/ der mazad da dung mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi gling sgrung bya ba'i grub 'brasa'agrem ston la gzigasapa dang / skad gragasacan gyi sku 'bumadagon pa/ mtsho sngon po sogs la ltasgor gzigs mo gnang bas/ kho tshor mtsho sngon gyi khyad du mtshar ba'i rang byung yulaljongasakyi gan4tshul la cha rgyusaragayotsam yod thub pa byung /da lan gyi gling sgrung rig gzhung grosatshogasal gzhan dang mimatshungasapa'i khyad chosagatso bo gang dag yod dam zhe na/ rgyal yongasagling sgrung bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gi 'go gtso ste/ bod kyi mkhasapa gragasacan 'jamadapal rgya mtsho lagasakyisagasung don/ da theng4kyi rgyalaspyi'i groyotshogasalakhyad cho4gtso bo 'ga' yod pa ste/ gcig ni/ dpyad rtsomagyi grangasaka mang zhing rgyu spusakyang legasal/ sngon dang bsdur na 'phelargyasachen po byung yod cing / zhib 'jug gi khyabakhongasakyang rgya je cher song yod/ dper na/gling sgrung gi sgrung mkhan lazhib 'jug dang par gzhi zhib 'jug gling sgrung 'tsholasdud dag sgrig gi spyi sdom dang ma'ongasapa'i ltatshul/ gling sgrung rig gan4kyi sngog 'don bed spyod dang / khor yug srung skyong / glu rta'i zhiba'asdi/ ༵casakyi thad du tshan khag mang ba dang go rim mang po'i sgo na4zhib

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshogs chen dang tshogs chung brgyud nas rig gzhung brje res byas pa lasagazhan/ mtsho sngon khye shor rgyal mo'i 'gram rgyud kyi rgya ye sde bas 'khrab ston bgyis pa'i gleng sgrung gi rta rgyug rgyal 'jog dang dpa' rtul sum cu'i gab ston 'a gzigs pa dang zhing chen mi rigs glu gar tshogs pa'i 'khrab ston la 'ang gzigs/ der ma zad da dung mtsho sngon zhing ra gyi gling sgrung bya ba'i grub 'bras 'grem/ ston la gzigs pa dang / skad grags can gyi sku 'bum dgon pa/ mtsho sngon po sogs la lta skor gzigs mo gnang bas/ kho tshor mtsho sngon gyi ga du mtshar ba'i rang byung yul ljongs kyi gnas spyo la cha rgyusarags tsam yo da thub pa byung /da lan gyi gling sgrung rig gzhung gros tshogs la gzhan dang mi mtshungasapa'i khyad chos gtso bo gang dag yod dam zhe na/ rgyal yongs gleng sgrung bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gi 'go gtso ste/ bod kyi mkhas pa grags can 'jam dpal rgya mtsho lags kyis gsung don/ da zengs kyi rgyal spyi'i gros tshogs la khyad chos gtso bo 'ga' yod pa ste/ gcig ni/ dpyad rtsom gī grangs ka mang zhing rgyu srus kyang legs la/ sngon dang bsdur na 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod cing / zhib 'jug gi khyab khongs kyang rgya je cher song yong/ dper na/gling sgrung gi sgrung mkhan la zhib 'jug dang par gzhi zhib 'jug gling sgrung 'tshol sdud dag sgrig gi spyi sdom dang ma 'ongs pa'i lta7tshul/ gling sgrung rig gnas kyi sngog 'don bed spyod dang / khor yug srung skyong / glu rta'i zhib 'jug bcas kyi thad du tshan khag mang ba dang go rim mang po'i sgo nas zhib 312

rma 'bri'i 'byung khungs kyi gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogs/4ga byas yod la/ des gling sgrung rig pa'i zhib khrug thad du nged cag gis grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs yod pa bden dpang byas/gnyis ni/ da lan gyi rig gzhung gros tshogs 'di ni rang rgyal gyi gling sgrung rig pa'i zhib khrug gi dpung sde phyir mngon pa'i go skabs legs po zhig red/ nged rnams shin tu spro 'os pa zhig ni/ tshogs zhugs mkhas pa'i nang du dar ma/ dang na gzhon gyis mang che shos zin yod par ma zad/ slob grwa ra mo las byung ba dang yang na yig rigs gsum yan go shes pa'i na gzhon mkhas pa yang cung mang po yo da/ da dung dgon pa la la'i chos lugs mi sna'i zhib 'jug nga yang yod/ 'di'i steng nas bltas na rang rgyal gyi gling sgrung zhib khrug gi dpung sder stobs shugs gsar ba kha sgon byas yod cing /khong rnam sa ni gling sgrung rig pa'i dza khag gi ma 'ongs pa'i re ba yin pa dang //spe /zhe /tsho /rje /phyo /zo /byeng sgrung ba 'jug la ma/ na na yang sa gas su rgyun 'a na da mkhan yod la kho tshor re ltos kyang dza po byed kyin ra/gsum ni/ gling sgrung gi sgrung mkhan gsar ba mu mthud du 'byung bzhin ra/ spyir gsar byung sgrung mkhan ni nyung shas shig yin na'ang nged cag gis shes thub pa ni/ gling sgrung 'di gzhan dang mi mtshungs par bod rigs dmangs khrod du gson por gnas yod cing / da dung mu mthud du 'phel rgyas dang rgya skyed du 'gro bzhin mchis pa de yin/ de'i phyir nged rnams kyis sgrung mkhan gyis bshad pa'i sgrung dag sgrar phab pa dang zin bris ga'adebs pa/ dag sgrig par sgrun byed pa bcas kyi bya bar gtsigs 'dzin 313

rma 'bri'i 'byung khungs kyi gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogs/'jug byasayod la/ desagling sgrung rig pa'i zhib 'jug thad du nged cag gi4grub 'bra4g.yur du za ba blangasayod pa bden dpang byas/gnyi4ni/ da lan gyi rig gzhung grosatshogasa'adi ni rang rgyalagyi gling sgrung rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi dpung sde phyir mngon pa'i go skabasalegasapo zhig red/ nged rnamasashin tu spro'osapa zhig ni/ tshogasazhugasamakhasapa'i nang du dar ma dang na gzhon gyisamang che shosazin yod par ma zad/ slob grwa chen mo lasabyung ba dang yang na yig rigasagasum yan chad shesapa'i na gzhon mkhasapa yang cung mang po yod/ da dung dgon pa lala'i cho4lugasami sna'i zhib 'jug pa yang yod/ 'di'i steng na4bltasan rang rgyal gyi gling sgrung zhib 'jug gi dpung sder stobasashugasagasar ba kha snon byasayod cing /khong rnam/sani gling sgrung rig pa'i tshan khag gi ma'ong4pa'i re ba yin pa dang /gling sgrung zhib 'jug lamatshon na yang rjesaphyogs4rgyun 'dzin byed mkhan yod la kho tshor re ltosakyang chen po byed kyin yod/gsum ni/ gling sgrung gi sgrung mkhan gsar ba mu mthud du 'byung bzhin yod/ spyir gsar byung sgrung mkhan ni nyung shasashig yin na'ang nged cag gisasheyothub pa ni/ gling sgrung 'di gzhan dang mi mtshungasapar bod rigasadamangasakhrod du gson por gnasayod cing / da dung mu mthud du 'phel rgyasadang rgya skyed du 'gro bzhin mchisapa de yin/ de'i phyir nged rnamayokyisasgrung mkhan gyisabashad pa'i sgrung dag sgrar phab pa dang zin brisasu'adebs pa/ dag sgrig par skrun byed pa bca4kyi bya bar gtsigakā~Xṭ+wāṃn

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang sgrung mkhanagyi 'tsho babakod sgrig legasapo bgyisate/ nu4pa yod tshad kyisakhotshoste gling ṭ+wāṃng myur skyob kyi bya ba'i nang zhugasasu'ajug par 'bad 'bungaXr+shadi da lda/ lan gyi rigagazhung grosatshogasabargyud nas/ tshogasazhugasamakhasapa'i bsamatshul gcig mthun byung bste/ gling sgrung ni mirigasarig gnasakyi phulabyung shulabazhag yin zhing / krung hwa mi rigasarig gnasakyi grubacha gtso shosakyang yin la/ 'dzam gling rig gan4bang mdzod khrod kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i nor bu zhig kyang lags/ da ltadamang4khrod du gson por gnasayod pa'i rig gnayoshul bzhag 'di dag myur skyob dang srung skyong byed rgyur nged cag rnam4la'osa'agan yod la 'gan khur yang yod/'di dag sngamonasayongasa'agrub byed rgyu ni nged cag mirabasa'adi'i gzi brjid ldanapa'i la4'gan yin no zhesagasungasapa lag4so/ /da lan gyi rig gzhung grosatshog4mjug bsduba'i tshogasachen steng reb 'di'i gro4tshogasakyi 'go khrid tshan chung gi 'go gtso ste/ bod kyi snyan ngag pa chen poskalabazang rdo rje lagasakyisakyang / tshogasazhugasamakhasapa rnamasakyisagling sgrung zhiba'ajug bya ba 'phelargyasayong bdang phan tshun bar gyi mdza' brtse sngar la4je zab tuyong slad/ phyogasabazhi mtshamalobargyad nasadaka' ngalalama'adzem4par rma 'bru'i 'byung khungasamatsho sngon zhing chen du phebasate gling sgrung rgyalaspyi'i rig gzhung grosatshogasal zhugasapa red/ de ri~X spyang sgrungargyal spyi'i rig gzhung grosatshogasathengasalnga ba rgyal kha'i ngang

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang sgrung mkhan gyi 'tsho ba bkod sgrig legs po bgyis te/ nus pa yod tshad kyes kho tsho gling sgrung myur skyob kyi be+e ba'i nang zhugs su 'dig par 'bad 'bungs byed dgos/bzhi ni/ da lan gyi rig gzhung gros tshogs brgyud nas/ tshogasazhugs mkhas pa'i bas mtshar gcig mthun byung ba ste/ gling sgrung ni mirigs rig gnas kyi phul byung shul bzhag yin zhing / krung hwa mi rigs rig gnas kyi grub cha gtso shos kyang yin la/ 'dzam gleng rig gnas bang mdzod khrod kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i nor bu zhig khrung lags/ da lta dmangs khrod du gson por gnas yod pa'i rig gnas shul bzhag 'di dag myur skyob dang srung skyong byed rgyur nged cag rnams la 'os 'gan yod la 'gan khur yang yo da/'di dag snga yonas yongs 'grub byed rgyu ni nged cag mi rabs 'di'i gzibarjid ldan pa'i las 'gan yin no zhes gsungs pa lags so/ /da lan gyi rig gzhung gros tshogs mjug bsdu ba'i tshogs chen steng reb 'di'i gros tshogs kyi 'go khyed tshan chang gi 'go gtso ste/ bod kyi snyan ngag pa chen mo skal bzang rdo rje lags kyis kyang / tshogs zhugs mkhasaparnams kyis gling sgrung zhib 'jug bya ba 'phel rgyas yong ba dang phan tshan bar gyi mdza' brtse sngar las ji zab tu yong sbad/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas dka' ngal lam 'dzems par rma 'di'i 'byung khungs mtsho sngon zhing don du phebs te gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogs la zhugs pa red/ de ring gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogs thengs lnga ba rgyal kha'i ngang 314

rma 'bri'i 'byung khungs kyi gling sgrung rgyal byu'i rig gzhung gros tshogs/mjug bsgril ba yin la/ sang nyin sbu mgron rnams so sor lam la chas rgyu red/ thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du'i 'tshogs yun thung na'ang nged rnams kyi ma dza' brtse ni chu bo'i rgyun bzhin ring zhing chad pa med/ phyis su nged cag thams cad phan tshun 'brel ba dam po yong ba dang / rig gzhung zhib 'jug 'phel rgyas yo nga ba/ de min gling sgrung 'di 'dzam gling chad mangs kun lashes sa 'jug slad/ nged rnams kyis mnyam du 'bad brtson byas te/ gling sgrung gi rig gzhung zhib 'jug 'di rim ba gsar ba'am zam skas gsar ba zhig la sleb tu 'jug dgos pa yin zhes gsungs so/ /

rma 'bri'i 'byung khungs kyi gling sgrung rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros tshogs/mjug bsgril ba yin la/ sang nyin sku mgron rnamasasosor lamalachasargyu red/ thengasa'adi'i tshogasa'adu'i 'tshog4yun thung na'abanged rnamasakyi mdza' brtse ni chu bo'i rgyun bzhin ring zhing chad pamed/ phyisasunged cag thamasacad phan tshun 'brelabadamapoyong ba dang / rig gzhung zhiba'ajug 'phelargya4yong ba/ de min gling sgrung 'di 'dzamagling midamangasakun lashesasu'ajug slad/ nged rnamasakyisamanyamadu 'bad brtson byasate/ gling sgrung gi rig gzhung zhib 'jug 'di rimapagasar ba'amathemaskasagasar bzhig la sleb tu'ajug dgosapa yin zhesagasungasaso/ /

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /bod brgyud nang bstan kun 'dus zhal thang chen mo las ming grung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mtshams spyor mdor bsdus/bod gangs can gyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi blo gros kyi rtsal las thon pa'i dmangs khrod kyi ngag rtsom ring po zhig yin zhing / de rang re'i bod kha ba can gyi ljongs sa dar khyab che ba tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam 1nga steng gi rgyal khab nyi shu lhag gis kyang gtsigs 'dzin dang len gnang ste/ ched gnyer gyi zhiba'ajug las khungs btsugs shing ched las mi sna bkod sgrig mdzad de 'tshol sdud dang / legs sgrig yig sgyur/ par skrun/ zhib 'jug bcas kyi lasadon legs par gnyer bzhin yod/ khong rnam/ pas ge sar sgrung ni 'dzam 1nga rig gnas bang mdzod khrod kyi 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba'i rin chen nor bu zhig tu bste ba las gzhan/ bo gling lhom 'a 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyusazhib 'jug spe bar shin tu thob par dka' ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha tshad lda na zhig yin pa yang shes yod/gling ge sar gyi sgrung 'di rang re'i krung go'i khongs gtogs kyi bod 316

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/ ༈bod brgyud nang bstan kun 'dus zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mtshams spyor mdor bsdus/bod gangasacan gyi dpa' bo'i lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsom gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni bod rigasami dmangasakyi blo grosakyi rtsal la4thon pa'i dmangs khrod kyi ngag rtsom ring po zhig yin zhing / de rang re'i bod khab can gyi ljong4sudar khyab che ba tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam gling steng gi rgyal khab nyi shu lhag gisakyang gtsigasa'adzin dang len gnang ste/ ched gnyer gyi zhib 'jug lasakhungasabatsugasashing ched la4mi sna bkod sgrig mdzad de 'tsholasdud dang / legasasgrig yig sgyur/ par skrun/ zhib 'jug bcasakyi lasadon legasapar gnyer bzhin yod/ khong rnam pasage sar sgrung ni 'dzam gling rig gnasabang mdzod khrod kyi 'od zer rab tu 'phroba'i rin chen nor bu zhig tu brtsi ba lasagazhan/ yagling lhoma'i 'gro ba mi'i rigasakyi lo rgyusazhib 'jug bya bar shin tu thob par dka' ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha tshad ldan zhig yin pa yang shesayod/316gling ge sar gyi sgrung 'di rang re'i krung go'i khongasagatog4kyi bod

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/rigs dang / sog rigs/ hor rigs/ 'jang rigs/ yus ku'u rigasasogs kyi sa khul du khyab dang khyab bzhin yod par ma zad/ mong gol mi dam ngas spyi mthun rgyal khab dang uru su'i pu'u le nab sa khul/ hi ma la mo re lto 'gram gyi rgya gar/ ba pa la/ pa khi 6than/ 'brug yu'i/ 'bar ma/'bras ljongs bcas rgyal khab mang por yang dar khyab byung yo da/gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 'di'i brjod bya'i don gyi thad la bltas na yang lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gang gis kyang 'gran zla med pa zhig yin la/sgrung rtsom/ 'di ni ge sar rgyal pos phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi btul te rdzong chen bco brgyad dang rdzong phran nyer gcig phab pa'i rtogs brjod mtshon pa tsam zhig ma yin par/ gna' rabs bod kyi lo rgyus dang / chab srid/ dpal 'byor/ dmag don/ dmangs srol/ rig gnas sgyu rtsal bcas mtshon pa'i kun 'dus kyi dpe deb zhig go /des na 'dir bod brgyud nang bstan kun 'dus zhal thang chen mo'i ge sar sgrung gi skor gyi ri mong nang don ma tshams sbyor rags tsam byas na 'di lta ste/dang po/ lha ming gab tse dgu skor/1 slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis steng phyogs lhan pho brang nasayab bde mchog dkar po dang yum bde mchog dmar po gnyis la sras gsum byung ba las sras chung ba thos pa dga' mi byed du 'gro dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba bzhin/ nam mkha'i dbyings nas 'ja' don sna lnga shar ba'i dbusagal phrug dgung lo bcu lhag can zhig mar mi yul khams sa phebs bzhin 317

zhal thang chen mo lasagling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/rigayodang / sog rigs/ hor rigs/ 'jang rigs/ yusaku'u rigasasogasakyi sakhul du khyab dang khyab bzhin yod par ma zad/ mong golamidamangasaspyi mthun rgyalakhab dang uru su'i pu'u le 5the sakhul/ hi yol ya'i lho'agram gyi rgya gar/ ne pa la/ pa khisithan/ 'brug yul/ 'bar ma/'brasaljong4bcasargyalakhab mang por yang dar khyab byung yod/glingage sar rgyal po'i sgrung 'di'i brjod bya'i don gyi thad la bltasan yang lo rgyu4brjod pa'i snyan rtsom gang gisakyang 'gran zla med pa zhig yin la/sgrung rtsom 'di ni ge sar rgyalaposaphyogasabazhi'i dgra bzhi btul te rdzong chen bco brgyad dang rdzong phran nyer gcig phab pa'i rtogasabarjod mtshon pa tsam zhig ma yin par/ gna' rabayobod kyi lo rgyusadang / chab srid/ dpal 'byor/ dmag don/ dmangasasrol/ rig gnasasgyu rtsal bca4mtshon pa'i kun 'dusakyi dpe deb zhig go / desan 'dir bod brgyud nang bstan kun 'du4zhalathang chen mo'i ge sar sgrung gi skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mtshamasasbyor rag4tsam byasan 'di ltaste/dang po/ lha gling gab tse dgu skor/1 slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnasakyisasteng phyogayolhayipho brang nasayab bde mchog dkar po dang yumabade mchog dmar po gnyisal srasagasum byung ba lasasrasachung ba tholopa dga' miyul du 'gro dgosapa'i bka' gnang ba bzhin/ nam mkha'i dbyingasanasa'aja' tshon sna lnga shar ba'i dbusasulhaphrug dgung lo bcu lhag can zhig mar miyul khamasasuphebakā~Xṭ+wāṃn

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i rmya/2 slob dpon lhun zhing brjid par bzhugs te gsung brjod par lhaphrug gsum gus pas yar bzhengs shing thal yo sbyar nas nyan pa'i spyo/3 klu rgyal na mgon dkar po de bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi drung du phyin nas thal mo sbyar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lhang sar btsugs te/ 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rin po che/ / klu yum sdug bsnga la ma dze yis zin/ / ji la skyabs mgon zhus pa lags/ / zhes zhu bzhin pa'i tshul/4 slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs te klu khams kyi nad yams tshabs chen thams cad lhag ma med par dngas par mdzad/ slobadapon gyi bka' drin gso ba'i phyir/ klu rgyal gyis rang gi bu mo chung ba yi ga mdzes ldan de slob dpon r+ṣa por phul/ slob dpon gyis sras mo de gling seng blon la chung mar stsal ba las ge sar rgyal po 'khrungs/ 'dir gtso bo bcu drug lang tsho rdzogs pa'i klu mo yal ga mdzes ldan mtsho mo dwangs shingags ba las yar sko yul du phebs pa'i gzugs ris mtshon yo da/5 de yang stod na gangs ris bskor ba dang / bar na phyugs rigasasna tshogs kyis bkang ba/ smad na mtsho chung gsum gyi 'gram na sbra dang rdang thag 'dzoms pa'i dud khyem gsum chags 'dug pa 'di yang ma/tsho skya rengs kha na skya lo bsdad/ sngo rengs khan sngo lo bsdad/ gro rengasakha na gro lo bsdad ces pa'o/ /6 mtsho skya rengs 'gram gyi zo gur che zhing yangs pa'i mdun na yab skya 318

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i tshuX/ slobadaponalhunazhing brjid par bzhugasate gsung brjod par lhaphrug gsumagusapasayar bzhengasashing thalamosbyar nasanyan pa'i tshul/3 ku rgyalamimagon dkar po de bla mapad+ma 'byung gnasakyi drung du phyin nasathalamosbyar te/ pu4mo g.yasapa'i lhang sar btsug4te/ 'gro ba'iskyabasamagonarinapoche/ / klu yulasdug bsngalamadze yisazin/ / khyed gaskyabasamagon zhusapa lags/ / zhesazhu bzhin pa'i tshul/4 slobadapon pad+ma 'byung gnasaspyan drangasate klu khamasakyi nad yamasatshab4chen thamasacad lhagamamed par dwangasapar mdzad/ slobadapon gyi bka' drin gsoba'i phyir/ klu rgyalagyisarang gi bu mochung ba yalag mdze4ldan de slob dpon chen por phul/ slob dpon gyis srasamo de gling sengablon lachung mar stsalabalasage sar rgyal po 'khrungs/ 'dir gtso bo bcu drug lang tsho rdzog4pa'i klu moyalag mdzesaldan mtsho modangasashing gsalabalasayar miyuladu phebasapa'i gzugasarisamatshon yod/5 de yang stod na gangasarisabaskor ba dang / bar na phyugasarigasasnatshogasakyisabakang ba/ smad na mtsho chung gsum gyi 'gram na sbra dang dang thag 'dzom4pa'i dud khyimagasum chagasa'adug pa 'di yang mtsho skya rengasakha pyiskya lo/sdad/ sngo rengasakhan sngo lo bsdad/ gro rengasakha na gro lo bsdad ༷༷༵/ ma/tsho skya rengasa'agramagyi spragur che zhing yangasapa'i mdun na yabaskya

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/lo ston pa rgyal mtshan dang yum mdzangs chen gnyis kyis bzhin 'dzum gyisalus bkrus te ku re rtsen pa'i rmya 'di yang rgyud la sgo ma dkar 0 zor pa skya lo seng lcam 'khrug mo sku 'khrungs pa'i snga ltas yin tshul/7 slob dpon gyis thugs sras thos pa dga' ba khyod 'gro don dang sems ba byed ma 'gas par song zhig gsungs pas/ lha phrug thos pa dga' bdes 'jig rten 'di la byon dka' ba'i tshul bstan te/ tshe tog dmar ser gyi rjes btod de 'jam dbyangs kyi khri rgyab lag ba pas/ der shes rabakyi dngos grub thob par gyur/8 thos pa dga' yis tshe tog ser po'i rjes btod de/ 'od dpag med kyi khri zhabs la gab/ rigs drug sems can 'dren stobs kyi dngosagrub job/9 thos pa dga' yis tshe tog dkar po'i rjes btod de/ 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba'i lam ngos bzung / dmyal khams mun pa chos la bsgyur ba'i rten 'bre'/ bsgrigs pa bcas so/ /gnyis pa/ 'khrungs gling me tog ra ba/1 de nas nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub/ bar snang nasagayu 'brug sngon mos gsung snyan bsgrags/ sa gzhi nas bya rgyal byug sngon mos skad 'gyur brgyab/ skyid sos yag gi khamado'i sa cha la tshe tog gi char ba rgyun mi chad par babs/ de'i dus gajo skyid dam bsangs rgyas de nyid gsang gnas bde bskyed kyi 'khor lo nas ma 'khrungs shing / yab seng blon 319

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/loston pa rgyalamatshan dang yum mdzangasachenaganyisakyisabazhina'adzumagyisalusabakrusate ku re rtsen pa'i tshula'adi yang rgyud lasgrolamadakar mo'i sprulapaskya loseng lcama'abrug mosku 'khrungasapa'i sngaltasayin tshul/7 slob dpon gyi4thug4srasathosangadaga' ba khyod 'gro don dang semasabaskyed ma'achugasapar song zhig gsungasapas/ lhaphrug thosapadaga' ba desa'ajig rten 'di la byon dka' ba'i tshulabastan te/ metog dmar ser gyi rjesabatod de 'jamadabyangasakyi khri rgyab lagab pas/ der shesarabakyi dngo~Xrgyazlo ṭ+wāṃ~X /r+sha ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃyo/ metog ser po'i rje4btod de/ 'od dpag med ṭ+wāṃ khri zhabasalagab/ rigasadrug semasacan 'dren stobayokyi dngo4grub —༵/ tho4pa dga' yisametog dkar po'i rje4btod de/ 'od zer rnam par 'phroba'i lamangosabazung / dmyalakhamasamun bachosalabasgyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigasapa bca4so /gnyis pa/ 'khrungs gling me tog ra ba/1 de nasanamamakha' la'aja' 'od kyi gur phub/ bar snang nasagayu'abrug sngon mosagasung snyan bsgrags/ sagazhi nasabya rgyalakhubyug sngon mosaskad 'gyur brgyab/ skyid sosayag gi khamado'i sacha lametog gi char ba rgyun mi chad par babs/ de'i dusasujo skyid dmapasangasargyasade nyid gsang gnasabade bskyed kyi 'khor lonasasku 'khrung4shing / yab sezlo ṭ+wāṃn

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang yum 'gog poganyisasgoba'abumagyisamyosate bu phrug khong gnyisakyi dkyiladī baṭ+wāṃ t+na ༵d+nghat+na rnoX hū/ 'da' ra malabe'u ཿngas/ lug ོsim la lugu 'khrungs/ khyi rda gsang mal domabu thod dkar 'khrungs/ rgod ṭ+wāṃ gyo mal rkyang bu don grub 'khrung4pa bcasakyi ltasango mtshar babyung ba'i rgyar/ 3 seng blon dang rgya bza' 〉skyid sgroladakar gnyisagyi4rgya tsha zhaladakar dang bu chung jo ru gnyisalhan du sbra 'dabasasartse ru 'jug pa'i tshul/4 'gog bza' labu chung jo skyid dam pa 'khrungasapar rgya bzasaphrag dokusduXte med brlag gtong rgyu'i ngan semasade akhu khro thung lazhu bzhinapa' du5/ khro thung myur bar mustegasasgom pa ra dza'i mdun du song nas/bdag gi bla masgomapa rab gsalalags/ / gling dkar lhayigazhi dkyilal/ / 'dre phrug thang shing mgo 'bur skyes/ / kha gnon gyi dusabab khyed layod/ / ce4zhu bzhin pa'i skor/6 mu stegasasgomapa ra dzasabatang ba'i bya nag spun gsumadesagashogasgrasardza ri bshig le/ rkan sgrasaklad khrag 'jib le/ gzi brjid kyisablogrogabargyal lezhig byasanasashor byung ban/ jo rusame stag khromakhromadu springasapa'i mda' chung de bya gsumal phog stephreng ba sbrel ba ltar salalhung ba'i tshul/3201 sgom pa ra dza'i snying gting nasa'akhrugasate/ brag phug gi nang du

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang yum 'gog yoganyis sgo ba 'bum gyis myos te bu phrug khong gnyis kyi dkyil du bzung 'dug pa'i spyo/2 de nas nyin der 'bri 'da' ra mal be'u 'khrungs/ lug sgalasom la lu gu 'khrungs/ khye rda gsang mal dom bu thod dkar 'khrungs/ rgod gro khyo ma la rkyang bu don grub 'khrungs pa bcas kyi ltas ngo mtshar ba byung ba'i skor/3 seng blon dang rgya bza' lha skyid sgol dkar gnyis gyis rgya tsha zhaladakar dang bu ga jo ru gnyis lhan du sbra 'dabs su rtse ru dzog pa'i rmya/4 'gog bza' la bu chung jo skyid dam pa 'khrungs par rgya bzas ga dog byas te med brlag gtong rgyu'i ngan sems de sprikhu khro thung la zhu bzhinapa'i rmya/5 khro thung myur bar mu stegs sgom pa ra cha mdun du song nas/bdag gi bla ma sgom pa rab gsal lags/ / gling dkar lha yi gzhi dkyil la/ / 'dre phrug thang shing mgo 'bur skyes/ / kha gnon gyi dus bab khyed layod/ / ces zhu bzhin pa'i skor/6 mu stegs sgom pa ra dzas btang ba'i bya nag srun gsum des gshog sgras rdza ri bshig le/ rkan sgras klad khrag 'jib le/ gzi brjid kyis bla sgogabargyal le zhig byas nas shor byung ba na/ jo rus ma stag khrom khrom du springasapa'i mda' chung de bya gsum la phog ste phreng ba sbrel ba ltar sal lhung ba'i spyo/7 sgom pa ra dza'i steng gting nas 'khrugs te/ brag phug gi nang du 320

zhal thang chen mo las1nga sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/yar 'dzul nas/ shugs ring nar nar zhig byas te cung zad ngal gso ba'i che/ yang jo ru de gar byung 'dir byung med par ger mdzo re mdo gru bzhi de phyag la bzung nas brag phug gi sgo khar phebs pa'i tshul/8 de nas jo rus brag nag phug pa'i sgo chen de ger mjo'i ma rdo gru bzhis bcad nas/ mu stegasang na sngags kyi bdag po sgom pa ra dza de ru sbasanas dam la btags pa'i tshul/9 khro thung rgyal pos yid la ngan sems bcangs te/ jo ru ma bu gnyis rma smad g.yu lung sum mdor bzangs na yang gnam las 'ja' tshon shar ba dang sa las me tog bzhad pa'i dkyil dbus su sbra chung las gzi brjid kyi 'od zer 'phro ba'i tshul lo/ /gsum pa/ rta rgyug dbyad kyi nyi ma/1 jo byud yid bzhin nor bu rta rgyug rgyal 'jog gi khrod du rnam par rgyal te/ khong gser khye dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi steng du phebs nas sku'i sprul pa ri rab bzhin gser khre'i steng du 'gying nger bzhugs pa'i tshul/2 gong ma lhan lung bstan ltar/ rta rkyang rgod kyi srab mda' de chosakyi dar thag dkar po dang mnyam du nam mkha' nas brkyangs pas 'gog mo nyid nas mos gus smon lam dang bcas phyag gis bzung ba'i tshul/3 1nga gi dpa' rtul sum cu'i brta sum cu rta rgyug rgyal 'jog la zhugs pa'i tshul dang mang tshogs khye stong mang pos dga' spro'i ngang ltad mor gzigs pa'i tshul/321

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/yar 'dzulanas/ shug4ring nar nar zhig byasate cung zad ngalagasoba'i tshe/ yang jo ru de gar byung 'dir byung med par ger mdzo'i blardo gru bzhi de phyag la ༵zurdo /༵byā kū ༵༵ ni sdi ni dūdi swāg ṭ+wāṃ dzhai /de ger mahrū blardo gru bzhisabacad nas/ mu stegasangan sngagasakyi bdag po sgomapa ra dza de ru sbasanasada~X lazlo ṭ+wāṃsngi kārdo'i ༵༵yi/ da la ngan semasabacangasate/ jo ru ma bu gnyi4rma smad g.yulung sumamador brdzangasan yang gnamalasa'aja' tshon shar ba dang sa lasame tog bzhad pa'i dkyil dbu4susachung lasagazi brjid kyi 'od zer 'phroba'i tshul lo/ //lha skyi rdo/ yi/ /r+sha r+shasdi dū snyi /sna rgya/ la'ajog gi khrod du rnamapar rgyal te/ khong gser khri dgo4'dod kun 'byung gi steng du phebasanasasku'i sprul pa ri rab bzhin gser khri'i steng du 'gying nger bzhugasapa'i tshul/2 gong ma lhayilung bstan ltar/ rta rkyang rgod kyi srab mda' de chosakyi dar thag dkar po dang mnyayodu nam mkha' nasabarkyangasapasa'agog mo nyid nasamo4gusasmon lam dang bcasaphyag gisabazung ba'i tshul/3 gling gi dpa' rtul sumacu'i mirta sum cu rta rgyug rgyala'ajog lazhug4pa'i tshul dang mang tshogasakhri stong mang po4dga' spro'i ngang ltad mor gzigasapa'i tshul/ 321

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/4 khro thung gis ge sar la phrag dog gi gnod sems bcangs te lkoganas mi ngan 'ga' dang blo sdur bzhin pa'i phro/5 ge sar gyi lha rta rkyang rgod g.yer bas rta rgyug las mgyogs dar ang dang po blangs pas/ thams cad sgob rgyas te mgyogs dar 'dogs bzhinapa'i spyo/6 rta rgyug gi na tshogs khrod du seng lcam 'brug yodag 'a ba 'bum gyisamyos te/ ge sar mchog la bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas 'bul ba'i tshul/7 ge sar mchog gser khri'i steng du bzhugs pa dang / 1nga gi dpa' rtul rnams kyis gleng gi nor ku cha bdun khong rin po cher 'bul bzhin pa'i rmya/8 skya lo seng lcam 'brug mo ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gyi btsun mor bas bzhin pa'i tshul te/ 'dir ge sar 'khor rnams kyi khrod du gzi brjid ngang bzhengs nas 'dug cing / 'brug po yang sman mchog rnams kyis bskor nas ge sar gyi sku mdun du phebs bzhin pa'i tshul/9 gling dkar kyis ston yo rgya chen po mdzad de/ glu len gar rtse dang rta rgyug mda' 'phen byed bzhin pa'i tshur mo/ /bzhi ba/ bdud 'dul/1 gling rje ge sar rgyal pos lha mda' 'ug sgom gcig 'phangs pasabadud nag ma rungs klu btsan rgod po'i dpral gyi nya chung de la zabs pa dang bstun nas dam la btags pa'i lo rgyus/322

gcod pa don thub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/4 khro thung gi4ge sar laphrag dog gi gnod semasabacangasatelkoganasamingan 'ga' dang misdur bzhin pa'i tshul/co ge sar gyi lharta rkyang rgod g.yer bsarta rgyug lasamagyogasadar ang daX ༷ sangasapas/ tham4cad sprob rgyasate mgyogasadar 'dog4bzhinapa' du6/ rta rgyug gi mitshogasakhrod du seng lcam 'brug modaga' ba 'bumagyisamyosate/ ge sar mchog labakra shi4pa'i lhardzasa'abulaba'i tshul/7 ge sar mchog gser khri'i steng du bzhugasapa dang / gling gi daX /larnamasakyisagling gi nor bu cha bdun khong rin pocher 'bulabazhinapa' du8/ skya lo seng lcama'abrug poge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gyi btsun mor bsubazhin pa'i tshul te/ 'dir ge sar 'khor rnamasakyi khrod du gzi brjid ngang bzhengasanasa'adug cing / 'brug moyang sman mchog rnamasakyisabaskor nasage sar gyi sku mdun du phebasabazhin pa'i tshul/9 gling dkar kyisaston morgya chen pomadzad de/ glu len gar rtse dang rta rgyug mda' 'phen byed bzhin pa'i tshulalo/ /༵ṭ+wāṃ ༷/ rje r+sha hātā ༵hā ༵sa/ lhamada' zhug sgromagacig 'phangayopasabadud nag marungasaklu btsan rgod po'i dpralagyi nya chung de la thebayopadang bltihā shāsadamalabatagasapa'i lorgyus/

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/2 me bza' 'bumaskyid de nyin zhig grayisgo khar yong nas/ thang maldeb gcig g.yasalabardal/ thang maldeb gcig g.yon labardal/ dkyiladu mo4thag4shig btagasanasabasdad yod skabs/ glo bur du phu nasarlubadamar dang mdo nasarlung nag 'tshub pa'i dkyilanasamichen mthong na 'jigasashing skrag pazhig byung nasamebaza' glag gisalugu 'dzin 'dzin byasanasanam mkhar khyer ba'i lorgyus/3 ge sar rgyalapo bdud 'dul bar 'gro ba'i skabasasu/ 'brug mosargyal po dang kha baboyo'adod par rta'i srab mda' bzung nasa'agog pa'i tshul// ge sar rgyalapothog mar bdud yuladu slebasate bdud klu btsan rgyal po'i sring mo astag lhamo'i brang a'adra ba lapusamo 'u 'dra babatsugasate/rgya gri shel gyi spu dkar bton nasabatsan gyisagrogasasu'agug pa'i tshul/da ge sar yang zhag mang por der bzhugasan4astag lhapokhabatubazhesashing / astag lhamosakyang bdud rgan 'dulaba'i slad du sor gdub khong ge sar mchog lasprad pa'i skor/6 ge sar rgyalapobadud kyi mtsho nag dug khrag 'dra ba'i 'gramadu sleb4pa na/ bdud khyi ku ku rā tsa zer ba thon te lamabakag pa'i skabasasu/ge sar nyid kyisa.astag lhamo'i sor gdubabastan pa'i tshe/ bdud khyi ku ku rā tsa phyir mtsho nang du mchongasasong ba'i lo rgyus/7 ge sar rgyalapo bdud mkhar lcagasar rtse dgu'i zur nabadud kyi spranag zur dgu zhesapayod pa'i nang du phebasate/ mebaza' 'bumaskyidū tāng

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/2 ske bza' 'bum skyid de nyin zhig gran sgo khar yong nas/ bang ma ldeb gcig g.yas la brdal/ thang ma ldeb gcig g.yon la brdal/ dkyil du mos thags shig btags nas bsdad yod skabs/ glo 4ra du phu nas rlung dmar dang mdo nas rlung nag 'tshub pa'i dkyil nas na chen mthong na 'jigs shing skrag pa zhig byung nas me bza' glag gis tsa gu 'dzin 'dzin byasanas nam mkhar khyer ba'i lo rgyus/3 ge sar rgyal po bdud 'dul bar 'gro ba'i skabs su/ 'khrug mosargyal po dang kha bral ma 'dod par rta'i srab mda' bzung nas 'gog pa'i tshul/4 ge sar rgyal po thog mar bdud yu tha du skebs te bdud klu btsan rgyal po'i sring mo a stag lha mo'i brang a 'dra ba la pus mo 'u 'dra ba btsugs te/rgya gri shel gyi spu dkar bton nas btsan gyis grogs sa 'gug pa'i tshul/5 ge sar yang zhag mang por der bzhugs nas a stag lha mo khab tubazhes shing / a stag lha mos kyang bdud rgan 'dul ba'i spod du sor gdub khong ge sar mchog la sprad pa'i skor/6 ge sar rgyal po bdud kyi mtsho nag dug khrag 'dra ba'i 'gram du stebs pa na/ bdud khye ku ku rā tsa zer ba thon te lam bkag pa'i skabs su/ge sar nyid kyis spristag lha mo'i sor gdub bstan pa'i tshe/ bdud khye ku ku rā tsa phyir mtsho nang du mchongs song ba'i lo rgyus/7 ge sar rgyal po bdud mkhar lcags ra rtse dgu'i zur na bdud kyi granag zur dgu zhes pa yod pa'i nang du phebs te/ tse bza' 'bum byad dang 323

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ringagi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'phrad de bdud rgan ji ltar 'dulabar grosasdur mdzad pa'i skor/8 ge sar rgyalaposabadud kyi blamatsho bskams/ bla shing bcag sa'abrong la mdasabargyab nasabasad pa'i tshul/9 bdud klu btsan gyi sring mo sgrol mdesakha brag khung 'dra ba dang mig 'od khung 'dra ba gdang4nasan mganyisaka phrag la gcig bkal lag pasagacig skyor nasanga'i jo jo susabasad pa red zer nasamachongasayong bar/ge sar rgyalaposabum pa'i nang gi blasbrang de blang4nas sked pa nasabacad pasasrin mo de yang kha gdang4nasashi song ba'i lo rgyusaso/ /༵ ṭ+wā/nga rno kāsdi ༵ ༵hāX ṇ+ḍiṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wā/ melce 'bar ba bzhin langasate/hor gur dkar rgyal po'i gnya' la zhab4g.yasapasamanan te ralagri btab pa lan med dgung laphyar na4meg med bzo ba'i tshul/2 gling gi dpa' chen 'dan ma byang khra thugasakhros te 'phangasapa'i mdu~X de hor shan pa me ru rtse'i mgo laphog ste klad phor bkog nasasar lhung ba' ༄༵/ gling gi dpa' rtul 'dan masahor gur dkar gyi thod du springasapa'i mda' desalasagur stong shong dkar mo'i sgo phyi nang na hor dpon rje blon rnam4yod pa'i sar mi bco lnga bcu drug tsamathal ler phig4nas/gur dkar gyi thad du byung ba na rtsalachen namamakha' spar 'dzin gyi4bar sna~X ṭ+wāmasanasabazung bsagur dkar gyi srog la skyon ma byung ba'i lorgyus/

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'ag de bdud rgan ji ltar 'dul bar gros sdur mdzad pa'i skor/8 ge sar rgyal pos bdud kyi bla ma/tsho bskams/ bla shing bcag ma'abrong la ma/das brgyab nas bsad pa'i tshal/9 bdud klu btsan zu sring mo sgos ma des kha brag khung 'dra ba dang mig 'od khung 'dra ba gdangs nas nu ma gnyis ka phrag la gcig bkal lag pas gcig spyor nasanga'i jo jo sus bsad pa red zer nas mchongs yong bar/ge sar rgyal pos bum pa'i nang gi bla sbrang de blangs nas sked pa nas bcad pas srin mo de yang kha gdangs nas shi song ba'i lo rgyus so/ /lnga ba/ hor gling g.yul 'byed/1 gling ge sar rgyal por khong khro me lce 'bar ba bzhin langs te/hor gur dkar rgyal po'i gnya' la zhabs g.yas pas ma nan te ral gri btabapa lan med dgung la phyar nas chag med bzo ba'i tshal/2 gling gi dpa' can 'dan ma byang khra thugs khros te 'phangs pa'i mda' de hor shan pa rtse ru rtse'i mgo la phog ste klad phor bkog nas sar lhung ba'i spyo/3 gleng gi dpa' rtul 'dan ma/sa hor gur dkar rmi thod du springasapa'i mda' des las gur stong shong dkar mo'i sgo phyi nang na hor dpon rje blon rnams yod pa'i sar mi bco lnga bzu drug tsam thal ler blugs nas/gur dkar gyi thad du byung ba na rtsal chen nam mkha' spar 'dzin gyis bar snang khams nas bzung bas gur dkar gyi srog la skyon ma byung ba'i lo rgyus/324

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/4 gling gi dpa' chen rgya tsha zhaladakar gyi4ltamada' 'phur shesathog tsede hor gur dkar gyi bla lcagayosteng du 'phangasate/ hor gyi the'u rang bla lcagasa~Xlaṭ+wāṃ~X ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ༵dī ṭ+wāṃ ༵/ra nag gisaganam lcagasathog gi sbyogasardo 'phangs pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' melcesabakang nasa'aphyo ba dang / bar snang 'u/ sgrasaX nasa'aphyogate/ hor rtsalachen namamakha'i gson snying phyi ru ba na ༵'a ṭ+wāṃng gi/ rgya tsha zhal dkar gyisamada' gser stong ma gcig springasapa gur dkar gyi srasalha'u'i lusakyi smad dkyil du phog nasamadun gyi lte'og nasadon de rta thog nasalhung zhing shi ba'i lo rgyus/7 hor gyi shan pa dang 'thab pa'i skabasasu/ zhal lu'i rta rgya bya desaphyir 'grosashig brgyab pa na zhalalu'i sku gzugasade mdun du rngamastabayosuyo da pa lingasakyisalhung ba dang mnyam du mdung gi rtser 'then pa 'dra ba zhig byung nasam4te bco lnga'i dung zla thang la lhung zer ba de'i lo rgyus/8 sman mchog 'brug mosablabya khrung khrung la 'phrin yig bskur te nag ༵ bdu~X ༵༵ du ṭ+wāṃngagaXṭ+wāṃng / seng chen rgyal po myur du hor du phebasapar sgug 9 ༵bhe ༵ bhe ༵ dī ༅/ba/de labakod rjes/ seng chen yab yum gyi chibasakha gling la bsgyur zhing / gling lhalde rnam4kyisabasub rgya chen po mdzad pa'i skor ro/ / 325

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/4 gling gi dpa' chen rgya tsha zhal dkar gyis lha mda' 'phur shes thogalce de hor gur dkar gyi bla lcags steng du 'phangs te/ hor gyi je'u rang bla lcags thal bar btang ba'i skor/5 gling sga sde chos skyong ber nag gis gnam lca gas thog gi spyogs rdo 'phangs pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' me lces bkang nas 'phyo ba dang / bar snang 'ur sgras bkang nas 'phyos te/ hor rtsal chen nam mkha'i gson snying phyi ru bton pa'i ྾/6 gling gi rgya tsha zhal dkar gyis ma/da' gser stong ma gcig springs pa gur dkar gyi sra/sa lha'u'i lus kyi smad dkyil du phog nas mdun gyi lte 'og nas don de rta thog nas lhang zhing shi ba'i lo rgyus/7 hor gyi shan pa dang 'thab pa'i skabs su/ zhal 'u 'i rta rgya bya desaphyir 'gros shig brgyab pa na zhal lu'i sku gzugs de mdun du rngam stabasasayo da pa lings kyis lhung ba dang mnyam du mdung gi rtser 'jen pa 'dra ba zhig byung nas rmas te bco lnga'i dung zla thang la lhung zer ba de'i lo rgyus/8 sman mchog 'brug mos bla bya khrung khrung la 'phrin yig bskur te nag po bdud yul du mngags shing / seng chen rgyal po myur du hor du phebs par re sgug tshad med byed pa'i skor/9 ser po hor yul bde la bkod rjes/ seng chen yab yum gyi chibs kha gling la bsgyur zhing / gling lha sde rnams kyis bsab rgya chen po mdzad pa'i skor ro/ /325

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/drug pa/ 'jang gling g.yul 'khyed/1 gling rje ge sar rgyal po mchog pho brang ja mkhar phyug mor bzhugasapa'i skabs su/ nam mkha' g.yon gyi pha rol na/ / sprin 'ja' tshon gnyisakyi bar skabs su/ / mas ba gong sman rgyal mo de/ / seng ge sga med srab med chibs/ / sprin lhagazugs 'dra yis rgyab bskor byas/ / sprin mi gzugasacan gyis chib lo kha khrid/ / rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor nas lung bstan gnang bzhin pa'i spyo/2 'jang sa dam rgyal po'i sras 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur desakhrab rmog lus la gyon/ 'khor gsum sked la btags te/ 'do ba gnam yag sngon mo'i gong la bcibs te zab la 'gro grabs kyi skabs su/ khong gi ma yum gyis bu phrug 'di sku na zabs mas nas g.yul 'gyed du zhugs sa 'jug ma phod par rta'i srab mda' bzung nas 'gog bzhin pa'i spyo/3 sdeg gcod shan pa nyid kyis ge sar rgyal po'i bka' gsung ltar/'khor gsum sked la btags nas dgung nas glog dmar 'khyug pa ji bzhin dbus kyi tshwa mtsho khar chas nas/ 'jang phrug g.yul thog 'gyur dang 'phrad de phan a glu blangs te dpa' gtam rjod bzhin pa'i spyo/4 shan pas thabs shes kyis 'jang phrug la chang rgya ma bco brgyad 'thung du bcug ste/ re zhig rab rib nyu gyur pa'i skabs dang bstun nasathag pa 'dom pa brgya dang brgyad can gyis bkyigs/ ri mgo gsum la sha zungs gsum brdabs nas btags pa'i rmya/326

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ṭ+wāṃswā ༷/ rje r+sha ༵dī ṭ+wāṃshā /༵r+sha' hā ṭ+wāṃng/ ja mkhar phyag mor bzhugasapa'i skabasasu/ namamakha' g.yonagyi pha rolan/ / sprin zloja' tshon gnyisakyi bar skabasasu/ / mne ne gong sman rgyalamode/ / seng ge sga med srab med chibs/ / sprin lhagazug4'dra yisargyab bskor byas/ / sprin mi gzugasacan gyisachibasakhakhrid/ / rigasabazhi'i mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyisabaskor nasalung bstan gnang bzhin pa'i tshul/2 'jang sadamargyalapo'i srasa'ajang phrug g.yulhathog 'gyur desakhrab rmog lusalagyon/ 'khor gsumasked labatagasate/ 'do ba gnamayag sngon mo'i gong labacibasate glingala'agrogabasakyi skabasasu/ khong gi mayum gyi4bu phrug 'di sku na zabasamasanasagayula'agyed du zhugasasu'ajug maphod par rta'i srabamada' bzunganasa'agog bzhinapa'i tshul/3 sdig gcad shan panyid kyisage sar rgyalapo'i bka' gsung ltar/'khor gsum sked labatagasanasadagung nayoglog dmar 'khyug pa ji bzhin dbusakyi tshwa mtsho khar chasanas/ 'jang phrug g.yulhathog 'gyur dang 'phrad de phan tshun glu blangasate dpa' gtamarjod bzhin pa'i tshul/4 shan pasathabasashesakyisa'ajang phrug lachang rgya yobaco brgyad 'thung du bcug ste/ re zhig rabarib tugyur pa'i skabasadang bstun nasathag pa'adom babargya dang brgyad canagyisabakyigs/ ri mgo gsumalasha za~Xgasumabardabasanasabatagasapa'i tshul/

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/5 'jang gi bla 'brong de khanas rlangs pa 'phyur/ rwa brdar/ sozoldir bzhin 'gro bar/ shan pas mda' 'phen bzhin pa'i tshul/6 'jang gi ma dred 'jigs sa rung bde bdud khrag nag po'i ral pa shig ger thon zhing / gling gi dmag dpung gi khrod du rgyugs pas na/ ge sar rgyal pos rdzu 'phrul gyis gser gyi rdo rje zhig nam mkhar rlung gis bskyod pa ltar 'ur sgra dang bcas 'phangs ba me dmar lhab lhab kyis 'bab pa'i tshul/7 'jang gleng gnyis g.yu thar byed pa'i skabs/ 'jang gi byur lhasasbrul dmar zhags pa 'phangs ba1nga gi dpa' mo'i ske la bskon te 'jang mirnams kyi tshogs sar khyed song ba'i skor/8 rgyal po ge sar mchog 'jang gi dug mtsho'i khar skebs tshe/ 'jang sa dam rgyal po'i blon po ber thul zhes pa dang 'phrad de/ ge sar mchog gisagrig ser yag sor gsum de bton nas kho'i ske bcad de mgo dar 'tshodang bcas pa 'do ba'i steng du bsdams nas lam du chas pa'i tshul/9 'jang sa dam rgyal po de khrus kyi dzing bur zhugs bzhin pa'i skabasasu/ khrus kyi dzing bu glo bur du 'khrug pas hub gsum 'thung skabs ge sar rgyal po nya mo zhig sa sprul cadas khog nyu zhugs shing / de nas yang rtsebs stong 'khor lo zhig tu sprul nas sa dam rgyal po bsad pa'i skor ro/ /bdun pa/ mon gling g.yul 'khyed/1 mon gling gnyis 'thab 'khrus ga byung rjes/ mon shing khye rgyalapo'aja' 'od kyi skas la 'dzegs nas bros par/ ge sar rgyal pos ma dang 327

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/5 'jang gi bla'abrongade khanasarlangasaba'aphyur/ rwa brdar/ sosgraldir bzhin 'gro bar/ shanapasamada' 'phenabazhinapa'i tshul/6 'jang gi sadred 'jigasasurung bde bdud khrag nag po'i ralapa shig ger thon zhing / gling gi dmag dpung gi khrod du rgyugasapasan/ ge sar rgyal posadzu 'phrulagyisagaser gyi rdo rje zhig namamakhar rlung gisabaskyod pa ltar 'ur sgradang bcasa'aphangasapame dmar lhab lhabakyisa'abab pa'i tshul/7 'jang gling gnyisagayula'agyed pa'i skabs/ 'jang gi byur lhasasbruladamar zhagasapa 'phangasabagling gi dpa' mo'i ske labaskon te 'jang mirnamasakyi tshogasasar khrid song ba'i skor/8 rgyal po ge sar mchog 'jang gi dug mtsho'i khar slebasatshe/ 'jang sadamargyalapo'i blonapober thul zhesangadang 'phrad de/ ge sar mchog gisagri gser yag sor gsumade bton nasakho'i sgobacad de mgo dar 'tshodang bcasanga'ado ba'i steng du bsdamasanasalamadu chasapa'i tshul/9 'jang sadamargyalapode khru4kyi rdzing bur zhugasabazhinapa'i skabasasu/ khrusakyi rdzing bu glo bur du 'khrug pasahubagasuma'athung skabasage sar rgyal po nya mozhig tusprulanasakhog tuzhugasashing / de nasayang rtsib4stong 'khor yozhig tu sprulanasasadam rgyalapobasad pa'i skor ro/ /༵dusbyon dī/nga /r+shaṭ+wāṃzlo/ snar+shadi ṭ+wāṃ~X/rjes/ mon shing khri rgyalapo'aja' 'od kyi skasala'adzegasanasabrosaṭ+wār/ ge sar rgyalapos31ha'

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'phangasan4'ja' 'od kyi skasagator/ shing khri bar snang nasasalagayugasapa na gling dmag gisade'i bemaro me'aphreg pa'i tshul/2 akhukhro thung bud med la chagasapa che bsamon shing khri rgyalapo'i gam du chung maslong du song yang mabyin par/ rgyal khab gnyisakyi bar du ga.a ༵ṭ+wāṃ ngh+ru r+sha sdodī ṭ+wāṃ ༵/mi spyang dkar po de4dung gzhu sprilong golaba'i nang dung mda' sha zan sgrodakar de bzhag na4'phangasapasame lce glog dngabaṭ+wāṃsapaXnā gyi rgyalapo'i blastag gi snying la phog nasakhra 'khyil ler thang du 'a—la ༵'a dīn gyi/ blon chen stag mo stong bdud zer ba nga rgyal gyisargyugasayong bar g.yulhathog 'gyur gyisamyur bar sbrul dmar gyi zhagasapa de 'phangasapasakho yimagrin pal thebasanasaphyir 'then pa4rta thog nasalhung ba'i tshul/5 dpa' la dang g.yulhamon gyi dmag sgar du brgyugasate/ mon gyi thog rgod skar chen sogasabasad rjes/ mon gyi zlab khrab btsan gson bzung gisagling sgar lakhrid de/ gur sgo ru phur ba chen po zhig brdab4te khyi bzhin /ta/rdoṭ+wāṃ ༵ snror+sha/nga rwa bco brgyad kyi rtse ru me bang ba tsam 'bar ba/lusa'ajigasasurung ba zhig thon byung ba der dpa' la dang shan pa gnyisakyisarngam pa'i tshul gyisagri re re btab pasamestag khrom khrom du mgo bo thang lalhurdo zing lusa'akhor zlum ltar gtubasapa'i skor/

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'phangs nas 'ja' 'od kyi skas gtor/ shing khye bar snang nas salagayugs pa na gling dmag gis de'i bem ro tshel sreg pa'i spyo/2 sprikhu khro thung bud chad la chags pa che bas mon shing khri rgyal po'i gam du chung ma slong du song yang ma byin par/ rgyal khab gnyis kyi bar du gshi 'khrug byung ba'i skor/3 gling gi dpa' la mi spyang dkar po des dung gzhu sprilong 'a a ba'i nang dung mda' sha zan sgo dkar de bzhag nas 'phangs pas me lce glog dang bcas pas mon gyi rgyal po'i za stag gi snying la phog nas khra 'gyi ler thang du 'gyel ba'i rmya/4 mon gyi blon chen stag mo stong bdud zer ba nga rgyal gyis rgyugs yong bar g.yu lha thog 'gyur gyis myur bar sprul dmar gyi zhags pa de 'phangs pasakho ye mgrin pa la jebs nas phyir 'jen pas rta thog nas lhang ba'i spyo/5 dpa' la dang g.yu lha mon gyi dmag sgar du brgyugs te/ mon gyi thog rgod skar chen sogs bsad rjes/ rngo/na rmi zla ba khrab btsan gson bzung gis gling sgar la khrid de/ gur sgo nu phur ba chen po zhig brdabs te khye bzhin btags pa'i spyo/6 mon gyi bla 'brong rwa bco brgyad kyi rtse ru pe bang ba tsam 'bar ba/lus 'jigs su rung ba zhig thon byung ba der dpa' la dang shan pa gnyisakyis rngam pa'i tshul gyis gri re re btab pas me stag khrom khrom du mgo bo thang la phrung zhing lus 'khor byum ltar gtubs pa'i skor/328

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/7 mon shingakhri rgyalapo'i dug mdung thang rtse g.yu'abrug gi brang stod du theb4te rma4skyon phog pasarta thog nasalhung zhing tshe lasa'adasapas/ gling dmag mang poskyo gdung drag posamanar ba'i tshul/8 'bru gasde cho4skyong ber nag gisazhwa nag gosanag gyon nasaphyag g.yayopasadar nag gi g.yabamobyed cing / g.yon pasaskyogasathag 'chang bzhin mon shing khri rgyalapo'i pho brang gtor bar cha4pa'i tshul/9 mon bza' khrimasashog rgyal modang srasamo metog lhamadzesaganyisal skrag 'jigasachen po byung ste/ gosathag 'domapa chig stong dgu brgya phyir bsnar na4ge sar rgyal po la mgo btagasalusa'abul byasapa'i skor ro/ /brgyad pa/ rdzong chen bco brgyad phab pa/ (1)1 ge sar rgyal posadagung lo re bdun bzhesapa'i skabasasu/ rgya gar chosardzong phab ste/ khong giyophyag tu cho4dmapa'i po ti grangasamang bsnamasanasagangasacan bod kyi ljongasasudrangasapa'i tshul/2 ge sar rgyalaposadagung lo bzhi bcu tham pa bzhesapa'i skabasasu/stag gzig nor rdzong gi bdag po stag gzig rgyal po dam la btagasashing /stag gzig yul gyi gser dngul ga༅byur gyi gter sgo phyesate 'dzam bu gling la ༷ṭ+wāṃ bsha' brgyab nasadabulaphyug thamasacad kyi 'dod blotshimasapar gyur pa' ṭ+wāṃsage/ sar rgyal posadagung lozhe gnyi4bzhesapa'i skabasasukhache'i khri btsan rgyal pocham la phab nasag༅drug dkar namamakha'i mdog gasdudhag

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus//yo /zhe /dri /po'i mju 117 na nga rgyal 'a dug mdung thang rtsa g.yu 'brug brang stod du thebs te rmas skyon phog pas rta thog nas lhung zhing tshe las 'das pas/ gling dmag mang po skyo gdung drag pos mnar ba'i spyo/8 'bru sga sde chos skyong bor nag gis zhwa nag gos nag khyon nas phyag g.yas pas dar nag gi g.yab mo byed cing / g.yon pas sgogs thag 'chang bzhin mon shing khri rgyal h+phu pho brang gtor bar chas pa'i rmya/9 mon bza' khrims shog rgyal po dang sras mo ske tog lha mdzes gnyisal skrag 'jigs ra po byung ste/ gos thag 'dom pa ka stong dgu brgya phyir bsnar nas ge sar rgyal po la mgo btags lus 'bul byas pa'i skor ro/ /brgyad pa/ rdzong chen bco brgyad phab pa/ (1)1 ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo re bdun bzhes pa'i skabs su/ rgya gar chos rdzong phab ste/ khong gis phyag tu chos dam pa'i po ti grangs mang bsna mas nas gangs can bod kyi ljongs su drangs pa'i rmya/2 ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo bzhi bcu tham/ pa bzhes pa'i skabs su/stag gzig nor rngong gi bdag po stag gzig rgyal po dam la btags shing /stag gzig ga gyi gser dngul g.yu byur gyi gter sgo phyes te 'dzam bu gling la bgo bsha' brgyab nas dbul phyug thams cad kyi 'dod tsho྾sa par gyur pa'i lo rgyus/3 ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo zhe gnyis bzhes pa'i skabs su kha tsho khri btsan rgyal po cham la phab nas g.yu drug dkar nam mkha'i mdog g.yu drug 329

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ser gser gyi mdog bca4gling dkar stod la drangasapa'i tshul/〈ge sar rgyalaposadagung lozhe gsumabazhesapa'i thog gangasari minub dar rdzong phab ste/ gosarigasasna tshogasakyi dar rdzong blangasate gangasacan bohā rdi/ ༵༵ ltaṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃng/ lo zhe bzhi bzhesapa'i skabasasu/ zhang zhung mu tigardzong phab cing / zhang zhung rgyal po lhun grub grags pa'i gce4nor mutig sna tshogasagangasacan yuladu 'dren pa'i tshul/6ge sar rgyalapo4dgung lozhe drug bzhesapa'i skabasasu/ agrag4gzi rdzong phab cing / agragasanyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi gtso nor gzi sna migacig khri tsho brgyad brgya thamasacad gling dkar yuladu drangasapa'i skor/1ge sar rgyalaposadagung lo zhe bdun bzhe4pa'i skabasasu/ gru gu rgyalapo thog rgod dmal btagasashing / gru gu rgyal po'i gnamamatha' go ba gshog ring dang / samatha' rbab rdo 'grosachen/ medamar glog gi 'phrul mda' bcasago mtshon grangasamang gling la drangasapa'i skor/8ge sar rgyalapo4dgung lo zhe dgu bzhe4pa'i skabasasu/ megling gser rdzong phab cing / gser gyi khrab rmog 'khor gsumadang gser gyi jo bo ra ma sogasagling ladrangasapa'i skor/bge sar rgyalapo4dgung longagacig bzhesapa'i skabasasu/ smug gu drelardzong phab nasadrelarigayomigacig brgya dang brgyad gangasacan bod du dra~Xte drelargyud spelaba'i lorgyusaso/ /

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ser gser gyi mdog bcas gling dkar stod la drangs pa'i tshal/4ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo zhe gsum bzhes pa'i thog gangs ri minub dar rdzong phab ste/ gos rigs sna tshogs kyi dar rdzong blangs te gangasacan bod la drangs pa'i skor/5 ge sar gyis dgung lo zhe bzhi bzhes pa'i skabs su/ zhang zhung mu tig rdzong phab cing / zhang zhung rgyal po lhun grub grags pa'i gces nor satig sna tshogs gangs can byed du 'dren pa'i tshad/6 ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo zhe drug bzhes pa'i skabs su/ sprigrags gzi rdzong phab byung / a grags nyi ma rgyal mtshan zhu gco nor gzi sna mi gcig khri tsho brgyad brgya thams cad gleng dkar yaX du drangs pa'i skor/7 ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo zhe bdun bzhes pa'i skabs su/ gru gu rgyal po thog rgod dam la btags shing / gru gu rgyal po'i gnam mtha' go ba gshog ring dang / sa mtha' rbab rdo 'gros chen/ chad mar glog gi 'phrul mda' bcas go mtshon grangs mang 1nga la drangs pa'i skor/8ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo zhe dgu bzhes pa'i skabs su/ tse gling gser rdzong phab cing / gser gyi khrab rmog 'khor gsum dang gser gyi jo bo ra ma sogs gling la drangs pa'i skor/9 ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo nga gcig bzhes pa'i skabs su/ srug gu drel rdzong phab nas drel rigs migacig brgya dang brgyad gangs can bod du drangs te drel rgyud stsel ba'i lo rgyus so/ /330

7la thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/dgu ba/ rjong chen bco brgyad phab pa/ (2)1 ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo nga gnyis bzhes pa'i skabs su/ me ri thog rdzong phab ste/ sog po rgyal po nyi ma lhun grub dmal btags shing thog gi stsogs rdo chig khri bdun stong dang / thog mda' tshe dmar rang 'jomasabazhi brgya lnga bcu sogs gling dkar stod la drangs pa'i skor/2 ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo nga gsum bzhes pa'i skabs su/ mnga' ris yul gyi gser rdzong phab nas gser gyi shākya thub pa rang byon gangs can yang du drangs shing / 'dzam bu gling la bde byad kyi nyi ma shar ba'i lo rgyus/3 ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo nga lnga bzhes pa'i skabs su/ gangs ri shel rdzong phab byung / rin chen chu shel me shel sogs dang shel gyi khrab rmog bzhi brgya lnga bcu dang bcas pa kha ba'i ljongs sa drangs pa'i skor/4 ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo nga drug bzhes pa'i skabs su/ lto nub yul gyi tsa ri sman rdzong phab ste/ nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman/ bzang drug bdud rtse'i sman/ lo brgya thub pa'i sman bcas gangs can bod du drangasapa'i skor/5 ge sar rgyal pos dgung long brgyad bzhes pa'i skabs su/ bye ru'i byur rdzong phab nas byu du'i che dpag med mgon dang byu ru'i rta mgrin dmar po sogs gangs can bod yul du drangs te byu ru rin po ches rgyan sprasapa'i srol chags pa'i lo rgyus/6 ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo re gcig bzhes pa'i skabs su/ rgya 331
