la thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/dgu ba/ rdzong chen bco brgyad phab pa/ (2)1ge sar rgyal posadagung long gnyisabazhesapa'i skabasasu/ meri thog rdzong phab ste/ sog po'i rgyalapo nyi ma lhun grub dmalabatagasashing thog gisbyogasardo chig khri bdun stong dang / thog mda' medamar rang 'jomasabazhi brgya lngabacu sogasagling dkar stod la drangasapa'i skor/2ge sar rgyal posadagung lo nga gsum bzhesapa'i skab4su/ mnga' risayulagyi gser rdzong phabanasagaser gyi shākya thub pa rang byon gangasacan yul du drangasashing / 'dzamabugling labade skyid kyi nyi mashar ba'i lorgyus/3ge sar rgyal posadagung lo nga lngabazhesapa'i skabasasu/ gangasari shel rdzong phab cing / rin chen chu shelameshel sog4dang shelagyi khrab rmog bzhi brgya lnga bcu dang bcayopa kha ba'i ljongasasudrangasapa'i skor/〈ge sar rgyal po4dgung lo nga drug bzhe4pa'i skabasasu/ lhonub yul gyi tsa ri sman rdzong phab ste/ nad brgya 'jom4pa'i sman/ bzang drug bsdodī rtsi'i sman/ lo brgya thub pa'i sman bcayogangasacan bod du drangasapa' /༵/ge sar rgyal posadagung long brgyad bzhesapa'i skabasasu/ bye ru'i byur rdzong phab nasabyu ru'i tshe dpag med mgon dang byu ru'i rta mgrin dmar po sogasagangasacan bod yuladu drangasate byu ru rin po chesargyan sprasapa'i srol chagasapa'i lorgyus/6ge sar rgyalaposadagung lore gcig bzhesapa'i skabasaswā/3rgya

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nag yud du phebs rngo te ja sgong phab nas rgya ja me tog yongs 'dzin dang / rgya ja bkra shis zla ba/ rgya ja khu byug stong ldan bcas gangs can yul du drangasapa'i skor/7ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo re bzhi bzhes pa'i skabs su/ dung dkar rgyal po stag thub btsan po pham par mdzad de dung dkar stag rdzong lasadung khrab nyi ma rang shar/ dung zhags khams gsum rang 'gug dung gi sgom ma rang byon sogs bod kha ba can gyi ljongs su drangs pa'i skor/8ge sar rgyal ngo/sa dgung lo re brgyad bzhes pa'i skabs su/ lhophyogs yul gyi bal bo'i 'bras rdzong phab ste/ 'bras dkar khyung gi sgo nga dang 'bras dmar mu tig gzugs brnyan sogs bod yul du drangs pa'i skor/9ge sar rgyal pos dgung lo re dgu bzhes pa'i skabs su/ ste ra'i yal gyi lug rdzong phab/ lha lug ga ba rwa ring dang / gnyan 'u ga dmar po'i tshos can/ klu lug khyung gi sgo nga / lug dkar nag khra gsum/ dbyar gyi me tog 'dra ba thams cad gangs can ljongs sa drangs pa'i lo rgyus so/ /bcu ba/ ming gi yang rtul dam pa'i mi bdun/1 de yang / gling seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul de/ mi srug po dung gi so sgo can/ yang srug byu ru'i sha ma dngas can/ dbu rmog dkar dar 'phru sha le/ rgyab khrab dkar bstag 'tshubs se/ g.yas stag ral gnam du 'phyo 'dra/ g.yon gzig shubs sal 'tshal 'dra/ rta rkyang dmar ma/tshal gyi thig le can/ gser sga nyi ma rang shar/ bu dpa' bo jag la chas 'dra zhig tu 332

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nag yuladu phebab/te ja rdzong phab nasargya ja me tog yongasa'adzin dang / rgya ja ༷ṭ+wāṃ shisazla ba/ rgya ja khubyug stong ldan bcasagangasacan yul du drangasapa' mat+ta/ ge sar rgyal posadagung lore bzhi bzhesapa'i skabasasu/ dung dkar rgyal po stag thub btsan po pham par mdzad de dung dkar stag rdzong lasadung khrab nyi ma rang shar/ dung zhagasakhams gsum rang 'gug dung gi sgrolam rang byon sogasabod khab can gyi ljongasasudrangasapa'i skor/8 ge sar rgyal ngo/sadagung lore brgyad bzhesapa'i skabs su/ ltophyogasayul gyi bal bo'i 'brasardzong phab ste/ 'brasadakar khyung gi sgo nga dang 'brasadamar mutig gzugasabarnyan sogasabod yuladu drangasapa'i skor/9 gi sar rgyal posadagung lo re dgu bzhesapa'i skabasasu/ ste ra'i yul gyi lug rdzong phab/ lhaphug ga ba rwa ring dang / gnyan lug dmar po'i tshosacan/ klu lug khyung gi sgo nga / lug dkar nag khra gsum dbyar gyi me tog 'dra ba thamasacad gangasacan ljongasasudrangasapa'i lo rgyu4so/ /bcu ba/ gling gi yang rtul dam pa'i mi bdun/1 de yang / gling seng chen nor bu dgra 'dulade/ mi smug podung gi sosgo can/ yang smug byu ru'i sha ma dngasacan/ dbu rmog dkar dar 'phrusha le/ rgyab khrab dkar mestag 'tshub4se/ g.yasastag ral gnam du 'phyo 'dra/ g.yon gzig shubasasal 'dzul 'dra/ rta rkyang dmar mtshal gyi thig le ༵nā/ gser sga nyi marang shar/ budapa' bo jag la chasa'adra zhigatu

zhal thang chen mo las glingasgrubaskoragyirimo'inangadon mdor bsdus/ra pa~X tshu/pa/ 'a mi'agyur rgya tsha zhal dkar gyisa'akhor gsum sked labatagasate rta rgya bya'i gong du bud nas/ gri rno chod 5zi skar phran de dgung la phyar nasamadun du mchong bzhin pa'i tshul/3 dpa' 5med seng stag adom de nyid rta stong ri dar dkar gyi steng du zhonanasarmog dkar gyi 'dabar phab/ khrab dkar po'i rgyun thag bsdamasate/ go bkrag 'ja' tshon 'khyila'adra zhig tu 'dug pa'i tshul/4 tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra nyid rta 'do ba dngosagrub ldem par bcibs te/ dung gzhu dkar po rang 'khyil zhesapa'i steng du mda' mi 'gyur gnam lcagasathog mda' sprad de 'dug pa'i tshul/5 'bru sga sde chosaskyong ber nag gisadabu lazhwa nag gyon pa dang lu4la rasanag gi ber lwa mnabasashing / brang dkyil du gser gyi me long zhig btags nasaphyag g.ya4pasaspyogasardo'i sgrog thag gi sne la'achang / g.yon pasadar nag g.yabamobyed pa'i tshul/6 khro thung gi bu gnyi4pa stag rong anu gzig 'phen gyisasosma khrig khrig byed cing / dpung ba phur/ spyan dmar glog dmar 'khyug 'khyug gi ༵༵ ral gri phyar nasame lce mched pa ltar dgra sde'i nang du mchong bzhin pa'i ༄ 7 dar 'phen dug gi sdong bo de rta 'do ba smug po lding shesakyi steng du zhon nas/ mdung nag zhagasapa 'dra ba ladar dmar gyi bdan zudi kāsnam

zhal bang chen mo las bskor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/yod pa'i tshi/2 dpa' mi 'gyur rgya tsha zhal dkar gyis 'khor gsum sked la btags te rta rgya bya'i gong du bud nas/ gri rno ra mi zi skar phran de dgung la phyar nas mdun du ma྾ bzhin pa'i rmya/3 dpa' na med seng stag gdom de nyid rta stong ri dar dkar gyi steng du zhon nas rmog dkar gyi 'dab ra phab/ khrab dkar po'i rgyun thag bsdams te/ go bkrag 'ja' ra 'a a 'dra zhig tu 'dug pa'i rmya/4 tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra nyid rta 'do ba dngos grub ldem par bcibs te/ dung gzhu dkar po rang 'phro zhes pa'i steng du mda' mi 'gyur gnam lcags thog mda' sprad de 'dug pa'i spyo/5 'bru sga sde chos skyong ber nag gis dbu la zhwa nag phyon pa dang lusal ras nag gi ber lwa mnabs shing / brang dkyil du gser gyi me long zhig btags nas phyag g.yas pas sgogs rdo'i sgog thag gi sgo la 'chang / g.yon pas dar nag g.yab mo byed pa'i spyo/6 khro thung gi bu gnyis pa stag rong spri nu gzig 'phen gyis so sgra khrig khyeg byed cing / dpung ba phur/ spyan dmar glog dmar 'khyug 'khrug gi ngang ral gri phyar nas me lce mched pa ltar dgra sde'i nang du mchong bzhin pa'i spyo/7 dar 'phen dug gi sdong bo de rta 'do ba smrag po lding shes kyi steng du zhon nas/ mdung nag zhags pa 'dra ba la dar dmar gyi bdan zur gsum 333

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhig btags te dgra dar 'tshubs sem chu kham pa rab ped de sgo dras pa ltar phar bcad de hor sgar gyi nang du rgyug bzhin pa'i tshi/8 dpa' mi 'gyur nya tsha a brtan de 'do ba gangs ri lding shesalazhon nas/ khrab rmog rdo rje go khrab zer ba mnabs te lag tu khra mdung nyimarang shar bcangasashing / dpa' bo'i shugs yongs su rdzogs pas rta khabasgags nas 'dug pa'i tshul lo/ /ba byu gcig pa/ khyung gi sman mchog brgyad/1 gling rje ge sar rgyal po mchog mkhar mi 'gyur seng 'brug stag rtse pho brang gi nang du bzhugs 'dug par seng lcam 'brug yo nyid kyis gus shing brtse ba'i ngang nas lag zung gis ja 'dren pa'i tshi/2 klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen gyi sras yodang skyes ma/chog ge sar rgyal po'i ma yum 'gog bza' lha mo nyid kyis lus la rin chen rgyan chas ma sprasapar brtse ba'i byams sems shin tu ldan pa'i ngang nas dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshul/3 gling gi khra glag spyang gsum gyi mi rgyal rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi ma yum rgya bza' lha dkar gyis lus la rgyan cha mang po btags med kyang ma/chor sgeg gi nyams ldan zhing / phrag dog gis bzhin mdangs nag por 'dug pa'i tshul/4 gling gi rong tsha dmar leb kyi ma yum rong bza' shel sgon gyisayangs shing rgya che ba'i sa thang gi dkyil dbus sa bzhur ba'i rwangs shing gtsang ba'i chu phran gyi 'gram du dbu ga 'khrud bzhin pa'i spyo/334

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhig btagasate dgra dar 'tshubasasirma chu khamapa rab med de sgro drasapa ltar phar bcad de hor sgar gyi nang du rgyug bzhin pa'i tshul/8 dpa' mi'agyur nya tsha abartanade 'do ba gang4ri lding shesalazhonanas/ khrab rmog rdo rje go khrab zer ba mnab4te lag tu khra mdung nyimarang shar bcangasashing / dpa' bo'i shugasayongasasurdzogasapasarta khabasgagasanasa'adug pa'i tshul lo/ /bcu gcig pa/ gling gi sman mchog brgyad/1 gling rje ge sar rgyal po mchog mkhar mi'agyur seng 'brug stag rtse pho brang gi nang du bzhug4'dug par seng lcama'abrug monyid kyisagu4shing brtse ba'i ngang nasalag zung gi4ja 'dren pa'i tshul/2 klu rgyalagatsug na rin chen gyi sra4podang skyesamachog ge sar rgyal po'i mayuma'agog bza' ltamo nyid kyisalusal rin chen rgyan chasamasprasapar brtse ba'i byamasasemasashin tu ldan pa'i ngang nasadakon mchog gsum lagasolaba'adebasapa'i tshul/3 gling gi khra glag spyang gsumagyi 5gyalargya tsha zhaladakar gyi ma yum rgya bza' lhadakar gyisalusal rgyan cha mang thobatagasamed kyang mchor sgeg gi nyamasaldan zhing / phrag dog gisabazhin mdangasanag por 'dug pa'i tshul/4 gling gi rong tsha dmar leb kyi mayum rong bza' shel sgron gyi4yangasashing rgya che ba'i cabang gi dkyil dbusasubazhur ba'i dwangasashing gtsang bdī nā phran gyi 'gramadu dbu sku'akhrud bzhin pa'i tshul/

zhal thang chen mo lasagling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/5 gling seng lcama'abrug mo de rgyab skra rgyan ga༅byur gyi phreng 'grig pa/mdun kha dog sna lnga'i rgyan cha yod pa/ yar langasan rgya dar phyar 'dra/mar bdi da na gur khang phub 'dra/ lha'i bu mosagazhir babasapa zhig dang 'ju sduX phyag g.yasapasagaser skyogasabazung nasang phud dgung lamachod pa' dudu/ gling gi mebaza' 'bum skyid kyi4lusal ga༅byur gyi rgyan cha cung tsasdu ༷sdu sprasate/ sbra gur gyi mdun du phyag la thagasashing bzung nasa'adug pa' dug/ gling gi dpa' rtul rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi chung ma'am lha srasadagra lhartse rgyalagyi ma yum rag bza' dge 'tshosalusalargyan chasamasprasapar rang gi bu phrug srasadagra lhartse rgyalaskyong bzhin pa'i tshul/8 gling gi ne'u chung sgron nesalusalabud med ngalartsol paphal ba'i gyo1 chaṭ+wāgyon hūṃtsha/ lalag tu 'ur cha bzung nasalug khyu dkar nag khra gsum 'a ba~Xn ༵/ tweshing/ yid du 'ong ba/ lasalabartson zhing snying rje ldan pa'i mardongasasdu/zaX spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan gyi srasayogayusgron gyisagro ma rko ba na ༵༵ de nyiX/ pa// dmyal gling man pa rang gsal/1 4ge sar rgyal po mchog dmyaladro'i yuladu phebasate/ astag lhapogatso byasapa'i shi bo dung phyur mang po tsha dmyalabargyad dang grang dmya'adidiṭ+wāṃd/

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/5 gling seng lcam 'khrug mo de rgyab skra rgyan g.yu byur gyi phreng 'grig pa/mdun kha dog sna lnga'i rgyan cha yod pa/ yar langs na rgya dar phyar 'dra/mar bas da na gur khang phub 'dra/ lha'i bu mo sa gzhir babs pa zhig dang 'dra bar phyag g.yas pas gser skyogs bzung nas ja phud dgung la mchod pa'i spyo/6 gling gi me bza' 'bum skyid kyis lus la g.yu byur zu rgyan cha cung tsam zhig spras te/ sru gur gyi ma/dun du phyag la thags shing bzung nas 'dug pa'i spyo/7 gling gi dpa' rtul rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi chung ma'am lha sras dgra lhartse rgyal gyi ma yum rag bza' dge 'tshos lus la rgyan chas ma spras par rang gi bu phrug sra/sa dgra lha rtse rgyal skyong bzhin pa'i tshul/8 gling gi rme'u chung sgon des lus la 4da med ngal rtsol pa phal ba'i gyon chas gyon te/ lag tu 'ur cha bzung nas lug khyu dkar nag khra gsum 'tsho bzhin pa'i tshul/9 mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ las la brtson zhing snying rje ldan pa'i ma dzangs ma// gling spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan gyi sras mo g.yu sgon gyis gro ma rko bzhin pa'i tshul lo/ /bcu gnyis pa/ dmyal gling mun parang gsal/1 ge sar rgyal po mchog dmyal ba'i yul/du phebs te/ a stag lha mo gco byas pa'i shi bo dung phyur mang po tsha dmyal brgyad dang grang dmyal brgyad/335

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nyi tshe nye 'khor bsdoms pas bco brgyad dang / ngan song gsum gyi dong nasadag pa'i zhing du drangs pa'i skor/2 de yang yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal pos rgya nag po'i yul khamasathams cad chos la 'god par 'gro khar/ ma spristag lha mo la da res khyodala'achi ba mi rtag zer ba de thog la babs yod pas/ nam 'chi la nges pa med/sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod bshags dang phyin chad srog la babs kyang mibyed pa'i dam bca' drag po gyis la sdod gsung ba'i skor/3 gling rje ge sar rgyal po rgya nag yul du phebs rjes/ ma/ 'khyangasapar dpa' mo/ a stag lha mor 'chi ba'i nad chen zebs te na tsha bzod glagasamed par gyur nas/ sku rim dang rim gro ci bsgrubs kyang bzlog ma nus par shi ba'i lo rgyus/4 de nas las mkhan seng ge rab brtan gyis a stag lha mo'i la ga mgo nas bzung ste khrid/ sprib glang ma go can gyis rgyab nas ded/ dar ma sprelamago can gyis g.yas nas bzung / ra skyes phag mgo can gyis g.yon nasabazung / zhe sdang stag mgo can gyis lam sna 'dren pa'i tshul/5 gshin rje chos kyi rgyal pos a stag lha mo khrid yo nga ba na las kyi r+shalong la bltas/ gshin rje'i rgya mar tshad/ khrims yig lus la bskor/ lusangag yid gsum gyi sgo nas mi dge ba bcu'i las byas tshad thams cad gas bor shar te/ sdeg pa che ba byol thabs med pas ma a stag lha mo dmyal ba'i khams sa lhang ba'i lo rgyus/336

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshering gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nyi tshe nye 'khor bsdomasapasabaco brgyad dang / ngan song gsum gyi donganasadag pa~X zhirdo ༵ ngh+ru sdu/ ༷zlosdi di/bang gi rgyal po4rgya nag ༅ tsikhamasathamasacad chosal 'god par 'gro khar/ ma astag lhamo la da resakhyodala'achi ba mirtag zer ba de thog la babasayod pas/ nam 'chi la ngesapa med/sngar byasakyi sdig pa la 'gyod bshagayodang phyin chad srog lababasakyang mibyed pa'i dmabaca' drag po gyisal sdod gsung ba'i skor/3 gling rje ge sar rgyal po rgya nag yul du phebasarjes/ ma'agyangasapar dpa' mo.astag lhamor 'chi ba'i nad chen thebasate na tsha bzod glagasaṭ+wāṃd sdu~X gyur nas/ sku rimadang rimagro ci bsgrubayokyang bzlog mnasapar ba' 4 /sna na/ salasamakhan seng ge rab brtan gyisa.astag lhamo'i lag mgo nasabazung ste khrid/ ab glang mgo can gyisargyab nasaded/ dar ma sprelamago can gyisagayasanasabazung / ra skyesaphag mgo can gyisagayon nasabazung / zhe sdang stag mgo can gyisalam sna 'dren pa'i tshul/5 gshin rje chosakyi rgyalaposa.astag lhamokhrid yong ba na lasakyi melong labaltas/ gshin rje'i rgya mar tshad/ khrimasayig lusal bskor/ lusangag yid gsumagyi sgo nasamidage babacu'i lasabyasatshad thamasacad gsalabor shar te/ sdig pa che ba byolathabasamed pasam astag lhamo dmyalaba'i kha~Xsalhung ba'i lo rgyus/

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/6 yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po khong gisabaka' srung me stag mched mched/ chosaskyong ser ba 'baba'abab/ cho4rgyalabasha' lug 'dar 'dar/ lasamakhan ra khyu 'ded 'ded mdzad de stong nyid snying rje chen po'i ngang na4ki lan gsum btab pas/ bzhengasam myong ba'i chosargyalakhri thog nasabazhengs/ brosamamyong ba'i la4mkhan phyogs bzhir brosapa'i lo rgyus/7 na sar rgyal pomachog gisa.astag lhamo'i lusangag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa tham4cad dag pa'i slad du gser dngul lasagrub pa'i mchod rten stong rtsa gcig bzheng4na4smon lamargya chen po 'deb4pa'i tshul/8 astag lhamodang bca4pa mtho risathemaskasa'og mar slebasapa'i tshe na yar bltasapas/ dag pa'i thar lam dkar po ru 'brong g.yag khri 'bum gyisarwa rtse brdar/ rnga gzengasabyasate ngur sgra 'brug ltar sgrog khasna nasakha rlang4na bun bzhin 'thib4te lam bcad cing / khyod astag lhayogason 'jig rten na yod dusang tshor sdug bsngalabatang ba odran zhesa'ajigayobabastan pa'i lo rgyus/) astag lhamo gtso byasapa'i shi bo dung phyur bco brgyad de nub phyogasabade ba can du drangasapasadaga' zhing sproba'i ngang na4ge sar rin po che la bka' drin che zhu ba'i gusaphyag 'bul bzhin pa'i tshul lo/ /bcu gsum pa/ khams gsum bde bkod/1 'dzamagling seng chen rgyal po nyid seng 'brug stag rtse pho brang du/gser khri lasayar bzhengasate gling gi gser khri dang rgyal sabaka' shokū ༵ma

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/6 yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po khong gis bka' srung be+e stag mched mched/ chos skyong ser ba 'bab 'bab/ chos rgyal bsha' lug 'dar 'dar/ las mkhan ra khyu 'ded 'ded mdzad de stong nyid snying rje chen po'i ngang nas ki la na gsum btab pas/ bzhengs ma myong ba'i chos rgyal khri thog nas bzhengs/ bros ma myong ba'i las mkhan phyogs bzhir bros pa'i lo rgyus/7 ge sar rgyal po mchog gis spristag lha mo 'i lusang ga yid gsum zu sgrib pa thams cad dag pa'i slad du gser dngul las grub pa'i mchod rten stong rtsa gcig bzhengs nas smon lam rgya chen po 'debs pa'i tshul/8 spristag lha mo dang bcas pa mtho ris them/ skas 'og mar slebs pa'i che na yar bltas pas/ dag pa'i thar lam dkar po ru 'brong g.yag khri 'bum/ gyis rwa rtse brdar/ rnga gzengs byas te ngur sgra 'brug ltar sgog kha sna nas kha rlangs na bun bzhin 'thibs te lam bcad cing / khyod spristag lha mo gson 'jig rten na yo da dusang tshor sdug bsnga la btang ba cha dran zhesa'ajigs pa bstan pa'i lo rgyus/9 spristag lha mo gtso byas pa'i shi bo dung phyur bco brgyad de nub phyogs bde ba can du drangs pas dga' zhing spro ba'i ngang nas ge sar rin po che la bka' drin che zhu ba'i gus phyag 'bul bzhin pa'i tshul lo/ /bcu gsum pa/ khams gsum bde bkod/1 'dzam gling seng chen rgyal po nyid seng 'brug stag rtse pho brang du/gser khro las yar bzhengs te gleng gi gser khye dang rgyal sa bka' shog tham 337

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ka sog4rgya tsha zhaladakar gyi bu dgralhartse rgyalalasprod bzhin pa'i tshul/2 gling ge sar rgyalapo4phyogasabazhi'i dgra bzhi btul zhing rdzobachenabaco brgyad dang rdzong phrananyer gcig phabastodagung lorgya gcig bzhesapa'i skabasastong gsumabade labakod nasazhing gzhan laphebasakhar gling lhasde/sdusalagling dkar stod kyi rjesaphyogasakyi lasadon skor gsung bzhin pa'i ༄ 3 gling dkar lhasdernamasakyisage sar mchog zhing gzhan du phebasapa'i dusasubabasangashesanas/ sdug bsngalagyisamanar te gling seng chen laphyag dang skor ba byed bzhin pa'i tshul/4 gling gi nor bu'abrug rgyalagyisablamanor bu chosa'aphel lagling gi lhanyen chosagasumaphulate/ khyed kyisagling gi saphyogayothamasacad cho4labasgyur rgyu yid la zungasagasung ba'i skor/5 lharta rkyang rgod g.yer bdesasku seng chen zhing gzhan la phebasabazhin pa mkhyen nas/ rta khyu tshogasapa'i dkyilanasarta rnamasakyi rjesaphyogasakyi lasadon thamasacad gsungasatshar rjesarta khyu mang po'i mtha' ru g.ya4skor zhig brgyab mthag tulhayulala'aphur song ba'i lorgyus/6 lhamada' thog rgod 'bar bde yar bzhengasate gling gi mda' monāṭ+wāṃ~X ṭ+wāṃ blangasarjesagayon skor zhig brgyab mthag lhayul du 'phur song 3387 ralagri rdulagacod spu gri yar bzhengasanasamatshon cha rnamasal glu

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ka sogs rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi bu dgra lha rtse rgyal la sprod bzhin pa'i tshad/2 gling ge sar rgyal pos phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi btul zhing rdzong don bco brgyad dang rdzong phran nyer gcig phab ste dgung lo rgya gcig bzhes pa'i skabs stong gsum bde la bkod nas zhing gzhan la phebs khar gling lha sde rnams la gling dkar stod kyi rjes phyogs kyi las don skor gsung bzhin pa'i rmya/3gling dkar lha sde rnams kyis ge sar mchog zhing gzhan du phebasapa'i dus sa babs pa shes nas/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar te gling seng don laphyag dang skor ba byed bzhin pa'i tshad/4gling gi nor bu 'brug rgyal gyis bla mnor bu chos 'pheng la 1nga gi lha rten chos gsum phul te/ khyed kyis gling gi sa phyogs thams cad chosalabasgyur rgyu yid la zungs gsung ba'i skor/5lha rta rkyang rgod g.yer bdes sku seng chen zhing gzhan la phebasabazhin pa mkhyen nas/ rta khyu tshogs pa'i dkyil nas rta rnams kyi rjes phyogasakyi las don thams cad gsungs tshar rjes rta khyu mang byed mtha' ru g.yas skor zhig brgyab ma thag tu lha yul tha' phur song ba'i lo rgyus/6lha mda' thog rgod 'bar ba de yar bzhengs te gleng gi mda' yornams la glu blangs rjes g.yon skor zhig brgyab mthag lha yul du 'phur song ba'i lo rgyus/7ral gri rdul gcod sru gre yar bzhengs nas mtshon cha rnams la glu 338

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/blangs pa dang mnyam du glog dmar 'kholer mtshon cha mang pol g.yas skor zhig brgyab nas lhag du 'phur ba'i lo rgyus/8 ma 'brug yodang mgar bza' chos sgo na gnyis ma seng chen gyi g.yas g.yon du bzhugs te/ na chung bu yo rnams la 'tshams 'dri byas nasasprin dkar nag gnyis byu mtshams su slebs pa'i tshul/9 lha chen tshangs pa dkar pos gtso mdzad pa'i lha phrug khye ma 'bumadang / gnam a rna gong sman rgyal mos gtso mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro bye ba bdun gyis mdun bsus te/ sbu lus rin r+ṣa na mngon pa'i dbyingasastothim pa na/ bar snang nas mo tog u dum wa ra dang lha'i tshe tog gags kyi char babs nas ltas bzang po byung ba'i lo rgyus bcas so/ /

zhal thang chen mo las gling sgrung skor gyi ri mo'i nang don mdor bsdus/blangasapa dang mnyamadu glogadamar 'khyilaler mtshonacha mang polagayasaskor zhig brgyab nasalhayuladu 'phur ba'i lorgyus/8 ma 'brug modang mgar bza' cho4sgronaganyisasku seng chen gyi g.yayogayon du bzhugasate/ na chung bu pornamasala'atshamasa'adri byasanasasprin dkar nag gnyisakyi mtshamasasaslebasapa'i tshul/9 lhachen tshangasapadakar posagatso mdzad pa'i lhaphrug khri ma'abumadang / gnam arna gong smanargyalamo4gtso mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro bye ba bdun gyi4mdunabasusate/ sku lusarin chen mimangon pa'i dbyingasasuthim pa na/ bar snang nasametoga.udumawar dngalha'i mitog snachogasakyi char babasanasalta4bzang pobyungaba'i lorgyusabaca4so/ /

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/a mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/de yang chab 'gag gser gzhong ring mo zhes pa ni mtsho sngon zhing chen ma/tsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi mnga' khongs sa gtogs shing / yurkader 'dus sdod bgyid pa'i bod rigs ni gna' snga mo nas yod pa'i gdod ma'i mi rigs shig yin zhing / dus yun ring ba'i spyo tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du khong rnams kyis rang gi rtsol ba dang blo rig la brten nas rang byung khamasadang 'thab rtsod byas te bcos sgyur bgyid pa'i lag len nang du dngos po'i 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa gsar skrun gnang ba dang chabs cig gson shugs ldan pa'i phul byung rtsom rig sgyu rtsal yang gang mang zhig gsar du bskrun yod/ dmangs khrod rtsom rig la mtshon na thog mar ngal rtsol khrod du byung bdang / rim gyis spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur dang bstun nas ji rgyas dang ji legs sa song ba red/ der mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba dang 'dod blo/ dga' skyo chag4sda nga sogs mtshon yod la/ bgrang bya brgya phrag du ma'i ring gi 'tsho ba'i nyams myong dang spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rim yang mtshon pa las gzhan/ lo 340

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/a mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/de yang chab 'gag gser gzhong ring yozhesapa ni mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho lhobod rig4rang skyong khulagyi mnga' khongasasugatogasashing / yulader 'dusasdod bgyid pa'i bod rigasani gna' snga mo nasayod pa'i gdodama'i mi rigasashig yin zhing / dusayun ring ba'i spyi tshogasakyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du khong rnamasakyisarang gi rtsolab dang blo rig la brten nasarang byung khamasadang 'thab rtsod byasate bcosasgyur bgyid pa'i lag len nang du dngosapo'i 'byor ba phun sum tshogasapa gsar skrun gnang ba dang chabasacig gson shugasaldan pa'i phul byung rtsom rig sgyu rtsal yang gang mang zhig gsar du bskrunayod/ dmangasakhrod rtsom rig lamatshon na thog mar ngal rtsol khrod du byung ba dang / rimagyisaspyi tshogasakyi 'pho 'gyur dang bstun nasaje rgyasadang je leg4gsong ba red/ der midamang4kyi 'tsho ba dang 'dod blo/ dga' skyo chagasasdang sog4mtshon yod la/ bgrang bya brgya phrag du ma'i ring gi 'tsho bdī ༵༵samyong dang spyi tshogasakyi 'phel rimayang mtshon pa lasagazhan/ lo

a mdo chab 'gag yul dud ra ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/rgyus kyi dar rgyad kyang mtshon yod pas/ dmangs khrod rtsom rig ni mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi blo gros kyi rtsal las thon pa'i khyad 'phags can gyi rtsom rig gi gras shig yin pa gdon mi za'o/ /de yang chab 'gag yul la dar khyab tu song ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la cha mtshon na/ rtsom rig gi rigs ma nga po yod pa de yang skor zhig sa de ga'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs thun mong gis gsar rtsom bgyis pa dang /skor zhig gzhan shis nas khyab yong ba yin/ yang skor zhig la yon tan pasalegs sgrig kyang gnang myong ba red/ gsham du chab 'gag yul du dar rgya che ba dang ga chos thun min yod pa'i rtsom rig ste/ gnyen bshad dang chang bshad skor dang / rgan po'i bslab bya'i skor/ rogs 'jen gyi skor/ glu dang shags 'a/ gzhas kyi skor/ 'bras dkar gyi skor/ gling ge sar sgrung gi skor bcas pa dmigs sa bkar nas dpyad gtam rags tsam brjod pa lags/dang po/ gnyen bshad dang ston bshad chang bshad kyi skor/de yang mi rigs gang dang gang zhig yin rung tshang mar mi rigs rang gi khyad chos ltar gnyen ston gyi mdzad sgo rgya cher spel ba'i srol chags yod/khyad par du mdo smad bod kyi gnyen ston gyi mdzad sgo'i thog glu len gar ste byed pa spyi dang bdag zhang tshan dang sku mgron rnams kyis lag bsam zol med kyis phan tshun la 'grul bkur dang gnyen bshad ston bshad chang bshad ska rags bshad pa bcas kyi cho ga gzab rgyas sumadzad srol yod pa ni gzhan 341

a mdochab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/rgyuyokyi dar rgud kyang mtshon yod pas/ dmangasakhrod rtsom rig ni mi dmangasamang tshogasakyi blo grosakyi rtsalalasathon pa'i khyad 'phagasacan gyi rtsom rig gi grasashig yin pa gdon mi za'o/ /de yang chab 'gag yulaladar khyabatu song ba'i dmangasakhrod rtsom rig skor la cha mtshon na/ rtsom rig gi rig4mang po yod pa de yang skor zhig 4de ga'i ngal rtsol midamangasathun mong giyogasar rtsom bgyi4pa dang /skor zhig gzhan yul nasakhyab yong ba yin/ yang skor zhig la yon tan pasalegasasgrig kyang gnang myong b.red/ gshamadu chab 'gag yul du dar rgya che ba dang khyad choyothun min yod pa'i rtsomarig ste/ gnyen bshad dang chang bshad skor dang / rgan po'i bslab bya'i skor/ rogasa'athen gyi skor/ glu dang shagasal gzhayokyi skor/ 'brasadakar gyi skor/ gling ge sar sgrung gi skor bcasapa dmigasasubakar na4dpyad gtam ragasatsam brjod pa lags/dang po/ gnyen bshad dang ston bshad chang bshad kyi skor/de yang mirig4gang dang gang zhig yin rung tshang mar mi rig4rang gi khyad chos ltar gnyen ston gyi mdzad sgo rgya cher spel ba'i srol chags yod/khyad par du mdo smad bod kyi gnyen ston gyi mdzad sgo'i thog glu len gar rtse byed paspyi dang bdag zhang tshan dang sku mgron rnamasakyisalhag bsam zolamed kyisaphan tshun la 'grul bkur dang gnyen bshad ston bshad chang bshad ska ragasabashad pa bca4kyi cho ga gzab rgyasasumadzad srolayod pa ni 3kāXn

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang thun mong ma yin pa'i srol bzang zhig yin/rang re'i a mdo'i chab 'gag yul gyi gnyen srol dang bshad pa rnamagasum gyi skor thams cad kyang phal cher mdo smad yul gyi rong 'brog sa khul gyi 'gro lugs bshad lugs dang mthun pa yin/ yul der dar rgya che ba'i gnyen bshad kyi lugs srol la mtshon na/ thog mar kha bde lce bde can gyi pho gsar zhig gis lag tu chang dkar dang kha btags bzung nas yul lhagazhi bdag la mchod kha 'phen pa dang / de'i 'phror gnyen gyi dar lugs/gtam gyi sgo mo rnam gsum// gtam gyi 'dus pa rnam gsum/ a khu dpon gyi skyes rabs/ a khu tshang gi skyes rgyud/ gnyen tshang gi skyes rabs/ bag ma dang mag par bstod pa/ ska rags la bstod pa bcas rim bzhin bshad pa'i srol yod/ gnyen bshad kyi zhu tshig re re'i nang rjod byed tshigs bcad du bstar zhing / bton na khar bde la nyan na rna bar snya na pas/ rgan gzhon kun gyi sems kyi skyo sdug gi snang ba ci yang rang pal du 'gro zhing dga' ba dang spro ba'i snang ba rgya cher skyed thub pa'i nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thon 'dug dper na/ gnyen bshad gser gyi 'khor lo las/ dang po lha klu gnyis ka gnyen dar zig / lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyi bu mo/ / klu'i rgyalapo gtsug na rin chen la mna' ma byin zig / bar ba rje btsun 'jam dbyangs byas zig / snga dpon pad ma 'byung gnas byas zig / phyi dpon phyag na rdo rje byas zig / lha rta dkar po bag rta byas zig / ri mo can gyi gos gon zig / dar tshon sna lnga'i ska rags bcings zig / rin chen sna 342

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang thun mong ma yin pa'i srolabazang zhig yin/rang re'i amado'i chaba'agag yulagyi gnyen srol dang bshad pa rnamagasum gyi skor thamasacad kyang phal cher mdo smad yul gyi rong 'brog sakhulagyi 'gro lugasabashad lugasadang mthun pa yin/ yul der dar rgya che ba'i gnyen bshad kyi lugasagrogagal mtshon na/ thog mar kha bde lce bde can gyi pho gsar zhig gisalag tu chang dkar dang kha btagasabazung nas yul lhagazhi bdag la mchod kha 'phen pa dang / de'i 'phror gnyen gyi dar lugs/gtam gyi sgo mo rnam gsum/ gtamagyi 'dusapa rnamagasum/ akhudapon gyi skye4rabs/ akhu tshang gi skyesargyud/ gnyen tshang gi skyesarabs/ bag mdang mag par bstod pa/ ska ragasal bstod pa bcasarimabazhin bshad pa'isrol yod/ gnyen bshad kyi zhu tshig re re'i nang rjod byed tshigasabacad du bstar zhing / bton na khar bde la nyan na rna bar snyan pas/ rgan gzhon kun gyi semasakyi skyo sdug gi snang ba ci yang rang yal du 'gro zhing dga' ba dang thoba'i snang ba rgya cher skyed thubapa'i nu4pa bsamagyi4mikhyab pa thona'adug dper na/ gnyen bshad gser gyi 'khor lolas/ dang po lhaklu gnyisaka gnyen dar zig / lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyi bu mo/ / klu'i rgyalapo gtsug na rin chen la mna' mabyin zig / bar ba rje btsun 'jamadabyangasabyasazig / snga dpon pad ma'abyung gan4byasazig / phyi dpon phyag na rdo rje byasazig / lharta dkar po bag rta byasazig / ri mo can gyi goswā~Xn zig / dar tshon sna lnga'i ska ragasabacingagazig / rin chen sna

a mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangasakhrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/lnga'i rgyan cha btagasazig / yid bzhin nor bu'i rdzong ba byasazig / lhatshangasapa dkar po mgron 'go byasazig / lharigasadri ma med pa mgron la chayozig / steng lha'og gnyisakyisaston mobyasazig / zhesapadang / de nasaganam saganyi4laganyen dar zig / lha'adzin gnam lhadakar po'i bu mo/ / 4'dzin legasapa chen mo lamana' mabyin zig / lhaphug mon chen 'od zer mag pa byasazig / bar ba tsosprin smug po bya4zig / snga dpon nyis ser po byasazig / phyi dpon zla ba dkar pobyasazig / skyi bser rlung ni bag rta byasazig / smin drug khra mo bag rog4byasazig / 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i go4gon zig / rin chen sna lnga'i phrabakod zig / dmacan rdo rje leg4pa mgron 'go byasazig / sprulapa lhasrin sde brgyad mgron la chasazig / gnam saganyisaka'i ston mobyasazig / zhesapa ltabu'i tshig don nyamasagasum ldan pa'i gnyen bshad rim pa mang po yod do/ /ston bshad la mtshon na'ang gnyen bshad chang bshad dang phalacher gcig mtshungasayin mod/ 'on te mimatshungasasangang yod de/ de yang ston bshad ni ston mo'i gzhi rgya che chung dang gralagyi rgan dar gzhon gsum/ ma sru che rgan chung gsum/ ston mo'i sder kha'i che chung / sku mgron tsho'i shomagyi bzang ngan sogasal bstod pa bgyid pa gtso bor brjod pa zhig go / dper na/ ston bshad gser gyi me tog lasatshan pa zhig bkod na 'di ltaste/gnam la blta4na skar mabazang gi / sal bltasan dusatshod bzang gi/'di lto'adzam bu gling gi lteb/ / bod kha ba can gyi sacha/ / sachab 3༵kyāg

2mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/lnga'i rgyan cha btags zig / yid bzhin nor bu'i rdzong ba byas zig / lhatshangs pa dkar po mgron 'go byas zig / lha rigs dri ma sked pa mgron la gyis zig / steng lha'og gnyis kyis ston mo byas zig / zhes pa dang / de nas gnam sa gnyis la gnyen dar zig / lha 'dzin gnam lha dkar po'i bu mo/ / sa 'dzin legs pa chen mo la mna' ma byin zig / lha phrug mon chen 'od zer mag pa byas zig / bar ba lho sprin smrag po byas zig / snga dpon nyim ser po byas zig / phyi dpon zla ba dkar po byas zig / byu bser rlung ni bag rta byas zig / smin drug khra mo bag rogs byas zig / 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gos gon zig / rin chen sna lnga'i po bkod zig / dam can rdo rje legs pa mgron 'go byas zig / sprul pa lha srin sde brgyad mgron la chas zig / gnam sa gnyis ka'i ston mo byas zig / zhes pa lta bu'i tshig don nyams gsum ldan pa'i gnyen bshad rim pa mang po yong do/ /ston bshad la mtshon na'ang gnyen bshad chang bshad dang phal cher gcig ma/tshungs yin mod/ 'on te mi ma/tshungs sa'ang yod de/ de yang ston bshad ni ston mo'i gzhi rgya che chung dang gral gyi rgan dar gzhon gsum/ ma sru che rgan chung gsum/ ston mo'i sder kha'i che chung / sbu ma/gron tsho'i shom gyi bzang ngan sogs la bstod pa bgyid pa gco bor brjod pa zhig go / dper na/ ston bshad gser gyi ma tog las tshan pa zhig bkod na 'di lta ste/gnam la bltas na skar ma bzang gi / sal bltas na dus tshod bzang gi/'di lho 'dzam bu gleng gi lteb/ / bod kha ba can gyi sa cha/ / sa chab 'gag 343

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yul gyi gnasabazang / / thang g.yung drung 'dra ba'i dkyiladabus/ / khyim phyug po'i lha4ra yang4sa/ / skyid kyi lha khyimagur khyima'adi na/ / bkra shisartagasabargyad 'dra ba'i mgron potshogasaki / 'ja' tshon snalnga 'dra ba'i dar 'then gi / khu byug gsung snyan 'dra ba'i gtamabashad gi / rab mdzesametog 'dra ba'i gosagon gi / bdud rtsi bsil ma 'dra ba'i chang 'thung gi /snyan mo pi wang 'dra ba'i glu len gi / rma byas gur khang phub 'dra'i bro 'khrab gi / ston mophun sum tshogasapar rten 'brel zhu/ / ltabu'o/ / ston bshad kyi tshan pa 'dir mtshon na tshig snyan zhing 'jebasapasaston ro/'i khyad chosaphal cher cha tshang bar brjod yod pa dang / da dung mgron gyi tshogasapa dang dar 'then pa/ gtam bshad pa/ gosagon pa/ glu len pa/ gar 'khrub pa sogasadang bkra shisartagasabargyad dang 'ja' tshon sna lnga/ khu byug gsung snyan/ rab mdzesametog snyan mo pi wang / rma bya'i gur khang sogasal rimapar dpe blangasanasaston mor bsngagasabarjod bgyis pa 'di yang shin tu ran zhing 'tsham la yid 'gug gi nusapa ldan pa zhig yin zhing / ston bshad de gnyen bshad dang mi mtshungasasani ston mor mtshon na ston mo'i nang don ltar du brjod bya'i don gtso bo 'bur du thon dgosapa de'o/ / dper na/ rta rgyug dga' ston gyi skabasasurta dang rta'i sga dang srab la bstod pa bgyid pa dang / mda' rtsed kyi skabasasumada' gzhu sogasal bstod pa'i gomasasrolayod pa ltabu'o/ /344gzhan yang yu+ophyogasa'adir dar rgya che ba'i chang bshad la cha mtshon

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /yul gyi gnas bzang / / thang g.yung drung 'dra ba'i dkyil dbus/ / khyim phyug po'i lhas ra yangs sa/ / byud kyi lha khyem gur khyem 'di na/ / bkra shisartags brgyad 'dra ba'i mgron po tshogs ki / 'ja' tshon sna lnga 'dra ba'i dar 'jen gi / khu byug gsung snyan 'dra ba'i gtam bshad gi / rab mdzes ṣ+petog 'dra ba'i gos gon gi / bdud ste bsel ma 'dra ba'i chang 'thung gi /snyan mo pi wang 'dra ba'i glu len gi / rma byas gur khang phub 'dra'i bro 'khrabagi / ston mo phun sum tshogs par rten 'brel zhu/ / lta bu'o/ / ston bshad kyi tshan pa 'dir mtshon na tshig snyan zhing 'jebs pas son rngo 'i gachos phal cher cha tshang bar brjod yod pa dang / da dung mgron zu tshogs pa dang dar 'jen pa/ gtam bshad pa/ gos gon pa/ glu len pa/ gar bskyab pa sogs dang bkra shis rtags brgyad dang 'ja' tshon sna lnga/ khu byug gsung snyan/ rab mdzes me tog snyan mo/ pi wang / rma bya'i gur khang sogasal rim par dpe blangs nas ston mor bsngags brjod bgyis pa 'di yang shin tu ran zhing 'tsham la yid 'gug gi nus pa lda na pa zhig yin zhing / ston bshad de gnyen bshad dang mi mtshungs sa ni ston mor mtshon na ston mo'i nang don ltar du brjod bya'i don gtso bo 'bur du thon dgos pa de'o/ / dper na/ rta rgyug dga' ston gyi skabs sa rta dang rta'i sga dang srab la bstod pa bgyid pa dang / mda' rtsed kyi skabs sum da' gzhu sogs la bstod pa'i goms srol yong pa lta bu'o/ /gzhan yang yul phyogs 'dir dar rgya che ba'i chang bshad la cha mtshon 344

2 mdo chab 'gag yu la du dar ba'i phye rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dbyad pa/na'ang gtso bo chang gi phan yon dang 'byung khungs/ dgos gal gyi rang bzhin bcas brjod pa yin/ dper na/ chang skyems bstod pa las/ 'di lo la bsnya la ba'i lo chang yin/ / lo chang bdud rtsi kham pa yin/ / zla la bsnya la ba'i zla chang yin/ / zla chang bdud rtsi zil ma yin/ / zhag la bsnyal ba'i zhag chang yin/ / zhag chang bdud byu'i nying khu yin/ / gangs can yul gyi nas bcud yin/ / 'jig rten srid pa'i sgrub chang yin/ / ge sar rgyal po'i gsol chang yin/ / sngags pa rnams kyi bum chang yin/ / mkhasapa rnams kyi gtam chang yin/ / gnyen po rnams kyi ston chang yin/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi dpa' chang yin/ / gzhon pa rnams kyi rtsed chang yin/ / che rgan pa bkur ba'i 'bul ba yin/ / mgron tshur yongs rnamasakyi bsam yin/ / mgron phar 'gro rnams kyi rdzong ba yin/ / grogs nye ring sgrig pa'i bar ba yin/ / gtam ku re 'byed pa'i lde mig yin/ / glu rtsed mo/ gnyis kyi sgo 'byed yin/ / thag nye ring med pa'i grogs po yin/ / zhes pa lta1bu lags/ 'dir chang bshad las tshan pa gcig ma/ gtogs bkod med na yang / bdud rtsi chang gi 'byung khungs gsal ler brjod yod par ma zad/sngags pa'i bum chang dang mkhasapa'i gtam chang / gnyen po'i ston chang /dpa' bo'i dpa' chang / gzhon pa'i rtsed chang / rgan po'i bkur changabacas pa'i phan yon rim bzhin 'jig rten gyi lugs srol la mthun par brjod 'dug chang bshad kyi rigs 'di mdo smad yu'i phyogs 'dir dar khyab kyi rgya che zhing yun ring la/ da dung yul khams so so'i yul srol gom sa345

a mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangasakhrodartsom rigaskoralarags tsam dpyad pa/na'ang gtso bo chang gi phan yon dang 'byung khungs/ dgosagalagyi rang bzhin bcasabarjod payin/ dper na/ chang skyemasabastod pa las/ 'di lo labasnyal ba'i lo chang yin/ / lo chang bdud rtsi khamapa yin/ / zla la bsnyal ba'i zla chang yin/ / zla chang bdud rtsi zil ma yin/ / zhag la bsnya la ba'i zhag chang yin/ / zhag chang bdud rtsi'i nying khuyin/ / gangs can yul gyi nasabacud yin/ / 'jig rten srid pa'i sgrub chang yin/ / ge sar rgya' po'i gsol chang yin/ / sngagasapa rnamasakyi bumachang yin/ / mkhasapa rnamasakyi gtam chang yin/ / gnyen po rnamasakyi ston chang yin/ /dpa' bo rnam4kyi dpa' chang yin/ / gzhon parnamasakyi rtsed chang yin/ / che rgan pa bkur ba'i 'bul ba yin/ / mgron tshur yongasarnamasakyi bsum yin/ / mgron phar 'gro rnamasakyi rdzong ba yin/ / grogasanye ring sgrig pa'i bar ba yin/ / gtamaku re 'byed pa'i lde mig yin/ / glu rtsed mo gnyisakyi sgo 'byed yin/ / thag nye ring med pa'i grogasapoyin/ / zhesapa ltabu lags/ 'dir chang bshad lasatshan pa gcig ma gtogasabakod med na yang / bdud rtsi chang gi 'byung khungasagasal ler brjod yod par mazad/sngagasapa'i bum chang dang mkhasapa'i gtam chang / gnyen po'i ston chang /dpa' bo'i dpa' chang / gzhon pa'i rtsed chang / rgan po'i bkur chang bcasapa'i phan yon rim bzhin 'jig rten gyi lugasasrolal mthun par brjod 'dug chang bshad kyi rig4'di mdo smad yul phyogasa'adir dar khyab kyi rgya che zhing yun ring la/ da dung yul khamasasoso'i yul srol 3ṭ+wāṃsnas

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'dris ltar je bzang ji legs sa 'gro bzhin pa'i sgang yin no/ /da dung skra shad kyi bshad pa dang / bag ma gtong kha'i gdams tshigarta kha bsab/ lcag 'bod pa'i gtam/ mag bcings dang glu ring mo bcasamang po mchis kyang 'dir re re gsal bor brjod pa la tshig tshogs kyi lo'adab rgyas par dogs nas mtshams bzhag pa yin/gnyis pa/ rgan po'i bslab bya'i skor/de yang rang re'i mdo smad chab 'gag yal 'dir gna' nas bzung rgan po'i bslab bya 'ga' re dar khyab byung stsong mod/ yin na'ang dus namayang nyams pa med pa'i bslab bya ni rnam rgyal tshe lo'i bslab be+e dang na ri'i spribasod kyi snyeng gtam zhes pa 'di gnyis ka yin/ de'i nang du yang dar khyab shin tu che ba ni rnam rgyal tshe lo yin la/ der a mdo'i rong 'brog sa khul gyi mang tshogs kun rgyas rnam rgyal tshe lo'i bslab bya zhes dga' bsu ches chen po bgyid pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso yang bslab bya des 'jig rten mi yul 'di ru 'tsho gzhes gnang ba'i che ba rgan pa dang chung ba byis pa su yin yang 'jig rten sgyu gnas lugs bste ba dang be+e ngan spyod ngan spong ba/ mi bzang don bzang bsgrub dgos pa bcas kyi bslab be+e yid la 'bab pa zhig btang yod pa lasagazhan/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin chen 'di rnyed dka' ba dang / rnyed pa'i skabs sa 'jig rten la phan 'bras ldan pa'i las don zhig ma/ bsgrubs na/mun nag phyi ma'i yal du song na rgyu yod kyang bkol sa med pa dang gos yod kyang gon sa med pa/ dpa' yod kyang ngom sa med pa'i lo rgyus dag gas 346

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'dri4ltar je bzang je legayosu'agro bzhin pa'i sgang yin no/ /da dung skra shad kyi bshad pyodang / bag ma gtong kha'i gdamasatshigarta khabasub/ lcag 'bod pa'i gtam/ mag bcingasadang glu ring mo bcasamang po mchisakyang 'dir re re gsalabor brjod palatshig tshogasakyi lo'adab rgyasapar dogasanasamatshamasabazhag pa yin/gnyis pa/ rgan po'i bslab bya'i skor/de yang rang re'i mdo smad chab 'gag yul 'dir gna' nasabazung rgan po'i bslab bya 'ga' re dar khyababyung myong mod/ yin na'ang dusanamayang nyamasapa med pa'i bslababya ni rnamargyalatshe lo'i bslababya dang 5ri'i yobasod kyi snying gtam zhesapa 'di gnyisaka yin/ de'i nang du yang dar khyabashin tuche ba ni rnamargyalatshe loyin la/ der amado'i rong 'brog sakhulagyi mang tshogasakun gyisarnamargyal tshe lo'i bslab bya zhes dga' bsuchesachen po bgyid pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso yang bslab bya desa'ajig rten miyul 'di ru 'tsho gzhesaganang ba'i che ba rgan pa dang chung ba byisapa suyin yang 'jig rten gyi gnasalugasabartsi ba dang bya ngan spyod ngan spong ba/ mibazang don bzang bsgrubadagosapa bcasakyi bslab bya yid la'abab pa zhig btang yod pa lasagazhan/ dal 'byor gyi milusarin chen 'di rnyed dka' ba dang / rnyed pa'i skabayosu'ajig rten la phan 'bra4ldan pa'i la4don zhig mabasgrubasan/mun nag phyi ma'i yul du song na rgyu yod kyang bkol4med pa dang gosayod kyadī~Xn samed pa/ dpa' yod kyang ngom samed pa'i lo rgyu4dag gsal

a mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rigaskoralarags tsam dpyad pa/ler brjod yod pasaso/ /der yang rnamargyalatshe lozhesapa'i rgan pode4ngag thog nasabaslababya phun sum tshogasabazhig rtsom thubapa'i rgyu rkyen gtso boyang / khong rang nitshe stod la rgyu nor longasaspyod rgyasapa dang / rta nor lug gsumadabyar kha'i ṣ+petog ji bzhin 'dzomasapa zhig yina'ang / tshe smad laphyi nang kun gyi rgyu nor thamasacad me tog sad kyis bcom pa ltar tshar song ba las/ khong gisargyu nor 'di mirtag camago'i zilab ltar yin pa shesapas/ semasacan kun la kha ta bslab bya'i kha chemasa'adi gnang bar gragasaso/ /rgan po'i bslababya 'di la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chosaldan pasan yige shes pa dang mishesapa tham4cad kyisago slazhing / brjod bya'i don yangaspyi tshogs 'tsho bar shin tu mthun pa zhig lags/ dper na/ ngayopho gsar rnamasal kha ta byed/ / yang bsod namasacan gyi dar lug4bshad/ / yul pha mar brtsi bkur byed re ltos/ / nang nye bo kun labyamasare ltos/ / dusargyun du kha lasadage re ltos/ / 'di bsod namasacan gyi tshogasabasagasared/ / yang min na deng rabasapho gsar tsho/ / yulapha mgayog la bkolagrokhegaltos/ / yulapha ma sgo la phud grokhiñtsaltos/ / yang ska ragasabyin phrablangasano ltos/ / da gri ring 'phred 'dogasabyasano ltos/ /yang 'khor gi 'khor gi 'gro srolaltos/ / shomachen phu rung ring no ltos/ /nga rgyal khengasadregasache no ltos/ / bosan alan ring no ltos/ / tshigabashadan skad mgo mtho no ltos/ / rgyagasabataban rgya sgor miskang spya1 /

i mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/ler brjod yod pas so/ /der yang rnam rgyal tshe lo zhes pa'i rgan po desang ga thog nas bslab bya phun sum tshogs pa zhig rtsom thub pa'i rgyu byen gtso bo yang / khong rang ni tshe stod la rgyu nor longs spyod rgyas pa dang / rta nor lug gsum dbyar kha'i me tog ji bzhin 'dzoms pa zhig yin 'ang / tshe smad la phyi nang kun gyi rgyu nor tham/sa cad me tog sad kyis bcom pa ltar tshar song ba las/ khong gis rgyu nor 'di mi rtag sa mgo'i zil ba ltar yin pa shes pas/ sems can kun la kha ta bslab bya'i kha chems 'di gnang bar grags so/ /rgan po'i bslab be+e 'di la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan pas na yi ge shes pa dang mi shes pa thams cad kyis go ma zhing / brjod bya'i don yang ste tshogs 'tsho bar shin tu ma/thun pa zhig lags/ dper na/ ngas pho gsar rnams la kha ta byed/ / yang bsod nams can gyi dar lugasabashad/ / yul pha mar brtse bkur byed re ltos/ / nang nye bo kun la byamasare lto sa/ / dus rgyun du kha las dge re ltos/ / 'di bsod nams can gyi tshogs bsags red/ / yang min na deng rabs pho gsar tsho/ / yus pha ma g.yog la bkol sngon ltos/ / yul pha ma sgo la phud dren ltos/ / yang ska rags byin ༅blangs no ltos/ / da gri ring 'phred 'dogs byas no ltos/ /yang 'khor gi 'khor gi 'gro srol ltos/ / shom chen phu rung ring no ltos/ /nga rgyal khengs dregs che no ltos/ / bos na a lan ring no ltos/ / tshigabashad na skad mgo mtho no ltos/ / rgyags btang na rgya sgor mi shong gi /347

— ba 7 ba palogs btang na dra mar mi thogs gi / khyod sa gzan zhig gi gong ralared/ / yang rtsam gzan zhig gi zhol ma red/ / de ma/ byed deng rabs pho gsar tsho/ / brtsi dgos no lo lon rgan po red/ / nang sgos sa drin can pha ma/ red/ / ces pa lta bur mtshon na'ang / skye bo sus kyang go ma bar ma zad/pho gsar rnams kyi skyon dag sba gsang sted par sun 'byen gnang yod pasabashad pa gnad la phog 'dugad dung mgo dkar po can gyi lo lon tshor kha ta gnang bar yang 'di ltakhu'i tshan pa zhig yod pa ste/ 'jig rten khams kyi 'khor ba 'di/ / skra nag po'i dus sam 'grub na/ / mgo dkar po lon dus gang nas 'grub/ / tshe 'di nas yun ring 'dug khom med/ / lo lon nas brgyad cur bud dusasu/ / kha bkod pa ma 'phen lo lon tsho/ / kha bkod pa sa nas longs song zig / kha tshags ma mang lo lon tsho/ / khro'i go kha thems no dga' nibyos/ / da rgas pa'i sdug bsngal thon dus su/ / mig gis rgyang ring skomathong gi / tshig tshur bshad rna yis mi go gi / yang phar bshad kha yisaskokhrol gi / zas sra/ mo so yis mi chong gi / gos yag pa 'u sal mi ran gi /'gro gom pas rgyang ring mi chod gi / rtsog bsdad na mkhal mas mi lcogs gi/zhes pa lta bu rgan po'i 'tsho bar shin tu mthun pa yang gsungs yod do/ /ya ri'i a bsod kyi snying gtam zhes pa'i ngag rtsom 'di'i rtsom pa po ni spri mdo kan ltos khul gyi yin yang spri mdo'i sa phyogs so so ru dar khyab shin tuche zhing / chab 'gag yul 'dir mtshon na'ang dar snga la bshad shes pa'i 348

— ༄ 1 ོ laltogasabatang na dra mar mithogasagi / khyod cagazan zhig gi gong rolared/ / yang rtsam gzan zhig gi zhol ma red/ / de ma byed deng rabasapho gsar tsho/ / brtsi dgosano lo lon rgan po red/ / nang sgosasadrin can pha mared/ / cesapaltabur mtshon na'ang / skye bo su4kyang go slabar mazad/pho gsar rnamasakyi skyon dag sba gsang med par sun 'byin gnang yod pasabashad pa gnad la phog 'dugad dung mgo dkar po can gyi lolon tshor kha ta gnang bar yang 'di ltabu'i tshan pa zhig yod pa ste/ 'jig rten khamasakyi 'khor ba 'di/ / skra nag po'i dusasuma'agrub na/ / mgo dkar po lon dusagang nasa'agrub/ / tshe 'di nasayun ring 'dug khom med/ / lo lon nasabargyad cur bud dusasu/ / kha bkod pa ma 'then lolon tsho/ / kha bkod pa sa nasalongasasong zig / kha tshag4ma mang lo lon tsho/ / khyod go kha themasano dga' ni byos/ / da rgasapa'i sdug bsngal thon dusasu/ / mig gisargyang ring mimathong gi / tshig tshur bshad rna yisamigo gi / yang phar bshad kha yisamikhrol gi / zasasu mo soyiyomichod gi / gosayag pa lusal mi ran gi /'gro gom pasargyang ring michod gi / rtsog bsdad na mkhal mayomi lcogasagi/zhesapa ltabu rgan po'i 'tsho bar shin tu mthun pa yang gsungasayod do/ /5ri'i abasod kyi snying gtam zhesapa'i ngag rtsom 'di'i rtsom pa po ni amado gan lhosakhul gyi yin yang amado'i saphyogasasosoru dar khyab shin tuche ṭ+wāṃṭ+wā / chab 'gag yul 'dir mtshon na'ang dar sngal bshad shesapa'i

2 mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/rgan rabs pa yang shi nyung ba yod par ma zad/ mi rnams kyis dus rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du snying gtam de'i nang gi tshan pa re blangs nas gzhon nu rnams la slob gsogatong ba'i srol yang chags yod do/ / dper na sde bar nang mthun yo nga ba'i bslab khya gtong ba'i skabs su/ gros thar thor sdo bar shugs med/ / tshig thar thor gtam la mdo med/ / nang gros kha thub na mkhas pa/ / lha rlung rtas skyob sa gan yin/ / nang gyod kha bzo mi khyi yin/ / stag sha ra'i nang rdzong mthun yin/ / mthun med na phu nu rang yin/ / lta bu'i drug gi don bsdus na/ sde ba mthun pa yong dgos pa dang phu nu mthun pa yong dgos pa'i gal chen gyi rang bzhin brjod yod pa ltabu'o/ /da dung skyes pho rabs dang pho ngan/ ma/ bzang mo dang ngan mo bcas la slob gsogatong ba'i skabs su'ang / ngo ri'i spri bsod kyi snyeng gtam las/skyes pho rabs gcig gi lugs srol / / dgra nag pos bskor na dpa' yod/ / nang phu nus bskor na brtse yod/ / khyem bza' bas bskor na byams yod/ / don chen pos bskor na thabs yod/ / lta bu dang / skyes pho ngan zhig gi dpe bshad/ / dgra nag po bcar na phyir bros/ / nom dngosardzas rig na mig 'phrul/ / lus 'chi khar da rung gyod bzo/ / skyon ngo la bzhag na snying 'dar/ / lta bu/ ma bzang mo zhig gi dpe bshad/ / phyi 'grul ba khyim la yong dus/ / ngo 'khrum mdangs skyes nas bas gi / ja dron po lag la 'jog gi / nang bza' tshang kun la byams gi / khyim bza' 349

a mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rigaskoralarags tsam dpyad pa/rgan rabasapa yang minyung ba yod par ma zad/ mi rnamasakyisadusargyun gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du snying gtamade'i nang gi tshan pa re blangasanasagazhon nu rnam4la slob gsogatong ba'i srolayang chagasayod do/ / dper na sdebar nang mthun yong ba'i bslab bya gtong ba'i skabasasu/ grosathar thor sdebar shugasamed/ / tshig thar thor gtam la mdo med/ / nang grosakha thub na mkhasapa/ / 2rlung rtasaskyob sagan yin/ / nang gyod kha bzo mikhyi yin/ / stag sha ra'i nang rdzong mthun yin/ / mthun med na phu nu rang yin/ / ltabu'i tshig gi don bsdu4na/ sde ba mthun pa yong dgosapa dang phu nu ༵thun pa yong dgo4pa'i galachen gyi rang bzhin brjod yod pa ltabu / da/ dung skyesapho rab4dang pho ngan/ ma bzang mo dang ngan mobacasal slob gsogatong ba'i skabasasu'ang / yari'i abasod kyi snying gtamalas/skyesapho rabasagacig gi lug4srol/ / dgra nag po4bskor na dpa' yod/ / nang phu nusabaskor na brtse yod/ / khyim bza' bsabaskor na byamasayod/ / don chen posabaskor na thabasayod/ / ltabu dang / skyesapho ngan zhig gi dpe bshad/ / dgra nag po bcar na phyir bros/ / nomadangosardzasarig na mig 'phrul/ / lusa'achi khar da rung gyod bzo/ / skyon ngo la bzhag na snying 'dar/ / ltabu/ ma bzang mo zhig gi dpe bshad/ / phyi 'grul ba khyimal yong dus/ / ngo 'dzum mdangasaskyesanasabasugi / ja dron po lag la 'jog gi / nang bza' tshang kun labyamasag / khyim 3༵༵'a

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i nang 'dzin thub gi /lta bu/ yang / ma ngan mo zhig gi cha lugs/ /lo lon gnya' nas gnon gi /kha yar khyer mar khyer byas nas/ /khrimamatshes kha 'khon gtong gi /nang phu nur zhe sdang slong gi /ru sde bar dgrug shing 'phen gi /lta bu bcas brjod par phan nus ha cang che zhib/mi rnams kyis kyang rang shugs sa pho mong bzang ngan gyi tshad gzhi ltar du brtsi 'jog byed bzhin mchis/ gong zhu'i tshig 'di dag snyan zhing 'jibs pa zhig min yang spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas dang yar skul la phan pa dang / mi rnams kyi bsam pa'i kun spyod ji legs su gtong bar yang phan pa chen po mchisaso/ /snying gtam 'di'i brjod bya'i don gyi gco bo ni/ rgan po ya ri'i spribasod kyis rang gi cham gang gi 'tsho ba'i khrod du spyid sdug mang po myangs pa'i lo rgyus la dpe blangs nas/ dpon po ngan pa'i spyod ngan mtshang 'byen dang dpon po bzang po'i spyod par bsngags brjod bgyis yod pa dang / byesaparab 'bring tha gsum byu dbye ba dang skyes ma rab 'bring tha gsum gyi dbye babacas sa bor phye ste/ dge ba'i don la phyogs pa dang chadage ba'i lasadag 'gog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs go ma ba'i kha skad las brjod yod pasader gson nyams ldan zhing mi nyams pa'i srog shugs mchis yo da pa lagasaso/ /gsum pa/ rogs 'then rgya skor/de yang rogs 'dren zhes pa be+e na gzhon pho mo' bar gyi mi phyed pa'i 350

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i nang 'dzin thubagi / ltabu/ yang / ma ngan mozhig gi cha lugs/ /lolon gnya' na4gnon gi / khayar khyer mar khyer byasanas/ / khyimamatshe4kha'akhon gtong gi / nang phu nur zhe sdang slong gi / ru sde bar dkrug shing 'phen gi / ltabu bca4brjod par phan nusaha cang che zhib/mirnamasakyisakyang rang shugasasupho mo'i bzang ngan gyi tshad gzhi ltar du brtsi 'jog byed bzhin mchis/ gong zhu'i tshig 'di dag snyan zhing 'jebasapa zhig min yang spyi tshogasakyi 'phelargyasadang yar skul laphan pa dang / mi rnamasakyi ṭ+wāsamapa'i kun spyod je legasasugatong bar yang phan pa chen po mchisasnyingagatam 'di'i brjod bya'i don gyi gtso bo ni/ rgan po 5ri'i abasod kyisarang gi mitsha gang gi 'tsho ba'i khrod du skyid sdug mang pomyangasapa'i lo rgyusal dpoblangasanas/ dpon ponganapa'i spyod ngan mtshang 'byin dbadapon po bzang po'i spyod par bsngagasabarjod bgyisayod pa dang / skyesapa rab 'bring tha gsumagyi dbye ba dang skyesam raba'abring tha gsumagyi dbye ba bcasagasalabor phye ste/ dge ba'i don laphyogasapa dang midage ba'i lasadag 'gog dgo4pa'i rgyu mtshan sogasago slaba'i kha skad lasabarjod yod pasahāragasonanyamasaldan zhing minyam4pa'i srog shugasamachi4yod pa lagasagasum pa/ rogs 'then gyi skor/350de yang rogasa'athen zhesapani na gzhon pho mo'i bar gyi miphyed pa'i

ma mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/brtse dung mtshon byed kyi don brjod snyan ngag gi gras yin/ rogs 'phen gang yin yang gtso bo slad med kyi brtse dung 'bur thon bgyis yod cing /mtha' ma'i brtse dung la bar chad byung ba'i brgyud rim yang brjod yod/rogs 'then 'dir mtshon na rgan pos gtam rgyud bshad pa ji bzhin brjod na mi chog la/ nges par du rogs 'phen gyi dbyangs la bkug nas len dgos pa red/ gal srid ngag 'dzoms kyi skye bos blangs na/ pho mo rgan gzhon sa yin yang 'gug thub pa'i nus pa mchis/ rogs 'phen de yang thog ma/ra ⑪ge mi shes pa'i dmangs khrod kyi sgyu rtsal pa'i ngag las thon zhing rim/ gyis yo na tan pa'i smyu gu brgyud nas je legs ji rgyas sa btang ba zhig yin/ de yang ngag thog dang yig thog gang brgyud kyang tshang ma tshigs bcad kyi lam nas brjod yod pa red/a mdo sa cha spyi la dar khyab che ba'i rogs 'phen gyi rigs la cung mang po 'dug dper na/ na gzhon zung gi 'dod glu dang na chung rtsen pa'i skyo glu/ma/na 'a bcad don go gzhon dpal dang pad mtsho/ don grub rgyal lo dang ye shes sgo la ma/ tā ni stod/ las dbang gi skyo glu/ 'ba' na chung rtsen pa'i rang mdangs/ rogs mthun/ lhasa'i khrom/ bu mo mnar sdug ltabu'o/ / gong zhu'i rogs 'dren phal cher ni gna' snga mo nas dar ba zhig yin pas/ mang tshogs kyi khrod du khyab rgya yang de bas che/ yin na yang nyung shas shig gsar du bcoms pa yang yod la/ gang ltar kyang rang re'i chab 'gag yul du dar rgya shin tu che ba'i rogs 'phen ni tā ni stod yin zhing / 351

ma mdochab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/brtse dung mtshon byed kyi don brjod snyan ngag gi gra4yin/ rogayo'athen gang yin yang gtso bo slad med kyi brtse dung 'bur thon bgyisayod cing /mtha' ma'i brtse dung labar chad byung ba'i brgyud rim yang brjod yod/rogasa'athen 'dir mtshon narganaposagatayorgyud bshad pa ji bzhinabarjod na mi chog la/ ngesapar du rogasa'athen gyi dbyangasalabakug na4len dgo4pa red/ gal srid ngag 'dzomasakyi skyebosablangasan/ pho mo rgan gzhon suyin yang 'gug thub pa'i nusapa mchis/ rogasa'athen de yang thog mar yige mi shesapa'i dmangasakhrod kyi sgyu rtsalapa'i ngag lasathon zhing rim gyisayon tan pa'i smyu gu brgyud nasaje legasaje rgyasasubatang bzhig yin/ de yang ngag thog dang yig thog gang brgyud kyang tshang mtshigasabacad kyi lam nasabarjod yod pa red/amado sacha spyi la dar khyab che ba'i rogasa'athen gyi rigasal cung mang po 'dug dper na/ na gzhon zung gi 'dod glu dang na chung rtsen pa'i skyo glu/mna' bcad don go gzhon dpaladang pad mtsho/ don grub rgyalalodang yeshe4sgrolam/ tā ni stod/ lasadabang gi skyo glu/ 'ba' na chung rtsen pa'i rang mdangs/ rogasamathun/ lhasa'i khrom/ bu mo'i mnar sdug ltabu'o/ / gong zhu'i rogasa'athen phal cher ni gna' sngamon4dar bzhig yin pas/ mang tshogasakyi khrod du khyab rgya yang de bsache/ yin na yang nyung shasashig gsar du brtsamasapa yang yod la/ gang ltar kyang rang re'i chaba'agag yul du dar rgya shin cache ba'i rogasa'athen ni tā ni stod yiṭ+wāṃ 5snying /

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/phal cher rong 'brog sa khul yongs gas khyab rdo khyab tu gyur 'dug la chebargan pa dang chung ba gzhon pa g.yin yang tā be+e stod kyi tshan pa 'ga' re bshad mi shes pa ha cang nyung shas yin no/ /rogs 'phen mang po las tā ni stod ces pa 'dir gna' nas da snye'i bar nyams med kyi srog shugs ldan pa dang / rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis dga' bas chen po bgyid pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo yang rogs 'phen 'di'i gtam rgyud kha tshang zhing gson nyams ldan pa dang / brjod bya'i don dag spyo tshogs 'tsho ba dngos la mthun pa/ rjod tshig snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i rkyen gyis so/ /dper na/ tā ni stod las/ mkhar skya mo'i shar phyogs sa nas/ / lcagasanag gi gling bu'i nang la/ / sems 'gul ba'i glu zhig bzhag nas/ / rgyang zhig nas rgyang 'bud byed ki / nga'i gsal mo rna yis nyan na/ / nga'i dogs gi 'bud tshul lhang red/ / nga'i ngo la 'dzum zhig langs nas/ /nga'i sems la dga' spro skyes no/ / nang 'jig rten mi yis ci shes/ / nga phyi sgo'i sgo kha 'bud dus/ / sde tā be+e stod gi dga' lo/ / zhe snang ba ma/thun pa'i rogs lo/ / kha bgad le sgo khar thon thal/ / phar 'khor nas ma sgogasa'adri ma btang / / tshur 'khor nas ske la 'jus nas/ / kha zhim pos 'o zhig byedaka / lta bu dang / nga'i chung dus rogs gi ngo la/ / byad nyi ma 'dra zhig shar nas/ / khosang thungasang zo zer gi / zasazhim po za dbang ma byung / / ja mngar mo 'thung dbang ma byung / / tshig snyan mo bshad dbang ma byung / / sha mchin pa glan dbang ma byung / / bzhi ma byung las kyi ma/tha' 352

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/phalacher rong 'brog sakhul yongasasusakhyabardo khyab tu gyur 'dug lache brgan pa dang chung ba gzhon pa suyin yang tā ni stod kyi tshan pa 'ga' re bshad mishe4pa ha cang nyung shasayin no/ /rogasa'athen mang po lasatā ni stod ce4pa 'dir gna' nasad lta'i bar nyamasamed kyi srog shugasaldan pa dang / rgya che'i mang tshogasakyisadaga' bsuchen po bgyid pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo yang rogasa'athen 'di'i gtam rgyud khatshang zhing gson nyamasaldan padang / brjod bya'i don dag spyi tshogasa'atsho ba dngosal mthun pa/ rjod tshig snyan zhing 'jebasapa'i rkyen gyisaso/ /dper na/ tā ni stod las/ mkhar skya mo'i shar phyogasasanas/ / lcagasanag gi gling bu'i nang la/ / sem4'gul ba'i glu zhig bzhag nas/ / rgyang zhig nasargyang 'bud byed ki / nga'i gsal mo rna yisanyan na/ / nga'i rogasagi 'bud tshul lhang red/ / nga'i ngo la 'dzum zhig langs nas/ /nga'i semasal dga' spro skyesano/ / nang 'jig rten mi yisaci shes/ / nga phyi sgo'i sgo kha'abud dus/ / sde tā ni stod gi dga' lo/ / zhe snang ba mthun pa'i rogasalo/ / kha bgad le sgo khar thon thal/ / phar 'khor nasamagyogasa'adri ma btang / / tshur 'khor nasaska la 'jusanas/ / kha zhim posa'o zhig byedaki / ltabu dang / nga'i chung du4rogayogi ngo la/ / skyid nyi ma 'dra zhig shar nas/ / khosang thungasang zo zer gi / zagazhim poza dbang ma byung / / ja mngar mo 'thung dbang ma byung / / tshig snyan mo bshad dbang ma byung / / sha mtshon pa glan dbang mabyung / / bzhi ma byung lasakyi mtha' 352

a mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/ma/ / lasamabazang ba zhig byung no/ / phyi sgochenakhrog sobatang thal/ /nang sgo chung chom sebatang thal/ / dgra nag po rgya stag 'dra bo/ / stag bzhin du lding nasathon thal/ / nga'i rogasakyi bde myur bya red/ / bya bzhin du gshog pa med rung / / mgo khang ba'i skar khung nang nas/ / bya bzhin du 'phur nasabud thal/ / dgra nag po'i ngar la bltasan/ / ma nged tsho thar sa med gi / nga'i mi lusa'adom gang zamo/ / shing sdong lo bcomabacomabyed gi / skra lan bu ljang lo 'dra bo/ / shing smyug mgatub gtub byed gi / nga'i mi sha rlon pa'i steng la/ / lcag zamosalnga brgya 'brab gi / phyi sha pagasarnga bo rdung rdung / / khrag dmar po rka chu bzhur bzhur/ /ltabu dang / nga 'jam po gdan zhig 'ding gi / nag4gla shing cher ma'i tsub red/ / nga mthon po snga4shig 'jog gi / de dma' mo dong gi dma' red/ / nga yang mo gosashig 'gebasagi / de gor mo rdo yiphyi red/ / ltabu/nam gung gi gung dkyilazhig la/ / nga gzer rgod rta rgod rgyug rgyug /gzer 'bring phur ba deb rdeb/ / gzer chung g.yag rgod ngur ngur/ / snying dmar po lu gu rtse rtse/ / tsha lum meyisasreg sreg / khrag thigasachar ba 'bab 'bab/ / lasadabang rgyu min no shesag / ltabu bcasapar zhib tu dpyad na gtam rgyud kyi tshig rkang re re'i nang du brtse dung zab momatshon yod cing / nyan pa po dang klog ngaposayin yang semasal dga' skyo gnyisaldan gyi snang tshulazhig dbang med du ster b.lasagazhan/ rjod byed tshig gi nyamasadang shug4shin tu ldan pa ste/ lusaphramo sdong lo bcomabacom da~X /53 skra

i mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/ma/ /las ma bzang ba zhig byung no/ / phyi sgo chen khrog so btang thal/ /nang sgo chung chom sebatang thal/ / dgra nag po rgya stag 'dra bo/ / stag bzhin du lding nas thon thal/ / nga'i rogs kyi bde myur bya red/ / khya bzhin du gshog pa med rung / / mgo khang ba'i skar khung nang nas/ / bya bzhin du 'phur nas bud thal/ / dgra nag po'i ngar la bltas na/ / mnged tsho thar sa sted gi / nga'i mi lus 'dom gang ga mo/ / shing sdong lo bcom bcom byed gi / skra lan bu ljang 'o 'dra bo/ / shing sprug ma gtub gtub byed gi / nga'i mi sha zlon pa'i steng la/ / lcag po mos lnga brgya 'brab gi / phyi sha pags rnga bo rdung rdung / / khrag dmar po rka chu bzhur bzhur/ /lta bu dang / nga 'jam po gdan zhig 'ding gi / nags gla shing tsher ma'i tsub red/ / nga mthon po mas shig 'jog gi / de dma' mo dong gi dma' red/ / nga yang mo gos shig 'gebs gi / de gor mo rdo ྾lci red/ / lta bu/nam gung gi gung dkyil zhig la/ / nga gzer rgod rta rgod rgyug rgyug /gzer 'breng phur ba rdeb rdeb/ / gzer chung g.yag rgod ngur ngur/ / snying dam ra po lu gu rtse rtse/ / tsha lum ske yis sreg sreg / khrag thigs char ba 'bab 'bab/ /las dbang rgyu min no shes gi / lta bu bcas par zhib tu dpyad na gtom rgyud kyi tshig rkang re re'i nang du bste dung zab mo mtshon yod cing / nyan pa po dang khrog pa po g.yin yang sems la dga' skyo gnyis ldan gyi snang tshul zhig dbang sked du ster ba las gzhan/ rjod byed tshig gi nyamasadang shugs shin tu ldan pa ste/ lus po mo sdong lo bcom bcom dang / zi 353

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ljang lo smyug ma gtub gtub/ phyi pags rnga bo rdung rdung / khrag dam ra po rka chu bzhur bzhur lta bu dang da dung rta rgod rgyug rgyug phur ba rdeb deb/g.yag rgod ngur ngur/ lu gu rtse rtse lta bu'i dmangs khrod kyi kha skad zung ldan gyi tshig nyams yod pa dang shugs lda na pa mang po bkol yod pa'i dbang gisabaton na khar bde bar ma zad yid dbang yang cig car du 'gug pa'i shugasachen po thon yod/ da lta'i rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi khrod du'ang brtsams chosalegs po tā be+e stod lta bu'i rjod byed tshig la 'gran thub pa ni yod re skan/dper na/ tā be+e stod las/ pho bzang po nyi ma tshe ring gis ma bzang yo zla bzang sgol ma'i sbu lus ma 'tshams pa rmi lam las shes te/ myur du lamalaskyod pa'i tshul ni 'di ltar bris 'dug rta 'do ba'i gong la zhon nas/ /lcag sa mo dgung la phyar nas/ / rta 'do ba'i gom kha phye nas / / ngas thang chen thang chung brgyud dus/ / thang chen po shog skya lteb lteb/ / ngas la ring la thung brgyud dus/ / la ring po gru gu sgril sgril/ / ngas khug chen khug chung brgyud dus/ / khug nyag ga sgog gu rgyag rgyag / ngas chu chen chu chung brgyud dus/ / chu chen po rta rnga gcod gcod/ / lta bur mtshon na tshig rkang mi mang yang nyi ma tshe ring gi sems kyi byel ba dang rta'i myur tshul dag ji ma ji bzhin du brjod 'dug la tshig rkang 'di dab/ gi shugs las bcos ma ma yin pa'i brtse dung zab mo zhig mtshon yo da pa shes thub cing / rjod byed kyi tshig gson nyams lda na pa 'di lta bu brtsams chos gzhan las mthong shin tu dkon pa lags so/ /354

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ljang lo smyug ma gtub gtub/ phyi pagasang bo rdung rdung / khrag dmar po rka chu bzhur bzhur ltabu dang da dung rta rgod rgyug rgyug phur ba rdeb sdeb/g.yag rgod ngur ngur/ lugu rtse rtse ltabu'i dmangasakhrod kyi kha skad zung ldan gyi tshig nyamasayodapa dang shug4ldan pa mang po bkol yod pa'i dbang gisabaton na khar bde bar mazad yid dbang yang cig car du 'gug pa'i shugasachen po thon yod/ da lta'i rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi khrod du'ang brtsamasachosalegasapo tā ni stod ltabu'i rjod byed tshig la 'gran thub pa ni yod re skan/dper na/ tā ni stod las/ pho bzang po nyi ma tshe ring gisam bzang pozla bzang sgrolama'i sku lusam 'tshamasapa rmi lam lasashesate/ myur du lamalaskyod pa'i tshul ni 'di ltar bri4'dug rta 'do ba'i gong la zhon nas/ /lcag phramo dgung laphyar nas/ / rta 'do ba'i gom kha phye nas/ / ngas thang chen thang chung brgyud dus/ / thang chen po shog skya lteb lteb/ / ngasal ring la thung brgyud dus/ / la ring po gru gu sgrilasgril/ / ngasakhug chen khug chung brgyud dus/ / khug nyag ga sgrog gu rgyag rgyag / ngasachu chen chu chung brgyud dus/ / chu chen po rta rnga gcod gcod/ / ltabur mtshon na tshig rkang mi mang yang nyi ma tshe ring gi semasakyi brel ba dang rta'i myur tshul dag ji ma ji bzhin du brjod 'dug la tshig rkang 'di dab/ gi shugasalasabacosamam yin pa'i brtse dung zabamo zhig mtshon yod pashesathub cing / rjod byed kyi tshig gson ༵ningh+ruṭ+wāṃ na pa 'di ltabu brtsamasachosagazhan lasamathong shin tu dkon pa

2mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/tā ni stod kyi gtam rgyud 'di'i snying bo ni/ hor gtsang khog gi gzhon num zla bzang sgo lam dang tā ni stod kyi pho gsar nyi ma tshe ring bar gyi brtse dung zab mo der/ dgra nag ma rungs pas bar chad bzos te zla bzang sgolamar gcar rdung bgyis nas mtha' mar tshe las 'das pa dang / nyi ma tshe ring gis gtam ngan de rmi lam las shes te zla bzang sgrol ma'i dur sa'i steng du song nas kha bkar dka' ba'i tshul brjod yod pa yin/ dmangs khrod kyi don brjod snyan ngag gi gtam rgyud 'dir tshig rkang lnga brgya re bdun yod do/ /bzhi ba/ glu dang shags la gzhas kyi skor/glu dang shags la gzhas ni mdo dbus khams gsum yongs su dar khyab tu so/nga yod pa'i dmangs khrod tshom rig gi gras shig yin zhing / de yang gtso bo a mdo'i shis gyi khri ka dang chab 'gag reb gong / kan lho/ rnga ba bcas sa khul du dar rgya cung che ba red/ yul khams de dag gi bar du'ang che phyogs gcig mtshungs dang chung phyogs mi mtshungs pa yang mchis/de yang chab 'gag yus du dar khyab tu song ba'i glu kha mtshar la mtshor na gtso bo'i brjod bya ni 'jig rten gyi byung rim bshad pa dang che ba rnams la bstod pa bgyid pa/ 'tsho ba'i byad sdug brjod pa/ dus nam yang bde zhing skyed pa'i bkra shis bde legs kyi smon tshig zhu ba bcas yod/ glu tshig khrung phal cher tshig rkang bcu gnyis can dang brgyad can dgu can drug can mang shas yin/ rkang pa re la yig 'bru phal cher brgyad re yod pa lags/ glu rta 355

a mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skoral rags tsam dpyad pa/tā ni stod kyi gtamargyud 'di'i snying bo ni/ hor gtsang khog gi gzhon num zla bzang sgro lam dang tā ni stod kyi pho gsar nyi mtshe ring bar gyi brtse dung zab poder/ dgra nag ma rungasapasabar chad bzosate zla bzang sgrolamar gcar rdung bgyisanasamatha' mar tshe lasa'adasapa dang / nyi ma tshe ring gisagatam ngan de rmi lam layoshesate zla bzang sgrol ma'i dur sa'i steng du song nasakha bkar dka' ba'i tshulabarjod yod pa yin/ dmangasakhrod kyi sdon brjod snyan ngag gi gtamargyud 'dir tshig rkang lngabargya re bdun yod bzhi ba/ glu dang shags la gzhas kyi skor/glu dang shagasalagazhasani mdo dbusakhamasagasum yongasasudar khyab tu song yod pa'i dmangasakhrod rtsom rig gi grasashig yin zhing / de yang gtso bo amado'i yulagyi khri ka dang chab 'gag reb gong / pon lho/ rnga ba bca4sakhuladu dar rgya cung che ba red/ yul kham4de dag gi bar du'ang che phyog4gcig mtshungasadang chung phyogasami mtshungayopa yang mchis/de yang chab 'gag yuladu dar khyab tu song ba'i glu khamatshar la mtshon na gtso bo'i brjod bya ni 'jig rten gyi byung rimabashad pa dang che ba rnamasal bstod pa bgyid pa/ 'tsho ba'i skyid sdug brjod pa/ dusanam yang bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shisabade leg4kyi smon tshig zhu ba bcasayod/ glu tshig kyang phal cher tshig rkang bcu gnyi4can dang brgyad can dgu can drug can mang shasayin/ rkang pa re la yig 'bru phal cher brgyad re yod pa lags/35ṭ+wāṃ rta

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la yang rnam pa sna tshogs mchis/ glu ba dang glu ma grags can zhig la mtshon na ma tha yang glu rta bcu lhag cig yid du nges yod/ glu kha mtshar gyi len lugasal yang thog mar skyes pas glu sgo phye ba dang / rim gyis glu ba dang glu mas len res byed sro la yod/ glu kha mtshar gyi 'gro rim yang thog mar glu 'go stom pa'i skor len pa dang / de'i 'phror bstod pa'i skor len pa/ de nas drin lan zhu ba'i skor dang smreng ba'i skor len pa/ mjug du bkra shis 'jog pa bcasaso/ /'dir rim pa bzhin dper brjod re bkod na/ glu 'go rtsom pa'i skor las/ chos kyi 'go ma ka kha yin/ / chos ka kha ma bton 'don sgo/la med/ / zas kyi 'go ma mchod kha yin/ / zas mchod kha ma 'phangs za sro la med/ / glu ⑪'go ma kha mtshar yin/ glu kha mtshar ma blangs len sro'imed/ / ces pa lta bu ni glu 'go stom pa'i skabs kyi glu zhig go / bstod glu'i skor las/ seng dkar mo gangs ri'i rtse nas 'gying / / seng g.yur la rang gi phrag na yod/ / seng phrug mang pos bskor nas yo da/ / seng 'di tsho'i bsod nams rang grub red/ / stag dar ma rgya rdzong nags nas 'gying / /stag thig le rang gi rgyab na yod/ / stag phrug mang pos bskor nas yo da/ /stag 'di tsho'i bsong nams rang grub red/ / nang a khu gral la bzhugasanas yod/ / gtam kha lce rang la 'dzoms nas yod/ / bu tsha rgyud mang posabaskor nas yod/ / rgan sprikhu'i bsod nams rang grub red/ / ces brjod pa lta bur mtshon na sho lo ka gsum yod pa las sngon gyi sho lo ka gnyis ni dpe 356

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la yang rnam pa snatshogasamachis/ glu ba dang glu mgragasacan zhig la mtshonanamatha yang glu rta bcu lhag cig yid du nge4yod/ glu kha mtshar gyi len lugasal yang thog mar skyesapasaglu sgo phye ba dang / rimagyisaglu ba dang glu masalenaresabyed srolayod/ glu kha mtshar gyi 'gro rim yang thog mar glu 'go rtsom pa'i skor len padang / de'i 'phror bstod pa'i skor len pa/ de nayodrinalanañtsā ba'i skor dang smreng ba'i skor lenapa/ mjug du bkra shi4'jog pa bcasa'adir rimapa bzhin dper brjod re bkod na/ glu 'go rtsom pa'i skor las/ chos kyi 'go ma ka kha yin/ / cho4ka kha yobaton 'don srolamed/ / zasakyi 'go ma mchod kha yin/ / zasamachod kha yo'aphangasaza srolamed/ / glu yi'ago mkha mtshar yin/ glu kha mtshar mablangasalen gros med/ / ces pa ltabu ni glu 'go rtsomapa'i skabasakyi glu zhig go / bstod glu'i skor las/ seng dkar pogangasari'i rtse nasa'agying / / seng g.yural rang gi phrag na yod/ / seng phrug mang po4bskor nasayod/ / seng 'di tsho'i bsod namasarang grub red/ / stag dar yorgya rdzong nagasanasa'agying / /stag thig le rang gi rgyaban yod/ / stag phrug mang posabaskor nasayo/da/ /stag 'di tsho'i bsod namasarang grub red/ / nang akhu gralal bzhugasanasayod/ / gtam khalce rang la'adzomasanasayod/ / bu tsha rgyud mang posabaskor nasayod/ / rgan akhu'i bsod namasarang grub red/ / cesabarjod pa ༈hūṃr mtshon na sho loka gsum yod pa la4sngon gyi sho loka gnyisani dpo

a mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/yin la rjesama'i sho loka ni dpocan yin/ bstod pa'i gzhi ni akhu'i bsod namasache ba de yin/ yang drin lan zhu ba'i skor gyi nang du'ang tshig 'di ltabu zhig yod pa ste/ lug g.yang dkar yan na drin can med/ / snga dro bal dang pagasapas gsos/ / phyi dro sha dang khrag gisagasos/ / lug g.yang dkar drin lan 'jal thabasamed/ / zhing gru bzhi'i yan na drin can med/ / sngadro nayodang gro yisagasos/ / phyi dro bdud rtsi chang gisagasos/ / zhing gru bzhi'i drin lan 'jalathabasamed/ / yulapha ma'i yan na drin can med/ / snga dro brang gi nu masagasos/ / phyi dro zasadang za ma4gsos/ /yul pha ma'i drin lan 'jalathabasamed/ / ltabu ni pha ma'i bstod pa'o/ /yang smon lam zhu ba'i glu la'ang / stod gan na dkar yag gangasakyi rdzong / /rdzong re re seng ge 'gying sared/ / seng dkar mor g.yural 'dzomasasared/ / sagan na4skye ba'i smon lam 'debs/ / smad gan na tsho drug sde ba'i rdzong / / sde re re stag shar skye sared/ / stag sha rar dpa' rtsal 'dzoms sared/ / yogan nasaskye ba'i smon lama'adebs/ / zhesabaltar yul mchog gyur gyi gan4la bstod pa dang sade ru skye ba'i smon lamazhu ba ltabu'o/ / glu kha mtshar gyi skor lazhib tu brjod na da dung cung mang pobarjod rgyu ༵da mod/ ༵na te rgya4par brjod na mang par dogasanasa'adi tsayogyis—ga paṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ//sal/ mtshon na'ang 'gro rimaphalacher glu khamatshar gyi 'gro rim dang mtshungasashing / glu ba glu ma'i len stang4kyang gong zhu'i khamatshar hūm̐ ༵na

a mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/yin la rjes ma'i sho lo ka ni dpe can yin/ bstod pa'i gzhi ni a khu'i bsod nams che ba de yin/ yang drin lan zhu ba'i skor gyi nang du'ang tshig 'di lta bu zhig yod pa ste/ lug g.yang dkar yan na drin can med/ / snga dro bal dang pags pas gsos/ / phyi dro sha dang khrag gis gsos/ / lug g.yang dkar drin lan 'jal thabs med/ / zhing gru bzhi'i yan na drin can med/ / snga dro nas dang gro yis gsos/ / phyi dro bdud byu chang gis gsos/ / zhing gru bzhi'i drin lan 'jal thabs med/ / yul pha ma'i yan na drin can med/ / snga dro brang gi nu mas gsos/ / phyi dro zas dang za mas gsos/ /yul pha ma'i drin lan 'jal thabs med/ / lta bu be+e pha ma'i bstod pa'o/ /yang smon la ma zhu ba'i glu la'ang / stod gan na dkar yag gangs kyi rdzong / /rdzong re re seng ge 'gying sa red/ / seng dkar mor g.yur la 'dzomasasared/ / sa gan nas skye ba'i smon lam 'debs/ / smad gan na tsho drug sde ba'i sdong / / sde re re stag shar bye sa red/ / stag sha rar dpa' rtsal 'dzoms sa red/ / sa gan nas bye ba'i smon lam 'debs/ / zhes pa ltar yul mchog gyur gyi gnas la bstod pa dang sa de ru skye ba'i sgon lam zhu ba lta6'o/ / glu kha mtshar gyi skor la zhib tu brjod na da dung cung mang po brjod rgyu yo da mod/ 'on te rgyas par brjod na mang par dogs nas 'di tsam gyisachog par bya'o/ /glu shags la mtshon na'ang 'gro rim phal cher glu kha mtshar gyi 'gro rim dang mtshungs shing / glu ba glu ma'i len stangs kyang gong zhu'i kha mtshar gyi len 357

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/stangasadangamatshungasapa yin/ glu shagasakyi gzhan dang mimatshungasapa'i khyadacho4gtso bo ni/ thabasabargya jusastong gisapha rol po gnon padang rang nyidalabasto da pa/ da dung khashoma'athenapa/ gcig lan gcig dang gnyisalanaganyisabyed pa/ galasrid shagasayod kyang lan ma phog na phan tshun gyisakha4mi len pa/ glu tshig kyang khamatshar dang mi'adra bar shin tu rno zhing mtshang laphog pa zhig yin pa de red/ dper na/ nga rdza mgo skor re 'gro rgyu yin/ /khyod broser ru dmar 'dzin rgyu yin/ / shing bra ma'i sna gcu sprod rgyu yin/ /zhing 'debasapa'i sgo zog byed rgyu yin/ / nga rgya rdzong nagasala'agro rgyu yin/ / stag thig lecan zhig 'dzin rgyu yin/ / sker lcag4thag sngonapo'ajog rgyu yin/ / khyod bzung nasasgo khyi byed rgyu yin/ / nga khromapa'i gralala'agro rgyu yin/ / shagasalen mkhan zhig la gtug rgyu yin/ / shagasablangasanasaphug labartsargyu yin/ / khyod khromapa ngo tsha gtod rgyu yin/ / ltabu dab/gyang kha'i bya pho dkar po'adi/ / khyod 'phur rgyu med lagashog rdeb cig /gyang rting phag ma nag rog ma/ / khyod bzho rgyu med la ngur rgyu zhig / khrom gyi glu bshobarkyalabo/ / glu len rgyu med lalurgyu zhig / zhesapa ltabu'i tshig tsub cing gnad laphogapa'i nabadon gyi glu shagasamang po yod/glu shagasablangasan4phan tshun gyi rgyal phamathag gcod dka' ba'i skabasasu/ glu bgazhan zhig gisabar 'byed kyi glu len pa'i dpe yang yod/dper na/ nagasargya rdzong yag gi dkyil khug nas/ / stag dang stag mo thug bkā~X ༵la/ / nga stagaphrug yong nasabar zhig 'byed/ / nga stag phrug khango

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/stangs dang mtshungs pa yin/ glu shags kyi gzhan dang ba mtshungs pa'i ga chosagatso bo ni/ thabs brgya jus stong gisapha rol po gnon pa dang rang nyid la bsto da pa/ da dung kha shom 'then pa/ gcig lan gcig dang gnyis lanaganyis byed pa/ gal srid shags yod kyang lan ma phog na phan tshun gyis khasami len pa/ glu tshig kyang khamatshar dang ba 'dra bar shin tu no zhing mtshang laphog pa zhig yin pa de red/ dper na/ nga rdza mgo skor re 'gro rgyu yin/ /khyod bre ser ru dmar 'dzin rgyu yin/ / shing bra ma'i sna gcu sprod rgyu yin/ /zhing 'debs pa'i sgo zog byed rgyu yin/ / nga rgya rdzong nags la 'gro rgyu yin/ / stag thig le can zhig 'dzin rgyu yin/ / sker lcags thag sngon yo'ajog rgyu yin/ / khyod bzung nas sgo khye byed rgyu yin/ / nga khrom pa'i gralala'agro rgyu yin/ / shags len mkhan zhig la gtug rgyu yin/ / shags blangasanas phug labs rgyu yin/ / khrod khrom pa ngo tsha gtod rgyu yin/ / lta ste dang /gyang kha'i bya pho dkar po 'di/ / khyod 'phur rgyu med la gshog rdeb cig /khyang rting phag ma nag rog ma/ / khro'i bzho rgyu sted la ngur rgyu zhig / khrom gyi glu ba sho brkyal bo/ / glu len rgyu sted las rgyu zhig / zhes pa lta bu'i tshig tsub cing gnad la phog pa'i nang don gyi glu shags ma/nga po yod/glu shags blangs nas phan tshun gyi rgyal pham thag gcod dka' ba'i skabs su/ glu ba gzhan zhig gis bar 'byed kyi glu len pa'i dpe yang yod/dper na/ nags rgya rdzong yag gi dkyil khug nas/ / stag dang stag mo thug btang thal/ / nga stag phrug yong nas bar zhig 'byed/ / nga stag phrug kha ngo 358

a mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/yod ni byos/ / khrom chen po'i dkyilagyi gralabar nas/ / khyod glu bganyisaka thug btang thal/ / nga khromapalangasan4bar zhig 'byed/ / nga khrom pa kha ngo yod ni byos/ / ltabu'i bar 'byed kyi glu blangasapasan/ phyogasaganyisaku4de mthag mtshamasa'ajog dgo4pa'i lugasasrolayang gna' nasad lta'i bar ma nyamasapar yod do/ /lagazhas ni rang re'i chab 'gag yula'adir shin tudar snga bar ma zad/ dar rgya yang ha cang che/ de ni pho mo'i brtse dung mtshonabyed kyi thabasalam zhig yin la/ pho mo'i brtse dung sbrelabyed kyi zam pa zhig kyang yin/rgyun ldan gyi 'gro rimaltar na lagazhasa'adi gtso bo na gzhonarnamasakyisalen pa'i srol yod na'ang rgan dar gyisakyang blang4na michog rgyu ci yang med/yin na'ang rang gi pha ma dang ming sring nye 'brelabar du ngo srung dgosapasan la gzhasalen michog pa yin/ lagazhasala'agro rimamang poyod pa ste/thog mar 'go rtsomapa'i skor len pa dang / de'i 'phror mthun pa'i skor len pa/ de nasadran pa'i skor dang smreng ba'i skor len padang / mjug tu bde mo 'jog pa'i skor lenapa'i rimabayod/ gshamadu 'gro rimade dag gsalaborangesapa'i phyir dper brjod re bkod na 'di ltaste/ 'go rtsomapa'i lagazhasani/ / khalagazhasalen na la gzhasalen/ / khal gzhasadagung sngon gnam la len/ / 'brug pho chung thugasala'abab ni len/ / khalagazhasalen na la gzhasalen/ / khal gzhasasde chen grong lalen/ / sde chen poyogazur med ni len/ / rogasachung lo'i thugasala'abab ni len/ 3/5༈bu
