a mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/yod ni byos/ / khrom chen po'i dkyil gyi gral bar nas/ / khyod glu ba gnyisaka thug btang thal/ / nga khrom pa langs nas bar zhig 'byed/ / nga khrom pa kha ngo yod ni byos/ / lta bu'i bar 'byed kyi glu blangs pas na/ phyogs gnyisakas de ma thag mtshams 'jog dgos pa'i lugs srol yang gna' nas da lta'i bar ma nyams par yod do/ /la gzhas ni rang re'i chab 'gag yul 'dir shin tu dar snga bar ma zad/ dar rgya yang ha cang che/ de ni pho mo'i brtse dung maྈ byed kyi thabasalam zhig yin la/ pho mo'i brtse dung sbrel byed kyi zam pa zhig kyang yin/rgyun ldan gyi 'gro rim ltar na lagazhas 'di gco bo na gzhon rnams kyis len pa'i srol yod na'ang rgan dar gyis kyang blangs na mi chog rgyu ci yang sted/yin na'ang rang gi pha ma dang ming sring nye 'brel bar du ngo srung dgos pas na la gzhas len mi chog pa yin/ la gzhas la 'gro rim mang po yod pa ste/thog mar 'go rtsom pa'i skor len pa dang / de'i 'phror mthun pa'i skor len pa/ de nas dran pa'i skor dang smreng ba'i skor len pa dang / mjug tu bde mo 'jog pa'i skor len pa'i rim pa yod/ gsham du 'gro rim de dag gsal bor nges pa'i phyir dper brjod re bkod na 'di lta ste/ 'go rtsom pa'i la gzhas ni/ / khal gzhas len na la gzhas len/ / khal gzhas dgung sngon gnam/ la len/ / 'brug pho chung thugs la 'bab ni len/ / khal gzhasalen na la gzhas len/ / kha la gzhas sde chen grong la len/ / sde chen po yogazur med ni len/ / shogs chung lo'i thugs la 'bab ni len/ / lta bu 359

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang / mthun pa'i lagazhasani/ nga 'thad nasadungasani zhig la/ / thang dkar rgod la dungasagi / nga rang gar dungayoni cir yin/ / khyodasgromadog ser po gser red/ / khyod sgro sked sngon po g.yurd/ / khyod sgrorting dkar po dung red/ / nga dungayodon rtsa ba de red/ / nga 'thad nasadungasani zhig la/ / chung dusarogasalor dungasagi / nga rang gar dungasani cir yin/ / khyod phar 'khor smyug ma'i mda' red/ / khyod tshur 'khor bco lnga'i zla red/ / tshig bshad na rje btsun mgur red/ / nga dungasadon rtsa bde red/ / ltabu dang / dran pa'i skor ni/ rta dran pa'i lo rabasayobashad/ / rta dran pa'i lo rabasabashad na/ / srab sil ma'i mgo lung stong ba red/ / sga bosang sga khog 'khyagasapared/ / rta dran pa'i lo rabasade 'dra red/ / rogasadran pa'i lo rab4ma bshad/ / rogasadran pa'i lo rabasabashad na/ / gdan gru bzhi'i phyed ka stong ba red/ / sha mchen pa'i ngo 5'khyagasapa red/ / rogasadran pa'i lo rabasade 'dra red/ / ltabu dang / semasar+sāng ba'i skor gyi lagazhasani/ na khra risan lung gong man/ / nga skyid ki yod dang sdug gi yod/ / nga lasaskyid spang lung khug red/ / nga lasasdug 'do ba rig gi med/ / rig gi med rung brjed gi med/ / sagar song sanasagleng gi yod/ / na khra na lung zholam na/ / nga skyid ki yod dang sdug gi yod/ / nga lasaskyid sdechen dkyil red/ / nga la4sdug rog4lo rig gi med/ / rig gi med rung brjed ki med/ / sagar so~X ṭ+wānasagleng gi yod/ / ltabu/ bde mo 'jog pa'i skor gyi la gzhasani/

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang / mthun pa'i la gzhas ni/ nga 'thad nas dungs ni zhig la/ / bang dkar rgod la dungs gi / nga rang gar dungs ni cir yin/ / khyodasgomadog ser po gser red/ / khyod sgo sked sngon po g.yu red/ / khyod sgo rting dkar po dung red/ / nga dungs don rtsa ba de red/ / nga 'thad nas dungasani zhig la/ / chung dus rogs lor dungs gi / nga rang gar dungs ri cir yin/ / khyod phar 'khor sprug ma'i mda' red/ / khyod tshur 'khor bco lnga'i zla red/ / tshig bshad na rje btsun mgur red/ / nga dungs don rtsa ba de red/ / lta bu dang / dran pa'i skor ni/ rta dran pa'i lo rabs ma bshad/ / rta dran pa'i lo rabs bshad na/ / srab sil ma/'i mgo 'u nga stong ba red/ / sga be+e sang sga khog 'khyags pa red/ / rta dran pa'i lo rabs de 'dra red/ / rogs dran pa'i lo rabs ma bshad/ / rogs dran pa'i lo rabs bshad na/ / gdan gru bzhi'i phyed ka stong ba red/ / sha mching pa'i ngo mi 'khyags pa red/ / rogs dran pa'i lo rabs de 'dra red/ / lta bu dang / sems smreng ba'i skor gyi la gzhas ni/ na khra ris na lung gong ma na/ / nga smyud ki yod dang sdug gi yod/ / nga las byad spang lung khug red/ / nga las sdug 'do ba rig gi med/ / rig gi med rung brjed gi med/ / sa gar song sa nas gleng gi yod/ / na khra na 'u nga zhol ma na/ / nga skyid ki yod dang sdug gi yod/ / nga las skyid sde chen dkyil red/ / nga lasasdug rogs lo rig gi tsed/ / rig gi sped rung brjed ki med/ / sa gar song sa nas gleng gi yod/ / lta bu/ bde mo 'jog pa'i skor zu la gzhas ni/360

a mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/bde mo gcig dang bde mo/ / mtsho g.yas ru g.yon ru bde mo/ / don dam pas mtsho snying bde mo/ / bde po gcig dang bde mo/ / sde g.yas ru g.yon ru bde mo/ / don dam pas rogs lo bde mo/ / lta bu mang po yod kyang 'di tsam rgyas la gzhas kyi 'gro rim dang nang don bcas rags tsam zhig go bar gyis shigalnga ba/ 'bras dkar skor/de yang 'bras dkar 'jib len bgyid pa 'di mdo dbus kham sagasum du gna' nas bzung dar khyab tu song yod cing / 'jib len gyi khyad chos dang 'gro lugs sogs sa cha gang yin yang che phyogs nas mthun pa dang chung phyogs sa mi mthun pa'ang yo da do/ /spri mdo chab 'gag yul du dar khyab tu song yod pa'i 'bras dkar la mtshon na/ ma/tsho sngon gyi mgo log dang yul shul sa khul du dar khyab che ba'i 'bras dkar gyi tshig dang 'jib stangs la phal cher mthun na'ang mi mthun pa'i khyad chos kyang yod pa ste/ dper na/ chab 'gag sa char 'bras dkar bshad mkhan gyi rgan po'i lus la phrug lwa gyon te lag tu dbyug pa zhig bzung nas mang tshogs kyi dkyil du yong zhing dgye dbye dang sgur sgur lan mang bgyisapa dang mtshungs su/ de ring nyi ma bzang po/ skar ma bzang po/ bkra shisapa'i nyi ma/ bde skyid 'dzoms pa'i nyi ma zhes 'go rtsom blta bu'o/ / yul shul sa khul du 'khrab len bgyid pa'i 'bras dkar gyi khyad chos la mtshon na/'bras dkar bshad mkhan gyi rgan po'i lus la kha mdog dkar po'i lwa ba gyon 361

a mdo chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rigaskoral rags tsamadapyad pa/bde mo gcig dang bde mo/ / mtsho g.yasaru g.yon ru bde mo/ / don dmapayomatsho snying bde mo/ / bde mogacig dang bde mo/ / sde g.yasaru g.yon ru bde mo/ / don dmapasarogasalobade mo/ / ltabu mang po yod kyang 'di ṭ+wāṃmaṭ+wāṃsal gzhasakyi 'grorimadang nang don bcasaragasatsam zhig go bar ོ4 ༵ ba 'bras dkar skor/de yang 'brasadakar 'khrab len bgyid pa 'di mdo dbus khamasagasum du gna' na4bzung dar khyab tusong yod cing / 'khrab len gyi khyad chosadang 'gro lugasasogasasacha gang yin yang che phyogasanasamathun pa dang chung phyogasasumi mthun pa'ang yod do/ /amado chab 'gag yul du dar khyab tu song yod pa'i 'brasadakar la mtshon na/ mtsho sngon gyi mgo log dang yul shulayokhuladu dar khyab che ba'i 'brasadakar gyi tshig dang 'khrab stangasal phalacher mthun na'ang mi mthun pa'i khyad cho4kyang yod pa ste/ dper na/ chab 'gag sachar 'brasadakar bshad mkhan gyi rgan po'i lusal phrug lwa gyon te lag tu dbyug pa zhig bzung nasamang tshogasakyi dkyil du yong zhing dgye dgye dang sgur sgur lan mang bgyisapa dang mtshung4su/ de ring nyi mabazang po/ skar yobazang po/ bkra shisapa'i nyi ma/ bde skyid 'dzomasapa'i nyi mazhesa'ago rtsom paltabu'o/ / yul shul sakhuladu 'khrab len bgyid pa'i 'brasadakar gyi khyad cho4lamatshon na/'brasadakar bshad mkhan gyi rgan po'i lusal kha mdog dkar po'i wa~X ༈na

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa dang / gdong lazhal 'bag gyon pa/ rkang par gna' lham gyon pa/phrag latā len 'phen pa/ lag tu dbyug pa 'dzin pa bca4kyi khyad chosayod pa de lags/ spyir 'brasadakar gyi nang don la yang sngon gyi ma gzhi'i stebadusaskab4gsar ba'i nang don 'ga' re bsnan 'dug la/ lo re'i dbyar kā/ t+t+waṃ rgyug dga' ston gyi skabasasu'abrasadakar sakhrab len bgyid pa'i srol yul khamasasosoru 'khrab pa'i 'brasadakar gyi nang don phal cher gcig mtshungasayin yang mi mtshungasapa 'ga' re'ang yod/ chab 'gag yuladu dar rgya che ba'i 'bra4dkar ni nga 'brasadakar bsam pa'i don grub yin zhesapa de lags/ gshamadu 'brasadakar gyi nang don gtso bo ragasatsamazhig bkod na 'di ltaste/o/ nyon cig nga 'bra4dkar rgan po zer ba 'di/ / nga ma song sacha gcig kyang med/ / tshig mthosapa la gnyisakyang med/ / nga 'brasadakar rgan por bshad pa mang / / ngasabashad pa'i tshig la nyan rgyu yod/ /lhadakon mchog gsumapo lhargyal lo/ / nga 'brasadakar bsam pa'i don grub yin/ / nga 'brasaphrug yid bzhin nor bu yin/ / nga da nangasayong yong gang nasayong / / nga da nangasayong yong shar nasayong / / shar rdo rje semasadapa'i mdun nasayong / / dgung nyi mdang ni mnyam du yong / / nga do nub 'gro 'gro gang la 'gro/ / nga do nub 'gro 'gro nub la 'gro/ / nub snaX ༵ mtha' yasamadun la'agro/ / gser ser po'i 'khar rnga rdung sar

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa dang / gdong la zhal 'bag gyon pa/ rkang par gna' lham khyon pa/phrag la tā len 'phen pa/ lag tu dbyug pa 'dzin pa bcas kyi khyad chos ngo da pa de lags/ spyir 'bras dkar gyi nang don la yang sngon gyi ma gzhi'i steng dus skabs gsar ba'i nang don 'ga' re bsnan 'dug la/ lo re'i dbyar kha'i rta rgyug dga' ston gyi skabs sa 'bras dkar 'khrab len bgyid pa'i srol yod do/ /yul khams so so ru 'khrab pa'i 'bras dkar gyi nang don phal cher gcig mtshungs yin yang mi mtshungs pa 'ga' re'ang yo da/ chab 'gag yu'i du dar rgya che ba'i 'bras dkar ni nga 'bras dkar bsam pa'i don grub yin zhes pa de lags/ gsham du 'bras dkar gyi nang don gtso bo rags tsam zhig bkod na 'di lta ste/o/ nyon cig nga 'bras dkar rgan po zer ba 'di/ / nga ma song sa cha gcig kyang med/ / tshig ma thos pa la gnyis kyang med/ / nga 'brasadakar rgan por bshad pa mang / / ngas bshad pa'i tshig la nyan rgyu ngo da/ /lha dkon mchog gsum po lha rgyal lo/ / nga 'bras dkar bsam pa'i don grub yin/ / nga 'bras phrug yid bzhin nor bu yin/ / nga da nangs yo nga yong gang nas yong / / nga da nangs yong yong shar nas yong / / shar rdo rje sems dpa'i mdun nas yong / /dgung nyi ma dang ni mnyam du yo nga / / nga do nub 'gro 'gro gang la 'gro/ / nga do nub 'gro 'gro nub la 'gro/ / nub snang ba mtha' yas mdun la 'gro/ / gser ser po'i 'khar rnga rdung sar 362

amado chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/'gro/ / dngul dkar po'i mchod rten bzhengasasar 'gro/ / lhasamachagasalhasachags/ / lhasargya mtsho'i khanasachags/ / lhasa'i rten gyi gtso bo ni/ / lhajo bo yid bzhin nor bured/ / lhadakon mchog gsumapolhargyalalo/ / ngasa'abrasadakar bshad na 'brasadakar bshad/ / nga 'brasadakar bsam pa'i don grub yin/ / nga 'bra4phrug yid bzhin nor bu yin/ / ki bswo bswo chen po lhargyal lo/ / lhuchen lhuchung bcu gnyisayod/ / sgalatshigasabazhi bcu zhe dgu yod/ / ding ru na chung bco brgyad yod/ / mdzub gu rgyal ba rigs lnga yod/ / yathod shelagyi melong yin/ / dbu skurgya lcang lo ma yin/ / smin mdom nag mchong 'dra yin/ / mig gnyisaskar chen shar 'dra yin/ / rna ba gser gyi melong 'dra/ / mne gser gyi sga ru 'dra/ /akha gser gyi pa tra 'dra/ / ma kha dngulagyi pa tra 'dra/ / kha'i dung soban chung bsgrigasa'adra yin/ / lce dar ma glog dmar 'khyug 'dra yin/ / yol kyog mchod rten brtsigasa'adra yin/ / sna khung zangasathur gshib 'dra yin/ / glo ba gangasari dkar po yin/ / mchin pa rdza ri smug po yin/ /mkhal lolhaphrug klu phrug yin/ / rgyu ma lhaklu'i zhagasapa yin/ / nga'i thod pa'i dkyil gyi me long 'di/ / orgyan pad ma'i cha lug4yin/ / nga'i sna mgor mgron bu btagasapa 'di/ / atsa ra yicha lugasayin/ / ltabu dang / / nga'i lag la bzung ba'i dbyug pa 'di/ / lha.orgyan pad ma'i sgrub shing red/ / rje rin po che yiphyag rten red/ / gong margyalapo'i khrimayoshing red/ / da 'di labastod pa eyod zer/ / da 'di labastod pa~Xre

am do chab 'gag yul du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/'gro/ / dngul dkar po'i mchod rten bzhengs sar 'gro/ / lhas ma chagasalhas chags/ / lhas rgya mtsho'i kha nas chags/ / lhasa'i rten gyi gtso bo ni/ / lha jo bo yid bzhin nor bu red/ / lha dkon mchog gsum po lha rgyal lo/ / ngas 'bras dkar bshad na 'bras dkar bshad/ / nga 'bras dkar bsam pa'i don grub yin/ / nga 'bras phrug yid bzhin nor bu yin/ / ke bsgo bslo chen po lha rgyal lo/ / lha chen 5chung bcu gnyis yod/ / sgal tshigs bzhi bcu zhe dgu yod/ / ding ru na chung bco brgyad yod/ / mdzub gu rgyal ba rigs lnga yod/ / tha thod shel gyi tshe long yin/ / dbu skra rgya lcang lo ma yin/ / smin ma dom nag mchong 'dra yin/ / mig gnyis skar chen shar 'dra yin/ / rna ba gser gyi me long 'dra/ / ma ba gser gyi sga du 'dra/ /mi kha gser gyi pa tra 'dra/ / ma kha dngul gyi pa tra 'dra/ / kha'i dung sob na chung bsgrigs 'dra yin/ / lce dar ma glog dmar 'khrug 'dra yin/ / tshe' kyog ma ra rten brtsigs 'dra yin/ / sna khung zangs thur gshib 'dra yin/ / glo ba gangs ri dkar po yin/ / mtshon pa rdza ri sprug po yin/ /mkhal ma lha phrug klu phrug yin/ / rgyu ma lha klu'i zhags pa yin/ / nga'i thod pa'i dkyil gyi me 'o nga 'di/ / o rgyan pad ma'i cha lugs yin/ / nga'i sna mgor mgron bu btags pa 'di/ / spri tsa ra a cha lugs yin/ / lta bu dang / / nga'i lag la bzung ba'i dbyug pa 'di/ / lha cha rgyan pad ma/'i sgrub shing red/ / rje rin po che a phyag rten red/ / gong ma rgyal po'i khrims shing red/ / da 'di la bstod pa e yod zer/ / da 'di la bsto da pa los re 363

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yod/ / 'di mi rgod klad pa rdung byed red/ / khye rgan 'gram pa gtor byed red/ / nga 'bras dkar lam gyi 'gro rogs red/ / lha 'dre dmal 'dogs byed red/ / ces pa lta bu'i dbyug pa'i bshad pa dang / nga ngang paser po ma yin yang / / mtsho che chung brgyud te 'phur nas yong / / gsung skad re re bsgrags nas yong / / yang e bden mi bden grags na shes/ /nga bong / nga bong / nga bong / nga pho rog nag chung ma yin yang / / ri mgo re re brgyud nas yong / / gshog rtsal re re ngom nas yong / / yang chabade na mi bden 'phur na shes/ / ko ling ling / ko ling ling / nga khu byug sngon yom/ yin yang / / nags tshal re re brgyud nas yong / / skad snyan mo'i gsung skad bsgrags nas yong / / chabade na mi bden grags na shes/ / ki ko ki ko ki ko nga ra ma rgya mo ma yin yang / / sa ste tog re re zos nas yong / /ngas 'ba' skad re re bsgrags nas yong / / chabade na mi bden 'ba' nashes/ / mes tshe e/ mas e e/ rgyal lo rgyal lo lha rgyal lo/ / ki bswo bswochen po lha rgyal lo/ / bkra shis bde legs phun sum/ tshogs/ / nga 'brasadakar mi 'dug 'gro rgyu yin/ / nga 'bras dkar rgan pos kha g.yang 'bod/ / rta ra gong ma rta yis bkang / / nor ra bar ma nor gyisabakang / / lug ra zhol ma lug gis bkang / / 'brog pa rnams kyi mar g.yang shog / rong ba rnams kyi nas g.yang shog / 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs shing / / 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / / bde legasaphun sum tshogs pa rnams/ / yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pa 364

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yod/ / 'di mirgod klad pa rdung byed red/ / khyi rgan 'gramapa gtor byed red/ / nga 'brasadakar lam gyi 'gro rogasared/ / lha 'dre dmala'adogs byed red/ / cesapaltabu'i dbyug pa'i bshad pa dang / nga ngangabaser po ma yin yang / / mtsho che chung brgyud te 'phur nasayong / / gsung skad re re bsgragasanasayong / / yang obaden mibaden gragasan shes/ /nga bong / nga bong / nga bong / nga pho rog nag chung ma yin yang / / ri mgo re re brgyud nasayong / / gshogartsalare re ngom nasayong / / yang chabaden mibaden 'phur na shes/ / ko ling ling / ko ling ling / nga khu byug sngon pom yin yang / / nagasatshal re re brgyud nasayong / / skad snyan mo'i gsung skad bsgragasanasayong / / ebaden mi bden gragasan shes/ / ki ko ki no ki ko nga ra ma rgya yomayin yang / / 〈rtsi tog re re zosanasayong / /ngasa'aba' skad re re bsgragasanasayong / / ebaden mi bden 'ba' na shes/ / mesaskyesa.e/ mesacesa.e/ rgyal lo rgyal lo lha/rgyal lo/ / ki bswo bswochen po lhargyal lo/ / bkra shisabade leg4phun sumatshogs/ / nga 'brasadakar mi 'dug 'gro rgyu yin/ / nga 'brasadakar rgan posakha g.yang 'bod/ / rta ra gong marta yisabakang / / nor ra bar ma nor gyisabakang / / lug ra zholamalug gisabakang / / 'brog pa rnamasakyi mar g.yang shog / rong ba rnamasakyi nasagayang shog / 'jig rten bde zhing lolegasashing / / 'bru rnam4'phel zhing cho4'pheladang / / bde legasaphunā spyam tshogasapa rnams/ / yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / cesapa

2 mdo chab 'gag yu la du dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/lta bu'o/ /gong zhu'i 'bras dkar las zhib tu dpyad na der 'bras dkar rgan po thog ma ji ltar yong ba dang yong don ci zhig yin pa/ rang lus kyi phyi'i dbang bo thams cad dang nang gi don lnga sgod drug re re 'grel bshad bgyisapa/ lag tu bzung ba'i dbyug pa'i phan yon brjod pa/ da dung khong nyid yong ba'i skabs sumatsho che chung dang / ri mgo re re/ nags tshal re re bcas brgyud nas yo nga ba'i lo rgyus bshad yo da la/ gal srid chabade na mi bden bsams na/ be+e ngang ba dang pho rog khu byug ra ma rgya mo/ bcas pa grags na shes zer nas 'dab chags bya dang dud 'gro ra ma bcas kyi ngag tshabacos nas grags pa dang 'ba' ba ste/ ngo mtshar gyi ltad mo nyams dang lda na pa ston zhing / mjug mthar mi phyugs thams cad bde zhing rgyas pa dang /lo yag skal bzang yong ba'i bkra shis smon lam mam khag yang phun sum tshogasapa bsgra gas byung / mi rnams kyis bshad pa ltar na/ 'bras dkar ni bsam pa'i don grub dang yid bzhin nor bu'i mtshon byed cig yin pas/ lo rer byad pa med par sde ba dang tsho ba'i nang du bshad na/ phyugs la god kha med pa dang mil na tsha sked pa/ lo lon thams cad tshe ring ba/ gzhon pa thamasacad kha las rlung rta dar ba/ 'bru rigs sna lnga'i lo legs yong nges yin zhesapa'i bshad tshal yod do/ /drug pa/ gling ge sar sgrung gi skor/gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni bod rigs thun mong gi zo gros kyi rtsal 365

amado chaba'agag yuladu dar ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/ltabu'o/gong/ zhu'i 'brasadakar lasazhibatudapyad na der 'brasadakar rgan po thog ma ji ltar yong ba dang yong don ci zhig yin pa/ rang lusakyi phyi'i dbang bo tham4cad dang nang gi don lnga snod drug re re 'grel bshad bgyisapa/ lag tu bzung ba'i dbyug pa'i phan yon brjod pa/ da dung khong nyid yong ba'i skabasasumatsho che chung dang / ri mgo re re/ nagasatshal re re bcasabargyud nasayong ba'i lo rgyusabashad yod la/ galasrid ebaden mi bden bsamasan/ bya ngang bdang pho rog khu byug ra ma rgya mo bca4pa gragasan shesazer nasa'adab chagasabya dang dud 'gro ra ma bcasakyi ngag tshababyasanasagragasapa dang 'ba' ba ste/ ngo mtshar gyi ltad yonyamayodang ldan pa ston zhing / mjug mthar miphyugasathamasacad bde zhing rgya4pa dang /lo yag skal bzang yong ba'i bkra shisasmon lam/ mam kha g.yang phun sum tshogasapa bsgra gsabyung / mirnams kyisabashad pa ltar na/ 'brasadakar ni bsam pa'i don grub dang yid bzhin nor bu'i mtshon byed cig yin pas/ lo rer chad pa med par ldob dang tsho ba'i nang du bshad na/ phyugasal god kha med pa dang mil na tsha med pa/ lo lon thamasacad tshe ring ba/ gzhon pa thamasacad khal4rlung rta dar ba/ 'bru rigasasna lnga'i lo legasayong ngesayin zhesapa'i bshad tshul yod do/ /drug pa/ gling ge sar sgrung gi skor/gling rje ge sar rgyalapo'i sgrung ni bod rig4thunamong gi blogro4hūṃ ṭ+wāṃl

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/las thon pa'i byung brjod snyan ngag ring po zhig yin zhing / rang re'i kha ba'i yal 'dir dus snga yonas dar rgya shin tu che ba dang ma/nga tshogs kyis kyang dga' bas chen po byed bzhin mchis/ da lta lag tu son pa'i sgrung dpe yang nyis brgya lhag la bud yod cing / de dag las sgrung dpe brgyad khru lhag par skrun bgyis nas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du bkram pa yin/ da dung sgrung pa rnams kyis bshad shes pa'i sgrung rnams lhan du brtsis pa na sgrung grangs bzhi brgya lhag la skeb thub/ de'i phyir ge sar gyi sgrung 'di rang re'i rgyal khab kyisagaces nor du bstes nas 'chol sdud dang dag sgrig yig sgyur/ par sgrun/zhib 'jug bcas byed bzhin yod par ma zad/ phyi'i rgya' khab phal cher sum — lhag gis kyang ched gnyer gyi las khungs btsugs te zhib 'jug pa gtan khel bgyis nas ge sar sgrung legs sgrig dang zhib 'jug byed nu/sasamachis/ge sar sgrung gi brjod bya'i don gyi cha nas blta kyis/na'ang de ni bod gna' rabs kyi chab srid dang dmag don/ rig gnas/ chos 'u gas/dmangs sros bcas mtshon pa'i dpa' bo'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan ngag ring rngo zhig yin/ der gleng ge sar rgyal po gtsos1nga gi dpa' rtul sum cusabatsan po gnya' na4gnon pa dang dbul phongs mtha' nas skyong zhing /phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi btul te rdzong chen bco brgyad dang rdzong phran grangasasped cham la phab pa'i lo rgyus dag gsal ler brjod yod/ 'jig rten khadaper bod mi re'i kha na sgrung re zer ba ltar/ gling ge sar gyi sgrung ni bod 366
