gcod pa don grub dang snying bom ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/r+ṣa zhig yin la/ 'dis mi dmangs mdun skyod dang / mi rigs kyi bsayo—1 13 zur/phyo /ra14111 (mo /ce 'a la rgyas 'byung ba 'a gsal nus shugs na da nga / sgyu rtsal gyi byed nus kyang ga 'phags can 'byung du bcug rang zhing gi rgya che ba'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi bya ba gnyer mkhan dag gis dmangs khrod rtsom rig dang dmangs srol rig gnas 'a sdud/ myur skyob/ zhib 'jug bcasakyi thad la 'bad brtson lhar len byas shing / rin thang lda na pa'i rtsom rig gi nor bu 'di dag srung skyob byed par mdzad rjes bla na sked pa bskrun yod/rtsom pa po dang sgyu rtsal pa mang po zhig dmangs khrod kyi 'tsho bar zab zhugasam dzad pa dang / zab zhugs khrod nying bcud rnam sa sdud len byas te ga du 'phags pa'i brtsams chos gang mang bcoms pas/ rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu snyan pa rlung ltar khyab yod/bcos sgyur sgo 'byed kye gom sta bas je myur dang / nub rgyud gsar a r+ṣa po'i go skabs legs po skebs pa dang bstun nas/ rang zhing gi dmangs khrod rig rtsal pa'i 'gan 'khur yang je lcer 'gro bzhin yo da la sngar sped kyi dka' ngal mang po'ang mdun du bsham sa yod pas/ phyis su nged cag rnams kyis bya ba dag sngon las zhib tshags dang 'thus tshang can du gtong rgyu be+e gal 'gangs shin tu che/ da lta 'dzam gling dpal 'byor grub stangasagacig 'dus can du 'gyur bzhin pa'i skabs 'dir/ rig gnas mi rigasacan du 'gyur ba dang sa gnas can du 'gyur ba 'di ni dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab dag gis ra sprod byas pa'i lo rgyus kyi go rim gsar ba zhig yin la/ 'di 372

mtshosngon gyi dmangs khrodartsom rig sgyu rtsal skor gyi bsam gzhiga'adra'i skyi g.ya' ba'i go rimalagazhigasanas/ saganasarang gi gal che ba'i rig gnasakyi nang gsesate mirigasadamangasakhrod rig gnas la mtshon na/nge4par du sngar lasalhag pa'i sgo nasago rimamathon por spob dang / de sngog 'don dang srung skyob legasapo byed dgosashing / de 'dra byasan da gzod nga tsho krung hwa mi rigasakyi lo ngo lnga stong lhag gi dpalayon gyi rtsa ba rgya4te 'brasabu g.yur du za ba smin nasamirabasamang por 'byor phyug gi bde skyid bskrun thub/ yin na yang duyorabasagang lamatshon na'ang chesagal che ba ni lo rgyu4kyi dkyog mtshamasayin te/ dper na rang rgyal 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugasalazhugasarjesaphyi yong rig gnasakyi phog thug che stabs/mtsho sngon gyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal la mtshon na'ang go skabasabazang po zhig la 'phrad yod mod/ 'on te 'gran sdur drag po'i tsha rlabasala'ang 'phrad yod pa ltabu red/ de'i phyir/ mtsho sngon dmangasakhrod rig gnas de yang ji ltar 'tsho gnasabyed pa'i 'gag sgor thug yod/ spyir nga tshor sbyong brdar dang nyamasamyong la gomasache ba'i rig rtsal pa'i dpung sdezhig yod na yang /dka' khag mang po zhig gisang tsho'i mdun skyod dang 'phel rgyas la bkag 'gog thebs yod pas/ ngesapar du nan tan gyisathag gcod byed dgosapar 'dug gshamadu ngasagand don 'di'i thad du lhag bsamagyi re ba 'ga' 'don rgyu yin pas/ gal srid mi rig4pa'amami 'dang sayod tshe mdzub ston dag bcosaganang rog4zhu/dang po/ 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉gi bya bar shugasasnon zlo~Xte

mtsho sngon gyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig sgyu rtsal skor gyi bsam gzhiga'adra'i skyi g.yang ba'i go rim la gzhigs nas/ sa gnas rang gi gal che ba'i rig gnas kyi nang gses te mi rigs dmangs khrod rig gnas la mtshon na/nges par du sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas go rim mthon por sgob dang / de sngog 'don dang srung skyob legs po byed dgos shing / de 'dra byas na da gzod nga tsho krung hwa mi rigs kyi lo ngo lnga stong lhag gi dpal yon gyi rtsa ba rgyasate 'bras bu g.yur du za ba smin nas mi rabs mang por 'byor phyug gi bde skyid bskrun thub/ yin na yang dus rabs gang lamatshon na'ang ches gal che ba ni lo rgyus kyi dkyog ma/tsham lo yin te/ dper na rang rgyal 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzunas la zhugs rjes phyi yong rig gnas kyi phog thug che stabs/mtsho sngon gyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal la mtshon na'ang go skabs bzang po zhig la 'phrad yod mod/ 'on te 'gran sdur drag po'i tsha rlabs la'ang 'phrad yod pa lta bu red/ de'i phyir/ mtsho hro na dam/ngas khrod rig gnas de yang ji ltar 'tsho gnas byed pa'i 'gag sgor thug yo da/ spyir nga tshor spyong brdar dang nyams myong la gom/sa che ba'i rig rtsal pa'i dpung sde zhig yo da na yang /dka' khag ma/nga po zhig gisang tsho'i mdun skyod dang 'phel rgyas la bkag 'gog jebs yod pas/ nges par du nan tan gyis thag gcod byed dgos par 'dug gsham du ngas gnad don 'di'i thad du lhag bsam gyi re ba 'ga' 'don rgyu yin pas/ gal srid mi rigs pa'am mi 'dang sa yod tshe mdzub ston dag bcos gnang rogs zhu/dang po/ 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉gi be+e bar shugs sgon byas te 373

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'thus tshang can du btang nas/ sgrung bshad sgyu rtsal pa myur skyob dang srung skyob gang legs byed dgos/ ma/tsho sngon ni lo rgyus snyan rtsom ring mo〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung〉gi 'byung yul yin par ma zad/ sgrung gi 'tshol sdud dang myur skyob kyi be+e ba 'go rtsom pa ches snga shos kyi zhing chen nyag gcig khrung yin/ nga tshos lo ngo so drug lhag gi ring la dka' spyad 'bad brtson byed pa brgyud nas/ lo rgyus kyi shul bzhag khrod du gnas pa'i dgon sde'i khag gi shing dpar dang / dmangs khrod du khyab pa'i lag bris ma/ da dung ge sar sgrung sna kha brgya lhag bshad thub pa'i sgrung pa rnyed cing / kho tshos bshad pa'i sgrung sna mang po sgra phab dang / dag sgrig par skrun bcas bgyis yod pa red/de'i nang nas kyang rgyal khab kyi gces nor zhes mtshan snyan kyi ba dan phyogasabazhir g.yo ba'i sgrung pa tshe ring dbang 'dus mchog ni sgrung sna mi gcig pa120lha ga bshad thub pa'i sgyu rtsal pa phul du byung ba zhig yin/ deng skabasang tshos sgrung sna bcu gcig tsam sgra ra blangs shing / sgrung sna drug tsam dag sgrig byas zin/ sgrung sna gnyis dngos su par skrun byas te spyi tshogs steng 'grem spel byas/ yin na'ang rang zhing gi ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug la lo rer sgor khri gcig tsam yang sted pas/ 'di 'dra'i gzhi khyon che ba'i rnam grangs zhig la mtshon na mtshan mo' srin 4 ste khyer gyi nus pa lta bu las thon kyin med/sgrung pa tshe ring dbang 'dus mchog la mtshon na/ dgung lo bdun cu lhag la thon pa dang / sbu lus lo re nas lo rer ji sdug tu 'gro bzhin yod pas/ nga tshos myur du khong gi sgrung sna dag sgrar ma phab na 'khyod pa'i gnas sa thong ba lta374

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'thusatshang can du btang nas/ sgrung bshad sgyu rtsal pa myur skyob dang srung skyob gang legasabyed dgos/ mtsho sngon ni lo rgyusasnyan rtsom/ ring mo〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung〉gi 'byung yul yin par mazad/ sgrung gi 'tsholasdud dang myur skyob kyi bya ba 'go rtsom pa chesasnga shosakyi zhing chen nyag gcig kyang yin/ nga tshosalo ngo sodrug lhag gi ring la dka' spyad 'bad brtson byed pa brgyud nas/ lo rgyusakyi shul bzhag khrod du gnasapa'i dgon sde'i khag gi shing dpar dang / dmangasakhrod du khyab pa'i lag brisam/ da dung ge sar sgrung sna kha brgya lhag bshad thub pa'i sgrung pa rnyed cing / kho tsho4bshad pa'i sgrung sna mang po sgra phab dang / dag sgrig par skrun bcasabagyisayod pa red/de'i nang nasakyang rgyalakhab kyi gciganor zhesamatshan snyan kyi ba dan phyogasabazhir g.yo ba'i sgrung pa tshe ring dbang 'dusamachog ni sgrung sna mi gcig pa120lhag bshad thub pa'i sgyu rtsal pa phul du byung ba zhig yin/ deng skabasang tshosasgrung sna bcu gcig tsam sgrar blangasashing / sgrung sna drug tsam dag sgrig byasazin/ sgrung sna gnyisadangosasupar skrun byasate spyi tshogasasteng 'gremaspel byas/ yin na'ang rang zhing gi ge sar sgrung gi zhib 'jug la lo rer sgor khri gcig tsam yang med pas/ 'di 'dra'i gzhi khyon che ba'i rnam grangayozhig la mtshon na mtshan mo'i srin bu mekhyer gyi nusapa ltabu las thon kyin med/sgrung pa tshe ring dbang 'dusamachog lamatshon na/ dgung lo bdun cu lhag lathon pa dang / sku lusalo re nasalorer je sdug tu 'gro bzhin yod pas/ ngatshoswābyār du khong gi sgrung sna dag sgrar maphab na 'gyod pa'i gnasasulhung ba lta

mtsho sngon gyi dmangasakhrod rtsom rig sgyu rtsal skor gyi bsamagazhigazhog mesapo dag gi re ba'ang stong zad du btang bar ma zad/ mirab4rjesam la'ang gyong gud tshabasachen bzosapa min nam/ de bayon nga tshosa'adir spyi tshogasayongasalare 'bod zhu rgyu ni/ nga tshosabaden drang gi bya spyod kyisargyal nor tshe ring dbang 'dusadang sgrung mkhan gu ru rgyalamatshan/ yul shul khul gyi sgrung mkhan zlab gragasapa bca4sgyu rtsal pa gragasacan dag srung skyob byasate/ ge sar sgrubacha tshang du par skrun dang 'grem spelabyasanas/ṭ+wāṃd stor+sha ldan pa'i sgyu rtsalagyi brtsamasachosa'adzam gling yongasal 'bul thub pa —da da/rnyi/sapa/ ma tsho sngon gyi dmangasakhrod rig rtsaladang dmangasasrol rig gnasamyur skyob dang srung skyob byed par dal 'gor byed mi rung / mtsho sngon gyi dmangasakhrod rig gnasadang dmangasasrol rig gnasani mi rabasadu mar 4cha 'dir 'du4sdod byed pa'i rgya rigasadang / bod rigs/ he rigs/ hor rigs/ sog rigasabaca4mi rigasa'adi dag tshang masamanyam du gsar skrun byasapa'i bsam blo'i rgyu nor yin la/ mirabasanasami rabasasungag thog nasabargyud pa'i ngag rtsom dang dngosapo mayin pa'i shul bzhag rig gnasagalachen zhig yin zhing / lo ngo stong phrag du mar brgyud pa'i krung hwa mi rig4kyi rig gnasakyi snying bcud kyang yin/ de'i nang gi phul du byung ba'i dmangasakhrod rig rtsalabartsam4cho4dang dmangasasrol rig gnasamang po zhig mtsho sngon rig gnasakyi nor bu yin par ma zad/ 'dzam gling rig gnasakhrod du'ang ngom chog chog yin pa'i rin thang gzhal hā ṭ+wāṃd

mtsho sngon rgyad mangs khrod rtsom rig sgyu rtsal skor gyi bsam gzhigazhog mes po dag gi re ba'ang stong zad du btang bar ma zad/ mi rabasarjes ma/ la'ang gyong gud tshabs chen bzos pa min nam/ de bsan nga tshosa'adir spyi tshogs yongs la re 'bod zhu rgyu ni/ nga tshos bden drang gi bya spyod kyis rgyal nor tshe ring dbang 'dus dang sgrung ma/khan gu ru rgyal mtshan/ yal shul khul gyi sgrung mkhan zla ba grags pa bcas sgyu rtsal/ pa grags can dag srung skyob byas te/ ge sar sgrung cha tshang du par skrun dang 'grem bal byas nas/'od stong ldan pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi brtsams chos 'dzam gling yongs la 'bul thub pa byed dgos/gnyis pa/ ma tsho sngon gyi dmangs khrod rig rtsal dang dmangs srol rig gnas myur skyob dang srung skyob byed par dal 'gor byed mi rung / ma tsho sngo na gyi dmangs khrod rig gnas dang dmangs sgo la rig gnas ni mi rabs du mar sa cha 'dir 'dus sdod byed pa'i rgya rigs dang / bod rigs/ nye rigs / hor rigs/ sog rigs bcas mi rigs 'di dag tshang masamanyam du gsar skrun byas pa'i bsam blo'i rgyu nor yin la/ mi rabs nas mi rabs gang ga thog nas brgyud pa'i ngag rtsom dang dngos po ma yin pa'i shul bzhag rig gnas gal chen zhig yin zhing / lo ngo sto/nga phrag du mar brgyud pa'i krung hwa mi rigs kyi rig gnas kyi snyeng bcud kyang yin/ de'i nang gi phul du byung ba'i dmangs khrod rig rtsal brtsams chos dang dmangs srol rig gnas ma/nga po zhig mtsho sngon rig gnas kyi nor bu yin par ma zad/ 'dzam gling rig gnas khrod du'ang ngom chog chog yin pa'i rin thang gzhal du med 375

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i rin chen nor bu lta bu yin no/ /de'i byen gyis/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi ched mkhas shes ldan pa ming grags can mang po zhig gis mgyogs myur ngang grung go'i dmangs khrod rig gnas shul bzhag myur skyob byed pa'i rnam grangasa'atshags rgyu ni shin tu mkho gal che zhes gleng brjod gang mang byas yod la/rnam grangs 'di'i nang du dmangs khrod rtsom rig dang dam/ngas khrod sgyu rtsal/dmangs lnga kha rig gnas bcas tshang ma 'dus yod/ der brten rang zhing gis kyang myur du dang len byas te/ da lta dmangs khrod rig gnas dang dmangs srol sgyu rtsal/ dmangs srol rig gnas bcas myur skyob byed pa'i 'char gzhi 'god bzhin yod na'ang / dper na/ reb gong thang ga'i sgyu rtsal dang rgya'i hwa ar(tshi)6)pags grib sgyu rtsal/ sa gnas rol rtsed/bod kyi zhabs bro sogs la slob spyong byed par dga' ba'i mang tshogs sngar lasaji nyung du 'gro bzhin pa dang / len mkhan dang 'khrab ston byed mkhan yang ji nyung du song nas nyams pa dang 'jig nyen che ba'i skabs gsabs yo/da pas de re re bzhin myur du srung skyob legs po byed rgyu ni ha cang gal che ba zhig go /gsum pa/ rtsom pa po dang sgyu rtsal pa'i gsar rtsom dang ngal rtsol la sems khur byas te/ gsar rtsom gyi khor yug dang cha rkyen bzang po zhig bskrun dgos/ rang zhing gi nye rabs rtsom/ rig sgyu rtsal gyi gsar rtsom dang gsar gtod/ gzhung lugs dang zhib 'jug bcas pa bcings 'grol yar sngon la mtshon nas bshad na phal cher stong cha yin zhes zer chog la de yang 376

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i rin chen nor bu ltabu yin no/ /de'i rkyen gyis/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi ched mkhasashesaldan pa ming grag4can mang po zhig gisamagyog4myur ngang krung go'i dmangasakhrod rig gnasashulabazhag myur skyob byed pa'i rnam grangasa'adzugs rgyu ni shin tu mkho gal che zhesagleng brjod gang mang byasayod la/rnam grangasa'adi'i nang du dmang4khrod rtsom rig dang dmangasakhrod sgyu rtsal/dmangasagros rig gnasabacasatshang ma 'dusayod/ der brten rang zhing gisakyang myur du dang len byayote/ da ltadamangasakhrod rig gnasadang dmangs༄kha sgyu rtsal/ dmangasagrol rig gnasabacas myur skyob byed pa'i 'char gzhi 'god bzhin yod na'ang / dper na/ reb gong thang ga'i sgyu rtsaladang rgya'i hwa arayo16pagasagrib sgyu rtsal/ saganasarol rtsed/bod kyi zhabasabro sogasal slob sbyong byed par dga' ba'i mang tshogasasngar lasaje nyung du 'gro bzhin pa dang / len mkhan dang 'khrab ston byed mkhan yang je nyung du song nasanyamasapa dang 'jig nyen che ba'i skabs0slebasayod r+shasade re re bzhin myur du srung skyob legasapo byed rgyu ni ha cang gal che ba zhig gsum pa/ rtsomapa po dang sgyu rtsal pa'i gsar rtsom dang ngalartsolal sem4khur bya4te/ gsar rtsom gyi khor yug dang cha rkyen bzang po zhig bskrun dgos/ rang zhing gi nye rabasartsom rig sgyu rtsalagyi gsar rtsomadang gsar gtod/ gzhung lugasadang zhib 'jug bcas pa bcing4'grol yar sngonā/ 6mtshon nasabashad na phal cher stong cha yin zhesazer chog la de yang

mtsho sngon gyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig sgyu rtsal skor gyi bsam gzhigakrung go gsar ba btsugasapa'i tshun dang / lhag par du bcosasgyur sgo 'byed kyi lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi 'phel rgyayol brten nas/ saganasarang gi rtsom pa po dang sgyu rtsalapa/ gzhung lugasazhib 'jug pa'i dpung khag gsar ba zhig grub yod cing / rtsom pa po dang sgyu rtsalapa/ gzhung lugasazhib 'jug pa minyung ba zhig gi gsar rtsom brtsamasachosal rgyalakhab phyi nang gi mkhasadabang dag gisakhasalen dang gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang yod pa dang / de ni brtsam4chosa'adi dag gisamatsho sngon gyi spyi tshogasa'atsho ba'i 'gyur ldo ga mtshon zhing / ga'adi'i mi rnamasakyi phugasabasam dang rang byung khor yug gi mdzesasdug rmad byung ri mor bkod yod la/ dmangasasrolarig gnasakyi zab tshad kyang 'jal yod pasared/ 'on kyang rang zhing gi rtsom pa po dang sgyu rtsal pa dag lakha tsha dgosagatugasakyi mdangularogasaskyor med pas/ rig rtsal pa tsho 'tsho bar zab zhugasabyed pa dang dmangasakhrod du 'gro ba/ 'tsho bar 'brela'adrisabagyid pa bcasakyi rtsa ba'i re 'dun de mngon du 'gyur thub kyin med/ dper nazhing chenartsom papo'i mthun tshogasadang / rol mo'i mthun tshogs/ ri mo pa'i mthun tshogs/ zlosagar pa'i mthun tshogs/zhab4bro pa'i mthun tshogasabacasal lo rer gron dngul mang na sgor brgyad stong tsam dang / nyung nasgor bzhi stong tsam yinapas/ cha snyomasabyasan lorer ched lasartsom pa po 'tsho bar zab zhugasakyi gronadangul mirer sgor drug brgya la4med pa ltabu'o/ /tang gi tshogasachen bcu drug pa'i snyan zhu'i nang du midamangasanā /ga

mtsho sngon gyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig sgyu tsal skor gyi bsam gzhigakrung go gsar ba btsugs pa'i tshun dang / lhag par du bcos sgyur sgo 'byed kyi lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi 'phel rgyas la brten nas/ sa gnas rang gi rtsom pa po dang sgyu rtsal pa/ gzhung lugs zhib 'jug pa'i dpung khag gsar ba zhig grub yod cing / rtsom pa po dang sgyu rtsal pa/ gzhung lugs zhib 'jug pa mi nyung ba zhig gi gsar rtsom brtsams chos la rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas dbang dag gis khas len dang gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang yod pa dang / de ni bcoms chos 'di dag gis mtsho sngon gyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i 'gyur rdo ga mtshon zhing / sa 'di'i mi rnams kyi phugs bsam dang rang byung khor yug gi mdzes sdug rmad byung ri mor bkod yod la/ dmangs srol rig gnas kyi zab tshad kyang 'jal yod pas red/ 'on kyang rang zhing gi rtsom pa po dang sgyu rtsal pa dag la kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi ma dngul rogs skyor med pas/ rig rtsal pa tsho 'tsho bar zab zhugs byed pa dang dmangs khrod du 'gro ba/ 'tsho bar 'brel 'dris bgyid pa bcas kyi rtsa ba'i re 'dun de mngon du 'gyur thub kyin med/ dper na zhing chen rtsom pa po'i ma thun tshogs dang / rol mo 'i mthun tshogs/ ri mo pa'i mthun tshogs/ zlos gar pa'i ma thun tshogs/zhabs bro pa'i mthun tshogs bcas la lo rer gron dngul ma/nga na sgor brgyad stong tsam dang / nyung na sgor bzhi stong tsam yin pas/ cha snyoms byas na lo rer ched la sa rtsom pa po 'tsho bar zab zhugs kyi gron dngul mi rer sgor drug brgya las med pa lta bu'o/ /tang gi tshogs chen bcu drug pa'i snyan zhu'i nang du mi dmangs ni rig 377

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rtsal bya ba gnyer mkhan dag gi skyed yum yin la/ 'tsho ba ni sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom gyi 'byung gnas yin pas/ mang tshogs khrod zab zhugs dang 'tsho bdangos la zab zhugs byas te/ mi dmangs kyi sngon thon khrod nas sgyu rtsal gyi sngon thon brtson dgos zhes bkod yod pa ltar/ rang zhing gi rtsom pa po dang sgyu rtsal pa mi nyung ba zhig gis rang 'gul ngang gron dngul gī dka' khag khyad gsod byas te 'tsho bar zab zhugs byas shing / bcoms chos rmad du byung ba brtsams yod na yang / 'gro gron gyi bkag rkyen chen pos par skrun byed thabs bral zhing / des rtsom pa po dang sgyu rtsal pa'i gsar rtsom gyi hur brtson rang bzhin la shan shugs tshabs chen bzos yo da/ slad du rtsom pa po dang sgyu rtsal pa'i gsar rtsom bya ba de la cha byen gang legs shig bskrun pa'i la sa'agan ni spyo tshogs kyi phyogs so sos rgyab skyor dang rogs ram byed par rag las so/ /bzhi ba/ khor yug legs bcos dang 'gro gron je cher gtong rgyu ni rang zhing gi dmangs khrod rig rtsal de ji ltar mi rigs bsam slong sgron me dang mi dmangs mdun skyod kyi dung sgra lnga bur bsgyur ba'i khag theg yin/mtsho sngon rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gsar spel byed pa'i rig rtsal mthun tshogs sosobe+e mtsho sngon mi rigs dmangs khrod rig rtsal gyi stobs shugs 'ba' zhig yin la/ dus yun ring po'i nang du rgya che ba'i rig rtsal be+e ba gnyer mkhan dag gis dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyis mtsho sngon gyi lhom rig sgyu rtsal 'phel rgyasadang mtsho sngon dmangs khrod rtsom rig myur skyob dang srung skyong byed pa'i thad du 378

gcod pa don thub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rtsalakhya ba gnyer mkhan dag gi skyed yumayin la/ 'tsho ba ni sgyu rtsalagasar rtsomagyi 'byung gnasayinapas/ mang tshogasakhrod zab zhugasadang 'tsho bdango4lazab zhug4byasate/ mi dmangasakyi sngon thon khrod na4sgyu rtsalagyi sngon thon brtson dgosazhe4bkod yod pa ltar/ rang zhing gi rtsom pa po dang sgyu rtsal pa mi nyungab zhig gisarang 'gulangang gron dngul gyi dka' khag khyad gsod byasate 'tsho bar zab zhugasabyasashing / brtsamasachosarmad du byung babartsamasayod na yang / 'gro gron gyi bkag rkyen chen posapar skrun byed thabasabralazhing / desartsom pa podang sgyu rtsal pa'i gsar rtsom gyi hur brtson rang bzhin lashan shugasatshabasachen bzosayod/ slad du rtsom pa po dang sgyu rtsal pa'i gsar rtsomabya ba de la cha rkyen gang legasashig bskrun pa'i lasa'aganā ni spyi tshogasakyi phyog4sosolorgyab skyor dang rogasaram byed par rag las /bzhi/ ba/ khor yug legasabaco4dang 'gro gron je cher gtong rgyu ni rang zhing gi dmang4khrod rig rtsalade ji ltar mi rigasabasam blo'i sgron medang mi dmangasamadun skyod kyi dung sgraltabur bsgyur ba'i khag theg yin/mtsho sngon rtsom rig sgyu rtsalagasar spelabyed pa'i rig rtsal mthun tshogasasosoni mtsho sngon mirigasadamangasakhrod rig rtsalagyi stobasashugasa'aba' zhig yin la/ dusayun ribapo'i nang du rgya che ba'i rig rtsal bya bganyer mkhan dag gisadaka' spyad 'bad brtson gyisamatsho sngon gyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 'phel rgyasada~X ༵tsho sngon dmangasakhrod rtsomarig myur skyob dang srung skyong byed pa'i thad du

mtsho sngon gyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig sgyu rtsal skor gyi bsam gzhigabya ba bla na ma mchis pa bsgrubs shing / grub 'bras kyang g.yur du za ba blangasayod/ yin na yang mar byed gsum gyi dgongs pa lag len dang 'byor 'bring spyi tshogs yongs khyab tu tshogs skrun byed pa'i nyin mo 'di la mapho na/nga tsho ma/tsho sngon rtsom rig sgyu rtsal mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs dang de'i khongasagatogs rig rtsal mthun tshogs kyi phrag la babs pa'i las 'gan ni sngar lasalci ba yin la/ khrung go'i ga chos ldan pa'i spyo tshogs ring lugs kyi rig dpa /sgo 11 (1 /phyo /ce so 14 2)gnas 'jugs skrun da da san/ nga sa gsag ga nas lngan na ga gnas ma/dun skyod kyi kha phyogs rgyun ltongs byed pa dam 'dzin byas nas/nu/ mthud du mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi bsam pa'i rig gnas nyin re las nyinarer je rgyas su 'gro ba'i re ba de skong dgos la/ phyogs gzhan gcig nasang tshos da dung sngon thon rig gnas tshogs skrun byas te phul byung srol rgyun rig gnas khyab spel du gtong dgos shing / nam rgyun don dngos dang nye ba/'tsho ba dang nye ba/ mang tshogs dang nye ba bcas byas te/ bla na med pa'i bsam blos mi'i gzugs brnyan bzo ba dang / phul du byung ba'i brtsamasachos kyis mi la skul lcag gtong dgos pa yin no/ /yin na'ang nga tsho sdod ga gyi khor yug dngos dang da yo da kyi cha rkyen labaltas na/ gron dngul nyung ba dang / gzhung sgrub sgrig chas rnying ba yin zhing / gzhung sgrub cha rkyen dang gnas mal khor yug ha cang thabs rdugasayin pas/ be+e gzhag hril bo 'phel rgyas yong bar bkag rkyen jebs shing /sgrub 'dod pa dang bsgrub dgos pa/ sgrub thub pa'i bya ba rnams kyang sgrub 379

mtsho sngon gyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig sgyu rtsal skor gyi bsamagazhigabya ba blan mamachisapabasgrubasashing / gruba'abrasakyang g.yur du za bablangasayod/ yin na yang mtshonabyed gsumagyi dgong4ngalag len dang 'byor 'bring spyi tshogasayongasakhyab tu'adzugasaskrun byed pa'i nyin mo'adi lamatshon na/nga tsho mtsho sngon rtsom rig sgyu rtsal mnyama'abrelalhan tshogasadang de'i khongasagatogasarig rtsalamathun tshogasakyi phrag lababasapa'i lasa'agan ni sngar lasalci ba yin la/ krung go'i khyad chosaldanapa'i spyi tshogasaring lugasakyi rig gan4'dzugasaskrun byed dgosan/ nga tshosaphyogasagacig nasasngon thon rig gnasamadun skyod kyi khaphyogs rgyun 'khyongasabyed pa dma'adzin byasanas/mu mthud du mi dmangasamang tshogasakyi bsamapa'i rig gnasanyin re la4nyin rer je rgyasasu'agro ba'i re ba de skong dgosal/ phyog4gzhan gcig nasang tshosad dung sngon thon rig gnasa'adzugasaskrun byasate phul byung srol rgyun rig gnasakhyab speladu gtong dgosashing / namargyun don dngo4dang nye ba/'tsho ba dang nye ba/ mang tshogasadang nye ba bcasabyasate/ blan med pa'i bsam blosami'i gzugasabarnyan bzo ba dang / phuladu byung ba'i brtsam4chosakyisamil skul lcag gtong dgosapa yin no/ /yin na'ang nga tsho sdod yul gyi khor yug dngosadang da yod kyi cha rkyen la blta4na/ gron dngulanyung ba dang / gzhung sgrub sgrig chasarnying ba yin zhing / gzhung sgrub cha rkyen dang gan4malakhor yug ha cang thabasardug4yin pas/ bya gzhag hrilabo 'phel rgyasayong bar bkag rkyen thebasashing /sgrub 'dod pa dang bsgrub dgosapa/ sgrub thub pa'i bya ba rnamasaskrur+sha ṭ+wāṃb

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thabs med pa zhig yin pas na/ rig gnas gsar stel dang legs rtsom mang byung / ched mkhas mang thon bcas kyi bya gzhag 'di mngon du 'gyur dka' ba yin la/ nges par du gnad don 'di thag gcod legs po byed dgos/ deng skabasang tshor mtshon na rig rtsal mthun tshogs gsum la gzhung las khang med cing gzhan du khang ba g.yar nas gzhung sgrub bya ba gnyer bzhin mchis/ gzhan yang rig rtsal mthun tshogs skor zhig gis klog klad kyang nyo mi thub pas deng rabs kyi gzhung sgrub bya ba'i thad du gom sta bas shin tu dal ba yin/ de'i phyir nged cag gi re ba ltar na/ srid gzhung dang 'brel yod sde khag gis rang zhing gi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal myur skyob byed pa'i bya bar mthong chen gnang ste ma dngul nges can zhig gnang rgyu dang / rig rtsal mthun tshogs kyi gzhung sgrub cha rkyen ji legs srubatang ste dus rgyun du rig gnas byu rtsal par thugs khur gnang nas bya bar mdzub sto na dang / khrul ma gtong ba bcas byas nas rtsom rig sgyu rtsal pa'i hur brtson gyi rang bzhin 'don bar byed pa dang mtsho sngon gyi sngon thon rig gnas 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i thad lag rjes gsar ba bskrun dgos so/ /'dir da dung nges par du gleng dgos pa zhig ni/ zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gis mtsho sngon rtsom rig sgyu rtsal lte gnas 'dzugs skrun bya bar mthong chen gang legs bgyis te/ ma 'byangs par rol mo khang dang rig gnas 'grem ston khang / dmangs sgol shul rdzas khang / shes rig snya na zhu khang / yig gzugs ri mo khang / mi sna sbyong brdar khang bcas 'dus380

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ringagi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thabasamed pa zhig yin pasan/ rig gnasagasar spel dang legasartsom mang byung / ched mkha4mang thonabaca4kyi bya gzhag 'di mngon du 'gyur dka' ba yin la/ ngesapar du gnad don 'di thag gcod legasapo byed dgos/ deng skabasang tshor mtshon na rig rtsal mthun tshogasagasum la gzhung la4khang med cing gzhan du khang ba g.yar nasagazhung sgrub bya ba gnyer bzhin mchis/ gzhan yang rig rtsalamathun tshogasaskor zhig gisaklog klad kyang nyo mi thub pasadeng rabasakyi gzhung sgrub bya ba'i thad du gom stabasashin tu dalab yin/ de'i phyir nged cag gi re ba ltar na/ srid gzhung dang 'brel yod sdekhag gi4rang zhing gi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal myur skyob byed pa'i bya bar mthong chen gnang ste mdangul ngesacan zhig gnang rgyu dang / rig rtsal mthun tshogasakyi gzhung sgrub cha rkyen je legasasubatang ste dusargyun du rig gnasasgyu rtsal par thugasakhur gnang nasabya bar mdzub ston dang / skul ma gtong ba bcasabyasanasartsom rig sgyu rtsalapa'i hur brtson gyi rang bzhin 'don spel byed pa dang mtsho sngon gyi sngon thon rig gnasa'adzugasaskrun byed pa'i thad lag rjesagasar ba bskrun dgosaso/ /'dir da dung ngesapar du gleng dgosapa zhig ni/ zhing chen mi dmangasasrid gzhung gisamatsho sngon rtsom rig sgyu rtsal lteganasa'adzug4skrun bya bar mthong chen gang legasabagyi4te/ ma 'gyangasapar rolamo khang dang rig gnasa'agrem ston khang / dmangasagros shulardza4khang / shesarig snyan zhu shāzlo / yig gzugasari mokhang / mi 5sbyong brdar khang bca4'du4

pa'i deng rabasasngon thona'adzugasaskrun gyi khyad cho4ldan pa'i mtsho sngon rtsom rig sgyu rtsal lteganasa'adzugasaskrun bgyisanas/ mtsho sngon mirigasadamangasakhrod rtsomarig sgyu rtsal dag 'di nasadar speladang gcig sdud yong bar byasate/ mtsho sngon gyi rgya che ba'i rgya bod sog gsum kyi mi dmangasamang tshogasakyi

da—byub sams ra— khu——ga mar dpya— ga ris na bza rin dag—ga kan——gakhrod stom rig sgyu rtsal dag 'di nas dar spel dang gcig sdud yong bar be+esate/ mtsho sngon gyi rgya che ba'i rgya bod sog gsum kyi mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor rags tsam gleng ba/gangs ri'i yul du chags pa'i bod mi rigs ni las la brtson zhing sgorig ldan pa'i cha rigs mchog tu gyur pa zhig lags/ bgrang be+e stong phrag gcig lhag gi lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i nang du/ bod du phul byung tshan rig pa dang / ched las mkhas pa/ snyan ngag pa sogs bgrang las 'das pa zhig byung myong zhing / khong tshos bod rigs mi dmangs la rin bral gyi bsam pa'i nor bu brjod kyis mi lang ba dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po gsar skrun gnang yod pas/ 'di ni grung hwa shi rigs kyi rtsom rig bang mdzod khrod kyi rin po che rtsa chen zhig yin no/ / 'dir mtsho sngon khyeng rkyang la dpe blangasanas byung zad brjod na/ rang re'i mtsho sngon sa khul du sku 'khrungs pa'i zhwa ser bstan pa'i srol 'byed pa po rje cong kha pa dang mkhas dbang stobs lda na 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje/kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo/ spri rig dge bshes chen po/ zhabasadakar pa tshogs drug rang grol/ sum pa ye shes dpal 'byor/ pra ti rin chen don grub sogs dang / nye rabs kyi mkhas pa skad grags can dge 'dun chos 'phel dang shes rab rgya mtsho/ sgos steng blo bzang dpal lda na/382

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor rags tsam gleng ba/gangasari'i yuladu chagasapa'i bod mirigasani lasalabartson zhing blorig ldan pa'i mirigayomachog tu gyur ngazhig lags/ bgrang bya stong phrag gcig lhag gi lorgyu4kyi chu rgyunaring mo'i nang du/ bod du phul byung tshan rig pa dang / ched la4mkhasapa/ snyan ngag pa sogasabagrang lasa'ad4pa zhig byung myong zhing / khong tshosabod rigasami dmangasal rin bral gyi bsam pa'i nor bu brjod kyisamilang ba dang bsamagyisamikhyab pa mang po gsar skrun gnangayod pas/ 'di ni krung hwa mirigasakyi rtsom rig bang mdzod khrod kyi rinapo che rtsa chen zhig yin no/ / 'dir mtsho sngon rkyang rkyang la dpe blangasanasacung zad brjod na/ rang re'i mtsho sngon sakhul du sku 'khrung4pa'i zhwa ser bstan pa'i srola'abyed pa po rje tsong kha pa dang mkha4dbang stobasalda na 'jamadapalargya mtsho/ thu'u bkwan chosakyi nyi ma/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje/kun mkhyen 'jigasamed dbang bo/ arig dge bshesachen po/ zhabasadakar pa tshogasadrug rang grol/ suyopa yoshesadapal 'byor/ pra ti rin chen don grub sogasadang / nye rabasakyi mkhasapa skad gragasacan dge 'dīhā ༵sa'apheladang shesarab rgya mtsho/ giyosteng blobazang dpal ldan/

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor rags tsam gleng ba/gsung rab rgya mtsho/ tshe tan zhabs drung bcas pa rnams la phul du byung ba'i stom rig gi brtsams chos mang po mchis par ma zad/ dus rabs gang la'ang nyams pa med pa'i gson shugs ldan yod/ mkhas dbang khong rnam par chos lugs kyi gzhung chen po'i shes bya mtha' yas pa zhig yod pa lasagazhan mkhas pa'i rtsom rig dang dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi thad la'ang 'brasabu g.yur du za ba smin yod/ khong rnam pas rang re'i bod rigs kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i thad la bsu ba babs med pa'i phyag rjes bskrun yod la/krung hwa mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas gtong bar yang rogs 'degasabasam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad yod/rngung hwa mi dmangs spyo mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa'i rjes dang /khyad par du tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogasathengs gsum pa'i tshun la/ tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang rig gnas sgyu rtsal gyi srid jus lag len bgyis pa dang bstun nas/ rang re'i bod rigasakyi rtsom rig las don la yang sngar chad kyi 'pho 'gyur gsar ba byung / rtsom pa po rnams kye bsam blor bcings 'grol thob ste/ phun sum tshogs pa'i spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i nang nas bcud bzang len ci thub byas nas rtsom rig gsar rtsom bgyis par brten/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi brjod bya'i don dang rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi rtsom stangs sna tshogs bkol ba'i thad du'ang 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod par ma zad/ rtsom rig bcoms chos kyi bro ba'i thad du'ang mthor 'degs sngar med cig byung yod/ rtsom lus thad nas bltas383

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor rags tsam gleng ba/gsung rab rgya mtsho/ tshe tan zhabasadrung bcasaparnamasalaphuladu byung ba'i rtsomarig gi brtsamasachosamang pomachisapar ma zad/ du4rabasagang la'ang nyamasangamed pa'i gson shugasaldan yod/ mkhasadabang khong rnam par cho4lugasakyi gzhung chen po'i shesabya mtha' ya4pa zhig yod pa lasagazhan mkhasapa'i rtsomarig dang dmangasakhrod rtsom rig gi thad la'ang 'bra4bu g.yur du za ba smin yod/ khong rnamapasarang re'i bod rigasakyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyasagatong ba'i thad labasub thabasamed pa'i phyag rjesabaskrun yod la/krung hwa mi rigasakyi rig gnasa'aphelargyasagatong bar yang rogasa'adegasabasamagyisamikhyabapa mdzad yod/krung hwa midamangasaspyi mthun rgyalakhabadabu brnyesapa'i rjesadang /khyad par du tang gi skabasabacu gcig pa'i krung 4tshang 'dzomasagrosatshogasathengasagasumapa'i tshun la/ tang gi mi rigasasrid jusadang rig gnasasgyu rtsalagyi srid jusalag len bgyisabadang bstunanas/ rang re'i bod rigasakyi rtsom rig lasadon layang sngar med kyi 'pho 'gyur gsar ba byung / rtsom pa po rnamasakyi bsamablor bcingayo'agrolathobaste/ phun sumatshog4pa'i spyi tshogasakyi 'tsho ba'i nang nasabacud bzang len ci thub byasanasartsom rig gsar rtsom bgyisapar brten/ rtsomarig gsar rtsomagyi brjod bya'i don dang rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi rtsomastangasasnatshogayobakolaba'i thad du'ang 'phelargya4chen po byung yod par mazad/ rtsomarig brtsamasachoyokyi bro ba'i thad du'ang mthor 'degasasngar med cig byung yod/ rtsomalusathad na~X༈sa

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/na'ang snyan ngag dang lhug rtsom/ sgrungagatam/ zlosagar/ dpyad gtamasogasayod la/ deng rabasakyi sgrung gtam gsar rtsom la'ang sgrunga'abreng dbasgrung thung kho na tsam min par sgrung ring yang yod pa ste/ bod rigasartsomapapodapala'abyor dang 'jamadapalargya mtsho/ yoshe4bstan 'dzin/ stag 'bum rgyal/ bkra shisadapal ldan/ rdo rje tshe brtan bcasakyisadeb grangasabacu lhag tsam gsar rtsom bgyisate par skrun byasayod/ da ltabod khuladu she4rig ldan zhing gsar rtsom gyi nusapayod pa'i gzhon dar rtsomapa po 'bor chen zhig char rjesakyi myu gu bzhin gcig rjesaganyisamathud du 'tshar longayobyung yod la/ khong rnamasakyisabrisaganang mdzad pa'i snyan ngag dang lhug rtsom/ sgrung gtam/ rtsom rig gzhung lugasakyi dpyad gtam sogasaglegasabam mang po par skrun bya4te kun gyi mig gi spyod yul du gyur yod/brtsamasachoyode dag largyal yongasagrangasanyung mirigasakyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom bya dga' dang zhing ljongasalnga'i bod rigasakyi gsar rtsom dpyad bsdur khrod kyi bya dga' thengasamang thob myong / rtsom pa po skor zhig 'dzam gling gi skad gragasacan gyi misna'i tshig mdzod nang du bkod yod la/ da dung brtsams chosaskor zhig rgyal khab du ma'i yoger bsgyur nasaphyi rgyal lamatshamasasbyor bya4shing / mkha4dbang mi nyung bsagadeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang 'dug brtsamasachosade dag gisadusarabs gsar ba'i bod rigasamidamangasakyi 'tsho ba gsar ba dang / tang gi mirigasachosalugasasrid jus/brdo~Xsgyur sgo 'byed kyi srid jusabaca4la bsngags brjod byasayod par ma

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/na'ang snyan ngag dang lhag stom/ sgrung gtom/ zlos gar/ dpyad gtamasogs yod la/ deng rabs kyi sgrung gtam gsar rtsom la'ang sgrung 'a zeng dang sgrung thung kho na tsam min par sgrung ring yang yod pa ste/ bod rigs rtsom payodapal 'byor dang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ ye shes bstan 'dzin/ stag 'bum rgyal/ bkra shis dpal ldan/ rdo rje tshe brtan bcas kyis de ba grangasabacu lhag tsam gsar rtsom bgyis te par skrun byas yod/ da lta bod khul du shes rig ldan zhing gsar rtsom gyi nus pa yod pa'i gzhon dar rtsom pa po'abor chen zhig char rjes kyi myu gu bzhin gcig rjes gnyis mthud du 'tshar longs byung yod la/ khong rnams kyis bris gnang ma/dzad pa'i snyan ngag dang lhug rtsom/ sgrung gtam/ rtsom rig gzhung lugs kyi dpyad gtam sogasaglegs bam mang po par skrun byas te kun gyi mig gi spyod yul du gyur yod/brtsams chos de dag la rgyal yongs grangs nyung mi rigs kyi tshom rig gsar rtsom bya dga' dang zhing ljongs lnga'i bod rigs kyi gsar rtsom dpyad bsdur khrod kyi bya dga' zangs mang thob myong / rtsom pa po skor zhig 'dzam gling gi skad grags can gyi mi sna'i tshig mdzod nang du bkod yod la/ da dung brtsams chos skor zhig rgyal khab du ma'i na ger bsgyur nas phyi rgyal la mtshamasasbyor byas shing / mkhas dbang mi nyung bas gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang 'dug bcoms chos de dag gis dus rabs gsar ba'i bod rigasami dmangs kyi 'tsho ba gsar ba dang / tang gi mi rigs chos 'u/gas srid jus/bcos sgyur sgo 'byed kyi srid jug bcas la bsngags brjod byas yod par ma384

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor rags tsam gleng ba/zad/ bod rigs kyi sems khams dang 'dun pa/ bsam blo dang ltab/ mi rigs sa gnas kyi khyad chos sogs kyang shugs stomatshon yod pas/ 'disabod rigs kyi deng rab4rtsom rig las don 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin pa'i gnas bab gsal bshad byas pa las gzhan bod rigs kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi myu gu rgyas te 'bras bu smin bzhin pa dang / bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom sgo kun nas jem skas gsar ba zhig la slebs 'dug par sprod byas yod/ gzhan yang da dung zhing ljongs lngas bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom dang 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho ltar/ 〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉dang〈sbrang char〉〈mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〈zla zer〉〈skal bzang me tog〉〈gangasadakar ri bo〉〈gangs rgyan me tog〉sogs rtsom rig dus deb gsar sgrub byasayod cing / dus deb 'di dag sgrub pa'i nyin dang po nas bzung bod kyi rtsom rig gi son bzang 'debs pa dang rtsom rig gi mi sna gsar ba skyed sring bgyid pa'i thad la nus pa gzhal du med pa thon par ma zad/ da dung mtsho sngo na zhing chen mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis〈bod kyi deng rabs dpe tshogs〉(glegs bam bcu)par skrun 'grem mkha byas pa des bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusathog tu deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig gi brtsams chos zhes pa'i lo rgyus gsar ba zhig bskrun pa red/ yin na'ang / gser la lhad ma 'dres pa med pa dang mi la skyon ma gos pa sted pa'i dpe ltar/ rang re'i rtsom rig gi brtsamasachos dag gzhan pa'i sngon thon mi rigs kyi brtsams chos dang bsdur na/ da dung bar thag cung ring po yod pa khas ma blangs na ga la 'grig de yang bye 385

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor rags tsam gleng ba/zad/ bod rigasakyi semasakhamasadang 'dun pa/ bsam blodang ltab/ mirigayosaganasakyi khyad chosasogasakyang shugasasumatshon yod pas/ 'disabod rigasakyi deng rabasartsom rig lasadon 'phel rgyayo'agro bzhin pa'i gan4bab gsalabashad byasapa lasagazhan bod rigasakyi deng rabasartsomarigagasar rtsom gyi myu gu rgya4te 'brasabu smin bzhin pa dang / bod kyi rtsomarig gsar rtsomasgo kun na4them skasagasar ba zhig laslebasa'adug pa ra sprodabyasayod/ gzhan yang da dung zhing ljongasalngasabod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom dang 'phel rgyasakyi dgosamakho ltar/ (bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉dang(sbrang char〉〈mang tshogasasgyu rtsal〉〈zla zer〉(skal bzang me tog〉〈gang4dkar ri bo〉〈gangasargyan metog〉sogasartsomarig dusadebagasar sgrub bya4yod cing / dusadeb 'di dag sgrub pa'i nyin dang po nasabazung bod kyi rtsom rig gi son bzang 'debasapa dang rtsom rig gi misna gsar ba skyed sring bgyid pa'i thad lanasapagazhaladu med pathon par mazad/ da dung mtsho sngon zhing chen mirigasadape skrun khang gis〈bod kyi deng rabasadape tshogs〉(glegasabam bcu)par skrun 'grem spel byasapa desabod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusathog tu deng rabasabod kyi rtsomarig gi brtsamasachoyozhe4pa'i lo rgyusagasar ba zhig bskrun pa red/ yin na'ang / gser la lhad ma 'dresapa med pa dang mil skyon ma gosapa med pa'i dpe ltar/ rang re'i rtsom rig gi brtsamasachosadag gzhan pa'i sngon thon mirigasakyi brtsamasachosadang bsdur na/ da dung bar thag cung ring po yod pa khasamablangasan ga la'agrig de ༵༵ bye

gcod pa don grub dang snying bom ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brag tubarjod na/ gcig nga tsho'i rtsom papo skor zhig la rtsomarig sgyu rtsalagazhung lugasaskor gyi gsosbyong zhan padang / rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi nyamasamyong med stabs/ gsar rtsom gnang ba'i brtsamasacho4la lar deng rabasakyi bsamachodang ltab mi 'dang ba dang / da dung brtsamasachosaskor zhig misnazhiba'abri byed pakhona'i steng du bskyar zlosasu'adug pa ma gtogs/ deng rabasami rnamasakyi semasakhamasa'akhor phyogasadang / ma/dzesadapyod kyi gomasasrol sogasakyi 'gyur ldog lazazhib kyi rtog dpyod med par brten/brtsamasachosal don ldan gting zab kyi nusapa thon med/ gnyis/bcoms chosakyi brjod bya'i don gyi cha nasabalta4na khyab shin tu chung /brjod bya phal che ba zhig tu 'dagazin pa'i rong 'brog sakhul gyi 'tsho ba spyir btang ba rnamasabakod pa mgatogs/ deng rab4kyi tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyi bcosasgyur rlabasargyun khrod du byung ba'i rnyog dra che ba'i 'gal ba dang 'tsho ba rnam4mtshon thub med pas/ bod rigasasakhul gyi deng rabasacan 'dzugasaskrun la 'bod skuladang bod mirigasakyi tshan rig gi 'du shesadang deng rabasakyi 'du shesal shugasasnon thebasapa ha cang nyung / rjod byed tshig gi cha nasabashad na'ang lung skad dang yulaskad mang drag4pasabod khul yongasakyisago mi bde zhing / mdo dbusakham4gsumakun gyi4khasalen zhing go slaba'i gling rje ge sar rgyalapo'i sgrung gi tshig rgyan gyi rigasaltabu dang rgyun spyod skad cha'i skor bkolab shin tu nyung / gsum/ dus rabasagasar ba'i bod kyi ṭ+wāṃ~Xrig gsar rtsomagyi khrod du bod gna' rabasakyi sro/la rgyun rig gnayo

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brag tu brjod na/ gcig nga tsho'i rtsom pa po skor zhig la rtsom rig sgyu rtsalagazhung lugs skor gyi gso spyong zhan pa dang / rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi nyamasamyong med stabs/ gsar rtsom gnang ba'i brtsams chos la lar deng rabs kyi bsam blo dang ltab mi 'dang ba dang / da dung brtsams chos skor zhig mi sna zhib 'bri byed pa kho na'i steng du bskyar zlos sa 'dug pa ma gtogs/ deng rabs mi rnams kyi sems khams 'khor phyogs dang / ma/dzes dpyod kyi gomasasrol sogs kyi 'gyur ldog la po zhib kyi rtog dpyod ped par brten/brtsams chos la don ldan gting zab kyi nus pa thon med/ gnyis/brtsams chos kyi brjod khya'i don gyi cha nas bltas na khyab shin tu yong /brjod bya phal che ba zhig tu 'das zin pa'i rong 'brog sa khul gyi 'tsho ba byer btang ba rnams bkod pa ma gtogs/ deng rabs kyi tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyi bcos sgyur rlabs rgyun khrod du byung ba'i rnyog dra che ba'i 'gal ba dang 'tsho ba rnams mtshon thub med pas/ bod rigs sa khul gyi deng rabs can 'dzugasaskrun la 'bod skul dang bod mi rigs kyi tshan rig gi 'du shes dang deng rabs kyi 'du shes la shugs sgon jebs pa ha cang nyung / rjod byed tshig gi cha nas bshad na'ang lung skad dang yal skad mang drags pas bod khul yongasakyis go mi bde zhing / mdo dbus khams gsum kun gyis khas len zhing go maba'i gleng rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung gi tshig rgyan gyi rigs lta bu dang rgyun spyod skad chang skor bkol ba shin tu nyung / gsum/ dus rabs gsar ba'i bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi khrod du bod gna' rabs kyi sro la rgyun rig gnas386

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor rags tsam gleng ba/khasamilen pa'i phyogasalhung zhig khyab bzhin yod/ de yang na gzhon rtsomapa po nyung shasashig gisarang mirig4kyi gan4tshul dngosadang rgyab 'galabyasate/ nubaphyog4rgyal khab kyi rtsom rig rtsom stangasalald yobyed gang thub kyisadeng rab4bod kyi rtsom rig gi bgrod lamagasar ba zhig gtod dgosazhesazer na4rdo chag btsan sgrig gi dpoltar gong 'og bar gsum mimathun pa'i rtsom yig re zung brisapa des/ bod kyi rtsomarig gtan 'jagasangang 'phelargyasagatong bar gnod pa bzosapar ma zad/ mirigasarang gi rtsomarig gi tha snyad yang dag par spyod pa la'ang gnod pa bzosayod/ spyir bod yig lasabartsamasapa'i rtsomayig zhig yin phyin mdo dbusakhamasagasumagang gisakyang go thub pa ni smosam dgos/ 'o na da lta'i gsar rtsom skor zhig phan tshun gyisago mithub pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo gang yin zhe na/ de ni bod kyi phulabyung srolargyun rig gnasakyi rmang gzhi dor ba'i khar/ bod thun mong gisago thub pa'i skad cha'i nying bcud rnam4bsdu len ma byasapa'i rkyen min nam snyam/mig sngar/ rang rgyal gyi bco4sgyur sgo 'byed gnad 'gag gi skabasasuslobasayod pa dang / spyi tshogasaring lugasatshong ra'i dpala'abyor gyi sgrig gzhi 'dzug4rgyu yang nga tsho'i phrag tu babasapa'i lasa'agan lci mo zhig lags/'di 'dra'i gnasatshul gsar ba'i 'og tu/ rtsom rig bya ba byed mkhan rnamasakyisarang nyid ji ltar lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi 'gyur ldog la 'phrod par bya4te/ gom gang mdun spo4kyi4bod kyi rtsom rig lasadon 'phel rgyasasugatong dgo4pa'i thad la kho bosagashamagasalagyi ltatshuladon tshan 'ga~X ṭ+wāṃng

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor rags tsam gleng ba/khas mi len pa'i phyogs lhung zhig khyab bzhin yod/ de yang na gzhon tshom pa po nyung shas shig gis rang ba rigs kyi gnas tshul dngos dang rgyab 'gal byasate/ nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi rtsom rig rtsom stangs la lad mo byed gang thub kyis deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig gi bgrod lam gsar ba zhig gtod dgosazhes zer nas rdo chag btsan sgrig gi dpe ltar gong 'og bar gsum mi mthun pa'i rtsom yig re zung bris pa des/ bod kyi rtsom rig gtan 'jags ngang 'phel rgyas gtong bar gnod pa bzos par ma zad/ cha rigs rang gi rtsom rig gi tha snyad yang dag par spyod pa la'ang gnod pa bzos yo da/ spyir bod yig las brtsam/sa pa'i rtsom yig zhig yin phyin mdo dbus kham sa gsum gang gis khrung go thub pa ni smos ma dgos/ 'o na da lta'i gsar rtsom skor zhig phan don gyis go shi thub pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo gang yin zhe na/ de ni bod kyi phul byung sog rgyun rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi dor ba'i khar/ bod thun mong gis go thub pa'i skad pa' nying bcud rnams bsdu len ma byas pa'i rkyen min nam snyam/mig sngar/ rang rgyal gyi bcos byu ra sgo 'byed gnad 'gag gi skabasatsho skebs yod pa dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi sgrig gzhi 'dzugs rgyu yang nga tshol phrag tu babs pa'i las 'gan lce mo zhig lags/'di 'dra'i gnas tshul gsar ba'i 'og tu/ rtsom rig bya ba byed mkhan rnam sa kyis rang nyid ji ltar lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi 'gyur ldog la 'phrod par byas te/ gom gang mdun spos kyis bod kyi rtsom rig las don 'phel rgyasagagatong dgos pa'i thad la kho bos gsham gsal gyi lta tshul don tshan 'ga' gleng 387

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bar bya'o/ /dang po/ rang gi rtsom rig gsar rtsom des nges par du spyi tshogs ring lugs la zhabs zhu bgyid pa'i kha phyogs dang me tog mnyam bzhad dang mkhasabargya 'gran gleng gi byed phyogs rgyun 'khyongs byas thog tsha rlabs 'phyur ba'i dngos yo da kyi 'tsho ba'i nang zab zhugs byed pa dang / rgya che ba'i rong 'brog mang tshogs kyi khrod du 'gro ba/ gsar rtsom gyi gtso gnad de deng rabs kyi 'tsho ba dngos brjod pa'i nang du bzhag ste/ sprug rtse dang mig mda' bzo zhing dam ga dang shes yon can gyi phyogs stobaskor ba dang / spyi tshogs ring 'u gas deng rabs can gyi 'dzugs skrun las don dang bye tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang gi 'bur thon gyi gnad don brjod de/ bcos sgyur sgo 'byed skabs kyi nyams myong gsar ba dang sngon thon mi sna/ dpe legs can gyi byas rjesasogs la bsngags brjod gang legs byas te/ klog pa pos dga' bas byed pa'i brtsams chos legs po gsar rtsom byed dgos la/ dus ma tshungasasabartsams chos kyi brjod bya dang rjod byed/ rtsom stangs/ rtsom thabs bcasakyi cha nas sna mang bkol spyod bgyid pa dar spel byas nas/ mang tshogs kyi 'dod blo sna tshogs dang rim pa mang ba'i rig gnas kyi dgos mkho rgyun mi chad par skong ci thub byed dgos/gnyis pa/ bod rigs rang gi 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i deng rabs tshom rig gi brtsams chos shig yin phyin/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi nang don dang mi rigs kyi rnam pa gnyis nges par du gcig mthun yong dgos pa dang /388

gcod padon grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bar byaṭ+wāṃ/nga po// rang gi rtsom rig gsar rtsom de4nge4par du spyi tshogs ring lugasalazhabasazhu bgyid pa'i kha phyogasadang metog mnyam bzhad dang mkhasabargya 'gran gleng gi byed phyogasargyun 'khyongasabyasathog tsha rlabasa'aphyur ba'i dngosayod kyi 'tsho ba'i nang zab zhug4byed pa dang / rgya che ba'i rong 'brog mang tshogasakyi khrod du 'gro ba/ gsar rtsom gyi gtso gnad de deng rabasakyi 'tsho ba dngosabarjod pa'i nang du bzhag ste/ smyug rtse dang mig mda' bzo zhing dmag dang shesayon can gyi phyogasasubaskor ba dang / spyi tshogasaring lug4deng rabasacan gyi 'dzugasaskrun lasadon dang spyi tshogasa'atsho ba'i nang gi 'bur thon gyi gnad don brjod de/ bcosasgyur sgo 'byed skabasakyi nyam4myong gsar ba dang sngon thon misna/ dpe legasacan gyi byasarjesasogasal bsngagasabarjod gang legasabyasate/ klog pa po4dga' bsubyed pa'i brtsamasachosalegasapo gsar rtsomabyed dgosal/ dusamatshungasasubartsams chosakyi brjod bya dngarjod byed/ rtsom stangs/ rtsom thabasabacasakyi cha nasasnamang bkolaspyod bgyid pa dar spel byasanas/ mang tshogasakyi 'dod blo sna tshogasadang rim pamang ba'i rig gnasakyi dgosamakhorgyun michad par skong ci thub byed dgos/gnyisapa/ bod rigasarang gi 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i deng rabasartsomarig gi brtsamasachosashig yin phyin/ spyi tshog4ring lugasakyi nang don dang miṭ+wāṃñtshasakyi rnamapa gnyis ngesapar du gcig mthun yong dgosapa dang /

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor ragasatsam gleng ba/dusarabasakyi bsamablodang mi rigasakyi khyad cho4gsalabo yin pa'i brtsamasachosashig yin na/ mi rigasarang gi nang du klog ngapo shin tumang bar ma zad/ mirigasagazhan gyi klog pa posakyang dga' bsadang gcesasu'adzin ngesared/ de'i phyir nga tsho'i dusarabasagasar ba'i bod rigasartsoyopa po r+shamasakyisade'i thad la shugasasnon byed rgyu ni gal 'gangasache ba'i bya ba zhig gsum pa/ bod khamasasuspyi tshogasaring lugasakyi rtsom rig gsar ba 'phel rgyasasugatong dgosan/ nga tshosargyalakhab phyi nang gi rtsomarig sna tshogasakyi leg4cha bsduci thub byed dgosal/ mirigasarang gi phul byung bi srol rgyun rig gnasakyang 'dzin skyong spelwa gsum gang legasabyed dgos/rang re'i bod rigasakyi deng rabasartsom rig de gzhan pa'i sngon thon mi rigasadang bsdur na 'phel rgyasakyi gom 'gro4cung dalab red/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang rang nyid la rtsomarig gsar rtsomagyi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig med par mgyogasamyur gyisargyalakhab phyi nang gi rtsom rig snatshogasakyi rtsom thabasate bkol zin pa'i rtsomathabasarnying ba dag la lad mobyasanasagasar rtsom byed pa dang / rtsom thabasagasar bzhig brtsalen byasapa'i dbang du btang na yang mi rigayorang gi klog pa po'i mdze4dpyod kyi gomasasroladang 'dod blobacasal mi mthun na mirigayode'i long4spyod kyi dga' ston du 'gyur mithub pa ltabu red/ gzhan bod kyi rtsomarig yig sgyur byed pa'i bya bde yang phyi phyogasasasgo 'byed pa dang / phan tshun nyamasamyong brje resabyedū ༵'i

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor rags tsam gleng ba/dus rabs kyi bsam zodang mi rigs kyi khyad chos gsal bo yin pa'i brtsamasachos shig yin na/ mi rigs rang gi nang du khrog pa po shin tu mang bar ma zad/ na rigs gzhan gyi klog pa pos kyang dga' bas dang gces su 'dzin nges red/ de'i phyir nga tsho'i dus rabs gsar ba'i bod rigs rtsom pa po rnams kyis de'i thad la shugs sgon byed rgyu ni gal 'gangs che ba'i be+e ba zhig go/gsum pa/ bod khams su spyi tshogs ring lugs byu rtsom rig gsar ba 'phel rgyas sa gtong dgos na/ nga tshos rgyal khab phyi nang gi rtsom rig sna tshogs kyi legs cha bsdu ci thub byed dgos la/ mi rigs rang gi phul byung ba/ srol rgyun rig gnas kyang 'dzin skyong pel gsum gang legs byed dgos/rang re'i bod rigs kyi deng rabs rtsom rig de gzhan pa'i sngon thon mi rigasadang bsdur na 'phel rgyas kyi gom 'gros cung dal ba red/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang rang nyid la rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig med par mgyogs myur gyis rgyal khab phyi nang gi rtsom rig sna tshogs kyi rtsom thabs te bkol zin pa'i rtsom thabs rnying ba dag la lad mo byas nas gsar tshom byed pa dang / rtsom thabs gsar ba zhig bas len byas pa'i dbang du btang na yang mi rigasarang gi klog pa po'i mdzes dpyod kyi goms srol dang 'dod blo bcas la mi ma/thun na ba rigs de'i longs spyod kyi dga' ston du 'gyur me+ethub pa lta bu red/ gzhan bod kyi rtsom rig yig sgyur byed pa'i bya ba de yang phyi phyogs sa sgo 'byed pa dang / phan tshan nyams myong brje res byed pa'i 389

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi chedartsom phyogs bsgrigs/thabasalamagalachen zhig yinal/ nga tshosabod rigasarang nyid kyi phul du byung ba'i srolargyun rig gnasadang deng rabasakyi rtsomarig brtsamasachosaphulabyung canarnamasamirigasagazhan gyi yige dang phyi rgyalagyi yiger bsgyur nasamatshamasasbyor byasachog la/ rgyalakhabaphyi nang gi phulabyung brtsamasachosadag kyang mirigasarang gi yiger bsgyur nasaslob sbyong bya4chog de ltar phan tshun bar rgyusalon dang phan tshun bar skul 'ded/ phan tshun la mtshamasasbyor byed pabacasabargyud nas/ bod kyi rtsomarig gsar rtsomagyi chu tshad mthor 'degasagatong bar nam yang 'bad 'bungasabyed dgosaso/ /bzhi ba/ da ltabod rigasagasar rtsomapa'i khrod du skor zhig gisargya yig khon lasagasar rtsomabyed ngadang skor zhig gisabod yig kho na lasagasar rtsom byed bzhin padang / yang la lasabod rgya yig rig4gnyi4kyisagasar rtsomabyed bzhin yod/ yig rigasagang bkol kyang bod mi rigasakyi 'tsho ba dngosabarjod pa'i brtsamasachosashig yin phyin/ bod kyi deng rabasartsom rig 'phel rgyasasu'agro bar 'brayobu smin yod pani smosam dgosamod/yin na'ang kho bo4bltasan rang rigasakyi mayig bkol nayortsom rig gsar rtsom bya rgyu ni shin tugal che ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni mi rigasarang gi mayig mabakolan bod kyi srolargyun rig gnasa'adzin skyong spel gsum byasate mirigasarang gi skad dang rig gan4'phelargyasasugatong bar gnod pa yod pa dang gcig rang re'i bod skad dang bod kyi rig gnasal brten nasagrub pa'i rtsoswāṭ+wāṃg brtsamasachosa'adi yin zhesabarjod rgyu med pa dang gnyis/ rang gi

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thabs lam gal chen zhig yin la/ nga tshos bod rigs rang nyid kyi phul du byung ba'i srol rgyun rig gnas dang deng rabs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos4labyung can rnams mi rigs gzhan gyi ye ge dang phyi rgyal gyi ⑪ger bsgyur nasamatshams sbyor byas chog la/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi phul byung brtsams chos dag kyang mi rigs rang gi ye ger bsgyur nas slob spyong byas chog de ltar phan tshan bar rgyus lon dang phan tshun bar skul 'ded/ phan tshan la mtshamasasbyor byed pa bcas brgyud nas/ bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi chu tshad mthor 'degs gtong bar nam yang 'bad 'bungs byed dgos so/ /bzhi ba/ da lta bod rigs gsar rtsom pa'i khrod du skor zhig gis rgya yig kho na las gsar rtsom byed pa dang skor zhig gis bod yig kho na lasagasar rtsom byed bzhin pa dang / yang la las bod rgya yig rigs gnyis kyisagasar tshom byed bzhin yod/ yig rigs gang bkol kyang bod mi rigs kyi 'tsho ba dngos brjod pa'i brtsams chos shig yin phyin/ bod kyi deng rabasartsom rig 'phel rgyas sa 'gro bar 'bras bu smin yod pa ni smos ma dgos mod/yin na'ang kho bos bltas na rang rigs kyi ma yig bkol nas rtsom rig gsar rtsom bya rgyu ni shin tu gal che ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni mi rigs rang gi ma yig ma bkol na bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum/ byas te mi rigasarang gi skad dang rig gnas 'phel rgyas tshogatong bar gnod pa yod pa dang gcig rang re'i bod skad dang bod kyi rig gnas la brten nas grub pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos 'di yin zhes brjod rgyu sted pa dang gnyis/ rang gi 390

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor rags tsam gleng ba/rig gnas las grub pa'i brtsams chos shig min phyin/ bod rigasar+shadamangs mang tshogs kyis longs sa spyod pa'i zas rigs su 'gyur ba thub pa dang gsum bcas pa'i zhan cha yod la/ de'i phyir nga tshos rang na rigs kyi skad dang ⑪ge la brten nas rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed par blo kha phyogs rgyu be+e nam yang 'dor mi rung / gal srid ba rigs gzhan pa'i yig rigs bkol nas bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed mkhan zhig yin na'ang rang sko rigs kyi skad dang rig gnas 'dor mi rung ste/ rang shi rigs kyi skad dang rig gnas kyi gzhi brtan po zhig chags pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng mi rigs gzhan pa dang yang na phyi gling pa'i yig rigs bkol nas bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed thub pas na da gzod der ma ze bong bsgrengs nas bsngags brjod byed 'os so/ /lnga ba/ bod kyi rtsom rig la cha mtshon na/ rtsom rig gsar ba shugasacan gyis 'phel rgyas sa gtong ba dang chabs cig rtsom rig dpyad bsdur gyi be+e ba dam 'dzin byed dgos/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom dang rtsom rig dpyad bsdur gnyis ni phan tshan la brten pa dang phan tshan la khrul 'ded byed pa'i phyogasag 'a/ chen gnyis yin la/ gang yang med du mi rung ngo / /bod kye lo rgyasasab lha yon 'ang bod la rtsom rig dpyad bsdur gyi skor zhan pa'i dbang gis bod kyi rtsom gyi rig gsar rtsom 'phel rgyas kyang cung dal bar gyur pa de mthong thub pas na/ nged cag 'brel yod sde khag dang mi snas dus rgyun du 'di phyogs kyi ched las mkhas pa dang klog pa po rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ rtsom pa po' 391

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor rags tsam gleng ba/rig gnasalasagrub pa'i brtsamasachosashig min phyin/ bod rigasamidamangasamang tshogasakyi4longasasuspyod pa'i zasarigasasu'agyur mithub padangagasumabacasapa'i zhan cha yod la/ de'i phyir nga tshosarang mirigasakyi skad dang yige la brten nasartsomarig gsar rtsomabyed par blokhaphyogasargyu ni nam yang 'dor mirung / gal srid mirig4gzhan pa'i yig rigasabakol na4bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed mkhanazhig yin na'ang rang mirigasakyi skad dang rig gnasa'ador mirung ste/ rang mirigasakyi skad dang rig gnasakyi gzhi brtan po zhig chagasapa'i rmang gzhi'i steng mirig4gzhan padang yang na phyi gling pa'i yig rigasabakol nasabod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom ṭ+wāṃd ṭ+wāṃbapasan da gzod der mthe bong bsgrengasanasabasngagasabarjod byed —4 /lnga ba// bod kyi rtsom rig la cha mtshon na/ rtsom rig gsar ba shugasachen gyiyo'aphelargyasasugatong ba dang chabasacig rtsom rig dpyad bsdur gyi bya ba dam 'dzin byed dgos/ rtsomarig gsar rtsomadang rtsomarig dpyad bsdur gnyisani phan tshun la brten pa dang phan tshun laskul 'ded byed pa'i phyogasagal chen gnyi4yin la/ gang yang med du mirung ngo / /bod kyi lorgyusasubaltasana'ang bod la rtsom rig dpyad bsdur gyi skor zhanapa'i dbang gisabod kyi rtsomagyi rig gsar rtsoma'aphel rgyayokyang cung dalabar gyur pa de mthong thub pasan/ nged cag 'brel yod sdekhag dang misnasadusargyun du 'di phyogasakyi ched lasamakhasangadang klogapa po rtsa 'dzugasabyasate/ rtsom ༵ /'i

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brtsamasachosaladapyad bsdur gtong ba dang / 'brelayod kyi dusadebatu'ang rtsomarig dpyad bsdur skor gyi rtsomayig spel bar gtsigasa'adzin byasan da gzod rtsomapa po laskulamagatong thubapadang / rtsom rig gsar rtsoyogyi chu tshad mtho ru 'degasapar yang rogasaramabyed thub bo/ /drug pa/ dusarabasagasar ba'i nang gi bod rigasartsomapa po'i rtsoyorig sgyu rtsalaphyog4kyi shesabya phun sum tshog4par gtong rgyur shugasasnon byed dgos/ gal srid shesarig sna tshogasakyi rmang gzhi cung brtan po zhig chagasam thub na sha rusaganyisaldan gyi brtsamasachosalegasapo zhig 'bri dka' bar brten/ nga tshosathog mar bsam blo'i 'du shesadang rtsom rig sgyu rtsalagyi 'du shesagasar sgyur byasate/ rgyun chad med par rang nyid kyi mthong rgya je cher gtong ba dang / spyi tshogasakyi shesabya mang por slobasbyong byasate/ gom gang mdun sposasgosarang nyid kyi rjod byed tshig gi bkol spyod kyi nusapa mthor 'degasagatong bar hur brtson lhod med byed dgos/bdun pa/ 'go khrid la shug4snon byed pa dang rtsom rig gsar rtsomagyi dpung sde'i 'dzugasaskrun dam 'dzin byed rgyu ni deng rabasabod kyi rtsomarig 'phel rgyasasugatong ba'i gnad 'gag yin/ nga tshor rgan dar gzhon gsumagyi rtsomarig gsar rtsomagyi dpung sdergya chen po zhig med phyin/ bod kyi rtsom rig lasadon 'phel rgyas sugatong ba'i mdun ljongasayag po zhig yong dka' bas/ rtsomarig gsar rtsomapa'i mirabasagasar ba skyed sring byed rgyu ni nga tsho/ ṭ+wāg tu babasapa'i lasa'agan ljid po zhig red/ mig sngar bod du ched

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /brtsams chos la dpyad bsdur gtong ba dang / 'brel yod kyi dus deb tu'ang rtsom rig dpyad bsdur skor sgyu rtsom yig bal bar gtsigs 'dzin byasan da gzod rtsom pa po la skul ma gtong thub pa dang / rtsom rig gsar rtsomagyi chu tshad mtho ru 'degs par yang rogs ram byed thub bo/ /drug pa/ dus rabs gsar ba'i nang gi bod rigs rtsom pa po'i rtsomarig sgyu rtsal phyogs kyi shes bya phun sum tshogs par gtong rgyur shugs sgon byed dgos/ gal srid shes rig sna tshogs kyi rmang gzhi cung brtan po zhig chagasam thub na sha rus gnyis ldan gyi bcoms chos legs po zhig 'bri dka' bar brten/ nga tshos thog ma/ra bsam blo'i 'du shes dang rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi 'du shes sar sgyur byas te/ rgyun chad med par rang nyid kyi mthong rgya je cher gtong ba dang / spyo tshogs kyi shes bya mang por slob sbyong byas te/ gom gang mdun spos sgos rang nyid kyi jod byed tshig gi bkol spyod kyi nus pa mthor 'degs gtong bar hur brtson lhod med byed dgos/bdun pa/ 'go khrid la shugs sgon byed pa dang rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi dpung sde'i 'dzugs skrun dam 'dzin byed rgyu ni deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i gnad 'gag yin/ nga tshor rgan dar gzhon gsum gyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi dpung sde rgya chen po zhig med phyin/ bod kyi tshom rig las don 'phel rgyas tshogatong ba'i mdun ljongs yag po zhig yong dka' bas/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom pa'i bar bas gsar ba skyed sring byed rgyu be+e nga tshol phrag tu babs pa'i las 'gan ljid po zhig red/ mig sngar bod du ched 392

bod kye deng rabs rtsom rig skor rags tsam gleng ba/las rtsom pa po cung nyung stabs las zhor rtsom pa pos rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi ka rdo'i tshab byed bzhin mchis/ las shor rtsom pa por mtshon na/ kho tsho rtsom rig gsar rtsom kyi skabs stodaka' ngal dang gnad don cha nyung bar 'phrad bzhin yod pas/ 'brel yod 'go khrid dang sde khag gis nam yang lhod med ngang sems khur dang rgyab rogs gang nus gnang ste/ kho tsho'i dka' ngal sel ba dang sbrags rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi khor yug legs po zhig bskrun rgyu be+e ha cang gal che/ gzhan yang gsar rtsom gyi sbas shugs byung che zhing mdun ljongs yangs pa'i dar gzhon las zhor rtsom pa po dag gtso bor bzung nasabyed sring byed rgyu de nga tshong be+e ba'i gnad sar 'jog dgos snyam/ klad pa'i thon rdzas kyi thon skyed be+e ches dka' sdug can gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i ngal rtsol zhig yin phyir/ 'go khrid sde khag gis khong rnams la bste bkur dang khong rnams kyi ngal rtsol la srung skyob byas te/ sngar las legs pa'i brtsamasachos mang po 'brir bcug nas brtsams chos ches bzang ba rnams mi dmangasamang tshogs la 'bul bar brtson dgos pa de'o/ /1996lor bris/393

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor rags tsam gleng ba/layortsomapapo cung nyung stabasalasazhor rtsomapa posartsom rig gsar rtsomagyi ka rdo'i tshab byed bzhinamachis/ la4zhor rtsomapa por mtshon na/ kho tsho rtsomarig gsar rtsoyokyi skabasasudaka' ngal dang gnad don minyung bar 'phrad bzhin yod pas/ 'brelayod 'go khrid dang sde khag gisanamayang lhod med ngang sem4khur dang rgyab rogasagang nusaganang ste/ kho tsho'i dka' ngalasel ba dang sbragasartsomarig gsar rtsom gyi khor yug legasapozhig bskrun rgyu ni ha cang galache/ gzhan yang gsar rtsomagyi sbasashugasacung che zhing mdun ljong4yang4pa'i dar gzhon lasazhor rtsomapapo dag gtso bor bzung nasaskyed sring byed rgyu de nga tsho'i bya ba'i gnad sar 'jog dgosasnyam/ klad pa'i thonardzasakyi thon skyed ni cheyodaka' sdug can gyi thun mong mayin pa'i ngal rtsol zhig yin phyir/ 'go khrid sde khag giyokhong rnam4la brtsi bkur dang khong rnamasakyi ngalartsol la srung skyob byasate/ sngar la4leg4pa'i brtsamasachosamang po 'brir bcug nasabartsamasacho4che4bzang ba rnamasami dmangasamang tshogasal 'bul bar brtson dgosapa de'o/ /1996lor bris/393

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sbu 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/'go brjod/'phags 'phags 'jig rten srid pa'i rtse mo las/ /snyan snyan grags pa'i rgyal mtshan rab g.yo ba'i/ /mchog mchog sku 'bum dgon pa'i gzi dpal gyis/ /mdzes mdzes mdo smad ljongs 'di rnam par brgyan/ /zhes pa'i bsngags brjod tshig gis sngon bsus shing / / de yang dge mtshan yongs su khyab pa'i dpal/ / gangs can chol kha gsum gyi skyed tshal las/ / mdo smad mgyogs 'gro'i chol kha 'dab brgya'i phreng / / phyogs kyi bu mo'i snyan du yongs smin pa/ / de las shar phyogs tsong kha'i sman ljongasazhes/ / rgyu skar khrod na chu shel dbang bo bzhin/ / ma dzes pa'i lang tsho malus rab rdzogs pa'i/ / gnas mchog 'di la ngo mtshar stong gis brgyan/ /lhal ma stebs brgyad 'khor lo'i tshul du gnas/ / nor 'dzin pad ma 'dab brgyad dbyibs sa 'khrungs/ / lhan chags sa 'dzin zeng bas yongasasabaskor/ / tsan dan dang bcas sna tshogs 'khri shing gis/ / nyin yang ma/tshan/ mor bkod pa'i snang ba ster/ / yan lag bzhi zung ldan pa'i tsong chu 394

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/'go brjod/'phagasa'aphagasa'ajig rten srid pa'i rtse molas/ /snyan snyan gragasapa'i rgyalamatshan rab g.yoba'i/ /mchog mchog sku 'bum dgon pa'i gzi dpalagyis/ /mdze4mdze4mdo smad ljongasa'adi rnam par brgyan/ /zhesapa'i bsngagasabarjod tshig gisasngon bsu4shing / / de yang dge mtshan yongasasukhyab pa'i dpal/ / gangasacan cholakha gsum gyi skyed tshalalas/ / mdo smad mgyog4'gro'i cholakha'adab brgya'i phreng / / phyogasakyi bu mo'i snyan du yongasasmin pa/ / de lasashar phyogasatsong kha'i sman ljongasazhes/ / rgyu skar khrod na chu shel dbang bo bzhin/ / mdze4pa'i lang tsho malusarab rdzog4pa'i/ / gnasamachog 'di lango mtshar stong gisabargyan/ /lhalamartsibasabargyad 'khor lo'i tshuladu gnas/ / nor 'dzin pad ma 'dab brgyad dbyibasasu'akhrungs/ / lhun chags4'dzin phreng ba4yongasasubaskor/ / tsan dan dang bcasasna tshogasa'akhri shing gis/ / nyin yang mtshan morwa ༵kod pa'i snang ba ster/ / yan lagabazhi zung ldan pa'i tsong chu

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/zhes/ / chu klung lhang lhang dbang bo'i phyogs la 'bab/ / phyugs rigs dang ni 'bru rigs sna lnga bcas/ / bri med dkar phyogs zla bzhin 'phel ba'i yul/ / rgyab rten rgyab ri 'brug chung zhes pa 'di/ / g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i dbyibs bzhin lhan zhing sdug / mdun ri 'bras bzang ga tshogs srungasa'adra ba'i/ / bang rim glegs bam brgya phrag brtsegs pa 'dra/ / g.yas ri ma chod rten dbyings sa bsnyegs 'dra ba'i/ / lto bar rin chen gter gyi mngal khur lci/ / g.yon ri glang chen 'phred du 'gying 'dra'i ngor/ / srid zhi'i yon tan nor bu 'bum/ gyis brgyan/ / yangs pa'i mda' na grong dang grong khyer gyi/ / khang brtsegs mthon po mu tig brdal ba bzhin/ / ltan sdug pa'i pha mtha' gzhal nus bral/ / phun tshogs nyams dga'i tsong kha'i gser gzhong ni/ / 'chi sked dga' tshal gnas 'dir 'phos pa 'dra/ / de'adra'i 'dab brgya phrug par bzhad dbus su/ / rmad byung gru 'dzin ri bor co 'dri ba'i/ / sku 'bum byams pa gling zhes chos kyi sde/ / mdzes sdug rngam brjid dang bcas lhang nger bzhugs/ / de na rten gsum nor rgyas rab brgyan pa'i/ / lha khang brgya phrag du ma'i mdzes rtsal gyis/ / rnam rgyal khang bzang yin kyang skyengs ster na/ / gnam 'og 'di na 'gran zla yod re skan/ / de ⑪rin chen bo thog rgya phebs kyi/ / gser mdangs 'khyu ga pa'i gzi 'od bye ba brgyas/ / mtshan yang nyin bzhin gsal ler snang ba'i dpal/ / nyin byed stong gis 'gran zla ma bzod par/ / skyengs nas chu lha'i phang bar 'khrud par brtsams/ / gser gyi rtseg pa rab mtho'i bzhin 395

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/zhes/ / chu klung lhung lhung dbang bo'i phyogasal 'bab/ / phyugasarigasadang ni 'bru rigasasna lnga bcas/ / bri med dkar phyog4zabazhin 'phel ba'i yul/ / rgyab rten rgyab ri 'brug chung zhesapa 'di/ / g.yu'abrug sngon mo'i dbyib4bzhin lhunazhing sdug / mdun ri 'bra4bzang snatshogasaspungasa'adra ba'i/ / bang rim glegasabamabargya phrag brtsegasapa 'dra/ / g.yasari mchod rten dbyingasasubasnyegayo'adra ba'i/ / ltobar rin chen gter gyi mngalakhur lci/ / g.yon ri glang chen 'phred du 'gying 'dra'i ngor/ / srid zhi'i yon tan nor bu 'bum gyisabargyan/ / yangasapa'i mda' na grong dang grongakhyer gyi/ / khang brtsegasamathon po mu tig brdal ba bzhin/ / ltan sdug pa'i pha mtha' gzhalanusabral/ / phun tshogasanyamasadaga'i tsong kha'i gser gzhong ni/ / 'chi med dga' tshal gnasa'adir 'pho4pa 'dra/ / de 'dra'i 'dab brgya lhug par bzhad dbusasu/ / rmad byung gru 'dzin ri bor co 'dri ba'i/ / sku 'bum byamasapagling zhe4chosakyi sde/ / mdzesasdug rngam brjid dang bca4lhang nger bzhugs/ / de na rten gsum nor gyisarab brgyan pa'i/ / lhakhang brgya phrag du ma'i mdzeyortsal gyis/ / rnamargyal khang bzang yin kyang skyengs ster na/ / gnam 'og 'di na 'gran zla yod re skan/ / de yirin chen yathog rgya phibasakyi/ / gser mdangasa'akhyug pa'i gzi 'od bye ba brgyas/ / mtshan yang nyin bzhin gsal ler snang ba'i dpal/ / nyin byed stong gisa'agran zla mabazod par/ / skyengasanasachu lha'i phang bar 'khyad par bcoms/ / gser gyi rtsig pa rabamatho'i3 sduṭ+wāṃn

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo ma ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ngos la/ / mtho ris 'od lnga chags 'dra'i tshon mdangs kyis/ / mngon par brgyan pa'i don ldan gzugs ris ni/ / byed pos bris pa yin nam 'phyang mo nyug / rnam par mdzes pa'i dra ba dra phyed dang / / rnam mang gser dngul dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng / / rnam pa mi gcig gar gyi ri mo la/ / mig stong sprul nas bltas kyang ngoms pa med/ / nang rten 'gangs chen rin bral nam mkha'i nor/ / lta bu'i gzi byin rab tu 'bar ba na/ / lha yod bang bo yin kyang re zhig la/ / sum rtsen gnas la 'khrul nas rnam 'gyur 'dzin/ / de las rgyal bstan gas byed sde sgod gsum/ / gcig tu bsdusapa'i bka' bstan glegs bam 'bum/ / 'dzin mas ma jeg rgya ma/tshor shor dogs nas/ / sred med bu yis 'degs la ngal brgya bsten/ / lhag par nyam/sa ldan phul byung sgyu rtsal las/ / grub pa'i sna tshogs me tog mchod rdzasal/ / lta skor phyag mjal phebs pa'i mi rigs kun/ / sprin dkar 'du'agod yang yang bgyid par mtshungs/ / de ltar bkod pa'i sgod kyi 'jig rten 'di'i/ / ngo mtshar zla bral yon tan stong phrag gis/ / mtho ris grong khyer yin kyang dman ster na/ / blo ldan skye bo'i yid dbang ces mi 'phrog /ces dang / da ni lo rgyus dngos la 'jug par bya ste/dang po/ dgon pa gsar bzhengs kyi dgos pa dang brgyud rim/de yang rje tsong kha pa'i 'khrungs yul sku 'bum byams pa gleng zhes bya ba'i dgon chen 'di ni mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi dge lugs pa'i dgon 396

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ringagi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ngosal/ / mtho risa'od lnga chagasa'adra'i tshon mdangasakyis/ / mngon par brgyan pa'i don ldan gzugasaris ni/ / byed posabri4pa yin nama'aphyang monyug / rnamapar mdzesapa'i dra badra phyed dang / / rnam mang gser dngul drilabu g.yer kha'i phreng / / rnam pami gcig gar gyi ri mol/ / mig stong sprul nasabaltasakyang ngomasapa med/ / nang rten 'gangasachen rin bralanam mkha'i nor/ / ltabu'i gzi byin rab tu 'bar ba na/ / lhayidabang bo yin kyang re zhig la/ / sumartsen gnasala'akhrul nasarnama'agyur 'dzin/ / de lasargyal bstan gsalabyed sde snod gsum/ / gcig tu bsdusapa'i bka' bstan glegasabama'abum/ / 'dzin masamatheg rgya mtshor shor dogasanas/ / sred med bu yisa'adegasal ngal brgya bsten/ / lhag par nyamasaldan phulabyung sgyu rtsalalas/ / grub pa'i snatshog4metog mchod rdzasal/ / yiskor phyag mjal phebasapa'i mi rig4kun/ / sprin dkar 'du 'god yang yang bgyid par mtshungs/ / de ltar bkod pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten 'di'i/ / ngo mtshar zla bralayon tan stong phrag gis/ / mtho risagrong khyer yinakyang dman ster na/ / bloldan skye bo'i yid dbang cisami 'phrog /cesadang / da ni lorgyu4dngosala'ajug par bya ste/4 dang po/ dgon pa gsar bzhengs kyi dgos pa dang brgyud ram/ de yang rje tsong khapa'i 'khrungasayul sku 'bum byamasapa gling zhesabya bdi dūgon chen 'di ni mdo dbusagatsang gsumagyi dge lugasapa'i dgon

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/don drug gi gras tshogatogs shing / de ni maḥ sngon zhing chen zu ltob zi ling grong khyer gyi yas nas spyo le nyer lnga'i mtshams sumangon par cigs yod do/ /chos sde 'di la spyi lo1560lor sgom chen pa rin chen brtson 'grus rgya mtshos rje tsong kha pa'i 'khrungs yul la rjes dran du dgon pa chung ngu zhigabatab pa nas brtsis na lo 'khor443gyi lo rgyus ldan zhing / spyi lo1583lor rgyal dbang gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho mchog nyid dgon pa 'dir phebs te sa 'dul lam sa rtags mdzad nas phal cher khang ba'i gzhi bzung ba nas brtses na lo 'khor420'das pa'i lo rgyus ldan la/ spyolo1612lor chos rje 'od zer rgya mtsho mchog khro thog dang por bzhugs te/mtshan nyid kyi grwa tshang thog mar btsugs pa nas brtsis na lo 'khor391'das pa'i lo rgyus ldan no/ /dgon pa 'di'i lo rgyus bor gas ci 'dra zhig brjod kyang thog mar nges par du sku 'bum gser sdong chen mo/'i lo rgyus brjod dgos shing /gser sdo nga chen mong lo rgyus de nges par du rje cong kha pa'i lo rgyus dang ma/ 'brel na brjod thabs bral ba'i dbang ges/ sngon la mdo snga gas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan rje tsong kha pa chen po'i lo rgyus mdo tsam brngod par bya'o/ /de yang khong ni sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong nyisabargya so bdun te spyi lo1357lo'i hor zla bcu ba'i tshes bcu'i snga dro mdo smad 397

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdusapa/chen drug gi gra4sugatog4shing / de ni mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi lteb zi ling ṭ+wāṃng khyer gyi ya4nasaspyi lenyer lnga'i mtsham4sumangon par chagasayod chosar+sā'adi laspyi lo1560lor sgom chen pa rin chen brtson 'grusargya mtshosarje tsong khapa'i zhakhrungasayul la rjesadran du dgon pa chung ngu zhig btab pa na4brtsisan lo'akhor443gyi lo rgyusaldan zhing / spyi lo1583lor rgyal dbang gsumapa bsod namasargya mtsho mchog nyid dgon pa 'dir phebasate yo'adulalam sartagasamadzad nayophal cher khang ba'i gzhi bzung ba nasabartsi4na lo 'khor420'dasapa'i lo rgyusaldan la/ spyi lo1612lor chosarje 'od zer rgya mtsho mchog khri thog dang por bzhugasate/mtshan nyid kyi grwa tshang thog mar btsugasapanas brtsisan lo'akhor391'ad4pa'i lo rgyusaldan no/ /dgon pa 'di'i lo rgyusaphraragasaci 'dra zhig brjod kyang thog mar ngesapar du sku 'bum gser sdong chen mo/'i lo rgyusabarjod dgosashing /gser sdong chen mo'i lorgyusade nges par du rje tsong kha pa'i lorgyusadang ma 'brel na brjod thabasabral ba'i dbang gis/ sngon la mdo sngagasabastan pa'i mnga' bdag mkha4pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan rje tsong kha pa chen po'i lo rgyu4mdo tsam brjod par bya'o/ /de yang khong ni sangasargyasamya ngan lasa'adasanasalo nyi4stong nyisabargya sobadun te spyi lo1357lo'i hor zla bcu ba'i tshe4bcu'i snga dro ma~X snad

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tsongasazhesabya ba'i sman ljongayo'adi ru yabaklu 'bumadage dang yumashingapobaza' achosaganyi4kyi4srayosusku legasapar 'khrungasapa lags/ yabayum gnyisalasrasadrug mnga' spolasarje 'di nyid ni bzhi ba yin no/ /desan lo rgyusakyi gdanarab4ltar na rje khong nyid kyi ltokhrag sala'aphosapa lasatsan dan gyi ljon shing phun sum tshogasapa zhig skyesazer ba dab/dgung logasum bzhesatshe kurma rolapa'i rdo rje'i drung du yongasardzogasadage bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhesashing / mtshan la kun dga' snying bor gsol/dgung lobadun la babasapa na bya khyung brag dgon 'debasapa po cho4rje rin chenadon grub mchog gi sku drung du phyinanas/ rab byung gi tshulakhrimasadang dge tshul bsgrub4te/ blobazang gragasapa'i dpal zhesamatshan gsolazhing /rje dam pa'adi nyid lasamado sngagasaganyisakyi gzhung legs par gsan padang / yoge 'bri klog la brtson pa shin tumadzad pasarig pa'i gnasalnga phalacher thogasapa med par thugasasuchud/ dgung lobacu drug bzhesapa'i tshe legasabashad kyi skyesalen pa'i phyir rje khong nyid kyis sproshāgasadrag po bzlog tu med pa bskyed nas/ mdo smad bya khyung nasam4te bcu bdun lo la dbusasuslebs/ de nasarimapasa'abri khung dpal gyi nagasakhrod/ gsang phu bde ba can/ myang stod/ zha lu/ snar thang / saskya sogasaganasam/chog du mar byon nas/ lo tsā ba mkhan chen rin chen rnam rgyal dang / sabazang paṇa chen ma ti ba/ dbu mabartsona'agrusaseng go lhobrag grub chen nam mkha' rgya~Xtshan/ rje red mda' ba gzhon nu blogrosal sog4skyesachen dam pa

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tsong kha zhes bya ba'i sman ljongs 'di ru yab klu 'bum dge dang yum shingayobaza' a chos gnyis kyis sras sum legs par 'khrungs pa lags/ yabayum gnyis la sras drug mnga' ba las rje 'di nyid ni bzhi ba yin no/ /des na lo rgyu4kye gdan rabs ltar na rje khong nyid byu lte khrag sala'aphos pa las tsan dan gyi ljon shing phun sum tshogs pa zhig skyes zer ba dab/dgung lo gsum bzhe4tshe karma rol pa'i rdo rje'i drung du yo ngas rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes shing / mtshan la kun dga' snying bor gsol/dgung lo bdun la babs pa na bya khyung brag dgon 'debs pa po chos rje rin chen don grub ma/chog gi sbu drung du phyin nas/ rab byung gi tshul khrims dang dge tshul bsgrubs te/ blo bzang grags pa'i dpal zhes ma tshan gsol zhing /rje dam pa 'di nyid las mdo sngags gnyis kyi gzhung legs par gsan pa dang / na ge 'bri klog la brtson pa shin tu mdzad pas rig pa'i gnas lnga phal cher thogs pa med par thugs su chud/ dgung lo bcu drug bzhes pa'i che legs bshad kyi skyes len pa'i phyir rje khong nyid kyes sgo shugs drag po bzlogatu med pa bskyed nas/ mdo smad bya khyung nas chas te bcu bdun 'o la dbusas khrebs/ de nas rim pas 'bri khung dpal gyi nags khrod/ gsang phu bde ba can/ myang stod/ zha lu/ snar thang / sa skya sogs gnas ma chog du ma/ra byon nas/ lo tsā ba mkhan chen rin chen rnam rgyal dang / sa bzang paṇa chen ma ti ba/ dbu ma brtson 'grus seng ge lho brag grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rje red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros la sogs skyes chen dam pa 398

sku 'bum byams pa 1nga gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/rnams blo sems rtse gcig gis spyi bor bsten te shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs pa legs par mdzad de/ rgya chen thos pa'i lung gi yon tan gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol tu phyin cing / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa'i khri 'phang ma/thon por 'jigs pa sked par mnga' bsgyur te/ mdo sngagasagazhung gi glegs bam dum pa bcu dgu brtsams so zhes bdag gi mtshungs med sgob dpon shar ming 'dzin pa'i 'dab brgya'i zhal las grol lo/ /spyi lo1379lo ste rje rin po che dgung lo nyer gnyis bzhes pa'i lo der mdo smad tsong kha'i yal nas khong gi yum gyisang ni rgas shing 'khogs pas pha yu'i 'dir ci nas kyang phebs dgos zhes 'phrin yig dang chabs cig skra dkar lan bu zhig phul bar/ khong gis mdo smad du phebs par bgegs bya che la dgos pa chung bar gzigs nas mi yong bar thugs thag bcad de/ rje dbon grags pa rgyal mtshan lan skyel du mngags nas yum dang spriche gnyis la rje rang nyid kyi khru thang re dang rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro'i ma dpar bcas bskur te bdag rang skyes pa'i sa cha der rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro'i snang brnyan 'bum dang tsan dan gyi sdong bo snying bor byas pa'i mchod rten zhig bzhengs na bdag nyid der 'ongs pa dang khyad par ma mchis shing / bstan pa phyogs kun la rgyas pa'i rten 'brel yod ces gsungs pa dang / mngag4pa'i pho nyas ye ge dang rten bcas khyer nas ma yum gyi sgo drung du slebs pa na bas sku de'i zhal nas am sprim zhes 'bod par mdzad pas na/ gsung 'byon par gnang zhes lo rgyus gdan rabs gags la zhing / yum thugs shin tu skyo nas spyan 399

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/rnam4blosemasartse gcig gisaspyi bor bsten te shesabya'i gnasamatha' dag la sbyangasapa legasapar mdzad de/ rgya chen thosapa'i lung gi yon tan gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol tu phyin cing / 'chad rtsod rtsoyogasum lathogasapa med pa'i khri 'phang mthon por 'jigasapa med par mnga' bsgyur te/ mdo sngagasagazhung gi glegasabamadum pabacu dgu brtsamasasozhesabadag gi mtshungasamed slob dpon shar ming 'dzin pa'i 'dab brgya'i zhal lasagrol lo/ /spyi lo1379lo ste rje rin po che dgung lonyer gnyisabazhesapa'i lo der mdo smad tsong kha'i yul nasakhong gi yumagyisang ni rgasashing 'khogasapasapha yul 'dir ci nasakyang phebasadago4zhesa'aphrin yig dang chabasacig skudakar lan bu zhig phulabar/ khong gisamado smad du phebasapar bgegasabya che la dgosapa chung bar gzigasanasamiyong bar thugasathag bcad de/ rje dbon grag4pa rgyalamatshan lan skyeladu mngagasanasayum dang ache gnyiyol rje rang nyid kyi sku thang re dang rgyalab seng ge'i nga ro'i sku dpar bcayobaskur te bdag rang skye4pa'i locha der rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro'i snang brnyan 'bumadang tsan dan gyi sdong bo snying bor bya4pa'i mchod rten zhig bzhengasan bdag nyid der 'ongasapa dang khyad par mamachisashing / bstan pa phyogasakun la rgya4pa'i rten 'brel yod cesagasungasapa dang / mngagasapa'i pho nyagayige dang rten bcasakhyer nasayoyumagyi sgo drung du slebasapa na bri4sku de'i zhal nasa.am am zhesa'abod par mdzad pasan/ gsung 'byon par gnang zhesalo rgyusagadan rabayosugasal zhing / yum thug4shin caskyo naswāsnan
