sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/tshog4chen 'du khang chagasasa'i gzhi de yin par snyam/ )de'i phyisate spyi lo1583lor zhing skyong nang sosagadan drangasapa ltar rgyal ba bsod namasargya mtsho sku 'bum du pheb4nasamachod rten chen pobyang chub mchod rten du bsgyur bar mdzad cing / sku 'bum du dgon pa zhig tshugasan legasazhesa'adulab cho4rje snga ma brtson 'grusargyal mtshan bzang po dang sbyin bdag rnamasal bka' lung nan moganang ba ltar thamasacad kyisabaka' bzhin sgrub par khasablangasate/ rgyaladabang mchog gisadangosasusa'adul lam sartagasamadzad nasaphalacher khang ba'i gzhi bzung ngo / /de'i phyisasuspyi lo1603lor rgyal dbang bzhi bayon tan rgya mtsho mong gol nasalhasar 'gro skabasasku 'bum dgon par phebasate/ sngar gyi dgon pa rnying ba rim gyi4grong dgon ltabur song ba lazhig gsomadzad par dgongasanasa'adul ba chosarje phyi ma'od zer rgya mtsho gan4dgon 'di'i gdan 4dang por bsko bzhag bya rgyu'i bka' nan bcag4stsal pa ji bzhin spyi lo1612lo'i smon lamagyi steng na4dpalaldan bshad sgrub gling zhesagragasapa'i mtshan nyid kyi grwa tshang gsar du btsug4te chosarje 'od zer rgya mtsho khri thog dang por phebasan4lolnga'i bar du chosadang 'jig rten gnyisaka'i sgo nasadagon paskyong bar mdzad/de nasabazung dgon pa 'di'i dar rgyasala'aphela'agrib cung re byung mod kyang spyir khri thog chen po re re yisasbyin bdag mdzad pa dang / gzhan dad ldan rnamasakyi4thugasakhur gnang 'og rimagyisadagon pa'i gtī 0༈ je

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/pa rgya phebs kyi lugs ltar gsar bzhengs byas pa la bla brang chen mo bkra shisakhang zhes btags/spyi lo1711lor jun wang er ti ni jus nang gis gser srang chig sto nga sum brgya dang dngul srang chig khye nyis stong brgal ba'i rgyu zong gi sbyin bdag mdzad de rgya mgar zung ja la sogs las ka ba bco lngas rgya khyod khebasapa'i gser zangs kyi rgya phebs gsar skrun mdzad/spyi lo1712lor ching wang bkra shis pā thur tha'i jis gser srang brgya phrag dang dngul srang brgya phrag brgal bas gser sdong chen mo'i cho 'phrul ma ra rten rgya ji cher btang ste gsar skrun mdzad pa dang / skyabs rje chu bzang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis dngul srang stong phrag bzhi dang don gsum brgal bas rgyal dbang gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i khru gdung mar rten dngul gdung du bsgyur te dbyen zlum ma/ra rten gyi dbyibasasabasgyur/spyi lo1717lor cha kyu hung tha bla mas gnas brtan bcu drug 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i zhabs brtan lha khang gsar skrun mdzad/spyi lo1718lor khri thog nyi shu ba rgyal mkhan po sprichi thu no mon han blo bzang don grub kyis bdag skyong mdzad skabs zhal 'bag dang 'chag lābazos te/ rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi 'cha dpon gyis 'cham khrid par bam ba pa'i sgo nas dus kyi sgon lam rnam bzhi'i skabs la 'cham pa grwa tshang zur du bye ba'i srol gsar 'dzugs byas/403

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyusabasdus pa/spyi lo1868lor khri thog re gcig pa bkra shisazhabasadrung yeshesamakhas grub nyi ma'i skabasasurgya sog dang za lar gyi dpung 'khrug chen po lang4pa la/ gong grasami rnamasakyisa'agrig thabasakyi rlaci 'dra btsal kyang mthun thabasamabyung bas/ hor zlabazhi ba'i tshesanyer lnganasachosasde 'di'i skor lam du rgya sog gi dmag brgyug4te/ rgyud pa grwa tshang dang / dusa'akhor 'du khang / thamayocad mkhyen pa'i lhakhang / ra kho sgar ba/ zi na sgar ba/ che shosasgar ba/ thu'u bkwan sgar ba/ 'jamadabyangasasgar ba/stag mcher sgar ba/ rgya yag sgar ba/ gzim khang gong ma sogasasgar khag du ma rnamasal me skyon tshabasachen btang zhing / dusamatshungagasuphyi nang gi ser skya mi ngan dpung sdeb kyisalhakhang / 'du khang / sgar khag sogasakyi lha rdzasamachod chasasogasayobyad dang rgyu nor thamasacad gang thob ci thobatu gtor ba dang / bla brang chen mo dang / ak+ṣa sgar ba/ shing bza' sgar ba/ chu bzang sgar ba/ an 'ja' susgar ba/ blon po btsan khang / mi nyag sgar ba sogasalargya sog masleb4kyang / du zhag dang me 'od mthong ba4dngangasaskrag tshad med pa skyesate/ lha'i bu'i bdud kyi cho 'phul byung ngo zhesarang sgar lasaphebasazin pa'o/ / de nasalasar+sārnamasanasazi ling am bhan sogasayāmon lnga zhusapa ltar dgon par yong nasalasasne rnamasal tham ka can gyi yige gnang nas/ gser sdong chen modang / 'du khang / btsan khang /'jamadabyangasakun gzigasasogasal bdag byed dgosatshuladang / grwa pa rnam4rang 'dod kyi4'gro mi chog pa'i bka' bkod lci mophab pa la 4༵ṭ+wāṃn

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/spyi lo1868lor khye thog re gcig pa bkra shis zhabs drung ye shesamakhas grub nyi ma 'i skabs sa rgya sog dang za lar gyi dpung 'khrug chen po la ngas pa la/ gong gras mi rnams kyis 'grig thabs kyi blo ci 'dra btsal kyang mthun babs ma byung bas/ hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes nyer lnga nas chos sde 'di'i skor lam du rgya sog gi dmag brgyugs te/ rgyud pa grwa tshang dang / dusa'akhor 'du khang / thams cad ma khyen pa'i lha khang / ra kho sgar ba/ zi na sgar ba/ che shos sgar ba/ thu'u bkwan sgar ba/ 'jam dbyangs sgar ba/stag ma/cher sgar ba/ rgya yag sgar ba/ gzim khang gong ma sogs sgar khag du ma/ rnams la ske skyon tshabs chen btang zhing / dus mtshungs sa phyi nang gi ser skya mi ngan dpung sdeb kyis lha khang / 'du khang / sgar khag sogs kyi lha rdzasamachod chas sogs yo khyad dang rgyu nor thams cad gang thob ci thob tu gtor ba dang / bla brang chen mo dang / a kyu sgar ba/ shing bza' sgar ba/ chu bzang sgar ba/ an 'ja' sa sgar ba/ blon po btsan khang / mi nyag sgar ba sogs la rgya sog ma slebs kyang / du zhag dang me 'od mthong bas dngangasaskrag tshad sted pa skyes te/ lha'i bu'i bdud kye cho 'phrul byung ngo zhes rang sgar las phebs zin pa'o/ / de nas las sna rnams nas zi ling am bhan sogayolnga mo/na lnga zhus pa ltar dgon par yong nas las sna rnams la tham ka can gyi nage gnang nas/ gser sdong chen yodang / 'du khang / btsan khang /'jam dbyangs kun gzigs sogs la bdag byed dgos tshul dang / grwa pa rnams rang 'dod kyis 'gro mi chog pa'i bka' bkod lci mo phab pa la brten 4()5

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo che ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nas/ dgon sde 'di slar yang brtan por 'dzin jub par gyur/ skabasader dgon sde 'dir brlag skyon tshabs chen thebs na'ang phyis su khri chen don bdun pa bkra shis mkhan chen sbyin pa don grub rgya mtsho la sogs pa khri chen rim byon gyis chos srid gnyis ldan gyi sgo nas dgon sde 'dir do dam bdag skyong legs par mdzad pa dang gzhan dad ldan bye bo rnams kyis mthun rkyen bsgrubs 'og sngar brlag skyon zabs pa rnams gzhi nas gsar bzo byasapar ma zad/ jo khang dang mgon khang / 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs la sogs pa'i lha khang dang gtsug lag khang la zhig gso mang po mdzad pa dang /phyis sa yang sdeg srin gdon 'dre ma lus 'gog pa dang me skyon chu skyon gyi gnod pa thams cad mi 'byung ba'i slad du gser sdong chen mo/'i sum thog gi shar ngos gyi gyan thang du gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i ldebs ris bzhengs shing /gling rje'i sdebs ris 'dir bye bo rnam sa kyis dngos sam jal thub pa lags/ldebs ris de yang srung ma dang dgra lha'i tshul du bzhengs pa ma gtogs ge sar rgyal po'i mdzad pa'am gtam rgyud la bstod pa'i tshul du bzhengs pa min/de yang grub mtha'i dgongs don la mthun pa'i skor rgyun 'dzin dang yang na 'gal ba yod pa'i skor nges par du 'dor dgos pa ni sus kyang mkhyen gsal ltar lags/dgon chen 'di'i grwa tshang che khag bzhi ste/ thog ma mtshab nyid grwa tshang gong du brjod zin pas bskyar du brjod rgyu min/rgyud pa grwa tshang ni spyi lo1711'o ra zi na chos rje legs pa rgya ma/tsho paṇa 406

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nas/ dgon sde'adi slar yang brtan por 'dzin jub par gyur/ skabasader dgon sde'adir brlag skyon tshabasachenathebasana'ang phyisasakhri chen don bdun pa bkra shisamakhan chen sbyin pa don grub rgya mtsho la sogasapa khri chen rimabyonagyisachosasrid gnyis ldan gyi sgo nasadagon sde 'dir do dam bdag skyong legasapar mdzad pa dang gzhan dad ldan skye bo rnamasakyi4mthun rkyen bsgrubs 'og sngar brlag skyon thebasapa rnam4gzhi nasagasar bzo byasapar ma zad/ jo khang dang mgon khang / 'jamadabyang4kun gzigasalasogasapa'i lhakhang dang gtsug lag khang la zhig gsomang po mdzad pa dang /phyisasuyang sdig srin gdon 'dre malusa'agog pa dang me skyon chu skyon gyi gnod pa tham4cad mi'abyung ba'i slad du gser sdong chen mo'i sum thog gi shar ngosagyi gyan thang du gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i ldebasari4bzhengs shing /gling rje'i ldebasarisa'adir skye bo rnamasakyi4dngos sum/jal thub pa lags/ldebasarisade yang srung ma dang dgra lha'i tshuladu bzhengasapa ma gtogasage sar rgyalapo'i mdzad pa'am gtam rgyud labastod pa'i tshul du bzhengasapa min/de yang grub mtha'i dgongasadon lamathun pa'i skor rgyun 'dzin dang yang na 'gal ba yod pa'i skor ngesapar du 'dor dgosapa ni susakyang mkhyen gsalaltar la/r+sha/na chen 'di'i grwa tshang che khag bzhi ste/ thog ma mtshan nyid grwa tshang gong du brjod zin pasabaskyar du brjod rgyu min/406rgyud pa grwa tshang ni spyi lo1711lor zi na chosarje legasapa rgya mtsho paṇa

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung ltar btab pa yin la/ rim gyisargya che ru btang /sman pa grwa tshang ni spyi lo1757lor khro thog nyer brgyad pa chu bzang pa ngag dbang thub bstan dbang phyug gis gsar du btsugs te 'chad nyan gyi srol btsugs pa red/dus 'khor grwa tshang ni spyi lo1817lor che shos paṇ+ḍi ta ngag dbang bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi mas 'go 'dzin legs par mdzad de gsar du btsugs so/ /spyir grwa tshang che khag 'di bzhi la ji ltar gsar bzhengs mdzad pa dang 'phel rgyas sa phyin pa'i lo rgyus dang khro rabs ji ltar byon pa'i lo rgyus/ nang rten 'gangs chen gyi rigs ji bzhin gnas pa'i lo rgyus rnams gsal bor mches kyang 'dir zhib tu ma bkod/ gal srid gsal bor mthong 'dod kyi skye bo rnams kyis sku 'bum gdan rabs chen mo las shes par rgyas/la ra dgon sde chen po 'di'i yun ring gi lo rgyus ni gtsang chen nang du dpa' sems nyams pa med pa'i dad ldan mi dmangs kyi stobs ldan 'dzad med kyi shugs la brten nas rim gyis 'phel ba'i myu gu'i dpe bzhin dar zhing rgyas par phyin pa'i mdzes sdug dpal yon ci rigs bsam/ gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig red la/ lhag par du rgya bod lag shes bzo lasamakhan du ma'i sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i bzo rtsal gyi blo gros la 'chi med lha'i bzo bos kyang sgrun par dka' ba'i snang tshul ster ba ji bzhin khyad par 407

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/chespya blobazang cho4kyi rgyalamatshan gyi gsung ltar btab pa yin la/ rimagyisargya — ru ṭ+wāṃ/ ༵ /grwa tshang ni spyi lo1757lor khri thog nyer brgyad pa chu bzang pa ngag dbang thub bstan dbang phyug giyogasar du btsugasate 'chad nyan gyi srol btsugasapa red/dusa'akhor grwa tshang ni spyi lo1817lor che shosapaṇ+ḍi ta ngag dbang ba~Xd sgruṭ+wābastan pa'i nyi masa'ago 'dzin legasapar mdzad de gsar du bduga~X ༷/ grwa tsha/ nga che khag 'di bzhi laji ltar gsar bzhengasamadzad pa dang 'phelazlogasuphyin pa'i lorgyusadang khri rabasaji ltar byon pa'i lo rgyus/ nang rten 'gangasachen gyi rigasaji bzhin gan4pa'i lo rgyusarnamasagasalabor mchisakyang 'dir zhib tu ma bkod/ gal srid gsal bor mthong 'dod kyi skye bo rnamasakyisasku 'bum gdan rabasachenapolasashesapar gyis/lar dgon sdechen po 'di'i yun ring gi lo rgyu4ni gtsang chen nang du dpa' semasanyamasapa med pa'i dad ldan mi dmangasakyi stob4ldan 'dzad med kyi shugasal brten nasarimagyisa'aphel ba'i myu gu'i dpe bzhin dar zhing rgya4par phyin pa'i mdzesasdug dpalayon ci rigasabasamagyisamikhyab cing brjod kyisami lang ba zhig red la/ lhag par du rgya bod lag shesabazo lasamakhan du ma'i sgyu rtsalagyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i bzo rtsalagyi blogrosal 'chi med lha'i bzo bosakyang sgrun par dka' ba'i snang tshulaster ba ji bzhin khyardo ༵ra

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/du 'phag4shing ltan sdug pa zhig go/smrasapa/ rten gzhi pad spungasamachod rten ltogalas/ /leg/snaḍi /ungasapa'i mtshungasamed gtsug stong phrag du mgaser dngul brdal ba bzhin/ /gsal ler mngon pa'i dpal 'di em rmad/ /bgrang yasakhri chen rim pasamanga' bsgyur 'og/rgya bod zung 'brelaphul byung bzo rtsalalas/ /grub pa'i ngo mtshar ltad mo'i gzug4ri4tshogs/ /khyab/ sdo~X ༵༵༵ gyisaganasa'adir bkod zhesabarjod pa ni bar r+shabasakyi tshigasasubacad pa'o/ /gsum pa/ dgon pa'i nang rten 'gangs chen gyi skor/da ni chosasde chen po 'di'i rin thang bral ba'i nang rten gyi rigasarnamasabarjod par bya la/ de dag zhib mor brjod pa ha cang dka' na'ang /skabasasubab pa'i nang rten 'gang4chen gyi skor ragasatsamabarjod na/mchod rten chen mo'i g.yon ngosasulcang skya sku gong ma ngag dbang blobazang chosaldan gyi dngul gdung dang de'i mdun du ra kho cho4rje shesarab chosa'abyor gyi dngulagadung / gser zangasal4grubapa'i akyu rin po che'i ma/hā ṭ+wāṃn bcasabazhugayol/ mchod rten chen mo'i g.yayophyogasakyi kun

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /du 'phags shing ltan sdug pa zhig go/smras pa/ rten gzhi pad srungs mchod rten ltob las/ /legs par 'khrungs pa'i mtshungs med gtsug lag khang / /stong phrag du ma gser dngul brdal ba bzhin/ /gsal ler mngon pa'i dpal 'di em rmad/ /bgrang yas khri chen rim pas mnga' bsgyur 'og/rgya bod zung 'brel 4la byung bzo rtsal las/ /grub pa'i ngo mtshar ltad tha gzugs ris tshogs/ /khyab 'jug 'phrul gyis gnas 'dir bkod dang mtshungs/ /zhes brjod pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs sa bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa/ dgon pa'i nang rten 'gangs chen gyi skor/da ni chos sde chen po 'di'i rin thang bral ba'i nang rten gyi rigasarnams brjod par bya la/ de dag zhib mor brjod pa ha cang dka' na'ang /skabs sa bab pa'i nang rten 'gangs chen gyi skor rags tsam brjod na/mchod rten chen mo'i g.yon ngos sa lcang skya sku gong ma ngag dbang khrobazang chos ldan gyi dngul gdung dang de'i mdun du ra kho chos rje shes rab chos 'byor gyi dngul gdung / gser zangs las grub pa'i a kyu rin po che'i mchod/ rten bcas bzhugs la/ mchod/ rten chen mo'i g.yas phyogs kyi kun 408

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/dga' ra bar bka' 'gyur dbus dpar ma cha tshang gcig dang / g.yon ngosasubastan 'gyur dbusadapar mcha tshang gcig yod la/ gong ma khang zhi rgyal po dang chun lung rgyalapoganyisakyi gser yig khashasadang khyad par du chun lung rgyalapo nasaganang ba'i gser gyi tsi pan gcig kyang yod do/ /mchod rten chen mo'i mdun gyi mchod rdzasakyi rim par gong ma chun lung rgyal posaphul ba'i 'khor lo zargyan can stegasadang bcasapa gcigabyu ru'i phreng ba legasapa gcig dngul srang brgyad la4grub pa'i bkra shisardzasabargyad kyi snod bzhi/ dngulasrang sum cu soganyisalasagrub pa'i bkra shi4rtag4brgyad/ dngul srang lngabacu lasagrubapa'i maṇ+ḍal gser tshosam gcig dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga lasagrub pa'i bumapa kha rgyan dang bcasapa can gcig yo da do/ /'dukhang chen mo'i nang rten gtso bo ru rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho dang rgyaladabang lngab ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho rnam gnyisakyi dbu zhwa dang /rgyal ba gsumapabasod namasargya mtsho'i phyag dril/ rgyaladabang bzhi ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhabasalham/ paṇa chen blobazang yoshes kyi sku sham/ rgyal dbang bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho'i gosaber/ rgyal dbang drug pa tshangasadabyangs rgya mtsho'i zhab4lham/ ba sodrung rin po che'i sku gzan/ chu bzang blobazang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi dbuzha bcasabazhug4so/ /de la4gzhan da dung rdo ngo4kyi rje tsong kha pa'i zhabasarjesadang /khong gisabrisapa'i thang brnyan dang khong sku dngosakyi tshems/ yumagyi~X/dzo

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/dga' ra bar bka' 'gyur dbus dpar ma cha tshang gcig dang / g.yon ngos stobastan 'gyur dbus dpar ma cha tshang gcig yod la/ gong ma khang zhi rgyal po dang chu lung rgyal po gnyis kyi gser yig kha shas dang khyad par du chu lung rgyal po nas gnang ba'i gser gyi tsi pan gcig kyang yod do/ /mchod rten chen mo'i mdun gyi mchod rdzas kyi rim par gong ma chu lung rgyal pos phul ba'i 'khor lo sa rgyan can stegs dang bcas pa gcigabyu ru'i phreng ba legs pa gcig dngul srang brgyad las grub pa'i bkra shisarjas brgyad kyi sgod bzhi/ dngul srang sum hru soganyis las grub pa'i bkra shis rtags brgyad/ dngul sra/nga lnga bcu las grub pa'i ma lkol gser tshos ma gcig dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga las grub pa'i bum pa kha rgyan dang bcas pa can gcig yo da do/ /'du khang chen mo/'i nang rten gtso bo ru rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho dang rgyal dbang lnga ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho rnam gnyis kyi dbu zhwa dang /rgyal ba gsum pa bsod nam/sa rgya mtsho'i phyag dril/ rgyal dbang bzhi ba yo na tan rgya mtsho'i zhabs lham/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kye sku sham/ rgyal dbang bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho'i gos ber/ rgyal dbang drug pa tshangasadabyangs rgya mtsho'i zhabs lham/ ba so drung rin po che'i sku gzan/ chu bzang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi da6 zhwa bcas bzhugs so/ /de las gzhan da dung rdo ngosakyi rje tsong kha pa'i zhabs rjes dang /khong gis bris pa'i thang brnyan dang khong sku dngos kyi tshe sa/ yum gyis mdzo 409

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mo btags sa re rdo dang yum gyi chu stegs su grags pa'i pha bong bcas yodabadang / gong ma chen mos gnang ba'i gser gyi tham ka 'ja' sa/ gzimagur ser po/ mi bcu gnyis kyis 'degs pa'i khyogs shing ser po dang/gong ma khang zhi rgyal po'i na bza' gos chen 'brug ris ma dang 'bog cha ser po 'khrug ris ma/ bzhugs gdan rgyab yol ser po 'brug ris ma bcasayod par ma zad/ 'du khang chen yodang grwa tshang so son chos lugs kyi skor dang / gsob rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ gnam gshis rig pa/ snyan ngag dang zlos gar la sogs kyi glegs bam khri phrag mang po mchis so/ / gzhan yang sngon byon mkhas pa la la'i gsung sgos las/ sku 'bum dgon pa'i nang rten gyi gras sa gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i shul bzhag gi dngos rdzas rtsa chen gser sga nyi ma rang shar dang ral gri btab pa lan sped bcas kyang yod par gsungs mod/ 'on te kho bo bcas bangs mang la chas na'ang mthong ma byung /yin na'ang ma brang dgon pa'i nang du ge sar gyi gser sga dang ral gri khyung gi sgo nga bcas yod pa mthong myong ngo / /spyir dgon chen 'dir nang rten gyi rigs sna tshogs pa rin thang gzhal du med pa'i rin po che rnams kyis mngon par brgyan yod mod/ 'on kyang de rnams zhib tu bsgrugs nas bsan mgo nyog par bsams nas che shosa'aga' bris pa lags so/ /smras pa/ dri bral nang rten chu srin 'byung gnas mthar/ /sgol thabs bral ba'i rin chen rten bzang tshogs/ /410

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mobatagasasa'i rdo dang yum gyi chu stegasasugragasapa'i pha bong bcasayodapadang / gong ma chen mosaganang ba'i gser gyi thamaka 'ja' sa/ gzimagur ser po/ mibacu gnyisakyisa'adegasapa'i khyog4shing ser po dang/gong ma khang zhi rgyalapo'i nabaza' gosachen 'brug risam dang 'bog cha ser po 'brug risam/ bzhugasagadanargyabayolaser po 'brug risam bcasayod par mazad/ 'du khang chen yodang grwa tshang soson chosalugasakyi skor dang / gsobarig pa/ bzo rig pa/ gnam gshisarig pa/ snyan ngag dang zlosagar lasogasakyi glegasabamakhri phrag mang pomachisaso/ / gzhan yang sngon byon mkhasapa lala'i gsung sgrosalas/ sku 'bum dgon pa'i nang rten gyi gragasagling rje ge sar rgyalapo'i shulabazhag gi dngosardza4rtsa chen gser sga nyi marang shar dang ral gri btab pa lan med bcasakyang yod par gsungasamod/ 'on te khobo bcasathengasamang la chasana'ang mthong ma byung /yin na'ang blabrang dgon pa'i nang du ge sar gyi gser sga dang ralagri khyung gi sgong bcasayod pa mthong myong ngo / /spyir dgon chen 'dir nang rten gyi rigasasna tshogasapa rin thang gzhaladu med pa'i rin poche rnamasakyi4mngon par brgyan yod mod/ 'on kyang de rnamasazhibatu bsgrugasanasabrisan mgo nyog par bsam4nasache shosa'aga' brisapa lag4so/ /smrasapa/ dri bral nang rten chusrin 'byung gnasamathar/ /41) sgrolathabasabralaba'i rin chen rten bzang tshogs/ /

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/gser 'od 'bumaphrag 'phrobazhin bzhugasapa'adi/ /ltabasamingomasango mtshar stong gisaspras/ /de bsagong marimabyon ra ba las/ /gnang ba'i gser dngulag༅byur khri 'bumagyis/ /brgyan pa'i rten bzang metog tsamapa ka/gnaṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ/ga dgon 'di'i 'gangasachen gter 'o zhesapa ni gong gsal gyi tshig don phyogasatsamabasdusanasabarjod pa / ba/ zhi ba/ dgon pa'i ming dang dge lugs pa sogs ji ltar byung ba'i mtha' dpyad/gshamadu sku 'bum zhesapa dang sku 'bumabyamasapagling zhesapa'i ming ji ltar thogasadon gtso byasanasabarjod pa'i zhor du tsong khabazhesapa'i mtshan yang ji ltar byung ba mdo tsam brjod na/ sku 'bumazhesapa'i ming 'di mchod rten gyi nang rten du bzhugasapa'i rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro'i sku dpar ma 'bum bzhugayopa tsamagyisasku 'bumazhesamatshan btagasapa mayin par/rje khong nyid 'khrungasaskabasaltekhrag sar lhung ba la4skyesapa'i tsan dan dkar po sdong bo'i 'dab ma'abum phrag dang ldan pa/ 'dab ma 'bumal de bzhin gshegasapa seng ge'i nga ro'i sku 'bumaphrag dngosasubazhug4pa de labarten nasasku 'bumazhesathogasaso/ / 411

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/gser 'od 'bum phrag 'phro bzhin bzhugs ba 'di/ /ltabs mi ngom/sa ngo mtshar stong gis spras/ /de bas gong ma rim byon ra ba las/ /gnang ba'i gser dngul g.yu byur khri 'bum gyis/ /brgyan pa'i rten bzang tshe tog tsam pa ka/gnas mchog dgon 'di'i 'gangs chen gter du gyur/ /zhes pa ni gong gsal gyi tshig don phyogs tsam bsdus nas brjod pa'o/ /bzhi ba/ dgon pa'i ming dang dge lugs pa sogs ji ltar byung ba'i mtha' dpyad/gsham du sku 'bum zhes pa dang khru 'bum byams pa gling zhes pa'i ming ji ltar thogs don gtso byas nas brjod pa'i zhor du tsong kha pa zhes pa'i mtshan yang ji ltar byung ba mdo tsam brjod na/ rū 'bum zhes pa'i ming 'di mchod rten gyi nang rten du bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro'i sku dpar ma'abum bzhugs pa tsam gyis sku 'bum zhes mtshan btags pa ma yin par/rje khong nyid 'a ngas skabs lte khrag sar lhang ba las skyes pa'i tsan dan dkar po sdong bo' 'dab ma 'bum phrag dang ldan pa/ 'dab ma 'bum la de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i nga rdo'i sku 'bum phrag dngos sa bzhugs pa de la brten nas sku 'bum zhes thogs so/ /41

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi spyod rtsom—phyogs bsgrigs /sku 'bum khyam/sa pa gling zhes pa ji ltar thogs she na/ de 5/nga spyo lo 1517lor gnas 'dir gtsug lag khang thog mar bzhengs te/ rin chen brtson 'grus rgya ma tshos spyin bdag mdzad nas sman 'dam las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa mgon po dgung lo bcu gcig pa'i sku tshad cig bzhengasapa nasabazung dgon gnas 'di la sku 'bum byams pa gling zhes mtshan snyan kun gyi rna ba'i rgyan du gyur to/ /des na rje blo bzang grags pa'i ma/tshan la cong kha pa zhes thogs don ci yin zhe na rags tsam brjod par be+e la/ spyir der gsal bshad kyi dgos pa med na yang / da dang rgya yig las brtsams pa'i rtsom yig kha shas sa rjod stangs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs byung ba'i dbang gis lta tshul mi mthun pa byung tshe gas nga ba sted par brjod na/ lhad sted gser gyi thigs pa bzhin du 'khrulamed thon thub pas na/ phra ra gyis kyang 'dir mthong thos ma/do tsam brjod par bya'o/ /tsong chu zhes pa'i chu klung 'di'i 'byung yul tsong kha'i skyes ri yin pas/ cong kha'i skyes ri las thon pa'i chu zhes pa'i ming bsdus nas mang chu zhes pa'i tha snyad thon zhing / tsong chu zhes pa'i chu klung 'di bzhur ba'i sachar tsong kha'i byed zhes thogs pa yin te/ rje rin po che 'khrungs pa'i yul ni tsong kha'i yul yin pas na/ tsong kha zhes pa'i mtha' ru pa yig bdag sgra sbyar te gnas ming ma tshan la thogs pa yin no/ /gnas ming mtshan la 'byor ba'i dpe ni kha ba'i ljongs 'dir gna' nas dbar du dar rgyas shin tu che ste/dper na/ sa paṇa/ gung thang bstan pa 'i sgo na me/ tshe tan zhabs drung lta42

gcod pa don grub dngasnyingabomaringagichedartsom phyogasabasgrigs/sku 'bum byamasapa gling zhesapa ji ltar thogasashe na/ de yang spyi r+sha 1517lor gnasa'adir gtsug lag khang thog mar bzhengasate/ rin chen brtson 'grus rgya ma tshosasbyin bdag mdzad nas sman 'dam las grub pa'i rgyalab byam4pamagon po dgung lobacu gcig pa'i sku tshad cig bzheng4pa nasabazung dgon gnasa'adi la sku 'bumabyamasapa gling zhesamatshan snyan kun gyi rna ba'i rgyan du gyur to/ /desan rje blobazang gragasapa'i mtshan la tsong kha pa zhesathogasadon ci yin zhe na rags tsam brjod par bya la/ spyir der gsal bshad kyi dgosapa med na yang / da lta'i rgya yig lasabartsam4pa'i rtsom/ yig kha shas surjod stang4mi 'dra ba sna tshogasabyung ba'i dbang gisaltatshul mi mthun pa byung tshe gsang ba med par brjod na/ lhad med gser gyi thigasapa bzhin du 'khrul med thon thub pasan/ phra na gyisakyang 'dir mthong thos mdo tsam brjod par bya'o/ / tsong chu zhe4pa'i chu klung 'di'i 'byung yul tsong kha'i skye4ri yin pas/ tsong kha'i skyesari lasathon pa'i chu zhes pa'i ming bsdusanasatsong chu zhe4pa'i tha snyad thon zhing / tsong chu zhesapa'i chu klung 'di bzhur ba'i sachar tsong kha'i yul zhesathogasapa yin te/ rje rin po che 'khrungasapa'i yul ni tsong kha'i yul yin pasan/ tsong kha zhesapa'i mtha' ru pa yig bdag sgra sbyar te gnasaming ma/tshan la thogasapa yin no/ / gnasaming mtshan la 'byor ba'i dpe ni kha ba'i ljongasa'adir gna' nasad bar du dar rgyasashin tu che ste/dadī~X hā/ sapaṇa/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me/ tshe tan zhabasadrung lta

sku 'bum byam sapa gling gi lo rgyus bsdusapa/bu'o/ ga/ zhan chosasde chen po 'di yang dge lugasapa'i dgon chen zhig yin par brten/ dge lug4pa'amadage ldan pa/ zhwa ser pa zhesapa'i mtshan ji ltar thogasatshul mdo tsam brjod na/ der yang bshad tshulami 'dra ba mang ste/dper na la las / rje tsong kha pasagrub mtha' sger du bzung bsasger lugasapar 'bod pa'i sgra phyis sunyamasanasadage lugasapar gragasazer ba dang /la las/ rje tsong khapasakho'i skabasade'i rig gzhung mthon po'i snyan gragasalabartenanas/ dge 'dun pasachang 'thung mi chog pa dang / nor lami gnyer ba sogasasdomapa srung ba'i sgrig lam gtan la phab te/ dge bcu cher bshad byasapa'i dbang gisarje khong nyid kyi rang lugasal dge lugasapa zhesamatshan btagasazhe4pa tshang ma khungasalung med pa'i bab col gyi gtam du gyur to/ / desan ji ltar brjod tshe da gzod khungasabatsun par 'dug ce na/ de yang dge lugasapa'am dge ldan pa zhes pa ni gdan sa'i ming gis btags pa yin te/ rje tsong kha pa dgung lo lnga bcu nga gsum bzhe4pa'i tshe/ 'brog ri bo dga' ldan rnamapar rgyal ba'i gling btab nas sku tshe smad der bzhugasapar brten nasarje khong nyid kyi rang lugasal chosarje dga' lda na pa'i lugasazhesa'abod pa byung / phyisasudaga' lugasapa'am dga' ldan pa zhesa'abod ba'i phyir na/ dge lugasapa'am dge ldan pa zhesargyun chasasaso/ /da ni dge lugasapa la zhwa ser pa zhesapa'i mtshan thogasatshul mdo tsam bshad na/ de la mkhasapa'i bzhed srol mi 'dra ba gnyisamachisate/ 4tā~Xr

sku 'bum byam sa pa gling gi lo tsi sa bsdus pa/—bu'o/ /gzhan chos sde don po 'di yang dge lugs pa'i dgon chen zhig yin par brten/ dge lugs pa'am dge ldan pa/ zhwa ser pa zhes pa'i ma tshan ji ltar thogs tshul mdo tsam brjod na/ der yang bshad tshad mi 'dra ba mang ste/dper na la las / rje tsong kha pas grub mtha' sger du bzung bas sger lugasapar 'a rbad pa'i sgra phyis su nyams nas dge lugs par grags zer ba dang /la la sa/ rje tsong kha pas kho'i skabs de'i rig gzhung mthon po'i snyan gragasal brten nas/ dge 'dun pas chang 'a nga mi chog pa dang / nor la mi gnyer ba sogs sdo ma pa srung ba'i sgrig lam gtan la phab te/ dge bcu cher bshad byas pa'i dbang gis rje khong nyid kyi rang lugs la dge lugs pa zhesam/tshan btags zhes pa tshang ma khungs lung med pa'i bab col gyi gtam du rgyar to/ /des na ji ltar brjod tshe da gzod khungs btsun par 'dug ce na/ de yang dge lugs pa'am dge ldan pa zhes pa ni gang na dang ming gis btags pa yin te/ rje tsong kha pa dgung lo lnga bcu nga gsum bzhes pa'i tshe/ 'brog ri bo dga' lda na rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab nas sku tshe smad der bzhugs par brten nas rje khong nyid kyi rang lugs la chos rje dga' lda na pa'i lugs zhesa'abod pa byung / phyis su dga' lugs pa'am dga' lda na pa zhes 'bod ba'i phyir na/ dge lugs pa'am dge ldan pa zhes rgyun chabs so/ /da ni dge lugs pa la zhwa ser pa zhes pa'i mtshan thogs tshul mdo tsamabashad na/ de la ma/khas pa'i bzhed sro la mi 'dra ba gnyis mchis te/ dper 43

gcod padon grub dngasnying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/na/ khacig gis/ rje tsong khapa rang nyid dang slob ma bgreyopa rnamasakyi dgongasapar zhwa mo dang chasasogasalugasabyings dang mi 'dra ba zhig byung tshe grub ma tha' gzhan dag gi phrag dog4dang ngan smrasasogagayong ba'i nyen kha che bsachosalugasaspyi dang mthun na bsamasakyang / slob ma phal che bas zhwa pomadog ser po dang dbyibasakyang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba sger 'dzin byed pasan/rje'i rang lugasal zhwa ser 'chang ba'i lugasazhesathogasazer ba dang / khacig gis/ blachen dgongasapa rabagasalagyi4klu mesabod du 'byon khar dbu zhwa ser po bzhesa'aphrozhig gnang nasa'adi gyon la nga rjesasudran pa ra gyisagasu ngasapar brten sngon gyi 'dul 'dzin pa chen po rnams kyi4dbu zhwa ser po nab pa yin pas/ rje blam sakyang 'dul ba'i bstan pa nyamasapa gzhi nasagasoba'i rten 'bre' du dbu zhwa'i kha dog sngon gyi 'dul 'dzin pa rnamasadang mthun pa'i ser po mdzad par brten rje'i rang lugasal zhwa ser 'a4 nga ba'i lugasazhesabazhed pa'o zhesapa ltar/ blo chung padag gisabazhed pa mi'adra ba 'di gnyi4labloyisadapog tshod kyisarags tsam dpyad na/ sngama'i bzhed tshulade khungasabatsun zhing 'khrul bamed pa 9nag min par bas mas/ci'i phyir zhe na/ dusaskabasade'i spyi tshogasakyi cha rkyen lagazhigasan chosalugs be /nga gras mi sna'i snyan gragayoshin tudar rgyas su'agro ba'i skabasayin la/ rje tsong kha pa ltabu'i ma khasachen dam pa dang de'i slob gnyer ba bgres pa rnamasakyisazhwa ser gyon par bzhed pa med tshe dman gyi slob gnyer ba dar gahūṃṭ+wāṃ 4rnamasakyi4rje slob dpon chen po'i dgong4pa la 'gal te/ u

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/na/ kha cig gis/ rje tsong kha pa rang nyid dang slob ma bgres pa rnams kyi dgongs par zhwa mo dang chas sogs lugs byings dang mi 'dra ba zhig byung che grub ma tha' gzhan dag gi phrag dogs dang ngan spra4sogs yong ba'i nyen kha che bas chos lugs spyi dang mthun na bsams kyang / slob ma phal che bas zhwa mo mdog ser po dang dbye bas kyang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba sger 'dzin byed pas na/rje'i rang lugs la zhwa ser 'chang ba'i lugs zhes thogs zer ba dang / khacig gis/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis klu mas bod du 'byon khar dbu zhwa ser po bzhes 'phro zhig gnang nas 'di sgon la nga rjes sa dran pa ra gyis gsu ngas par brten sngon gyi 'dul 'dzin pa chen po rnams kyis dbu zhwa ser po nab pa yin pas/ rje bla ma sa kyang 'dul ba'i bstan pa nyams pa gzhi nas gso ba'i rten 'dreb du dbu zhwa'i kha dog sngon gyi 'dul 'dzin pa rnam/sadang ma thun pa'i ser po mdzad par brten rje'i rang lugs la zhwa ser 'chang ba'i lugs zhes bzhed pa'o zhes pa ltar/ blo chung bdag gis bzhed pa mi'adra ba 'di gnyis 'a1blo yis dpog chod kyis rags tsam dpyad na/ lnga ma/'i bzhed tshul de khungs btsun zhing 'khrul ba med pa (nag min par bas mas/ci'i phyir zhe na/ dus skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi cha rkyen lagazhigs na chosalugs pe/nga gras mi sna'i snyan grags shin tu dar rgyas ga 'gro ba'i skabs yin la/ rje tsong kha pa lta bu'i ma khas chen dam pa dang de'i slob gnyer ba bgres pa rnams kyis zhwa ser stson par bzhed pa sked tshe dman — khrob gnyer ba dar zhe— 4rnams kyis rje slob dpon chen po'i dgongs pa la 'gal te/ u

sku 'bum byams pa 1nga gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/—byed—tshugs kyis zhwa ser gyon thub bam/ gal te zhwa ser gyon thub pa'i dbang du btang na'ang / zhwa rngo 'i mdog dang dbye bas bsgyur ba tsam gyis grub mtha'i ngo bo 'dzin mi thub pa dang grub mtha' sger 'dzin yang byed ba thub par bsams / de'i rgyu mtshan be+e grub mtha'i ltab mi 'dra ba'i nang du'ang khyon chas dang zhwa'i mdog mtshungs pa yo da pas so / /de'i phyir nyam chung bdag 'dras kyang dgag byed kyi mtshon cha zhig bsgongs na ci ma rung snyam mo/ /'o na bzhed tshad ci 'dra zhig la 'thad ce na/ phyi ma'i bzhed pa de khungs lung btsun zhing / bsru sted skyon dang bral ba zhig yin par sems so/ /lnga ba/ tang dang rgyal khab kyi gzigs byung / spyi lo1949'o ra krung go gsar ba dbu brnyes pa nas bzung rnam 'dren tang gis 'a la sked dbu mdzad kyi sbrang char sgoms par phab ste/bgrang bya stong phrag du mar sdom rgyas dam por 'ching ba'i 'dzin ma rnam par grol nas / bde skyid kyi 'dab brgya ma lus sa phyogs kun tu phrug par bzhad cing/ tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang chos lugs srid jus kyi dri bral gzi 'od kyi gzigs skyong dang / lhag par du rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis rig gnas dngos rdzas srung skyob byed dgos pa'i na 'jig gnam lcags thog 'dra'i rdo ring lhang nger bzhengasapa'i bka' drin la brten nas/ mtshungs med sku 'a6ma byams pa gling ste rgya mtsho lta bu'i glegs bam gyi bang mdzod dang /byed du 'phags pa'i rko bzo dang 'jim bzo/ yang na ngo mtshar stong ldan gyi li khang dang gtsug lag khang / de min rin thang bral ba'i nang rten 'gangs 45

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/tshugasakyi4zhwa ser gyon thub bam/ galate zhwa ser gyon thub pa'i dbang du btang na'ang / zhwa mo'i mdog dang dbyibasabasgyur btsamagyisagrub mtha'i ngo bo 'dzin mi thub pa dang grub mtha' sger 'dzin yang byed mithub par bsams / de'i rgyu mtshan ni grub mtha'i ltab mi'adra ba'i nang du'ang gyon chasadang zhwa'i mdog mtshungasapa yo da pasaso / /de'i phyir nyam chung bdag 'drasakyang dgag byed kyi mtshon cha zhig bsgrengasan ci mdung snyamamo/ /'o na bzhed tshul ci 'dra zhig la'athad ce na/ phyi ma'i bzhed pa de khungs lung btsun zhing / bslumed skyon dang bralab zhig yin par sem4so/ /lnga ba/ tang dang rgyal khab kyi gzigs skyong / spyi lo1949'o ra krung go gsar ba dbu brnyesapa nasabazung rnam 'dren tang gisa'akhrul med dbu mdzad kyi sbrang char snyomasapar phab ste/bgrang bya stong phrag du mar sdomargyasadamapor 'ching ba'i 'dzin yornam par grol nas / bde skyid kyi 'dab brgya malusasaphyogasakun tu lhug par bzhad cing / tang gi mirigasasrid jusadangachosalugasasrid jusakyi dri bral gzi 'od kyi gzigagaskyong dang / lhag par du rgyalasrid spyi khyab khang gi4rig gnasadangosardza4srung skyob byed dgosapa'i mi'ajig gnam lcagasathog 'dra'i rdo ring lhang nger bzhengasapa'i bka' drin labarten nas/ mtshungs med sku 'bumabyamasapagling stergya mtsho ltabu'i glegasabamagyi bang mdzod dang /khyad du 'phagasapa'i rko bzo dang 'jim bzo/ yang na ngo mtshar stong ldan gyi li khang dang gtsug lag khang / de min rin thang bralaba'i nang rten ༷/༵sa

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chen lasogasapar brlag skyon tshabasachen mthebasangalagasaso/ /lhag par du dang gi skabasabacu gcig pa'i krung 0tshang 'dzomasagrosatshogasathengasagasum pa'i tshun du/ tang gi mirigasasrid ju4dang chosalugasasrid ju4kyi 'od zer yang bskyar lham mer 'phrosate/ mi rig4kunal chosalugasadad mosarang dbang dang midad pa'i rang dbang yod pa dang /der mazad da dung rgyalakhab kyi4rogasaskyor gang legasamadzad de/ nye 'ga'i lo largyalakhab kyisa'agro song sgor sa5gsum lhag btang nayodagon sdo'adi'i gser sdong chen mo gtso byasanasazhig gsorgya chen gnang bar brten/da ltang tsho'i mig gi spyod yuladu dgon sde 'di slar yang lhun chagasarngamabarjid ldan pa'i ngang lhang nger 'gying zhing / nang bstan chosalugasakyi dad ldan mang tshogasani sprin dkar 'du 'god bgyid pa bzhin bar mtshamasamed par/ phyag mjalayiskor layong bzhin mchisal/ snga phyir tang dang rgyal khab kyi gtso 'dzin cang tse min dang hu'u cin tho/ lisaphun/ kru'u rung ci/lisarosahan/ lisalan chin/ bun ca pa'o/ chan chi khrin bcasapasamatsho sngon du bya bar gzigasazhib gnang ba'i skabasadang bstun nasadagon sde chen po 'dir ltagazigasamadzad cing / da dung bstod bsngagasakyi me tog kyang gang legasa'athor myong bar ma zad/ phyisasubadag skyo nga legasapo bgyi ba'i thad du gsung bshad gal chen kyang gnang ngo / /'dir smra4pa/ mdo smad 'dzin ma'i lhalam yangasapa ru/ /416 grong dang grongakhyer rgyu skar rnam bkra yang / /

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chen la sogs par brlag skyon tshabs chen ma jebs pa lags so/ /lhag par du dang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms grosatshogs zangs gsum pa'i tshun du/ tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang chosalugs srid jus kyi 'od zer yang bskyar lham mer 'phros te/ mi rigs kun la chos lugs dad mos rang dbang dang mi dad pa'i rang dbang yod pa dang /der ma zad da dung rgyal khab kyis rogs skyor gang legs mdzad de/ nye 'ga'i lo la rgyal khab kyis 'gro song sgor san gsum lhag bteng nas dgon sde 'di'i gser sdong chen mo gtso byas nas zhig gso rgya chen gnang bar brten/da ltang tsho'i mig gi spyod yul du dgon sde 'di slar yang lhan chags rngamab jid ldan pa'i ngang lhang nger 'gying zhing / nang bstan chos lugs kyi dad ldan mang tshogs ni sprin dkar 'du 'god bgyid pa bzhin bar mtshams med par/ phyag mjal lta skor la yong bzhin mchis la/ snga phyir tang dang rgyal khab kyi gtso 'dzin cang tse min dang hu'u cen tho/ lis phun/ kru'u rung ci/lis ros han/ lis lan chin/ bun ca pa'o/ chan chi khrin bcas pas mtsho sngon du khya bar gzigs zhib gnang ba'i skabs dang bstun nas dgon sde chen po 'dir lta gzigs mdzad cing / da dung bstod bsngags kyi me tog khrung gang legs 'thor myong bar ma zad/ phyis su bdag skyong legs po bgyi ba'i thad du gsung bshad gal chen kyang gnang ngo / /'dir smras pa/ mdo smad 'dzin ma'i lhal ma yangs pa ru/ /grong dang grong khyer rgyu skar rnam bkra yang / /416

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/bzo rtsal rmad byung sku 'bum chu shel dbang / /lha gling 'di ⑪mdzes rgyan nyid du gyur/ /dgon 'di'i lo rgyus zab yangs rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /shes bya dbul ba'i nyam chung bdag 'dra bas/ /lce brgya dris nas bskal pa khye phrag la/ /brjod kyang thar ba'i legs byas rab tu phra/ /yin yang gnas 'di'i lo rgyus legs byang ba'i/ /mkhas pa stong gi dpyad gtam rgyud mangs sgra/ /yongs5'gug slad rtsom thung 'dod ldan mas/ /don chad glu gzhas ca co 'di phul lo/ /zur lha'i yig cha/1kun mkhyen dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bos mdzad pa'i gdan rabs mutig zeng ba/2gser tog blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gdan rabs rten dngabarten par bcas pa'i dkar chag ched du brjod pa don ldan tshangs pa'idabyangs snyan/3thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i spub mtha' bcas yin no//417

sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lo rgyus bsdus pa/bzo rtsalarmad byung sku 'bumachu sheladabang / /lhaming 'di yimadzesargyan nyid du gyur/ /dgoṭ+wāṃ shā/'i lo rgyusazab yangasargya mtsho'i shesabya dbulaba'i nyamachung bdag 'dra bas/ /'u'ibargya spru9gnas/bska'/pa khri phrag la/ /brjod kyang thar ba'i legasabyasarabatu phra/ /yin yang gnasa'adi'i lorgyusalegasabyang ba'i/ /mkhasapastong gi dpyad gtam rgyud mngasasgra/ /yongasasu'agug slad rtsomathung 'dod ldan mas/ /don med glu gzhasaca co 'di phulalo/ /zur lta/ ṭ+wāṃ/ hūṃkhye/na dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bos mdzad pa'i gdan rabs mu2/paXr+sha/ /blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gdan rabs rten dngabarten par bcas pa'i dkar chag ched du brjod pa don ldan tshangs pa'i3ṭ+wāṃzlo ༵sna༈ nā/sa kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i grub mtha' bcas yin no// 417

dge lugs pa'i dgon chen se 'bras dge gsum/sa mo glang ste spyi lo1409lor rje bdag nyid chen po'i zhabs 'bying bu slob rnams kyis gdan sa dben dgon zhig gding ba'i zhu bsngar nas yang yang phul ba ltar dang / sde ba dang bu slob yon bdag so sonas kyang dgon brnying ba dang / gsar ba 'ding bar bdag rkyen byed ces pa'i gsol ba 'debs mkhan mang du byung ba la/ rje nyid nas kyang 'brog ri bo ste nyid du gdan sa 'debs pa'i dus la bab par mngon sum du gzigs shing mkhyen nas/ lo der rgyal bas lung bstan pa ltar 'brog ri chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab ste/ snga gzhug tu dwags po grwa tshang dang / byang rtse grwa tshang / nyag rong grwa tshang sogs btab cing / dge 'dun pa ches mang ba'i skabs stobargyad stong brgyad brgya la bud myong ngo / / rje bdag nyid chen po khong dgung lo re gsum pa sa po phag gi lor dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'i phyis su/ rgyal tshab thamasacad mkhyen pa dang mkhas grub smra ba'i seng ge rnam gnyis snga gzhug tu lo 'khor nyi shu lhag la je bla ma'i chos khyer bzhugs nas dge ldan bstan pa'i rkang tshugs par mdzad do/ / lha lda na smon lam chen mo'i mchod rgyun gyi srol 'dzugs pa yang dga' ldan dgon pa 'debs pa'i lo dang dus mnyam pa lags/gzhan yang dge lugs pa'am dga' ldan pa zhes pa ni gdan sa'i ming gis btags pa ste/ rje rin po ches 'brog ri bo dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab nas sku tshe smad du der stan chags par bzhugs pa la 419

dge lugs pa'i dgon chen se 'bras dge gsum/brgya dang brgyad kyi tshig don mtha' dag thugasalabazung nasa'achad par mdzad/ dbu tshad dang phar phyin sogasarje blama'i rang lugasakyi bshad sroladri ma med pa'i 'chad nyan rgyun michad du gnang bas/ gsung lasaskyesapa'i slob mnamamakha'i skar tshogasaltabu byung / gsar dgon der grwa tshang snga gzhug tu bdun byung ba ste/ sgo mang / blogasal gling / bde yangasapa/shag skor thoyobasam gling ngam rgyalab/ 'dulab/ sngagasapa grwa tshang bcasaso / / rnamadapyod kyi rig pa shin tu yangasapa'i mkhasadabang chen po 'jam dbyangasachosarje mchog gisadagon pa gsar 'dzugasaganang ba'i phyisasu/'brasaspungasamakhan khrir dpal ldan seng ge dang / rin chen byang chub/ rje dbon blo bzang nyi ma/ rong ston blobazang gragasapa/ nyan po shākya rgyal ma/tshan/ rje smon lamadapal/ 'jamadabyangasalegasapa choyo'abyor/ stong skor yo na tan rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen bsod nam4gragasapa/ rgyal ba bsod namasargya mtsho/ yon tan rgya mtsho/paṇa chen thamasacad mkhyen pa blobazang chosakyi rgyal mtshan/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po sogasarim gyi4bzhugasate dam pa'i cho4kyi 'khor lo bskor/bsam gyisamikhyab pa'i 2rten chosagasum gsar snon mdzad de dgon pa 'di rgya che ru btang / dgon pa der dge 'dunapa che4mang ba'i skabasasubadun stong lhag labud myong / de yang tā la'i blam sku phrengalngaba'i skabasasu/ ri bo dge lugasapa'i chosadang / bod saganasasrid gzhung gi chab srid lugasaganyisazung 'brel gyi sgo nasabod ljongasayongasal dbang sgyur ba'i lam ༵gas
