dge lugs pa'i dgon chen se 'bras dge gsum/bsod namasargyalamatshan/ stong skor yonatan rgya mtsho/ rgyalabayon tan rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen blobazabachosargyan/ rgyaladabang lngab chenapornamasasngagazhug tubazhugasashing / de nasabazung sku rimabyonagyisadagonapa'adir 'dzin bdag mdzad/ gzhan yang byamasachen chosarje mchog rgya yulanasaphyir log skab4rten skaladu bsnamasaphebasapa'i gser chosabaka' 'gyur dang tsan dan gyi gnasabartan bcu drug bcasabagasar dgon 'di'i rten 'gangasachen du gyur yod do/ /ser theg chen gling lathog mar grwa tshang lngayod kyangaphyisasudagosamakho'i dbang gisabyamasangagrwa tshang dang sman pagrwa tshang gnyi4subasgrilab dang / dge 'dun pa chesamang ba'i skabasasulnga stong lngabargya yod cesasemasacan kun gyisagleng bzhin gda'/ dgon pa der phyag mjalaltasgor du phebasapa'i dad ldan skye bo bgrang lasa'ad4bachu bo'i rgyun bzhin gna' nasad lta'i bar du zamachad mamyongango / /de ltar gdan sachen pori bodage ldanagyi gzi dpalalabarten nasaser dgon dang 'brasaspungasadagon bganyisadang / de nasabudang tsha bo yang tshe'i tshulagyisabashad sgrub kyi choyosdemang du spelan4rje blayorinapoche'i rang byāgasagaser ldana'adzin ma'i ljong4yongasasubar med du khyabapa lags423

dge lugs pa'i dgon chen se 'bras dge gsum/bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ stong skor yon tan rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po rnamasalngagazhug tu bzhugs shing / de nas bzung sbu rim byon gyis dgon ba 'dir 'dzin bdag mdzad/ gzhan yang byams chen chos rje mchog rgya yul nas phyir log skabs rten skal du bsnams phebs pa'i gser chos bka' 'gyur dang tsan dan gyi gnas brtan bcu drug bcas pa gsar dgon 'di'i rten 'gangs chen du gyur yod do/ /ser jeg chen gling la thog mar grwa tshang lnga yod kyang phyis su dgosamakho'i dbang gis byams pa grwa tshang dang sman pa grwa tshang gnyis sa bsgril ba dang / dge 'dun pa ches mang ba'i skabs sa lnga stong lnga brgya yod ces semasacan kun gyis gleng bzhin gda'/ dgon pa der phyag mjal lta skor du phebs pa'i dad ldan bye bo bgrang las 'das pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin gna' nasad lta'i bar du zam chad ma myong ngo / /de ltar gdan sa chen po ri bo dge ldan gyi gzi dpal la brten nasasor dgon dang 'bras srungs dgon thaganyis dang / de nas bu dang tsha bo yang tsho'i tshul gyis bshad sgrub kyi chos sdomang du spel nas rje mam rin po che'i rang lugs gser ldan 'dzin ma'i ljongs yongs stobar med du khyab pa lagastoso/ /423

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/a mdo chab 'gag yul gru mda' sgod/de yang mda' zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di mi yul khams su khyab nas bgrang bya ga tshod 'das pa sus kyang kha tshon nges can zhig gcod dka' yang / sngon byon mkhas pa dam pa rnams kyis brtsams pa'i lo rgyus deb ther chen po ste/dkar dang dmar ser bcas sags ra ba ltar na/ bod 'dir gdod ma'i spyo tshogs kyi skabs nas bzung mda' mdung gri gsum gyi ma/tshon cha dar myong bar brten/ da ltam mtha' yang bgrang bya stong phrag 'ga'i lo rgyus yod pa bsnyon du med/ nyag phran mda' mo 'di bod rang la dar ba shin tu lnga bar ma zad/ na rigs gzhan pa ste rgya rigs dang sog rigs bcas la yang dar ba ha cang snga ba lags/ da dung phyi gleng pa la'ang gna' snga mo nas dar yod pa yang lo rgyus kyi deb zer mang po las shes thub/ lhag par du rgya rigs la cha mtshon na dus snga yonas dar rgya dang bkol rgya che ba yang〈rgyal khab gsum gyi gtam rgyud〉dang〈chu ngogs gtam rgyud〉sogs kyi sgrung gtam las gsal ler mthong thub pa lags/ mi rigs gang yin yang rang gi mi rigs de grub pa'i brgyud rim nang du rang byung gis grub pa'i rdo dang dbyug pa lag char bgyis myong ba las gzhan/ thog ma'i mtsho'i cha de ni mda' mdung gri gsum yin pa khas ma blangs na mi chog snyam/ de yang gna' rabs su 'thab 'khrug 424

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed/de yang mda' zhesapa'i tha snyad 'di miyulakhamasasukhyab nasabagrang bya ga chod 'dasapa susakyang kha tshonangesacan zhig gcod dka' yang / sngon byon mkhasapa dmapa rnamasakyi4brtsamasapa'i lorgyusadeb ther chen po ste/dkar dang dmar ser bcas sugasal ba ltar na/ bod 'dir gdod ma'i spyi tshogasakyi skabasanasabazung mda' mdung gri gsumagyi mtshon cha dar myong bar brten/ da ltamamatha' yang bgrang bya stong phrag 'ga'i lo rgyusayod pa bsnyon du med/ nyag phran mda' mo 'di bod rang la dar ba shin tu snga bar mazad/ mirigasagazhan pa ste rgya rigasadang sog rigasabacasal yang dar baha cang sngab lags/ da dung phyi gling pala'ang gna' sngamo na4dar yod payang lo rgyusakyi deb ther mang po lasashe4thub/ lhag par du rgya rigasalacha mtshon na dusasnga mon4dar rgya dang bkol rgya che ba yang〈rgyal khab gsum gyi gtamargyud〉dang(chu ngogasagatam rgyud〉sogasakyi sgrung gtam lasagasal ler mthong thubapa lags/ mi rigasagang yin yang rang gi mirigasade grub pa'i brgyud rim nang du rang byung gi4grub pa'i rdo dang dbyug pa lag char bgyisamyong ba lasagazhan/ thog ma'i mtshon cha de ni mda' mdung gri gsum yinā ༵ khasamablangasan michog snyam/ de yang gna' rabasasu'athab 'khrug

a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed/gang byung ba de'i steng du bkol spyod byed pa'i mchod cha gtso bo yang mda' mdung gri gsum dang zhags pa sogs yin la/ dper na/ bod rigs rang gi blo gros kyi rtsal las thon pa'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung gi brjod don ltar na'ang / gling ge sar rgyal po dang dpa' rtul sum cu thams cad kyis rang gi 'khor gsum mda' mdung gri gsum la brten nas phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi dang rdzong don bco brgyad cham la phab pa yin/ gzhan yang bod btsan po'i skabs sa byung ba'i g.yu tha'abyed so so'i steng du bkol ba'i ma tshon cha gco bo de yang mda' mdung gri gsum yin la/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes glang dar ma 'dul ba'i skabs sa bkol ba'i ma tshon cha yang sgo ldan mda' yin pa tshang mas shes gsal ltar ro/ /phyis sa mi rigs gang dang gang yin yang spyi tshogs kyi 'phel 'gyur dang bstun nas thon skyed nus shugs ji legs dang tshan rig lag rtsal ji mthor song ba'i brgyud rim khrod thon byed yo byad dang dgra 'gog gi mtshon cha sogs la mtshon na'ang med pa nas yod pa dang / chung ba nas che ba/ rjesalus nas sngon thon phyogs gagomakhabs pa'i rkyen gyis g.yul 'byed skabasasamada' mdung gri gsum kyi bkol rgya yang ji byed du gyur par brten/ mtshon dang nus pa rim gyis shor zhing dmangs khrod kyi spro sted byed pa'i lag cha zhig tu gyur pas/ mi rnams kyis rang shugs sum da' rtsed ces pa'i ming tshig 'di gsar bzo bgyis pa lags/ skabs de nas bzung mdo smad phyogs kyi rong sde phal mo cher rta rgyug mda' 'phen gyi srol chags shing / lo re'i rgya lo dang dbyar zla drug pa'i nang du mda' rtsed kyi dga' mgu'i dpal la rol 425

a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed/gang byung ba de'i steng du bkol spyod byed pa'i mtshonacha gtso bo yang mda' mdung gri gsumadang zhagasapasogasayin la/ dper na/ bod rigasarang gi blogrosakyi rtsal lasathon pa'i lo rgyusabarjod pa'i snyan rtsomaring megling rje ge sar rgyalapo'i sgrung gi brjod don ltar na'ang / gling ge sar rgyalapo dang dpa' rtulasumacu thamasacad kyi4rang gi 'khor gsumamada' mdung gri gsumal brten na4phyogasabazhi'i dgra bzhi dang rdzong chen bco brgyad chamalaphab pa yin/ gzhan yang bod btsan po'i skabasasubyung ba'i g.yula'agyed soso'i steng du bkolaba'i mtshon cha gtso bo de yang mda' mdung gri gsum yin la/ lhaphung dpal gyi rdo rjesaglang dar ma'adulaba'i skabasasubakol ba'i mtshon cha yang sgroldan mda' yinapa tshang masashesagasal ltar ro/ /phyisasumirigasagang dang gang yin yang spyi tshogasakyi 'phel 'gyur dang bstun nas thon skyed nusashugasaje legasadang tshan rig lag rtsal je mthor song ba'i brgyud rim khrod thon skyed yobyad dang dgra 'gog gi mtshon cha sog4la mtshon na'ang med pa nasayod pa dang / chung ban4che ba/ rjesalusanasasngon thon phyogasasugoyokhasposapa'i rkyen gyisagayul 'gyed skabasasumada' mdung gri gsumakyi bkolargya yang je chung du gyur par brten/ mtshon cha'i nusapa rim gyisashor zhing dmangasakhrod kyi spro rtsed byed pa'i lag cha zhig tu gyur pas/ mi rnamasakyi4rang shugasasumada' rtsed cesapa'i ming tshig 'di gsar bzo bgyisapa lags/ skabasade nasabazung mdo smad phyog4kyi rong sde phalamo cher rta rgyug mda' 'phen gyi srol chag4shing / lo re'i rgya lo dang dbyar zla drug pa'i nang du mda' rtsed kyi dga' mgu'i dpala~X ṭ+wāṃl

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bzhin pa be+e da lnga' bar rgyun chad ma sgong ngo / /mda' la yang rigs mang ste gser ltong ma dang / dngul ltong ma/dung ltong ma bcas yod la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang mda'i ltong gser gyisabargyan pa na gser ltong ma zer ba dang / mda'i ltong dngul gyis brgyan pa na dngul ltong ma zer/ da dung mda' mo rgod sgo mdang / 'ug sgo ma// khra sgo mazer srol yang yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang rgod khros bstad pa'i mda' mor rgod sgo ma zer ba dang / 'ug sgos bstad pa'i mda' mo la 'ug sgo ma zer la/khra sgos bstad pa'i mda' mo la khra sgo ma zer ro/ / dmangs khrod kyi bshad srol ltar na/ rgod sgo ma de shugs che la rgyang chod pa dang / 'ug sgo ma de mtshan mor 'phangs na gnad la phog thub pa/ khra sgo ma de myur la rno ba'i khyad chos ldan pa yin skad/ gzhan yang mda' gzhu'i rigs la lcags mda' dang lcags gzhu/ smyug mda' dang sprug gzhu/ byer mda' dang byer gzhu zhes pa yang byung zhing / phyis gdar khyab shin tu che ba ni gsom dkar gyi mda' dang 'brong rwa'i gzhu yin/ dmangs khrod kyi ngag sgos la yang / nang a khu bzang ba'i bka' drin la/ / 'brong rwa srug po gzhu la bkug / nang bu tsha yong na 'phen rkyang yin/ / zer ba bzhin rwa gzhu thams cad 'brong rwa 'ba' zhig yin pa sus kyang kha tshon gcod dka' mod/ 'on te rwa co'i gzhu yin pa sus kyang khas len bzhin 'dug rwa gzhu de sprug gzhu'am byer gzhu dang mi 'dra ste/ mda' 'phen mkhan la shugs zung che ba med na gzhu rgyud 'jen dka' la/ 'chen thub pa'i dbang du btang na'ang gtong dka' bayin/ gal srid nus shugs 'dzoms pa'i pho gsar zhig yin phyin 'then ma426

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bzhin pa ni da lta'i bar rgyun chad mamyong ngo / /mda' layang rigasamang ste gser stong mdang / dngul ltong ma/dung ltong ma bcasayod la/ de'i rgyu mtshanayang mda'i stong gser gyisabargyan pa na gser ltong mazer ba dang / mda'i ltong dngul gyi4brgyan pa na dngul ltong ma zer/ da dung mda' morgod sgro mdang / 'ug sgro ma/ khra sgro mazer srol yang yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang rgod sgrosabastad pa'i mda' mor rgod sgro ma zer ba dang / 'ug sgrosabastad pa'i mda' mo la'ug sgro ma zer la/khusgrosabastad pa'i mda' mo la khra sgro ma zer ro/ / dmang4khrod kyi bshad srol ltar na/ rgod sgro mde shugasache largyang chod pa dang / 'ug sgromade mtshan mor 'phangasan gnad la phog thub pa/ khra sgomade myur la rno ba'i khyad chosaldan pa yin skad/ gzhan yang mda' gzhu'i rigasal lcagasamada' dang lcagasagazhu/ smyug mda' dang smyug gzhu/ skyer mda' dang skyer gzhu zhesapa yang byung zhing / phyisasudar khyab shin tu che ba ni gsom dkar gyi mda' dang 'brong rwa'i gzhu yin/ dmangasakhrod kyi ngag sgrosal yang / nang akhu bzang ba'i bka' drin la/ / 'brong rwa smug po gzhu la bkug / nang bu tsha yong na 'phen rkyang yin/ / zer babazhin rwa gzhu thamasacad 'brong rwa 'ba' zhig yin pa susakyang khatshon gcod dka' mod/ 'on te rwa co'i gzhu yin pa susakyang khasalen bzhin 'dug rwa gzhu de smyug gzhu'am skyer gzhu dang mi'adra ste/ mda' 'phen mkhan lashugasacung che ba med na gzhu rgyud 'then dka' la/ 'then thubapa'i dbang du btang na'ang gtong dka' bayinā/26gal srid nusashugasa'adzomasapa'i pho gsar zhig yin phyin 'then sla

a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed/la gtong yang bde bar ma zad/ 'ben la yang phog sla/ gang ltar kyang gtso bo rang rang gi mjeb rtsal la rags las yod do/ /da lta ma dang rtsed 'di rgyun ma chad par rtse bzhin pa'i sa khul la yang gtso bo rma chu'i pha rol gyi grong sde chen yo mang 'ba' bya gsum dang gcan tsha/rma chu'i tshu rol gyi chab 'gag sa khul dang gro tshang / dpa' lung sogs yo da la/yul phyogs de dag tu phal cher rang gi pha mes yang mas kyis btod pa'i srol ltar lo rer chad pa sted par ma da' rtsed kyi dga' ston la rol dang rol bzhin mchis/ sa khul dang sa khul bar gyi mda' rtsed kyi khyad chos dang goms srol de che phyogs nas mthun na yang chung phyogs gnamathun sa yang mang mod/ 'on kyang 'dir re re bzhin ngo sprod byed pa'i dgos pa chen po med pas/ gsham du brgya kha gcig chong kyi tshul du skabs bab kyi brjod be+e gtso bo ste chab 'gag shis gyi mda' sted ngo sprod rags tsam bya'o/ /dang po/ mda' rtsed kyi brgyud jim/1 mda' rtsed kyi sngon 'gro'i cho gamada' sted kyi rgya cung che ba'i skabs ni rgya 'o 'i(hor zla dang po)nang yin/ sde ba dang sde ba'i bar du mda' rtsed byed 'dod na thog mar chang dang kha btags bzung nas phan tshun bar 'brel gtug byas te nyi ma dang skar ma thag gcod byed pa'i srol yod la/ mngags pa'i mis mda' 'phen pa'i nyin ska ra thag bcad rjes/ phyir rang sde'i nang du yong nas mda' 'phen gyi 'byel gtug bgyis pa'i rgyu mtshan rgan pa dang sde dpon rnams la zhus pa na/sde bas tshogs 'du skong 'tshogs byed cing / tshogs 'du la zhugs mkhan ni 427

a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed/la gtong yang bde bar mazad/ 'ben la yang phog sla/ gang ltar kyang gtso bo rang rang gi mtheb rtsalalaragasalasayod do/ /da ltamada' rtsed 'di rgyun mchad par rtse bzhin pa'i 4khulalayang gtso bo rma chu'i pha rol gyi grong sde chenamomang 'ba' bya gsumadang gcan tsha/rma chu'i tshu rol gyi chab 'gag sakhuladang gro tshang / dpa' lung sogasayod la/yulaphyogasade dag tuphalacher rang gi pha mesayang mesakyisabatod pa'i srol ltar lo rer chad pa med par mda' rtsed kyi dga' ston laroladang rol bzhin mchis/ sakhul dang sakhul bar gyi mda' rtsed kyi khyad chosadang gomasasrolade che phyogasanasamathun na yang chung phyogasasumimathun sayang mang mod/ 'on kyang 'dir re re bzhin ngo sprod byed pa'i dgosapa chen po med pas/ gsham du brgya khagacig chod kyi tshul du skabasabab kyi brjod bya gtso bo ste chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed ngo sprod rag4tsam bya'o/ /dang po/ mda' rtsed kyi brgyud rim/1 mda' rtsed kyi sngon 'gro'i cho gamada' rtsed kyi rgya cung che ba'i skabasani rgya lo'i(hor zla dang po)nang yin/ sdeb dang sde ba'i bar du mda' rtsed byed 'dod na thog mar chang dang kha btagasabazung na4phan tshun bar 'brel gtug byasate nyi ma dang skar ma thag gcod byed pa'i srol yod la/ mngag4pa'i mi4mda' 'phen pa'i nyin skar thag bcad rjes/ phyir rang sde'i nang du yong nasamada' 'phen gyi 'brel gtug bgyisapa'i rgyu mtshan rgan pa dang sde dpon rnamasal zhu4pa na/sde bsatshogasa'adu skong 'tshogasabyed cing / tshogasa'adu la zhug4ma:t+ta ni

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/phalacher mda' rtsed byed thub pa'i rgan dar gzhon gsum yin/ mda' 'phen tshogasa'adu'i steng du gtso bo yulalhagazhi bdag dang dgra sawer ma rnamasal mchod bkur bla na ma mchisapa bgyid pa dang / mda' 'phen gyi rgyal kha lon pa'i gsol 'debasadang skyabasa'ajug zlog tu med pa zhusashing /mda' bsososakyang mda' phog pa'i smon lama'adebasapa dang chabasacig zan rilamang po bsgrilab dang bsang mchod rgya chen pobagyid dgosapar ma zad/ ra lug gsur lagatong ba dang yang na mda' phog pa'i slad du bsang dang ra lug khasalen pa'i srolakyang yod/ da dung tshogasa'adu'i steng du ma bu khrid mkhan gyi mi thag gcod pa dang / thengs 'di'i mda' dpon dang gzhug ma'ang thag gcod dgosapa lags/ lugasasrol ltar na ma bu khrid mkhan der nge4par du rang lamayod dgosapa dang bu khrid mkhan der ngesapar du rang la bu yod dgosapa yin/ mda' dpon ni sdeba'i nang du mtshan snyan mtho ba'i rgan po'am yang na dar ma yin dgosal/ de'i lasa'agan gtso bo ni mda' brnams kyi 'go khrid de la rgya 'chor ba'i don dag 'byung du mi 'jug pa byed rgyu de yin/ de yang mabu khrid mkhan dang mda' dpon gzhug ma/ de ji ltar 'demasapa yin zhe na/ ma dang bu khrid mkhan ni ngesapar du ma ṇi khang nasazan sgrilazhu ba'am yang na bla ma'i drung du thag gcod pa'i srol yod la/ mda' dpon dang gzhug ma ni mda' ba byingasarnamasakyisa'adems bsko byasapasachog gzhug ma zer ba la mda' gzhug kyang zer/mda' gzhug gi lasa'agan gtso bo ni mda' rtsal la brten nas rgyal pham gyi dadī ṭ+wā'abyed gang thubabyed rgyu de yin/

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /phal cher mda' rtsed byed thub pa'i rgan dar gzhon gsum yin/ mda' 'phen tshogs 'du'i steng du gtso bo yal lha gzhi bdag dang dgra lha byur ma rnams la mchod bkur bla na ma mchis pa bzhud pa dang / mda' 'phen gyi rgyal kha lon pa'i gsol 'debs dang skyabs 'jug zlog tu med pa zhus shing /mda' ba so sos kyang mda' phog pa'i smon lam/ 'debs pa dang chabs cig zan ril mang po bsgril ba dang bsang mchod rgya chen po bgyid dgos par ma zad/ ra lug gsur la gtong ba dang yang na mda' phog pa'i slad du bsang dang ra lug khas len pa'i srol kyang yod/ da dung tshogs 'du'i steng du mabukhrid mkhan gyi mi thag gcod pa dang / zangs 'di'i mda' dpon dang gzhug ma'ang thag gcod dgos pa lags/ lugs sro la ltar na ma bu khrid mkhan der nges par du rang la ma yod dgos pa dang bu khrid mkhan der ngesapar du rang la bu yod dgos pa yin/ mda' dpon ni sde ba'i nang du mtshan snyan ma/tho ba'i rgan po'am yang na dar ma yin dgos la/ de'i la sa 'gan gtso bo ni mda' brnams kyi 'go khrid de la rgya 'chor ba'i don dag 'byung du mi 'jug pa byed rgyu de yin/ de yang ma bu khrod mkhan dang mda' dpon gzhug ma/ de ji ltar 'dems pa yin zhe na/ ma dang bu khrod mkhan ni nges par du ma ṇi khang nas zan sgrib zhu ba'am yang na bla ma'i drung du thag gcod pa'i srol yod la/ mda' dpon dang gzhug ma ni mda' ba byings rnams kyisa'adems bsko byas pas chog gzhug ma zer ba la mda' gzhug kyang zer/mda' gzhug gi las 'gan gtso bo ni mda' rtsal la brten nas rgyal pham gyi dbye ba 'byed gang thub byed rgyu de yin/428

a mdo chaba'agag yul gyi mda' rtsed/gzhan yang mda' ba rnamasakyisagazab mchor gang legasasprasadagosashing / gal srid rang la med na gzhan nasagayar bsakyang chog gtso bo shom dang mda' rtsed kyisasde ba'i la rgya 'chor minyan pa de yin/ zasarigasakyang sha mar thud gsumalasagazhan ka ra bu ramadang sil tog sna tshogasabasgrigs nasasder khaji 'drar mtho na de 'drar zagashomache ba'i bshad srol yod/ gong zhu'i gra sgrig dang 'gro rimadag ni sde ba gang yin yang phal cher gcig mtshung4susnang la/ gzhisapa yin na'ang 'dra mgron po yin na'ang 'dra gra sgrig byed srolal khyad par de 'dra med/mda' mkhan pa rnamasasde bgacig nasasde ba gzhan zhig la 'gro ba'i skabasasurgan pa phalacher rtar zhon pa dang / dar ma dang gzhon pa rnamasarkang thang du 'gro dgos/ mda' bdag sdeb gzhan par sleb lanye ba'i skab4sutshang masalhan du ki ring thengasamang 'deb4pa dang chabasacig rkang pa sar rdung ba'i srol yang yod/skab4der sde ba'i mda' ba rnamasakyisaphyi sde'i mda' ba rnamasasleb lanye ba na dril skul(bsuba'i cho ga zhig)thengasagasum khyer te/ akhu brgya thamapa dang na zla brgya tham pa sku kham4bde lab/sazhesa'atshamasa'adri zhu ba'i lugasasrol de yang sde ba sosor yod de nasamada' ba rnamasarim gyisamada' rtsed byed sa'i yul la slebasapa na/ sdeb gnyi4kyi mda' dpon mnyamadu tshogasanasa'ajala'aben bzo sadang 'ben gyi ring thung thag gcod byasarjesa'aben bzo ba'i 'go rtsom palags/2 mda' rtsed kyi 'go rtsom pa'i skor/ 429

2 mdo chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed/gzhan yang mda' ba rnam/sa kyis gzab mchor gang legs spras dgosashing / gal srid rang la med na gzhan nas g.yar bas kyang chog gtso bo shom dang mda' sted kyis sde ba'i la rgya 'chor ba nyan pa de yin/ zas rigasathi'i to byedakyang sha mar thud gsum las gzhan ka ra bu ram dang ga sna gsabasgrigs nas sder kha ji 'drar mtho na de 'drar zas shom che ba'i bshad srol yo da/ gong zhu'i gra sgrig dang 'gro rim dag ni sde ba gang yin yang phal cher gcig mtshungs sa snang la/ gzhis pa yin na'ang 'dra mgron po yin na'ang 'dra gra sgrig byed srol la khyad par de 'dra med/mda' mkhan pa rnams sde ba gcig nas sde ba gzhan zhig la 'gro ba'i skabs sa rgan pa phal cher rtar zhon pa dang / dar ma dang gzhon pa rnam/sarkang thang du 'gro dgos/ mda' ba dag sde ba gzhan par sleb la nye ba'i skabs sa tshang ma/sa lhan du ki ring zangs mang 'debs pa dang chabs cig rkang pa sar rdung ba'i sog yang yo da/skabs der sde ba'i mda' ba rnams kyis phyi sde'i mda' ba rnams slob la nye ba na dril skral (bas ba'i cho ga zhig)zangs gsum khyer te/ sprikhu brgya tham pa dang na zla brgya tham pa sku khams bde las/sa zhes 'tshams 'dri zhu ba'i lugs srol de yang sde ba so sor yo da / de nas mda' ba rnam/sa rim gyisam/da' rtsed byed dang byed la slebs pa na/ sde ba gnyis kyi mda' dpon mnyam du tshogs nas 'jal 'ben bzo sa dang 'bon gyi ring thung thag gcod byas rjes 'ben bzo ba'i 'go stom pa lags/2mda' rtsed kyi 'go rtsom pa'i skor/429

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'jal 'ben lag ma zer ba'i srol yod la/ mda' 'phen sa'i yulalam ra dang / mda' 'phen grogs la sku lo yang zer/ gang ltar kyang phyogs gnyis kyis bzos pa'i 'jal 'bon rgya dbyibs ni zur gsum/ yin la/zur gnyis sar 'bab pa dang zur gcig gnam la 'khor ba/ zur rtse ru tho lu zer ba'i sa tho chung chung zhig 'jog pa/ 'ben gyi stod kyi snying khar 'jal lte zhes pa zhig dang mtha' skor du dkar chag gru bzhi can nam rus chag dkar po lnga drug tsam 'jog pa'i lugs srol yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni mda' 'phen skabs 'ben gyi dkyil snying gsal bor mthong ba'i ched du yin/'jal 'ben gyi mtha' mtshams su rtsi to ring bas phyi nang gi mtsham/sa bcad 'dug 'dir gsal bor shes dgos pa zhig ni 'jal lte dang mtha' mtshams kyi rtsi to gnyis shin tu gal che la/ de yang mtha' ma/tsham/sa kyi rtse to'i nang phyogs sa phog pa'i mda' yin na grangs ka'i nang du brtses chog la /ma/tha' mtshams kyi rtsi to'i phyi ru yod na brtsi mi chog de bzhin mda' mang po 'jal 'ben tu babs pa'i dbang du btang na'ang mda' gang 'jal ltel/ thag nye na de kho na brtse ba las gzhan mda' yod tshab mi brtsi ba yin/ de ni mda' mo gcig gis ma dang gzhan tshang ma blangs zin pa yin pas/ ma/da' ba rnams kyis 'di'i phyogs su do snang byed bzhin mchis/de yang phyogs gnyis kas 'jal 'ben bzos grub rjes/ mda' ba re'i lag tu mda' cha re bzung nas rang gi 'jal 'ben dam por bskor nasabangs gsum 'khor ba dang ki sgra 'brug stong ldir ba bzhin sgo ga cing / skad sgra ji 'drar che na de 'drar brjid nyams ldan zhing / da dung pha rol po zil 430

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/'jala'aben la.amazer ba'i srolayod la/ mda' 'phen sa'i yulalasku ra dang / mda' 'phen grogasalasku yayang zer/ gang ltar kyang phyogasaganyisakyi4bzo4pa'i 'jala'aben gyi dbyibasani zur gsum yin la/zur gnyisasar 'bab pa dang zur gcig gnamal 'khor ba/ zur rtse ru tho lu zer ba'i satho chung chung zhig 'jog pa/ 'ben gyi stod kyi snying khar 'jalaltezhesapa zhig dang mtha' skor du dkar chag gru bzhi can nam rusachag dkar po lnga drug tsama'ajog pa'i lugasasrol yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni mda' 'phen skabasa'aben gyi dkyil snying gsalabor mthong ba'i ched du yin/'jal 'ben gyi mtha' mtshamasasugyu to ring bsaphyi nang gi mtshamasabacad 'dug 'dir gsalabor shesadagosapazhig ni 'jal lte dang mtha' mtshamasakyi rtsi to gnyi4shin tu gal che la/ de yang mtha' mtshamasakyi rtsi to'i nang phyogasasuphog pa'i mda' yin na grangasaka'i nang du brtsisachog 'a /mtha' mtshamasakyi rtsi to'i phyi ru yod na brtsi mi chog de bzhin mda' mang po 'jal 'ben tu babasapa'i dbang du btang na'ang mda' gang 'jalarnal thag nye na de kho na brtsi ba lasagazhan mda' yod tshad mi brtsi ba yin/ de ni mda' mogacig gisamada' gzhan tshang ma blangasazin pa yin pas/ mda' ba rnamasakyisa'adi'i phyogasasudo snang byed bzhin mchis/de yang phyogasaganyisakasa'ajala'aben bzosagrub rjes/ mda' ba re'i lag tu mda' cha re bzung nasarang gi 'jala'aben dmapor bskor nasathengasagasum 'khor ba dang ki sgra 'brug stong ldir ba bzhin sgrog cing / skad sgra rdo ༵dar che na de 'drar brjid nyam4ldan zhing / da dung pha rol po zil

a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed/gyis gnon pa'i nang don yang mchis so/ /de nas mda' 'phen gyi 'go brtsams pas na thog mar gzhis pa tshang gis 'jal 'ben steng la 'phen pa'i sros yod la/ mda' po dang po de ma khrid mkhan gyis 'phen dgos pa lags/ de ltar gzhis pa tshang gi ma khrod mkhan gyis mda' dang po 'phangs pa na/ mda' mgo na yod pa'i pho gsar byugazugs yag cing khyon pa phal cher do mnyam pa lnga nas drug gis myur du ma/da' dang po de 'jal 'ben gyi tho lu'i ltag tu btsugs rjes rim gyis skad chen pos ki shur brgyab nas rkang pas sa rdung ba'i skabs su/ mda' ba ma nga po gral bsgrigs nas ki 'debs pa dang rkang pa dag rim pa yod pa'i sgo nasasar brdungs te 'jal 'bon gyi phyogs sa 'gro ba dang / de nas mda' mgo'i pho gsar dag dang 'dres nas 'bon la skor ba thengs gsum grub rjes/tham/sa cad kyis ki bswo bsro lha rgyal lo zhes lan mang po sgog cing phyir mda' 'phen sar log pa lags so/ / de nas mgron po tshang gi ma khyed mkhan gyisamada' dang po 'phangs pa na yang gong bzhin rim pa de dag brgyud dgos pa lags/ de yang ki btab par brjid che ba dang gral bsgrigs nas 'gro bar nyams ji 'drar che na de 'drar gzengs bstod thob pa yin la der sde bar la rgya brtson pa'i don yang 'dus/ phyogs gnyis ka'i ma khrid pa'i go rim/ mjug bsgril rjes bu khrid mkhan gnyis kyis 'phen dgos pa dang / de nasam/da' ba thams cad kyis rim ba bzhin 'phen pa'i 'go rtsom pa yin/gzhis pa dang mgron po phyogs gnyis ka'i mda' ba tshos rang rang gi cha bsgrigs nas/ mda' 'phen pa'i skabs su lha 'bod klu 'bod bgyis nas431

a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed/gyisaganon pa'i nangadon yang mchisaso /de nasamada' 'phen gyi 'go brtsamasapasan thog mar gzhisapa tshang gisa'ajala'aben steng la 'phen pa'i srol yod la/ mda' modang po de mkhrid mkhan gyisa'aphen dgosapa lags/ de ltar gzhisapa tshang gi ma khrid mkhan gyisamada' dang po 'phangasapa na/ mda' mgo na yod pa'i pho gsar skyegazugasayag cing gyon pa phalacher do mnyamapalnganasadrug giyomyur du mda' dang po de 'jala'aben gyi tho lu'i ltag tubatsug4rje4rim gyisaskad chen posaki shur brgyab nasarkang pasasardung ba'i skabayosu/ mda' ba mang po gral bsgrigasanasaki 'debasapa dang rkang pa dag rimapa yod pa'i sgo nasasar brdungasate 'jala'aben gyi phyogasasu'agro ba dang / de nasamada' mgo'i pho gsar dag dang 'dresanasa'aben la skor ba thengasagasumagrub rjes/tham4cad kyis ki bswo baspo lhargyal lozhe4lan mang po sgrog cing phyir mda' 'phen sar log pa lagasaso/ /de nasamagron po tshang gi ma khrid mkhan gyisamada' dang po 'phangasapa na yang gong bzhin rim pa de dag brgyud dgo4pa lags/ de yang ki btab par brjid che ba dang gralabasgrigasanasa'agro bar nyamasaji 'drar che na de 'drar gzengasabastod thob payin lader sde bar la rgya brtson pa'i don yang 'dus/ phyogasaganyisaka'i ma khrid pa'i go rim mjug bsgril rjesabu khrid mkhan gnyisakyi4'phen dgosapa dang / de nasamada' ba thamasacad kyisarimangabazhin 'phen pa'i 'go rtsomapa yin/gzhisapa dang mgron po phyogasaganyisaka'i mda' ba chosarang rang gi cha bsgrigasanas/ mda' 'phen pa'i skabasasulta'abod klu 'bod bgyiswā/4

gcodapa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mda' 'gog pa'i srol yang chagasayod/ rang rang gi sku ya'am mda' 'phen grogasakyi mda' de 'ben la phog pa na/ la rgya shor ba dang ngo tsha che ba'i bshad tshulayod pas/ mda' ba phan tshun suyin yang mda' phog par dogasaṭ+wāṃsa~Xrdo ༵bye /bye/ byu/na nasayong thabasamed/mda' rtsed kyi rtsed srolagyi thad la yang sacha sosor lugasasrol mi 'dra ba re yod kyang ma bu dang ba mo'i rtsed srolani phalacher mthun par snang la/mda' lnga long dgosapa de yang gzhi mgron gnyisaka suyin yang sngon mar mda' sulongasan de'i phyogasakyi ma longasapa yin/ ma longasapa'i steng du mda' lhag yodrug bdun brgyad ltabu phog ste brtsi rgyu yod pasan/ lhag ma'i mda' la cong rdog(amado'i kha skad de go re'i rigasashig yin) zer/dmangs srogaltar na malongasan4cong rdog gcig cong rdog gnyisazhesapa'i brtsi srolayod/ yolongasarjesabu khrid pa'i 'go bcomasapa lags/ bu khrid pa'i 'gro lugasakyang gong du brjod zin pa'i ma khrid pa'i 'gro lugasadang gcig mtshungasayin/ bu la'ang mda' lnga long dgosapa yin/ gal srid ma bu gnyisaka sde gcig lalongasapa'i dbang du btang na ba mo(ba mo zhesapa ni srog chagasab mo'i ming dang gcig mtshungasayin la/ 'dir mda' bcu longasapasan ba mogacig labartsi srol yod)bzhag ngayin/ ba mo bzhag pa yin na ba mo'ajog mkhan de mda' rtsed lasarnam par rgyalab dang bamo 'khur mkhan de mda' rtsed layolam pa yin/ galasrid gzhi mgron gnyisanaswā~Xn tshun la ba more bzhag pa'i dbang du btang na/ 'dra mnyam du gyur

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mda' 'gog pa'i srol yang chags yod/ rang rang gi sku ya'am ma/da' 'phen grogs kyi mda' de 'ben la phog pa na/ la rgya shor ba dang ngo tsha che ba'i bshad tshal yod pas/ ma da' ba phan tshan sa yin yang ma/da' phog par dogs nas yid bde mo zhig gtan nas yong thabs med/3 ma da' rtsed rtsed srog/mda' rtsed kyi rtsed srol byu thad la yang sa cha so sor lugs sro la mi 'dra ba re yod kyang ma bu dang ba mo'i rtsed srol ni phal cher ma thun par snang la/mda' lnga long dgos pa de yang gzhi mgron gnyis ka sa yin yang sngon mar ma da' sa longs na de'i phyogs kyi ma longs pa yin/ ma longs pa'i steng du mda' lhag ma drug bdun brgyad lta bu phog ste brtsi rgyu yo/da pas na/ lhag ma/'i mda' la cong rdog(a mdo'i kha skad de go re'i rigs shig yin)zer/dmangs grol ltar na ma longs nas cong rdog gcig cong rdog gnyis zhes pa'i brtse srol yod/ ma longs rjes bu khrid pa'i 'go brtsam/sa pa lags/ bu khyed pa'i 'gro lugs kyang gong du brjod zin pa'i ma khrid pa'i 'gro lugs dang gcig mtshungs yin/ bu la'ang mda' lnga long dgos pa yin/ gal srid ma bu gnyis ka sde gcig la longs pa'i dbang du btang na ba mo(ba mo zhes pa ni srog chags ba mo' ming dang gcig mtshungs yin la/ 'dir ma/da' bcu longs pas na ba mo gcig la brtse srol yod)bzhag pa yin/ ba mo bzhag pa yin na ba mo 'jog mkhan de mda' rtsed las rnam par rgyal ba dang ba mo 'thar mkhan de mda' rtsed las pham pa yin/ gal srid gzhi mgron gnyisakas phan tshan la ba mo re bzhag pa'i dbang du btang na/ 'dra mnyam du grur 432

a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed/pa'i rkyen gyisayang bskyar mkhrid pa'i 'go rtsom pa dang / ma longayorjesabu khrid pa'i 'go rtsom dgosapa red/ der yang mgazhisapar long4pa dang bu mgron por longs pa'i tshe/ mabu gang gang zer te 'dra 'dra yin par brtsi/sde ba gang yin rung ma bu longasakyang ba mo mabazhag tshe/ la rgya dang ngo tsha chen po shor med na'ang / bshad srol laphan tshun gyisab mo mabazhag kyang rgyal kha sde ba su la yod cesagleng bar bya ngeyored/ de yang sde ba gcig gisasde ba gzhan gcig la ba mobazhag pa'i dbang du btang na/ rtsed thengasa'adir skyin pa sprod mthub kyang skabasanam zhig glagasadang bstun nasaskyin pa sprod rgyu'i bsam pa mda' batshang mar yod/ gzhan yang phan tshun la grosasdur ci yang med par mda' rgyug tu'agro ba'i srol yang yod/ mda' rgyug zer ba de glo bur du mda' ba tham4cad bsdu4nasarang la ba mo 'jog mkhan gyi sde bar mda' 'phen par rgyug pa'i don yin/ mda' rgyug tu song nasab mo phyir sprod thub pa byung tshe 'dod thog tu 'ongasapa yin la/ ba mo sprod ma thub par ba mo'i steng du ba mo 'khur na de ba4yid sdug par gyurate snying nad kyang je cher 'gyur ba'i khar la rgya yang shor zin pani smosam dgosaso/ /gnyis pa/ mda' rtsed dang 'brel ba'i glu gar gyi skor/sde ba gang yin yang phan tshun la mda' 'phen du song na nyin gcig dang phyed ka 'dug pani phal cher gom4srol du gyur yod/ mda' 'phen du song ba'i nyin dang po'i dgong ja 'thungasarjes/ mda' ba dang gzhisapa'i ma sru rnamasalhan du 'dzomasanasaglu len gar rtsed byed srolamachis/ glu len gar rtsed kyi brgyud rim yang thog mar gzhisapa'i glu ba gsumagyisahūm̐ ṭ+wāṃn

2 mdo chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed/pa'i rkyen gyis yang bskyar ma khyed pa'i 'go rtsom pa dang / ma longs rjes bu khyed pa'i 'go rtsom dgos pa red/ der yang ma gzhis par longs pa dang 4 mgron por longs pa'i tshe/ ma bu gang gang zer te 'dra 'dra yin par bste/sde ba gang yin rung ma bu longs kyang ba mo ma bzhag tshe/ la rgya dang ngo tsha chen po shor ped na'ang / bshad sgos la phan tshum gyis ba mo ma bzhag kyang rgyal kha sde ba su la yo da ces gleng bar bya nges red/ de yang sde ba gcig gis sde ba gzhan gcig la ba mo bzhag pa'i dbang du btang na/ rtsed jengs 'dir skyin pa sprod ma thub kyang skabs nam zhig glags dang bstun nas byan pa sprod rgyu'i bsam pa mda' ba tshang mar yod/ gzhan yang phan tshun la gros sdur ci yang ped par ma da' rgyug tu 'gro ba'i srol yang yod/ ma/da' rgyug zer ba de glo bur du mda' ba thams cad bsdus nas rang la ba mo 'jog mkhan gyi sde bar ma/da' 'phen par rgyug pa'i don yin/ mda' rgyug tu song nas ba mo phyir sprod thub pa byung tshe 'dod thog tu 'ongs pa yin la/ ba mo/ sprod ma thub par ba mo'i steng du ba mo 'khur na de bas yid sdug par gyur te snying nad kyang je cher 'gyur ba'i khar la rgya yang shor zin pa ni smos ma dgos so/ /gnyis pa/ mda' rtsed dang 'brel ba'i glu gar gru skor/sde ba gang yin yang phan tshum la mda' 'phen du song na nyin gcig dang phyed ka 'dug pa ni phal cher goms srol du gyur yod/ mda' 'phen du song ba'i nyin dang po'i dgong ja 'thungs rjes/ mda' ba dang gzhis pa'i ma sru rnams lhan du 'dzoms nas glu len gar rtsed byed srol mchis/ glu len gar rtsed kyi brgyud rim yang thog mar gzhis pa'i glu ba gsum gyis glu snyan 433

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/zhing 'jeb4pagasumablangasan4'isgo phyesapasan/ mgron potshang gi skad ngag 'dzomasapa'i glu bgasumagyisakyang glu gsum blangasate/ gzhisapa'i masrutsho'i lag tu chang phor sprod/ dusader masrutshang gi glumasakyang glu len pa'i 'go rtsomazhing blangasapa'i glu chang mgron po'i lagatugasapa'i ngaba'ajog bdang / pho pophan tshun gyi4glu khamatshar bcu lhag cig blangasarjes/ stonabashad dang chang bshad sogasabashad pa'i lugasasrol dang / miganyisasayobazhisartse rig 'khrab len byed pa'ang yod/ de'i rjesasumagron potshang gisaglu chen(lagazhas)len pa'i re ba zhu glu blangayote/ rang gi grala'ago'i rgan po'i lag tu chang phor bzhag pasan/ rgan po4skad gseng mthon posaganang ba byin pa yin/ sta re bzung na4nagasasu'agro na/ lcagasathomakhyer nasachu la'agro na/ mgo na mthur med/ rkang na sgrog med ce4zer nasaganang ba byin tshe/ skad ngag yid du 'ong bzhig gisalagazhasakyi rtsed 'go blangasanasamasrutsho'i lag tuchang phor bzhag mthag glu mal yang the tshomaci yang med par phyir gzhasalan slog pa yin la/ de ltar phalacher dgong mo'i chu tshod dgu nasaphyi nyin gyi snga dro'i chu chod gnyisayasamasasul gzhasagatug resabyed pa dang / der yang skad ngag gi bzang ngan dang la gzhasakyi mang nyung ltar rgyalaphamalaltaba'i sros yod/ glu gar gyi tshogasapa grol ba'i skabasasusku mgron tsho4bkra shisapa'i glu gsumalen pa dang / bkra shisakyi glu gzhug moblangasapa dang chabasacig sku mgron rnamasayar langasanasarim gyisasgor 'gro bar rtsom/ dusader gzhisapa'i ma sutsho sngon du phyir bud nasaphyi sgor ga/snyi ༵ brgyab nasamagron po sgor 'gro ru mi'ajug gal te sgo phye dgosan

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhing 'jebs pa gsum blangs nas glu sgo phyes pas na/ mgron po tshang gi skad ngag 'dzoms pa'i glu ba gsum gyis kyang glu gsum blangs te/ gzhis pa'i yosru tshol lag tu chang phor sprod/ dus der mas tshang gi glu mas kyang glu len pa'i 'go rtsom zhing blangs pa'i glu chang mgron po'i lag tu gus pa'i ngang 'jog pa dang / pho yo phan tshan gyis glu khamatshar bcu lhag cig blangs rjes/ ston bshad dang chang bshad sogs bshad pa'i lugs srol dang / miganyis sa ma bzhis rtse rig 'jib len byed pa'ang yod/ de'i rjes sa mgron po tshang gisaglu chen(lagazhas)len pa'i re ba zhu glu blangs te/ rang gi gral 'go'i rgan po'i lag tu chang phor bzhag pas na/ rgan pos skad gseng mthon posaganang ba byen pa yin/ sta re bzung nas nags su 'gro na/ lcags thom khyer nas chu la 'gro na/ mgo na mthur med/ rkang na sgog med ces zer nasaganang ba byen tshe/ skad ngag yid du 'ong ba zhig gis la gzhas kyi rtsed 'go blangs nas ma sru tshong 'a ga tu chang phor bzhag mthag glu ma la yang ze tshom ci yang med par phyir gzhas la na sgog pa yin la/ de ltar phal cher dgong mo'i chu tshod dgu nas phyi nyin gyi snga dro'i chu chod gnyis yas mas sa la gzhas gtug res byed pa dang / der yang skad ngag gi bzang ngan dang la gzhas kyi mang nyung ltar rgyal pham la lta ba'i srol yod/ glu gar gyi tshogs pa grol ba'i skabasas sku mgron tshos bkra shis pa'i glu gsum len pa dang / bkra shis kyi glu gzhug yo blangs pa dang chabs cig khru mgron rnams yar langs nas rim gyis sgor 'gro bar stom/ dus der gzhis pa'i ma ga tsho sngon du phyir bud nas phyi sgor gtan po brgyab nas mgron po sgor 'gro ru mi 'jug gal te sgo phye dgos na 434

a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed/mgron po rnams dang mas tshos am rogs gzhas zer bde bshad de mas tsho pham pas na da gzod sgo phye nges yin la/ gal te pham par gtong mthub na sgo mi 'byed/ yin na'ang dus tshod 'gyangs na mgron po tsho'i sku ngal bar dogs nas gzhis pa'i 'go dpon zhig gis mas tsho la kha ngo bslangs pas na/dgazod ma sru tshos sgo phyes nas sku mgron rnams lang la gso bar 'jug pa lags/ der yang kha bde rtse bde can gyis bshad pa'i a mar gas gzhasazer ba ni yang snyeng ci zhig yin zhe na/ de ni na gzhon pho mo bar phan tshun mthun pa'i brtse sems mtshon pa'i khamatshar zhig yin/ phal cher tshig rkang bzhi dang drug brgyad bcu can mang po 'dug pa ste/ dper na/ pha gi'i sgang nas 'khor lo 'khor gi / tshur ga'i sgang nas 'khor lo 'khor gi / a pha sprim yul nas 'khor gi / rogs khyod dang 'u gnyis 'di na 'khor gi / zhes pa lta bu'i bzhi rkang can dang / pha gi brag red/ / tshur ga nags red/ / lung ba chu red/ / gram brdo red/ / bya mo 'phur gi / gshog rtsa 'dar gi /bya phrug 'phur gi / snyeng rtsa 'dar gi / rogs nged gnyis 'grogs na/ /rkang rtsa 'dar gi / zhes pa ni tshig rkang bcu can lta bu'o/ / kha mtshar 'di rigs la srol rgyun gyi bshad srol bzhir bzhag gi steng gsar ba bsgrigs pa yang yong/ gang ltar kyang a mar gas gzhas zhes pa 'di rong sde phal cher gyis mda' rtsed skabs sa bkol ba yin la 'brog sde mang po dang khams phyogasastod ra khyab tu song yod med gas bo cha shes/de yang mda' ba rnams phyi nyin gyi nyi ste ri gsum gyi zom la phog pa'i dus su/ slar yang sku ra'i(mda' 'phen sa)nang du 'dus shing / sngar 435

a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed/mgron pornam4dang masrutshosa.amarog4gzhasazer bde bshad de yosrutsho pham pasan da gzod sgo phye ngesayinal/ galate phamapar gtong yothuban sgo mi'abyed/ yin na'ang dusatshod 'gyangasan mgron potsho'i sku ngalabar dogasanasagazhisapa'i 'go dpon zhig gisamasrutsho lakha ngo bslang4pasan/dgazod masrutsho4sgophyesanasasku mgronarnam4langalagasobar 'jug pa lags/ der yang kha bde rdzibade can gyisabashad pa'i amarogasagazhasazer ba ni yang snying ci zhig yin zhe na/ de ni na gzhon pho mobar phan tshun mthun pa'i brtse semasamatshon pa'i khamatshar zhig yin/ phal cher tshig rkang bzhi dang drug brgyad bcu can mang po'adug bste/ dper na/ pha gi'i sgang nasa'akhor lo'akhor gi / tshur ga'i sgang nasa'akhor lo'akhor gi / apha amayul nasa'akhor gi / rogasakhyod dang 'u gnyi4'di na 'khor gi / zhesapa ltabu'i bzhi rkang can dang / pha gi brag red/ / tshur ga nagasared/ / lung ba chu red/ / gramabardo red/ / bya mo'aphur gi / gshog rtsa 'dar gi /bya phrug 'phur gi / snying rtsa 'dar gi / rogasanged gnyisa'agrogasan/ /rkang rtsa 'dar gi / zhesapani tshig rkang bcu can ltabu'o/ / kha mtshar 'di rigasalasrolargyun gyi bshad srolagazhir bzhag gi steng gsar ba bsgrigasapa yang yod/ gang ltar kyang amarogasagazhasazhesapa 'di rong sde phal cher gyisamada' rtsed skab4subakolabayin la'abrog sdemang podang khamasaphyogasasudar khyab tu song yod med gsalabo mishes/de yang mda' ba rnamasaphyi nyin gyi nyi rtse ri gsumagyi zomalaphog pa'i dusasu/ slar yang sku ra'i(mda' 'phen sa)nang du 'du4shing /43ṭ+wāṃr

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs sgrigs/nyin bzhin phyogs gnyis kyis 'jal 'ben bzos nas grub rjes mda' 'phen pa'i 'go rtsom pa yin/ mda' rtsed kyi 'bras bu ste bzang ngan ci 'dra byung yang phyi dro mda' rtsed mtshams bzhag nas glu len gar rtse byed dgosapalags/ de ni sku mgron rnams kyis dros ja 'thungs rjes phyir sbu ra'i nang du 'dus shing / gzhis pa tshang gis bting ba'i gdan dkar dmar khra gsumagyi steng du sbu mgron rnams lo rim gral ltar dkyil krung bcas nas 'dug pa dang / gzhis pa tshang gi bkod sgrig ltar mdang dgong tshogs pa'i 'gro rimadang mtshungs par/ gzhis pa tshang gis glu sgo phye rjes sku ma/gron rnams dang gzhis pa'i ma sru tshos phan tshun bar glu len gyi 'go rtsom pa yin/ glu len gyi nang don dang 'gro rim thams cad sngar dang mtshungs la khru mgron rnams lam la chas skabs skyel ma rgya chen po byed dgos/ der yang gzhis pa'i pho gsar rnams kyis lag tu chang phor 'brug rgyan bzung ste/ gral nyis bsgrigs byasanas sku mgron rnams de'i dkyil du 'gro ba'i skabs su chang 'dren ci thub byed pa dang / ma sru tshos glu dang rtse rig gis skyel ma byas te/ phal cher sde ba'i 'dabs bar du byel ba'i srol yod/ de ltar sku ma gron rnams phal cher rgyang grags gcig tsam la skebs pas na/ sku mgron rnams kyis mnyam du ki la na gsum btab rjes lam la zhugs te pha yul phyogs sa kyis pa yin/de ltar sde ba gnyis ka'i bshad ma/tshams ltar nyin gcig dang gnyisakyi rjes su/ sde ba 'di'i mda' ba rnams sde ba gzhan der mda' 'phen du 'gro dgos la/ mda' rtsed kyi 'gro rim dang glu gar gyi brgyud rim tham/sacad gong du brjod pa dang gcig mtshungs yin pas bskyar du brjod pa'i 436

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nyin bzhin phyogasaganyisakyisa'ajala'aben bzosan4grub rjesamada' 'phen pa'i 'go rtsom pa yin/ mda' rtsed kyi 'brasabu ste bzang ngan ci 'dra byung yang phyi dro mda' rtsed mtshamasabazhag nas glu len gar rtse byed dgosabalags/ de ni sku mgron rnamasakyisadrosaja 'thungasarjesaphyir sku ra'i nang du 'dusashing / gzhis pa tshang gisabating ba'i gdan dkar dmar khra gsumagyi steng du sku mgron rnamasalo rim gra' ltar dkyilakrung bca4nasa'adug padang / gzhisapa tshang gi bkod sgrig ltar mdang dgong tshogasapa'i 'gro rimadang mtshungasapar/ gzhis pa tshang gisaglu sgo phye rjeyosku mgron rnamasadang gzhisapa'i ma sutshosaphan tshun bar glu len gyi 'go rtsom pa yin/ glu len gyi nang don dang 'gro rim thamasacad sngar dang mtshungasal sku mgron rnamasalamal chasaskabasaskyel ma rgya chen po byed dgos/ der yang gzhiyopa'i pho gsar rnamasakyisalag tu chang phor 'brug rgyan bzung ste/ gral nyiyobasgrigasabyasanayosku mgron rnamasade'i dkyiladu 'gro ba'i skab4suchang 'dren ci thub byed pa dang / masru tsho4glu dang rtse rig gisaskyelamabya4te/ phal cher sde ba'i 'dabasabar du skyel ba'i srol yod/ de ltar sku mgron rnams phal cher rgyang gragasagacig tsam la slebasapasan/ sku mgron rnamasakyisamanyam du ki lan gsumabatab rjesalam la zhugasate pha yulaphyogs suchasapa yin/de ltar sde ba gnyisaka'i bshad mtshamasaltar nyin gcig dang gnyi4kyi rjesasu/ sde ba 'di'i mda' ba rnamasasde ba gzhan der mda' 'phen du 'gro dgosal/ mda' rtsed kyi 'gro rim dang glu gar gyi brgyud rimathamasacad ṭ+wāṃng du brjod pa dang gcig mtshung4yin pas bskyar du brjod pa'i

a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed/dgosapa med/ lar chab 'gag yulagyi rgya ra gtso byasapa'i rka gsar/ ar sti/ dum pa/ metog lung ba gong zhol/ 'gag gong zhol/ sor rgyag dang khra tshang bcasasumada' rtsed kyi grangasamang yang / gtso bo rgya lo'i tshesapa gsum nasabacu bar du mda' rtsed byed pa ni chad med yin/ 'on kyang 'dir shesadagosapa zhig ni/ sde ba'i rgan po gtso che shosare tshe lasa'adas pa na lo der mda' mi'aphen pa'i srol yang yod do/ /mda' rtsed kyi rig4'di gang ltar kyang dmangasakhrod rtsed mo'i grub cha gtso bo zhig yin pas/ 'dir rang gzhan thamasacad kyi4nyam4pa sor chudadang mnyam4rgyun 'dzin byed rgyu ni shin tu gal che/ dmang4khrod la mtshon na rig gan4'tsho b.longayosuspyod rgyu mang po med par brten/mda'artsed dang glu rtsed sogasargya je che dang nang don phun sum je tshogasasugatong mthub na/ mang tshogasakyi rig gnasa'atsho ba'i 'dod blon skong thabasamed palags/ de'i phyir/ nged cag 'brel yod pa rnamasakyisarang re'i chab 'gag yul gyi sngar yod thun mong mayin pa'i mda' rtsed kyi khyad chosagazhir bzung ste/ deng rabasacan gyi khyad chosaldan pa'i mda' rtsed kyi rnam pa gsar ba zhig gtod par 'bad 'bungasalhod med byed dgo4pa 95ba/mu /437

ya mdo chab 'gag yul gyi mda' rtsed/dgos pa med/ lar chab 'gag yul gyi rgya ra gco byas pa'i rka gsar/ ar ste/ dum pa/ me tog lung ba gong zhol/ 'gag gong zhol/ sor rgyag dang khra tshang bcas sam/da' rtsed kyi grangs ma/nga yang / gtso bo rgya lo'i mas pa gsum nas bcu bar du mda' rtsed byed pa ni chad med yin/ 'on khrung 'dir shes dgos pa zhig ni/ sde ba'i rgan po gtso che shos re tshe las 'das pa na lo der mda' mi 'phen pa'i sro la yang yod do/ /mda' rtsed kyi rigs 'di gang ltar kyang dmangs khrod rtsed mo'i grub cha gco bo zhig yin pas/ 'dir rang gzhan thams cad kyis nyams pa sor chung dang ma nyams rgyun 'dzin byed rgyu ni shin tu gal che/ dmangs khrod la mtshon na rig gnas 'tsho ba longs su spyod rgyu mang po med par brten/ma da' rtsed dang glu rtsed sogs rgya je che dang nang don phun sum je tshogasagagatong ma thub na/ mang tshogs kyi rig gnas 'tsho ba'i 'dod blo de skong thabs med pa lags/ de'i phyir/ nged cag 'brel yo da pa rnams kyis rang re'i chab 'gag yul gyi sngar yod thun mong ma yin pa'i mda' rtsed kyi khyad chos gzhir bzung ste/ deng rabs can 6 khyad chos ldan pa'i mda' rtsed kyi rnam/ pa gsar ba zhig gtod par 'bad 'bungs lhod med byed dgos pa 'ab/ba /437

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi dus ston lab rtse chab ril/de yang chab 'gag ces pa'i yul gru 'di ni stod na ri rab kyi dbu 'phang rnam par mtho ba'i dkar phyogs skyong ba'i blon po gser chen thin zhing brjed par gyigs shing / shar du yid bzhin gyi nor bu khri 'bum mang po lhan du srungs pa lta bu'i ba phro dung ri dkar po lhang nger mngon pa/ nub tu bdud sde ma lus zil gyis gnon pa lta bu'i dpa' rtul rdza rgan khros pa'i tshul gyisa'agying ba/ mdun du 'gro ba sems can yongs kyi tsha ba'i sdug bsngal sol ba'i rma klung gsa'i sring mo dal gyis dbang phyogs yul du 'bab pa/ dbusasumado snga gas zung du 'brel ba'i 'jam mgon bla ma/'i 'u gas bzang dri mas ma gos par 'dzin spyong spen gsum bgyid pa'i chab 'gag dgon gsar bkra shis jeg mchog gling zhes pa mig gi dga' ston du gyur pa dang / der ma zad da dung sgod bcud 'dzoms pa'i yul khams 'di ru bod gangs can gyi nyi zla lta bu'i sngon byon skyes bu dam pa du ma ste/ btsan po khri ral pa can/ saskyakun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa/ rgyal pa sku phreng gsum pa bsong nams rgya mtsho/ rgyal dbang sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba 438

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi dus ston lab rtse chab ril/de yang chab 'gag cesapa'i yul gru 'di ni stod na ri rab kyi dbu 'phang rnam par mtho ba'i dkar phyogasaskyong ba'i blon po gser chen lhun zhing brjid par chagasashing / shar du yid bzhin gyi nor bu khri 'bum mang po lhan du spungasapa ltabu'i ba dzodung ri dkar po lhang nger mngon pa/ nub tu bdud sdomalusazilagyisaganon pa ltabu'i dpa' rtulardza rgan khro4pa'i tshul gyisa'agying ba/ mdun du 'gro bsemasacan yongasakyi tsha ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i rmaklung gaṅgā'i sring mo dal gyisadabang phyogasayul du 'bab pa/ dbusasumado sngagagazung du 'brelaba'i 'jam mgon bla ma'i lugasabazang dri mas ma gosapar 'dzin skyong spelagasum bgyid pa'i chab 'gag dgon gsar bkra shisatheg mchog gling zhesapamig gi dga' ston du gyur pa dang / der ma zad da dung snod bcud 'dzom4pa'i yul khamasa'adi ru bod gangasacan gyi nyi zla ltabu'i sngon byon skyesabudam pa du ma ste/ btsan po khri ralapa can/ saskya kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'gro mgon 'phagasapa/ rgyal pa sku phreng gsum pabasod nam4rgya mtsho/ rgyal dbang sku phreng lnga ba blobazang rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba 438

a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi dus ston lab rtse chab ril/gyisaganamasakhebasapa dang / bsang rtsi ba dang bsang 'bod blan mamachisapa bgyid padang mtshung4su/ dri med yid kyisaphyag gsuma'atshal ba dang /de nasa'ado rig rta bor zhon pa'i skyesapa thamasacad rtar zhon pa dang rta med patshang markang thang du lab rtse laskor ba gsum rgyag zhor du/ rlung rta gnam saganyisasugator ba dang / ki bswo bar+sālhargyal lo zhesaskyesapa yongasakyisalhan du yang nas yang du skad sgra'abrug stong ldir ldir byed pa/ memada' khur ba'i skyesapatshoyome mda' phyogasabazhi'i gnam la bskor nasaskag skag turgyag pa/ skya rtsal legs pa'i skyesapa tsho4rta'i gong du 'gyur ba mang po'i 'khrub ston bgyid pa/ bgegasarkyen gyisagadung ba'i skyesapa lal4lab rtse la 'khor nasalag pa'i pad mosnying khar sbyar nasaskyabasa'ajug zhu ba'amasmon lam 'debasapa yin no/ / gong zhu'i cho ga de dag yongasasugrub rjesaphag lug gi dpung ba 'ben la bslangasate/ memada' khur ba'i skyesapa tshosa'aben bo'u bgyid pa'i dpe yod/ nyin der bslangasapa'i dpung ba de susagacog thub na/ lo der khalasarlung rta rta rgod rgyug rgyug dang bya rgod 'phur 'phur byed cing / da dung dgra dpung ba'i nang nasagacog thubapa'i bshad srol yang yod/ memada'i 'khrubaston gyi rjesasu/ skya rtsal legasapa'i skyesapa tsho sodagra rgyug pa'i lugasasrol yod/ sodagra zhesapa ni thang du skye ba'i rtsi to de thag pasadamapor bsdamasate/ rgyang nasabaltasan mgo dang lag pa gnyisaka tshang ba'i mizhig dang mtshungasapa de dgra bo'i tshul du bzhag nas/skya rtsalabade ba'i skyesapa rnamayokyisaphar rgyug tshur rgyug skabasasurdoswā~Xṭ+wāṃb

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/co —a de ze sri skye bo mas de conas ga da pa' la ra/ gal da sus dgra ga da thub na bder thams cad kyis bstod bsngags bgyid bdang / phul byung pho gsar gyi mtshan snyan yang rang shugs su 'byor nges lags/gsum pa/ rta rgyug mda' 'phen/de yang la brtse bstod pa'i cho ga yongs sa bsgrub yonas grub rjes/ rta rgyug mda' 'phen gyi 'go rtsom pa yin/ der thog mar rta rgyug pa dang /de'i 'phror mda' 'phen pa lags/ rta rgyug la rigs gnyis su dbye ba ste/gcig ni bang gis rgyug pa dang gnyis ni gom pa 'gran pa de yin/ rta rgyug la zhugs pa'i sde bar rgya ra dang ar ste/ dum pa/ me tog lung ba/ skya rengasalha khang / sor rgyag khra tshang bcas sdeb mang po yod/ 'gran sdur la zhugs pa'i rta pa yang phal cher sum cu yas mas yod cing / 'gran sdur skabs su yang thog mar bang rtsal 'gran pa dang phyis sa gom rtsal 'gran pa yin/ bang col 'gran pa'i rgyug lugs la rta sum cu yod pa'i dbang du btang na/ rgyug rta bcu re skor pha re bgos te jengs gsum la brgyugasarjes/ skor chung de'i nang du sngon ma gsum re len pa dang / sngon ma gsum re blangs pas gsum gsum dgu yod pa yang bangs gcig la 'gran dgosashing / de dag las kyang ga gzhug ltar rta sngon ma gsum blangs te a/nga dang 0 ma sgogs dar/ ang gnyis pa'i mgyogs dar/ ang gsum pa'i mgyogs dar zhes mgyogs dar 'dogs pa'i lugs ga yod/ gom pa 'gran par yang bang rgyug dang khyad par chen po ma mchis mod/ 'on te gom 446

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nasagacod pa'i srolade lazer/ galasrid skye bo susasodagra de gcod thub namider thamasacad kyisabastod bsngagasabagyid bdang / phulabyung pho gsar gyi mtshan snyan yabarang shugasasu'abyor ngesalags/gsum pa/ rta rgyug mda' 'phen/de yang labartse bstod pa'i cho g.yongasasubasgrubasanasagrub rjes/ rta rgyug mda' 'phenagyi 'go rtsomapayin/ der thog mar rta rgyug pa dang /de'i 'phror mda' 'phenapalags/ rta rgyug larigasaganyisasudabye ba ste/gcig ni bangagisargyugapadangaganyisani gomapa 'gran pade yin/ rta rgyug lazhugasapa'i sdebar rgya ra dang ar sti/ dumapa/ me tog lung ba/ skya rengasalhakhang / sor rgyag khra tshang bcasasdebamang po yod/ 'gran sdur lazhugasapa'i rta payang phalacher sumacu ya4masayod cing / 'gran sdur skabasasuyang thog mar bang rtsal 'granapa dang phyisasugom rtsala'agran pa yin/ bang rtsal 'gran pa'i rgyug lugasalarta sumacu yod pa'i dbang du btang na/ rgyug rta bcu re skor chung re bgosate thengasagasum labargyugasarjes/ skor chung de'i nang du sngon mgasumar len padang / sngon mgasumarablangasapasagasulogasumadagu yod pa yang thengasagacig la'agran dgosashing / de dag lasakyangasngagazhug ltar rta sngon mgasumablang4te ang dang po'i mgyogasadar/ ang gnyisapa'i mgyogasadar/ ang gsum pa'i mgyog4dar zhesamagyogasadar 'dogasapa'i lugasasrolayod/ gomapa 'gāhā ༵ra yang bang rgyug dang khyad par chen po mamachi4mod/ 'on te gom

a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi dus ston lab rtse chab ril/pa 'gran pa'i khyad choyogatso bo ni/ goyoba'acholaminyan 0ste/ galasrid gom pa 'cholan sngon du bud kyaba.ang dang por brtsisamichog rgyu mtshan ni gomapa 'cholabasaso/ / bang rgyug lamatshon na rgyugangaji ltar mgyogasan de bzhin legasapayin no/ /rta rgyug gi rgyalaphamayang miger khona'i mtshan snyanadang largya min par/sde ba dang sacha'i largya dang mtshan snyanalarag lasayod stabs/ rta rgyug lazhugasapa'i skye bo suyin yang rta margyugasapa'i sngon labasang gtong ba dang gsol ba 'deb4pa'i lugasasrolayod cing / galate rta rgyug lasargyalakhablangasapa'i dbang du btang na/ sdeba'i mirnamasadaga' ba 'bumagyi4myosate dar ling 'dog4pa dang mil gosabatagasasogasa'athen nasarten 'brelazhu ba'i lugasasrol yang yod do/ /rta rgyug 'gran rtsalagrubarjes/ sde bsoso'i mda' brnamasalhan du 'dzomasanasamada' 'phen pa'i 'go rtsoyongayin/ mda' 'phenabade sdeb dang sde ba'i bar phan tshun 'gran sdur byed payin/ dper na/ rgya ra dang ar sti 'gran pa/ rka gsar dang khra tshang 'gran pa/ sor rgyag dang metog lung ba 'gran paltabu yin/ sdeb rer mda' baphalacher bzhi bcu yasamasayod la/ miresa'aphen thengasarer mda' gnyisalasa'aphangamichog galasrid mda' 'phen 'gran sdur skabasasurgyalakhablangasapasan dga' rtagasayod par mazad/ sde ba'i largya zinapa'i bshad srolayod cing / ldobagang yin yang rgyalakha blangasapa de mda' ba'i mda' rtsaladang sdeba'i tā~Xs

a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi dus ston lab rtse chab ril/pa 'gran pa'i khyad chos gtso bo ni/ gom pa 'chol na nyan bste/ gal srid gom pa 'chos na sngon du bud kyang ang dang por brtsis mi chog rgyu maྈ ni gom pa 'chol bas so/ / bang rgyug lamatshon na rgyug ba ji ltar mgyogs na de bzhin legs pa yin no/ /rta rgyug gi rgyal pham yang mi sger khona'i mtshan snyan dang la rgya min par/sde ba dang sa cha'i la rgya dang mtshan snyan la rag las yod stabs/ rta rgyug la zhugs pa'i bye bo g.yin yang rta ma rgyugs pa'i sngon la bsang gtong ba dang gsol ba 'debs pa'i lugs srol yod cing / gal te rta rgyug las rgyalakhablangs pa'i dbang du btang na/ sdeba'i cha rnams dga' ba 'bum gyis myosate dar ling 'dogs pa dang nal gos btags sogs 'then nas rten 'brel zhu ba'i lugs srol yang yod do/ /rta rgyug 'gran rtsal grub rjes/ sde ba so so'i mda' brnams lhan du 'dzoms nas mda' 'phen pa'i 'go rtsom ba yin/ mda' 'phen bde sdeb dang sde ba'i bar phan a 'gran sdur byed ba yin/ dper na/ rgya ra dang ar ste 'gran pa/ rka gsar dang khra tshang 'gran pa/ sor rgyag dang cha tog lung ba 'gran pa ltab yin/ sdeb rer mda' ba phal cher bzhi bcu yas masayod la/ skores 'phen zangs rer mda' gnyis las 'phang cha chog galasrid mda' 'phen 'gran sdur skabs sa rgyal kha blangs pa4na dga' rtagasayod par ma zad/ sde ba'i la rgya zin pa'i bshad srol yod cing / sde ba gang yin yang rgyal kha blangs pa de mda' ba'i mda' tsal dang sde ba'i khalas447

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'ba' zhig tumi bsamapar/ gtso bo rang gisamachod bkur bgyisapa'i yulalhagazhi bdag gisasdongasagrogayomadzad pa'i 'brasabuyinapar bsama'adug mda' rtsed kyang nyin dang postetshe4bcu bdunalamajug rdzogasamathub na/ tshesabaco brgyad dang bcu dgur yang mumathud du 'phangasachog pa lags/bzhi ba/ glu len gar rtsed/sde ba phan tshun bar 'granapa'i mda' rtsed kyi rgyal pham kho thag ma chod kyang mda' ba tshosadrosang 'thung4rjesamada' 'phen gyi mtshamasabazhag ste/glu len gar rtsed kyi 'go rtsom pa yin/ glu len gar rtsed bgyid pa de yang sde ba 'di'i pho gsar tsho dang sde ba gan gyi ma sru tsho'i bar phan tshun glu len 'gran sdur byedapa zhig yin/ glu ba dang glu mgang yin yang thog mar rgyan gosakyi bzang ngan 'gran pa dang / de'i 'phror skad dang ngag gi bzang ngan 'gran pa/ mtha' mar glu'i mang nyung 'gran pa'i dpe yod/ gal srid mo gsar skye gzugasayag la skad ngag kyang snyan zhing 'jebasapa zhig yin na'ang glu khamatshar dang shags/ lagazhasasogasamang po med tshe rgyal khamilon zhing dga' rtagasa.ang dang po yang lon pa'i dpe mi srid/ pho gsar yin na'ang gcig mtshungasayin/ skad ngag glu gsum yongasasum 'dzoms na rgyalakhalen pa'i thabasam mchis/ de bsasdeb soso'i glu ba dang glu ma rnamasakyisalab rtse chabarilal nye ba'i skabasasu/ phyugasarjesadang ngal rtsol gyi khomaska~Xsaglu rta mang po dang / glu tshig mang por sbyangasapa byed kyin yod/

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'ba' zhig tu mi bsam par/ gtso bo rang gis mchod bkur bsgyus pa'i byed lhagazhi bdag gis sdongs grogs mdzad pa'i 'bras bu yin par bsama'adug mda' rtsed kyang nyin dang po ste tshes ba— bdun la mjug rdzogasamathub na/ tshes bco brgyad dang bcu dgur yang mu mthud du 'phangs chog pa lags/bzhi ba/ glu len gar rtsed/sde ba phan tshan bar 'gran pa'i mda' rtsed kyi rgyal pham kho thag ma chod kyang mda' ba tshos dros ja 'thungs rjes mda' 'phen gyi mtsham/sa bzhag ste/glu len gar rtsed kyi 'go rtsom pa yin/ glu len gar rtsed bgyid pa de yang sde ba 'di'i pho gsar tsho dang sde ba gan gyi ma sru tshol bar phan tshan glu len 'granasdur byed pa zhig yin/ glu ba dang glu ma gang yin yang thog mar rgyan gos kyi bzang ngan 'gran pa dang / de'i 'phror skad dang ngag gi bzang ngan 'gran pa/ mtha' mar glu'i mang nyung 'gran pa'i dpe yod/ gal srid mo gsar skye gzugs yag la skad ngag kyang snyan zhing 'jebs pa zhig yin na'ang glu kha ma/tshar dang shags/ la gzhas sogs mang po med tshe rgyal kha mi lon zhing dga' rtags ang dang po yang lon pa'i dpe mi srid/ pho gsar yin na'ang gcig mtshungs yin/ skad ngag glu gsum yongs gam 'dzoms na rgyal kha len pa'i thabs ma mchis/ de bas sde ba so so'i glu ba dang glu ma rnams kyisalab rtse chab ril la nye ba'i skabs su/ phyugs rjes dang ngal rtsol gyi khom skabs sa glu rta mang po dang / glu tshig mang por sbyangs pa byed kyin yod/448

a mdo chab 'gag yul gyi dus ston lab rtse chab ril/galate glu bslu masayin yang labartsechabariladu glu lenagar rtsed kyi rgyalakhablang4pa na/ bstod pa'i bsngagayobarjod yang yang byed par ma zad/ sde bsadaga' rtagasakyi gosaling btagasanasagazhan langomapadang / glu ba dang glu ma'i mtshanasnyanayang chab 'gag yuladu lhang lhabadu khyab ngesayin/gal srid glu len gar rtsed skabasasuphamakhastongasan mitshosaglu bag ge mozhig lab rtse chab ril du glu blangasan4pham song zhesapa'igatam nganaphyogasabazhir rlung rtar gragasangesayinapas/ mirang gi largya shor bar mazad sde ba de'i largya shor ba'i bshad lugasakyang yod/ spyir btang du sde ba gang gi glu ba dang glu mayin rung / dusatshod gnyisagasum la len resabyasapasamajug rdzogasadaka' mo 'dug glu ba dang glu ma phul byungacan zhig yin phyin/ phan tshun bar nyin zhag gnyisarer lenaresabyasakyang blangasami tshar la/ da dung glu ba glu ma la la zhig ni blangasate tshar rgyu med pa'i mdzod ltabu zhig go /glu len gar rtsed kyi rim pa yang thog mar glu kha mtshar gyisa'ago brtsar/sate/ rimagyisaglu shagasartsed rig sogasaphan tshun blangasashing 'khrab nasadusachod gcig ya4ma4kyi skabasasu/ la gzhasa'athen pa'i 'go rtsom pa yin/ la gzhasala'ang 'go rtsomapa'i skor dang / mthun pa'i skor/ dran pa'i skor/ bde mo'i skor bca4yod la/ rgan gzhon su yin yang la gzhasal nyan 'dod shin tu che zhing / khyad par du skad ngag ldan pa'i glu ba glu ma4blangasapa'i la gzhasal nyan 'dod de la4kyang che/ galasrid glu ba glu masal gzhasablangasate mthun pa'i skabasasuslebasapa'i tshe/ phan tshun kha 4༵gar

ya mdo chab 'gag yul gyi dus ston lab rtse chab ril/gal te glu ba glu mas yin yang la brtse chab ril du glu len gar rtsed kyi rgyalakhablangs pa na/ bstod pa'i bsngags brjod yang yang byed par ma zad/ sde bas dga' rtags kyi gos ling brtags nas gzhan la ngom pa dang / glu ba dang glu ma'i mtshan snyan yang chab 'gag yug du lhang lhang du khyab nges yin/gal srid glu len gar rtsed skabs sa pham kha myangs na na tshos glu ba ga ge yo zhig la ba rtse chab ril du glu blangs nas pham song zhes pa'i gtam ngan phyogs bzhir rlung rtar grags nges yin pas/ charang gi la rgya shor bar ma zad sde ba de'i la rgya shor ba'i bshad lugs kyang yod/ spyir btang du sde ba gang gi glu ba dang glu ma yin rung / dus tshod gnyis gsum la len res byas pas mjug rdzogasadaka' mo 'dug glu ba dang glu ma phul byung can zhig yin phyin/ phan tshun bar nyin zhag gnyis rer len res byas kyang blangs mi tshar la/ da dung glu ba glu ma la la zhig ni blangs te tshar rgyu med pa'i mdzod lta ku zhig go /glu len gar rtsed kyi rim pa yang jog mar glu kha ma tshar gyis 'go brtsam/sa te/ rim gyis glu shags rtsed rig sogs phan tshan blangs shing 'jib nas dus tshod gcig yas mas kyi skabs su/ la gzhas 'dren pa'i 'go rtsom pa yin/ la gzhas la'ang 'go rtsom pa'i skor dang / mthun pa'i skor/ dran pa'i skor/ bde mong skor bcas yod la/ rgan gzhon su yin yang la gzhasal nyan 'dod shin tu che zhing / khyad par du skad ngag ldan pa'i glu ba glu ma sablangs pa'i la gzhas la nyan 'dod de las kyang che/ gal srid glu ba glu mas la gzhas blangs te mthun pa'i skabs sa slebs pa'i tshe/ phan tshun kha bkar 449

mtsho sngon po'i 'gram rgyud kyi 'brog pa'iganyen srol skor rags tsam gleng ba/zhang 'ga' resabarjed song zer/ yang 'ga' resabor btang zer nasa.azhang tsho4bu ras mabyin tshe/ azhang 'drud pa'i 'go 'artsamasate gral bar du rgyugasanasa.azhang rnamayodang 'dzin resabyed cing / galate gzhang re gnyi4sgor drud tshe largya shor 0yin/ de ltar rtsed mo sna tshogasartse rjesadamangasaglu blangasate gcig gisagacig laglu'i ltaba'am bsum byed pa yin la/ de yang glu 'go ma ni 'di ltaste/ jo ser po yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /bzo rgyal pi sha garma4bzhengs/ / lham ring rnamasadrug sbyin bdag byas/ / lhashākya thub pasarab gnasamadzad/ / jo byin rlabasache ba de don red/ /logacig gi lochang kham pa 'di/ / gling gi seng lcam 'brug mosabasnyal/ / gling yang rtul bdun gyisasbyin bdag byas/ / gling seng chen rgyal posarab gnasamadzad/ / bod dpa' rtsal che ba de don red/ / ltabu sogasablangasanasaja yun tsama'agor ba'i rjesasu.azhang gi gralanasakyang glu ba skad ngag yang4pa zhig gis/ ri mthon po yod na dma' mo byos/ / nga bya rgyalakhyung chen 'phur rgyu yin/ / ming chung sring chung bkar yag byos/ /ngasasrid pa'i glu rgan len rgyu yin zhesabarjod mthag tshang ma phyogasasosor 'thor nasango mibasrung bam gtogasamanyamagacig tu mi'adug dusader gnyen tshang rgan pozhig gis/ yad thomabu bzung ste chu la'agro na/ sta re bzung nasanag4la'agro na gnang babyin payin zer ba na/ pho mozung gisalagazha4len resabyed 'go rtsomapadang/ dang po 'go rtsom pa'i skor/gnyi4pa mthunapa'i skor/ gsum pa rogasadran pa'i skor/ bzhi ba 4༵pyal

mtsho sngon po'i 'gram rgyud kyi 'brog pa'i gnyen srol skor rags tsam gleng ba/zhang 'ga' res brjed song zer/ yang 'ga' res bor btang zer nasasprizhang tshos bu ras ma byin tshe/ gzhang 'drud pa'i 'go 'a rtsams te gral bar du rgyugs nas gzhang rnams dang 'dzin res byed cing / gal te gzhang re gnyis sgor drud tshe la rgya shor ba yin/ de ltar rtsed mo sna tshogs rtse rjesadamangs glu blangs te gcig gis gcig la glu'i lta ba'am bsam byed pa yin la/ de yang glu 'go ma ni 'di lta ste/ jo ser po yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /bzo rgyal pi sha karmas bzhengs/ / lha tshe ring rnams drug spyin bdag byas/ / lha sha kya thub pas rab gnas mdzad/ / jo byin rlabs che ba de don red/ /lo gcig gi lo chang kham pa 'di/ / gleng gi seng lcam 'brug mosabasnya la/ /gling yang rtul bdun 1sa spyin bdag byas/ / gling seng chen rgyal pos rab gnas mdzad/ / bod dpa' rtsal che ba de don red/ / lta bu sogs blangs nas ja yun tsam 'gor ba'i rjes sa a zhang gi gral nas kyang klu ba skad ngag yangs pa zhig gis/ ri ma thon po yod na dma' mo byos/ / nga bya rgyal khyung chen 'phur rgyu yin/ / ming chung sring chung bkar yag byos/ /ngas da pa'i glu rgan len rgyu yin zhes brjod ma thag tshang ma phyogs so sor 'thor nas ngo mi bsrung ba ma gtogs mnyam gcig tu mi 'dug dus der gnyen tshang rgan po zhig gis/ bod thom bu bzung ste chu la 'gro na/ sta re bzung nas nags la 'a rgo na gnang ba byin pa yin zer ba na/ pho mo zung gisal gzhas len res byed 'go rtsom pa dang/ dang po 'go rtsom pa'i skor/gnyis pa mthun pa'i skor/ gsum pa rogs dran pa'i skor/ bzhi ba 'gal 461

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i skor/ lngab bde mo'i skor bcasablangasate dgun nam ring mo('brog pa'i gnyen ston mang che shosadagun khar byed pa yin/ rgyu mtshan ni dbyar stonadapyid gsumalaru spobasatshang mamanyamagacig tu med)skyelangesayin/dgong mochu chod bcu yasamasasulo na mtho ba'i rgan pa rnamasakyisangalagasob yin/ gsar bu gsar motshosanamamagasalabar du la gzhasalen resabyasate rgyal phamagyi dbye ba thag gisagacod pa red/ phyi nyin gyi nyi mar sto na chung zer ba.anang rnamasalagosadang dar gyisardzong babyasate bag ma dang azhang rnamasaphyir rang yulagyi lamalachasashing / gnyen tshang gi4bkra shisapa'i kha g.yang sgrog bzhin dpag tshad gcig gi sar skyelam byasate kha gyesapa yin/ de'i rjesakyi logacig gamayang na zla ba'aga'i nang bu momyur du bskyal te bu moganasayuladu gzhi 'dug byed pa dang azhang tshang gi4mag pa mag 'bod byed par yang yulamire 'gasabaskyalab na gnyen ston chung chung re byed/ de ltar rim gyisabu dang bu mo btsasanasakhyim tshang de'i mna' ma'am ṭ+wāsdesdi mor gyur te 'tsho baphun sumatshogasapar rolanasatshe mjug skyong ba 462

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i skor/ lnga ba bde mo'i skor bcas blangs te dgun nam ring mo('brog pa'i gnyen ston mang che shos dgun khar byed pa yin/ rgyu mtshan ni dbyar ston dbyed gsum la ru spobs tshang ma mnyam gcig tu med)skyel nges yin/dgong mo chu tshod bcu yas mas su lo na mtho ba'i rgan pa rnams kyisang la gsob yin/ gsar bu gsar mo tshos nam ma gsal bar du la gzhas len resabyas te rgyal pham gyi dbye ba thag gis gcod pa red/ phyi nyin gyi nyi mar sto na chung zer ba gzhang rnams la gos dang dar gyis rdzong ba byas te bag ma dang azhang rnams phyir rang yul gyi lam la chas shing / gnyen tshang gis bkra shisapa'i kha g.yang sgog bzhin dpag tshad gcig gi sar byel ma byas te kha gyes pa yin/ de'i rjes kyi logacig gam yang na zla ba 'ga'i nang bu mo myur du bskyal te bu mo gnas yul du gzhi 'dug byed pa dang gzhang tshang gis ma ga pa mag 'bod byed par yang byed cha re 'gas bskyal ba na gnyen ston chung chud re byed/ de ltar rim gyis bu dang 6 mo btsas nas khyim tshang de'i mna' ma'am bdag mor gyur te 'tsho ba phun sumatshogs par rol nas tshe mjug skyong ba yin no/ /462

mtsho sngon po'i 'gram rgyud kyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar rol stangs/ces:sngo ——rwa spyo 11ma na 'a 'gram rgyud kya 'a ga pa'i lo gsar nol stangs/dang po/ lo gsar ma thon gong gi gra sgrigalo gsar ni 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab mang po dang shi rigs mang por thun mong du dar ba'i lo gcig gi ches 'du 'dzi che ba'i dus ston rgya r+ṣa po zhig yin/ 'u cag bod kyi kha dper/ gos yag pa yong na drug pa'i glu rol la gon/ zas zhim po yod na bod kyi lo gsar la zo/ zer ba ltar lo gsar gyi snga rol tu tshang ma/sa rdul sprug gam dud 'phyag rgyag pa sogs kyi gtsang sbra byed nges yin/ de be+e bod lo'i mas pa bcu dgu'am nyer dgu ste/ de gnyisagang rung la dud 'phyag brgyab chog de las zhan da dung khyim gyi do cha stomasasgrig dang thab ka bsang khri sogs ji mdzes je legs sa gtong dgos/ lo de'i lo lha shar lho nub byang gang du yo da pa gsal bor bltas rjes lo lha mi gnas sar dud 'phyag gi gad snyigs pho ba dang de'i steng du kha lag bgrusanas lo gcig gi mi gtsang ba mtha' dag legs par 'dag pa byed cing / mi la na tsha dang phyugs la god kha mi 'byung ba'i bkra shis rten 'brel yang yang brjod pa yin/ nyi shu gcig gnyis nas bzung go re btso ba dang go re sreg pa/463

mtsho sngon po'i 'gram rgyud kyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar rol stangs/mtsho sngon po'i 'gram rgyud kyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar rol stangs/dang po/ lo gsar ma thon gong gi gra sgrigalogasar ni 'dzam gling gi rgyalakhab mang po dang mirigasamang por thun mong du dar ba'i lo gcig gi chesa'adu 'dzi che ba'i dusaston rgya chen po zhig yin/ 'u cag bod kyi kha dper/ gosayag pa yod na drug pa'i glu rol lagon/ zasazhim poyod nabod kyi lo gsar lazo/ zer ba ltar lo gsar gyi snga rol tu tshang masardul sprug gam dud 'phyag rgyag pa sogayokyi gtsang sprabyed nge4yin/ de ni bod lo'i tshesapa bcu dgu'am nyer dgu ste/ de gnyisagang rung la dud 'phyag brgyab chog de lasazhan da dung khyimagyi do cha snyomayosgrig dang thab ka bsang khri sogasaje mdzesaje legasasugatong dgos/ lo de'i lo lhathar lhonub byang gang du yod pagasarabor bltasarje4lolhamigan4sar dud 'phyag gi gad snyig4pho ba dang de'i steng du kha lag bkrusanasalo gcig gi migatsang ba mtha' dgalegasapar 'dag pa byed cing / mil na tsha dang phyug4la god khami'abyung ba'i bkra shisarten 'brel yang yang brjod pa yin/ nyi shu gcig gnyisanasabazung go re btso ba dang go re hūṃsna pa/

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sha btso ba/ zhun phrug pa sogs bya/ zas rigs de tsho'i khrod nas ches khyad par ba ni zhun dang rgyal po gnyis yin/ zhun ni gco bo mar dang gro ma/sil dmar rgun 'brum bcas las grub pa'i 'brog pa'i zas rigs gal chen zhig yin/ der che 'bring chung gsum sna tshogs yod/ che ba ni skang lta bu dang / chung ba ni dkar yol gyi che chung tsam cho// / rgyal po zhes pa ni gro phye yis las pa'i go re'i rigs shig yin la dbyibs la zlum po dang rgya gram gyi dbyibs/ de'i steng du me tog dang ri mo sna tshogs phab yod pa'i go re khyad par ba zhig yin/ bod lo'i nyi shu dgu'i dgong mor dgu thug gam dgu rdzong skol ba la sna kha dgu nges par du tshang dgos pa dang dkar yol dgu 'thung dgos te/ ma 'thungs tshe gshin rje chos rgyal rgya mar tshad du yo nga na rgya kha r+shalong zhes pa'i ngag rgyun gyi gtam rgyud gson nyams ldan pa zhig kyang yo da pa red/gnyis pa/ lo gsar ches gcig gi cho gnam gung ste chu tshod bcu gnyis la thon ma thag nas khyim tshang phal che ba zhig gis bsang phud de lo gsar gyi mdzad sgo thog ma ste dkar yol 'brug ma'i nang la'o ja dkar po'i khar 'bri mar ser po 'phangs nas/ bza' mi tshang mas mnyam gcig tu zhogs ja 'thung 'go rtsom/ de nas gos 'u gsar ba gyon zhing lo gsar ru nyul la 'gro ba'i 'go rtsom pa dang / 'brog pa tshor mtshon na nyal gnon rgyag pa zer ba zhig yod la de ni nangs snga mor sa tshang langs med na de tshang la bkra shis pa'i khag yang sgog bzhin song nas khyim 464

gcod pa don grubadang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sha btso ba/ zhun ldug pa sogasabya/ zas rigasade tsho'i khrod nasachesakhyad par ba ni zhun dang rgyal poganyi4yin/ zhun ni gtso bo mar dang gro ma/siladamar rgun 'brumabacasalasagrub pa'i 'brog pa'i zasarigasagal chen zhig yin/ der che 'bring chung gsumasnatshogasayod/ che ba ni slang ltabu dang / chung ba ni dkar yolagyi che chung tsam mo/ / rgyalapo zhesapa ni gro phye yisalasapa'i go re'i rigasashig yin ladabyibasalazlum po dang rgya gram gyi dbyibs/ de'i steng du metog dang ri posnatshogs phab yod pa'i go re khyad par ba zhig yin/ bod lo'i nyi shu dgu'i dgong mor dgu thug gam dgu rdzong skol ba lasna khadagu ngesapar du tshang dgo4pa dang dkar yol dgu 'thung dgosate/ ma'athungasatshe gshin rje chosargyal rgya mar tshad du yong na rgya kha mi~Xng zhesapa'i ngag rgyun gyi gtam rgyud gson nyamasaldan pa zhig kyang yod pa da/ gnyis pa/ lo gsar ches gcig gi cho gnamagung ste chu tshod bcu gnyisal thon mthag na4khyim tshang phal che ba zhig gisabasang phud de lo gsar gyi mdzad sgo thog ma ste dkar yola'abrug ma'i nang la'o ja dkar po'i khar 'bri mar ser po 'phangasanas/ bza' mitshang masamanyamagacig tu zhog4ja 'thung 'go rtsom/ de nasagosalwa gsar ba gyon zhing lo gsar ru nyul la 'gro ba'i 'go rtsom pa dang / 'brog pa tshor mtshon na nyalaganonargyag pa zer ba zhig yod la de ni nangasasnga mor sutshang ladī~Xmed na de tshang labakra shi4pa'i khagayang sgrog bzhin song nasakhyim

mtsho sngon po'i 'gram rgyud kyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar rol stangs/tshang kha shas de kha skyengs par khrug pa de yin/ lo gsar ru nyul du 'gro ba'i 14:rdo /de sngo (pe /zhe /tha /sgo/re rjes rngon ma nga na ma gsar bu dag na nga / gsar gas yos jin g.yin na go re rgyal po khyer ba yin zhing / 'tsho ba'i cha byen je legasasusong ba dang bstun nas chang dam dang ja bag ka ra rdo/ lcags krin sogasakhyer ba yin te khyim tshang gang la thon na der glu len gar rtsed dang gtam bshad pa sogs rtsed mtshar ga tshogs la rol ba yin/ de nas nyi ma rim gyisashar ba na/ byes pa tsho 'gro ba'i dus yin te byis pa dzo lo gsar gyi legayoskyes go re rgyal po yin la/ phyir byis pa tshor ka ra dang shog sbag rtsed chas sogs ster ba yin/ tshes pa gnyis gsum la slebs tshe bud med rnamasaphan tshun la lo gsar du 'gro ba yin no/ /gsum pa/ byis pa'i mnol ston/tshes gsum gyi nyin sa tshang gi byis pa lo gsum la bud na der ston mo chung chung re byed pa yin/ tshes gsum gyi skya rengs bkyags ma thag rgan po lo 'o na kha gtsang mgo gtsang zhig gis byes pa'i skra bzhar te ral ba 'jog pa yin/ kha dper/ dmag char la ba can/ dmag rta tham ka can zer ba ltar/ ral ba ma gtogs tshang ma bzhar te ras thum la bcug nas byis pa rang gi lwa ba'i ltag rgyab la btsem/ byis pa'i skra der mnol skra zer/ nyin der yang cung 'du 'dzi che zhing byis ston gyi legs skyes sogs mang po a yong / mjug mthar lo lon rgan po des kha g.yang 'bod pa yin la/ dper na/ a btsan gyi rtse mo dgung dang mnyam/ phyugs kyi ru ma sal khyab/465

mtsho sngon po'i 'gram rgyud kyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar rol stangs/tshang kha shasade kha skyengasapar 'jug pa de yin/ logasar ru nyuladu 'gro ba'i go rim ni sngon ma gsar bu dag yin zhing / lo gsar gyi legasaskye4sasngon chadayin na go re rgyalapo khyer ba yin zhing / 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen je legasasusong ba dang bstun nasachang dam dang ja bag ka ra rdo/ lcagasakrin sog4khyer ba yin te khyim tshang gang la thon na der glu len gar rtsed dang gtamabashad pa sogasartsed mtshar snatshogasalarolab yin/ de nasanyi marim gyisashar ba na/ byis pa tsho 'gro ba'i du4yin te byisapa tsho'i lo gsar gyi legasaskyesani go re rgyal po yin la/ phyir byisapa tshor ka ra dang shog sbag rtsed chagasogasaster ba yin/ tshesapa gnyisagasumal slebasatshe bud med rnamasaphan tshun la lo gsar du 'gro ba yin no/ /gsum pa/ byis pa'i mnol ston/tshesagasum gyi nyin sutshang gi byisapa lo gsumal bud na der ston mo chung chung re byed pa yin/ tshesagasum gyi skya reng4bkyag4ma thag rgan po lo lon kha gtsang mgo gtsang zhig gi4byisapa'i skubazhar te ralab 'jog pa yin/ khadaper/ dmag miral ba can/ dmag rta tham ka can zer ba ltar/ ral ba mgatogasatshang mabazhar te rasathum labacug nasabyisapa rangagi waba'i ltag rgyab la btsem/ byisapa'i skra der mnolaskra zer/ nyin der yang cung 'du 'dzi che zhing byisaston gyi legasaskyesasogasamang po khyer yong / mjug mthar lolon rgan po desakha g.yang 'bod pa yin la/ dper na/ khyod btsan gyi rtse modagung dang mnyam/ phyugasakyi ru masa~Xṭ+wāṃb/

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rlung rta rta rgod rgyug rgyug khalasamelce 'bar 'bar/ dgra ltabu yug 'tshuga'atshub/ chosaskyong ser ba 'baba'abab/ mi brgya'i mgo nasa'adug cing/cho4brgya'i gleg4bama'adon na/ bcosapa'i bya lamal 'gro/ dran pa'iblolamal 'gro zhesapaltabu'i bkra shisakyi khagayang bar snang khengasapa sgrog go/bzhi ba/ rgan po'i gya ston/rgan po'i gya ston de yang tshesapagasumadang bcu gsum la byed pa yin/de ni rgan po'am rgan mode tshe lomathar phyin te chung dar gzhon gsum lalogayang ster ba'i bkra shisapa'i nyin moyin/ rgan po'am rgan mo lobadun cu zad na4brgyad cu gya gcig la slebasatshe brgyad cu'i gya ston byed pa yin/ gya ston ni mim gcig gi mjug mtha'i ston yoyin/ spyir bod mizhig yin na thog mar btsasaston/ bar du mnolaston/ tha mar gnyen ston/ tha ma'i tha mar gya ston bca4go rim bzhi brgyud dgoyopa red/ gya ston gyi rgan pa de tshor mtshon na snga mo nasaskyadang khaspu bzhar/ wagasar ba gyon/ tshil len dkar po gyon/ ska rags sngon pobacings/ dbu laphying zhwa gyon/ rkang lalham chen shur ma'i yub la/ lhamasgrog dmar po4mtha' brgyan bya4pa gyon tesrid pa rgan po'am rgan mozhesapa 'di min na gang yin snyam pa'i blo dbang med du skyesa'ong ba zhig byed/ chung dar gzhon gsum kun gyisabakra shisapa'i bstod glu4ltab byed cing / skor ba byasate phyag 'tshal/ gya ston gyi lo lon desatha mar logayang kyi kha g.yang 'bod pa ste/ ya/ byisapa tsho 'dab lag rgya4pa'i bkra shisashog gzhon pa rnamasatshe thag ring ba'i bkra shisashog466

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rlung rta rta rgod rgyug rgyug kha las tshe lce 'bar 'bar/ dgra lha bu yug 'tshuba'atshub/ chos skyong ser ba 'bab 'bab/ mi brgya'i mgo nas 'dugacing/chos brgya'i glegs bam 'don na/ bcos pa'i bya lam la 'gro/ dran pa'idz+ralam la 'gro zhes pa lta bu'i bkra shis kyi kha g.yang bar snang khengs pa sgog go/bzhi ba/ rgan po'i gru ston/rgan po'i rgya ston de yang tshes pa gsum dang bcu gsum la byed pa yin/de ni rgan po'am rgan mo de tshe lo mthar phyin te chung dar gzhon gsum lalogayang ster ba'i bkra shis pa'i nyin mo yin/ rgan po'am rgan mo lo bdun cu zad nas brgyad cu rgya gcig la slebs ma brgyad cu'i gya ston byed pa yin/ khya ston ni mi tshe gcig gi mjug mtha'i ston mo yin/ spyir bod mi zhig yin na thog mar btsas ston/ bar du mnol ston/ tha ma ra gnyen ston/ tha ma 'i tha mar rgya ston bcas go rim bzhi brgyud dgos pa red/ gya ston gyi rgan pa de tshor mtshor na snga mo nas skra dang kha spu bzhar/ lwa gsar ba gyon/ tshil len dkar po gyon/ ska rags sngon po bcings/ dbu la phying zhwa gyon/ rkang la lham chen shur ma'i yub la / lham sgog dmar pos mtha' brgyan byas pa gyon te srid pa rgan po'am rgan yo zhes pa 'di min na gang yin snyam pa'i blo dbang med du skyes 'ong ba zhig byed/ chung dar gzhon gsum kun gyis bkra shisapa'i bstod glus ltab byed cing / skor ba byas te phyag 'tshal/ rgya ston gyi 'o lon des tha mar log yang kyi kha g.yang 'bod pa ste/ ya/ byis pa tsho 'dab lag rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog gzhon pa rnams che thag ring ba'i bkra shis shog466
