gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/:bo tsho spyod sa zu da kya snyan ngag rag pa gal cha ba 'a rang bzhin la rags tsam dpyad pa/thugs dgongs mtha' dbus med pa'i lhal ma dkyil 'khor las/ /ris med 'jo ba'i gsung dbyangs bdud rtse'i gru char gyis/ /bgrang yas gdul bya'i lo tog bu bzhin skyong ba'i mgon/ /mi pham bshes gnyen rnams la gzhar yang snyeng nas 'dud/ /sngon byon mtshungs med mkhas ma/chog dam pa'i ra ba 'a sa/ /legs par khrungs pa'i snyan ngag chu skyes 'dab brgya'i greng / /slar yang skal ldan rkang drug tshogs kyis rol ba'i skabs/ /ldan pa 'bul med srid gsar 'di yi drin min nam// /zhes pa'i tshig gis sngon bsus te/ de yang snyan ngag rig pa zhes pa ni bcu ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'di'i rig gnas che ba lnga'i sgra rig pa'i khongasagagatogs par gsungs shing / rig gnas chung ba lnga 'i a rgyal zhig yin pa dang / gangs can bod kyi rig gnas bang mdzod las ches 'od zer stong ldan 'thoba'i shes bya'i 'jug sgo zhig yin la/ 'dzam gling yongs kyi rig gnas rgya mtsho las dar rgya shin tu che ba'i rig gnas kyi bye brag cig kyang yin/468

bod kyi snyan ngag rig pa gal che ba'i rang bzhinal rags tsam dpyad pa/snyan ngag ce4pa ni rna bar snyan zhing yid 'phrog pa dang spronyamasaldan pa'i tshig sbyor la zer zhing / snyan ngag gi bstan bcosa'adi gna' dusakyi rgya gar gyi snyan ngag mkhan chen po rnamasalasamached cing / phyisasasnyan ngag pa chen po slob dpon daṇ+ḍi ste dbyug pa can gyisasnyan ngag melong brtsams/ de ni lostong gcig sum brgya'i sngon gyi bod rgyalasrong btsan sgam po dang dusamanyam yin par grags/ da lta'i yan la lobadun brgya lhag phyin pa'i 'gro mgon chosargyal 'phag4pa'i sku ring la lo tsā ba chen po shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyisaparnyi ta k+ṣim ka ra'i mdun nasasnyan ngag melong thog mar bod yig la bsgyur ba yin zhing / de'i rjesasudapang lo tsā ba blogrosabartan pa'i zhal snga na4'gyur bcosacung zad dang 'chad nyan legasapar mdzad pa dang /de'i phyisasu rim gyi4dusaskabasasoso'i ring la/ zur mkhar ba/ snar thang lotsā ba/ zha lu lo chen/ dpa' bo gtsug lag pa bca4gang gi zla med mkhasadabang rnam4kyi4rgya dpe dang bstun nasa'agyur bcosalegasapar mdzad cing tshad ldan gyi 'grel ba dang nyamasalda na gyi dper brjod pa bgrang gisamilang ba brtsamayote mig ldan skye bo yongasakyi mthong byed kyi spyod yul du gyur yod pa smra ci dgos/snyan ngag rig pa 'di yang spyi tshogasakyi 'phel rgyasadang bstun nasarim gyisadar rgyasasubyung ba zhig yin zhing / spyi tshogasagang layang bkol spyod kyi rnamapa dang khyab gdalagyi chu tshad mi'adra ba ma gtogs/ mang tshogasakyi rig gnasa'atsho ba'i khrod du longasaspyod kyi skal ba gna' nasad ༵༵ du

ke rge rang bzhin la rags tsam dpyad pa/snyan ngag ces pa ni rna bar snya na zhing yid 'phrog pa dang sgo nyams ldan pa'i tshig spyor la zer zhing / snya na ngag gi bstan bcos 'di gna' dus kyi rgya gar gyi snyan ngag mkhan chen po rnams las ma ched cing / phyis sa snya na ngag pa chen po slob dpon daṇ+ḍi ste dbyug pa can gyis snyan ngag ste long brtsams/ de ni lo sto nga gcig sum brgya'i sngon gyi bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang dusamanyam yin par grags/ da lta'i yan la lo bdun brgya lhag phyin pa'i 'gro ma gon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i sku ring la lo tsā ba chen po shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis pa ni ta khrim ka ra'i mdun nas snyan ngag be+e long thog mar bod yig la bsgyur ba yin zhing / de'i rjes su dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa'i zhal snga nas 'gyur bcos cung zad dang 'chad nyan legs par mdzad pa dang /de'i phyis su rim gyis dus skabs so so'i ring la/ zur mkhar ba/ snar thang lo rnga ba/ zha lu lo chen/ dpa' bo gtsug lag pa bcas gang gi zla med mkhas dbang rnam/sa kyis rgya dpe dang bstun nas 'gyur bcos legs par mdzad cing tshang lda na gyi 'grel ba dang nyams lda na gyi dper brjod pa bgrang gis mi lang ba brtsams te mig ldan skye bo yongs kyi mthong byed kyi spyod yul du gyur yod pa smra ci dgos/snyan ngag rig pa 'di yang spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas dang bstun nasarim gyis dar rgyas sa byung ba zhig yin zhing / spyi tshogs gang la yang bkol spyod kyi rnam pa dang khyab gdal gyi chu tshad mi 'dra ba ma gtogs/ mang tshogasakyi rig gnas 'tsho ba'i khrod du longs spyod kyi skal ba gna' nas da bar du 469

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo cho ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /rgyun chad ma myong zhing / da ltang tsho bod rigs rnams kyi phan tshun gyi tshig sbyor gyi nang du yang dngos sa 'brel 'dug pa gsal ler mthong thub pa ste/dper na/ dmangs khrod kyi sgrung dang gtam dpe/ glu gzhas shagasalasogs pa ji snyed cig byung ba thams cad phal cher snyan ngag dang tshig rgyan gyis bcings yod pa red/ tshig spyor gang yin yang snyan ngag dang tshig rgyanagyis spras na de dag gi don gyi brjod spe ston tshul rnams ma dzes shing gsa'i la klog pa po'i blo yid 'gug thub pa zhig yin la/ snyan ngag gi tshig rgyan sbyoratshul sogs legs par bkol spyod byed shes na/ sngon rabs kyi lo rgyu sa dang rig gzhung rtsom pa sogs la tshig don yid 'phrog pa'i ngag sgo yangs por yang 'byed nus pa red/ de las ldog ste ngag gi sbyor ba gang zhig snyan ngag dang tshig rgyan gyis spras pa legs po ma byung na/ bud med mdzes ma sgren mor rgyu ba'i dpe bzhin/ rang gis bstan bcos legs po zhig rtsom dka' zhing /gal te rtsom rig sna tshogs bris na'ang rna bar snyan zhing 'jibs pa zhig 'byung mi thub pa dang / gzhan gyis brtsams pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos sam yang na snyan ngag gis brgyan pa'i bstan bcos ji snyed pa'i don mi go zhing 'grel mi nus la/ tha na log par go ba dang log par 'grel te don dag kyang log par 'gyur 'gro stabs/ sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyis snyan ngag rig pa'i gal chen rang bzhin la gsung dbyangs sgog pa ni 'di lta ste/470

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyun chad ma myong zhing / da ltang tsho bod rigasarnamasakyi phan tshun gyi tshig sbyor gyi nang du yang dngosasu'abrela'adug pa gsalaler mthong thub pa ste/dper na/ dmang4khrod kyi sgrung dang gtamadape/ glu gzha4shagasal sogasapa ji snyed cig byung ba thamasacad phalacher snyan ngag dang tshig rgyan gyisabacingasayod pa red/ tshig sbyor gang yin yang snyan ngag dang tshig rgyan gyisasprasan de dag gi don gyi brjod bya ston tshularnamasam dzesashing gsal la klog pa po'i blo yid 'gug thub pa zhig yin la/ snyan ngag gi tshig rgyan sbyor tshulasogasalegasapar bkol spyod byed she4na/ sngon rabasakyi lo rgyusadang rig gzhung rtsomapasogasalatshig don yid 'phrog pa'i ngag sgo yangasapor yang 'byed nusapa red/ de lasaldog ste ngag gi sbyor ba gang zhig snyan ngag dang tshig rgyan gyisasprasapa legasapo mabyung na/ bud med mdzesam sgren mor rgyu ba'i dpe bzhin/ rang gisabastan bcosalegasapozhig rtsom dka' zhing /galate rtsomarig snatshogasabrisana'ang rna bar snyan zhing 'jebasapa zhig 'byung mithub pa dang / gzhan gyi4brtsamasapa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcosasam yang na snyan ngag gisabargyan pa'i bstan bcosaji snyed pa'i don migo zhing 'grel minusal/ tha na log par go ba dang log par 'grel te don dag kyang log par 'gyur 'gro stabs/ sngon byon mkhasapa rnamasakyisasnyan ngag rig padī ༵lachen rang bzhin la gsung dbyangasasgrog pa ni 'di ltaste/

/de bodakyilhanangag rig pa gal che ba'i rang bzhin la rags tsam dpyad pa/rgyalapo lang tshosadregasagyur kyang / /rgyan med pa na skye bosagleng / /de bzhin snyan ngag mildan pa'i/ /bstan bcosamakhasalartsigasumed/ /cesapa dang / mkhasapa nyid ni med na blogrosarnamasanyam samirnamasa'atsho ba don yo da min/ / mtshungasamed rgyasapa'i snyan ngag med na mkhasapa nyid ni ne tso'i klog dang mtshungs/ / zhesagasungasaso/ / de ba4nga tshosasnyan ngag rig par mthong chung gi bsam pa'adzin mi rigasapar ma zad slob sbyong gang legasakyisamadzesanyamasaldan zhing go bde ladon dag kyang gsalabor ston thubapa'i rtsomarig sna tshogasabartsamayote/ deng rabasakyi chab srid dang spyi tshogasaring lugasakyi gsar brje dang 'dzugasaskrun/ lhag par du can bzhi mngon 'gyur bcasakyi thad lazhabasa'adegasazhusan phan thogasachen poyod pa red/ yin na'ang nga tsho'i tang gi yang dag pa'i 'go khrid 'og bod mi rigasakyi rig gnasaji snyed pa yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel ba'i sgang la/mibasrun bdud bzhisam rungasamache sder byung rgyaladu bsringasate/ nga tsho'i mirigasakyi rig gnasaladama' 'bebasadang skyon 'dogasagang bsamasgosabakolaspyod kyi rang dbang med par bzosashing re zhig lakhaba'i ljongasa'adi ru bro ba med pa'i sgyur yig 'ga' zhig mthong rgyu mgatogs/ mirigasarang gi mkhasapa rnamasakyi dngosartsom zhig mthong rgyu'i skal bamed pa de dpyod ldan skye bo kun gyi bloyid du mar r+shasgron pa bzhinadu gsalaler mamachi~Xm/

— bod kyi snyanang ga rig pa gal che ba'i rang bzhin la rags tsam dpyad pa/rgyal po lang tshos dregs gyur khrung / /rgyan sked pa na skye bos gleng / /de bzhin snyan ngag mi ldan pa'i/ /bstan bcos mkhas la rtsis su med/ /ces pa dang / ma khas pa nyid ni med na blo gros rnams nyam/sa mi rnamasa'atsho ba don yo da min/ /ma tshungs med rgyas pa'i snyan ngag med na mkhas pa nyid ni ba rol klog dang mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bsang tshosasnyan ngag rig par mthong chung gi bsam pa 'dzin mi rigs par ma zad slob spyong gang legs kyis mdzes nyams ldan zhing go bde la don dag kyang gsal bor ston thub pa'i rtsom rig sna tshogs brtsams te/ deng rabs kyi chab srid dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje dang 'dzugs skrun/ lhag par du can bzhi mngon 'gyur bcas kyi thad la zhabs 'degs zhus na phan thogasachen po yo da pa red/ yin na'ang nga tsho' tang gi yang dag pa'i 'go khrid 'og bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas ji snyed pa yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel ba'i sgang la/mi bsrun bdud bzhis ma rungs mche sder byung rgyal du bsrings te/ nga tshol mi rigs kyi rig gnas la dma' 'bebs dang skyon 'dogs gang bsam sgosabakol spyod kyi rang dbang sted par bzos shing re zhig la kha ba'i ljongs 'di ru bro ba med pa'i sgyur yig 'ga' zhig mthong rgyu ma gtogs/ na rigs rang gi mkhasapa rnams kyi dngos rtsom zhig mthong rgyu'i skal ba med pa de dpyod ldan bye bo kun gyi blo yid du mar tshe sgon pa bzhin du gsal ler ma mchis sam/47/

bod kyi snyan ngag rig pa gal che ba'i rang bzhin la rags tsam dpyad pa/dang drug cu re lnga/ gsumapa labargya dang gya drugaste/ kun bsdusanadrug brgya nga drug yod cing / spyir tshigasabacad larkang pagacig nasadrug bar du yod kyang / da lta'i lugasalarkang pa bzhi langesacan byed pani gomasasrolazhig tu gyur to/ / gzhan yang rkang par latsheg bar mang nyung ci rigasayo da na'ang tsheg bar bdun mdang dgu mdar srolache zhing / tsheg bar nyer bdun yan largyun chagagasamarab bsagasazer mod/ de yang tshig4bcad kyi khongasasugatogasaso/ / de dag tshang mayang lu4dngargyan skyon bsalabacasadon gsumagyisabasdusayod la/ sbyor tshulagyi sgo nasagrolab dang /rigs/ mdzod/ 'du4bzhesabya ba'i dbye ba bzhi mchi4so/ / rgyanalayang thun mong gi rgyan dang thun mong mayin pa'i rgyan gnyisayod cing / de'i snga ma ste thun mong gi rgyan la'ang don rgyan dang / sgra rgyan/ gab tshig gi rgyan rnam4sudabye yod de/ de yang bye brag tudabye na/ don rgyan lasdetshan solngayod ༵ dar+sha / sgrargyan lasde tshan brgyad cu/ gab tshig gi rgyan lasdetshan bcu drug sabhe // ngag/ gi rgyan gang yin na'ang tshang mar mtshan nyid mi'adra ba re yod phyir/ rang rang gi mtshan nyid dang mthun pa'i sgo nasasbyong ba dang dper brjod bkod 'osapa lasagang 'dod kyisadaper brjod bkod pa'i lugasasrolagana' na4da bar du gomasamed mod/ 'on kyang snyan ngag gi 'dzin grwa lasamathar phyin rjes/ rgyan snatshogasakyi mtshan nyid dang mthun pa'i sgo nasartsom rig snatshogasa'abri dgosapa'i ngesapa med cesabanā~X gi

bod kyi snyan ngag rig pa gal che ba'i rang bzhin la rags tsam dpyad pa/dang drug cu re lnga/ gsum pa la brgya dang gya drug ste/ kun bsdus na drug 18/ce /spyo /ba /cobargya nga drug nga / ra sa bcad la rkang bag ga nas drug bar du yod kyang / da tshwa lugs la rkang pa bzhi la nges can byed pa ni goms srorkazhig tu gyur to/ / gzhan yang rkang pa re la tsheg bar mang nyung ci rigs yo da na'ang tsheg bar bdun mdang dgu mdar srol che zhing / a bar nyer bdun yan la rgyun gsas mar ba bsag4zer mod/ de yang tshigs bcad kyi khongs sa gtogs so/ / de dag tshang ma yang lus dang rgyan skyon ba.ā+obacas don gsum gyis bsdus yod la/ spyor phro/ gyi sgo nas grol ba dang /rigs/ mdzod/ 'dus pa zhes bya ba'i dbye ba bzhi mchis so/ / rgyan la yang thun mong gi rgyan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan gnyis yod cing / de'i snga ma ste thun mong gi rgyan la'ang don rgyan dang / sgra rgyan/ gab tshig gi rgyan rnams su dbye yod de/ de yang bye brag tu dbye na/ don rgyan la sde tshan so lnga yod pa dang / sgra rgyan la sde dza brgyad cu/ gab tshig gi rgyan la sdor+sā bcu drug yod do/ /snyan ngag gi rgyan gang yin na'ang tshang mar mtshan nyid ba 'dra ba re yod phyir/ rang rang gi mdza nyid dang mthun pa'i sgo nas sbyong ba dang dper brjod bkod 'os pa las gang 'dod kyis dper brjod bkod pa'i lugs srol gna' nas da bar du goms med mod/ 'on kyang snyan ngag gi 'dzin grwa las mthar phyin rjes/ rgyan sna tshogs kyi mas+dzawī nyid dang mthun pa'i sgo nas rtsom rig sna tshogs 'bri dgos pa'i nges pa med ces bdag gi 473

bod skad bkol spyod byed pa'i thad la lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/bod skad bkol spyod byed pa'i thad la lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/rang rgyal la cha mtshon na mi rigasang drug 'dus pa'i khyim tshang chen po zhig yin/ de dag so sor skad cha mi 'dra ba re yod kyang ye ge yod pa'i mi rigs ni nyung shas yin/ rang re'i bod rigs la mtshon na/ 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas yod par ma zad/ rig gnas kyi lo rgyus ches ringaba'i mi rigs kyi gras su chud yod cing / 'dzam gling steng gi sngon thon yig rigs kyi gras su yang tshad yod/ rang re'i gangs can bod kyi lo rgyus steng gi btsan po rim byon dang mkhas dbang rnam pas lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mong nang du nged cag mi rigs 'di'i rig gnas dang chab srid/ dpal 'byor sogs 'phel rgyas sa gtong ba'i slad du man ma mchis pa'i phyag rjes gnang yod pa las gzhan/ 'dzam gling yongs kyi 'phel rgyas la 'ang mdzad rjesabasu bas kyang sub thabs med pa bzhag yod/ da ltang tshol mdun du ri rab las dpangs mtho zhing rgya mtsho las gting zab pa'i bcu phrag rig gnas kyi glegs bam grangs las 'das pa srungs yod pa 'di thams cad khong rnam pa'i blo rig gi rtsal las thon pa smos ci dgos/ des na khong rnam pa'i rjes skyo nga ba 475

bod skad bkol spyod byed pa'i thad la lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/bod skad bkol spyod byed pa'i thad la lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/rang rgyal lacha mtshon na mirigasang drug 'du4pa'i khyimatshang chen po zhig yin/ de dag sosor skad cha mi 'dra ba re yod kyang yoge yod pa'i mi rigasani nyung shasayin/ rang re'i bod rigasal mtshon na/ 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnasayod par mazad/ rig gnasakyi lorgyusachesaring ba'i mirigasakyi grasasuchud yod cing / 'dzamagling steng gi sngon thon yig rig4kyi grasasuyang tshud yod/ rang re'i gang4can bod kyi lorgyusasteng gi btsan porim byon dang mkhasadabang rnamapasalorgyu4kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i nang du nged cag mirigasa'adi'i rig gnasadang chabasrid/ dpal 'byor sogasa'aphelargyasasugatong ba'i slad du blan mamachisapa'i phyag rjesaganang yod palasagazhan/ 'dzamagling yongasakyi 'phelargyasala'ang mdzad rjesabasubasakyang sub thabasamed pa bzhag yod/ da ltang tsho'i mdun du ri rab la4dpangasamatho zhing rgya mtsho lasagating zabapa'i bcu phrag rig gnasakyi glegasabamagrangasalasa'adasapaspungasayod pa'adi thamasacad khong rnam pa'i blorig gi rtsalalasathon pa smosaci dgos/ desan khong rnamapa'i rjesahūṃ~X ba

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rang rigasagang4can pa zhigal mtshon na/ mirigasarang gi skad dang yiger brten nasasngon byon mkhasadabang bsam gyisamikhyabapa rnamasakyi shulabazhag gi rig gnasabang mdzod 'di dag 'dzin skyong spelagasumabyed pagatsor bzung ste/ deng 'di'i bod rigasasakhulagyi rig gnasadapala'abyor ji ltar 'phel rgyasasugatong ba'i phyir du 'bad 'bungasabyed rgyu ni khyad du 'phagasapa'i 'osa'agan zhig lags/yin na'ang srid pa'i khadaper gser la bslad ma 'dresapamed/ mil skyon mgosapa med zer ba'i dpe bzhin/ dusaskab4shig larang re'i kha ba'i yul gyi ljongasa'adir g.yon lhung lam phyogasakyi shugasarkyen thebasate/mirigasakyi yige dang skad cha bkol spyod byed par bar chad chen po bzosastabs/ bod kyi rig gnasadang skad cha 'dzin spel byed pa'i thad la'ang gnod skyon tshabasachen thebasayod/ nye ba'i bgrang bya 'ga'i ring la rang re'i mi rigasalasha tsha ba'i 'go khrid dang mkhasadabang mi nyung bsatang gi srid jusabazang po'i gzi shugasalabarten nasabod kyi rig gnasadang skad cha 'phel rgya4sugatong phyir 'bad pasabya ba gang legayobasgrubasadang sgrub bzhin yod mod/ 'on te du4yun thung ngu zhig gi nang du nyamasapa thamasacad sngar bzhin slar gsobyed rgyu de lasaslamozhig ga la yin/ da ltang tsho'i bod rigasakyi khrod du bshad bzhin yod pa'i bod skad skor zhig ni ngo ma4blopham pa zhig red/ de yang rim pa gsumadu dbye nasaragasatsam dpyad na/daX ༵'i skor te/ de ni bod skad cung tsam mgatogasabashad mi shesapa'i

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rang rigs gangs can pa zhig la mtshon na/ ba rigs rang gi skad dang yoger brten nas sngon byon mkhas dbang bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams kyi shulabazhag gi rig gnas bang mdzod 'di dag 'dzin skyong bal gsum byed pa gtsor bzung ste/ deng 'di'i bod rigs sa khul gyi rig gnas dpal 'byor ji lhar 'phel rgyas sa gtong ba'i phyir du 'bad 'bungs byed rgyu ni khyad du 'phagasapa'i 'os 'gan zhig lags/yin na'ang srid pa'i kha dper gser la bslad ma 'dres pa med/ mi la skyon ma gos pa med zer ba'i dpe bzhin/ dus skabs shig la rang re'i kha ba'i yal gyi ljongs 'dir g.yon lhung lam phyogs kyi shugs rkyen zebs te/mi rigs kyi ye ge dang skad cha bkol spyod byed par bar chad chen po bzosastabs/ bod kyi rig gnas dang skad cha 'dzin ste spa byed pa'i thad la'ang gnod skyon tshabs chen jebs yod/ nye ba'i bgrang be+e 'ga'i ring la rang re'i mi rigs la sha tsha ba'i 'go khrid dang mkhas dbang mi nyung bas tang gi srid jus bzang po'i gzi shugs la brten nas bod kyi rig gnas dang skad cha 'phel rgyas gagatong phyir 'bad pas be+e ba gang legs bsgrubs dang sgrub bzhin yod mod/ 'on te dus yun thung ngu zhig gi nang du nyams pa thamasacad sngar bzhin slar gso byed rgyu de las ma mo zhig ga la yin/ da lta7nga stong bod rigs kyi khrod du bshad bzhin yod pa'i bod skad skor zhig ni ngo mas blo pham pa zhig red/ de yang rim pa gsum du dbye nas rags tsam dpyad na/dang po'i skor te/ de ni bod skad cung tsam ma gtogs bshad mi shes pa'i 476

bod skad bkol spyod byed pa'i zad la lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/grong par dang grong brdal nas skyes pa'i na gzhon gyi skor yin la/ gsar skyes na gzhon de rigs kyis rgyun par rgya skad khon bshad pa las bod skad tshig gcig kyang ba bshad/ tha na rang gi pha mdang 'brog khul nas yong ba'i nye 'brel rnams la kha brda byed pa'i skabs su yang bod skad tshig 'ga' smra ba las gzhan thams cad rgya skad 'ba' zhig bshad bzhin mchis la/ na gzhon 'di rigs kyis bod skad byung tsam bshad pa'ang bod kyi skad pa' srol ltar 'das ma 'ongs da pa'i 'gyur ldog la mi blta bar rgya skad kyi sro la bzhin brjod kyin 'dug dper na/ ar gas khyod kyis za ma cha zos zhes dris pa na/ lan du za btang zer ba ma gtogs za ma zos btang zhes 'das pa'i byu tshig bkol mi shes/ yang chu khol cha blangs zhes pa na/ chu khod ma blangs mi zer bar chu khol ma brgyab ces pa lta bu/ sprikhu lags khyed kyis chang zhig longs zhes/pa na/ lan du len gi yod mi zer bar longs ki yo/da zer ba lta6/ sder ma ma/dun cog steng khebazhag zer ba'i tshe/ sder ma mdun cog steng 'jog btang zhes pa ma gtogs mdun cog steng bzhag btang zer mi shes/'di 'dra'i ha cang mi 'os pa'i skad cha sna tshogs gang 'dod du brjod pa lasarang nyid kyis skad cha rnam dag cig bshad mi shes pa phar zhog rbad rigs kyi skad cha tshad ldan can du gtong bar yang bslad kyon zebs kyin yo da pa red/gnyis pa'i skor te/ de ni spyir bod skad chung dus sa bshad shes sna kyang khor yug gi rgya rigs dang blud jus dril bsgrags byed ma/khan gyi las byed pa'i shugs rkyen thebs pas/ rgya skad dang bod skad 'dres ma las bshad cha shes477

bod skad bkol spyod byed pa'i thad la lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/grong khyer dang grong brdalanasaskyesapa'i na gzhonagyi skor yinal/ gsar skyesan gzhon de rigasakyisargyun par rgya skad khonabashad pa lasabod skad tshig gcig kyang mibashad/ tha na rang gi pha mdang 'brogakhulanasayong ba'i nye 'brelarnamasalakhabarda byed pa'i skabasasuyang bod skad tshig 'ga' thob la4gzhan thamasacad rgya skad 'ba' zhig bshad bzhin mchi4la/ na gzhon 'di rigasakyisabod skad cung tsamabashad pa'ang bod kyi skad cha'i srolaltar 'dasama'ongasad lta'i 'gyur ldog lamibaltabar rgya skad kyi srol bzhin brjod kyin 'dug dper na/ arogasakhyodakyisaza ma.ezosazhe4drisapa na/ lan du za btang zer bamagatogasaza mazosabatang zhesa'adasapa'i bya tshig bkol mi shes/ yang chu kholachablangasazhesapa na/ chu khol yoblangasami zer bar chu khol mabargyab cesapa ltabu/ akhu lagasakhyed kyisachang zhig longasazhesapa na/ lan du len gi yod mizar bar longasaki yod zer ba ltabu/ sder ma mdun cog steng ebazhag zer ba'i tshe/ sder mamadunacog steng 'jog btang zhesapa mgatogasamadun cog steng bzhag btang zer mishes/'di 'dra'i ha cang mi'osapa'i skad cha sna tshogasagang 'dod du brjod pa lasarang nyid kyisaskad cha rnamadag cig bshad mishesabaphar zhog bod rigasakyi skad cha tshad ldan can du gtong bar yang bslad skyon thebasakyin yo da pa red/gnyisapa'i skor te/ de ni spyir bod skad chung du4subashad she4kyang khor yug gi rgya rigasadang srid jusadrilabasgragasabyed mkhan gyi las byed pa'i shugasarkyen thebasapas/ rgya skad dang bod skad 'dresamalasabashad zlostes

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i skor yin zhing / dper na/ mang tshogasalalas/ nga tshos rwa bshad rgyu na/ da ltatang gi yo ngo yobazang gi tsho'agingacha yang je bzang lasonga'ad gi zhesapa ltabu/ yang bod yig mishesapa'i lasabyed pa la lasatshogasa'adu'i steng gtamabashad pa'i skab4su'ang / nga tsho tshang ma tang krung dbyang gilo.o la༅tho byasate/ tang gi༅yozlosajasmra/1 ༅sobyed dgosapa dang / ༅༅zasngalam 'jog dgo4zer bltabu dang / zhing pa lalasakyangamacho nang na4tsho mang gi ltabu'i skad gnyiyo'adresama'i skad cha rgyun par bshad bzhin mchis/ rgya min bod min gyi skad cha bshad srola'adi phal cher kho tshor gomasayod pa 'dra/ skad cha 'di rigayokyi bshad srol 'disamirig4kyi skad cha rgyuna'adzin 'phelargyasasugatong bar phan nu4med paphar zhog rang rig4kyi skad cha nyamayopar 'gyur ba'i gnod pa chen po bzosayod/ gsumapa'i skor te/ de ni rgya bod yig sgyur gyi ming tshig gsar ba'i rjesam chod par bod skad lashan zhugasapa'i skor yin la/ dper na/marma1khuza larin min te po ltabu dang / salalang pozer ba/ 7〉laphun tho ltabu/ tshololalangamin/ ṣ+ṭhalol go min/ cathul hrig tin ltabu/ mtshilayang hang ltabu rgya skad kyi sgramidag pa'i ming tshig tha snyad 'di dag gisabod skad kyi tshab byasanasarjod pa labartagasan/ rin min te po dang yang hang / hrig nyin ltabur mtshon na/ rgya ming bod labasgyur ba'i ming tshig yod kyang thog mar bkolaba'i skabayosubasgyur ming gtsigasasumabastat+ta ༵'i rkyenagyisade'i rjesam chod par 'brog pa mang tshogasakyi ngag la

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i skor yin zhing / dper na/ mang tshogs la las/ nga ya7 bshad rgyu na/ da lnga tang gi ṣ+ṭhalko ngo ma bzang gi pa' gi tsho lnga yang je bzang lasong yod gi zhes pa lta bu/ yang bod yig mi shes pa'i las byed pa la lasatshogs 'du'i steng gtam bshad pa'i skabs stsal pa / nga tsho tshang ma tang krung dbyang gis la lnga cha byas te/ tang gi lnga7 mtsha1 7/)4oṃ byed dgosapa dang / khra4cha lams 'jog dgos zer ba lta bu dang / zhing pa lalas kyang ba nang na0zlo mang gi lta bu'i skad gnyis 'dres ma'i skad cha rgyun par bshad bzhin mchis/ rgya min bod min gyi skad cha bshad sgo la 'di phal cher kho tshor goms yod pa 'dra/ skad cha 'di rigs kyi bshad srol 'dis mi rigs kyi skad cha rgyun 'dzin 'phel rgyas gagatong bar phan nus med pa phar zhog rang rig4kyi skad cha nyams par 'gyur ba'i gnod pa chen po bzos yod/ gsum pa'i skor te/ de ni rgya bod yig sgyur gyi ming tshig gsar ba'i rjes ma chod par bod skad la shan zhugs pa'i skor yin la/ dper na/ma4sgo la rin min te po lta bu dang / phal lang pho zer ba/ 7〉laphun tho lta bu/ mkhrol lang min/ pu lo la go min/ ra khyel hrig tin ltabu/ tson la yang hang lta bu rgya skad kyi sgra chad ga pa'i ming tshig tha snyad 'di dag gis bod skad kyi tshab byas nas rjod pa la brtags na/ rin min te po dang yang hang / hrig tin lta bur mtshon na/ rgya ming bod la bsgyur ba'i ming tshig yod kyang thog mar bkol ba'i skabs stobasgyur ming gtsigs tshomabazung ba'i byen gyis de'i rjes ma chod par 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi ngag la 478

bod skad bkol spyod byed pa'i thad la lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/lobasasong bsad ltabasgyur 'dod kyang 'gyur dka' bar 'dug gzhan yang go minadabalang min/ phun tho ltabur mtshon na da lta'i bar du bsgyur ming 'osa'atshamasashigamed pa'i dbang gisargya skad kyi rjesa'ajugasamizhugasakyang re zhig thabasamed paltabu red/gzhan yang da ltabod rig4sakhula'aga' zhig lamatshon na/ bod skad bkolaspyod kyi khadabyangasasgrog bamatho zhing / gobyangabatagasapamang yang don la lag bstar byed pa'i khrod du de 'dra'i rbad semasashigamed par mazad/ da dung ji ltar bkolaspyod byed pa'i sgrig srolayang gsalabo zhig 'dzugasathub med pasabya dngosakyi nang du sngar bzhin mirigasagazhan pa'i skad rigasakyi rje4bsnyegasanayo'agro bzhin 'dugagongagasalagyi mi'osapa'i rnamapa 'di dag 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo gang yin zhe na/ de ni phyi rkyen khon lasabyung ba min te/ de yang phyi rkyen dang nang rkyen gnyi4larag lasayod paste/gcig ni/ zhing chen rimapa'i bod yig dang bod skad tshad ldan du gtong ba'i lasakhungasadang ched lasamisnagatan khelayang dag med par brten/ lasarigasasopo'i ming tshig gsar ba'i skor dusathog tubod skad du bsgyur ma thub padang / gzhi rimadu byung ba'i bod skad dag min la'ang zhib 'jug byasate de yobasrang kyang byed mthub pas/ bod skad bkolaspyod kyi thad du tshad ldan min pa'i skad cha gsar bsnatshogasabyung stephyi rabasapar rnyog dra chen po bzo4pared/ 479

— bod skad bkol spyod byed pa'i thad la lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/lobs so nga bsad lta bsgyur 'dod kyang 'gyur dka' bar 'dug gzhan yang go min dang lang min/ phun tho lta bur mar na da smyo bar du bsgyur ming 'os 'tshams shig sked pa'i dbang gis rgya skad kyi rjes 'jug tu cha zhugasakyang re zhig thabs med blta bu red/gzhan yang da lta bod rigs sa khul 'ga' zhig lamatshon na/ bod skad bkol spyod kye kha dbyangs sgog ba mtho zhing / sgo byang brtags pa mang yang don la lag bstar byed pa'i khrod du de 'dra'i rbad sems shig med par ma zad/ da dung ji ltar bkol spyod byed pa'i sgrig srol yang gsal bo zhig 'dzugs thub sted pas bya dngos kyi nang du sngar bzhin mi rigs gzhan pa'i skad rigs kyi rjes bsnyegs nas 'gro bzhin 'a gagong gsal gyi mi 'os pa'i rnam pa 'di dag 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo gang yin zhe na/ de ni phyi rkyen khon las byung ba min te/ de yang phyi rkyen dang nang rkyen gnyis la rag las yod pa ste/gcig ni/ zhing chen rim pa'i bod yig dang bod skad tshad ldan du gtong ba'i las khungs dang ched las mi sna gtan khel yang dag sted par brten/ las rigs so so'i ming tshig gsar ba'i skor dus thog tu bod skad du bsgyur ma thub pa dang / gzhi rim du byung ba'i bod skad dag min la'ang zhib 'jug byas te de yo bsrang kyang byed mthub pas/ bod skad bkol spyod kyi thad du tshad ldan min pa'i skad cha gsar ba sna tshogs byung ste phyi rabs par rnyog dra r+ṣa po bzos ba red/479

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnyisani/ nged cag bod rigasakyi khrod du 'go khrid che chung skor zhig gisatshogasa'adu che ma chung gsumagang yin yang stegasabu'i steng du gtam bshadaganang ba'i skabasasurgya skad labyang cha yod kyangarung med kyang rung skad cha bshad yulal migazigasapar rgya skad khon bshad padang / mtshamasamatshamasasubod dang bod la'aphrad de khabarda byed pa'i skabasasu'ang rgya skad bshad pa/ tha na bod rang nyid kyisabashad pa'i rgya skad kyi gtam yang bod skadal sgyur du 'jug par brten/ gzhi rimalasabyed pa phalab skor zhig gisakyang namargyun rang gi mirigasakyi skad cha bkol spyod mi byed par rgya skad bshad par shin tu spro ba dang / galate bod skad bshad na'ang rgya bod 'dresama'i skad cha bshad pa ma gtog4tshad ldan gyi bod skad cig bshad mi shes/mide dag gi bsamapar bod yig dang bod skad labakolaspyod kyi nusapa med bsamasate der mthong chen byed kyin med pasaso/ /gsumani/ rang re'i bod rigasapha ma skor zhig gisarang gi bu dang bu mor rgya yig khon slob tu 'jug pa dang / bod skad tshig gcig kyang ma shesan ngo miganong zhing / da dung gzhan gyi yig rigasadang skad cha de mtho sar 'jog pa dang / rang gi mirigasakyi rig gnasadang skad char mthong chung byed pa'i gnasatshulayang med pa ma yin/ 'di'i phyogasasukun gzigasachen mo paṇa chen rin pochesang tshor gsung bshad gal chen gnang yo da/khong gisabod rigasashig yin phyin thog mar rang gi skad dang yige byang chub parwa zungasapa'i rmang gzhi'i steng du gzhan mirigasakyi yig rigasadang skad

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/—byedaganyis ni/ nged cag bod rigs kyi khrod du 'go khrid che chung skor zhig gis tshogs 'du che ma chung gsum gang yin yang stegs bu'i steng du gtam bshad gnang ba'i skabs sa rgya skad la byang cha yod khrung rung med kyang rung skad cha bshad yul la migazigs par rgya skad khon bshad pa dang / mtshamasamatshams su bod dang bod la 'phrad de kha brda byed pa'i skabs su'ang rgya skad bshad pa/ tha na bod rang nyid kyis bshad pa'i rgya skad kyi gtam yang bod skad la sgyur du 'jug par brten/ gshi rim las byed pa phal ba skor zhig gis kyang nam rgyun rang gi mi rigs kyi skad cha bkol spyod mi byed par rgya skad bshad par shin tu spro ba dang / gal te bod skad bshad na'ang rgya bod 'dresama'i skad cha bshad pa ma gtogs tshad ldan gyi bod skad cig bshad mi shes/mi de dag gi bsam par bod yig dang bod skad la bkol spyod kyi nus pa med bsams te der mthong chen byed kyin med pas so/ /gsum ni/ rang re'i bod rigs pha ma skor zhig gis rang gi bu da nga su mor rgya yig kho na slob tu 'jug pa dang / bod skad tshig gcig kyang ma shes na ngo mi gnong zhing / da dung gzhan gyi yig rigs dang skad cha de ma tho sar 'jog pa dang / rang gi ba rigs kyi rig gnas dang skad char mthong chung byed pa'i gnas tshutha yang med pa ma yin/ 'di'i phyogs sa kun gzigs don mo paṇa don rin po chesang tshor gsung bshad gal don gnang yo da/khong gis bod rigs shig yin phyin thog mar rang gi skad dang na ge byang chub par byings pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng du gzhan mi rigs kyi yig rigs dang skad 480

/de bodaskadabakol spyod byed pa'i thad la lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/char sbyang dgosazhes gsungasapa ltar/ nged cag mi rabasa'adisarang gi mirigasakyi skad dang yige ma sbya ngasan/ mirabasarjesamasaji ltar rgyun 'dzin byed pa dang / mi rigasa'adi glag rgod bzhin skyod bzhin pa'i deng rabasacan bzhi 'dzugayoskrun byed pa'i khrod du ji ltar mdun du skyod rgyu lags/ da dung deng rabasakyi gsar skyesan gzhon skor zhig gisadusargyun rang gi mirigasakyi skad cha bkol spyod mibyed pa'i rkyen gyisami rigasakyi 'du she4gsal bo med pa dang / mi rigasakyi skad cha'i galachen gyi rang bzhin lago ba zab mo malon pasami rigasarang gi skad smra bar ngo tsha ba'i gnasatshul yang yod pa yin/ gong gsalagyi 'di dag thamasacad phyi rkyen kho na lasabyung ba min zhing / gtso bo nang rkyen lasabyung ba yin pasmosaci dgos/ de'i phyir rang mi rigasakyi skad cha bkol spyod byed na phyi rol gyi cha rkyen leg4po zhig dgosapa rmang gzhi yin yang rang ngosakyi cha rkyen leg4po zhig bskrun mthub na'ang michog mi rigasashig la mtshon na rang mirigasakyi rig gnasadang /chab srid/ dpala'abyor bcasa'aphel rgyasasugatong dgosan mirigasarang gi skad cha bkolaspyod ma byasan mi chog pa'i skor la/ sita lin mchog gisami dmangasamang tshogasakhri 'bumamang posarang gi mi rigasakyi skad cha bkolaspyod bya4na/ da gzod rig gnas dang / chab srid/ dpal 'byor phyogasasuyar thon chen po yong thub cesagasungasayod/ da ltang tsho'i miskor zhig gisami rigasagazhan zhig gi yi ge dang skad rigasalabarten nasarang gi mirigasa'adi skyob rgyu'i kun slong yod pa de don dngosadang mthun pa zhikā ༵/na

bod skad bkol spyod byed pa'i thad la lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/— ————— — ——char byi nga dgos zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nged cag mi rabs 'dis rang gi me+erigs kyi skad dang ⑪ge ma bye ngas na/ mi rabs rjes mas ji ltar rgyun 'dzin byed pa dang / mi rigs 'di glag rgod bzhin spyod bzhin pa'i deng rabasacan bzhi 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i khrod du ji ltar mdun du spyod rgyu lags/ da dung deng rabs kyi gsar skyes na gzhon skor zhig gis dus rgyun rang gi mi rigs kyi skad cha bkol spyod mi byed pa'i rkyen gyis mi rigs kyi 'du shesagasal bo sted pa dang / mi rigs kyi skad cha'i gal chen gyi rang bzhin la go ba zab mo ma lon pas mi rigs rang gi skad smra bar ngo tsha ba'i gnas tshul yang yod pa yin/ gong gas gyi 'di dag thams cad phyi rkyen kho na las byung ba min zhing / gtso bo nang rkyen las byung ba yin pa zos ci dgos/ de'i phyir rang mi rigs kye skad cha bkol spyod byed na phyi dol gyi cha rkyen legs po zhig dgos pa rmang gzhi yin yang rang ngosakyi cha byen legs po zhig bskrun ma thub na'ang mi chog mi rigs shig la mtshor na rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang /chab srid/ dpal 'byor bcas 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos na mi rigs rang gi skad cha bkol spyod ma byas na mi chog pa'i skor la/ 6ta lin mchog gisami dmangs mang tshogs khri 'bum mang pos rang gi mi rigs kyi skad cha bkol spyod byas na/ da gzod rig gnas dang / chab srid/ dpal 'byor phyogasagayar thon chen po yong thub ces gsungs yod/ da ltang tsho'i shi skor zhig gis mi rigs gzhan zhig gi yi ge dang skad rigs la brten nas rang gi mirigs 'di skyob rgyu'i kun slong yod pa de don dngos dang mthun pa zhig gtan 481

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsomaphyogs bsgrigs/na4min/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni nga tsho'i mirigasa'adi'i brgya cha'i brgyad cu nasadagu bcu'i midamangasamang tshogasakyisarang gi yige dang skad cha mgatogasamishesapasamirigayogazhan zhig gi rig gan4dang skad chasaji ltar skyob thub/ tha na phan tshun latshig brda tsam yang mi'aphrod pasan skyob rgyu zer ba de kha stong nang gi tshig stong tsamadu zad pa min nam snyamamo/ /'o na rjesasubod skad bkol spyod ji ltar byed pa'i thad la ltatshul gsar ba ci yod ce na/ kho bor 'di phyogasal bsam tshulado na tshan 'ga' yod pasabarjod par bya ste/dang po/ phyisasumirigasakyi skad yig tshad ldan can du btang ste/mirigasarang gi skad dang yige bkolaspyod legasapo zhig yong bar byed na/thog mar 'di phyogasakyi bya bar gtsigasa'adzin dang len byed pa'i la4khungasadang 'go khrid pa/ ched layomisnabacasamed na mi chog par brten/ ma 'gyangasapar zhing chen du mirigasaskad yig bya ba'i uyon lhan khang 'dzugasadagosapadang / bod rigasarang skyong khuladag gi4kyang mi rigasaskad yig bya ba'i uyon lhan khang 'dzugasadagos/ zhing chen mirigasaskad yig uyon lhan khang lamatshon na/ lasarigayososo'i ming tshig tha snyad gsar ba dag dusathog tu bsgyur te gcig gyur tshad ldan can du gtong ba'i 'gan lci 'khur te/ khul soso'i mi rigasaskad yig gi bya bar gcig gyur gyisa'ago 'dzin dang bkod sgrig byasanas/ mirigasakyi skad dang yige bkolaspyod byedā ṭ+wā'i khrod du gnasapa'i gnad don dang dka' ngalarnamasaci nusakyis

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgogs/nas min/ de'i rgyu mdza ni nga phro ske rigs 'di'i brgya cha brgyad cu nasadagu bcu'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis rang gi ye ge dang skad cha ma gtogasan shes pas mi rigs gzhan zhig gi rig gnas dang skad chas ji ltar skyob thub/ tha na phan a la tshig brda tsam yang shi 'phrod pas na skyob rgyu zer ba de kha sto nga nang gi tshig stong tsam du zad pa min nam snyam mo/ /'o na rjes sa bod skad bkol spyod ji ltar byed pa'i thad la lta1rmya gsar ba ci yo da ce na/ kho bor 'di phyogs la bas ma tshi do na ka 'ga' yod pas brjod par be+e ste/11 /phyo /sgo1de /) /ba /tha /stedang / sag gas skad ga ldan can du btang /ba rigs rang gi skad dang pe ge bkol spyod legs po zhig yong bar byed na/thog mar 'di phyogs kyi be+e bar gtsigs 'dzin dang len byed pa'i las khungs dang 'go khrid pa/ ra las mi sna bcas med na mi chog par brten/ ma 'byangs par zhing s+dzawī du cha rigs skad yig bya ba'i u yon lhan khang tshogasadagos pa dang / bod rigs rang skyong khul dag gis kyang mi rigs skad yig khya ba'i u yon lhan khang 〈gas dgos/ zhing r+ṣa mi rigs skad yig uyon lhan khang la mar na/ las rigs so 0 ming tshig tha snyad gsar ba dag dus thog tu bsgyur te gcig gyur dza ldan can du gtong ba'i 'gan lci 'khur te/ khul so a mi rigs skad yig gi be+e bar gcig gyur gyis 'go 'dzin dang bkod sgrig byas nas/ pi rigs kyi skad dang ye ge bkol spyod byed pa'i khrod du gnas pa'i gnad don dang dka' ngal rnams ci nus kyis482

— bodaskadabakol spyod byed pa'i thad la lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/thag gcod byed pa brgyud de/ mirigasakyi skad dang yege tshad ldan tshulamathun zhig yong ba'i slad du dmigasayulayod pa dang / 'char gzhi yod pa/go rimayod pa'i ngang nasabya ba 'di dayo'adzinalegasapo byed dgosapa red/khulasosor mtshon na'ang rang khuladu mi rigasakyi yige dang skad cha ji ltar bkol spyod byed rgyu'i thad la'achar gzhi legasapo bzosate/ dusargyun du 'brelayod kyi rdzong sosor song nasami rigasakyi skad dang yige lag bsta ra gyi bya bar brtag dpyad zhib 'jug bya4te gnasapa'i gnad don skor duyothog tu thag gcod byayonas/ rang gi mi rigasakyi skad dang yige'i khyad chosaji bzhin 'dzin skyong byed pa dang / rang khul gyi skad yig tshad lda na du gtong bar 'bad 'bungasagang leg4byed dgos/gzhanayang mirigasakyi skad dang yige 'phelargyasasugatong na/ mirigasarang gi skad dang yige bkolaspyod byed pa'i shesaldan mi sna mang poskyed sring byed dgosapar brten/ nga tsho4mirigasaslob gsodar rgya4gong 'phel du gtong ba'i thad 'brelayod sdekhag ladage mtshan ldan pa'i re ba ༵ton ṭ+wāṃ/ mi rigasaslob gso'i malag cha tshang du gtong bar 'bad brtson da da/rnyi/sapa/ rimapa soso'i 'go khrid pa4mirigasakyi yige dang skad cha bkol spyod byed par thugasakhur gnang ste/ dusargyun du bya ba'adir bkod sgrig dang zhib bsher ltaskulabyed padang mtshungasasu/ 'go khrid rang nyid kyisarang dpogazhan ston gyisabod yig dang bod skad bkolaspyotā 8༵ rgyu

—sgo spyod byed pa'i thad la lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/thag gcod byed pa bsgrod de/ mi rigs kyi skad dang a ge tshad ldan tshadamathun zhig yong ba'i slad du dmigs yul yo da pa dang / 'char gzhi yod pa/go rim yod pa'i ngang nas bya ba 'di dam 'dzin legs po byed dgos pa red/khul so/sor mdon na'ang rang khul du mi rigs kyi ⑪ge dang skad cha ji ltar bkol spyod byed rgyu'i thad la 'char gzhi legs po bzos te/ dus rgyun du 'brel yo da kyi rdzong so se ra song nas mi rigs kyi skad dang ye ge lag bsta ra zu bya bar brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas te gnas pa'i gnad don skor dus thog tu thag gcod byas nas/ rang gi mi rigs kyi skad dang ye ge'i byed chos ji bzhin 'dzin skyong byed pa dang / rang khul gyi skad yig byed lda na du gtong bar 'bad 'bungs gang legs byed dgos/gzhan yang mi rigs kyi skad dang ye ge 'phel rgyas sa gtong na/ mi rigs rang gi skad dang yi ge bkol spyod byed pa'i shes ldan mi sna mang po byed sring byed dgos par brten/ nga tsho4mi rigs slob gsod ra rgyas gong 'phel du gtong ba'i thad 'brel yod sdo khag la dge mtshan ldan pa'i re ba bton te/ mi rigs slob gso'i ma lag cha tshang du gtong bar 'bad brtson byed dgos/gnyis pa/ rim pa so ru' 'go khrid pas mi rigs kyi ske ge dang skad cha bkol spyod byed par thugs khur gnang ste/ dus rgyun du bya ba 'dir bkod sgrig dang zhib bsher lta skul byed pa dang mtshungs su/ 'go khrid rang nyid kyis rang dpe gzhan ston gyis bod yig dang bod skad bkol spyod bya rgyu 483

/de/ gcodapadon grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ni shin tu gal che/ gal te bod yig dang bod skad bkol spyod byed pa'i go skabasayong pa'i skabasasurang gi mirig4kyi skad cha bkol spyod gang legasam byasan/ lasabyed pa phal ba dang mang tshogasala'ang de'i shan shugasathebasange4 yin/ 'go khrid pa zhig gisarang skad bkol min de mi gcig gi gnad don lo/ nar thug med cing / de ni rgya che'i lasabyed pa dang mang tshogasathamasacad kyis ji ltar bkol spyod byed pa'i gnad la thug yod par brten/der do sna nga chen po byed dgo4so/ /de snga le nyin mchog gisakyang mi sus mirig4'dra mnyam dang skad cha 'dra mnyam yin pa khasalen dang rgyun 2khyongasami byed pa dang / mi rigasakyi gnya' gnon nam yang na 'dra mnyam min pa gang dang gang la 'thab rtsod byed ma thub na/ de ni mar khe siring lugasapa zhig min par ma zad/ dmang4gtso ring lugasapa zhig kyang min zhesagasungasayod/ da ltang tsho'i 'go khrid pa la lasatang gi mi rigs srid jusadang mirigasasaganasarang skyong gi srid jus la go ba gting zab cig ma lon par mi rigasarang gi yige dang skad cha bkol bar spobasapa med cing / mirigasaring lugasapa'i zhwa mo bskon par skrag nasami rigasakyi yige dang skad cha 'phel rgyasasugatong bar 'jog 'osapa'i grub 'brasa'ajog ma thub/spyir na tang gi mi rigasasrid jusakyi dgongasapa ltar na mi rigasakyi skad dang yige yang dag gisabakol spyod byed pargyun 'khyongasabyasan/ da gzod tang gi mi rigasasrid jusalamathun pa dang / bkolaspyod mthilaphyin pamabyasan miṭ+wāṃ~Xsasrid jusal 'galab red/ de'i phyir 'brel yod 'go khrid rnams

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/—— ——— —be+e shin tu gal che/ gal te bod yig dang bod skad bkol spyod byed pa'i go skabs yong pa'i skabs garang gi mi rigs kyi skad cha bkol spyod ba/nga legasam byas na/ las byed pa phal ba dang mang tshogs la'ang de'i shan shugasajebs nges 0 na/ 'go khrid pa zhig gis rang skad bkol min de mi gcig gi gnad don lo/ nar thug sked cing / de ni rgya che'i las byed pa dang mang tshogasatham/sa cad kyis ji ltar bko'/ spyod byed pa'i gnad la thug yod par brten/der do sna nga chen po byed dgos so/ / de snga le nyin mchog gis kyang mi sus mi rigs 'dra ma/nyam dang skad cha 'dra mnyam yin pa khas len dang rgyun na khyongasami byed pa da nga / mi rigs kyi gnya' gnon nam yang na 'dra mnyam min pa gang nga/nga gang la 'thab rtsod byed ma thub na/ de de mar— khe si ring lugs pa zhig min par ma zad/ dmangs gtso ring lugs pa zhig kyang min zhesagasungs yod/ da ltang tsho'i 'go khyed pa la las tang gi mi rigs srid jusadang mi re pa/sas gnas rang skyong gi srid ju sa la go ba gting zab cig ma lon par mi rib/sa rang gi ye ge dang skad cha bko' bar sgobs pa med cing / mi rigs reng lugs pa'i zhwa mo bskon par bog nas mi rigs kyi yi ge dang skad cha 'phel rgyas sa gtong bar 'jog 'os pa'i grub 'bras 'jog ma thub/spyir na tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi dgongs pa ltar na mi rigs kyi skad dang ⑪ge yang dag gis bkol spyod byed pa rgyun 'chag byas na/ da gzod teng gi mi/ regs srid jus la mthun pa dang / bkol spyod mthil phyin pa ma byas na mi rigs srid jus la 'gal ba red/ de'i phyir 'brel yod 'go khyed rnams ri4

bod skad bkol spyod byed pa'i thad la nyatshul 'ga' brjod pa/kyisabya ba 'di gal chen zhig tu brtsisate/ mirigasakyi skad dang yige 'di mi rigasagazhan gyi skad dang yige ji bzhin bkol spyod legasapo byasanas/sngi/ṭ+wāṃ~X ṭ+wāṃ ༵ sdu/ hā r+sha yige dang skad cha 'dra mnyam gyi khri 'phang zhig gsum pa/ gangasari'i khrod na gnasapa'i bod gangasacan pa zhig la mtshon na/ mi rigasakyi 'du shesagasal bo yod pa dang / mirigasakyi brtse dung zab ro bcangs te/ mirigasarang gi rig gnas dang skad char brten nasarang re'i mi rigasa'adi dar rgyasaphun sum tshogasapa zhig yong bar stob4shugasa'abul rgyu ni smosaci dgos/ yin na'ang da lta'i grong khyer dang grong brdal sogasasubod rigasakyi lasabyed pa dang / bzo ba/ slob ma bcasakyi4mirigasarang gi skad dang yege bkolaspyod byed pa de 'dra legasapo zhig min pas/ phyisasud rung 'di phyogasakyi bya bar mthong chen ma byasan/paṇa chen rin po chesagasungasapa ltar/ de ring gi bod rigasa'adi sang nyin mañdzu rigs su'agyur rgyu red cesapa ltabu yin pas/ nged cag che chung rgan gsum kun gyi4rang gi mirigayokyi skad dang yige bkol spyod byed par 'bad brtson byed dgosapa lasagazhan/ bod rigasasakhul du rgyun sdod byed pa'i mi rigasagazhan pa'i lasabyed pa dang lasabazo ba/ slob masogasakyisakyang gtso bo'i mirigs kyi skad dang yiger sbyang dgos/ khyad par du bod rig4rang skyong khul drug gi mi rigayoslob grwa chung 'bring gi 'dzin grwa tshang mar bod skad dang bod yig khrid pa'i bslab tshan bkod sgrig ṭ+wāṃtā pa

byed bod skad bkol spyod byed pa'i thad la lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/kyis bya ba 'di gal chen zhig tu brtsis te/ mi rigs kyi skad dang a ge 'di mi rigs gzhan gyi skad dang ⑪ge ji bzhin bkol spyod legs po byas nas/mi rigs 'dra mnyam dang na ge dang skad cha 'dra mnyam gyi khri 'phang zhig ma nga 'a bar re ba don po yod/gsum pa/ gangs ri'i khrod na gnas pa'i bod gangs can pa zhig la mtshon na/ mi rigs kyi 'du shes gsal bo yo da pa dang / mi rigs kyi brtse dung zab rngo/ bcangs te/ mi rigs rang gi rig gnas dang skad char brten nas rang re'i mi rigs 'di dar rgyas phun sum tshogs pa zhig yong bar stobasashugs 'bul rgyu rgo smos ci dgos/ yin na'ang da lta 'i grong khyer dang grong brdal sogs sa bod rigs kyi las byed pa dang / bzo ba/ slob ma bcas kyis mi rigs rang gi skad dang ye ge bkol spyod byed pa de 'dra legasapo zhig min pas/ phyis sad rung 'di phyogs kyi bya bar mthong chen ma byas na/paṇa don rin po ches gsungs pa ltar/ de ring gi bod rigs 'di sang nyin mañdzu rigs su 'gyur rgyu red ces pa lta bu yin pas/ nged cag che chung rganagasu ma/ kun gyis rang gi mi rigs kyi skad dang ye ge bkol spyod byed par 'bad brtson byed dgos pa las gzhan/ bod rigs sa spa du rgyun sdod byed pa'i mi rigs gzhan pa'i las byed pa dang las bzo ba/ slob ma sogasakyis kyang gtso bo'i mi rigs kyi skad dang yi ger byi nga dgos/ khyad par du bod rigs rang skyong khul drug gi mi rigs slob grwa chung 'bring gi 'dzin grwa tshang ma ra bod skad dang bod yig khyed pa'i bslab tshan bkod sgrig byed pa485

bod kyirtsomarig dusadeb(sbrang char〉la rags tsam dpyadapa/rtsom rig bya dga' thob pa'i rtsomapa po ni nyung shasayin yang skul 'ded kyi nu4pa ni rgya chen po yin pas/ 〈sbrang char〉gyi rtsom rig bya dga' spel ba'i thabasashes de ni rtsom rig brtsam4chosakyi spusaka je legasadang / rtsom pa po'i gsar rtsom gyi spro ba je rgyasasugatong ba 'ba' zhig lasabargalate/ bod spyi'i rig gnasa'adzin skyong spel gsum bgyid par yang phan 'brasami dman pa zhig mchis/ gzhan yang spyi lo1995lo nasabazung / 〈sbrang char〉rtsom sgrig khang gi4sku bsod can gyi klog mkhan zhesapa'i bya 'gul spel te klog papo mi nyung bar bya dga' gnang bas/ bod kyi deng rabasartsomarig khyab gdal du gtong bar skula'aded bgyi4par mazad/ klog mkhan gyi tshogasapa rgya je cher bskyed pa'i cha la'ang grub 'brasagayur du za ba blangasa'adugaspyir〈sbrang char〉spelanasabagrang bya nyi shu 'khor ba'i ring la blangasapa'i grub 'brasamangon par gsal zhing phan 'brasabarjod kyisami lang mod/yin na'ang bod kyi kha dper shing 'dzer med rgya rdzong nagasan med/ mi skyon med 'dzam bu gling na med cesapa'i dpe ltar/ da ltanged rnamasakyi mthong yuladu gyur pa'i bod kyi rtsomarig brtsamasacho4kyi brjod bya'i khyab chung la/khyad par du deng rab4kyi spyi tshogasadang 'tsho bamatshon pa'i brtsamasacho4cung nyung ba dang gcig bod kyi rtsomarig brtsamasachos gsar ba'i nang du snyan ngag gi brtsamasachosam/nga ba dang lhug rtsom gyi brtsamasachosanyung ba dang gnyis/deng rab4rtsomarig brtsamasachosagragasacan skor zhig rgya yig dang dbyin ji'i skad sogasasubasgyur nasami rigasagazhan dang phyi gling par mtshama~X sbyor

bod kyi rtsom rig dus deb〈sbrang char〉la rags tsam dpyad pa/rtsom rig bya dga' thob pa'i rtsom pa po ni nyung shas yin yang skul 'ded kyi nus pa ni rgya chen po yin pas/ 〈sbrang char〉gyi rtsom rig bya dga' bas ba'i thabs shes de ni rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi spus ka ji legs dang / rtsom pa po'i gsar rtsom gyi spro ba ji rgyas sa gtong ba 'ba' zhig las brgal te/ bod spyo'i rig gnas 'dzin skyong bsha gsum bgyid par yang phan 'bras mi dam/na pa zhig mchis/ gzhan yang spyi lo1995lo nas bzung / 〈sbrang char〉stom sgrig khang gis sku bsod can gyi klog mkhan zhes pa'i be+e 'gul mkha te klog papo mi nyung bar bya dga' gnang bas/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig khyab gdal du gtong bar skul 'ded bgyis par ma zad/ klog mkhan gyi tshogasapa rgya je cher bskyed pa'i cha la'ang grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs 'dugaspyir〈sbrang char〉bsha nas bgrang be+e nyi shu sa ra ba'i ring la blangasapa'i grub 'bras mngon par gsal zhing phan 'bras brjod kyis mi lang mod/yin na'ang bod kyi kha dper shing 'dzer med rgya rdzong nags na med/ mi skyon med 'dzam bu gling na med ces pa'i dpe ltar/ da lta nged rnams kyi ma/thong yul du gyur pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi brjod bya'i khyab chang la/khyad par du deng rabs kyi spyo tshogs dang 'tsho ba mchod pa'i bcoms chos byung nyung ba dang gcig bod kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos gsar ba'i nang du snyan ngag gi brtsams chos ma/nga ba dang lhag rtsom gyi brtsam/sa chos nyung ba dang gnyis/deng rabs rtsom rig brtsams chos grags can skor zhig rgya yig dang dbyin ji'i skad sogs sa bsgyur nas mi rigs gzhan dang phyi gleng par mtshams sbyor 50

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bgyis pa nyung ba dang gsum bcas byu thad du zhan cha re ma/chis kyang / slad mar mu mthud nas gong rim 'brel yod las khungs dang dbu khrid rnams kyi lhag bsam rnam dag gi thugs khur dang rgyab rogs dang 'brel/ rtsom sgrig pa rgan gzhon yongs kyis blo sems rtse gcig ngang lhod med kyis brtson pa ba byed na/ rang re'i〈sbrang char〉dus deb 'di dbyud kyi dpal yon rgyas pa bzhin ji rgyas ji legs sa 'gro nges par ma zad/ ma 'khrungs par gangasacan 'dzin ma'i rtsom rig gi 'dab brgya'i dbus su/ rnam par mdzes pa'i me tog tsam pa ka dang ma/tshungs par lhang nger mngon thub par yid ches brtan po yod do/ /'byams klas gangs can rtsom rig dga' tshal/ las/ /legs 'khrungs〈sbrang char〉chu skyes pad ma'i dpal/ /nyams med dar rgyas phun sumatshogs pa dang / /gzhar yang gangs ri'i rgyan du gnas par sgon/ /2001lor bris/502

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bgyi4pa nyung ba dang gsum bcasakyi thad du zhan cha re mchisakyang / slad mar mu mthud nasagong rim 'brelayod lasakhungs dang dbu khrid rnamasakyi lhag bsam rnamadag gi thugasakhur dang rgyab rogasadang 'brel/ rtsomasgrig pa rgan gzhon yongasakyisablosemasartse gcig ngang lhod med kyisabartson pa bskyed na/ rang re'i〈sbrang char〉dusadeb 'di dpyid kyi dpal yon rgyasapa bzhin je rgyasaje leg4su'agro ngesapar mazad/ ma 'gyangasapar gangasacan 'dzin ma'i rtsomarig gi 'dab brgya'i dbusasu/ rnam par mdzesapa'i ༵ ṭ+wāṃg ṭ+wāṃm paka dang mtshungasapar lhang nger mngon thub par yid chesabartan da /'bya/mayokla4gangasacan rtsomarig dga' tshal las /legs 'khrungs〈sbrang char〉chu skyesapad ma'i dpal/ /nyamasamed dar rgyayophun sumatshogasapa dang / /gzhar yang gangasari'i rgyan du gnasapar smon/ /2001lor bris/502

〈mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉dus deb kyi ngo ma tshar rags tsam brjod pa/—〈mang tshogs gyu rtsal〉dus deb kyi ngo mtshar rags tsam brjod pa/'byam/sa klas mtsho sngon g.yun mkha' dbyengs la sa/ /dri ped shes rab 'od dkar rab 'dzum pa'i/ /skye rgu'i blo mun ser ba'i nya gang zla/ /mnyam ped mang tshogs byu rtsal rgyal gyur cig/ces dri med lhag bsam bar ped du bcangs pa'i shis brjod kyi chu skyes pad ma'i sil ma sngon du btang nas/ de yang 'dzin ma'i khron yongasastobagrang bya bcu phrag du mo'i ring la 'dren byed kyis ma/thong dkon pa dang sgra 'dzin gyis thos dka' ba'i bod rigs dmangs khrod kyi rin thang gzhal ped rtsom rig yod do cog slar yang nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i rgyan du spras pa'i slad du/gang gi rig gnas yon tan gyis phyug cing rnam dpyod kyi rtsal yangs pa'i dbu 'dren rnam gdang rtsom sgrig pa rnams kyis ma rungs bgegs dang bar chad thams cad sel ci thub dang / phan yon dge mtshan gyi mthun byen legasapar bsgrubs par brten/ mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal gyi chu skyes 'dab brgya de mtsho sngon kyi sa zhing yangs pa ru thog par bzhad de rgya che ba'i bod 503

(mang tshogasasgyu rtsal〉dus deb kyi ngo mtshar rags tsam brjod pa/〈mang tshogs gyu rtsal〉dus deb kyi ngo mtshar rags tsam brjod pa/'byamayoklasamatsho sngon g.yuyimakha' dbyingasalas/ /dri med shesarab 'od dkar rab 'dzumapa'i/ /skye rgu'i bloyun sel ba'i nya gang zla/ /mnyamamed mang tshog4sgyu rtsalargyal gyur cig/cesadri med lhag bsam bar med du bcangasapa'i shisabarjod kyi chu skyesapad ma'i silam sngon du btang nas/ de yang 'dzin ma'i khyon yongasasubagrangabya bcu phrag du ma'i ring la 'dren byed kyi4mthong dkon pa dang sgra 'dzin gyisathosadaka' ba'i bod rigasadamangasakhrod kyi rin thang gzhal med rtsom rig yod do cog slar yang nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i rgyan du sprasapa'i slad du/gang gi rig gnasayon tan gyisaphyug cing rnam dpyod kyi rtsal yangasapa'i dbu 'dren rnam padang rtsom sgrig pa rnamasakyisam rungasabagegasadang bar chad thamasacad sel ci thub dang / phan yon dge mtshan gyi mthun rkyen legasapar bsgrubasapar brten/ mtsho sngon mang tshogasasgyu rtsalagyi chu skyesa'adab brgya de mtsho sngon kyi gzhing yangasapa ru lhug par bzhad de rgya che ba~X ༵da

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ byedarigs mang tshogs rnams kyi lhogs pa'i zas bcud dang skom pa'i bdud rtsir gyur yo da pa 'dir dga' mgu'i glu gzhas mi gtong ba'i skye bo zhig gang na mchis/nye ba'i lo 'ga'i nang du dus deb gsar ba'i sprin rum la sa/ ban ba'i sprang char ltasa'i dmangs khrod kyi rtsom rig phun sum tshogs pa gang la gang 'tshams dang / gang gi 'dod mos ji bzhin ris med du sbyin pa nasabazung / yangs shing mu mtha' bral ba'i sa thang dang / bde zhing khod stoms pa'i zhing kha/ 'du 'dzi lang long 'khrigs pa'i dus ston dang gnyen ston la sogs pa'i khrod du/ lhang lhang gi gnyen bshad dang ston bshad/ yid 'gug pa'i glu dang la gzhas 'bol dkar la sogs pa'i snyan 'jebs kyi pi wang gcig las gcig lhag tu sbreng bzhin gda' bas/ ngo mas bod rigasadamangs khrod kyi rtsom/ rig thad du dbyar mtsho bzhin rgyas shing dpyid dpal 3ra 'bar ba'i rnam pa gsar ba zhig rim gyis shar byung /lhag par du sa thang gi na gzhon skye pho mo rnams kyis mang tshogs sgyu rtsal mig gis ma thong ba na gces nor ji bzhin bdag dam byed par ma zad/dus chad bgos nas phan tshan la g.yar te nya7ba/ yang na chabs cig tu dus deb las gna' gtam bshad pa dang glu gzhas len pa/ shags 'debs pa/de min la la sa rang gi 'bri deb steng du bshus nas phyugs rjes su rgyun du klog pa dang / la las nangs dgong gi dus tshod bod spyad de blo la 'dzin bzhin mchis shing / ngo ma grangs las 'das pa'i klog pa po rnam sa kyis lhag bsam 504

gcod pa don grubadang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ring lugasakyi bsamapa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i thad la'ang khrid ston rang bzhin gyi don snying gal chenaldan yod/ de'i phyir khyed rtsom sgrig pa rnamasalabaka' drin dang bkra shisabade legasayang yang zhu zhes ma bcoyosem4kyi gtam bzang phyog4kyi bu mo'i rna ba'i rgyan du gyur to/ /gzhan yang mtsho sngon mang tshogasasgyu rtsalagyi snyan grag4de 'dra mtho zhing skye bo phal cher gyi blomig cig car du 'gug thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin ṭ+wāṃ na/ de la ngo mtshar ba'i phan 'brasabasnyon du med pa'adi 'dra zhig yod pa de yang dmangasakhrod du dar srol shin tuche ba'i glu dang la gzhas/'brasadakar/ ston bshad/ gab tshig gna' gtam la sogs nyamasapa sor chud dang nyamasamed rgyun bsringasate rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kyi spyan sngar mngon pa dang gcig gna' rabasakyi ljagasartsomaphul du byung ba dang /spun zlamirigasagazhan pa'i rtsomarig mtshamasasbyor dang / deng rabasakyi mirigasarang gi mkhasapa dang gsar slob pa rnamasakyi rtsom rig sna tshogasabakod par phan 'brasagazhaladu med padang gnyis/ gsar byung na gzhon rtsomapa pokhri stong mang po'i rtsom rig bdamasabakod byed pa'i ldum ra dang / blo rig gam rtsomartsalagasosbyong byed pa'i slob dpon ltabur gyur yod padang gsum/snyan ngag dang mngon brjod brda rnying sog4kyisarab tu ma bcingasapar/mang tshogasakyi skad dang phalacher mthun pa'i sgo nasartsom rig dag legasasgrig dadī kyāsar rtsom byasapas/ yon tan dma' ba'i mang tshogasagang gisakyang

gcod pa don grub dang snying bom ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /—— ———ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i dpal yon 'tshags skrun byed pa'i thad la'ang khyed ston rang bzhin rgya don snying gal chen ldan yod/ de'i phyir khyed rtsom sgrig pa rnams la bka' drin dang bkra shis bde legs yang yang zhu zhes ma bcos sems kyi gtam bzang phyogs kyi bu mo' rna ba'i rgyan du gyur to/ /gzhan yang mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal gyi snyan grags de 'dra mtho zhing skye bo phal cher gyi blo mig cig car du 'gug thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ de la ngo mtshar ba'i phan 'bras bston du med pa 'di 'dra zhig yo da pa ste/de yang dmangs khrod du dar sgom shin tu che ba'i gru dang la gzhas/'bras dkar/ ston bshad/ gab tshig gna' gtam la sogs nyams pa sor byed dang nyams med rgyun bsrings te rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kyi spyan lngar mngon pa dang gcig gna' rabs kyi lngags rtsom phul du byung ba dang /spun zla mi rigs gzhan pa'i rtsom rig mtshams sbyor dang / deng rabs kyi mi rigs rang gi mkhas pa dang gsar slob pa rnams kyi rtsom rig sna tshogs bkod par phan 'bras gzhal du med pa dang gnyis/ gsar byung na gzhon rtsom pa po khri stong mang po'i rtsom rig bdams bkod byed pa'i khrum ra dang / blo rig gam rtsom rtsal gso sbyong byed pa'i slob dpon lta bur gyur byed pa dang gsum//snyan ngag dang mngon brjod brda rnying sogs kyis rab tu ma bcings par/mang tshogs kyi skad dang phal cher mthun pa'i sgo nas rtsom rig dag legs sgrig dang gsar rtsom byas pas/ yon tan dma' ba'i mang chogs gang gis kyang 506

〈mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉dus deb kyi ngo mtshar rags tsam brjod pa/go bde zhing klog skab dang bzhi/ slob grwa ru zhugs pa'i skal ba med pa'i na gzhon pho mo dang lo chung byis pa rnams kyi yig rmongs sel ba dang rig gnasakhyab gdal byed pa'i nus pa gal chen thon pa dang lnga/ de min tang gi srid jus dang byed phyogs/ deng rabs can bzhi 'dzu 1 gas skrun byed pa'i rlabasachen gyi dgongs don dril bsgrags dang / 'brog pa'i sa thang gi rig gnasa'atsho ba gson nyams lda na zhing hur por gtong ba la sogs pa'i thad du'ang phan 'bras bla na ma mchis pa bcas so/ /'o na gsar byung gi dus deb 'dir skyon dri ma tsam gyis kyang ma gosasam zhe na/ min te/ kha dper shing 'dzer med rgya rdzong nags na med/ mi skyon sked 'dzam bu gling na med ces pa ltar dus deb dus thog tu par du bskrun khrung khrog pa po rnams kyi lag tu dus thog tu 'byor dkon pa dang gcigartsom/ sgrig pa'i stobs shugs zhan pas dus deb steng du rtag tu yig nor dang tshig nor cung mang ba dang gnyis/ dus deb kyi par skrun kha grangs mang yang sa thag ring ba dang 'brog pa'i sa thang gi na gzhon pho mo mang che shos kyi re ba skong mi thub pa dang / dus deb steng du sa cha re re'i grong skad las brjod na/ma/do dbus kham/sa gsum yongs kyis go mi thub pas/ phyis su bod spyi'i go thub pa'i thun mong gi yi ge dang tshig bkol nas rtsom rig sna tshogs bris na legs po 'byung thub pa dang bzhi bcas kyi phyogs gzung zad legs bcosabyed dgos pa'i re ba chen po yod mod/ 'on te ma 'khyangs par dam 'dzin dang legs 'dzin byas te sems can kun gyi rig pa'i blo sgo 'byed byed kyi lde 507

(mngatshogasasgyusal〉dus deb kyi ngo mtshar ragasatsam brjod pa/go bde zhing klog slab dang bzhi/ slob grwa ru zhugasapa'i skalab med pa'i na gzhon pho mo dang lochung byi4pa rnamasakyi yig rmongasasel ba dang rig gnasakhyab gdal byed pa'i nusapa gal chen thon pa dang lnga/ de min tang gi srid jugadang byed phyogs/ deng rabasacan bzhi 'dzug4skrun byed pa'i rlabasachen gyi dgong4donadrilabasgragasadang / 'brog pa'i cathang gi rig gnasa'atsho bgason nyam4ldan zhing hur por gtong ba la sogasapa'i thad du'ang phan 'brasabla na mamachi4pa bca4so/ /'o na gsar byung gi dusadeb 'dir skyon dri matsam gyisakyang mgosasam zhe na/ min te/ kha dper shing 'dzer med rgya rdzong nagasan med/ mi skyon med 'dzam bu gling na med cesapa ltar dusadeb dusathog tu par du bskrun kyang klog pa po rnamasakyi lag tu dusathog tu 'byor dkon pa dang gcigartsom sgrig pa'i stobasashug4zhan pasadusadeb steng du rtag tu yig nor dang tshig nor cung mang ba dang gnyis/ dusadeb kyi par skrun kha grangasamang yang sathag ring ba dang 'brog pa'i sathang gi na gzhon pho mo mang che shosakyi re ba skong mi thub pa dang / dusadeb steng du sacha re re'i grong skad lasabarjod na/mdo dbu4khamasagasumayongasakyisago mithub pas/ phyisasubod spyi'i go thub pa'i thun mong gi yege dang tshig bkolanasartsomarig sna tshogasabrisan legasapo 'byung thub pa dang bzhi bcas kyi phyogasasucung zad leg4bcosabyed dgosapa'i re ba chen po yod mod/ 'on te ma 'gyangasapar dam 'dzin dang legasa'adzin byasate semasacan kun gyi rig pa'i blosko 'byed byetā 0ṭ+wāṃ lde

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /—mig dang legs nyes blangs dor 'byed byed kyi me long / tsha gdung sel byed kyi bdud ster 'gyur bar yid ches brtan po yo da do/ /'dir smras pa/rmad byung dus deb gsar ba'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /rab dkar lhag bsam yid kyis che long tsam/ /brjod kyang bla med dge mtshan/ gsar ba'i dpal/ /ji bzhin lhang nger ma mngon yid re mug/1986lor bris/

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /mig dang legasanyesablangasador 'byed byed kyi me long / tsha gdung sel byed kyi bdud rtsir 'gyur bar yid chesabartan po yod do/ /'dir smrasapa/rmad byung dusadeb gsar ba'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /rab dkar lhag bsamayid kyi4che long tsam/ /brjod kyang blamed dge mtshan gsar ba'i dpal/ /ji bzhinalhang nger mamangon yid re mug/1986lor bris/

〈klu 'bum mi rgod〉ces pa ba lnga gas rjes kyi 'char snang /byed——— —byedabartsams sgrung〈klu 'bum mo god〉ces pa bklags rjes kyi 'char snang /de yang na gzhon rtsom pa po nags po skal bzang nyid kyis brtsamasapa'i〈klu 'bum mi rgod〉ces pa'i brtsam/sa sgrung ni bod rigs dmangs khrod du dar khyab shin tu che ba'i bod gangs can gyi dpa' chen skad grags can klu 'bum mi rgod du grags pa'i ngag rgyun gzhir bzung ste/ deng rabs kyi rtog bzo'i sgyu rtsal la brten nas dus skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi tsha rlabs drag po'i 'tsho ba'i khrod du skyes mchog klu 'bum mi rgod kyis 'jig rten 'dir bzhag pa'i mdzad 'phrin zhib tu brjod yod/bod gangs can yongs kyis bsngags par 'os pa'i klu 'bum mi rgod ni gzhon pa'i lo 'dab yongs tshom rgyas pa'i skabs nas bzung / drag rtsal la mkhas shing dpa' ngar ldan pa dang / blo rig glog la sa myur zhing mthu stobs mkha' dang mnyam pa/ gnyom chung skyong la pha ma dang btsan po gnon la tho ba ji bzhin drag byams gnyis ldan gyi skyes bu 'gran zla bral ba zhig la gas/ khong gi mtshan snya na grags ni gna' nas bzung srid gsum khams su khyab 'dug509

(klu'abum mi rgod〉cesapabaklagasarjes kyi'achar snang /brtsama~Xzlo sad+dhi ༵bhū ༵ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃd+nghaṭ+wāṃces pa de yang na gzhon rtsomapa po nag4po skal bzang nyid kyisabartsamasapa'i〈klu 'bumami rgod〉cesapa'i brtsamasasgrung ni bod rigasadamangs khrod du dar khyab shin tu che ba'i bod gangasacan gyi dpa' chen skad gragasacan klu 'bum mi rgod du gragasapa'i ngag rgyun gzhir bzung ste/ deng rabasakyi rtog bzo'i sgyu rtsal la brten nasadusaskabasade'i spyi tshogasakyi tsha rlabasadrag po'i 'tsho ba'i khrod du skyesamachog klu 'bum mi rgod kyisa'ajig rten 'dir bzhag pa'i mdzad 'phrin zhib tu brjod yod/bod gangasacan yongayokyi4bsngagasapar 'o4pa'i klu 'bumamirgod ni gzhon pa'i lo 'dab yongasasumargyasapa'i skabasanasabazung / drag rtsal la mkhasashing dpa' ngar ldan pa dang / blo rig glog lasamyur zhing mthu stobasamakha' dang mnyam pa/ gnyom chung skyong lapha ma dang btsan po gnon la tho ba ji bzhin drag byamasaganyisaldan gyi skyesabu 'gran zla bral ba zhig lags/ khong gi mtshan snyan gragasani gna' nasabazung srid gsum khamasasukhyab 'dug 509

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/skyes mchog klu 'bum na rgod ces gleng na mdo dbus khams gsum gyi bod rigs skye bo g.yin yang rgyu mtshan nyung tsam zhig bshad mi shes pa gcig kyang med pa 'dra/ khong gi ngo mtshar ldan pa'i gtam rgyud dag gangs can ljongs yongs gagan 'a nas da dang bar phal cher sa khyab rdo khyab tu gyur yod/rtsom pa pos 'di 'dra'i brjod be+e khyab che zhing don dang lda na pa zhig bzung ste rtsom rig gi rtog bzo'i rtsom stangs la brten nas go rim yod pa'i brtsams yang ring gras 'di 'dra zhig brtsams te/ rgya che ba'i gangs can pa rnams kyi spyan sngar 'bul ba'i dmigs bya gco bo ni/ gdong dmar bod rang gi gdung rgyud las skyes pa'i dpa' nod phul du byung ba klu 'bum mi rgod gyi mdzad rjes zan ma mchis pa rnams la bsngags brjod kyi pe tog 'bul 'dod pa dang gcig skyes mchog klu 'bum mi rgod kyi lo rgyus brjod pa dang bstun nas ma rungs spyod pa'i dug nag 'gog par blo stobs ldan dgos pa dang / tshal ldan spyod bzang gi byams sems lda na dgos pa'i slob gso' bsam blo mtshon yod pa dang gnyis/ deng dus rgyal khab phyi nang gi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi rtsom stangs la brten nas dam ngas khrod ngag rgyun gyi rtsom rig 'dzin skyong blta gsum byed 'dod kyi kun slong lhad med cig ma/tshon yod pa dang gsum/ gna' rabs bod kyi lo rgyus dang yal sol/ gna' mi bod kyi yid khams dang bod kyi drag rtsal rgyag tshal sogs shes su 'jug 'dod pa dang bzhi'i sgo nas gsal bor bstan 'dug pa dang/ da dung rtsom pa pos mirigs rang gi dpa' bor bcangs pa'i brtse dung dang 'du shes/ la rgya 51

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/skyesamachog klu 'bumamirgod ce4gleng na mdo dbusakhamasagasum gyi bod rigasaskye bo suyin yang rgyu mtshan nyung tsam zhig bshad mi she4pa gcig kyang med pa 'dra/ khong gi ngo mtshar ldan pa'i gtam rgyud dag gangasacan ljongasayongasasugana' nasad lta'i bar phal cher sakhyabardo khyab tu gyur yod/rtsomapaposa'adi 'dra'i brjod bya khyab che zhing don dang ldan pa zhig bzung ste rtsomarig gi rtog bzo'i rtsom stangasal brten nasago rimayod pa'i brtsamasaskrung ring grasa'adi 'dra zhig brtsamasate/ rgya che ba'i gangasacan pa rnamayokyi spyan sngar 'bul ba'i dmigasabya gtso bo ni/ gdong dmar bod rang gi gdung rgyud lasaskyesapa'i dpa' rgod phuladu byung ba klu 'bum mi rgod gyi mdzad rjesablan ma mchi4pa rnam4la bsngagasabarjod kyi me tog 'bul 'dod pa dang gcig skye4mchog klu 'bum mi rgod kyi lo rgyusabarjod pa dang bstun nasam rung4spyod pa'i dug nag 'gog par mistobasaldan dgosapa dang / tshul ldan spyod bzang gi byamasasemasaldan dgosapa'i slob gso'i bsam blomatshon yod pa dang gnyis/ deng du4rgyal khab phyi nang gi rtsomarig sgyu rtsal gyi rtsomastangasal brten nasadamangasakhrod ngag rgyun gyi rtsom rig 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed 'dod kyi kun slong lhad med cig mtshon yod pa dang gsum/ gna' rabasabod kyi lo rgyusadang yulasrol/ gna' mi bod kyi yid khamasadang bod kyi drag rtsal rgyag tshul sog4shesasu'ajug 'dod pa dang bzhi'i sgo nasagasal bor bstan 'dug pa dang / da dung rtsom pa posami rikā~Xrang gi dpa' bor bcangasapa'i brtse dung dang 'du shes/ la rgya

〈klu 'bum mi rgod〉ces pa bklags rjes kyi 'char snang/sogs kyang shugs sumatshon yod pa de'o/ /bcoms sgrung 'di'i rjod byed tshig gi thad nas bltas na/ snyan ngag dang brda rnying gis ma bcings par rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kun gyis go ma ba'i lam/ nas bcoms yo da/ khyad par du btsams sgrung ni tshig spyor bde zhing mdzes nyams ldan pa zhig red/ dper na brtsams sgrung las yal ljongs kyi skor bris 'dug pa ni 'di lta ste/ rdza lam de'i g.yas g.yon du sngo ljang snum gyi ler yod pa'i thang shing dang shug sdong sogs rlung khrod du gar stabs sna tshogasasgyur bzhin ma chis/ rlung bser bus sa dang rtsi shing sogs byug byug byed pa'i skad snyan dang / bya dang bye'u sna tshogs kyis dbyangs snyan kyu ru ru len pa'i skad snyan gyis mi la nyams dga' sgo snang 'phel ba'i snang ba zhig ngangangam shugs kyis ster/ zhes pa lta bur ma/tshon na/ ngo mas mig gi spyod yal du ma dzes ljongs yid du 'ong ba zhig shar ba'i tshor snang bcos min zhig ster thub par ma zad/ yid la'ang spro ba'i dga' ston gyi dpal ster thub/ da dung brtsams sgrung du dmangs khrod kyi ngag rgyun la dar rgya shin tu che ba'i gtam dpe 'os shing 'tshams pa mang po bkod yod kyang 'dir yig tshogasamang bar dogs nas dper blangs nas zhib tu brjod rgyu min/ gzhan yang mi sna zhib 'bri'i thad du yang rjod byed tshig lagason nyams ldan zhing yid 'gug gi nus pa thon yod/ dper na/ do bsdo ltab mig gis mi bzod pa zhig bris pa 'di ltar/ do bsdo de'i bo zhing rid pa'i gdong dang sgom zhing shugs sto bas lda na pa'i lus gzugs ni gnam yol du bris pa'i mgo bo chung 511

klu 'bum mi rgod〉ces pa bklags rjes kyi 'char snang /sogasakyang shug4sumatshon yod pa de'o/ /brtsamasasgrung 'di'i rjod byed tshig gi thad nasabaltasan/ snyan ngag dang brda rnying gisam bcingasapar rgya che ba'i mang tshogasakun gyisago slaba'i lam nasabartsamasayod/ khyad par du brtsamasasgrung nitshig sbyor bde zhing mdzesanyamasaldan pa zhig red/ dper na brtsam4sgrung lasayul ljongasakyi skor brisa'adug pa ni 'di ltaste/ rdza lamade'i g.yasagayon du sngo ljang snum gyi ler yod pa'i thang shing dang shug sdong sogasarlung khrod du gar stabasasna tshogasasgyur bzhin mchis/ rlung bser busacadang rtsi shing sog4byug byug byed pa'i skad snyan dang / bya dang bye'u snatshogasakyisadabyangasasnyan kyu ru ru len pa'i skad snyan gyisamilanyamasadaga' sprosnang 'phelaba'i snang ba zhig ngang ngamashugasakyi4ster/ zhesapa ltabur mtshon na/ ngo masamig gi spyod yul du mdzesaljong4yid du 'ong ba zhig shar ba'i tshor snang bcosamin zhig ster thub par ma zad/ yid la'ang spro ba'i dga' ston gyi dpalaster thub/ da dung brtsamasasgrung du dmangasakhrod kyi ngag rgyun ladar rgya shin tuche ba'i gtam dpo'osashing 'tsham4pa mang po bkod yod kyang 'dir yig tshogasamang bar dogasanasadaper blangayon4zhib tubarjod rgyu min/ gzhan yang misna zhib 'bri'i thad du yang rjod byed tshig lagason nyamasaldan zhing yid 'gug gi nusapa thon yod/ dper na/ do bsdo ltab mig gisamibazod pa zhig brisapa 'di ltar/ do bsdo de'i bozhing rid pa'i gdong dang sbom zhing shugasasto bsalda na pa'i lu4gzugasani gnayoyoladu brisapa'i mgo ༵ chung

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo ma ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/— sde pa —zhing lus stobs che ba'i gangs seng dkar mo de dang gnyis sum/ ma ches/zhes pa lta bur mchod na'ang / bklags ma thag tu lta ba 'jigs su rung ba'i grwa rgod do bsdo zhig mig mdun du shar thub pa'i nus pa thon yod/ 'di lta1bu'i mi rigs rang gi cha lugs dang khyad chos la mthun pa'i mi sna zhib 'bri byed pa ni mi rigs gzhan zhig gis 'ju dka' mo 'dugagazhan yang rtsom pa pos klu 'bum mi rgod ces pa'i klu 'bum zer ba ji ltar thon pa'i lo rgyus kyang 'u nga dang ma/thun pa zhig brjod 'dug pa 'di 3 ra/klu 'bum mi rgod khong gi dge rgan grub thob rnal 'byor ba sgon pas/ khyod sngon chad kyi khyod dang 'bral dgos pa'i rkyen zus khyong/ la ming gas rab zhig 'dogs dgos/ de ring nas bzung 'u gnyis ka dge slob tu gyur pas/ngas khyod chu mig rdzong gi sgrub phug tu 'did rgyu yin/ chu mig rdzong ni klu ma nga po khye ma 'bum gyi bzhugs gnas yin la/ khyod rang gnas der ma/jal ba dang 'u gnyis dge slob tu gyur pa rten 'brel shin tu 'grig de bas khyod kyi ming la klu 'bum zhes bos na ji 'dra red ces bris 'dug klu 'bum mi rgod kyi ming byung rim gyi tshan pa 'di bklags rjes spyir rtog bzo yin yang don la klog pa po'i yid la dngos gnas kyi 'char snang zhig dbang ped du shar thub/'di 'dra'i rtsom thabs ni bod mi rigs kyi 'tsho ba'i byung rim/ dngos dang mthun pas don la gnas so/ /brtsams sgrung 'di'i rtsom stangs ni tshig lhug kho nar brten nas brtsams pa min te/ de be+e bod gna' rabs kyi rtsom stangs bcad lhug bsha 512

gcod pa don grub dngasnying bo tshering gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhing lu4stob4che ba'i gangasaseng dkar mo de dang gnyisasum mchis/zhesapa ltabur mtshon na'ang / bklag4ma thag tu ltab 'jigasasurung ba'i grwa rgod do bsdo zhig mig mdun du shar thub pa'i nus pa thon yod/ 'di ltabu'i mirigasarang gi cha lugs dang khyad chosal mthun pa'i mi sna zhib 'bri byed pa ni mirigasagazhan zhig gi4'bri dka' mo 'dugagazhan yang rtsom pa posaklu 'bum mi rgod cesapa'i klu 'bum zer ba ji ltar thon pa'i lo rgyusakyang lung dang mthun pa zhig brjod 'dug pa 'di ltar/klu 'bum mi rgod khong gi dge rgan grub thob rnal 'byor ba spyon pas/ khyod sngon chad kyi khyod dang 'bral dgosapa'i rkyen gyisakhyod la ming gsar ba zhig 'dogs dgos/ de ring nasabazung 'u gnyisaka dge slob tu gyur pas/ngasakhyod chu mig rdzong gi sgrub phug tu 'khrid rgyu yin/ chu mig rdzong ni klu mang po khri ma 'bum gyi bzhugayoganasayin la/ khyod rang gnas der mjal ba dang 'u gnyisadage slob tu gyur pa rten 'brel shin tu 'grig de bsakhyod kyi ming la klu 'bum zhesabosan ji 'dra red cesabrisa'adug klu 'bum mi rgod kyi ming byung rim gyi tshan pa 'di bklagasarjesaspyir rtog bzo yin yang don la klog pa po'i yid la dngosaganasakyi 'char snang zhig dbang med du shar thub/'di 'dra'i rtsom thabasani bod mirigasakyi 'tsho ba'i byung rim dngosadang mthun pasadon la gnasaso/ /brtsamasasgrung 'di'i rtsom stangasani tshig lhug kho nar brten nasabatswa~Xpa min te/ de ni bod gna' rabasakyi rtsom stangasabacad lhug spel

〈klu 'bum mi rgod〉ces pa bklags rjes kyi 'char sna nga /ma'igros kyang bkod yod/ khyad par du phan tshun kha brda bgyid pa'i skabasasatshigasabacad snyan zhing 'jeb4pa'i lamanasabarjod pa desabartsam4sgrung gi rjod tshig phun sum tshogasapar btang 'dugad dung rtsom pa posaklog mkhan rnam4kyi yid dbang 'gug pa'i phyir/brtsams sgrung gi le'u re re'i mjug tu lta'adod shin tu che ba'i 'gal ba chen po zhig byung ba'i 'gag sgor glo bur du mjug bsduba'i 'bri srol bkod yod/'di 'dra'i rtsom stangasargya rigasakyi brtsamasasgrung gsar rnying du mthong rgyu yod kyang rang re'i bod kyi rtsom rig gi nang du ma thong ba ha cang dkon/ nga tshosagang nusakyis rtsom stangasaleg4po sna tshogs spyad de dar khyab tu btang na mi sdiga~Xra~X gi rtsoma'abri'i sgyu rtsal je mtho je legasasu'agro bar phan thogasargya yon ṭ+wāṃ/rdo ༵/'ang srid pa'i kha dper rta rgyug san rti li kha kher losayod zer ba ltar/ phyisasu(klu 'bumami rgod〉kyi brtsamasasgrung ring gas 'di rtsom rig khri stong mang po'i 'dab brgya'i dbu4sulhug par bzhad pa'i gang4lhametog ji bzhin snyan gragasakyi dbyar rnga phyogasabazhi ma/tshamasabargyad du khyab pa'i slad du/ kho bos gsham du lhag bsam dri med kyi re ba 'ga' bton na/ gcig ni brtsams sgrung gi mi sna gtso bo klu 'bum mirgod nyid blo rig rgod cing dpa' ngar rtul phod can zhig yin par mazad/ dgra grogasakyi shan 'byed dang /legasanyesablang dor gyi rnamadapyod rab tu yangasapa zhig kyang yin par brten/'di phyogasazhib 'bri'i skabasasacung tsama'abur thon byasan leg4pa/ ṭ+wāṃm/

〈klu 'bum mi rgod〉ces pa bklags rjes kyi 'char sna nga/byed —byedam/'i srol kyang bkod yod/ khyad par du phan tshun kha brda bgyid pa'i skabs su tshigs bcad snyan zhing 'jibs pa'i lam nas brjod pa des brtsams sgrung gi rjod tshig phun sum tshogs par btang 'dugad dung stom pa pos klog ma/khan rnams kyi yid dbang 'gug pa'i phyir/brtsams sgrung gi le'u re re'i mjug tu lta7'dod shin tu che ba'i 'gal ba can po zhig byung ba'i 'gag sgor glo bur du mjug bsdu ba'i 'bri sol bkod yod/'di 'dra'i rtsom sta ngas rgya rigs kyi brtsams sgrung gsar rnying du mthong rgyu yod kyang rang re'i bod kyi rtsom rig gi nang du ma thong ba ha cang dkon/ nga tshos gang nus kyis rtsom stangs legs po sna tshogs spyad de dar khyab tu btang na mi rigs rang gi rtsom 'bri'i sgyu rtsal ji ma tho ji legs ga 'gro bar phan thogs rgya ra po mchis /yin na'ang srid pa'i kha dper rta rgyug san rti li kha kher los yod zer ba rta/ra/ phyis su〈klu 'bum mi rgod〉kyi brtsams sgrung ring gras 'di rtsom/ rig khye stong mang po'i 'dab brgya'i dbus sa lhag par bzhad pa'i gangs lha‘pe tog ji bzhin snyan grags kyi dbyar rnga phyogs bzhi ma tshams brgyad du khyab pa'i be+e da du/ kho bos gsham du lhag bsam dri sked kyi re ba 'ga' bton na/ gcig ni brtsams sgrung gi mi sna gtso bo klu 'bum mi rgod nyid blo rig rgod cing dpa' ngar rtul phod can zhig yin par ma zad/ dgra grogs kyi shan 'byed dang /legs nyes blang dor gyi rnam dpyod rab tu yangs pa zhig kyang yin par brten/'di phyogs zhib 'bri'i skabs sa cung tsam 'bur thon byas na legs par snyam//513

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/gnyisani dmangasakhrod ngag rgyun gyi klu 'bum mirgod ni stobasashugasa'agran zla med pa'i skyesabu zhig yin pa lasagazhan rdzu 'phrulaldan pa'i mizhig kyang yin phyir lhaskung gi grub cha je mang du btang na brtsamasasgrung gi sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin mtho ru 'degasathub snyam/ gsum ni rjod byed tshig gi thad du spyir phun sumatshogasapa zhig yin yang rjod tshig gi sgyu rtsalamathor 'degasayong ba'i slad du tshigasabacad kyi skor cung je mang labatang na tshig shugasaje che dang je bzang du 'gro thub snyamamo/ /spyir brtsamasasgrung〈klu 'bum mi rgod〉cesapa 'di'i brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed tshig gi phyogasagang thad du bltasakyang sgrung rtsom gyi khyad chosadang mthun par ma zad/ blo gsal klog pa po spyi dang / lhag par du rong 'brog khul gyi rgya che ba'i klog pa po rnams kyis lta'adod ha cang che ba'i sgrung rtsom zhig tu yang gyur yod pas/ brtsamasasgrung 'di rigasakyi skor mumathud ṭ+wāṃ r+shaṭ+wāṃ :sdo /k+ta/r+sha rgyu ni bdag dang bdag 'dra'i skye bo kun gyi re 'dun 1992lor bris/514

gcod pa don grub dang snying bo tshe ring gi ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis ni dmangs khrod ngag rgyun gyi klu 'bum mi rgod be+e stobs shugs 'gran zla med pa'i skyes bu zhig yin pa las gzhan rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i mi zhig kyang yin phyir lha sgrung gi grub cha je mang du btang na brtsams sgrung gi sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin mtho ru 'degs thub snyam/ gsum be+e rjod byed tshig gi thad du spyir phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin yang rjod tshig gi sgyu rtsal mthor 'degs yong ba'i slad du tshigs bcad kyi skor cung ji mang la btang na tshig shugs je che dang je bzang du 'gro thub snyam mo/ /spyir brtsams sgrung〈klu 'bum mi rgod〉ces pa 'di'i brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed tshig gi phyogs gang thad du bltas kyang sgrung rtsom gyi khyad chosadang mthun par ma zad/ blo gsal klog pa po spyi dang / lhag par du rong 'brog khul gyi rgya che ba'i klog pa po rnams kyis lta 'dod ha cang che ba'i sgrung rtsom zhig tu yang gyur yod pas/ brtsams sgrung 'di rigs kyi skor mu mthud du dar khyab tu gtong rgyu ni bdag dang bdag 'dra'i skye bo kun gyi re 'dun zlog tu sted pa zhig go /1992lor bris/514
